His friends call him "Goodie-goodie" and "Hasabe" due to his straight-laced and honest behavior. He has a piercing on his left ear and likes wombats.

58691.description: A human girl who works part time at Shirokuma Cafe.

58697.description: Unlike Panda, he's a full-time employee at the zoo. He's also a tissue-pack distributor in his spare time, even doing it at work. He has a wife and three kids. One of his hobbies is making mecha.   ~!Full-Time Panda transfers to Singapore in episode 44, along with his family. He keeps in touch with Panda now via postcards.!~

58839.description: One of the students in 3-3. She has a cheerful personality and speaks with Sakakibara in his first day in the school. She is also in the drama club, and good friends with Arita Matsuko and Izumi Akazawa.   ~!She dies in a car accident - when her family was trying to escape from Yomiyama. It was raining a lot, and soon when they were on a road that looked like highway - something hit the car's front glass, making the car drift off from the road, and falling into the nearest forest.!~

58845.description:
Occupation: Middle School Student 
Grade: 3rd year, 3rd class Attendance Number: 3. Height: 160 cm.  

A girl with a bob cut, turned down eyes and a baby face, which makes her look a bit younger. She is quite lucky and has many friends.

58865.description: Class 3-3 students.   ~!He was burned to death when the dining hall exploded.!~  (Source: Another Wiki)

58867.description:
Student in Class 3-3.   ~! In the novel,he dies during the assasin attack while in the manga he dies in the fire.In the anime he was stabbed but Kouichi and the others found him and bring him outside.!~
(Source: Another Wiki)

58881.description: 3-3 classmate. He appears to have a crush on Akazawa. He also seems to be car sick.    ~!While swimming to the beach ball which had flown into sea he gets unconscious and he was probably already dead while he was floating in the water. Seconds after Kouichi, Naoya and Katsumi rushed into the water to help him he got hit by a boat. After his funeral Chibiki shares his thoughts with Kouichi and Mei. According to the police and his parents he had hit his head which was the cause of his death which meant the cause of the death happened in Yomiyama. !~

58885.description:
**Height:** 165 cm

Tsugumi is a hitwoman who was raised and trained by [Claude](https://anilist.co/character/82933/Claude-Ringheart) of the Beehive Gangsters.

Tsugumi is originally introduced as a guy who transfers to [Chitoge](https://anilist.co/character/48391/Chitoge-Kirisaki)'s class, and has orders to protect her from [Raku](https://anilist.co/character/48393/Raku-Ichijou), whom she thinks forced Chitoge into the relationship. She and Chitoge are childhood friends; she tries to keep a ten year old promise of becoming strong to protect Chitoge. However, after Raku treats her nicely, she begins to develop some feelings for him, even though she is too stubborn and embarrassed to admit it.

In America, her assassin code name is "Black Tiger", who had a rivalry with "[White Fang](https://anilist.co/character/84917/McCoy-Paula)". She does well academically, having ranked next to Chitoge on a yearly exam.

59317.description:
**Affiliation:** Student Council and Supernatural Studies

Council vice president and supernatural club vice president. Knows of [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/57489/Yamada-Ryuu) and [Shiraishi](https://anilist.co/character/57491/Shiraishi-Urara) switching secret.

59319.description:
A former artillery officer from an Asian country, he was discharged from the military after a deadly training accident and was later recruited by Koko. He is the only member on Koko's team that has a family. He is put in charge of giving Jonah science lessons.  

 (Source: Wikipedia)

59329.description:
A former police sniper who was once part of the counter-terrorist unit, until he becomes one of Koko's mercenaries.   

(Source: ANN)

59345.description: Kurosu Ouma was the father of the main protagonist, Shu Ouma and his older sister Mana Ouma. After the death of his wife Saeko Shijou, he married Haruka.  A genius, he was the scientist who discovered Void Genome to be an inhibitor of Apocalypse Virus. Together with Shuichiro Keido, his friend and fellow scientist, he led the research about the Apocalypse Virus. However, over the years, Keido's became increasingly embittered towards Kurosu as he witnessed his colleague's success and intellect steadily eclipse his own.

name.native: ウィリアム・ネルソン（ワイリ）

59435.description:
An Afro-American explosive expert and ex-lieutenant of the 20th Engineer Brigade of the XVIII Airborne Corps in the US Army. Graduated from University of Virginia School of Architecture. Wiley met Lehm and Echo in the first Gulf War when he was assigned to blow up a chemical factory. After several years, Wiley paid Lehm a visit and met Koko. His real name is William Nelson. He is put in charge of giving Jonah English lessons. He is the only person on the team aside from Koko to be blacklisted by the FBI.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name.native: レナート・ソッチ（アール）

59439.description: A former Italian Army Bersaglieri intelligence officer who now works for Koko.   ~!R is the CIA's mole from the day he worked with Bookman in Bosnia during the Bosnian Wars. He is eventually killed by Hex while protecting Koko.!~

59513.description: Tetsurou's brother-in-law who is married to his sister Manami.

59643.description:
__Hometown:__	Moscow, Russia

Kaname is a Prism Star with unexpectedly high skills despite her young age. She is considered a genius, due to the fact that she can remember whole routines by only seeing them once.

59763.description: A young man with poor eyesight who works part-time in a flower shop. He falls hard for the shop-owner, Rokka. He is dedicated and stubborn in regards to his feelings towards her. He is the only one who is able to see her husbands ghost and regularly argues with him.

59765.description: The flower-shop owner, however the shop she runs belongs to her decease husband, Shimao. She is completely unaware of his spiritual presence around her. Before he died, he told her to forget about him and move on to find new love, however she still stubbornly clings to memories of him.

59771.description: Shinnosuke's goal is to become a veterinarian however, he first has to overcome his dilemma with the practice of euthanasia on animals.

59773.description: Round like an egg as her name implies (tamago means egg in Japanese), Tamako is a 1st Year Dairy Farming Program student who is not afraid to speak her mind. She excels in accounting and is obsessed with micromanaging money. ~!Over summer she goes on a diet and slims down considerably to the point where most of the characters do not recognize her. She regains her weight quickly since being thin makes her feel weak and faint.!~

59801.description:
__School:__ 8th Year University student 
__Karuta Society:__ No society - Super A Class 
__Height:__ 180 cm 
__Hobby:__ Karuta 
__Favourite Song:__ Poem #2 The spring has passed And the summer come again

The reigning Master. He possesses the most intuition out of all the current karuta players, and has 28 one-syllable cards.  [Wikipedia] ; For the silk-white robes, So they say, are spread to dry On the "Mount of Heaven's Perfume."  Suoh started Karuta during university, and became Meijin within 3 years, and has held the title for 4 consecutive years. Everyone acknowledges his god-like abilities, but he is on constant lookout for someone stronger than himself. He is a solitary genius who always suffers from hunger, and is hard to become excited. It is his 4th time repeating a year at university.  Personality: The current Meijin is a weirdo? At first glance he may look like a typical university student, but in reality he is tall, has a questionable beard, an extremely quiet voice, and loves Japanese confectionery. His personal favourite idol is “Kyokotan” (Yamashiro Kyouko) who is a professional Karuta reader. He once asked her for a recording of her reading the poems, after offering her a gift of confectionaries. He is a man who wants to only fight strong people, and so he rarely makes an appearance at tournaments. In an interview, he has started that he wants to quickly be Meijin 5 years in a row, become an eternal-Meijin, then retire.

name.native: レベッカ・ハルストレム

59995.description: Rebecka is the commander and strategist of Team Pied Piper.  (Source: Wikipedia)

59999.description: Pippo is Gazelle's old friend and co-worker. He has a strong conviction to justice, and also is very unlucky. Against his father's wishes, he joins the Okinawa Private Self-Defense Forces.  (Source: Wikipedia)

60119.description: Kanai Sakura is Chihaya's opponent at Saitama tournament. She has 35 years of karuta experience.

60121.description: Mochida Futoshi is a coach of Hokuou Academy karuta club.

60123.description: He is the chairman and coach of the Suihoku Karuta Society.

60125.description: Yuusei Nishida's older sister. She designs T-shirts for the Mizusawa Karuta Club. She is in a relationship with Hiro Kinashi and chooses to root for him over her brother.

60151.description:
**Height:** 165 cm

The protagonist, childhood friend of Akiho Senomiya, member of the Robot Research Club and hardcore gamer ranked in the top 10 players worldwide of in-universe fighting game Kill-Ballad.

Despite being a member of the Robot Research Club and being a high ranking player at the fighting game based on the in-universe Gunvarrel mecha anime, Kaito insists he has zero interest in robots and mecha and actively avoids participating in club activities and is only there to supervise the club president and his childhood friend Akiho after being requested so by her older sister.

60153.description:
**Height:** 157 cm

Akiho is the secondary protagonist and main heroine of Robotics;Notes.

She is the president of the Tanegashima Robot Research Club taking over from her sister after her graduation from high-school and is taking over the construction of the life size mecha based on the in-universe anime Gunvarrel: the GunBuild-1 which was originally headed by her older sister, Misaki Senomiya.

Unlike her childhood friend Yashio Kaito, Akiho has a passionate love for robots and mecha anime and grew up with her father and sister watching various mecha shows including the fictional shows Gunvarrel and Gunbam.

60155.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

A second-year student in the same school as Kaito and Akiho. He won the Robo-One championship several years ago and as a result Akiho tries to get him to joint the robotics club, but he refuses because his father got him to promise he'd stop playing with robots in high school and become a fisherman after graduating. Kaito blackmails him into joining the club with Mr. Pleiades' identity.

60157.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm 

Known online under the alias Frau Koujiro, creator and lead developer of the in-universe fighting game: Kill-Ballad.

Offline she goes by her real name, Kona Furogoori and currently resides on Tanegashi Island as a member of Tanegashima High Robot Research Club.

60159.description:
**Height:** 148 cm

One of the members of the Robotics Club and a karate member.

60161.description:
**Height:** 145 cm

An AI existing within Iru-O created by Kimijima, with another personality (Geji-nee) that is used by him to collect information.    ~!She subconciously spies on Kaito for Kimijima. When the Iru-O servers are rebooted on Christmas Airi's personality is erased and Geji-nee returns to Kimijima's side.!~

60163.description: Atsushi Shimao is Rokka's deceased husband. He has been haunting her for the past 3 years. Hazuki Ryuusuke is the only one able to see and talk with him.

60201.description: The former Queen of Karuta and a member of Shuihoku Karuta Society. Her strategy involves contesting who actually got the cards. Outside of playing karuta, she works as a bank teller.

60203.description: Kanade's mother. She runs a kimono store, which provides hakama for the Mizusawa Karuta Club.

60223.description:
__Species:__ Lamia 

She is the first to arrive in [Kimihito's](https://anilist.co/character/60225/Kurusu-Kimihito) ward when the cultural exchange began. She is sweet, naive, and a carefree individual. She has a habit of being clingy when she sleeps. She's very ticklish when one holds the very tip of her tail, which is why Kimihito exploit that weakness in order to get out of her grip.

60225.description: Ever since the cultural exchange between humans and sub-species begun, he found himself suddenly forced to volunteer in such program where he has to be the custodian of 3 sub-species; namely Miia a lamia, Papi a harpy and Centorea Shianus a centaur, where everyday living with them is an accident waiting to happen.

60279.description: Hana is a college student that falls deeply in love with a [wolf-man](https://anilist.co/character/60285/Ookami) that she encounters in class one day. They start dating, and even though he tells her one night about his true nature, Hana does not seem to mind, getting married to him and eventually, giving birth to his daughter, [Yuki](https://anilist.co/character/60281/Yuki), and one year later, to his son, [Ame](https://anilist.co/character/60283/Ame).  Sadly, the wolf-man dies unexpectedly, leaving Hana and their wolf-children alone. Hana is scared of people finding the truth about her children, so she decides to leave the city for a rural town, starting there a new life, full of new experiences for her and especially Ame and Yuki.

60281.description: Hana's eldest child. She is very energetic.   ~!Later in the movie, you would notice that Yuki wants to be a normal human girl instead of a wild wolf like Ame.!~

60283.description: Ame is the youngest wolf child. He is shy and quite weak. He looks awfully lot like his father. He is a year younger than his older sister, Yuki   ~! Later in the movie, Ame wants to be a wild wolf instead of a normal human like Yuki.   Ame later goes onto living in the mountains to pursue his dream of living as a wild lone wolf. He would sometimes call out to his mother in the wind of the mountains.!~

60331.description: The male protagonist who is the heir to the Mikadono Group. For him to take over, he needs to graduate from school as well as finding a life partner. However, things become complicated as he learns that he has a younger sister who is watching over him as well as attending the same school. He has a scar on his forehead from an accident when he was a kid, which caused him to lose bits of his memories.   ~!In the last novels, he chooses Konoe as his lover, but also gets to know that she is also his sister. However, Shougo is not Kumagorou's biological son; for some reason,  Kumagorou and Shougo's mother, Kanoko, were unable to conceive a child together and Kanoko gave birth to Shougo through artificial insemination with another man.!~

60333.description: A young girl who attends the same school as Shougo and also the first friend he makes on his first day of his new life. Very curious and believing in destined meetings, she is in the same class as Shougo as well as the class representative. She loves creme puffs. Her father is a leading engineering designer of electronic devices, who designed one of the special cellphones that she used to deceive Shougo.     ~!She revealed later that she was Shougo's childhood friend and feels responsible for the accident that landed him in hospital. She tells Shougo, "When we were kids, I wanted to be your sister. I figured we could be together forever that way."!~  ~!In the last two novels, it is revealed that Konoe is actually Shougo's sister. However, Konoe is Kumagorou's biological daughter but she's not really Shougo's sister because Shougo is not Kumagorou's biological son.!~

60335.description: One of Shougo's friends and a tsundere. She is in love with Shougo and even said she wants to marry him.   ~!It's later revealed that she met Shougo when he was recovering from an injury in the hospital and he played with her; they even had a pretend wedding. !~  ~!According to the Vol. 8 of the novel series, it is revealed by DNA test that she's not actually Shougo's sister - but his cousin.!~ Her family owns a clothing line.   ~! In the anime, it is revealed that she is Shougo's real sister.!~

60337.description: A first-year and student council vice-president of Miryuuin Academy. Was bred in a royal family. After Shougo transferred into Miryuuin, Konoe calls her "a princess to the core." Rinka keeps the Student Council President in line and is shown to be very good at dancing. She is a more distant aloof character who has a tendency to be competitive.  ~!Rinka later revealed that school director Genda asked her to find Shougo's sister so that he can have leverage when working for the Mikadono Group. Rinka used Sagara's phone when making a fake sister announcement and threaten the director. Shougo sooner found out her scheme by using Konoe's phone. Shougo volunteered himself to pretend to be her lover so that her engagement to the director's son would be invalid. However, she told her parents about Shougo and broken the engagement to be with him.!~

60339.description: A third-year bespectacled girl who dresses as a witch and runs a little sister cafe called "Lyrical Sisters".  ~!She was abandoned when she was one or two years old and was adopted by a university professor because of her mathematical intellect. The cosplay café belonged to her adopted mother, but she soon past away because of illness. She lived with her father in Massachusetts after that, but returned after earning enough money and bought back the cosplay café.!~  ~!It's revealed that she knows Shougo's real sister and does not want her to be exposed to Mikadono family because she is an illegitimate child. But after Shougo made a promise to protect her, Mei said she will tell him if he proves himself that he's a good older brother.!~

60691.description: A classmate of Hotaru. He seems to have a crush on her.

60955.description:
__Height__: 160 cm

Wakana is known for being somewhat of a loner, and that is due to her outward personality that may seem harsh to others. She is skilled at playing the piano and has [a cat](https://anilist.co/character/386264) as a pet.  Despite the fact that she is very good at singing, she refuses to do so to the point of turning down Konatsu's attempt to recruit her into her new choir club. Before joining Konatsu's choir club, she never went out or did any extracurricular activities with her classmates.

60957.description:
__Class:__ 3rd Year
__Height:__ 149 cm (4'11")

A short, earnest girl who loves to sing and dance.    ~!She was previously affiliated with the choir club until she had a falling out with their supervisor, who prevented her from singing due to an incident a year prior when she was attacked by stage fright during their recital. After this incident, Konatsu began training herself by performing in the public park. She decides to create her own club so she can sing in front of the school. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

60959.description:
__Class__: 3rd Year
__Height__: 167 cm (5'6")

A 3rd year student who is part of the archery club. She is also noted for living in a temple and owning a horse as a pet.   ~!Being Konatsu's friend, she joins the new choir club and helps her recruit more members.!~

60963.description: Wien is the new transfer student from Austria, where he lived for twelve years. Due to his time away, he is very unfamiliar with Japanese customs, and had thus consulted books on the proper mannerisms, often to humorous results when he misuses certain gestures, including performing a dogeza when introducing himself on the first day.

61301.description: Ritsuko's father. He owns a record store. He occasionally holds jazz sessions in the basement of the store. He plays the upright acoustic bass.

61363.description: Blanc is the president of Génération Bleu, employer of Team Pied Piper, and Fleur's father. He seeks to find the "Secret" for his company's own uses.  (Source: Wikipedia)

61371.description:
**Height:** 162 cm

Mashiro is the female protagonist of the story. She is the resident of room 202. She is a world-famous artist who transferred into Suiko as a second-year to learn how to draw manga. Although her artwork is widely admired by the world, in spite of her young age, she knows nothing other than drawing and has an extreme lack of common sense and living ability. Due to this, [Sorata](https://anilist.co/character/64169/Kanda-Sorata) is forced to handle Mashiro's living chores, to the point that he even has to pick out underwear for her, or she will go out without them.   
~!In the third novel, Mashiro starts to grow feelings for Sorata, and she even claims that she cannot live without him. In the eighth novel Sorata confesses his feelings for her and in the next novel, they are officially a couple.!~ Given her only academic strong point is art, she does very poorly in other subjects. Utilizing her photographic memory allows her to succeed in these subjects. 
~!It is heavily implied in the last volume of the novel that Mashiro and Sorata had a child.!~

61559.description: One of the members of Hero's old party. A powerful swordswoman who also excels as a commander in battle. She reunites with the Hero by accident much to her surprise, as no one had news from him since he left for the Demon Realm. Despite failing to get a proper explanation from him, she joins the Crimson Scholar's efforts to improve Human society by teaching swordsmanship to her students. The Female Knight eventually becomes a close friend to the Crimson Scholar, staying by her side even after learning about her true identity, but also viewing her as a rival for the hero's affection as she also loves him.

61763.description: Kasper's ruthless head of security and Lehm's ex-wife. Both Chiquita and Lehm used to serve as Floyd Hekmatyar's bodyguards. She can be considered the best bodyguard in HCLI.

62041.description: Amuro is a free-lance private detective who also maintains employment on the side that may aid in investigation, like his part-time job as a waiter at Ristorante Sundayrino. After his introductory case, Amuro begins working part-time at Café Poirot. He is currently Mouri Kogorou's apprentice.   Amuro has a cheerful personality. He is also generous, bringing a plate of sandwiches for the detective agency bought with his money. In more serious situations, he seems to be patient, keeping calm even while even while others are abusing him. Although somewhat of a "cool type", he does not hide his emotions and is quite expressive. Like other detectives in Detective Conan, he enjoys presenting his deductions about cases to others. He is also manipulative, tricking others into performing certain actions so he can gather information. Kogorou calls him "effeminate".    ~! It is revealed in chapter 823 that he is Bourbon, a Black Organization member. !~  ~!It is also revealed in The Scarlet Truth that Tooru Amuro's real name is actually Furuya Rei who is a Security Police agent working undercover in the Black Organization.!~

62209.description: The ace of the Shiranami Karuta Society. He is a teacher and the advisor for the Homei High School Karuta Team.

62215.description: Wakana's late mother, who passed away from an illness just before Wakana entered high school. She wrote the Condor Queen's best hit, "Amigo", which is also Konatsu's favorite song.

62221.description: Responsible for Shirahamazaka High's vocal club, who is put in charge of Konatsu's choir club after its advisor, the principal, is hospitalized following a bicycle accident. She is often harsh towards Konatsu, seeing music as something that should not be treated like a game. She was Mahiru's friend in high school.

alternative: Burning Princess Saint Dragon Lady of Dawn

62263.description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5')  
__Weight:__ 46 kg (101 lbs)  
__Likes:__ Video games  

A mysterious, black-haired girl who is actually a chuunibyo. She sent Eita letters and messages so she could finally see him. Himeka calls herself "Himekashizuka Heaven's Rain" while being in chuuni mode, and tells that her name from past life was "Burning Princess Saint Dragon Lady of Dawn".  She has a one-sided crush for Eita, and says that she is his former girlfriend. However, when she isn't in chuuni mode, she has a poker face usually on, talks in third person, is a taciturn who answers usually by nodding and even throws tantrums sometimes about how Eita is only hers.  In the anime she is known as "Burning Pudding Princess."

62325.description: The micronized Zentradi president and manager of the small talent agency "Vector Productions".[33] He hears Ranka's singing by chance and scouts her, becoming her manager.[33] However, after Leon Mishima realizes that Ranka's singing has an effect on the Vajra he assigns Grace O'Connor as her new manager, forcing Elmo away from her. He is seen taking shelter in the same bunker as Sheryl and watching her sing during a Vajra attack. Elmo becomes Sheryl's new manager some time later. A comment made by him when asking Ozma Lee's permission to become Ranka's manager suggests that he is a Space War I veteran.

62407.description: She is Kagerou's mother.  Manga spoilers  ~!Before Ririchiyo died, she made Ayame promise her to find Soushi's reincarnation and free him from his house arrest again-which she did-.!~

62437.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")
__Class:__ 2-C
__Affiliation:__ Supernatural Studies Club

Miyabi Itou is a girl that believes in the supernatural, that's why she also joins the Supernatural club. She later learns the secret of Yamada. Although Miyabi is a considerably attractive and cheerful girl, due to her being a fan of the supernatural phenomenons and alike, she is considered among her peers to be a fraud and liar. Because of this, she didn't have any friends at all.

62475.description: Eren's mother.   ~!She's eaten alive in the second chapter.!~ Note: Carla Yeager is the official English translation by Kodansha.

name.native: グリシャ・イェーガー

62477.description:
Father of [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and caretaker of [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Mikasa-Ackerman). He is a renowned doctor who was well respected in the District of Shiganshina after he saved the village from a mysterious viral epidemic by developing vaccines. He also provides a medical house call service to the people of Shiganshina and to various towns in addition to having a network of contacts within the Corps of the Shiganshina District. He is married to [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475).

~!In the basement of the Yeager family house, he hides a secret which he refers to as the "truth". Upon finding Eren after the fall of Wall Maria, he injects him with a series of chemicals and amnesiacs and entrusts him with the key to the "truth", before mysteriously disappearing. This strange serum resulted in Eren gaining the ability to transform into a titan.!~

62479.description:
__Height__: 178 cm (5'9")
__Affiliations__: 104th Training Corps

Originally from Jinae District. Marco ranked 7th in the 104th Training Corps and is widely respected by other cadets of the 104th. Marco is a very kind, calm, and idealistic person, valuing the good of the group above his own interests, as well as understanding and coping with his own shortcomings and limitations. He is seen as a natural leader, and desires to join the Military Police to serve near the King. 

*Note: Marco Bott is the official English translation by Kodansha.*

62481.description:
__Height__: 145 cm (4'8")
__Affiliations__: 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps

Ranked tenth in the trainee class, Krista is a very shy and kind, caring person, often being described as a "goddess" or "angel" by her peers. She is good friends with [Ymir](https://anilist.co/character/71479/Ymir).

62485.description: The highest-ranked Administrator of the Southern Region. Head of the Garrison's Southern Territories, Pixis is a cunning leader with astute insights. However, he is also an alcoholic who is constantly watched over by his aid, [Anka](https://anilist.co/character/84331/Anka-Rheinberger), who constantly scolds him for sleeping and drinking during critical moments.

62581.description:
Aika was [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/42202/Fuwa-Mahiro)'s sister that was brutally murdered. Her murder is the central mystery that haunts the narrative in the series. Aika had a penchant for quoting [Shakespeare](https://anilist.co/staff/98134/William-Shakespeare), particularly Hamlet and The Tempest by William Shakespeare.

~!She secretly dated [Yoshino](https://anilist.co/character/43737/Takigawa-Yoshino), whom she deeply loved. She stated that Yoshino is the only person she would date and that she would not consider anyone else, even if Yoshino were interested in another person. Mahiro is someone very important and special to her too, but not in a romantic way.!~   ~!It is later revealed that she is the Mage of Exodus, and that instead of being murdered, she took her own life. Before her death, she records a video for Yoshino and Mahiro in which she tells them how important they are to her and how happy she was during her time with them.!~

alternative: Princess of the Tree of Beginnings

62583.description: The princess of the sorcerers and the strongest sorceress in history, she was left in a desert island to die by the leader of Kusaribe clan, Samon. Since the Island did not allow the use of magic, she joins Mahiro's quest to revenge Aika's death, and her own revenge against Samon. She talks to Mahiro and Yoshino through a wooded doll necklace.    ~!Later it is revealed that Hakaze had long died before she makes contact with Mashiro and Yoshino, and the doll in their possesion is connecting them with a Hakaze from before she perishes in the island and her remains are recovered by Samon. By using the connection between the dolls, Hakaze manages to escape the island and transfer herself from the past to the present by using her powers to send her body to the present except her skeleton which is left behind in the island for Samon to find, just to have her past body and present skeleton successfully rejoined in the current time, thus allowing her to return to life without violating the space-time continuum.  After the confrontation in Mt Fuji, she falls in love with Yoshino, but when she confessed her feelings to him he revealed that he was Aika's boyfriend.  She has been the only person who managed to make Yoshino show his true feelings. Aika punched her for that.!~   ~! She traveled back in time to find out the truth behind Aika's death. She encounters Aika, who reveals her identity as the Magician of Zetsuen and her intention of committing suicide in order to save the world.  After that she helps Hanemura in defeating the Tree of Genesis and loses her powers.!~   ~!In the final chapter we discover that she got a driving license and that she won't give up on Yoshino despite his statement that there are better guys than him.!~  Hakaze's setup and behavior includes allusions to Prospero, the main character from Shakespeare's play The Tempest, who just like her, is a magician betrayed by his servants and left for dead on a deserted island.

name.native: クロエ・マキャフリィ

62585.description: Chloe is an 11 year old IFO pilot for Team Goldilocks, piloting the RA169 Requiem. Despite her short stature, Chloe refuses to acknowledge that she is still a child. She is also fond of cake. After Ao alters the course of history, it is revealed that she and her sister are still living with their mother in the family's bakery shop.  (Source: Wikipedia)

62587.description: Maggie is a close friend of Chloe and Maeve and serves as the pilot of RA302 Credo. After Ao alters the course of history, she is seen as an allied forces pilot stationed in the U.S.S. Ronald Reagan.  (Source: Wikipedia)

62651.description:
The current head of the Higashikata household and owner of the Higashikata Fruit Company. He is the father of Jobin, Hato, Joshuu, and Daiya Higashikata. 

~!His stand, King Nothing, can track specific smells.!~

62653.description:
__Nationality__: Japanese

Jobin Higashikata is an antagonist featured in the eighth part of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, JoJolion. 

Jobin is the eccentric eldest son of the Higashikata Family. He is married with Mitsuba Higashikata and has a son, Tsurugi. Beyond his job at the Higashikata Fruit Company, Jobin was formerly one of the members of the Rock Humans' Locacaca Organization. 

In his room, he keeps a large shelving unit full of display cases for exotic beetles. It is hinted that his fondness for beetles is the way they symbolize strength. He breeds beetles to make them fight and considers them to be gladiators when on the arena.

Jobin desires the power of the Locacaca, wishing to obtain it to rid his family of the Higashikata curse. This desire leads to him valuing the Locacaca and elimination of any in his way above everything else, even being unconcerned if Morioh itself were to be destroyed in the process.

Jobin is a Stand User and wields the mysterious Speed King. Little is known about Speed King's abilities other than its primary ability to store heat and temperature within a short localized point. This power can be weaponized and used to heat people's blood vessels, boiling the blood inside to render them unconscious or even kill them- when applied to the temples the heat can become so damaging the victim's eyes burst. Speed King is shown to be physically able enough to rapidly pummel enemies. The Stand also has other hidden abilities that Jobin keeps undisclosed, even to his own family.

~!He is later killed after seeing the Wonder of U user, Tooru staring at him. He was struck with a calamity by being shot to death by the dip tube of a spray that pierced his chest and instantly suffered from extreme blood loss.!~

62655.description:
Hato is Norisuke Higashikata's eldest daughter. She's a model of some renown, and is quite proud of it. She gets into fights with Joshuu regularly.

~!Her stand, Walking Heart, allows her to lengthen her heels, turning them into deadly weapons.!~

62657.description:
Daiya is Norisuke Higashikata's youngest daughter. She is near-blind, and is an avid fan of progressive rock (in particular, Yes). She is extremely possessive of Josuke, and appears to be jealous of Yasuho for getting close to him.

~!When she was a child, she fell into a fault near the wall-eyes and gained a stand, California King Bed, which can steal people's memories and turn them into chess pieces. A memory can be stolen when a person lies to Daiya or tries to fool her. However, stolen memories return if she steps on that person's shadow.!~

62659.description:
Mitsuba is the wife of Jobin Higashikata and the mother of Tsurugi Higashikata.

~!Her stand, Awaking III Leaves, allows her to to use arrows to change the directions of energy and objects.!~

62661.description: Tsurugi Higashikata, the youngest member of the Higashikata family, is the son of Jobin and Mitsuba Higashikata. Tsurugi's stand, Paper Moon King, allows him to transform objects into origami and create illusions.

62743.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

A poverty god who wishes to restore the energy balance and give it back to all the places [Ichiko](https://anilist.co/character/33820/Sakura-Ichiko) took it from. She possesses Ichiko in order for the balance to stay stabled. She is troubled by her flat chest and she is very lazy. Surprisingly, even though she is after Ichiko's good luck energy there is often an undeclared truce between her and Ichiko when she needs barge in her flat to either eat or use some of her stuffs, that is, if she feels like it.

~!It is revealed that the source of her powers lie on not taking a bath in years so when she was given a good scrubbing and rinsing by Ichiko and [Ranmaru](https://anilist.co/character/64043/Rindou-Ranmaru) in a public bath (as punishment for her mischief), she immediately changes from a lazy and scheming poverty god to a sweet and caring person. Only by physically soiling herself would result in reverting back to her usual self.!~

62939.description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5'2")
**Home Town:** Kumamoto City, Kunamoto Prefecture

She was born into the distinguished family of the Nishizumi Style of Sensha-do, but she changed schools to Ooarai Girls Academy intending to run away from Sensha-do.   However, perplexingly enough, she was extorted into joining Sensha-do by the student council. She's a second-year and considers her friend's feelings more than anyone else. She has traumatic memory of tanks because of an incident that happened during her past with a tank. She's Ankou Team's Commander and is Ooarai's De Facto captain.   

Miho has a polite personality and can lack self-confidence when in social situations. However when in a Sensha-do battle, Miho is known for her quick and decisive thinking. Miho also has a deep sense of loyalty to her friends, being ready to sacrifice her own reputation for the sake of others. Finally, Miho is a fan of the teddy bear brand Boko, having a large collection of the bandaged/beat-up bears in both her apartment and her old room back home.

62941.description:
**Height:** 157 cm (5'2")
**Home Town:** Ooarai, Ibaraki Prefecture

Hana's friend and the other girl who befriended Miho during the first day of school. She is a social butterfly and is incredibly talkative. She yearns for a love that will love everything in the world, despite never being in a relationship before. She thought she would be popular among boys if she took Sensha-do. She is a member of the Ankou Team and serves as the Radio Operator and machine gunner. She also acts as a big sister for the Rabbit team comprised of the freshman. She sometimes calls [Miho](https://anilist.co/character/62939/Miho-Nishizumi) "Miporin". Saori is also a talented cook. 
~! As of Das Finale, she is now the PR Manager for the Oorari Student Council !~

(Source: Official Character Sheet)

62945.description:
**Height:** 157 cm (5'2")
**Home Town:** Tsuchiura, Ibaraki Prefecture

A member of Anko Team, and the loader of the Team. She gets overly excited when she sees or hears anything about tanks - to put it, she is a tank otaku. Yukari has had a deep love for all things tanking and WW2 since a young age. She collects tank models and frequently utilizes WW2-era equipment whenever possible. She uses her knowledge of tanks to help the team.  She has a deep respect and admiration of overall tank commander [Miho](https://anilist.co/character/62939/Miho-Nishizumi), going as far to refer to her as "Nishizumi-dono". Yukari is also known for her infiltration missions, where before a match she will sneak her way into the competing team's school in order to get intel for Miho and the rest of Oorari. 
~!As of Das Finale, Yukari is now the Vice President of the Oorari Student Council.!~

63267.description:
__Species:__ Harpy

Papi is the second girl to move in with Kimihito after she abducts him and almost dropped him while flying. She has difficulty with words which makes it difficult for Kimihito to understand what she is saying. She's childish, both physically and mentally, despite being as old as Miia.

63351.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'4")

Akame is one of the members of the Assassin's group, Night Raid. She is the first member to attack [Tatsumi](https://anilist.co/character/64749), and comes very close to killing him. She initially appears very serious and cold-hearted, but she is actually caring and worries about the safety of her comrades. She has a younger sister named [Kurome](https://anilist.co/character/65297), who is a member of the Jaegers, and loyal to the Empire. Her Teigu is the One-Cut Killer: Murasame, a katana known for being coated in an immensely deadly poison that could kill those cut by it within seconds, as the poison itself has no antidote.

 ~!When she was a child, her parents had sold both her and Kurome to the Empire. There, they were placed and raised as Assassins from childhood. Akame in particular became infamous enough to earned the top rank in the Imperial Assassin Division. At some point, many of her comrades had died and she become dissatisfied and resentful towards the government. It was not until she was sent to kill former General Najenda that Akame finally defected to the Rebels after being swayed by her.!~

63807.description: Panda's Little Sister. (First appearance in Episode 9)

63845.description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'5")
__Talent:__ ???

Kyouko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. Her talent is unknown.

Kyouko is a mysterious, stoic, and independent person who deliberately masks her feelings so that others won't be able to read her. Because of this, she has a cold demeanor and appears to remain calm and collected in most situations. Despite this, however, she can sometimes let her emotions get the best of her when she's especially upset. Though aloof and slow to trust others, Kyouko is adept at noticing things that the other students don't, which proves vital once bodies start turning up. She often advises [Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/63851/Naegi-Makoto) on conducting investigations.

~!Her actual talent is the Super High School Level Detective, or the Ultimate Detective in the English localization.!~

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Kou'un (超高校級の幸運)
Super High School Level Good Luck

63851.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Talent:__ Good Luck

Makoto is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. His talent is Super High School Level Good Luck (超高校級の幸運), meaning he got into Hope's Peak by winning a lottery, rather than being scouted for an extraordinary talent like everyone else. His title is the Ultimate Lucky Student in the English localization.

Makoto is friendly and a lot more down-to-earth than other students. He tends to act passively in conversation. According to him, his most distinguishing feature is his optimism.

name.native: ハンプニー・ハンバート

63971.description: A man who suddenly appeared in Ai's village and killed all the villagers. He calls himself the "Man-eating Toy", and describes himself as a cruel person. He also claims to be immortal and unable to age.

name.native: ユリー・サクマ・ドミートリエビッチ

63975.description: He's human, and has supposedly known Hampnie Hambart since childhood.

63977.description: Scar is a gravekeeper and she acts rather emotionless and cold.

64041.description:
Ichiko's classmate. He works many part-time jobs in order to provide his four siblings, and is the caretaker in the absence of his parents who ran away to escape a mountain of debt.

Unknown to him Ichiko has started to develop feelings for him, though she tries very hard to deny it. Ranmaru has a crush on him.

64043.description:
__Height:__ 171 cm

A butch, manly girl who transfers into [Ichiko](https://anilist.co/character/33820/Sakura-Ichiko)'s class. She usually dresses like a school delinquent. She was raised by her father (a karate master) who always pushes her hard to further improve her skills in karate. She develops a crush on [Keita](https://anilist.co/character/64041/Tsuwabuki-Keita) after seeing his chivalry.

64051.description: Akatsuki came back to the real world after defeating the demon king in a world of sword and magic called Alayzard.  A fine young man who is confident of his strength, perverted yet serious.  He has a nasty habit of irritating girls by taking off their lingerie in a stealthy manner.  For some reason, Miu is the frequent victim of his perversion.

64053.description: She is the daughter of the Demon King Akatsuki. For some unfortunate reason she would always finds herself being a victim of Akatsuki's perversion be it accidental or intentional however she is pretty much capable of fending him off.... some of the time that is. Though Akatsuki treats her like his sister, it is suggested that he may have deeper feelings for her.

64055.description: A classmate of Akatsuki's and Miu's. She is a friendly, tomboyish girl with short brown hair and amber eyes. She becomes friends with Miu immediately. She is also a lesbian, and admits this fact with no shame. Her element is water, and her weapon is a crossbow.  (Source: Wikipedia)

64057.description: A classmate of Akatsuki's and Miu's, also the Class Rep of their class. She is a really small girl, who is also really young, about the age of an elementary schooler. However, because of her being really smart and clever, she gets to be in high school. Doumoto has usually an emotionless expression most of time, and rarely smiles. Her element is earth, and her weapon is a gigantic, wooden hammer.

64059.description: The Vice President of Student Council, who has long, green hair and green eyes. She seems to dislike Akatsuki a lot, especially after he steals both her bra and her panties during the middle of a school day, though she attacked him out of nowhere. Her weapons are two big blades.  (Source: Wikipedia)

64109.description: The young king of Qin who bears a striking resemblance to Piao. Later becomes Qin Shi Huang.

64165.description:
**Height:** 156 cm

Misaki is the resident of room 201. Misaki is a third-year-student of Suiko who later attends Suimei University of the Arts. She is very outgoing and optimistic. [Sorata](https://anilist.co/character/64169/Kanda-Sorata) often refers to her as an "alien". She has very good grades and is very good at drawing, but the school decided to send her to Sakurasou Dormitory because she pays too much attention on drawing anime and manga. She is very good at making animation and can handle most work in making one without help from others. She has already sold an animation to a famous publishing company and made enough of a fortune for the rest of her life.

~!She has feelings for [Jin](https://anilist.co/character/64171/Mitaka-Jin), and acts very open to express her feelings, but Jin turns a blind eye to this and dates many other girls, which makes her very depressed.!~

~!She and Jin finally become a couple during the fifth novel. In sixth novel, she registers their marriage without asking Jin, making them officially husband and wife; her new name is Misaki Mitaka. She moves next to the Sakurasou Dormitory after her graduation into a house which she designed and built herself and has a recording studio in the basement.!~

64167.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

Nanami is [Sorata's](https://anilist.co/character/64169) classmate. Although she is harsh to Sorata, she actually has a crush on him, and everyone aside from Sorata has noticed this. She escaped from her home to become a voice actress and has to live on her own.

64169.description:
**Height:** 168 cm

Sorata is the male protagonist of the story. He is a second-year student of Suiko, who lives in room 101 of Sakurasou Dormitory. He was kicked out of the standard school dorm after he chose not to throw away a stray cat he picked up. As many of the Sakurasou Dormitory residents have outstanding grades and art skills, he often feels plain and normal among them. He is chosen by Chihiro to take care of Mashiro's daily life, although he resists at first, but he ends up getting used to it.

64171.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Jin is the resident of room 103 and a third-year student of Suiko. He is Misaki's childhood friend and a playboy. He has dated several girls, including Misaki's elder sister, but in the end he breaks up with all of them. 

~!Jin has feelings for Misaki, but he feels he is not good enough to match her, so he ended up becoming a playboy. He finally becomes a couple with Misaki during the fifth novel. He wants to become a playwright, and later attends a university in Osaka to achieve his goal. To pacify Misaki, he gives her a marriage registration form with his signature as a warranty, but Misaki ends up turning it in after his departure on the same day, which makes them officially married.!~

64173.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Ryuunosuke is the resident of room 102 and a second-year student of Suiko.

He is a hikikomori who rarely leaves his room, and usually communicates with others with cellphone message or e-mails. To reduce the need to communicate with others, he has written the "Maid" program. He is an expert of computer programming, and contributes lots of useful advice and information to [Sorata](https://anilist.co/character/64169/Kanda-Sorata) for the latter's computer game. According to Ryuunosuke, his ultimate goal is to make Maid become a real human. He likes tomatoes

~!He has gynophobia, and will even pass out when girls touch him, which becomes worse after [Rita](https://anilist.co/character/73507/Ainsworth-Rita) falls in love with him and kisses him on the cheek.!~

64573.description: The hero of the story. A war orphan who aims to become the "World's Greatest General". He later meets Zheng Ying, the future first king that would rule all of China.

64591.description:
**Height**: 169 cm

A joker who goes around asking for his schoolmates to share their lunch with him. Yashiro is soft-spoken but very charismatic. He is very friendly and well-liked. In addition, he is quite respectful towards anyone he meets, even robots.  He is also somewhat laid-back and happy-go-lucky. Yashiro carries also a red, Japanese-style parasol with him at all times.

~!His real name is Adolf K. Weissman and he's the Silver King. The Colorless King was once in control of "Yashiro's" body, but once he took control of Weissman's original body, their spirits switch. He had amnesia from episode one and regains them in the 11th episode, finally bringing light to the confusing situation.!~

64595.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Neko has a very joyful, carefree, and energetic personality. She is very playful, often participating or even starting chases with people. In addition, Neko seems to have no qualms or worries about being nude, especially in front of men, showing some immodesty. She even stated that she does not like wearing clothes, the reason being that "Clothes are too restricting". She is also a mysterious girl, who is also a cat. Neko also likes Shiro and even calls him "My Shiro".

~!Neko is a female Strain. By projecting her powers within a perimeter with herself at the center, she can interfere and manipulate the human senses and perceptions of those around her. However, her powers aren't limited to visual and auditory hallucinations. Her power to manipulate perception can even play with a person's memory. She can create false memories in people, and make people who've met for the first time believe they're old friends.!~

64597.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm  

Third King, known as the Red King. Has an ability to control fire. Feared by people as the leader of the Red Clan, HOMRA. Mikoto is a quiet man who says very little, even to his own subordinates. He is very calm, rarely being irritated or annoyed, and even when his mood changes Mikoto still maintains his composure. Mikoto is an avid smoker, often holding a cigarette and a lighter in each hand.

64599.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm 

A young man with an unyielding personality. He is also a skilled swordsman, martial artist, and housekeeper. Kuroh is a quiet, serious and composed individual that appears tough and completely no-nonsense on the surface. He is very determined to accomplish his goals, whatever they may be, but despite so Kuroh is willing to set them aside for the finer things in life, such as genuine companionship. Kuroh says that he follows a policy where, rather than judging a man by his appearance or words, their actions are what matters more.  In his younger years, Kuroh was trained by the 7th King, Miwa Ichigen. However, after unknown circumstances, Ichigen had passed away, leaving behind a will in Kuroh to defeat the "evil" King.

64621.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Third in Command of SCEPTER4 and a former member of HOMRA, having betrayed the latter Clan at some point in the past. Fushimi often displays himself as a cool-headed, though lazy and bored individual. He gives off a listless attitude and seems unmotivated, but is in fact very competent. He prefers not to participate in most of his Clan's activities. However, he will cooperate if necessary with little to no arguments. At the same time, he would often disregard his associates and act out on his own. While focused on an objective, Fushimi is willing to use any method possible to make his tasks quicker and easier, such as drugging innocent civilians. He would even attack several former allies without any hesitation just to accomplish his goal, displaying additional traits of ruthlessness.   A sociopath by nature, Fushimi's personality is far more twisted then he leads others to believe. He is cruel, bloodthirsty, and occasionally sadistic. During battle, Fushimi often sports a wide grin and a tendency to laugh giddily about the dangerous event. He also displays more evident signs of arrogance and superiority towards his opponents. Fushimi often boasts about his strength and speaks to his opponents in a more mocking tone. Nevertheless, Fushimi retains a carefree attitude during battle and likes to make rude, though somewhat personal jokes.  Misaki usually calls him "Saru" (Monkey).   ~!He used to be Misaki's partner back in HOMRA and personally burned the HOMRA mark off his own skin. He also displays the ability to use both blue and red flames from both clans.!~ (Source: ANN, Project K Wikia)

64627.description:
__Height:__ 140 cm 

A quiet, doll-like girl who serves as HOMRA's unofficial mascot. Anna is very quiet and shy compared to her louder, more eccentric HOMRA members. In addition, she rarely expresses much emotion nor does she actively participate in the gang-like activities of HOMRA, due to her young age and status as the sole female in the group; however, she is not unwilling to tag along and cooperate if necessary. She has the ability to locate things and people and read minds using her red marbles.

64631.description:
__Height:__ 167 cm  

One of HOMRA's raid captains who goes around riding a skateboard and acts as the group's vanguard. 

He's impulsive, but he also cares about his comrades very much. Yata is a brash teenager with high self-esteem. He is very brutal, showing no hesitation when bludgeoning his opponents, as well as vulgar and easily irritable, cursing openly towards people when things don't go as well as he'd planned. Nonetheless, he shows respect towards his fellow Homura members, especially [Mikoto](https://anilist.co/character/64597/Suoh-Mikoto); so he gets very shy around girls. 

He hates being called by his first name. He joined to HOMRA with [Saruhiko](https://anilist.co/character/64621/Fushimi-Saruhiko) when they were teenagers.

64661.description: [Taichi's](https://anilist.co/character/40195/) elementary school age younger sister. She often gives advice to her brother about love. Like Ryuuzen and Iori, she is sometimes controlled by Heartseed, but the different one from Heartseed the cultural club's members known.

64749.description: Tatsumi is a swordsman from a small village. He set out to the capital with two of his companions in hope of raising money for the village. He got separated from his friends and reaches the capital. Tatsumi was not aware of the type of place the capital really was. After a series of events centered around his naivety of the true nature of the capital he found himself being saved be Night Raid (Assassination Group) and later join them to rid the capital of its corrupt inhabitants.

alternative: Mr. I Got A Fever And Got Benched

64769.description:
__Teams:__ Yukigaoka Junior High (Former); Karasuno High (Current)
__Number:__ 1 (Junior High 3rd Year); 10 (High School 1st year); 5 (High School 3rd year)
__Position:__ Captain (Junior High); Outside Hitter (Junior High); Middle Blocker (High School)

Hinata has an unusually high ability to jump. Since he was young, Hinata trained his legs to compensate for his lack of height. He joins the Karusuno High School Volleyball team and amazes the team with his natural affinity as a spiker. Although he is a complete beginner and never had any experience playing in a volleyball team, he grows rapidly through each match.

~!After graduating from high school, Hinata traveled to Brazil to gain experience by playing beach volleyball. This is when he got the name, Ninja Shoyo. Upon returning to Japan, he became a member of the MSBY Black Jackals, a Division 1 team in the V-League. He became a member of the Japan Men’s National Volleyball Team during the 2021 Olympics. Currently, that is the year 2022, he is a member of Asas São Paulo, a professional team in the Brazil Super League.!~

64771.description:
__Team:__ Karasuno High, Kitagawa Daiichi Junior High (former) 
__Height:__ 180.6 cm 
__Year:__ 1st Year, class 3 
__Number:__ 9 
__Position:__ Setter 

A famous setter in his middle school who joins the Karusuno High Volleyball team. He was known as the "King of the Court" in his middle school because of his arrogant demeanor and the way he would order around his teammates. Although he still carries an overbearing attitude, he begins to change when he starts to play with [Hinata Shouyou](https://anilist.co/character/64769) who views him as a rival.

64847.description:
Hana is the secretary of the Underground Student Council, a vigilante school organisation. Hana is the fourth-best karate champion in the inter-high school championships. She is a subordinate and loyal friend of [Mari Kurihara](https://anilist.co/character/64861/Kurihara-Mari), the president of the USC.

Hana is of average height and slim with a medium bust. She has straw-coloured hair in a bob, and brown eyes. She is athletic and somewhat muscular despite her weight, as a third-grade Dan and the school's fourth best karate champion. She wears the standard school uniform in tandem with leggings and an undershirt.

Hana is a kind and shy individual, who enjoys brewing & drinking dandelion tea and has a love for four-leaf clovers. She can be very violent when angry, and expresses her anger with proficient karate attacks. She is somewhat reserved in comparison to [Meiko Shiraki](https://anilist.co/character/47117/Shiraki-Meiko) (the Underground Student Council's Vice-President), wearing underlayers when on guard duty. She is actually very shy and reserved, as shown when she is caught in compromising conditions by [Kiyoshi Fujino](https://anilist.co/character/46557/Fujino-Kiyoshi) a number of times. Hana is shown to be quite impressionable out of her tough exterior as in compromising or sexual situations, she faints and becomes mortified.

~!Hana has a fear of mushrooms which as a result of remembering the hospital visit. She develops a crush on Kiyoshi after they kiss.!~

64849.description: The weird one of the group. He always wears a hood and raises ants. He suffers from constant coughing fits due to severe stomatitis.

64851.description:
He is the bespectacled boy in the group. A die-hard fan of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

~!In a valiant effort to help Kiyoshi escape so he could go on his date and obtain a rare Romance of the Three Kingdoms Figurine, he defecated himself in front of a group of girls in order to obtain the resulting sound in a way that can only be described as camaraderie in its purest, unadulterated form.!~

64853.description: Shingo is a blonde guy who looks like a delinquent. He has a crush on [Anzu](https://anilist.co/character/89755/Yokoyama-Anzu).

64855.description: Nicknamed "Andre", he is the fat one of the group. He cares deeply about his friends, and is also an extreme masochist.

64859.description:
Chiyo is the first girl to talk to [Kiyoshi](https://anilist.co/character/46557/Fujino-Kiyoshi); she has romantic feelings for him.

~!She is [Mari](https://anilist.co/character/64861/Kurihara-Mari)'s sister.!~

64861.description: Mari is the president of the underground student council. ~!She is the daughter of Hachimitsu Academy's chairman and the sister of Chiyo.!~

64969.description: She is Rokka's sister in law, and often drops by the shop to either watch over it or help out when needed.   (Source: ANN)

64971.description: A giant tortoise who also works in the zoo. He speaks really slowly in addition to being slow moving. He likes cameras.

65169.description:
A player with a kite shield and proclaims himself to be a knight. He was the one who organized the first meeting of players to form a raid party to take on the first floor boss. He organized the participating players well into groups according to their specialty and displayed great leadership to motivate and lead the raid party. 

~!He is also a beta tester of Sword Art Online but pretended to be a newbie player to escape the wrath of the players against them.!~

65185.description: Ryoko Suwano is a girl in the same class of Tsubaki, who said she may had fallen for him and was very curious about Tsubaki's love relationship.

65227.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7)

Leone is one of the older members of the assassination group, Night Raid. She has a very relaxed and a cheerful personality, which tends to display a lack of ladylike manners, such as shoving [Tatsumi](https://anilist.co/character/64749/Tatsumi) into her breasts, putting her feet on the table, or consuming large amounts of Sake. She serves as a sort of big sister figure to Tatsumi and the younger members in Night Raid, often referring to herself as "Onee-San". Despite the morally dodgy nature, she can sometimes display, Leone is not one to tolerate injustice and can be especially vicious to those who commit the vilest acts. She excels at gathering information and exercising calm judgement when necessary.  

Her teigu is Lionel, a teigu is in the form of a belt, when activated, it enhanced her speed, reflexes, strength, and regeneration, as well as giving her animal-like characteristics.

65229.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1)

Mine is a self-proclaimed "Genius Sniper", as well as being a sharp-tongued and quick-witted member of the assassin's group, Night Raid. She is often quick to anger, and easily irritated with those she does not know well. Despite this cold exterior, she has shown to be warm and kind to those she has opened up to.  Mine wields a powerful Teigu in the form of a rifle called the "Roman Artillery: Pumpkin" that fires highly concentrated piercing shots of spirit energy. Her proficiency in its use allows her to strike any target with extreme precision. When Pumpkin's user is in a dangerous situation, the power of its shots is​ magnified.

Manga spoilers:
~!Tatsumi and Mine retired from service and settled down away from civilization where they married and had a child.!~

65231.description:
Lubbock is a member of the assassin group, Night Raid. He is often shown being a pervert, including trying to peep on Leone while bathing, usually these attempts end in failure. In the city, his cover is an owner of a bookstore. 
Lubbock's teigu is, Infinite Uses: Cross Tail, a wire based teigu able to be used offensively and defensively 

  ~!Rabac was 4th son born into a wealth merchant family in a region in the Empire. During his childhood as a boy he met Najenda who just moved into the region for the first time. Falling in love at first sight he left the privileged life he no longer desired to follow her into the army. Using his talent, Rabac rose through the ranks to the point where he could serve and be by her side. He would also join Najenda in her deflection to the rebellion, even going as far risk his life to change the military records of both him and her to K.I.A. Because of this he shares a somewhat antagonistic relationship Susanoo who he views as a rival for Najenda's affections.!~

65233.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3)

Sheele is one of the members of the Assassin's group, Night Raid. While she seems to be clumsy and ditzy on the surface, she's a very caring and sweet person. She bears the Teigu "Ecstasy", a huge pair of scissors that can cut through anything.

65237.description:
A seasoned assassin working for the Revolutionary Army, having successfully carried out countless missions. While she is somewhat aloof and carefree when not on the job, she is also extremely objective and is often quite blunt when voicing her opinions.  Her Teigu, 'Gaea Foundation', is a cosmetics box that allows her to instantly change her appearance and build at will.

Later in the series:
~!she develops a crush on Tatsumi.!~

65239.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7)

Esdeath is a high-ranking general of the Empire, and leader of the Jaegers. She enjoys torturing her enemies slowly, seen when she used her Teigu to put large blocks of ice in a cauldron so that the people inside would die slower and suffer more. Despite her sadistic actions, she is actually shown to have a compassionate heart when it comes to the lives of her men and others close to her.

Her Teigu is called Demons Extract, which allows her to manipulate ice and mold it from nothing.

~!She is looking for love and although her expectations were high when she saw [Tatsumi](https://anilist.co/character/64749)'s skill, she smiled and fell in love with him instantly !~

65257.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Shidou Itsuka is a student of Raizen High School. He was adopted into the Itsuka family when he was "abandoned" by his mother.   ~!Shidou has the ability to seal a spirit's power. However, the reason why he possesses it is shrouded in mystery. Due to this power which was already known by Kotori Itsuka he was recruited--or rather forced--to join "Ratatoskr" to help and save Spirits. Instead of killing Spirits to prevent spacequake from happening, he has to seal the Spirit's powers with a kiss in order for them to co-exist with humans.  Shidou met his real sister at volume 3 which was [Mana Takamiya](https://anilist.co/character/72283). Shidou, Mana and [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/65263) can't remember much about what happened 5 years ago because a certain "Spirit/person" locked their memories away, and at that time Shidou met [Origami](https://anilist.co/character/65261) and helped her which was the cause as of why Origami fell for Shidou.  Once the power of a Spirit is sealed within Shidou, he has the ability to use some portion of it, thus his resurrection power is from Kotori's abilities when he sealed Kotori's Spirit 5 years ago.!~

65259.description:
__Code name:__ Princess
__Height:__ 155 cm

Tooka Yatogami's name is given by [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257/Itsuka-Shidou) the second time they met. Due to being a spirit, she is always being targeted by the AST and is aiming for the kill; because of this, she hated humans for always shunning her and thinking that she wasn't allowed to live in this world. However, her whole life changed when she met Shidou.  Even with that high and cool presence, Tooka lacks some common sense and loves food very much.

~!Once her power was sealed, she wasn't being targeted by the AST anymore, and she started attending Shidou's high school. Her surname was given by [Reine](https://anilist.co/character/72281/Murasame-Reine).  She was overjoyed that she could live with Shidou now, but knowing that [Origami](https://anilist.co/character/65261/Tobiichi-Origami) was there too, she was somehow agitated and is always having a minor quarrel with Origami (mostly because of Shidou and their feelings).!~

65261.description:
__Height:__ 152 cm 

Origami Tobiichi is a student of Raizen High School, she is known for having high grades in her entire high school, while she is studying at this high school she is also a member of AST (Anti-Spirit Team) and she's one of the most skilled ones on their team.   

~!Origami is in love with [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257), her love for Shidou is greatly high that she stalks him. Origami met Shidou 5 years ago when the first great space quake happened. Although Shidou doesn't remember it due to his memories being erased by a certain spirit.  Origami has a great hatred towards spirits; 5 years ago when the first great space quake happened both of her parents died due to a flame spirit appearing causing every houses to burn and fall.  At the end of Volume 3 Origami saw the flame spirit (which was [Kotori Itsuka](https://anilist.co/character/65263)) she assumed it was the spirit that killed her parents but on Volume 4 that assumption was cleared by Shidou saying that there was another spirit lingering at the time the incident 5 years ago occurred.!~

65263.description:
__Height:__ 145 cm  

Kotori is [Shidou's](https://anilist.co/character/65257) foster sister. Kotori is the head commander of Ratatosk which teaches Shidou about the spirit and spacequakes happening. She told Shidou how to save the spirits in a peaceful manner so as to prevent the spacequake from happening.  Kotori has two modes which is depicted by the ribbon she wears. The white ribbon depicts the Imouto Mode which makes her show love for her brother. The black ribbon depicts the Commander Mode which shows her tsundere sadistic bossy nature.   

~!Kotori is actually a Fire Spirit. To be exact, she became a Spirit five years ago. The reason why Shidou regenerates his wound and comes back to life is because Shidou sealed Kotori's power inside him five years ago. It was around that time that there was a third entity which was said to be the cause of Kotori becoming a Spirit and the cause of [Mana](https://anilist.co/character/72283)'s, Kotori's and Shidou's memory to be erased.  Kotori's angel, Camael, contains the power of fire. Her weapon manifests itself as either a giant flaming axe or a heat cannon.!~

65397.description: Mitsuki appears to be a reserved and calm girl who recently moved in Yuuya's house after their divorced parents got married again. She encountered and was possessed by an angel one day on her way home from school shortly after transferring, whom the angel holds affection for Mitsuki's older brother. As a result, she often alters between her normal self and the angel's personality around people, especially to get Yuuya's attention.

65399.description: Chang Wen is the official who later worked his way up to Chancellor of the Left in the Qin state, and is extremely loyal to the king, Zheng Ying. He used to be a warrior of great fame and was skilled with the spear. In the past, he fought alongside Qi Wang and Hyou in the military.

65407.description: He Liao Diao is the last known descendent of the Kyuumei Mountain Tribe, which was destroyed in the war with Yang Duanhe, king of the Qin mountains. As a result of this, she moved to Kokuhi village, a place of outlaws in which she eventually encounters and befriends Ying Zheng and Li Xin. She becomes an expert in blowing poisonous needles using a hollow bamboo stem acquired following the defeat of the assassin Muta by Xin. It is initially assumed by Xin, Zheng and Bi that Diao is a boy, however it is revealed early on that she is a girl after she is wounded in a skirmish with their pursuers. She remains with Xin after they part ways with Zheng and she cares for their home during some of Xin's early campaigns before heading to strategy academy, where she is taught by Shou Hei Kun. Her expertise result in her eventual appointment as lead strategist of the Hi Shin Unit ~!and later the Hi Shin Army!~. One of the most notable displays of her strategic prowess was during the battle of Koku You Hill.

65445.description: A member of a legendary assassin clan called "Chi You" that is exceptional in combat and uses the notorious Dance of Death. She fights with a sword named "Lu Seui".

65495.description: ~!The alien that resided in the ocean near Enoshima that almost caused the end of the world.!~

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Gal (超高校級のギャル)

65523.description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'7")
__Talent:__ Gyaru

Junko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant in the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Gyaru, or Ultimate Fashionista in the English localization.

Junko is talkative, charismatic, and can be hotheaded at times.

~!It is discovered that the girl who introduced herself as Junko wasn't really Junko at all, but actually Mukuro Ikusaba, her twin sister, the Ultimate Soldier. She was the "victim" of the fifth murder, her body having been used to create a fake crime scene. The real Junko, the younger twin who she switched places with, was the mastermind behind Monokuma, as well as the Tragedy.!~

~!Junko's real personality and mannerisms are erratic and unstable, switching through several "personalities" at the drop of a hat, which she says is because she gets bored easily. Junko is incredibly manipulative and cunning, having orchestrated the Tragedy. She is obsessed with despair and finds it to be the most enjoyable emotion in the world.!~

~!It is eventually revealed that her true talent is that of Super High School Level Analytical Prowess. This ability allows her to quickly analyze her surroundings with superhuman speed, detailed thinking, and memorization, giving her the ability to predict the future with near-perfect accuracy, as well as be able to learn and understand new skills by just seeing it once. This ability is also what gave Junko her "Ultimate Fashionista" title: because she's able to predict trends, she can predict what will become popular with society.!~

name.native: セレスティア・ルーデンベルク
alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Gambler (超高校級のギャンブラー)

65525.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'5")
__Talent:__ Gambling

Celestia is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Gambler, or the Ultimate Gambler in the English localization.

Also known as the "Queen of Liars", Celestia is renowned for her exemplary luck in games of chance. She's accumulated a sizable fortune by robbing anyone stupid enough to challenge her blind. She speaks softly and smiles often, but in a way that tends to creep out everyone around her. She also hides a surprisingly short temper and will start shouting (usually at [Hifumi](https://anilist.co/character/65535/Yamada-Hifumi)) if she isn't pleased.  

~!Her true name is Taeko Yasuhiro.!~

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Bungaku Shoujo (超高校級の文学少女)
Super High School Level Literary Girl

65529.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm  (5'5")
__Talent:__ Literature

Touko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Literary Girl, or the Ultimate Writing Prodigy in the English localization.

Due to her severe persecution complex that originates from the bullying she suffered at a young age, Touko is highly suspicious of other people, frequently accusing them of thinking bad things about her. She has also caused others to give a bad first impression of her as she is known to blatantly insult others, even though it is the very first time they have met. Despite her young age, she has already won several awards for her writing, and her works are constantly on top of selling lists. She is also in love with [Byakuya Togami](https://anilist.co/character/65541/Togami-Byakuya), constantly swooning over him and acting extremely submissive towards him, although her affection is one-sided.

~!Touko actually has two different identities, the other being the infamous serial killer, Genocider Sho.!~

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Swimmer (超高校級のスイマー)

65531.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Talent:__ Swimming

Aoi is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Swimmer (超高校級のスイマー), or Ultimate Swimming Pro in the English localization.

Always energetic and friendly, Asahina is also a bit airheaded. She has difficulty remembering names.

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Bousouzoku (超高校級の暴走族)
Super High School Level Biker Gang Leader

65539.description:
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'2")
__Talent:__ Biker Gang Leader

Mondo is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Biker Gang Leader (超高校級の暴走族), or Ultimate Biker Gang Leader in the English localization.

Mondo is the second leader of the Crazy Diamonds, Japan's largest and most feared biker gang. He has ​high respect for his brother from whom he inherited the gang from after he died. Mondo acts tough and has a strong sense of honor and loyalty to his companions. After he finishes his role as a gang member, he wants to become a carpenter.

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Onzoushi (超高校級の御曹司)

65541.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Talent:__ Heir

Byakuya is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Heir, or the Ultimate Affluent Progeny in the English localization.

Byakuya is arrogant, seeing himself superior to his peers due to having fought to become the heir to his family's massive financial conglomerate. However, he is a sensible student who holds a truthful, albeit cynical, outlook on the world. He is ruthlessly honest about his opinions and often hurts others with his blunt remarks. Despite his negative attitude, he does occasionally lend a hand to other characters.

65593.description: A lonely 37-year-old high school teacher who has been the subject of multiple unrequited loves, his first being his old teacher Arisaka and later his own student Sajou. His name Manabu means to "study." Students are prone to making nicknames for him such as Sekuhara (Sexual Harassment) and Harasensei due to his name being easy to create puns with.

alternative: Prince of the Fateful Eternal Wind

65643.description:
__Height:__ ~300cm (~9'10")

He is a teacher for class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School and the main antihero of Ansatsu Kyoushitsu. He claims responsibility for blowing up the moon into a permanent crescent shape and plans to destroy the Earth in a year after teaching the students of class 3-E the art of assassination. His name comes from korosenai (殺せない), meaning "cannot be killed", and sensei (先生), meaning teacher. In this way, he is literally called the unkillable teacher.

~!Later in the story he is revealed to have been original reaper named Ryushi Korogane.!~

65645.description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'2.5")
__Class:__ Class 3-E 

He is one of the students in Class 3-E. 

Nagisa is seen as one of the weakest students in the class due to his small stature and mediocre physical abilities that are comparable to a girl. However, he is actually the most talented to become an assassin out of all the students, something acknowledged by [Korosensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643) and [Karasuma](https://anilist.co/character/73881). He is able to draw closer while hiding his bloodlust to make a surprise attack and able to make his opponents falter through his bloodlust alone.  

Nagisa usually writes down Korosensei's weaknesses that at first seen minor (since it doesn't look like major weaknesses), but eventually revealed to be useful since once they're able to almost kill Korosensei because of one of his weaknesses that is the same as the one that Nagisa has written down in his note.
