Outwardly friendly and polite to his friends and everyone, he hides a somewhat darker side of him as an assassin that won't be able to be found out during daily classes and will only be shown during training and assassination time. According to Karasuma, whenever Nagisa unleashes his killing intent, he isn't training and truly goes for a kill.

~!In the end, he kills [Koro-Sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Korosensei).!~

~!In the epilogue, 7 years later, Nagisa becomes a teacher of Paradise High School's Class 3-5, Deciding to follow in Koro-sensei's steps.!~

65819.description:
He is the holder of the Devotion bead. He is one of the five survivors of the destruction of Otsuka Village. 

He holds the living sword of Murasame on his right arm, along with a peony birthmark, which is the reason why he still looks like a 13-years old.

65821.description: Holder of the Duty bead. Sosuke also survived the fiery destruction of Otsuka Village. He did not have relatives and was raised with Shino and Hamaji as if they were siblings. He has a peony-shaped birthmark on the back of his neck. Ever since the accident that happened 5 years ago, he has an ability to transform into the dog Yoshiro.

alternative: Dark Flame Master (ダークフレイムマスター)

65863.description: A high school boy who used to be a delusional teen, believing himself to be the Dark Flame Master and becoming alienated from everyone as a result. Finding this to be embarrassing, he attempts to erase this past from existence, even choosing to go to a separate high school from all of his junior high school classmates. However, after encountering [Rikka](https://anilist.co/character/65865), his past delusions come back to haunt him.

alternative: Jaou Shingan no Tsukaite (邪王真眼の使い手)

65865.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Rikka Takanashi is an active Chuunibyou, who still has the syndrome. Her delusional syndrome involves her right eye which she calls her "Wicked Eye," which, according to her, wields darkness tamed by the power of a pure heart. In reality, her so-called "Wicked Eye" is nothing more than a colored contact lens which she conceals underneath an eyepatch. Despite being quite attached to [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/65863/Togashi-Yuuta), she is cautious of strangers and adopts a battle pose whenever she meets someone for the first time. She is also rather clumsy, often tripping over and forgetting things. She also doesn't have many friends, as shown that in her mobile phone only has her sister's email.  

~!Rikka's father died in the past, which she stubbornly denies. In the process, she one-sidedly met Yuuta, who was an active chuunibyou at that time, and was amazed by how cool Yuuta was as the Dark Flame Master. Her belief that her father is in the "horizon" is the cause of her chuunibyou.!~

~!Rikka eventually falls in love with Yuuta and makes a contract with him.!~

65871.description: A beautiful girl in [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/65863/Togashi-Yuuta)'s class. Shinka is Yuuta's classmate and class representative, who is also a cheerleader. One of the most popular girls in the class due to her looks, she is generally thought of a kind and gentle girl.   ~!She too suffered a case of eighth-grader syndrome, going by the name of Forest Summer. Like Yuuta, she chose a school that none of her former classmates were going to so she could escape from her embarrassing past.   When she is with Yuuta, [Rikka](https://anilist.co/character/65865/Takanashi-Rikka), and the others in the clubroom, her usual happy, sweet demeanor fades and she is blunt, edgy, and tends to fight with [Dekomori](https://anilist.co/character/67215/Dekomori-Sanae) quite a lot. This is because Dekomori admires Forest Summer (and does not believe Shinka is actually Forest Summer, constantly referring to Shinka as "fake Forest Summer") and has numerous copies of books, consisting of documents that Forest Summer had written, titled Mabinogion. Shinka seeks to destroy every last trace of her past, and Dekomori is a barrier against this, causing frequent fights between them.!~

66077.description: Yoshi, along with Futaba, Santa and Daiichi, have lived together, alone, since their father disappeared three years ago.

66171.description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") 

Kyouko Hori is one of the main protagonists of [Horimiya](https://anilist.co/anime/124080/Horimiya/), along with [Izumi Miyamura](https://anilist.co/character/66173/Izumi-Miyamura). She is a student in Class 3-1 of Katagiri Senior High School. Kyouko is mostly a very energetic and popular person who always creates a happy atmosphere around herself. She is a hard-worker in all aspects of her life, and, according to Izumi Miyamura, she scores above 90% for all her tests.

66173.description:
__Height:__ 169 cm

Miyamura is often mistaken for an otaku for his sneaky character. The truth behind his long hair and clothes is to hide his piercings and his excessive amount of tattoos. This is a secret that only [Hori](https://anilist.co/character/66171) and [Ishikawa](https://anilist.co/character/66961) know.  Izumi is a very thoughtful kid. He is a person who looks weak but is very strong.

66305.description:
__Height:__ 145 cm 
__Loves:__ [Tsuwabuki](https://anilist.co/character/64041/Tsuwabuki-Keita), P.E., Equitation, Enya, Classical Music 
__Hates:__ Women who get closer to Tsuwabuki (except from her family), Tea Ceremony, Ikebana, Anthropometry, Loud Music 
__Favourite Food:__ Haute Cusine, Tea, Macaron 
__Hated Food:__ Snacks, Sukiyaki  

[Ichiko](https://anilist.co/character/33820/Sakura-Ichiko)'s classmate and the after episode presenter of the anime. She's the sister of the Tennis Prince [Shion Adenokouji](https://anilist.co/character/77087/Adenokouji-Shion).

In the Manga, she's a Rich Girl in love with Tsuwabuki, and also a Ninja Stalker.

66311.description: A 16 year old high school student at introduction, Nanako is one of Makunouchi Ippo's biggest fans. Because of this, she views Mashiba Kumi as a rival and competes with her at almost everything. She takes any chance to be around Ippo, and even tried to steal a kiss from him once when he was sleeping after a rough match, but she was interrupted by Kumi. Like her older brother Manabu she is very attractive, but she also has the same love for puns as the rest of her family. Imai Kyousuke is in love with her, but she tends to ignore his feelings as she has no interest in dating her brother's rival.

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Programmer (超高校級のプログラマー)

66573.description:
__Height:__ 148 cm (4'9")
__Talent:__ Programming

A student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. Chihiro is the Super High School Level Programmer, or the Ultimate Programmer in the English localization.

Chihiro is a computer genius behind numerous innovative software. Has a very timid, meek personality, crying easily and apologizing often. However, Chihiro loves to talk about programming and becomes much livelier when it's brought up. 

As a kid, Chihiro spent most of the time on the computer. Chihiro's father, [Taichi Fujisaki](https://anilist.co/character/174957/Fujisaki-Taichi), was a software engineer who developed many major computer programs. While using his computer one day, Chihiro ended up modifying one of Taichi's incomplete programs and soon realized that she could write programs, after that, Chihiro became absorbed in programming and became famous for creating cutting-edge programs, including top-secret AI programs for an unnamed company, and gained many fans for resembling a "timid little bunny".

66591.description:
Naho Takamiya is the main female protagonist in Orange. When she receives a mysterious letter from the future involving [Kakeru Naruse](https://anilist.co/character/66593/Naruse-Kakeru), she and her friends try their hardest to fulfill the demands of the letter.

Naho is a very loving and shy girl who tends to scream whenever she is nervous or embarrassed. She is shown to have a rather passive personality, as on multiple occasions throughout the series, Naho is unable to speak her own mind and tell people (especially Kakeru Naruse) how she feels, possibly out of fear of hurting or confusing them. Despite this, however, Naho's feelings for what she cares about are very strong and passionate, even if she doesn't show it. As she gets older, she opens up and is able to tell people her feelings straight, but still shares some of her shy and reserved traits from high school. She is also shown to be fairly oblivious to people's romantic interest towards her, as seen with Kakeru and [Hiroto Suwa](https://anilist.co/character/66595/Suwa-Hiroto).

66593.description:
The series centers around him, his fate, and the efforts of his friends to fulfill the wishes of a letter from the future.

Kakeru is initially shown to be quiet and reserved, however, once [Hiroto Suwa](https://anilist.co/character/66595/Suwa-Hiroto) and the others invite him to join them on their walk home and hang out with him more, he seems to open up and enjoy himself. He enjoys video games. Though he puts up a happy front around his friends and family, he hides his true feelings often and is incredibly depressed over his mother's death/suicide, in which he blames himself for it happening. As the story progresses, he finally lets some of his feelings loose to Hiroto Suwa and [Naho Takamiya](https://anilist.co/character/66591/Takamiya-Naho), though even after the incident, he seems to still believe his feelings are only a burden to others. He is also very hard on himself on a consistent basis. He claims to think about killing himself every day. He is also a skilled runner and is the fastest runner in his class.

66595.description: Suwa is [Naho](https://anilist.co/character/66591/Takamiya-Naho) and [Kakeru](https://anilist.co/character/66593/Naruse-Kakeru)'s classmate and friend. He is very energetic and outgoing and he loves to hang out with his friends. He likes Naho but knows she likes Kakeru, so he supports them both. Suwa will become a very important person to her in her future, but 16-year-old Naho doesnt know yet.

66597.description:
**Height:** 152 cm

Marika transfers to [Raku](https://anilist.co/character/48393/Raku-Ichijou)'s class and is introduced as his fiancée; she bears a key that she thinks will unlock Raku's pendant, and is the most vocal about expressing her love to Raku. She is the daughter of the police chief, and has been in love with Raku for the past ten years. She does not get along with [Chitoge](https://anilist.co/character/48391/Chitoge-Kirisaki); she states she hates girls with long hair despite the fact that she also has long hair. She has a frail constitution; ten years prior, she was frequently visited by a young Raku, who brought her gifts and sparked a friendship with her. She used to speak in a rather vulgar manner but has attempted to correct her language after Raku had told her that he likes a girly girl with long hair. However, when flustered, she reverts to her old speaking habits.

66645.description:
Argo "The Rat" serves as an information broker and courier in the Sword Art Online death game. [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765/Kirigaya-Kazuto) and Argo suspect each-other without doubt to be a fellow beta testers but refuses to ever confirm the topic. As a broker she is known to sell any information for any price, including the story of her mysterious trademark whiskers. While she sells information to some at occasionally hefty prices, she is also known the be the author of free guide books situated in most town shops to help beginners. 

~!Argo's whiskers were originally drawn on to learn the "Martial Arts" skill during the beta test. Unable to complete the quest before beta testing ended, they became her trademark and source of her nickname.!~

66861.description: A third year student at Fujou High who was the previous student council president. There is a rivalry between her and Chitose that began since they were children.   Has an odd obsession with her twin-tail hairstyle, and uses it to her advantage in combat.

67001.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

One of the candidates for becoming an astronaut. Works with chimpanzees and always says what's on his mind out loud.

67057.description: ~!A son of a member of the Committee of 300, who actually works against them and has founded a secret organization which includes the characters of Steins;Gate and Chaos;Head to resist them.!~

67059.description: The author of the Kimijima Reports, who died several years ago.   ~!It turns out that he works for the Committee of 300 and caused the Anemone-gou incident which was in fact an experiment that would have killed all the test subjects; This was stopped by Misaki who killed him. However before his death he uploaded his consciousness to the internet and lives on through Iru-o, and now plans to execute the Committee's plans by inducing a massive solar flare that will kill the majority of the population of Earth. He uses the Kimijima Reports to manipulate people, and he has Geji-nee and Misaki (who was brainwashed by him) do his bidding in the the virtual and real worlds respectively. In the end he is defeated by Kai using a virus created to destroy him by Daru.!~

67065.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Hachiman is an isolated, friendless boy who is pragmatic to a fault. His most prominent feature is his set of "dead fish-eyes." He firmly believes that "youth" is simply an illusion created by hypocrites, for hypocrites, born from the ashes of past failures. In this state of apparent corruption, he is coerced into joining the Service Club by his futures advisor in the hopes that exposing him to the world will change his personality, and ultimately make him a "better person." He is called "Hikki" affectionately by [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/67069).

67067.description:
Yukino is the leader of the Service Club, of which she is the sole member until [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065) joins her. She is smart, beautiful, and is nicknamed the "Ice-cold Beauty" for her icy demeanor. She has a twisted sense of "noblesse oblige", and believes that it is the duty of the exceptional (in other words, herself) to help the "lost lambs" of the world. Her personality often leads her to be disgusted at the naivete of others, particularly [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/67069)'s, and she does not hesitate to show it. Despite this, Yui still affectionally calls her "Yukinon." She is a student of Class 2J (The academic standards of Class J are 2 to 3 points higher than the regular classes on the bell curve.)

~!It was later revealed that her father is a member of the National Diet (a legislator in Japan's parliament). Yukino was in the car that hit [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065).!~  

~!She later confesses to [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065) and becomes his girlfriend.!~

67069.description:
Yui is a cheerful, outgoing girl who becomes the Service Club's first "customer", asking them to help her bake cookies for "a certain someone". Her problems lie not with her personality, but with her inability to deal with issues by herself. She believes that talent is inborn, and often aspired to be like others until [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/67067) changed her way of thinking. Following her experience with the Service Club, Yui begins to attend Service Club sessions after school as well, despite Yukino's objections early on.

~!She is the owner of the dog that led to [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065)'s accident.!~

~!She has feelings for [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065) which she admits to the members of the Service Club in the final episode of the series.!~

67071.description: Saika is a member of the tennis club who has a feminine appearance, but prefers others to not mistake his gender. He is called "The Prince" by his female classmates. On their first meeting, Saika asks help from [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065) to join the tennis club, which was brushed off by [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/67067). Saika then asked the service club to help him improve his tennis skills. He eventually became one of the few people in class 2F who would talk to Hachiman, and often hangs out with Hachiman.

67073.description:
Zaimokuza is a student from class 2C who suffers from adolescent delusions. He displays a high interest in historical shoguns, magic, and writing (despite the fact he is a terrible writer), and video game creation. He often talks like a movie narrator or with grandiose overtones. He sometimes refers to himself and those around him in the 3rd person and involves them in his fantasy/roleplaying scenarios. 
He sees Hachiman as a friend after being paired up with him during physical education lessons. While he is annoying, he has a group of otaku friends he's on good terms with. He aims to be a light novel writer.

67075.description: [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065)'s younger sister who is very different than her brother. She's cheerful and lively and is part of her school's student council.

67077.description: Shizuka is [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065)'s teacher, a language teacher who serves as his futures advisor/counselor. She is aware of Hachiman's supposed "problems", and takes steps to ensure he is freed from them, her first move being to force him into joining the Service Club. However, she appears to have some quirks of her own: she is a young smoker, she is very sensitive about her age, and she is often prone to quoting or copying scenes from popular shounen manga. She also never remembers to knock before entering the Service Club's classroom, much to [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/67067)'s chagrin.

67167.description:
The main protagonist of the manga and brother of Momo Kisaragi, Shintaro is a hikikomori and as such, he has a hard time dealing with people. He seems to be constantly bothered by Ene.  First appeared in Transparent Answer. A hikikomori (recluse/shut-in) young man with an IQ of 168. In middle school and high school, he performed at the top of his class in National Mock Examinations, but due to the suicide of a close friend (Ayano), he dropped out of his first year of high school. Subsequently, a mysterious software enters into his computer named "Ene," and, being unable to control her actions, his lifestyle is at a loss. Due to one of Ene's pranks, his computer breaks down, so both Ene and him go to the department store for shopping where they happen upon a group of terrorists. They end up stopping them together with the Mekakushi Dan. After this, he and Ene come to join the Mekakushi Dan.

~!Shintaro's eye ability, given to him by Marry after promising long ago to "never forget this Tragedy", allows him to remember everything he sees. Unlike others, he does not visit the Kagerou Daze each Route to gain this ability and instead has it since before birth. When his ability is fully activated, he can remember events of past Routes and directly speak with the Snake of Retaining Eyes. In Manga Route 2, Ayano trades her life to become the snake for this ability.!~

67169.description:
__Species:__ Human

A strange program taking the shape of a young girl which has taken up residence inside [Shintaro](https://anilist.co/character/67167/Kisaragi-Shintarou)'s computer. She calls him "Master", and yet adores bothering him.  First appeared in Artifical Enemy. A naive cyber girl who lives in Shintaro's computer. She can possibly invade anything that uses electricity and gives her all in doing things that Shintaro hates. Was once a human, but lost her body in a certain experiment. She now possesses the power of immortality from her "opening eyes" ability.

67171.description: A mysterious girl who has appeared before [Shintaro](https://anilist.co/character/67167/Kisaragi-Shintarou) in a shopping center. She's seemingly the leader of the Mekakushi Dan. First appeared in Blindfold Code. A girl that plays the role of the leader of the Mekakushi Dan. She's essentially good-natured, but struggles to keep the individual members, like [Kano](https://anilist.co/character/67943/Kano-Shuuya) and [Seto](https://anilist.co/character/67945/Seto-Kousuke), in line. Using her "eye concealing" ability, she can erase the perception towards objects within a certain distance of herself or her surroundings. She is most always seen listening to music through her earphones.

67213.description: Kumin is [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/65863)'s chill and carefree senpai who loves adventures, cats, and pillows. Spends most of the time in the club room napping. She adores any chuunibyous and once said that it would've been fun to have some delusions herself.

67215.description:
Sanae is an underclassman to the rest of the club members. She, like [Rikka](https://anilist.co/character/65865/Takanashi-Rikka), is a Chuunibyou. She claims that she is Rikka's servant and wants to take her master's place. Her "power" is Mjolnir, a pair of hair nunchucks. Despite being a Chuunibyou, she is top in her class. Little was known about her relatives but it's implied that she is from a rich family.  

~!She eventually becomes the student council president with [Nibutani](https://anilist.co/character/65871/Nibutani-Shinka) as her vice president.
Her "nunchucks" are filled with candy, since her previous attempt with cookies didn't go well.!~
(Source: Anime News Network)

67321.description:
__Height:__ 174 cm 

Being the vice captain, Sugawara has a soothing personality for his teammates and acts as a pillar of support for them. Even though he isn't Karasuno's official setter anymore, he doesn't dream of giving up on playing in general. As such, he encourages himself and all of his teammates not to give up, no matter how rough the situation might be.

Sugawara's dedication to volleyball is clear when he decides to continue club activities even when most third years choose to retire to focus on their futures. In a meeting, his teacher asked Sugawara why he's so determined to continue playing even though he's not a starting member, and Sugawara replied that he doesn't want to have regrets in the future.

He is also quite perceptive as he noticed how [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/67325/Tanaka-Ryuunosuke) asked for the key to the gym (back during the first years' 3-on-3 match) even though he always comes in late, so Sugawara knew that something was up. He is also intelligent as he can come up with helpful tactics during the game. An example of this is when he came up with the idea of saying "bring it" and "send it to me" for [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Kageyama-Tobio) and [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/64769/Hinata-Shouyou)'s combo.

67323.description:
__Team:__ Karasuno High 
__Height:__ 176.8 cm 
__Year:__ 3rd year, class 4 
__Number:__ 1 
__Position:__ Wing Spiker 

The captain of the Karasuno High volleyball club.

67327.description:
__Team:__ Karasuno High, Chidoriyama Junior High (former) 
__Height:__ 159.3 cm (5'2")
__Year:__ 2nd year, Class 3 
__Number:__ 4 
__Position:__ Libero

Yuu is a very energetic and temperamental person. His boisterous nature and crazy shenanigans can attract unwanted attention quite easily, which often bodes ill for him. Although he hardly ever worries about the consequences of his actions (and may even revert to violence in order to vent out his anger on certain occasions), he is surprisingly considerate of his friends' feelings and insecurities.

Yuu can be extremely impatient, excitable and impulsive. As [Ryuunosuke Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/67325) puts it, "he simply gets too fired up for his own good." He doesn't bother to filter his words, and is therefore prone to blurting out whatever he's thinking in a loud and tactless manner. In-game, however, his attitude changes drastically: he becomes incredibly focused and serious, remaining calm and doing everything in his power to provide the support his team needs until the very end. For this reason, everyone in the volleyball club respects him greatly.

67329.description:
**Height:** 188 cm 
**Team:** Karasuno High
**Year:** 1st year, class 4 
**Number:** 11 
**Position:** Middle Blocker  

A member of the Karasuno High volleyball club. Tsukishima is very blunt and will sometimes rile his teammates up due to his antagonistic nature (most notably being [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/64769/Hinata-Shouyou), [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Kageyama-Tobio), [Nishinoya](https://anilist.co/character/67327/Nishinoya-Yuu), and [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/67325/Tanaka-Ryuunosuke)) and sometimes other teams because of his casual smug attitude, taking pride in and relishing when his opponents see him as a nuisance as seen with [Tendou](https://anilist.co/character/126073/Tendou-Satori) and [Shirabu](https://anilist.co/character/137537/Shirabu-Kenjirou). Tsukishima is standoffish and has an arrogant and condescending personality, but he has low self-esteem and thinks of himself as inferior. Although he is only outwardly close with [Yamaguchi](https://anilist.co/character/71609/Yamaguchi-Tadashi), he can be seen occasionally caring about his other club members.

67451.description:
Ichigo is one of the main characters, and a student of Starlight Academy. She is cheerful and has a cute personality; her choice in her cards reflects this. Her favorite brand of cards is Angely Sugar.

Ichigo was a middle school freshman. After seeing Mizuki's performance, she's inspired and enrolls into Starlight Academy, which is the beginning of her idol career. She's a complete novice, yet she is optimistic and works hard to become the top idol. She does not have much knowledge of the entertainment world, so she always has her best friend, Aoi Kiriya teach her.

Her favorite food is seaweed bento, her special skill is cooking, and her good luck charm is a rice scoop. She doesn't have any disliked food.

67453.description:
Aoi Kiriya is a student at Starlight School and Ichigo's best friend.

Aoi is a calm and bright girl. She is highly determined towards her goals and approaches them very seriously. Aoi makes sure to plan ahead and research as much as she can for a situation. She is hard-working and a bit of a perfectionist. As a child, Aoi quickly became interested in idols after discovering the freedom and excitement of it. Since then, she has dedicated herself to idols.

67455.description:
Ran Shibuki is a Starlight Academy student and one of Ichigo and Aoi's classmates.

Ran is a quiet, independent girl with a professional air about her. She is multi-talented and mature but she has a short temper and does not like being pestered. Despite this, Ran is a kind person. She is humble about who she is as a person and idol, despite her popularity.

67457.description:
Mizuki was the top student at Starlight School, priding herself on her ability and as well being the top idol. Mizuki was the number one idol and the role-model of all idols, thus being admired by just about everyone. She started off as an elementary model but then mysteriously disappeared from the public for a whole year. She came back without warning, taking the idol world by storm as a top idol. During that time, she did intensive training and pushed herself to work her hardest in order to reach the top. Mizuki doesn't show her hard-working side to many people and is thought of as just a prodigy. She is highly idolized by [Ichigo](https://anilist.co/character/67451/Hoshimiya-Ichigo) and inspired her to work even harder. As of Episode 28, she has her own brand designed after her image, Love Queen.

Mizuki is calm, elegant, and confident, acting professional, and working hard in her Aikatsu. In The Summer-Colored Miracle☆, it was shown that Mizuki can be bashful in certain situations and be viewed as a contrast from her usual personality. As of the second half of season two, Mizuki is shown to be happier and more relaxed than in the previous season, due to meeting Mikuru.

67473.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm  
__Players Data:__ No. 4  
__Job:__ Real estate agent  
__Home:__ Osaka  
__Bim Type:__ Homing type  

Kiyoshi is first Ryouta's teammate and the first adult who he manages to get along with. He hates feeling alone and seems to be a pacifist person the first time they meet each other.   ~!Because he saw an illusion of his family during his fight to escape from the island, Kiyoshi decides to betray Ryouta and Himiko in order to take their radar to escape. He decides to kill himself for all bad things he has done to Ryota and Himiko and because he was no match to handle a Komodor's groups.!~ It was hinted that he was put up for nomination by his employees because of him mistreating them.   (Source: Otaku-streamers)

67651.description:
A mysterious albino with supposed amnesia that appeared at Hiyori's relative's house one day during the summer. He was once a human called Haruka Kokonose but somewhere before the current timeline, he was turned into a cyber-being. He is currently living at Hiyori's sister's house as a foster child. Not knowing about the normal world, he's rather my-pace (air-headed, lost, confused). He is known to possess a strong curiosity for the unknown.

Haruka Kokonose was a boy in high school with a severe illness. He would often get tired easily, collapse, and not be able to do much. Caring greatly for any friends he had, he was sweet and gentle. Not once was he combative. Haruka was particularly good at drawing, even going as far as to create his own video game character who was strong, unlike himself. He was good friends with Enomoto Takane before he had particularly terrible symptoms on August 15th. On that day, he disappeared and hasn't been seen since—until Konoha came along, with an apparent bout of amnesia. ~!On the day of Haruka's worsened symptoms, he was brought to a near-death experience, received Awakening Eyes, and his body remade into Konoha. Haruka rejected his changed body, leading him to remain trapped in the Kagerou Daze and for Konoha to be an empty vessel that the Snake of Awakening Eyes would control to act on Haruka's final wish to make more friends.!~ ~!Eventually, in Mekakucity Actors, Haruka is reunited with his body as Black Konoha, taking it over and leaving the Snake of Clearing Eyes to be stopped and ultimately disappear. With his reclaimed body, Haruka is given a chance at life once more, now with more friends than he could ever imagine, and Enomoto.!~

67669.description: She works at Rokka's flower shop but then quits due to getting married.

67689.description:
__Team:__ Karasuno High
__Height:__ 166.2 cm
__Year:__ 3rd Year, class 2 

The manager of the Karasuno High volleyball club.

67745.description: __Height:__ 162 cm Race: Human In Princess Yona's group, he is the healer and genius. He is an outstanding curious intellectual. He can say mean things, but he's a caring pretty boy. He was born in a poor village of the Fire Tribe.

67747.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the white dragon of the group. He has dragon claws on his right hand, which is said to have ten times the strength of a normal human's.

~!In a side chapter focused on Kija, he (when he was a child) had secretly went to see his father (who was on deathbed). However his father was too weak to realise who it was and thought it was the granny. He had asked if it was okay for him to touch that child (Kija) now that his right hand was back to being a normal human hand. Kija, upon hearing this leapt onto the bed and hugged his father. His father died shortly after saying "Kija" when he realised it was him.!~

67749.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the blue dragon and has dragon eyes that allows him to see great distances. Shin-Ah's dragon eyes are also capable of disrupting the nerves of anyone he glares at until it kills them.

~!Later in the story, his power was explained in more detail. His victims are subject to fatal hallucinations. In extreme cases he can cause their entire bodies to stop functioning, including their hearts. However, he does not have full control over this power and will lose himself to the blue dragon's murderous willpower. When he finishes using that ability, he himself becomes paralyzed as a result, making the power a double-edged sword.!~

~!He almost lost complete control when [Yona](https://anilist.co/character/43814/Yona) was captured by some bandits (they were in the fire tribe and Shinah was assigned to protect Yona), causing them to have hallucinations after his mask was knocked off by a bandit. However, she wasn’t afraid of his power and saved him from losing to his power (though it wasn’t easy because he lost himself and didn’t recognize her). He was scared that he wouldn’t be able to stay by Yona’s side anymore and she would hate him because of this. But she reassured his importance to her and to continue to stay with the group.!~

He is also voiced by Sanae Kobayashi.

name.native: エマヌエーラ・ポルラローラ

67929.description: Emi knows both Yokodera and Ponta. She came from Italy and enjoys spending time with Yokodera.

67943.description:
Kano is a young man who is part of the Mekakushi Dan. He outwardly has an unfocused, aloof personality and always has a smile on his face. Because he teases [Marry](https://anilist.co/character/67947/Kozakura-Mary), [Momo](https://anilist.co/character/67949/Kisaragi-Momo), and [Kido](https://anilist.co/character/67171/Kido-Tsubomi) a lot, he's often considered to be a flirt, but when it counts, he's worth relying on. His actual personality, which he hides behind his ability the majority of the time, is quite subdued and mature. ~!He seems to be mistrustful of others and carries around self-loathing tendencies, believing himself to be "useless". !~

(Source: Kagerou Project Wikia)

67945.description:
First appeared in Imagination Forest. A young man who belongs to the Mekakushi Dan and is from the same orphanage as Kido and Kano. He works as a florist at the shopping center as well as various other fields of work such as traffic control and newspaper delivery. He is also the person that invited Mary into the Mekakushi Dan. With his "eye-stealing" ability, he can read information from any target. However, he dislikes it because, "it's a power where you steal with glances, without needing communication," so he rarely uses it. He has a pet hamster named "Hanao." He also has a habit of wandering around where he shouldn't be.

(Source: Vocaloid Wikia)

67947.description:
First appeared in Imagination Forest. A 1/4-Medusa, 3/4-human girl. 

Her parents told her “We’re medusae, so if we make eye contact with a human they’ll be turned to stone.” While growing up, she always stuck to their words and hid herself away from the world in the forest. Even after they died she continued to live alone. By chance, a boy named [Seto](https://anilist.co/character/67945/Seto-Kousuke) visited the forest and found her. He has since brought her to the outside world. 

After coming to the Mekakushi Dan’s hideout, and joining the group, she leads a sideline life making fake flowers in her room which generate a very small income. When she went into town to buy ingredients, the first people she met were neighborhood children. They bullied her, and she was traumatized by the incident, so she rarely goes outside anymore. Her ability is to “make eye contact”, which allows her to temporarily stop the movement of whoever meets her gaze.

67949.description: First appeared in Kisaragi Attention. A very popular idol in her first year of high school. Ever since a childhood marine accident at the beach with her father, she has the "eye-captivating" power that can draw peoples' attention regardless of their preferences in tastes or interests. Because of her power she was often alienated from people and had no friends, but since her meeting with the Mekakushi Dan, she regains her original, bright character. She has peculiar sense in taste and fashion, and as such, it is common for her opinions to disagree with other people's. She is also the younger sister of [Shintaro](https://anilist.co/character/67167/Kisaragi-Shintarou).

67951.description: First appeared in Heat-Haze Days. A boy that visits the city to take summer courses with Hiyori. He is known to be very mature for his age, yet has a cheeky personality. His quarrels with Momo are endless. On August 15, he becomes involved in a certain incident with Hiyori, but is the only one saved, and obtains the “eye focusing” ability under these circumstances.   (Source: Vocaloid Wikia)

68127.description:
[Rikuo](https://anilist.co/character/69339/Rikuo-Uozumi)'s former classmate and close friend. She taught at the same high school [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/11766/Haru-Nonaka) attended. She only wishes to be friends with [Rikuo](https://anilist.co/character/69339/Rikuo-Uozumi). She feels at fault for [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/11766/Haru-Nonaka) dropping out.

~!She loved [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/127393/Rou-Hayakawa)'s brother a long while ago, but when he passed away, she found it hard to love again. She loved him because of how hard he tried to be unpleasant, knowing he was going to die young, he didn't want others to be attached to him. She has known [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/127393/Rou-Hayakawa) and his family for a long time now. She tries to avoid the topic entirely and does not talk to anyone about it.!~

(Source: Yesterday wo Utatte Wiki)

68279.description: An otter who works in the zoo.

68315.description:
Shinya Kougami is an enforcement officer who is tasked with managing crime. Shinya has a high criminal mentality, but because of his skills as a detective, he was released under the condition that he becomes an Enforcer for the Public Safety Bureau, Unit 1.

Despite his natural grudge towards [Makishima](https://anilist.co/character/69725/Makishima-Shougo), they are actually somewhat alike, as shown in Shinya's ability to foresee Makishima's actions.

name.native: 山本エヴァンジェリン

68417.description:
A 28-year-old single and unemployed woman.

~!Later, she becomes an ally of [Samon](https://anilist.co/character/68419/Kusaribe-Samon).!~

68423.description: Junichirou is a university student and part of the Kusaribe Clan, being Hakaze's childhood friend. He can knock down a mage even though he can't use magic.

68583.description: The main female protagonist and the newly assigned Inspector of Unit 1. Considered a model citizen due to her ever calm demeanor and for passing the exams with the highest score for employment on several public sectors and private corporations. She decided to join the police due to being the only place where no one obtained a score as high as hers, thus she believes to be able to do something there that no one else can. She has a unique quirk in which it's hard to cloud her Pyscho-Pass Hues, making her a perfect fit for the job as Inspector.

69063.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")

An analyst in the Public Safety Bureau's General Analysis Division and a latent criminal as well. She provides backup to the Enforcers and Inspectors in their investigation by analyzing the data and evidence sent by them.

She is in a relationship with [Yayoi Kunizuka](https://anilist.co/character/69059/Kunizuka-Yayoi) who is one of the enforcers of Unit 1.

69295.description: A first-year second baseman of the team, Haruichi is a naturally talented, all-rounder baseball player. Despite his small stature and frail appearance, he has pinpoint precision while batting the ball, able to hit it as wide and as far as he pleases, and control where the ball lands. He also is extremely talented at defense, able to catch a ball in the air and throw it while still floating. He is often noted to have amazing baseball sense, able to decide in a split second where to hit the ball, what to watch for, and when to steal. His ability in baseball exceeds his older brother’s, Ryousuke Kominato, who is first-string player and also a second baseman. The only thing lacking is his stamina, which he works hard on improving.

69339.description:
Rikuo is a university graduate who has a passion for photography, but lacks motivation to find a career in life. He works part time at a convenience store to pay for his rent and living utilities. Rikuo has feelings for [Shinako](https://anilist.co/character/68127/Shinako-Morinome) ever since their university days.

He works at Nico2 Mart four days a week. [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/11766/Haru-Nonaka) claims that she knew him for a long time, but he has no recollection of her. He has a past that he doesn't want to remember. ~!He consistently treats Haru coldly, saying he doesn't know her or want any part of her, despite actually being unable to get her off his mind.!~

(Source: Yesterday wo Utatte Wiki)

69405.description: Ryouta is Kousei and Tsubaki's childhood friend who is also the captain of the school's soccer team. He is extremely popular with girls, often adopting a frivolous attitude. However, he does once in a while come up with good insight.

69407.description: Kousei is formerly a child prodigy in playing piano, often dubbed as the "Human Metronome". He was able to play the piano with extreme precision and discipline and thus had won many competitions across Japan.

69409.description: Tsubaki is Kousei's childhood friend and next-door neighbor, who treats him like a little brother. She is athletic and part of the softball club in school. Often dismayed at Kousei's inability to move on after his mother's death, she attempts to get him to play the piano again in order to make a clear decision about his future.

69411.description:
**Height:** 157 cm

Kaori is [Tsubaki's](https://anilist.co/character/69409) classmate, a free-spirited violinist who had drawn many criticisms from the judge panel due to her unwillingness to follow the score, but is highly favored by her audience. Kaori met [Kousei](https://anilist.co/character/69407) when she requested Tsubaki to set her up with [Watari](https://anilist.co/character/69405).

69435.description:
Izayoi Sakamaki is a young boy with strong psychic powers (Esper). He is always bored since no one can challenge him until he is summoned to the world of Little Garden.

~!Years ago, Sakamaki started a game called "Try to find me" where he would pay someone if they found him. He would go on a rampage as the world was too boring for him.  Canaria, Sakamaki's adoptive mother, discovered him 3 minutes before the time limit. She made him admit defeat then proposed that she was going to host a game with him. If she won, she would gain a son, if Sakamaki won, she would play with him for the rest of her life and even provide a wonderful place for him. With this, they both went around the world for 2 years, until Canaria made an orphan institution to help children like Sakamaki.!~

69437.description: A rich young lady who has the ability, her Gift "Authority", to command others with her words. It also has the ability to control other gifts and strengthen its power.

69439.description: A good-natured, quiet young girl who has the ability to speak to animals and use the abilities of any animal she's able to befriend. She is often accompanied by a calico cat. Her gift is called "Genome Arbor - Non Priorum". She came to Little Garden mostly due wanting more friends. In addition, she only gets angry when her friends are threatened, and is a big eater despite her appearance.

69441.description: A rabbit-eared girl who resides in Little Garden and is the one who summoned the problem children. She often tries to be serious but easily gets flustered. When using her power, her blue hair turns pink as she gains increased power.

69499.description:
__Height:__ 152 cm

A few years ago, Aoi had made a promise with [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/69503/Kuraue-Hinata) that they would climb mountains together, but after a bit of a nasty fall of a playground attraction, she ended up with a broken arm and a fear of heights, which eventually lead to a withdrawn personality.  However, once Hinata approached her at the start of high school, Aoi once again is drawn towards the lure of the mountain.

69501.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

Kaede meets [Aoi](https://anilist.co/character/69499/Yukimura-Aoi) in the local hiking and camping equipment store, where she asks her for advice regarding the purchase of a sleeping bag. The two exchange phone Email addresses, and Kaede eventually joins the circle of mountaineering friends.

69503.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Hinata is an exhuberant, energetic girl who used to go on long hikes together with [Aoi](https://anilist.co/character/69499/Yukimura-Aoi) when they were both kids. However, that came to an end when Aoi had her accident.  Still, with high school starting, she once again saw the opportunity to reignite Aoi's interest in hiking, so she went for it.

69505.description:
__Height:__ 144 cm

[Aoi](https://anilist.co/character/69499/Yukimura-Aoi) and [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/69503/Kuraue-Hinata) meet Kokona at the slopes of Mt. Takao, where she headed in the hopes of seeing dwarf flying squirrels, but was foiled when one of her shoes' soles partially tore off. Aoi performs some emergency repairs, though, and the three head back down.  The three of them, plus Kaede, eventually forms a circle of friendship through their common interest.

69725.description:
A humanist on the dark side who is hopelessly in love with cruelty, savagery, and all the worst aspects of human nature. A born evangelist, he possesses both uncommon charisma and a true gift for narrative. Makishima has quite a unique personality. He likes books a lot, as shown in his tendency to quote from famous literature.   

~!Makishima was the mastermind behind the many cases the Public Safety Bureau are investigating, including the one that led [Shinya Kogami](https://anilist.co/character/68315/Kougami-Shinya) to become demoted to Enforcer. Despite his murderous intent, his hue has always been pure white due to a unique genetics called criminally asymptomatic..!~   

~!According to Kogami, Makishima's pure Psycho-Pass is the result of having suffered hardships in his early life and that being "unrecognized" by Sibyl left Makishima feeling invisible, which may have triggered his single-minded goal of taking down the Sibyl System. Makishima, on the other hand, believes that isolation made him stronger.!~

70069.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

Kurumi is the third spirit who appeared after [Tohka](https://anilist.co/character/65259) and [Yoshino](https://anilist.co/character/70603). She has a split personality: that of a gentle, mysterious highschool girl with a slow talking pattern, and that of a psychopathic killer. She is very aggressive in her actions which makes it harder for [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257) to capture her.

~!Kurumi has the archangel Zafkiel, and has the power to control over time. The reason why she keeps appearing after being killed by [Mana](https://anilist.co/character/72283) countless times was because of her powers. For example, she can heal herself by turning back the time. She uses a gunblade as her weapon. Though she always keeps getting killed by Mana, Kurumi from a different time period appeared and was considered as the most deadly of all took down Mana, Tohka, and [Origami](https://anilist.co/character/65261) at near end of volume 3. It is said that her ultimate goal is to get the powers of the spirit inside Shidou to kill the very first spirit who appeared 30 years ago to make all spirits disappear from this world. Her angel is destroyed by [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/65263) in volume 4.!~

~!The twelve Roman numerals on the clock in her left eye have different powers that only the original Kurumi can use, but by using their powers, it will cause her life to be eaten away. In order to avoid this, she kills people to obtain 'time'.!~

70295.description: Kōda's son and Kyōko's younger brother. He is of the same age as Rei. After losing to Rei in shogi, he stopped playing at all, and afterwards started confining himself to his room and only playing video games.

70403.description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'2")

An amnesiac young woman who tries to regain her memories with the help of the spirit Orion. She's the protagonist of the series.

Her personality and past depend on which route the player chooses.

70405.description: A spirit that helps the heroine recover her memories. Orion has a very caring and eccentric personality, and can be very emotional at times. He is an all around nice and innocent spirit who tries to be helpful, but he's also very clumsy.

70407.description:
__Occupation:__ Photographer

Ukyo is a tall, slim young man with waist-length green hair and green eyes. His bangs fall freely over his face, down to his cheeks, and there is a long braid on Ukyo's right, held together using a white hair-band. ~!Ukyo's personality is out of the ordinary. He has a split personality disorder; one of his personalities is kind and caring, the other is somewhat crazy and menacing. When overcome with his more maddened and twisted personality, Ukyo develops dark lines under his eyes and he tends to grin very widely.!~

His symbolic route in the game is the "Joker."

(Source: Wikipedia, Amnesia wiki)

70409.description:
Fourth year University student. He is best friends with Kent and  has a 19-year-old younger sister. 

He also likes playing darts, billiards, and table tennis. He is apparently unbeatable at any game that uses hands, which is basically every single game. One of his hobbies is solving Kent's math puzzles. His favorite animal is supposed to be the hamster.

His symbolic route in the game is the "Spade."

(Source: Wikipedia)

70411.description:
A childhood friend of Shin and the heroine. Second year in University student.

He likes playing basketball, cycling, surfing the internet, playing video games, cooking, and reading. He is in quite a few school clubs, such as: soccer, broadcasting, archery, and newspaper. His favorite animals are humans.

His symbolic route in the game is the "Diamond."

70413.description:
He is the childhood sweetheart and friend of the heroine, and is childhood friend of Toma. He is in 3rd year high-school and is now studying hard to get into a university.

He likes playing card games and he's in the track and field club. His favorite animals are dogs.

His symbolic route in the game is the "Heart."

70415.description:
University graduate and best friends with [Ikki](https://anilist.co/character/70409/Ikki). He likes making math puzzles and observing things. He likes every single type of animal, because he likes to observe them all.

His symbolic route in the game is the 'Clover'.

70463.description: A young, high school age-looking girl.  She is referred as the "key" throughout the game. The last two concluding arcs of the game called "Moon route" and "Terra route" revolve around her.   ~!Kagari, the main heroine of Rewrite, has the power to destroy all intelligent life on Earth, though can also initiate a period of re-evolution, which restarts the process of evolving another means of intelligent life. However, this is done with the use of the Earth's energy, and by the time the events of Rewrite occur, there is no more energy left to do another re-evolution. Gaia wants to capture Kagari to ensure the destruction of humanity, but Guardian wishes to seek out Kagari to kill her, ensuring that human life continues.!~ (Source: Kanon-finale)

70465.description: Sakuya is a third-year student at [Kotarou](https://anilist.co/character/46723)'s school who looks after [Chihaya](https://anilist.co/character/40814) as a guardian would, and despite having the same family name, is not directly related to her. While generally a sociably kind person, he is rather cold only towards Kotarou; Sakuya enjoys making fun of him.   ~!He is the previous Rewriter, who rewrote himself to immortality to protect Minata. As a result, he turned into a tree, until one day a young Chihaya kneeled in front of the tree, prompting him to materialize and devote himself to protecting Chihaya as an atonement for his failure. He is known as the strongest familiar in Gaia, powerful enough to destroyed Tenma's Krivoy Rog (albeit injured) in one slash.!~

70467.description: Touka Nishikujou is a new teacher at [Kotarou](https://anilist.co/character/46723)'s school who is always seen smiling and is very kind. While not a teacher of Kotarou or the others, she often talks with them in the hallways, and has known [Shizuru](https://anilist.co/character/40816) for a while. She is a popular teacher among the students.

70603.description: The second spirit saved by [Shido](https://anilist.co/character/65257/Itsuka-Shidou). Yoshino is a shy girl who is said to be the Kindest spirit up to date. Her codename is Hermit.   ~!Other than Yoshino, she has her other personality named Yoshinon which is the rabbit in her left arm. Yoshino says it's her hero for protecting her from bad guys (which are the ASTs). It is also said that Yoshino created Yoshinon in order to restrain herself from hurting humans.!~

70733.description:
Satan Jacob is the main protagonist of the series. He was once the Demon King who declared war on Ente Isla in an attempt to annex the four continents. However, due to the actions of the Hero [Emilia Justina](https://anilist.co/character/70735) and her companions, he was forced to retreat to Earth, causing him to lose almost all of his powers.

Satan was well-known throughout Ente Isla as the great overlord of his people, his name synonymous with the terror and cruelty his army brought to those unfortunate enough to fall victim. He allowed his minions the right to perform any heinous acts they deemed fit, showing immense cruelty through the slaughter of many innocent humans in his conquest. By contrast, on Earth Sadao Maou is shown to be a diligent and proactive employee, instead applying his strong drive and determination to better himself in his new life. Forced to spend time living as a human and interacting with those he previously considered to be lesser beings, he has since developed a kindhearted and cheerful disposition making him popular among both his colleagues and neighbors. He now strives to climb the corporate ladder at MgRonald's.

~!Though he is not the legendary Satan spoken of in the Ente Islan Bible, Satan Jacob was given the name at birth, as it has since become an extremely common name among demons. While he once belonged to a lowly goblin-class tribe, Satan's family and comrades were slaughtered in a conflict between demons, the enemy having left him behind to die following the carnage. While lying motionless on the ground awaiting his eventual demise, he was found and rescued by a mysterious angel, who chose to care for the child and ensure his survival. The stranger claimed she had never seen a demon crying before and nursed him back to health, sharing with him many stories and her knowledge of humankind. Through her stories, he became instilled with a desire to unite his own kind the same way that humans had done in the past.!~

name.native: エミリア・ユスティーナ

70735.description:
Emilia is the main female protagonist and the Hero who defeated the [Demon King Satan](https://anilist.co/character/70733). After forcing the Demon King to retreat from Ente Isla, she followed him to modern day Japan to ensure his destruction. However, just like the Demon Lord, she lost most of her powers upon her arrival and was forced to assume a Japanese name. She was also forced to find employment, and so became a call center agent. She is a half human and half angel.

Overall, Emi is a strong-willed and determined hero, displaying many admirable qualities befitting of one in her position; among which are a pure heart, boundless courage, unwavering loyalty to those closest to her, and a deep-seated desire to protect the innocent. Moreover, she lacks self-confidence and gets angry/frustrated easily. While initially hesitant to become the great hero of Ente Isla, the death of her father at the hands of [Lucifer](https://anilist.co/character/83103)'s Army ignited a fire in the heart of the young hero, giving her a motivation to train harder and strike down those who destroyed her village. Due to her personal losses, she sees all demons as her enemy, most of all their leader, Satan Jacob.

~!Emilia Justina was born to her parents, an ordinary farmer named Nord Justina and the archangel Lailah. Knowing she had committed a taboo by birthing a child to a human, her mother fled, leaving Emilia to be raised by her father on his farm located somewhere on the Western Continent. During Satan's conquest, the child lived a peaceful life with her father. Despite fearing the day they would be accosted by the encroaching demon army, he assured her that their village would be protected by the Church, putting her mind at ease. Her life changed drastically one afternoon when representatives from the Ente Islan Church arrived at her home to train Emilia as the Hero who could free the world of the Demon King Satan. Although reluctant at first, Emilia's motivation was fueled when she received news of her father's apparent death when the Demon King's army laid waste to their fields only days after her departure. In reality, Nord Justina was taken by Lailah and hidden safely on Earth during this time, though Emilia remained unaware of her father's true fate.!~

70859.description: Hinata's good friend from Yukigaoka Junior High. He's playing basketball, but often helped out Hinata with practicing volleyball.

71121.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Section Commander, Squad Leader.

Leader of the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad, Hange is also in charge of conducting research on Titans, and pursues this knowledge so passionately that they have become obsessed with Titans as a result. After originally holding a deep hatred for the creatures, Hange decided to take on a new outside-the-box approach to their research by letting go of their resentment towards Titans and approaching the test subjects with compassion. 

Hange is an energetic, freethinking and quirky scientist, with a unique way of conducting both themselves and their work. Hange is a genius outside of just Titan research too, using their brain to create weapons, tactical plans, and inventions for the benefit of humanity. As a leader, Hange is thoughtful of their comrades, and can easily figure out complex problems in order to create plans for their teammates to carry out.

71267.description:
__Height:__ 169.2 cm

The setter of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. Kenma is [Kuroo](https://anilist.co/character/71269)'s childhood friend and keeps playing volleyball because of him. He has a very calm personality and is usually doing things at his own pace. Often seen playing video games and being introverted. Nekoma's backbone, brain and heart.

71269.description:
__Team:__ Nekoma High School 
__Height:__ 187.7 cm
__Year:__ 3rd Year, class 5 
__Number:__ 1 
__Position:__ Middle Blocker  

The captain of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. Kuroo has a somehow manipulative and cunning personality, but cares about his friends and teammates very deeply. As Nekoma's captain he has a sense of responsibility and confidence. Even though Kuroo's a middle blocker, he often uses offensive plays too.

71285.description:
__Height:__ 198 cm  

The center of the team. His best attribute is the hook shot, he is been practising the hook shot since grade school. He quit basketball after one year in grade school because of people had selfishly decided to have expectation on him and then selfishly got disappointed when those expectations didn't pan out.

name.native: マルロ・フロイデンベルク

71457.description:
__Affiliations:__ Military Police, 104th Cadet Corps.

Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District.

While most who join the Military Police Regiment do so because they want a safe position far from the danger of the Titans, Marlo did so because he claims to want "to uphold justice and do what's right.", much to the amusement of his fellow officer, [Hitch Dreyse](https://anilist.co/character/86017/Hitch-Dreyse), whom he often clashes with due to them being near complete opposites. His goal is to rise to the top of the organization so he can stop the pilfering of taxes and misappropriation of land. Though steadfast in his idealism, he could make moral compromises to achieve his goal, confessing a willingness to act like "scum" in order to move up in rank. Due to his passion towards his ideals, he had often been compared to [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) by people who know both of them.

71459.description:
A member of the Scout Regiment and a team leader in the 57th Exterior Scouting Mission.

~!He encounters the Female Titan, who catches Ness's line and whips it to the ground, killing him instantly.!~

71479.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7")
__Affiliations:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Scouting Legion

Member of the Scouting Legion. She seems selfish, cynical, bossy, sly, uncooperative, exploitative, and confrontational, but she can apparently be kind, especially to [Krista](https://anilist.co/character/62481/Krista-Lenz).

71539.description: A former neighbor of Sachiko, which holds in the old ruined house of her cats. The house they visited therefore very regularly to feed the local cats.

71541.description: As a doctor, he is a very able man, and because he treats everyone the same patient, he makes on others always a nice impression. His life has not been easy, as both his wife and his child he lost. Of which he has not let it get in Kiyoko and has now found a new love with which he is engaged. He also has a physical disability affecting his right leg.

71543.description: After an argument with his daughter, he is severely injured by her with a knife, which he survived but. She runs off and no longer has the courage to return home, even though her ​​father is not angry at her, and she would love to go back in its vicinity.

71545.description: As Miyuki, Hana and Gin have reached a dead end in their search for Sachiko, Kurumizawa tried to grab the trio with information on the ground. It ends, however, so that they and their neighbors a little gossip about the couple.

71553.description: The proprietor of the gay bar Hana was formerly employed in.

71565.description: Yasuo is Sachiko's husband, who has abandoned her and is currently in a dilapidated shack that can be aptly described as a dump, dwells. It all actually started very well, they loved each other, had a shared house and Sachiko was also pregnant. But then fell Yasuo gambling addiction, by which the marriage was suffering because he also took his wife's money in order to gamble on the tables. Even the alcohol he was not averse and when he was drunk again, it was no longer possible to talk reason with him.

71579.description: Rosalia is the leader of the orange guild Titan's Hand, she was caught by Kirito and sent to the prison managed by The Army.  As the leader of the guild, and in order to maintain her "green" status, she looks for victims and lures the players to a place where the other members of the guild attack and loot the player, while she maintains her «green cursor» to avoid suspicion.  (Source: SAO Wiki)

71581.description: Originally selected by Asuna's father to marry Asuna, he was adopted into her family on her father's wishes. He attended the same school with Kayaba Akihiko, who he viewed as a rival. During the Sword Art Online incident, he took advantage of the chaos to steal test subjects for research along with Asuna. In ALfheim Online he adopts the persona Fairy King Oberon  As the Fairy King Oberon, he keeps Asuna locked up in a bird cage at the top of the World Tree. In the real world, he confronts the powerless Kazuto by voicing his intentions of wedding the unconscious Asuna. While keeping Asuna locked up in ALO, he constantly visited her just to fool around with her. From his actions, one could say that he is a pervert.    ~!After Kirito manages to ascend the World Tree, Oberon and Kirito have a devastating fight. By using his system commands, Oberon is able to completely dominate Kirito. Fortunately, Kayaba Akihiko saves Kirito by overriding Oberon's authority. Then, in the real world, Sugou attempts to kill Kirito when he is running to Asuna's hospital. This backfired and ended up with him going to prison.!~

71609.description:
__Team:__ Karasuno High 
__Height:__ 179.5 - 180 cm 
__Year:__ 1st year, class 4 
__Number:__ 12 
__Position:__ Middle Blocker  

Yamaguchi always hangs out with [Tsukishima](https://anilist.co/character/67329/Tsukishima-Kei) and is very protective of him. He has trained himself hard to use a jump float serve. He is also a substitute ace server of the Karasuno Volleyball team.

71611.description:
__Height:__ 184 cm 

The setter and captain of the Aoba Josai High School volleyball club. He was [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Tobio-Kageyama)'s senpai when they were attending Kitagawa Daiichi. According to Kageyama, he is a very talented setter and volleyball player with a ​complex personality. 

His favourite food is milk bread.

71687.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")
__Affiliations:__ Survey Corps; Soldier, Special Operations Squad
__Relatives:__ [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/131991/Oluo-no-Haha), [Father](https://anilist.co/character/131994/Oluo-no-Chichi), Several Siblings.

Oruo Bozad is a soldier of the Survey Corps hand-picked by [Captain Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) for the Special Operations Squad for his especially high Titan kill record.

Oruo is a very self-confident, outspoken individual, and enjoys boasting about his own prowess. Despite his obnoxious demeanor, he is admittedly one of the best out of Levi Squad; having the highest kill count out of his peers, bested only by Levi. This only helps fuel his haughty nature. Though Oruo tries to come across as self-important, his cockiness is rarely taken seriously, and he is also shown to be somewhat clumsy, frequently biting his own tongue on accident while riding horses. Oruo also frequently attempts to imitate Levi, such as his rough speech and confident attitude, much to the frustration of one of his fellow teammates, [Petra Ral](https://anilist.co/character/62501).

71689.description:
__Height:__ 182 cm (6'0")

Eld Gin is an elite soldier in the Survey Corps. He was hand-picked by [Captain Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) and placed in the Special Operations Squad, of which he is second-in-command.

Eld is a responsible and firm leader with a strong sense of duty. He does not talk much, but when he does, he did so bluntly and in a straightforward manner. He also seems to have been a veteran of sorts as he teased [Petra Ral](https://anilist.co/character/62501) and [Oluo Bozad](https://anilist.co/character/71687/Oluo-Bozard) about how they acted during their first expedition. He also seems to hold some sort of belief of what makes a true soldier, saying that a kill record alone does not make a great soldier.

71929.description: Hamaji is like a sister to Shino and Sosuke, having been raised with them since childhood. Along with them, she survived the destruction of Otsuka Village. She is something of a health nut, and obsessed with making sure everyone around her maintains a proper diet, but her cooking skills leave a lot to be desired. Unlike her pretty appearance, she often manipulates Shino and Sosuke, but in heart, she cares about them. There are hints that Kaname has feelings for her, but those feelings haven't been addressed.

alternative: Mr. Humiliated Failure in The First Semester

71933.description:
**Height:** 175 cm

A student in [Koro-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643)'s class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School who had been suspended from school due to his violent behavior.  He excels at using weaponry and foul play and is the only student thus far to have successfully injured Korosensei. Despite this, he is actually rather smart and manages a perfect score on one of Korosensei's tests. He and [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/65645) were in the same class during their 1st and 2nd years at Kunugigaoka.

71953.description: Student at the same school as Shinichi.

71955.description: Student of Kita High School. Likes Kana. Gets jealous and beats up Shinichi.

71969.description: Student of Sakurazaki Middle School. Meet Shinichi on a boat and asks for his help.

71973.description: Formerly the best friend of Himiko.  ~!She was sexually-assaulted by Yoshioka-senpai's friends after being drugged. As a result, she was forced to move away and partially responsible for Himiko's nomination.!~  (Source: Wikipedia)

72073.description:
Race: angel/cat-man
Appearance: angel
Mother: angel
Father: cat-man (specific species name unknown. Because of his appearance, cat-man used as a alternative name).
Sisters (oldest to youngest): Chigusa, Chinami, Chiho, Suetsumi

She is the class president of Nozomi's class. Her family runs a shrine and she works part-time as a shrine maiden. She has four sisters all younger than her own. The first three younger sisters are triplets and have the appearance of cat-man, despite being half-angel like Manami. The youngest sister has the appearance of both angel and and her father's species. Unlike Manami, Suetsumi does not have a halo.

The halo of angels is not magical in any way. As a matter of fact, it is a hair decorated in a circular shape to promote the angel's culture, similar to how Christians wears crucifixes.

72181.description: Although Murano is a well known photographer, it isn't easy to work with him. His specialty is photo shoots for women who are stripping, and he may end up seeing attractive woman naked, which causes him joy. During the shoot, he can't resist a cheerful grin.

72183.description: In the film industry, Tejima is a very famous and influential man. He decides which actors, for example, get better roles.

72337.description: Schmitt is a lancer of the Divine Dragon Alliance and a former member of the Golden Apple.

72339.description:
Tetsuo was the member of the «Black Cats of the Full Moon», a small guild in «Sword Art Online». He is a mace user and the forward of the guild. He was killed along with most of his guild when a trap was triggered that called multiple monsters and prevented the use of crystals.

(Source: SAO Wiki)

72341.description:
Sasamaru was the member of the «Black Cats of the Full Moon», a small guild in «Sword Art Online». He was killed along with most of his guild when a trap was triggered that called multiple monsters and prevented the use of crystals.

(Source: SAO Wiki)

72343.description:
Ducker is a member of the «Black Cats of the Full Moon», a small guild in «Sword Art Online». He's a dagger user. 

~!He was killed along with most of his guild when a trap was triggered that called multiple monsters and prevented the use of crystals.!~

72345.description: Grimlock is a player in Sword Art Online and a former member of the guild Golden Apple.    ~!He was the culprit of his in-game and real-life wife, Griselda's death. He killed her because he didn't like the changes in her personality. At first he didn't want to aid Caynz and Yolko in their plans to catch Griselda's killer by forging them weapons to use in the in-AREA murders. Evenutally he did, but not with good intentions. He helped so he could have Caynz, Yolko and Scmitt together and get them killed with the help of the Laughing Coffin. But the plan failed, because Kirito came to the rescue. He is caught by Asuna. It is unknown to what happened to him in the remaining time of SAO, but in the end, he was logged out.!~ (Source: Sword Art Online Wikia)

72349.description: He is Lyfa's friend and mentor in ALfheim Online. He is skilled in concealment and high level dark magic.  He harbors a crush on Suguha, being her classmate in real life. He is key in investigating the Salamander's infiltration of the Sylph, and uncovering Sigurd's plot. He later rejoins Kirito and Lyfa at Aarun, and urges Lyfa to leave and return to Sylvain, after he finds her upset. Later he confesses to her and ends up getting punched. After Lyfa returns from meeting Kirito again, she informs them they are attacking the World Tree.   ~!During the World Tree assault, Recon breaks off and attracts multiple guardians, and later uses high level dark magic called Sacrifice to self-destruct, which entails a higher death penalty. This action buys enough time for Sylph and Cait Sith reinforcements to arrive.!~ (Source: SAO Wiki)

72397.description:
Megumi Nakajou is a very skilled tennis player. She won the All-Japan in middle school and is a freshman high schooler. Megumi is very skilled and was able to trouble Natsu by not letting her settle down. She is said to have a somewhat odd style of tennis.

(Source: Baby Steps Wikia)

72399.description: Souji Ike, also known as Sou-Chan, is a professional tennis player who was previously a member of Southern Tennis Club, STC. He was introduced to tennis by Natsu Takasaki and quickly surpassed her and players of his age. Souji is ranked in the top 10 in Japan.

72411.description:
Kazuya Maruo is Eiichiro's father. He is the one who first accepted Eiichirou Maruo's plan to become a professional tennis player after hearing his proposal.

Eiichirou's father has a somewhat mild personality. He was ready to give Eiichirou a chance to become professional in tennis. Later on, he was ready to help E-chan in anything he wants for his tennis training, claiming that until the All Japan tournament, he will provide any help he wants since Ecchirou wants to become one with his own will and is willing to work hard for it. However, since Eiichirou said that he would give up on being a professional tennis player if he did not win the tournament, He plans to make Ecchirou keep that promise.

72525.description: Also known by the name "Doc". Owner of the shop "Robo Clinic" which deals in robot parts. Junna's grandfather. He creates most of the important components used in the Robot Club's creations.

72563.description: A Second Year Student. The student council secretary of the First High School.

72653.description: Kagemune is the Lance Group captain for the Salamanders.  He led a group on a mission, to attempt to steal money and items from Lyfa and Recon. They managed to kill Recon but Lyfa escaped and they met Kirito. Kirito killed the two of his team members and left him alive after realizing he can't beat him.   ~! He helped Kirito on his lie about him being the ambassador of the Undine-Spriggan Union by lying to Eugene that Kirito had an Undine Ally when his teammates were killed by him. !~

72711.description: Cobert is a lieutenant-colonel in the Aincrad Liberation Force in Sword Art Online. He has a gung ho attitude. He drives his men to their limits, giving them no rest.   ~!He was killed by The Gleam Eyes after his party entered the boss room without any major preparations.!~ (Source: Sword Art Online Wiki)

name.native: ダーニアル・J.・ダービー

72735.description:
__Occupation:__ Gambler
__Stand:__ Osiris
__Manga Debut:__ Chapter 211
__Anime Debut:__ Episode 34

D'Arby is an expert and inveterate gambler and his Stand, Osiris, can steal souls. He is a member of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods and meets the Joestar Group in Cairo. Here, he tricks them into wagering their souls in various gambles. D'Arby is also Telence T. D'Arby's older brother.

Daniel J. D'Arby exhibits an affable but sly, knowing character. D'Arby first and foremost character trait is his love of gambling. He states that he lives for the thrill of gambling (which he recognizes as worthless). This love of gambling is complemented by his enjoyment for cheating, and he proudly admits that cheating is one of his greatest skills shamelessly rigging every game he's seen participating to while justifying himself by claiming that if the cheat isn't exposed, it is "fair" game.

name.native: テレンス・T.・ダービー

72737.description:
__Nationality:__ American
__Occupation:__ Butler
__Stand:__ Atum

D'Arby is one of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods and resides in DIO's mansion in Cairo acting as his butler. He isolates and challenges Jotaro, Joseph and Kakyoin when the Joestar Group enters the mansion and forces them into waging their souls against him in various video game challenges. He is also Daniel J. D'arby's younger brother.

As a butler, Terence is a mannerly individual. However, his demeanor is a facade for his twisted and arrogant personality. Due to his occupation, Terence is rather polite and affable, keeping his calm even in the face of provocations and comes to greet and confront the Joestar Group when they enter DIO's Mansion. Terence is a very intelligent man and is especially proficient at video games: He defeated the likes of Tatsuhiko, a child genius with an IQ of 190, albeit without the use of his Stand's ability to read minds.

72903.description: General Eugene is the head of the Salamander armed forces.   ~!He was considered the strongest player in ALfheim Online until he was defeated by Kirito during the Conference of the Lords.!~ (Source: SAO Wiki)

72921.description:
__Race:__ ~!Demon!~

__Height:__ 152cm (5'0")

Meliodas the leader of the Seven Deadly Sins and the Sin of Wrath with the symbol of the Dragon. He is the main protagonist of the Nanatsu no Taizai and the owner of the Boar Hat bar.

name.native: エリザベス・リオネス

72923.description:
Elizabeth Liones is the third adoptive princess of the Kingdom of Liones Originally an alleged survivor of Danafor's destruction, Elizabeth was adopted and raised by the king [Bartra Liones](https://anilist.co/character/131565/Bartra-Liones). After the Holy Knights rebel, she sets on journey to find Seven Deadly Sins, becoming a waitress for [Meliodas](https://anilist.co/character/72921/Meliodas-)' tavern Boar Hat.

~!She is 107th and current incarnation of the Goddess Elizabeth, and the lover of Meliodas, captain of the Seven Deadly Sins. She is the deuteragonist of the series.!~

72935.description: A Demon Lord who is friends with Kurousagi and the no-name community.

73019.description: A girl with the power to read minds. Her power has caused her harsh experiences since she was a child, so she's closed off her heart to others. But the truth is that she's still just a normal, weak girl who longs to be with someone. Her heart begins to open after her encounter with [Manabe](https://anilist.co/character/73021/Manabe-Yoshihisa) and the others. Even though she can read minds, she's not used to experiencing sexual thoughts, so she's always getting flustered by Manabe.

73021.description: A healthy young, high school boy who always has sex on the brain. Despite his loose appearance, he's a handsome man who hates twisted things. He's also generous, and doesn't mind Haruka's power at all. Though he does tease Haruka with his sexual fantasies, his love for her is clear and true, and he treasures her more than anyone.  (Source: ANN)

73023.description: The president of the ESP Research Club. Her mother was a clairvoyant similar to Haruka, who would often assist in police investigations. However, she was accused of being a fake and hung herself, bringing shame to her family and horrifying Yuriko who believed in her. Ever since, Yuriko has been keen to prove the existence of psychics, finally having the answer in Haruka.
