Yuuma has a laid back personality and is not very knowledgeable about Japanese customs, due to being from another world (despite having a Japanese father), leading to some run-ins with rough people. 

He is logical, advising [Mikumo](https://anilist.co/character/81237/Mikumo-Osamu) to stay away from the Trion Battle Soldier rather than save the students as Mikumo could die. He seems to be aligned with Border's cause, fighting against Neighbor forces.

81367.description:
__Race:__ Half-Alv
__Class:__ Enchanter
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")

Shiroe, the main protagonist of the series, was an engineering grad student before the Apocalypse. He's one of the most experienced and skillful adventurers in the game, due to having started playing Elder Tale when he was in middle school. He's also infamous for being a brilliant tactician. He is renowned as the strategist of the Debauchery Tea Party, an informal group that managed to tackle some of the game's most difficult raids. He knows [Naotsugu](https://anilist.co/character/81371) from the time both of them spent with the Debauchery Tea Party.

As an introvert with asocial tendencies, he would rather not have anything to do with guilds. Which is also because he doesn't want people to use him for his knowledge and skills. However, he doesn't actually hate other people, and he tends sympathize with beginners, especially if they happen to be children.

81369.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Class:__ Assassin
__Subclass:__ Tracker

A highly skilled level 90 adventurer who met [Shiroe](https://anilist.co/character/81367) and [Naotsugu](https://anilist.co/character/81371) shortly after the Apocalypse. Shiroe gave her the appearance changing potion (which allowed her character to look more like her real self); before that, she had been playing as a male character. She's very loyal to Shiroe for his generosity, and addresses him as "Master".

Akatsuki is rather insecure about her height, and hates it when people mistake her for a child (despite the fact that she is about Shiroe's age). She has a habit of kneeing Naotsugu in the face when he says anything perverted.

81371.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Class:__ Guardian
__Subclass:__ Border Patrol

Naotsugu is a friend of Shiroe. He believes that every man is a pervert, either openly or secretly. Thus, he prides himself for being an "open pervert", freely sharing his perverted thoughts about women with everyone.

81373.description:
__Race:__ Werecat
__Class:__ Swashbuckler
__Subclass:__ Chef

Nyanta is an old friend of Shiroe, as he also used to be a member of the Debauchery Tea Party. He's the one who protected Serara while she was trapped in the city of Susukino. He considers himself a "gentleman"; his weapon of choice is the rapier which he can double-wield. He can cook meals that have actual taste due to his subclass.

81597.description: Yukina Himeragi is the female protagonist of the series. She is an attack mage, or in the Lion King Organization, a Sword Shaman, who is sent by the Lion King Organization to observe the Fourth Primogenitor, Kojou Akatsuki. As she's appointed to observe him, she became a middle-school student studying in Saikai Academy who follows him everywhere and is also ordered to kill him if he becomes too powerful and insane to control himself. ~!She is also the first blood mate of Kojou, and thus being the first, her blood smell is always associated with Kojou's own smell, which has been pointed out many times by other characters who could smell blood, probably due to her blood interbreeding with Kojou's as she was the one who activated Kojou's first 'real' vampiric act. Also, unknown to her, she was intended and prepared by the Lion King Organization to be his lover.!~

81645.description:
__School::__ Luna Nova Magical Academy
__Occupation:__ Witch Student

The main protagonist, an energetic and optimistic girl who attends Luna Nova after being inspired by the witch [Shiny Chariot](https://anilist.co/character/81717/du-Nord-Chariot). Having come from a non-magical background, she struggles using magic much of the time, and is disappointed by the mundanity of her classes as opposed to Chariot's more spectacular performances. However, her strong sense of self-confidence enables her to wield Chariot's Shiny Rod, which accepts her as its new master.

81675.description: A 3rd generation city employee, who works at the city welfare department, he is assigned to the 1st section that issues nursing certifications. He claims to be good at almost everything and he is quite a charmer that he can get email addresses from pretty clients, even boasting about it to his superior, Taishi. Though, a slacker he wouldn't hesitate to go out of his way to help out Yamagami and Saya when they're having trouble dealing with difficult clients. He always teases Yamagami that he would find himself earning her ire.

81679.description:
A social service employee who is actually working as a temporary employee with a shorter shift than others. She is rather aloof towards her co-workers, and is revealed to be an avid fan of the magical girl series Magical Flowers. When she is not at work, she attends cosplay events dressed as Gerbera Pink, one of the characters of the series. She openly desires to see Lucy cosplay as one of the other characters from "Magical Flowers" due to her dark hair and large bust. She hates Hasebe getting too close to Lucy in case he convinces her to cosplay before she does.

~!She has been dating Ichimiya for over a year, and has tried to make it clear to him that she doesn't care if he prioritizes Tohko on Christmas because of comiket.!~

81681.description:
Taishi is a supervisor in the health and welfare office and the one in charge of Lucy and her friends. Although kind and approachable, Taishi is prone to be bossed around, particularly by his sister.

~!He has been dating Chihaya for over a year, but worries about getting dumped before Christmas, since Toko's birthday is on the same day and he always prioritizes Toko, though Chihaya, due to her own Christmas cosplay commitments, doesn't seem to care.!~

name.native: スーシィ・マンババラン

81699.description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__School:__ Luna Nova Magical Academy
__Occupation:__ Witch Student

Sucy is an aloof, calm, sarcastic, and somewhat sadistic person. She also surprisingly remains indifferent in various situations and things that drive the other girls crazy, which shows that she is calmer than her roommates.

name.native: ダイアナ・キャベンディッシュ

81709.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

Diana is serious, composed, and erudite. Being descended from a prestigious line of witches back to ancient times, she is exceptionally devoted to her magical studies and to the tradition and history of magic. Her status as Luna Nova's best student cannot be solely attributed to heredity — she has self-discipline and maturity far surpassing the average teenage girl.

She quickly becomes [Akko](https://anilist.co/character/81645/Kagari-Atsuko)'s rival, though she doesn't see herself as her rival.

81737.description: Candy Craftswoman. She’s tall and skinny and her hair is of the color of the wheat. Her dream is to become a Silver Sugar Master like her Mother. She’s doing her best to construct a relationship with [Shall](https://anilist.co/character/81739/Shall-Fen-Shall) and [Mythrill](https://anilist.co/character/81741/Mythrill-Rid-Pod) as equals.

name.native: シャル・フェン・シャル

81739.description:
Highly Skilled Warrior Fairy bought by [Ann](https://anilist.co/character/81737/Halford-Ann). Because he was born from Obsidian he’s always very dark. He also has a sharp tongue.

~!Although this is obvious, he has feelings for Ann. But he doesn't realise it himself.!~

~!In volume 2 of the light novel, more of his past with Liz is revealed. He loved her dearly, as long as she was happy he wouldn't minded if they had to separate. This was a contrast to Ann, where Shall was unwilling to let her go despite knowing she would have a stable and safe life if she lived in [Hugh](https://anilist.co/character/284535/Mercury-Hugh)'s castle. He didn't like the idea of giving away Ann to Hugh. Liz had also said that her love for Shall was not the same love he felt for her. So contrary to what Ann thought, Shall likely did not have romantic feelings for Liz.

Shall was asked to leave and never to come back by Ann. Despite this, he came and looked for her anyway when he knew that she could be in danger.!~

name.native: ミスリル・リッド・ポッド

81741.description: Tiny labor fairy that was saved by Ann once from a Fairy Hunter. He’s now with her to return the favor. He’s cute when he’s not talking. He was born from drops of water.

name.native: ジョナス・アンダース

81743.description:
The son of a wealthy candy craftsman. Ann freeloaded from him for a while. He likes Ann.

~!Although he expressed his "love" for her, it was all a lie. He tricked Ann into making a sugar sculpture, where he would steal it and her carriage and submit that sculpture as his own to win the annual Sugar Sculpture Festival. However in the end he failed as Ann made it in time to the festival. As the judges could not determine who was the real maker of the sculpture Jonas stole from Ann, neither Ann or Jonas won.!~

81751.description:
__Height:__ 152 cm

Mirai Kuriyama is the deuteragonist of the Kyoukai no Kanata series. She is a first-year student and a member of the school's Literary Club. She comes from a bloodline of Spirit World Warriors who possess blood-manipulation abilities. However, because these abilities are considered heretical among the Spirit World Warrior clans, she is shunned. After meeting [Kanbara Akihito](https://anilist.co/character/81757) she started opening up to people and relating to them again.

81753.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

Nase Mitsuki is the sadistic second daughter of the famous underworlder Nase household. She is with [Akihito](https://anilist.co/character/81757/Kanbara-Akihito) in order to observe him, but she is in fact very worried about him. She is good enough friends with Akihito to be able to speak frankly with him, and is the president of the school's literature club as a second-year student.

(Source: Anime News Network)

81757.description:
__Race:__ Half-Youmu
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7'')

Akihito is one of the main characters of the Kyoukai no Kanata series. He is an alone living second year student and a member of his school's Literary Club. He is a half-youmu and has the ability to instantly heal from his wounds. He is mostly unfamiliar with spirit world warriors and Youmu, something rare for someone like him.

81763.description:
**Race:** Spirit World Warrior
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")

Nase Hiroomi is the eldest son of the famous underworlder Nase family and [Mitsuki's](https://anilist.co/character/81753/Nase-Mitsuki) elder brother. 

It appears that Hirooumi and [Akihito](https://anilist.co/character/81757/Kanbara-Akihito) had something happen between them in the past, but now they are on such good terms that they can joke around with each other. He has a little sister complex. Due to his barrier powers as an underworlder, he is extremely sensitive to cold, and is almost always seen wearing a muffler or scarf. 

Hiroomi is a third-year student in high school.

81853.description:
Decim is the bartender of Quindecim and also the arbiter of floor 15. 

His faction deals with people who have died at the same time. He can create threads and use them to restrict rude customers from moving, or use them to hang things. They are strong enough to stop a person in their tracks and swing them hard against the wall.

81929.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Abilities:__ Psychokinesis
__Occupation:__ Superhero
__Level:__ S-Class; Rank: 2
__Affiliation:__ Heroes Association
__Family:__ [Fubuki](https://anilist.co/character/81931/) (sister)

Tatsumaki is a petite woman, commonly mistaken for being much younger than she really is. She has an adolescent face with emerald green eyes and green hair that naturally curls up on the ends. She wears a long dress that separates into 4 sections slightly above the hips and low-heeled black shoes.

__Personality:__
She has a rather brash, moody, hotheaded, and impatient personality. She is disrespectful towards most people, especially to those she deems incompetent. Despite her arrogant personality, she feels obligated to defeat monsters and considers her job as a hero to be a duty, accepting any of the Hero Association's requests to defeat monsters, due to the fact that she tends to get bored when she is not fighting monsters. She also seeks them to fight in her own time. She has a bit of a soft side towards her little sister Fubuki, but she is also very overprotective.

__Abilities:__
As the most powerful esper in One-Punch Man and one of the most powerful heroes, Tatsumaki possesses extreme skill in wielding her psychic abilities, whether it be for offense, defense, or miscellaneous uses. Tatsumaki's knowledge about psychic powers is also as vast as her skill in wielding them, which is enough to lift an entire city. She's also called as the Association's ultimate weapon.

alternative: Jigoku no Fubuki (地獄のフブキ)

81931.description: __Race:__ Human __Occupation:__ Superhero __Height:__ 167 cm (5'5¾") __Level:__ B-Class Rank 1 __Affiliation:__ Hero Association __Family:__ Tatsumaki (sister) __Abilities:__ Psychokinesis Fubuki, also known by her hero alias Blizzard of Hell, is the B-Class Rank 1 professional hero of the Hero Association. She is an esper, the younger sister of Tatsumaki, and the leader of the Blizzard Group, a B-Class hero faction. She and her sister are known as the Psychic Sisters. Fubuki is currently trying to recruit [Saitama](https://anilist.co/character/73935/Saitama) into her group. She's also a self-declared member of the Saitama Group.

81967.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

A narcissistic boy who is obsessed with the idea of getting revenge. His feelings of revenge are aimed towards the popular rich girl, [Adagaki Aki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/Adagaki-Aki). Despite his handsome appearance now, he was once a chubby kid who people liked to make fun of. 

~!It is shown later on that the reason he hates Adagaki Aki so much was because she rejected his feelings for her and nicknamed him "Piggy". Later on, in order to get revenge on Aki, Makabe teams up with [Koiwai Yoshino](https://anilist.co/character/121008/Koiwai-Yoshino), Aki's maid.!~

82037.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

She is an amnesiac woman taken in by [Nona](https://anilist.co/character/88681/Nona) to Quindecim and hired as [Decim](https://anilist.co/character/81853/Decim)'s assistant.

When she first awoke, she appeared to be an innocent but skeptical woman. However, once she became accustomed to living in Quindecim, she acted as a strong-willed woman who always spoke her mind whenever she felt it was necessary. She is not afraid to disagree with Decim if she believes he is wrong.

82069.description: Chan were the servants of Hagire Rinichirō and his artificial children.   Chan and En both wear the same clothes and look exactly the same way (with the exception of their hair). They wear a black formal suit with a white shirt under it. They also have a red tie. En's hair reaches over her shoulders and Chan's is shoulder length. They are albino so they have red eyes and a somewhat grey skin.

82071.description: Chan and En were the servants of Hagire Rinichirō and his artificial children.   Chan and En both wear the same clothes and look exactly the same way (with the exception of their hair). They wear a black formal suit with a white shirt under it. They also have a red tie. En's hair reaches over her shoulders and Chan's is shoulder length. They are albino so they have red eyes and a somewhat grey skin.

82073.description: Ledo's mech suit.   ~!Sacrifices itself to save Ledo and the people on Earth from the rule of the Striker by blowing itself and the Striker up together.!~

82111.description: Haruki is a teenage boy of average height with unkempt black hair and bangs that fall above his attentive grey eyes.

82115.description: Setsuna is a third year student at Houjou High. She has been Miss Houjou two years in a row and enjoys singing karaoke. Setsuna likes singing "White Album", a song from the first White Album visual novel. ~!In her True Ending, she marries Haruki Kitahara!~

82119.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm  

Kazusa is a third year student at Houjou High and is in the same class as [Haruki Kitahara](https://anilist.co/character/82111/Kitahara-Haruki). She often dozes off in, is late for, or skips class. She is a very talented pianist, and comes from a wealthy family.

~!In her True Ending, she becomes the wife of Haruki Kitahara!~

82121.description: Middle aged man driving a white Mercedes. Has a "sugar daddy" kind of relationship with Natsuki Mogi.

82327.description: She is maid to Earl Tigre Vorn, and also his childhood friend (little sister-like existence). Descended from a family of Priestess' who worship the Zechtd gods.

82331.description: A second year middle school student, and a member of the art club.  He's the main character of this series, and has a few small problems. He is mostly dense with girls but has a very close relationship with Usami.

82335.description:
A second year middle school student, and a member of the art club.  She's the heroine of the story, and has relatively fewer problems.
She tends to display a calm and outgoing expression but may turn violent at times.

alternative: Snow Princess of the Frozen Wave

name.native: ソフィーヤ＝オベルタス
エリザヴェータ＝フォミナ
ヴァレンティナ＝グリンカ＝エステス
アレクサンドラ＝アルシャーヴィン
ティグルヴルムド＝ヴォルン

82523.description:
__Race:__ Human

Abandoned by his parents, Sora is a brilliant NEET (Not in Education, Employment, or Training) hikikomori (shut-in) gamer along with his stepsister, [Shiro](https://anilist.co/character/82525/Shiro). He does not take life very seriously and is pretty much a good-for-nothing gamer. One day, he and his sister are called into an alternate world and they have to become Saviors of Humanity! 

Despite being a NEET and a shut-in, Sora is extremely outgoing and confident, and is not afraid to play games with people face to face, even when they're cheating. He is also extremely manipulative - which he refers to as using negotiating skills. This fits in with his play style as while Shiro is excellent at logic and computing, Sora can read people and predict what their next move is, using this knowledge to beat them. 

However, if he is separated from Shiro by so much as a closed door he becomes a spineless, cowardly wreck, and only returns to his former self if he is able to see her. He views his sister as his equal and partner, but is also protective of her, shown by actions such as putting his body between her and the ground when he thought they were going to hit hard when first arriving on Disboard.

Sora is extroverted and has no problems dealing with people. While not as intelligent as Shiro, he is shown to have a brilliant IQ. Rather than computing numbers like Shiro, Sora can rapidly compute what his opponents are going to do based on observing their behavior and motivations.

Sora is also slightly perverted and desires a girlfriend for himself. His lust lead to a linguistic mistake that causes [Stephanie](https://anilist.co/character/82527/Dola-Stephanie) to fall in love with him and causes him to receive a scolding from Shiro.

82525.description: Shiro is the main female protagonist. She's a genius NEET (Not in Education, Employment, or Training) hikikomori (shut-in) gamer along with her step-brother, [Sora](https://anilist.co/character/82523/Sora) and together they formed 『　　』. Between both siblings she is the calm and collective half which makes her the brain of the group.

name.native: ステファニー・ドーラ

82527.description:
__Race:__ Imanity

Stephanie is expressive and emotional, to the point where she cannot hide her emotions during a poker game. She loved her grandfather dearly and is angered when people call her grandfather a fool. She fell in love with [Sora](https://anilist.co/character/82523/Sora) due to the pledges forcing her to, and she often has violent outbursts to try to break free of it. She loves her kingdom and the world and believes in the potential of Imanity.

82533.description:
He is the main adviser for Prince [Canute](https://anilist.co/character/17438). Ragnar is bald apart from very long, black, curly hair on the sides of his head. He has very thick black eyebrows that lie close to his deepset eyes. His wrinkles are also very deep, especially in his cheeks, just above his thick beard.

(Source: Vinland Saga Wiki)

82535.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm

Eldest son of [Ketil](https://anilist.co/character/223346) and brother of [Olmar](https://anilist.co/character/224512). Much like [Thorkell](https://anilist.co/character/17440) he loves a good fight and has no qualms killing anybody who gets in his way. Served as a Thegn under Canute.

82537.description: A Jomsviking commander whom contracted [Askeladd](https://anilist.co/character/13020) to assassinate [Thors](https://anilist.co/character/13021), Floki's former comrade.

82541.description: "Bizarre Cooking" Tengu Buranchi is a genius chef and somewhat of a problem child, who, in the chef world, is a delinquent comparable to Zebra of the Bishokuya world. He has appeared only once in a Cooking Festival, but won it by a good margin. He currently holds the Number 3 spot in the IGO Chef Ranking, making him the third greatest chef in the world. He is from the "Bewitching Food World" located in the Gourmet World and is the head chef and owner of the Bizarre Dining Hall "Tengu Castle".  He is a tall red-skinned man with long white hair that he keeps combed back but also tied into a wild bushy ponytail. He has a somewhat sinister-looking appearance, such as fierce-looking eyes and sharp pointy teeth. His most notable trait is his very long nose which resembles that of a Japanese Tengu's, hence his name. He wears a black shirt and white pants along with a white chef's jacket. For footwear, he uses one-tooth tengu-geta. He appears to have a large mole or piercing embedded in his forehead and strangely enough, two small rectangular covers on his neck which conceal small battery slots, indicating that he may have some sort of cybernetic implants.  He appears to have quite the problematic personality and a careless approach to life. Despite his uncouth behavior, he takes his job as a chef seriously, and is usually seen as weird by others. He is shown to have a love for food as when he dropped down to the Four Heavenly Kings' table without moving the plates or bottles that had food or wine in them, and can also hear the "Voice of Ingredients" showing just how much he values and respects food. Buranchi seems to have formed a friendly rivalry with Komatsu after having been declined as a partner by Zebra and hearing about him from the Four Heavenly Kings.  Buranchi has the ability to generate and control large amounts of electricity. It is strong enough to completely incinerate the Bishokukai's Beasts, and even scorch and stun Elg, hinting it would be fatal to the latter if he were not immortal. Buranchi's body contains electricity-producing organs like an electric eel, but each of his cells also act as amplifier circuits. He can produce over 100,000 amperes of electricity with an average potential of 100 million volts, rivaling the power of a lightning. Since the time needed for discharging it is 0.1 seconds, his attacks are virtually unavoidable. When preparing a long-distance attack, he first makes the path in the air, the Stepped Leader, to lock on his targets, then unleashes the offensive discharge, the Return Stroke. While the first part goes at the speed of 200 Km/s (Mach 600), the second is much faster, traveling at 10000 Km/s (Mach 30000). He can use electricity to boost his already impressive speed and reactions to unthinkable levels, as shown during his confrontation with Elg, to the point that most attacks look "stopped" to him. He claims that, although lasting for a very short time and not reaching the speed of light, no living creature can measure up to it. While Buranchi can produce electricity naturally, he finds using batteries that he inserts into his neck most convenient. However, he can also generate it from other sources, including solar, wind, thermal, water or even kinetic energy received from opponents attacks, making his body a virtual power plant.

82543.description: Kakeru is one of [Hayato](https://anilist.co/character/79591)'s friends. He is in the football club. He has feelings for [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/79595) and is the only guy in class who often supports Hina's scripts.

82547.description: Oooka is one of Hayato's friends. He is in the baseball club.

82649.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm
__Class:__ 1-3

Tomoya is not only popular among girls, but he's also a player. A narcissistic guy who flirts and constantly and steals the hearts of many girls in his school. But what if there is one who doesn't fall for his good looks? He's a bit overprotective of his younger sister.

~!He falls in love with Mari and confesses to her in chapter 20. Before that he often tried to flirt with her already which she coldly rejected as his games but in his confession he tells her that he's serious and she also believes him.!~

82819.description: Takehara girl who goes to the same high school as Fuu. Like Fuu, her hobby is photography, and she uses the Pentax Q camera. She tends to overthink things and ends up unable to take action.  (Source: ANN)

82825.description: The leader of a pirate group.

82871.description: Onoda Sakamichi is the main protagonist of the Yowamushi Pedal series who starts off as a new first-year student in Souhoku High School. He is a member of the Souhoku High Bicycle Club and specializes in climbing. Onoda is also an anime otaku, his favorite anime being Love Hime. He is known to sing the Love Hime Theme Song while climbing. It is Onoda's eagerness to obtain anime goods from Akihabara that caused him to develop the strength needed to become a competitive cyclist. (Source: Yowamushi Pedal Wiki)

82873.description: Imaizumi is a high school freshman and a member of the Sohoku High Bicycle Club. He is an all-rounder and a logical thinker, also adored by many girls due to his good looks. His dream is to become the fastest cyclist in the world. He has a fierce rivalry with Naruko, because of his sprinting abilities and his overall attitude, and sets his goal on Kinjou, who he currently sees as his biggest obstacle as Kinjou uses this as his mentor to push Imaizumi. He treats Onoda friendlier than his other teammates as he sees his potential, and wants to see where Onoda's cycling career takes him. In the training camp, Kinjou takes away his gearshift, so he would have to rely more on his physical abilities than his technical skills and understanding. (Source: Wikipedia)

82875.description: As a sprinter, he has a competitive nature, and easily gets upset or disappointed when he is beaten in a race. He considered Imaizumi his rival, and therefore gets particularly riled up when he thinks that Imaizumi is winning. He also gets this way with his mentor, Tadakoro Jin, who he often tries to beat in sprinting. He is something of a brother figure to Onoda, whom he hangs out with often since they joined the cycling club together. Naruko is known for being "flashy;" he likes to stand out and thinks those who don't are dull. This flashiness encompasses his appearance as well as his cycling style. That's why he takes pride in being a sprinter; he thinks that the fastest is the coolest.

83015.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Yuuichirou is a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Shinoa Hiragi's squad in the Moon Demon Company. He, along with Mikaela Hyakuya, possesses the "Seraph" gene, which is relevant to the forbidden taboo and the focal point of the story, "Seraph of the End".

Yuuichirou seems to be an excellent swordsman, as he was trained by Guren himself. He is also a "seraph of the end" with 1/10th of him being not human; he may have been experimented on by the Hyakuya, but this is unclear since the adults in charge of him were killed minutes after he arrived at the orphanage.

83017.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Shinoa Hiiragi is Guren's sergeant and one of the squad leaders of the Moon Demon Company. She is appointed to supervise [Yuuichirou](https://anilist.co/character/83015/Hyakuya-Yuuichirou) during his suspension from the Japanese Imperial Demon Army for his reckless behavior. She is sarcastic and enjoys teasing others, especially Yuuichirou. 

Her Demon Weapon is Shikama Douji (Four-Scythe Child), a manifestation-type demon weapon which takes the form of a large scythe, but can be condensed into a pen-like object. She can call out the demon, which she fondly addresses as "Shi," inhabiting it out of the weapon to attack an enemy. Her primary ability is to detect anything that comes within the attack radius of her scythe.

Despite being a member of the distinguished Hiiragi family, Shinoa is uninterested in their internal power struggle. Moreover, due to her sister's legacy, she is generally shunned by the upper echelon of the army. However, she is loyal to Guren and to the members of her squad. 

A childhood lacking in familial warmth left Shinoa with little understanding of the importance of friendship and camaraderie. She is moved by Yuuichirou's unwavering loyalty to the members of his squad, who he considers his family, and wants to foster the same feelings for them herself.

83019.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10"); 179 cm (5'10")
__Swim Style:__ Butterfly (specialty), breaststroke, individual medley

The rival swimmer from Sametsuka Academy.  Rin Matsuoka is [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/83023/Nanase-Haruka)'s rival who is also in 11th grade. He had gone abroad to study swimming, but his personality changed immensely by the time he had returned to Japan and for this reason he often perplexes his former teammates.

Rin goes to all-boys school.

83021.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5"); 167 cm (5'6")
__Swim Style:__ Breastroke (Specialty)

Breaststroke swimmer of the Iwatobi High School swimming team. [Haruka's](https://anilist.co/character/83023/Nanase-Haruka) kouhai and a first year. He is a straight-forward person and his actions are faster than his words. He admires Haruka's swimming; it's the reason for him to start swimming. He enters Iwatobi High School because Haruka is there.

83023.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9"); 177 cm (5'10")
__Swim Style:__ Freestyle

Freestyle swimmer (crawl) of the Iwatobi High School swimming team. Haruka Nanase is an 11th grader who loves to swim. His strong and quiet swimming style fascinates many, and he holds a strong fixation on freestyle swimming.

His best friends include [Makoto Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/83027/Tachibana-Makoto) & [Nagisa Hazuki](https://anilist.co/character/83021/Hazuki-Nagisa) from Grade School, then he later befriends [Rei Ryuugazaki](https://anilist.co/character/83025/Ryuugazaki-Rei). He used to be best friends with [Rin Matsuoka](https://anilist.co/character/83019/Matsuoka-Rin), but now Rin has become Haruka's rival. Haruka has created the Iwatobi High School Swimming Club along with his other friends to take down Rin.

83025.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")
__Swimming style:__ Butterfly stroke

A freshman who joins the Iwatobi High School swim team.

Rei Ryuugazaki is a classmate of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/83021/Hazuki-Nagisa)'s in 10th grade. He was originally a member of the track team, but decided to join the swimming club instead. A handsome, intelligent young man who often gets manipulated by [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/83019/Matsuoka-Rin) for some reason.

(Source: ANN)

83027.description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")  

Backstroke swimmer of the Iwatobi High School swimming team.

Makoto Tachibana is [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/83023/Nanase-Haruka)'s inseparable best friend since 11th grade. He understands Haruka's good points, and is often forced to speak as his spokesman. He is very kind and considerate, but is also very easily scared and weak-hearted.

83073.description: Morii and Moriya are Azusa's friends back at middle school. They used to be the one who bullied her, but made up after Yōto manage to get them to apologize. They believe that Yōto and Azusa are a couple.  (Source: Wikipedia)

83075.description: Morii and Moriya are Azusa's friends back at middle school. They used to be the one who bullied her, but made up after Yōto manage to get them to apologize. They believe that Yōto and Azusa are a couple.  (Source: Wikipedia)

83181.description: Mina appears in Ch. 3. When the Colossal Titan appears outside Trost District, the burst of steam from its body knocks a number of trainees off the Wall. She follows when Eren instructs the other trainees to attack the Colossal Titan. After the second attack of the Colossal Titan, she was assigned to the middle guard along with Eren Yeager and Armin Arlert. Initially tasked with working under the training corps, they eventually were incorporated into the front guard due to the number of titans. Catching the group unaware, a titan lunged at the roof top they were standing on.   When Eren was talking about how killing titans that got in Trost District will get their rank up high, she joined him indicating that she is also signing up for Scouting Legion.   ~! After Eren's leg got bitten off by one of the titans, She and the other two tries to kill the titan that is responible for biting off Eren's leg. However, her Three Dimensional Maneuver Gear's wire was caught by titan's hand and was knocked over to the wall. When she found out where she was, it was too late for her to escape. She was caught by another titan and her face got bitten off.  !~

83209.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

Mei Aihara is an honor student, the chairman's granddaughter, and the stern and cold student council president. She is often calm and composed but she can be rather sensitive and mature to some extent. At first, there is little to know about her and a bad impression of Mei washes over [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/83367/Aihara-Yuzu), which causes Yuzu to take interest for Mei later on. Though Mei seems to be hard to approach, she is rather sensitive and lonely which makes Yuzu want to care for Mei more.

83235.description: An awkward otaku who has bad luck with relationships but is ironically dating [Igarashi Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/83237/Iroha-Igarashi). He has a very timid personality which often leads others to push him around.

83237.description:
A beautiful and flashy high school student dating [Tsutsui](https://anilist.co/character/83235/Tsutsui--Hikari). She is a very honest and easy-going person often fooling around with her close friends. 

Iroha is a very honest girl who is a little bit shy, but not all that much and she is also quite easy-going and can get jealous rather easily. She doesn't like it when others say rude things about her friends.

83319.description: Azusa Azuki's mother. A kind-hearted woman who is concerned about her daughter's inability to make friends.

83363.description: She appears in the Bakeneko of Mononoke. She is involved with the others witnesses in the new metro.

83367.description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

The self-proclaimed Gyaru and only child, Yuzu transfers to an all-girls school after her mother is remarried. Yuzu is outspoken, daring, and shameless to some extent. She is often seen wearing her uniform that runs against the rules thus far. Unfortunately for her, she is bothered by the Student Council President's dress code enforcement. Yuzu eventually comes home to hear that she is now the older sister of the Student Council President, [Mei Aihara](https://anilist.co/character/83209/Aihara-Mei).

Despite showing irritation towards Mei, she becomes concerned for her in which transitions into infatuation and deep care. Though she is rebellious in school, she means well and is often acting on behalf of Mei in a sense of protection. Also, her closest friend in school is [Harumin](https://anilist.co/character/83387/Taniguchi-Harumi).

83387.description: Harumi, most known as "Harumin", befriends Yuzuko being that she is a "Gyaru in Disguise". As she isn't one of the students who have been attending the academy since Elementary School, she takes no interest in following around the Student Council President and often packs items within her cleavage. As an individual, Harumi is perky, caring and an overall good friend towards Yuzuko.

83505.description: A mysterious individual. He reveals himself as being of the same roots as Rentaro.

83521.description: A Gastrea researcher who frequently advises Rentaro. The head of a legal medicine lab in Magata Public University Hospital. A Hikikomori & mad scientist. She is a person of an extraordinary intellect, but she enjoys making fun of Rentaro.  (Source: Baka-Tsuki)

83523.description:
Once a daughter of nobleman, for some reason she ran away from home and now earns her own living. Although, being a student, she manages "Tendo's Civil Security Company" but is forced to live in poverty. She is deeply in love with Rentaro.

(Source: Baka-Tsuki)

83681.description:
__Height:__ 171 cm
__Class:__ 1-3

Natsuki is a shy boy with a good heart and dreaming nature. He's energetic, delusional, and like a girl when it comes to affairs of the heart. On the day his heart gets broken, he meets a mysterious girl who he can't stop thinking of.

83683.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Class:__ 1-3

Keiichi is an boy who knows what he wants. And what he wants is the ultimate masochist girlfriend who he can realize his sadistic fantasies with. Will he ever find her? Or will he have to raise one from scratch? His older brother is a teacher in their school.

83685.description:
__Height:__ 169 cm
__Class:__ 1-3

An otaku and unpredictable guy. Tsuyoshi looks like he's only interested in otaku stuff, so how come he's the only one of his group of friends with an actual, stable relationship?

83797.description:
She transfers into Honnouji Academy as a second-year student, an Academy ruled by power and authority. She wields a huge single-bladed scissor, and demands to know the owner of the other half. As she remembers, the wielder of the lost half of the scissor blade is the same person who killed her father.

~!Her body has been fused with life fibers, making her a "life fiber monster"!~
~!She is the daughter of Kiryuuin Ragyou, making Kiryuuin Satsuki her older sister!~

83799.description:
Satsuki Kiryuin is another main heroine of the anime, "Kill La Kill." She is an 18-year-old woman, and is the Student Council President of Honnouji Academy. She rules the school with an iron first, and assesses the students' abilities, holding the position/authority to draw out power surpassing that of humans.

~!She seems to have information regarding the death of Ryuko's father, putting the two at odds immediately after her arrival.!~

~!She later states that she was the one to send Harime Nui to kill her father, however that was a lie, as the entire murder was orchestrated by Kiryuuin Ragyou and Harime Nui.!~

~!After betraying her mother, she shares the same goal as Ryuuko Matoi.!~

~!She is the sister of Ryuuko Matoi.!~

83801.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

King is a member of the Seven Deadly Sins and is the Sin of Sloth with the symbol of the Grizzly. He is also Oslo's master. King's real identity is Fairy King Harlequin, the king of the fairy race.

84153.description: A short-haired girl and Erika's friend who only knows the 'fake boyfriend' thing. She is also the classmate of Kyouya Sato during their first year. She also admitted that Sato-kun and her aren't close.

84241.description: Masamitsu Seki is one of the officers who befriended the children and assumed one of the empty places in Zearth's group. He joined the military thanks to his fascination with Idol Defense Force Hummingbird.    ~!During Kanji's battle, Seki sacrifices himself in order for Kanji to defeat the enemy robot, creating another empty seat in the group.  In the anime, Seki threatened Koemushi with a gun and gets his right arm cut off by him, when he teleported his whole body, except for the hand which was holding the weapon to another place. By the time he signed the contract along Tanaka, it was already replaced with a mechanical prosthetic, which hides some sensors planted by Kanji's mother in order to gain access to information regarding Zearth's technology.   In the end, he becomes the only contracted pilot to survive the battles.!~

name.native: キース・シャーディス

84305.description: Keith Shadis was the head instructor of the 104th Trainees Squad. He seemed to be a friend or have some sort of relationship with [Dr. Grisha](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Yeager-Grisha), as he knew [Eren](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Yeager-Eren) is the son of the doctor and praised Eren for his effort.

84309.description: He was a member of the Scouting Legion and was the first person killed by a Titan at the start of the series. When the Recon Corps squad returns to the District of Shiganshina, his mother starts asking for him, and the Squad leader, gives her all that remained of him- his right arm. In the manga his name is Brown (ブラウン), although it is changed to Moses in the anime. (Source: Wikipedia)

name.native: サムエル・リンケ-ジャクソン

84315.description:
Samuel is a member of the 104th Trainees Squad.  He appears in Ch. 3. When the Colossal Titan appears outside Trost District, the burst of steam from its body knocks a number of trainees off the Wall. While most are able to switch to their Three Dimensional Maneuver Gear and anchor themselves to the Wall, Samuel is struck in the head by a piece of falling rock and stunned. Sasha saves him from falling to his death by firing one of her grappling hooks into his leg. Eren tells Sasha to take Samuel somewhere safe, then instructs the other trainees to attack the Colossal Titan.

~!He is killed by Connie after being shot three times in the head.!~

name.native: ハンナ・ディアマント

84319.description: Hannah is a member of the 104th Trainees Squad.  Hannah first appears in Ch. 3 walking through Trost District with Eren and Franz. Eren refers to Hannah and Franz as a couple, which they both embarrassedly deny.

84371.description: He's a super flashy guy and belongs in the same class of Sata and Erika. Also, he's a sort of a  playboy type. He can easily remember the names he just acquainted to. Especially cute girls' name.

84457.description:
__Height:__ 179 cm 
__Hometown:__ Saitama 
__BIM Type:__ Blazing gas 

Mitsuo was a very large man. In the beginning he travelled along with Himiko, Masashi Miyamoto and Isamu Kondō.    ~!After Isamu Kondō was killed by Masashi Miyamoto, he along with Himiko ran away from Miyamoto taking away his supplies. He teaches Himiko how to use the radar to track people. He was killed by Himiko while attempting to sexually assault her.!~  Not much is known about his past, only that he had sex with a girl he liked once, and that afterwards everybody at his school hated him (implying that it may have been rape, a fact he seems to be unaware of). This could lead to him being sent to the island.

84469.description: Formerly a friend of Himiko. She was beaten and raped by Yoshioka's friends after being drugged. As a result, she was forced to move away and partially responsible for Himiko's nomination.

84471.description: Formerly a friend of Himiko. She was beaten and raped by Yoshioka's friends after being drugged. As a result, she was forced to move away and partially responsible for Himiko's nomination.

84491.description:
**Height:** 154 cm

Cocoa is a very extroverted girl, who has many dreams that she'd like to pursue, such as an international lawyer, novelist and a baker. Her motto is that everyone is a friend of hers after a mere few seconds. Because of her very optimistic, laid back and cheerful personality, she fills the people around her with happiness. Even though she is very clumsy and airheaded at times, she always strives to become a reliable big sister figure to those younger than her, especially if it's about [Chino](https://anilist.co/character/88032/Chino-Kafuu). 

Despite that, she is very skilled at mathematics and physics and loves to count prime numbers.

84559.description:
Harutora's shikigami. A diminutive silver-fox spirit who wears miko-like clothing and wields a wakizashi and has served the Tsuchimikado clan since a long time. She has been by Harutora's side since the moment he became Natsume's shikigami, but due to his low spiritual power and awareness, he was unable to hear or see her. A rare Gohou-type shikigami, she possesses independent thought and actions and is fiercely loyal to her master, and even gets jealous when Harutora associates with other girls.

~!Shortly before Harutora's awakening as Yakou, Kon reveals her true identity as Hishamaru, one of Yakou's two lengendary familiars who had 'disappeared' after his death. Kon forcefully destroyed her 5 seals restoring her true power and her appearance as Hishamaru. Her first seal hides both itself and the other seals, the second seals her personality, the third seals her appearance, the fourth seals her power, and the final seals her memory.!~

(Source: Wikipedia)

84613.description: Rumi is a lonely primary school student who is openly despised by her peers. Hayato at first tried to resolve the situation through talking to her in front of her classmates, which instead attracted more hateful attention to her. After much discussion, Hachiman and company decided that the only way out is to destroy the trust between her peers, through having Hayato and Kakeru acting as bullies threatening Rumi's group-mates during treasure hunt and exposing their selfish nature to each other, thus preventing further organized acts of teasing on Rumi. However, in exchange, she would hardly have any friends after this.  (Source:Wikipedia)

84677.description:
__Race:__ God
__Height:__ 174 cm (5’8”)
__Occupation:__ God of War, Delivery God, God of Calamity (previously) 

Yato is one of the three main protagonists of Noragami. An obscure god who considers himself a God of Fortune / Happiness and War, he has been labeled a God of Calamity and Depression in the past. Yato's dream is to become a famous god, whom everyone worships.

Yato can be mischievous, crude, and unpredictable in his behavior. He often has a low tolerance for something he wants, usually causing those around him to become upset. Furthermore, he is rather childish and gullible at times. Yato will often indulge in fantasies of being a very successful God with more followers than any other deity; shrines full of luxury and shrine maiden at his fingertips. As his existence would end if he were to be forgotten, he has developed Athazagoraphobia.

~!It is revealed that Yato's real name is Yaboku (夜卜) Yaboku contains the kanji ya (夜 night) and boku (卜 divination). [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/189754/Sakura) mistakenly read 卜 as the katakana ト to because of the similarities, thus giving the well-known alias name Yato.!~

84679.description:
__Race:__ Hanyou (Half Phantom, Half Human)
__Height:__ 162,5 cm (~5'4")

Hiyori Iki is a Half-Phantom who can leave her human body, being like this since she "saved" [Yato](https://anilist.co/character/84677/Yato) from an incoming bus. Despite being raised to be completely lady-like in a rich household, Hiyori is a huge martial arts fan and has a fixation on a martial artist called Touno, whom she adores and copies her attacks from. She often becomes inspired and acts on his words.

Hiyori is a very pure, kind-hearted, and brave girl who will go out of her way to help someone in danger, even strangers, regardless of the severe consequences, including suffering from blight. She has a strong moral compass and is not above calling people out if she feels their actions are wrong. Hiyori is also extremely perceptive of those around her, but despite that she can be a bit air-headed too. 

She also has a strong liking to Yato's smell and even called it her favorite smell on one occasion, but she becomes rather embarrassed by how much she likes it and dodges the subject whenever it is brought up.

84681.description:
__Race:__ Shinki
__Height:__ 147 cm (4'10")

While wandering about as a spirit, Yukine was picked up by [Yato](https://anilist.co/character/84677) and made into a Shinki. When called "Sekki" he transforms into a katana.

~!He died at a young age, making him miss his normal life as a middle schooler. He acts like his age, and was once stealing money from people with the excuse that it's okay since he's dead. After being "saved" by [Hiyori](https://anilist.co/character/84679/Iki-Hiyori), he becomes more obedient and respects Yato and Hiyori. When he was alive he had trouble with his father as seen by Yato when he first obtains Yukine.!~

In a katana form, he finds Yato's sweaty hands so disgusting that he calls him "Drippy."

84769.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 168 cm (Part 1), 180 cm (Part II)
__Rank:__ Irregular
__Position:__ Wave Controller
__Born:__  ~!Floor of Death!~__Occupation:__  ~!FUG Slayer Candidate!~

Twenty-Fifth Baam is an Irregular and one of the main protagonists of Tower of God. Bam entered in search of his best friend [Rachel](https://anilist.co/character/135466/Rachel), and after passing Headon's test he was deemed worthy to climb the Tower.

In Part I, he is a highly empathetic and caring young man, understanding little of life, having had virtually no contact with people before meeting Rachel and later entering the Tower. He hates loneliness and other people's loneliness. He is considered very naive and knows little about the Tower. During Part I, his only reason for climbing the Tower is to be with Rachel.

In Part II:
~!
He was forced to join FUG, and received then the name of Jue Viole Grace (쥬 비올레 그레이스), the Slayer Candidate, to keep his real identity hidden. As Viole, he is far more violent. He now has friends to protect and will not hesitate to fight if it means protecting them. He now completely understands that in order to climb the Tower, he must be pre-emptive and prepared to engage in combat and eradicate all opposition. He's become more introverted, rarely ever speaking or displaying any signs of emotion. He's also quite cold and calculating, interacting with others only out of necessity and will take advantage of a situation to defeat his opponents.

Later in the Part as FUG's hold on him weakens, he begins to be more expressive and talkative. Later, when he officially meets with Khun and Rak for the first time in seven years, he smiles happily and embraces them, showing that his original personality that he had hidden away to protect himself from FUG's influence was resurfacing.
!~


In Part III:
~!
He is completely back to his normal self, with the addition of some improvements in areas such as confidence. He additionally dropped the 'Viole' look and sticks with an updated 'Baam' look. He is still often called both Baam and Viole now. He now goes through new questions such as what to do when he can't save everyone, and old questions, such as why everyone can't just get along, but he is more accepting of things than before, all the while continually fighting stronger enemies and becoming stronger.
!~

alternative: クン · アゲロ · アグネス

84781.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 170 cm
__Rank:__ Regular
__Position:__ Light Bearer

Khun Aguero Agnis is a E-Rank Regular from Khun Family, and is often referred to simply as "Khun". He is a best friend of [Twenty-Fifth Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Bam), one of the main protagonists of Tower of God.

Khun relies heavily on his master intellect, however, this is not his only strong field. He also has exceptional physical attributes and is a skilled Light Bearer. His powers in combat cannot be denied.

alternative: ラーク・レクレイシャー

84783.description:
__Species:__ Wraithraiser, ~!Native One!~ __Height:__ 3m (Decompressed) __Rank:__ Regular C-Rank __Position:__ Spear Bearer Rak Wraithraiser is a Regular. He unwillingly teamed up with [Baam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Baam) and [Khun](https://anilist.co/character/84781/Khun-Aguero-Agnis) during the first test on the Second Floor and passed other tests with them. He was selected for the Spear Bearer position. He is a large and powerful warrior and a very confident individual.
Rak is originally a 3 meter tall creature, but after he mocked the Ranker [Yu Han Sung](https://anilist.co/character/141286/Sung-Yu-Han), the Second Floor Test Director, his body was shrunken by them. He eventually found out how to get back to his original size. As a being who can control their body size, he is a Compression Licenser.
He is a direct descendant of the Native One, a type of being that is able to rule over the elements in the Tower.
Rak doesn't come off as particularly smart; he thinks he's superior to almost everyone else and so refers to other people as "turtles". He occasionally calls himself "Rakleader" when he is feeling particularly full of himself, although Khun may be to blame for indulging him. He tries to make himself appear tough, although he's actually a bit of a baby sometimes. However, he does seem to have a little of a caring side in him.

84811.description:
Kuro is a Servamp ( a vampire + servant). He was named Kuro, by his Eve, [Mahiru Shirota](https://anilist.co/character/87273/Mahiru-Shirota), is the Servamp of Sloth. He is the oldest of the eight Servamps. When he is exposed to sunlight, he transforms into a black cat.

Being the Servamp of Sloth, Kuro spends his time sleeping, lazing around or playing video games. He feels no shame in running away to avoid any trouble and refuses to make decisions, since he doesn't want anything to be his fault, and doesn't want to disappoint anyone. Kuro is a 'shut in' pacifist vampire, and rarely drinks Mahiru's blood, most of the time he refuses and drinks only when he is about to fight. He prefers staying at home rather than going out and seems to dislike the changes of temperature, according to him vampires are delicate to this. Despite his lazy and at times comical nature (comical due to his laziness and arguments with Mahiru), he is shown to have a dark side.

Mahiru's straightforwardness and sincerity start to influence Kuro, though he always hides it by feigning disinterest and acting lazy. After Mahiru confronts him in his mind regarding his past actions and assured him he is not alone, Kuro decides to stop running away and face his past, since then he has become more willing to fight and determined to stop Tsubaki.

(SERVAMP Wiki)

name.native: ユリス＝アレクシア・フォン・リースフェルト

85151.description:
Julis is the fifth ranking student of Seidoukan Academy and is Lieseltania's First Princess. Her full name is Julis-Alexia Marie Florentia Renate von Riessfelt. She wields a rapier-type lux called Aspera Spina which she uses during the Phoenix tournament and bears the image of a flower for her power - control over flames.

She warms to [Ayato](https://anilist.co/character/89058/Amagiri-Ayato), unlike the other students with whom she is distant. She starts to like Ayato and often find herself arguing with [Saya](https://anilist.co/character/89060/Sasamiya-Saya) and [Kirin](https://anilist.co/character/89059/Toudou-Kirin) and even [Claudia](https://anilist.co/character/89061/Enfield-Claudia) for his attention.

85205.description: Manager of the Musashino baseball team.

85207.description: Captain of the Musashino baseball team.

85283.description:
Minami is the leader of the second most influential clique in class 2F, and holds a grudge towards [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/67069/Yuigahama-Yui), who she was friendly with in their first high school year, for being in the superior clique.

She volunteered to be event organizer for the cultural festival in order to promote her worth without the actual ability to do such job, and thus requested help from the service club. ~!As such, [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/67067/Yukinoshita-Yukino) took up the role of assistant event organizer and claimed the spotlight in making the cultural festival a successful one, which in turn made Minami depressed about her own uselessness and refused to host the closing ceremony. However, as [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065/Hikigaya-Hachiman)'s fierce scolding has successfully turned himself into the scapegoat and shifted the blame away from Minami, she attended the closing ceremony and ended the cultural festival on a high note.!~

85291.description:
She is one of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/65645/Shiota-Nagisa)'s classmates and close friends, being the one who is mostly seen with him. She hasn't shown any capabilities during her training to become an assassin, and so far has only been shown to discuss [Koro-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Korosensei)'s weaknesses along with Nagisa. She experiences a slight inferiority complex when it comes to sex appeal, resulting her to get angry whenever there's a woman with big breasts and readily protest.

~!it's revealed later in the story that she's [Aguri Yukimura's](https://anilist.co/character/207936/Aguri-Yukimura) younger sister, Akari Yukimura and her real birthday is on November 9.!~

85297.description: She is a student in class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School, taught by Korosensei.   Okuda is shy and rather introverted. She admits that she isn't really good with surprise attacks and expressing things in language. She excels in chemistry and capable of making poisons for assassinations.

85727.description:
Ryouko is gentle and kind, responding to the eccentrics of the other Polar Star residents in a level-headed manner and comforting the other students when they are troubled. Ryōko's specialty is fermented foods due to her parents owning a well-known fermented-goods shop, and she maintains a workshop near the dorms to produce her own ingredients. She also keeps a bottle of "fermented rice drink" that she would sometimes bring out during parties and celebrations, which [Souma](https://anilist.co/character/75216/Yukihira-Souma) suspects is illegally brewed sake.

~!During the Autumn Elections, she presented a "curry soy-natto rice" using charcoal-fermented natto and homemade rice-sauce fermented with koji. The dish garnered praise from the judges, who suddenly felt as if they were in a festival due to the quintessentially Japanese and festive taste of the dish. She ultimately took 7th place in her block.!~

alternative: Little Red Riding Hood of the Forest of Wild Beasts

85773.description: She is a student at Tōtsuki Culinary Academy and a resident of Polar Star Dormitory. She and the other resident students from his hostel befriended with their fellow roommate Yukihira Soma and also aware to Soma's talent as one of the finest and unique of all. She is also a roommate and friend to her fellow student, Tadokoro Megumi and Sakaki Ryoko.  Yuki is more focus on animal meat as her main cuisine. Unlike Ikumi, the meat master in any meat culinary, Yuki often used the animal hunted game from domestic poultry to any other animals (like rabbits and deer) as her main theme. Yuki's cutting skill could be yet

85775.description: Shun is presumably known his senior, Isshiki Satoshi better than anyone else as he was stayed much longer than the rest of the Polar Star Gang.  Unlike his passionate room mates, Shun is very realistic on the terms and very serious upon making his style in perfection. Shun is also a quiet student who prefer speak only whenever is considered as crucial by many. It is also once claimed that he is a calculative chef whose choose to act wisely over hesitation.

name.native: タクミ・アルディーニ
alternative: The One Who Cuts Through The Horizon of Flavors

85777.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

Takumi is the oldest nephew of the owner of the Trattoria Aldini, a trattoria (family-style restaurant) located in Florence, Italy. He is half-Japanese but, unlike his brother [Isami](https://anilist.co/character/85785/Aldini-Isami), appears more European – with blond hair and blue eyes – and is noted as being extremely handsome, having fan clubs in Toutsuki Academy and his hometown. He enrolled in Tōtsuki at the behest of his uncle, taking with him his mezzaluna (two-handed knife) and a bottle of homemade olive oil as a good luck charm. His specialty is Italian cuisine, although many professional chefs noted that he has a broad vision; like [Souma](https://anilist.co/character/75216/Yukihira-Souma), he will incorporate ingredients and methods from other culinary styles to create inventive dishes, and can modify his recipes while cooking. He is very kind and supportive of his less-skilled brother, to the point of risking his pride to defend Isami's honor.

Takumi has a fierce (and somewhat one-sided) rivalry with Sōma. Takumi sees Sōma as someone similar to himself – both having grown-up working at small family restaurants – and a worthy rival, and jumps at any chance to compete with him. He frequently tries to challenge Sōma to informal cooking challenges (usually leading to an embarrassing situation for himself), hoping to one day defeat Sōma in a formal Shokugeki. Despite their rivalry, both he and Sōma greatly respect each other, and likely view each other as friends outside of the arena.

Takumi and his brother Isami are the main characters of the Shokugeki no Soma – Fratelli Aldini spinoff manga which focuses on their time in Italy before going to Tōtsuki Academy.

85779.description:
One of the graduated students from Tootsuki Culinary Academy who turned professional, she is one of the respected legends of both her former school and alumni, among the few students who successfully graduated academy.  Like most of the 10 alumni, Inui took the quality of the food very serious for it's freshness as well as. Fame for her nickname as the Mist Queen during her admission in the academy, Inui is able to know the quality of the food just by her nibble before she could bite into her mouth. With this, she can easily tell of the food is good or bad by just putting the food on her lips before finally eating them.  Behind her mature, stern and professional personality however, Inui may be childish and rather whenever she confused of either decision which she could made. Considered as a joke member of all alumni, Inui actually make several jokes to cheer her peers.  Inui's cooking style would preferred to the Japanese traditional style/ known as Washi. 

(Source: Shokugeki no Souma Wiki)

85783.description:
Graduated from Tootsuki Culinary Academy, he is one of the respected legends of both his former school and Tootsuki Academy Alumni that is among the few who successfully graduated his academy with flying colors, thus became one of the proficient members of Tootsuki Resort as his graduation. As a living legend, Doujima is skillful in both culinary and board administration due to his talents in both culinary and managements that he handle the kitchen solo without the assistance of any chef around him. It is due to his professional discipline and tenacity, he is both respected and feared by many students and lecturers alike in his former academy.   As the legend by the students of the Tootsuki Culinary Academy, Doujima is believed to possesses all styles of cooking to create much unique cuisine in different way. Usually handle the kitchen solo, Doujima has no problem to make 100 different meals thanks to his vast knowledge of ingredients as well of the varieties of cuisine.   

(Source: Shokugeki no Souma Wikia)

name.native: イサミ・アルディーニ

85785.description:
Isami is Takumi's brother, and the younger nephew of the owner of Trattoria Aldini. Unlike his brother, he has more of a Japanese appearance, with black hair and sharp eyes. Isami is originally shown to be overweight, with his eyes and mouth drawn in a simple fashion, although he briefly became much thinner during the Autumn Election preliminaries. Like Isami, he enrolled in Tōtsuki to hone his skills at the behest of their uncle.

Although an equally talented chef, Isami is shown to be less sophisticated than his brother. He was scolded for trying to (and failing to) revise a dish that Takumi had made during their time in the trattoria, and constantly sought to be praised for his cooking like Takumi. Though Isami is supportive of his brother, he does aim to eventually surpass him as a cook. Nonetheless, the brothers are very close.

~!At the Autumn Election, he presented a tomato-curry calzone that was praised by the judges. He aimed to surpass his brother's score with the dish, but ultimately finished 5th in his block. He tried to support Takumi in his quarter-finals match against Subaru Mimasaka, and was devastated when Takumi lost to his own dish. He and Takumi opened a booth during the Moon Banquet Festival, naming it a branch of Trattoria Aldini, and gained first place in sales in their area. He is targeted as a rebel by the Azami Administration's Promotional Exams, defeated by Eishi on the third exam and expelled.!~

Isami and Takumi are featured in the Shokugeki no Soma – Fratelli Aldini spinoff manga which focuses on their time in Italy before enrolling at Tōtsuki Academy.

85787.description: Italian restaurant "Ristorante F" chef. Withdrawn basically cynical personality.

85789.description: Hitoshi Sekimori is a 78th Generation Tōtsuki Academy Alumnus. He is the owner and head chef of the sushi restaurant, Ginza Hinowa.

85799.description:
She is a student of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. She is assigned to Class 3-E, where she trains to become a professional assassin, with her teacher as the target. She is one of the two class representatives of Class 3-E, with the other being [Yūma Isogai](https://anilist.co/character/85801/Isogai-Yuma).

(Source: Ansatsu Kyoushitsu Wikia)

85801.description: He is a student and class rep in class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School, taught by Korosensei.

85895.description:
The princess of Dorssia.

~!She saved L-Elf's life when he was a child.!~

85949.description: [Rin Matsuoka](https://anilist.co/character/83019/Matsuoka-Rin)’s little sister. She's [Hazuki](https://anilist.co/character/83021/Hazuki-Nagisa)'s classmate and 1st-year in Iwatobi high school. She has a refreshing personality in school but is always worried about her brother, Rin.

85951.description: [Haruka Nanase](https://anilist.co/character/83023/Nanase-Haruka) and [Makoto Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/83027/Tachibana-Makoto)'s homeroom teacher and classic literature teacher. She seems to have been an office lady in Tokyo in the past, but no one knows the details. She utters the words of great figures from ages past. Due to her personality, when she asks something of someone, they can't refuse.

85991.description: Carnage Kabuto (阿修羅カブト, Ashura Kabuto) was an artificial mutant created by Dr. Genus of the House of Evolution and is by far their strongest creation.

86015.description:
Meguri is a third year student and the president of Sobu High School's student council. Although she is not a reliable leader herself, her personality has brought her immense support from the councilors and thus she is able to unite the student council. 

(Source: Wikipedia)

86017.description:
**Height:** 168 cm
__Affiliations:__ 104th Cadet Corps.

Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District. She was roommates with [Annie Leonhart](https://anilist.co/character/46490/Annie-Leonhart).

Hitch acts immature in certain ways, she has a sarcastic, easygoing personality and seems to mischievously enjoy teasing and needling her fellow officers, especially [Marlo Freudenberg](https://anilist.co/character/71457/Marlo-Freudenberg). She claims she chose to join the Military Police out of laziness, as it is well known that the senior staff are incredibly corrupt and she wanted to benefit from the system herself; however, she did not take into account that, as a new recruit, her superiors would dump all their work on her. Though she may act a bit air-headed at times, Hitch is not selfish and cares about those around her, especially her fellow comrades.

86027.description: Watchdog Man (番犬マン Banken-man) is a S-Class Rank 12 professional hero who is in charge of Q-City. Watchdog Man has been shown to be very blunt and nonchalant. He acts like a dog at all times, speaking sparingly, sitting on his haunches while alert or loitering, and curling up in a dog bed while asleep. He takes a stance on all fours while fighting, rather than standing upright to confront enemies.

86029.description:
__Occupation:__ Superhero 
__Level:__ S-Class; Rank 17

Puri-Puri Prisoner is a flamboyant, openly homosexual superhero. He takes an interest in other, up-and-coming heroes and criminals; an interest which led to his titular jail sentence, as he kept attacking them. Criminals that he apprehends are then added to his harem.

name.native: イケメン仮面アマイマスク

86031.description:
__Race:__ Human
~!Mysterious Being (Ugmon)!~
__Occupation:__ Superhero
__Level:__ A-Class; Rank 1.  

 Sweet Mask is a tall and lean-built young man with messy, shoulder-length light blue hair and yellow eyes. He is considered to be very handsome by the public. Aside from being a hero he is also a famous model, actor and singer, being the most popular one in the world. Sweet Mask has stated that he believes that heroes are to protect the citizens, and if they can't do that, they must become strong enough to be able to do so. He also genuinely cares for the well-being of the citizens around him and actually wishes happiness upon every living thing in the universe. However, befitting the darker side of Sweet Mask's name is his hidden merciless nature. He is shown to have a burning hatred for anything that he sees as evil. Anything that he declares as evil must be swiftly and thoroughly exterminated. 

Sweet Mask is shown to adhere to any method that makes heroes popular. He notes that only promotions to S-Class or A-Class are fit for his attention, as they are the heroes who draw the most attention from the public, and hence, any heroes in those ranks who earn themselves negative reputations would drag his reputation down as well. Because of this, Sweet Mask stays in the A-Class Rank 1 position to prevent unworthy heroes from promoting to S-Class. 

Sweet Mask is very narcissistic about "beauty overwhelming the power", as he said about his philosophy that "heroes have to be beautiful as well". This became obvious when he showed interest in a worthy S-Class Hero like Genos, who has both a beautiful appeal and having done more heroic deeds as the main priority, fitting Sweet Mask's philosophy. 

~! However, after witnessing the defeat of Garou by Saitama, his viewpoint changes and becomes more focused on the overwhelming power of the individual than beauty alone. !~

86057.description: The Deep Sea King (深海王, Shinkaiō) ruled over the Seafolk as their king, and claimed the deep sea as his own. The Deep Sea King is a rather sadistic individual, who enjoys causing pain to others and starting fights. He is determined to take the surface world for himself to rule. He regards people as little more than food and has no qualms about treating them as such. He is also very arrogant and prideful, considering himself to be better than everyone and stating that he stands at the very top of the pyramid of all living organisms on the planet.

name.native: ラチネラ・アラチネラ

86199.description:
__Species:__ Arachne

Arriving to her first host family, the host family did not expect Rachnera to be a Arachne, which caused them to take a disliking to her. When a man offered them money for the rights as her host, they accepted. Being used as a way to make money by producing spider web the man could sell, she ran away from the man. While on the run she kidnapped Kurusu Kimihito, causing the police to search for him and her.

86225.description: A boy from the surface whose grandfather is a fisherman. One day, he meets [Manaka](https://anilist.co/character/73065/Mukaido-Manaka) when she is caught in his net. He is quiet, stoic, and very interested in the underwater world.

86227.description:
A calm and compassionate 14-year-old middle school student from Shioshishio, a village located in the sea. Chisaki is the childhood friend of [Manaka](https://anilist.co/character/73065/Mukaido-Manaka), [Hikari](https://anilist.co/character/73067/Sakishima-Hikari), and [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/86313/Isaki-Kaname), and together they attend Mihama Junior High School, which is located in the surface town of Oshiooshi. She attempts to act mature in most situations, putting her friends' feelings before her own, but her temper can flare up whenever she gets especially frustrated - in particular towards [Tsumugu](https://anilist.co/character/86225/Kihara-Tsumugu), whose new presence she believes is spoiling the harmonious relationship between her friends. 

Chisaki harbors an unrequited crush on Hikari, although he is unaware of her feelings. She also has a complex about her body​ and hates change to the point where it hinders her own emotional development.

~!Chisaki is the only one of her childhood friends left on the surface after the disaster at the Ofunehiki festival leaves Shioshishio in a state of forced hibernation, and she grows to be five years older than the three of them, feeling guilty for not only living peacefully away from her home in their absence, but for falling in love with Tsumugu in the process too. She aspires to become a nurse after Tsumugu's grandfather, who took Chisaki in after she was left homeless, collapses due to deteriorating health.!~

86239.description:
__Height:__  159cm (5'2")

Haru is shown to be a bright and cheerful girl of Black Class. As claimed by Tokaku, Haru poses a naive character and trusts anyone without a single thought. She is shown to have a highly optimistic attitude, which is sometimes bothersome for Tokaku since she is not used to friendliness. All in all, Haru's rival classmates appreciate her gullible nature; deeming her as an easy target. She is very forgiving and doesn't mind anyone for bearing any kind of grudge towards her as seen when she still talks in a caring and friendly manner towards every other girl who loses their purpose after chasing her with killing intents.

~!Like the other women of her clan, Haru possesses the "Queen Bee" power of manipulating others to protect her and let her live the position of highest hierarchy; making others be simply a "worker bee". Haru inhibits and implies this power without being aware of it. Using it unconsciously, she had manipulated Tokaku Azuma to protect her in the black class. Haru had a terrible past, as she was targeted because of her power, and her parents and siblings were killed in front of her eyes while protecting her. Haru's mother had held her while protecting, and her bloody hands slipped off Haru after she died, leaving her alone in nothing but shock and despair as she cried out loud. This incident was probably the reason Haru decided she wanted to live. 

As she claims to Isuke on her first assassination attempt, Haru has an immunity to drugs and poisons, and the effect of the laxatives is compartively very mild on her body and mind. Haru also has good fighting skills but tends to use the on their bare minimum, as shown in her fight Otoya Takechi and Sumireko Hanabusa.!~

~!In the final episode, it is shown Haru had survived her stab wound from earlier on in the episode because her rib was made of titanium and the edge of the knife stayed from her heart by a small fraction. She is the sole graduate of the Black Class and after the graduation ceremony, she meets up with Tokaku to deliver everyone's diplomas.!~

86241.description:
__Birthday:__ March 3
__Height:__ 170cm (5'6")

Tokaku is a distant and cold girl. Even at first glance, she has the appearance of an assassin.She eventually grows to care for Haru in time, even coming to the point of calling herself Haru's protector. Azuma dislikes it when other people try to get close to her, and she especially hates being called by her first name, but Haru compromises and calls her "Tokaku-san". She is skilled with using knives, and has exceptionally quick reflexes. It is soon revealed that Azuma has never killed anyone before, despite possessing very useful skills as an assassin.

Her family is a well known family of assassins. They say that the east's Azuma and the west's Kuzunoha are two assassination clans that existed in the country since ancient times. The Kuzunoha was the main branch and the Azuma is a branch family. However, interactions between these two clans have almost died out.

When she was little, she lived with her grandmother and aunt where she was already practicing her skills by throwing stones to a dartboard. Her aunt tried to persuade Tokaku to leave her grandmother's house and come live in the city, although her grandmother did not agree and called Tokaku's aunt "the disgrace of the Azuma Clan".

86313.description: One of four childhood friends from Shioshishio. He is [Hikari](https://anilist.co/character/73067/Sakishima-Hikari)'s best friend and is quiet and mature for his age. He is interested in [Chisaki](https://anilist.co/character/86227/Hiradaira-Chisaki) and cares deeply for her.

86339.description: Kiriko Zubreska is a young boy from Ortus who meets Ai and Julie on their journey. He's apprenticing at the office. He's one of Princess Ulla's retainers, and serves as both her friend and teacher.

name.native: ウッラ・エウレウス・ヘクマティカ
ディー・エンジー・ストラトミットス

86385.description:
**Height:** 158 cm

Haruka is a student at Misato West High School and [Yuu's](https://anilist.co/character/86387/Yuu-Sonoda) best friend. Haruka also has a tendency to become jealous, especially when it comes to Yuu.

86387.description:
__Height:__ 149 cm

Yuu is a student at Misato West High School and [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/86385/Haruka-Takayama)'s best friend. She tends to slack off at school. Her older sister is [Mitsuki](https://anilist.co/character/87710/Mitsuki-Sonoda).

name.native: ターニャ・スウェッジウッド

alternative: Man Who Will Never Give Up

86595.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5' 10")
__Cyclist Type:__ All-rounder
__Occupation:__ Student, Cyclist


Formerly the Captain and Ace of Souhoku High Bicycle Club during his high school days. Currently a first-year student at Yonan University, also joined its Bicycle Club.

86599.description: Makishima was and still is often seen as creepy due to his facial expressions, strange hair color, and irregular dancing style. Makishima has admitted to being bad at socializing, and he often comes across as uncaring or harsh as a result, such as when he told Naruko and Onoda to leave Tadokoro behind. However, it is clearly shown that Makishima is kind-hearted and a bit softer than he looks, as he often gives Onoda useful advice about cycling. He cares and worries about his friends, as exemplified when he ran to Tadokoro's aid after the first day of the Inter High. Makishima also has a generally negative personality and seems to always expect the worst, which is probably why Onoda's successes have had such a large impact on him. He has a habit of ending sentences with "sho." (Source: Yowamushi Pedal Wiki)
