86665.description: Geera is a Holy Knight who left herself in a near-death state to have access to the Capital of the Dead and kill the Deadly Sins who had gone there. She is a young female with a slim build. She has long black hair and her eyes are depicted as if they are closed.

86677.description: Dreyfus is one of the current Great Holy Knights, thus also making him one of the two people who have command over the entirety of Britannia after the coup d'état. His attire consists of a standard set of a Holy Knight's armor that has a spike on each shoulder. He has long black hair that reaches up to his shoulder, with a short beard.

86679.description: Hendricksen is one of the current Great Holy Knights, thus also making him one of the two people who have command over the entirety of Britannia after the coup d'état. He wears a set of and covers it with a robe on top. He has short light-colored hair and also a goatee. Hendricksen is a serious man, who, like Dreyfus, appears to be willing to capture the king and enslave the citizens to prepare for the Holy War. However, he also seems to be plotting something.

alternative: Holy Maiden of the Fairy King's Forest

86681.description: Elaine is King's sister, and the Guardian Saint of the Fountain of Youth. She has long and thin eyelashes, and cut hair that reaches her neck. She wears a single white one-piece dress which is tied together with a butterfly knot at the back. Elaine is shown to be a kind, caring and forgiving girl.

alternative: Captain of the Knights of Leftovers Disposal

86683.description: Hawk is a talking pig and Meliodas's companion. He is introduced as the cleaner of the Boar Hat bar who helps clean the disgusting food scraps. He is a relatively large pink pig who wears an earring with the word star boar on his left ear. His body is well rounded and his legs are fairly short. He has a unique patch of black spots shaped like a four-leafed clover. His body and appearance are fairly similar to a typical Gloucestershire Old Spots Pig.

86685.description: Hauser is a Holy Knight, a colleague and partner of [Gilthunder](https://anilist.co/character/74285/Gilthunder), and a subordinate of the Great Holy Knight, [Dreyfus](https://anilist.co/character/86677/Dreyfus). He wears a set of Holy Knight armor and has short light-colored curled up hair. Hauser demonstrates a lot of self confidence and is very optimistic, which is the complete opposite of Gilthunder's personality; he is also shown to be somewhat naive and stupid.

86691.description: Veronica is the second princess of Britannia. The younger sibling of the first princess, [Margaret](https://anilist.co/character/126382/Liones-Margaret), and elder to her adopted sister; the third princess, [Elizabeth](https://anilist.co/character/72923/Liones-Elizabeth). She has a tomboyish appearance, short light colored hair and a slim build. She wears a stylish fur coat, a knight-styled attire, a belt and a pair of long boots.   She is described to be a tomboy, who, as a child, liked to and often used to play with swords with the boys, and would be scolded by her father for doing so. Sharing the Holy Knights' attitude about enslaving the citizens, she also cares about her younger sister, Elizabeth.

86699.description: Jericho is an apprentice Holy Knight who served under the Weird Fangs. She was stationed at the Baste Dungeon, where the Deadly Sin, Ban was imprisoned. She is young woman of slim build, with light hair that is swept over the left side of her face and tied into a ponytail at the back. She wears a black coat over her armor, adorned with a cross on the left side and larger cross covering the back. Underneath her armor are similarly fashioned black clothes. Metal gauntlets cover her arms, while metal greaves and sabatons cover her legs and feet.   Jericho is a proud and serious individual. She is stern in her command over the guards of Baste Dungeon and overconfident in her abilities, appearing arrogant at times, which led to her humiliation by Ban.

86703.description: Griamor is a Holy Knight who comes from a lineage of Holy Knights that have served the kingdom of Lyonesse for many generations. He is Veronica's bodyguard, and shows absolute loyalty towards her.  Griamor is a very tall and muscular individual who is at least twice the height of ordinary civilians, and has grey shoulder length hair. His attire consists of a single-spiked helmet, full leg armor and no upper body clothing, except a mysterious metal plate strapped around his chest with two straps. He also wears a glove on one hand and a sleeve-armor on the other arm. He, like many other Holy Knights, is heartless and cruel. Although he is ruthless, he shows absolute loyalty to Veronica and cannot allow himself to displease her, having started to serve her at a quite young age, even role-playing as a horse for her to ride on as a child.

name.native: デリウス・バーテンベルク

86869.description: Delius Wartenberg was a Admiral of Dorssia Military. He organized the 54th Military Tribunal where he condemned the Prime minister of Jior Ryuuji Sashinami to capital punishment. He was killed by the Valvrave 01's Harakiri Blade.

86871.description: A member of Asagi's pit crew

87017.description: The president of the Art Club that the above two are members of. He's taller than the other two, but also has more problems.

87201.description: After Jesus' resurrection, he thanked Joseph of Arimathea for the care of his body and stated that he would travel to the east. When Joseph asked him about a future meeting, Jesus made a map in the sand showing Joseph nine locations. Jesus then traveled east across the continent, learning new languages and cultures until he reached the sea. Making a ship with the help of the locals, he set off across the sea to what would be known as America, where he lived, aged, and was finally put to rest. He seemed to have at least partial connection with the natives, who stated prior to his deathbed that they wished to see him. Shortly after his death, a large earthquake tore the ground apart, dividing his corpse by the movement of sand and relocating it to the different areas of America that would become the nine locations on Joseph of Arimathea's map.

87219.description:
__Sigil:__ Flame God's Hammer
__Clan:__ Sunset Ravens

He was sent a help request by Kyouda Hiroyuki and joined the Darwin's Game. He is only interested in surviving. His sigil allows him to forge any weapon. However, it can't be too complicated.

87267.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")

Mikoto Mikoshiba is one of Nozaki's assistants and Yuu Kashima's best friend and classmate. He has red hair and equally red eyes. Both of his ears appear to be pierced and he usually wears tiny red earrings on them. He attracts the attention of many girls, and is admired by the males as well. However in reality, he has a timid and "tsundere" attitude. While outwardly he flirts with girls shamelessly and confidently, afterwards, he cringes and becomes embarrassed beyond words at his own actions.

87269.description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6'3")

Umetarou is the high school student that is the object of [Chiyo Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/87271/)'s affection. He is secretly a manga artist named Sakiko Yumeno, the creator of the shoujo manga "Let's Love~". This manga is published in the magazine called Monthly Shoujo Romance. Despite making a romance-oriented manga, he has no personal experience in love, and his story ideas are often ridiculous and farfetched. He appreciates Chiyo's drawing ability but is oblivious to her feelings.

In middle school, he was a captain of the school basketball team. In high school, he is now in class 2-B.

87271.description:
__Height:__ 145 cm (4'9")

The viewpoint character of the series, Sakura is a high school girl with a crush on [Nozaki](https://anilist.co/character/87269), but when her confession is misinterpreted, she ends up becoming Nozaki's inker assistant. She is in class 2-A and a member of the school's art club. She is petite, and on her head, she wears two large ribbons that have a polka dot pattern, of which it becomes Nozaki's trademark of Chiyo and names a screen tone after her.

87273.description:
Mahiru is the protagonist of the Servamp series. He is a freshman in high school who likes to keep things simple. He is the eve of Sleepy Ash and the one to name him Kuro.

On his way home from school, Mahiru finds a black cat laying exhausted on the street and cannot move due to the heat so decides to take the cat home, giving him a bell and naming him Kuro due to its black fur. He quickly learns that the cat is actually a vampire, a Servamp called Sleepy Ash.

Mahiru's mother died at a very young age. There was no mention of his father, and he didn't have any close family members to take care of him. His uncle, Toru Shirota, decided to take him in and raised Mahiru himself. However, his uncle was very busy and had to spend days away from home because of his work. Mahiru grew up alone and took care of himself. Because of this, he taught himself basic housework, such as cooking, cleaning, and sewing.

87275.description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'6")

Ken Kaneki was originally a human and a normal college student until he encountered a female ghoul named [Rize](https://anilist.co/character/88413/Rize-Kamishiro) who was posing as a human at the time. Rize, using Kaneki's crush on her as leverage, managed to lure him into an alley and tried to eat him but ended up dying when construction beams fell on top of her. Kaneki, already in a half-dead state from Rize's attempts at killing him, ends up in a hospital and has some of Rize's organs transplanted into his body. This results in him absorbing some of Rize's powers and characteristics, such as a ghoul eye, powers of regeneration, and the inability to stomach human food.

Terrified and lost, Kaneki's life takes a dramatic turn from then on as he tries to find a place for himself in the world, realizing he now belongs to neither the human nor ghoul world and refusing to eat humans to sustain himself. Meeting some of the ​other ghouls, as well as humans, makes him realize that things aren't just black and white and that there are more to ghouls and humans than originally thought.

87277.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")

Touka is a ghoul successfully posing as a human and working as a waitress at a cafe which serves as a gathering place for other ghouls, as well as a food resource.

She saves [Kaneki](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Kaneki-Ken)'s life at one point and acts as a reluctant guide to him and his adaptation to the ghoul society. She doesn't like Kaneki much and has no qualms about expressing her dislike for him. She is very serious, tough and hard-working, trying to keep their district as safe for ghouls and humans as possible. Her powers and strength are also quite great and she makes for a formidable opponent.

87279.description:
Although inattentive and often zoned-out, Arisugawa Nino is very passionate about her singing.

Growing up, she and her childhood friend [Momo](https://anilist.co/character/121356/Sakaki-Momo) would often sing with each other, usually to drown out the sounds of their parents arguing; however, right after the shock of Momo's disappearance, Nino stopped singing and began having the constant urge to shout instead. Unable to control herself, she began wearing a surgical mask. Later after meeting a boy named [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/121355/Yuzuriha-Kanade), Nino was given new faith in her voice, and when Yuzu left, Nino began to hope that one day her singing would bring both Momo and Yuzu back.

87283.description: Mysterious woman who appears as the guide program of Valvrave I.

87287.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

The deuteragonist of the Owari no Seraph series. He is an incomplete vampire and a servant of Third Progenitor [Krul Tepes](https://anilist.co/character/88899/Tepes-Krul). He was human until Krul Tepes forced him to drink her blood. He, along with [Yuuichirou Hyakuya](https://anilist.co/character/83015/Hyakuya-Yuuichirou), possesses the "Seraph" gene, which is relevant to the forbidden taboo and the focal point of the story, "Seraph of the End."

He wields a red colored sword. When he orders it to drink his blood, it sprouts thorny vines that pierce his hand. His strength grows in proportion to the amount of his blood the sword drinks.

87411.description: The loyal assistant of Morihiko Dan, she assisted Megumi, Kyu and Kinta in getting admitted to DDS, having met them during a case, featured in the first episode of the anime series.  (Source: Wikipedia)

87413.description: DDS's head of forensics, Shintarou Maki is both a skilled teacher and doctor, and is quite intelligent in his knowledge of medical and forensic science.

87415.description: He studied at Tokyo University. He is arrogant and enjoys boasting about his "superiority". He thinks he will be the qualified detective, often becoming the comic relief in the series. He is initially in Class A after joining DDS, but later gets demoted to Class B in the manga. He knows Megumi Minami via the Tokyo National Talent Development Research Center and has a crush on Megumi's older sister Akane alongside Kinta in one episode in the anime. Although he has an IQ of 180, he seems too inept in solving mysteries.

87417.description: He has an astonishing ability to perform magic tricks, inherited from his father (a famous magician), Hayato Shiramine is 16 years old, and often says that those who master magic are great detectives.

87510.description:
A living sailor uniform [Ryuuko](https://anilist.co/character/83797/Matoi-Ryuuko) finds beneath her house. Senketsu is a Kamui (神衣 lit. "God Clothes"), an outfit that provides its wearer with godlike abilities in exchange for their blood. He has the power to transform into an indestructible suit of armor, albeit with a skimpy appearance, much to Ryūko's embarrassment. His name, given to him by Ryūko, literally means 'fresh blood'.

~!After defeating Kiryuuin Ragyou, while falling through the earth's stratosphere, Senketsu burns up protecting Ryuuko.!~

87511.description: Mako is a second year student at Honnouji Academy. She is an uber air-head, so her unbelievable actions never cease to shock and awe the people around her. She strongly believes that she and [Ryuko](https://anilist.co/character/83797) are best of friends even though they have just met.

87536.description:
The main character. He is an ordinary, yet diligent, high school boy who has a somewhat dark past, and, due to certain circumstances, he is dating his childhood friend Kurumi Isoshima.

He holds a high rank in Kendo. Due to an accident in the past, he doesn't get along well with his family.

87537.description: The magician who finds by Takeshi that collapsed on the school campus and she accidentally turns Takeshi into a magician.

87539.description: Takeshi's Childhood friend and his "fake" girlfriend.

87552.description: Chihiro's friend, who helps her make her characters. She is shy in person, but gets animated when interested with a subject.

87555.description: A new teacher and the advisor of the Photography Club. Very supportive of Fu's Photography efforts.

87582.description: Hakuya's younger sister, who somehow manages to enroll in Kobeni's class. She often tries to vocalize that she isn't a child, but her honest feelings over her likes and dislikes are often read easily by the others. She is quite fearful of Benio but is easily swayed by sweet things.

87583.description: Hakuya is Kobeni Yonomori's fiancé who suddenly appears on her 16th birthday with his little sister Mashiro Mitsumine. He and his sister start living in the same house as Kobeni and her own sister, Benio Yonomori.

87585.description: Benio Yonomori is Kobeni's elder sister who has two personas: an immature and a carefree loving sister at home and the student council president at school, where she maintains her respectable popular image as a demure, well-mannered and an elegant top-performing student in front of her legion of fans. She has taken a liking to Mashiro to the extent that she would do all sorts of advances to her at home.

87606.description:
Nonon Jakuzure is one of the main characters in Kill la Kill and one of the Student Council's Elite Four. She regulates the school's non-athletic groups, such as the gardening and biology clubs. Nonon also runs the school's Rakugo Club, 100 Poems by 100 Poets Club and most likely the marching band. Nonon's Three-Star Goku Uniform resembles that of a drum majorette. Her baton is not just for show, as Nonon is a conductor as well. 

~!After the events of episode 17, she and the other 4 kings join Nudist Beach!~

87625.description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'3")

She is the second daughter of a family to whom [Mirai](https://anilist.co/character/81751) is indebted. She came to Nagatsuki City in pursuit of Mirai, who killed her older sister, [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/87630).

(Source: Kyoukai no Kanata Wiki)

87626.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

The eldest daughter of the Nase clan. She usually has a calm demeanor despite having a malicious undertone. She has the viewpoint that youmu are no different from crops or farm animals and exist solely to provide her clan with a livelihood. (Source: Wikipedia)

87627.description:
__Height:__ 146 cm

[Ayaka's](https://anilist.co/character/87628/Shindou-Ayaka) sister who manages the appraising shop when Ayaka is unavailable. She is a cat-like youmu, with the ability to shape-shift into human form. When transformed, she appears as a two tailed cat.

87652.description: Enma Daio is the Great King of Hell who judges the dead. He is also Hoozuki's godfather.

87654.description:
__Race:__ God
__Height:__ 140 cm (4'7")
__Affiliation:__ Hestia Familia

Hestia is an energetic, kind goddess who sees potential in [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell). She is a hard worker, and works jobs to support the two while Bell goes off to the dungeon. Hestia tends to be shown as very petty and gets jealous easily when girls, namely [Aiz](https://anilist.co/character/87655/Wallenstein-Ais), show interest in Bell, because she is deeply in love with him, or they are the reason for his strength growth. Despite seeming mature and dependable toward Bell, Hestia is in truth, a lazy goddess, as she couldn't get a job or put effort into work. After descending to the Lower World, Hestia was taken care of by her friend [Hephaestus](https://anilist.co/character/142544/Hephaestus). Soon after, she was asked to live on her own after she kept freeloading off of Hephaestus' familia and was given a room at an abandoned church. Hestia tried to create her own familia, but wasn't able to recruit anyone. After failing to recruit for the 50th time, she noticed Bell and decided to secretly follow him. Hestia found out that Bell had been trying to enter a familia, but was rejected multiple times and seemed to be in the same boat. Hestia then took the chance to recruit him, which Bell happily agreed upon; becoming the first member of her familia. She took Bell to a bookstore, the location she already decided beforehand, and granted her Falna to her first dependent.

name.native: アイズ・ヴァレンシュタイン

87655.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

Ais Wallenstein, also known as the Sword Princess, is a First-Class Adventurer and a key member of the Loki Familia. Among the small fraction of First-Class Adventurers, she is considered one of the strongest.

87706.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

Kotone is a student at Misato West High School and comes from a rich family. She gave [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/86385/Haruka-Takayama) the nickname "Harupoppo".

87713.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

Rina is a 3rd year student at Misato West High School and also the student council vice president.

87759.description: He is one of Kenji and Yokoshima's longtime​ friend and classmate, he is also part of the infamous trio called "Kazama's Party."

87821.description: Ebisugawa Kinkaku is the older brother of the fool twins in the Ebisugawa household. He looks down on the Shimogamo family and likes to bully Yashirou.

87887.description:
__Race:__ Flügel

Jibril is the youngest and strongest of the Flügel race. Her love toward knowledge starts even before the declaration of the Ten Oaths. She is against the book sharing law, and left her homeland to win the main library of the human world from the previous king in a game.

~!Unlike [Steph](https://anilist.co/character/82527), Jibril is happy to become the siblings underling, and is shown growing feelings toward [Sora](https://anilist.co/character/82523).!~

87904.description: A girl whom [Takeo](https://anilist.co/character/80757/Gouda-Takeo) saves from a molester on a train. After Takeo saves her, she immediately falls in love with him. She attends Koizumi Girls’ Academy and is very skilled in making sweets.

87950.description:
Kojou was a normal high school student 3 months ago, until the original 4th primogenitor had released her spirit into him because of a wish she had granted him. It's possible they made a deal.

Sometimes, his vampire urges try to take over and his eyes are about to turn red. He usually gets a nosebleed and coughs. Yukina claims that it is impossible for a human being to randomly become the 4th primogenitor, but he can't remember any details of the incident.

As a vampire, he possesses superhuman strength, speed, reflexes, and durability, but is much more powerful than normal vampires due to his status. He has also inherited Avrora's twelve familiars.

87951.description: She is one of Kojou's classmates who works as a part-time computer programmer at the Security Department of "Itogami Island Management Corporation" in Level B. She is very proficient with computers and deciphering complicated codes, which is why she was kidnapped by Christoper Gardos to awaken the "Nalakuvera" a so called ancient weapon of the gods. She created an AI program that she calls "Mogwai" that she uses to help her break into any firewalls, to hack into any secured sites or create and alter any programs. It was pointed out she has feelings for Kojou.

87952.description: Astarte was a homunculus servant of Rudolf Eustach until Kojou and Yukina defeated him. Since then she has been sentenced to 3 years probation and is currently entrusted to Natsuki, who made Astarte her maid.

87953.description:
Sayaka Kirasaka is a member of the Lion King Organization, which is assigned to the Multinational Magical Crimes under the Foreign Affairs Division. She is Dmitri Vatler's observer and is a "War Dancer" who specializes in using hexes and assassinations.

Kirasaka and Himeragi are very close and were former roommates during their training in the organization. Her unusual protective behavior for Himeragi may suggest that she has some sort of feelings for her. She also despises Kojou so much that she plans to eliminate him. 

She uses a sword called "Koukarin" that can nullify any physical attacks. It can also change into a bow called "Der Freischütz" which she uses to shoot magical arrows and spread any incantations over a wide area.

name.native: ラ・フォリア・リハヴァイン

87955.description:
She is the princess of Aldegyr and the third person to make a blood pact with Koujo.

She is related to Kanase Kanon, due to her grandfather having an affair.

87957.description: She is Kojou's younger sister and is also Yukina's classmate. She is usually chatty with people she likes and is a very good cook.

87958.description:
Akatsuki Kojou's English teacher that claims to be 26 years old.

She also assists Itogami Island Security with investigating crimes perpetrated by supernatural beings around Itogami Island.

(Source: Wikipedia)

87959.description:
He is Kojou and Asagi's classmate. He is a member of the Far East District of the Lion-King Organization, and is the real observer of Kojou, the 4th progenitor, he is also Asagi's childhood friend and therefore often offers support to the latter for going after Kojou. He is actually an Esper whose special ability is called "Air Current Manipulation" which is the ability to manipulate air, vibrations and sound waves, but needs certain drugs or enhancers to strength his ability, he can also use his special ability to eavesdrop on anybody from any location most especially when listening on to Kojou and Asagi's conversation. 

(Source Wikipedia)

name.native: アヴローラ・フロレスティーナ

87960.description: The previous Fourth Progenitor, a young girl who passed her title to Kojou after her death.

87970.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

A royal guard who carries a magical muzzle-loader infused into her body, named Steinberger, who forces [Seiya Kanie](https://anilist.co/character/87971/Kanie-Seiya) to go on a "date" with her to Amagi Brilliant Park.

She has a stoic personality and rarely shows emotion, finding it difficult to smile or understand the jokes of others. Her upbringing as a royal guard resulted in a tendency to quickly resort to violence by threatening others or inflicting non-lethal damage to them with Steinberger. Behind her mask of stoicism and violence, she is actually quite sensitive. She was the manager of Amagi Brilliant Park before Seiya's arrival but was unfit for the position due to her disposition for violence, which led to the park's staff collectively fearing her. Her muzzle-loader can be summoned from any exposed skin due to the effects of it being magically infused into her body. She uses a variety of different ammunition, all with different effects. To name a few, she can remove a target's memory or cause a target great pain when hit by Steinberger.

~!Isuzu has developed romantic feelings for Seiya but is reluctant to tell him due to her inability to properly express her feelings and emotions.!~

87971.description:
Seiya is a perfectionist high school student who is mentally sharp, intelligent, has excellent reflexes, and acts like a prince to the point of being a narcissist, much to the annoyance of others. 

He was involved with the entertainment industry as a child, bearing the stage name Seiya Kodama. According to [Isuzu](https://anilist.co/character/87970/Sento-Isuzu), he was a child who would have made every adult/parent proud.

88001.description:
__Height:__ 158cm

A human who allied with several different races in order to win the king's contest, due to her belief that humans will never be strong and must depend on others in order to survive.

88003.description:
__Race:__ Werebeast

Izuna Hatsuse is a Werebeast girl and the former ambassador of the Werebeast race to Immanity. After [Sora](https://anilist.co/character/82523/Sora) and [Shiro](https://anilist.co/character/82525/Shiro) forced the werebeasts to join the Commonwealth of Elkia, Izuna was directed by [Miko](https://anilist.co/character/137440/Miko) to follow and learn from them. [Steph](https://anilist.co/character/82527/Dola-Stephanie) has noted that she actually shares similarities to Sora and Shiro, such as lacking common sense, being arrogant towards others, and being extremely smart and competent at gaming. She mostly exhibits an innocent personality pertaining to her age yet is very competent at playing games to the point of representing the Werebeasts in national games against other races. She possesses all the incredible physical abilities found in all Werebeasts as well as the rare Blood Break found in a select few Werebeast individuals.

88004.description:
__Race__: None (Formerly: Old Deus)

Tet is the One True God of Disboard.
Tet does not belong to any of the 16 races, although the closest affiliation to him would be Immanity.
To challenge Tet for the title of the One True God, one must collect all pieces of different chess from 16 races. This means that, under the tenth rule of the Ten Covenants, one must defeat or unite all 16 races before being able to play against him.

~!He was born from [Riku](https://anilist.co/character/123691/Riku-Dola)'s wish and the overwhelming presence of incredible magic energy. Claiming the Suniaster and becoming the One True God, Tet immediately used his absolute power to repair the damage done to the planet and set forth the Ten Covenants, thus ending the Great War.!~

88011.description:
Inari is Koto's biological father and teacher, and also the father of Kurama, Yase, and Yakushimaru. He wears a fox mask and carries a katana. He is the original Myoue, but gives his title to his adopted son, Yakushimaru, when he leaves the Looking Glass City.

Inari appears younger than when he was Myoue. He has the same red eyes as both Kotos, but wears a Shrine-issued fox mask in public (and sometimes while at home) which conceals this feature.

88014.description:
Professor Shouko's underling. Even though he has a dry personality, he is very serious toward his work. And so, he is loyal to even someone like Professor Shouko.

~!He is actually a member of the Shrine organisation. He provided the Shrine technology to Kurama, which helped a lot in maintaining the City Through the Looking Glass.!~

88017.description:
A world famous pianist, and currently lives in Paris away from her daughter Kazusa. She's stirred the mass media up as much as an entertainer ever since she was young with her unrestrained lifestyle. She's divorced twice, but it's not certain who Kazusa's father is.

(Source: ANN)

88019.description: A student of Class 3-A at Houjou University Attached High School. She's the former captain of the basketball team. She's classmates with Setsuna, as well as Haruki's friend, and she's known Takeya for a while. Her frank, boyish personality earns her a lot of hidden fans, but she doesn't seem to be interested in romance.

88020.description:
A student of 3-G at Houjou University Attached High School. He's Haruki's best friend and president of the light music club. He's better at the guitar than Haruki. His loose looks and speech give birth to rumors that he has a girlfriend in each class, but the truth is unknown.

(Source: ANN)

88032.description:
__Height:__ 144 cm

Chino is a girl whose dream job is to become an amazing barista of Rabbit House. Chino, being reserved and quiet, found it difficult at first to open up to [Cocoa](https://anilist.co/character/84491/Cocoa-Hoto) when she first moved over to Rabbit House and being the energetic girl [Cocoa](https://anilist.co/character/84491/Cocoa-Hoto) is, she often tried acting as the bigger sister of Chino. Chino has an extremely low tolerance for alcohol, and will turn into a cute little sister character when she so much as smells alcohol from chocolate. She is the type to remember everything she did after she is no longer intoxicated. Chino looks up to [Syaro](https://anilist.co/character/88033/Syaro-Kirima), [Rize](https://anilist.co/character/88034/Rize-Tedeza), [Cocoa](https://anilist.co/character/84491/Cocoa-Hoto), [Chiya](https://anilist.co/character/88035/Chiya-Ujimatsu), and [Mocha](https://anilist.co/character/89519/Mocha-Hoto), as they are older and they act as role models for her. Her two friends of age are [Maya](https://anilist.co/character/89520/Maya-Jouga) and [Megu](https://anilist.co/character/89445/Megumi-Natsu).

88033.description:
**Height:** 151 cm

[Chiya](https://anilist.co/character/88035/Chiya-Ujimatsu)'s childhood friend who lives next door to the Ama Usa An and works at a herbal tea café, Fleur de Lapin. 

Syaro is a sensitive and bashful girl who has insecurities when it comes to her image. She is easily flustered and worries that her friends think she is a rich and sophisticated lady when in actuality she is a regular girl living in a humble home. She is [Rize](https://anilist.co/character/88034/Rize-Tedeza)'s underclassman at an elite school, though she is generally poor herself, and has a crush on her. 

She also has a major fear of rabbits, and becomes hyper whenever she drinks coffee.

88034.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Rize is a tough and headstrong girl. She secretly holds insecurity of not fitting in and can sometimes feel lonely; for example, while she is an independent and physically strong person, she tries to act like an average teenage girl (even going as far as to pretend she can't lift a bag of coffee beans) so that she can appear more relatable to her friends. Rize can be blunt with her opinions and often acts as the voice of common sense in the group.

She is a part-time worker at the Rabbit House Cafe, alongside [Chino](https://anilist.co/character/88032/Chino-Kafuu) and [Cocoa](https://anilist.co/character/84491/Cocoa-Hoto). [Her father](https://anilist.co/character/206902/Rize-no-Chichi) is a soldier, which is why she is quite strict and carries around a pistol for protection; however, Rize is quite vulnerable against cute things, and she has a vivid imagination which can run away with her sometimes.

88035.description:
**Height:** 157 cm

Chiya is a very well-spoken, gentle, and empathic girl, who genuinely strives to make her business successful and accepts tasks that may nurture her abilities to be the head of an organization, as she considers it good practice. She's often seen to be a jokester, who fools around with [Cocoa](https://anilist.co/character/84491/Cocoa-Hoto), and gives her menú strange names. However, she is very mature and helps out her friends whenever they are in a slump, trying her best to give them pieces of advice or cheer them up. It has been said that Chiya is only goofing off and an airhead when [Cocoa](https://anilist.co/character/84491/Cocoa-Hoto) is around, however, if that is not the case, she is quite reliable and gives off the vibe of a very dependable person.

88065.description:
She is the student council secretary. She idolizes Benio due to how nice Benio was towards her when she first moved into town. As a result, she studied hard to get into the same school, and managed to work her way into the student council to be near Benio.

She hates Mashiro due to how close the latter seems with Benio, and even after Mashiro gets into a rant about how much she hates being smothered by her, Konoha refuses to see Benio in a bad light.

88066.description: She is a member of the school's newspaper club, she is very nosy and often spies on ones personal affairs just to make a story.

88069.description: The student council vice president. She is much more refined and mature than Benio (who is the student council president). She is always the one who keeps Benio in-check whenever she is getting out of control. Benio often calls her up whenever she is feeling down, even if the cause isn't that bad. This is much to Kashima's annoyance—so much so that she often hangs up.

88070.description: A third grade elementary school girl whose mother, Miori (originally from Shioshishio), died when she was young. She met Akari a couple of times and played with her when Akari came to visit Miuna's mom and the family.

88071.description:
A third grade elementary school girl with brown haired pigtails and eyes. She is Miuna's best friend who often instigates confrontations with sea people. She appears to have a crush on Kaname.

 ~!
After the timeskip, she entered the same middle school as Hikari and the others. She also decided to be more serious at studying and becoming independent.
!~

88073.description: A high school boy who moves to room 106 and intends to keep it at all costs due to its unexpectedly cheap 5,000 yen per month rent. After an accident in the archaeology site he works at, he gains the ability to see ghosts and wield ancient artifacts.

88074.description: A female ghost who haunts room 106. She wants to expel [Koutarou](https://anilist.co/character/88073/Satomi-Koutarou) and claim the room as her own. She is able to manipulate solid items and launch them to attack, but her attack is neutralized when near sacred objects.

88075.description: A clumsy magical girl who intends to occupy the room, which contains high levels of magical power, with the intention of defending it from other magical girls who may use such power for evil. She constantly summons magical force fields whenever room 106 residents start engaging each other. Despite this, the residents of room 106 refuse to believe that she is a magical girl, instead considering her a mere otaku who loves cosplay.

88076.description: A well-endowed descendant of the Earth People, who moved underground during centuries past, and a member of the Kurano clan, a family of oracles and spellmasters, who claims that she needs to rebuild a shrine on the room's location and use the etheric energy gathered by it to generate weapons and launch an invasion against the people on the surface.

name.native: ティアミリス・グレ・フォルトーゼ

88077.description: An intergalactic alien princess from a planet named Fortorthe, with a flat chest, armed with pulse lasers and cannons. She is given the task of capturing room 106 as well as subduing the resident, which is [Koutarou](https://anilist.co/character/88073/Satomi-Koutarou), in order to prove her worthiness as a successor to the throne. She is fond of a Fortorthe legend known as the Blue Knight, and named her spaceship and battle armor after him.

88093.description:
Yuki Takeya is the main protagonist of the Gakkou Gurashi! series. She is a former senior student at Megurigaoka Private High School and a member of the School Life Club, where she, as the most cheerful and optimistic person, comes up with club activities and brings comfort among the club despite their surroundings.

~!Yuki is oblivious to the fact that she is in the midst of a zombie apocalypse and the "activities" of the club are survival missions. Not wanting to disturb her already fragile mental state, the other girls go along with her ideas.!~

88094.description:
Known as Nine, is one of two members of the Sphinx terrorist group. He grew up in an experimental institution for gifted children with [Twelve](https://anilist.co/character/88096/Twelve), though the both of them managed to escape. Later on, both Nine and Twelve carry out several terroristic acts in Japan.

He is reserved, calm and collected, and very, very intelligent. Nine is efficient in many fields, up to exceptional computing and hacking. He's an impeccable strategist, with a knack for chess and classical literature. Good with disguises.

88095.description:
Lisa Mishima is a quiet and shy girl who attended the same high school that [Nine](https://anilist.co/character/88094/Nine) and [Twelve](https://anilist.co/character/88096/Twelve) had transferred to. Because of her clumsiness and shyness, she was an easy target for the bullies in her class.

As she came to know the two boys, Nine and Twelve, she felt a connection. Like they all had something in common and she had grown attached to them, especially Twelve.

Nine didn't see her as very useful when she lived with them. Always in the way and always burning food, you can see why. But Twelve did not feel that way, for he had gotten too involved with her and was very affectionate toward her.

Her father and mother are divorced, and her mother is over-protective and appears to be mentally unstable. She holds the fear that Lisa would also one day leave her just like Lisa's father did once.

88096.description:
Twelve is one of two members of a terrorist group known as Sphinx, working with [Nine](https://anilist.co/character/88094/Nine) as his primary partner. He and Nine grew up together in an institution for children known as the Settlement, and engaged in terrorist activities, with unknown motives.

On the outside, he's a typical jokester: light-humored and energetic, enjoying messing around in other people's business. However, he is fully capable and willing to adopt ruthless and violent methods if the situation calls for it. This contradictory set of personality traits are the result of the psychological damage sustained during his stay at the aforementioned children's institution. Nonetheless, he is a loyal and dependable friend, has a genius mind and a keen sense of social justice. He also has a compassionate side, as evidenced by his interactions with [Lisa Mishima](https://anilist.co/character/88095/Mishima-Lisa).

~!Twelve changes dramatically upon interacting with Lisa Mishima. When she runs away, he goes after her against Nine's wishes. He is made by [Five](https://anilist.co/character/88301/Five) to choose between saving Lisa and betraying Nine, and ultimately chooses to save Lisa. However, he later helps Nine out of a sticky situation at great risk to himself.

In the final episode, shortly after he, Nine and Lisa are reunited, he is shot and killed by the American government.!~

88173.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

Inaho is a young boy of average height and short tousled black hair. His eyes hold a burgundy color and he has a blank gaze. He is seen in his high school standard uniform which consists of a white shirt, red tie and white sweater, along with a light brown blazer on the outside and black pants. His backpack is dark blue.

Inaho is a calm, intelligent boy. Even at times of great distress, he calmly thinks of a way out. He is intuitive and not afraid to go on many different tactics to analyze the opponents and figure out the suitable strategy.

Inaho's parents died sometime prior to the war and he lived alone with his sister. Waking up, cooking breakfast for his sister, he leaves for his school in Shinawara. He, along with his friends, attended the parade where the princess was killed by a missile attack. Shortly after, the Orbital Knights declared war on the Terrans and invaded Earth. Inaho's daily life was shattered because of the attack.

name.native: スレイン・トロイヤード

88174.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

He is the son of Dr. Troyard, a brilliant scientist researching Aldnoah, and was launched to Mars by his father as a means to protect him. He was found by [Princess Asselyum Vers Allusia](https://anilist.co/character/88175/Asseylum-Vers-Allusia) who took him in and later on became her tutor. After several years of living on Mars, [Count Cruhteo](https://anilist.co/character/88435/Cruhteo) takes custody over Slaine.

Slaine is very friendly and loyal towards Princess Asselyum as she was the one who saved him and the first person he met on Mars. He wishes to support her in any way possible and is willing to put his own life at risk in order to protect Princess Asselyum. Towards others however, he acts coldly and does not seem to trust anyone other than the Princess, often distancing himself from both Martians and Terrans. He is always seen with a serious look on his face.

Slaine proves himself to be a very capable pilot, able to quickly maneuver around in a Kataphrakt and face [Inaho](https://anilist.co/character/88173/Kaizuka-Inaho) by himself.

~![Count Saazbaum](https://anilist.co/character/88437/Saazbaum) eventually names Slaine as his son.!~

name.native: アセイラム・ヴァース・アリューシア

88175.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

The Princess of the Vers Empire. She is very close to [Slaine](https://anilist.co/character/88174/Troyard-Slaine). She went to Earth on a goodwill visit, but her motorcade was attacked and she was presumed to have died. This assassination was used by the orbiting Martians as a casus belli for their invasion. However, the princess was ill that day and the person who died was a body double. Asseylum now travels with Inaho's group under a false identity until they can get a message back to her grandfather in hopes of stopping the rekindled war.

Asseylum is an idealist and pacifist. She believes in peaceful solutions and she sees the people of the Earth in a good light. Unlike many of the Martians shown so far, she seems to treat the people of Earth as equal humans. Asseylum appears to be regretful of the actions that led to the Second Earth-Mars War between the Martians and the people of Earth, yet she feels that she has the responsibility to help stop the war.

Asseylum is kind, caring, and compassionate, however she is also naive, believing that if her grandfather found out that she were still alive, that the war would end. Asseylum later realizes her naivety, and that certain people of VERS were only using her as an excuse to start a war with Earth.

Asseylum seems to also have a bold and decisive side, she is not particularly guarded around others being quickly open and friendly. Asseylum seems to prioritize the safety of others over herself, and takes her position as the Princess of VERS seriously.

88176.description: Ritsu is a 2nd year high school student who lives in the same dorm with Usa. She is a seemingly shy girl who likes to read books. Her grandfather is brother to landlady of their dorm who views Ritsu as her relative. She is trusted with looking after the dorm when landlady takes a leave. She keeps multiple weapons around the house and doesn't hesitate to use them if one of the guys crosses into girls side of the house.

88177.description:
Usa Kazunari is a high school freshman whose parents had to move away for work. He agrees to stay anywhere, as long as he could live on his own in peace and quiet.
Having grown up surrounded by his parents' eccentric friends, Usa feels that unique individuals tend to gravitate to him resulting in what he considers a disastrous three years in middle school where he gained a reputation for handling odd people. Although he initially balks at the idea of rooming with dysfunctional people, he decides to stay at the Kawai Complex and quickly adjusts to its residents' behaviors.

His favorite dish is salisbury steak.

88178.description:
The manager of Kawai Dormitory and the sister of Ritsu's grandfather. She interviews potential boarders first to determine background and compatibility with the current residents. Wanting to be a perfect side character in a romantic drama, she sometimes practices on Usa by giving observations and comments that are meant to be of no value. Rather insightful, she knows just when to serve a resident's favorite dish for dinner.

She keeps a doll collection in her room.

88179.description:
An office lady who has terrible luck with men, she is the fourth resident that Usa meets. She is always spiteful to everyone, especially those who have found romance or are about to find romance. She tends to drink alcohol heavily when depressed and nags when drunk. She is always on the lookout for something to use against Sayaka and considers Miharu a boxful of Sayaka's weaknesses.

She is particularly fond of interfering with Usa and Ritsu's relationship. Though she often expresses displeasure at their budding romance, she seems to be happy for them in her own way.

88180.description:
Usa's somewhat perverted author roommate. Known for being a masochist, he specializes in bondage and can tie complex knots that are difficult to undo. He is good at crafting which he usually employs to while away boredom or make Mayumi feel better. When outside, he is usually marched off to the police station for being a suspicious character.

Caught sticking his head through a hole in a fence that surrounded a grade school, he is the third resident that Usa meets.

88181.description: A college student staying at Kawai Dormitory. She is the last resident that Usa meets. Sweet on the outside but loves to cause trouble for others, she has a penchant for leading men on. She loves to fondle Mayumi, much to the latter's resentment.

88190.description: Sayaka is a second year student in course 2 of the First High School. She is in the Kendo Club.

88200.description: Mari is the Moral Committee Chairman of the First High School.

88201.description: A first year 2nd course student in E class with [Tatsuya](https://anilist.co/character/55743/Shiba-Tatsuya), [Mizuki](https://anilist.co/character/55741/Shiba-Miyuki) and [Erika](https://anilist.co/character/72311/Chiba-Erika). He is childhood friends with Erika.

88202.description:
A rather shy and mysterious-looking young woman who's a former assassin who's developed a second personality at some point in her past named Shin'ya Banba who's a quite more rude and violent personality than the actual Mahiru. Both are like two souls who share the same body, thus both never appear at the same moment throughout the plot, yet both are able to communicate with each other to a certain degree.

Mahiru is a shy and timid girl who often has trouble speaking for herself. She is easily subject to bullying, and is often defenseless. However, when the sun sets, Mahiru's alternate personality, Shin'ya Banba, appears. Shin'ya is the complete opposite of Mahiru, and refers to herself (or even himself) as "ore (俺)", a masculine term. In contrast to her host personality, Shin'ya has an aggressive and borderline insane appearance cultivated to protect Mahiru. Shin'ya is able to enter a temporary state that grants her superhuman strength, though she is unable to use it for extended amounts to time without rest. She also seemed to be excellent at tracking her targets.

88203.description: Sumireko is a high class, polite girl. She's considerably warmer to people than [Tokaku](https://anilist.co/character/86241/Azuma-Tokaku) is, but she's hinted to be one of the more dangerous members of Class Black.

88205.description: Isuke is a truly sadistic girl who is always shown to be with clothing that show her stomach. She is also very blunt and quick to express her opinion, and likes to command other people, such as making [Haruki](https://anilist.co/character/88212/Sagae-Haruki) call her "Isuke-sama". Isuke's family includes her gay parents, who aren't related to her by blood at all.

88212.description: Tomboyish yet fashionable girl who is always shown eating snacks. Haruki is the typical lazy student who sleeps at class and is always looking for thrills, but is very sensitive about her family, which is full of siblings.

88214.description:
**Height:** 165cm (5'4")

Takechi Otoya is an extremely playful girl with a rather intrusive personality. She likes to tease others, but her actions are seen as borderline bullying.

~!In truth, she is actually a sadistic serial killer. She is quite obsessed with scissors to the point where she carries a whole bag of them around on her waist, which she uses to carry out killings. Otoya kills for a kind of sexual pleasure and targets beautiful women. She also seems to have some knowledge of poisonous flowers and spiders, as she was able to recognize and use the poisonous Gelsemium elegant flowers to incapacitate Haru, and compares her killing style to that of a spider. If she were to be successful in killing Haru, she wanted "serial killer insurance." This was so she could continue her murder spree without any fear of being captured.!~

(Source: Akuma no Riddle Wiki, edited)

88239.description:
__Race:__ God
__Occupation:__ Goddess of Fortune and Goddess of War

Bishamon is one of the Seven Gods of Fortune and also officially a Goddess of War and Warriors. She is intent on keeping order among the gods. Due to her past with [Yato](https://anilist.co/character/84677/Yato), she is bent on vengeance and decided to destroy anything he held dear to himself. 

Despite being a goddess, Bishamon is shown to be quite generous towards her Shinki. She willingly accepts any wandering and troubled spirit, useful or not, and adds them to her family. Due to her failure in the past involving Shinki, Bishamon decides to be more distant from them, depicting herself as a fierce goddess and making sure that they are not worried about her, which only resulted to them being more insecure and lonely.

In the anime, Bishamon's hair is depicted as blonde, as opposed of the silver hair in the manga.

88240.description:
__Race:__ Shinki

Kazuma is a calm, serious, and sensible person. He is one of [Bishamon's](https://anilist.co/character/88239/Bishamon) Shinki and cares about her deeply. When he is called by his shinki name, "Chouki", Kazuma transforms into a cherry blossom-shaped earring with the ability to navigate and track others. 
~!He is a Blessed Regalia.!~

88241.description: Originally introduced as [Yato's](https://anilist.co/character/84677/Yato) girlfriend that he frequently shakes down for money, Kofuku is later revealed to be the infamous Binbougami - a Japanese Goddess of Poverty. She goes by the cover name "Kofuku Ebisu" in order to make it seem as though she is a god of fortune. She has a Shinki named [Daikoku](https://anilist.co/character/88691/Daikoku).

name.native: カズミシュリーレンツァウアー

88242.description:
Kazumi is a half-Austrian magician who speaks Japanese with a Kansai accent. Her power is hacking computer systems.

She, also has feelings for Ryouta that she would try to seduce him and even go naked in front of him.

88243.description:
__Gender__: Male
__Race__: Modified
__Age__: Early 20s
__Hair Color__: Silver
__Eye Color__: Silver
__Affiliation__: The Union, RK (Raizel Knights)
__Occupation:__ Union Agent (Formerly), Ye Ran Special Security (Currently)

M-21 was one of the Union's hundred human experiments carried out under Dr. Crombel. He was labelled as a failed experiment and along with M-24 was used by the Union as an agent, until M-24's sacrifice in a mission against the Noblesse had changed him; as a person and as an experiment. The Noblesse, Raizel, awakened M-21's powers that the Union failed to, and M-21 became his affiliate. With the Noblesse's support, M-21 searches for the names and memories he and his fellow failed experiments lost during Dr. Crombel's tests on them.

While typically distant and reserved, M-21 is straight-forward and, if need be, provocative and aggressive. He has a wild temper, but also a dog-like loyalty, having grown protective of other RK, Raizel and the human high-schoolers.

name.native: ステラ・ヴァーミリオン

88264.description:
Stella Vermillion is an A-rank Apprentice Knight and second princess of the Vermillion Kingdom.

Stella initially appears to be feisty, hot-blooded, and quick to anger possibly due to her sheltered upbringing. However, later she is shown to be anything but bitter, and is even willing to admit her mistakes and be friendly with others. Despite this, she exhibits frequent bouts of jealousy especially when it comes to [Ikki](https://anilist.co/character/88265).

Stella gets agitated whenever anyone says that she is strong because she is an "A Rank" and do not see all her hard work, but Ikki Kurogane was the only one to see Stella's hard work which was one of the reasons Stella started developing feelings for him.

88265.description:
Ikki Kurogane is an F-rank Apprentice Knight who strives to become a real Mage Knight. He is a young man of average height with dark brown hair and brown eyes.

A noble young man with a caring personality. Ikki can be very cruel under certain circumstances. When it comes dealing women of his age and the whole academy in general Ikki is really clumsy because he has no prior experience with them outside of respect towards a superior or as a knight. This really shows when he confronts Stella on that subject.

~!At the end of volume 19 Ikki and Stella get married in the Vermillion Kingdom!~

88293.description:
__Height:__ 148 cm - 152 cm (4'10" - 4'11")

Hinami is a child ghoul whose parents were killed by ghoul investigators. Before, she and her mother seek help from the owner of the Antique Cafe to acquire food. Hinami is initially quite shy, but when she opens up, she is cheerful and earnest. [Ken](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Kaneki-Ken) helps her learn kanji, as she cannot attend school, and is very eager to learn. She is living together with [Touka Kirishima](https://anilist.co/character/87277/Kirishima-Touka).

88301.description: A government operative and a nuclear scientist affiliated with NEST, an organization within the United States FBI. She travels to Japan to assist in investigations regarding the terrorist attack.

88302.description: A detective in the metropolitan police department. He used to work in the investigations division but now works in the records division. He's a contemporary of the head of the terror incident investigation. He is aloof and lazy, with a reluctance to work, but when push comes to shove and people's lives are in danger he quickly turns into a smart, quick-minded man being able to solve most problems that arise. He is extremely experienced in his field and has a strong sense of justice.

88326.description:
Miwa Yamamura is the only daughter of a liquor seller. She is a 3rd-year middle school student whose brash and blunt personality leads her to shenanigans, often involving [Handa-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/31274/Handa-Sei).

She is best friends with [Tamako Arai](https://anilist.co/character/88327/Arai-Tamako).

88333.description: The village chief and Hiroshi's father.

88334.description: The headmaster of the branch school in the Nanatsutake village (grades 1 & 2 of elementary school). He is often smoking and sometimes appears unreliable, although he is a cheerful and capable educator.

88336.description: Tina is a product of Ayn Rand's mechanized soldiers and formerly her Model Owl Initiator.

88337.description:
Because of the war with Gastrea, Japan has been divided into five Areas. She is the ruler of Tokyo Area. 16 years old. Possessing an unworldly beauty, having a kind heart and noble goals, she receives a lot of support from the people.

(Source: Baka-Tsuki)

88340.description:
Yuzuki Katagiri is a Model Spider Initiator, younger sister of Tamaki Katagiri, who is also her Promoter. She is a member of the Katagiri Civil Security Corporation.

(Source: Black Bullet Wikia)

88341.description:
Tamaki Katagiri is a Promoter, partnered with his younger sister, Yuzuki Katagiri. He is the president of the Katagiri Civil Security Corporation.

(Source: Black Bullet Wikia)

88344.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Chise Hatori is a Sleigh Beggy and one of the main protagonists of the series. She is the apprentice and wife of [Elias Ainsworth](https://anilist.co/character/121430/Ainsworth-Elias).

Devoid of love from a young age, Chise has a mysterious connection to magic, which causes her to attract fairies. She learns more about her magical abilities as she finds herself in the care and tutelage of Elias, a powerful mage.

(Source: Ancient Magus Bride Wiki & Crunchyroll)

88346.description:
Sylphiette is [Rudeus'](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) childhood friend who is part human, elf, and beast race.

~!Following the teleportation incident, during which her hair turned white from mana exhaustion, she became Princess Ariel's personal bodyguard under the alias Fitz.!~

~!She is Rudeus' first wife and gives birth to their daughter [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/188846/Greyrat-Lucy) and son [Sieghardt](https://anilist.co/character/273377/Greyrat-Saladin-Sieghardt). She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. A cloth stained with her virgin blood that serves as a relic for the Goddess of Love is enshrined in the basement.!~

name.native: ルーデウス・グレイラット

88348.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Rudeus is a tall, well-built, and cool-looking man. However, before his reincarnation, he was originally an overweight 34-year-old Japanese NEET who became a recluse following his high-school persecution. Because of his former life, he is careful not to get carried away and become arrogant. As a result, he is extremely self-aware and humble because he does not want to revert to his old self. He is a kind person, helping his friends and protecting his family whenever needed. Due to being capable in many fields, people have high expectations of him. His body possesses a high affinity for magic. Rudeus is very polite to others, often to the point of making them uncomfortable.

Rudeus is one of the few people capable of using voiceless magic, and even rarer as someone who can use voiceless incantation with melded magics. He cannot use voiceless incantation for healing magic due to his lack of understanding in regards to how mana is manipulated to heal. A normal Magician takes at least five seconds for a simple spell, while for higher-level spells it's thirty to sixty seconds. Rudeus can do it almost instantly no matter what the difficulty of the spell, with the exception of healing magic.

name.native: エリス・ボレアス・グレイラット

88349.description:
Eris Boreas Greyrat is a noble girl and distant relative of [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat). She is a tsundere with a short temper but has potential in the Sword-God style.

~!She is Rudeus' third wife and gives birth to their son [Ars](https://anilist.co/character/273378/Greyrat-Ars) and daughter [Christina](https://anilist.co/character/278862/Greyrat-Christina). She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. A wooden sword that serves as a relic for the Goddess of War is enshrined in the basement.!~

name.native: ロキシー・ミグルディア

88350.description:
Roxy Migurdia is a talented mage from the Migurd race, and a former magic tutor. Because she can't use telepathy, she left her village due to feeling isolated from her peers. Unable to make a stable living as an adventurer, she became a travelling tutor and eventually becomes [Rudeus'](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) teacher.

~!She is Rudeus' second wife and gives birth to their daughter [Lara](https://anilist.co/character/273376/Greyrat-Lara) & [Lily](https://anilist.co/character/321620/Greyrat-Lily). She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. Her panties that serves as a relic for the Goddess of Wisdom is enshrined in the basement.!~

name.native: ルイジェルド・スペルディア

88351.description:
Ruijerd Superdia is the former leader of the Superd's Warrior group whom once served under Laplace with unwavering loyalty. He was accompanying [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) and [Eris](https://anilist.co/character/88349/Eris-Boreas-Greyrat).

~!Laplace betrayed his group by giving them each a devil spear which made them ecstatic from killing, even their own family. After giving his son a fatal wound, his son managed to destroy the devil spear and Ruijerd finally wakes up from the brainwash. He considered committing suicide but decided not to and everyone of that warrior group swore revenged on Laplace.

He finally got his revenge after several years of hiding. He interfered in the battle between Laplace and the three heroes. But even if Laplace was defeated, there was no way to change the things that had already transpired.

After exacting his revenge, he now has a goal of removing the infamy the Superd race has.!~

88359.description: Kurumi Ebisuzawa is a former student at Megurigaoka Private High School and the primary "zombie killer"/strategist of the School Life Club, where her abilities prove invaluable.

88361.description:
Yuuri Wakasa is one of the main characters of the Gakkou Gurashi! series. She is a former student at Megurigaoka Private High School. As the big-sister figure, Yuuri is the president of the School Life Club, where she is more commonly referred to as "Rii (-san)".
She keeps a detailed record of food, electricity, lessons, and other resources and activities. Yuuri is usually very calm and mature, and acts in a collected and proper manner. She also is quite serious, always looks after her comrades, and is not afraid to scold someone when they put themselves in danger pointlessly.

88371.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm

Kazuki is [Yuuji](https://anilist.co/character/80891)'s elder sister as well as the one who taught him throughout the earlier periods of his life.

Despite her delicate and diminutive body, she has brilliant intellect and excels in quick-witted judgement to the point that she has been labelled as a genius. She is the same age as [Amane](https://anilist.co/character/80899), both of which attended the same school "Takizono Private" and was also an active member of the basketball team for the aforementioned academy.
~!She unfortunately dies in an accident which has a great impact on both Amane's and Yuuji's lives, with the latter being more emotionally shaken.!~

88376.description:
__Race:__ Elf
__Class:__ Cleric
__Subclass:__ Woodcrafter
__Guild:__ Crescent Moon Alliance

Guild master of Crescent Moon Alliance. She's overly-friendly with everyone she meets, especially Naotsugu.

88385.description:
Race: Human
Class: Guardian
Subclass: Berserker
Guild: D.D.D.

name.native: レイネシア=エルアルテ=コーウェン

88394.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Class:__ Noble
__Level:__ 14
__HP:__ 1147
__MP:__ 695
__Affiliation:__ League of Eastal Freedom Cities/Akihabara Roundtable

Lenessia is the grand daughter of [Sergiatte Cowen](https://anilist.co/character/88395/Sergiatte-Cowen) and the princess to the throne.

88407.description:
__Height:__ 191 cm (6'3")

A first class police investigator who investigates Ghouls, also known as a Dove. He comes to the 20th ward with his mentor, [Mado Kureo](https://anilist.co/character/88423), to investigate Ghoul incidents in the area. He has a strong sense of justice, fervently believing it is the right and moral thing to do to exterminate the Ghouls. He hunts the Ghouls in order to prevent more human children from becoming orphaned like himself, and he often works after hours to achieve his goals.

He wields a "Quinque" (a weapon made from the "Kagune" of a Ghoul) that has the appearance of a pole-arm with a large cylindrical bludgeon at the end.

88408.description: A Special Class Ghoul Investigator. In the past, he acted as Koutarou Amon's instructor at the Academy.

88409.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'9")

Nishiki Nishio is a ghoul whose original feeding ground was taken from Rize. He is a sophomore in the Pharmaceutical Department of Kamii University and Kimi Nishino's boyfriend.

88411.description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'2")

Ayato Kirishima is [Touka Kirishima](https://anilist.co/character/87277/Touka-Kirishima)'s younger brother. He grew up with his sister in the 20th ward but at some point of time, he disappeared. Currently, he is an executive of Aogiri Tree. An arrogant youth with a similar harsh attitude that resembles his sister. Other than physical looks, he shares many similarities with Touka such as his cold, hotblooded attitude and a habit for kicking people. However, he's more harsh compared to her and surprisingly nicer than his Aogiri superiors.

88412.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

A Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator. In the past, he went by the name Rei Suzuya. He is the partner of [Yukinori Shinohara](https://anilist.co/character/88408). He is a young man with androgynous appearance. He has many stitches used as both first-aid and fashion. His hair is tied with a stitching string in a roman numeral 13 pattern, with large pupils that leaves an eerie and frightening impression.

88413.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

Rize Kamishiro is a ghoul that was hanging out at Anteiku. She set her eyes on [Ken Kaneki](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Kaneki-Ken), but moments before eating him, she died in an accident and her organs were transplanted in Ken Kaneki, making him half-ghoul.

88414.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm

A ghoul that has his own art studio where he makes masks for other ghouls. He has a lot of piercings and tattoos on his body, making him look pretty intimidating, even as a normal-looking human. He's the one who also made a mask for Kaneki.

88421.description:
__Race:__ Human

Hideyoshi is a normal human and the best friend of [Ken Kaneki](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Kaneki-Ken). Hide is incredibly observant and can figure things out about people in a almost sherlock-like manner. He also becomes interested in things and works hard on them until he finds something else to interest him.

88423.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm

A senior first class investigator, or a "Dove," who hunts Ghouls. He is Amon's mentor and partner. He hunts Ghouls with a maniacal glee, and believes that all Ghouls are lesser than humans, calling them "trash," and mocking them for trying to "imitate" human behavior. Mado is a fanatic about collecting Ghoul's "Kagune" (their extra limbs) and making them into "Quinque," or weapons that Doves use to kill Ghouls.

88424.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Shuu Tsukiyama was the infamous Gourmet ghoul of the 20th ward. He was a fourth-year student studying Social Welfare at the Department of Human Sciences at Seinan Gakuin University. He comes from the extremely wealthy and influential Tsukiyama family which his father, Mirumo Tsukiyama was the head of. Tsukiyama himself became the head of his family after the Tsukiyama Family Extermination Operation. He was also a member of the Ghoul Restaurant, known as MM until he betrayed them.

He joined Kaneki's group with the hidden intention of eating Ken Kaneki, obsessed with his scent and taste but eventually came to genuinely care for Kaneki. Two years later, his severe depression and anorexia after Kaneki's apparent demise left him emaciated and required constant care from his family servants. After finding out Kaneki was alive and meeting him, he recovers, being able to walk and eat on his own as well as take measures to help Kaneki regain his memories.

88449.description:
Daichi is a 17-year-old high school student who lost his father years prior in a space travel accident, and left his family's home on Tanegashima afterwards. When he sees a rainbow formation on a television broadcast from the Tanegashima Space Center, he returns, and because of his skill at a particular arcade game, it makes him the perfect pilot for the Earth Engine Impacter.

(Source: Wikipedia)

88452.description:
Akari is a 17-year-old genius hacker calling herself a "magic girl". She is shown to have adapt piloting skills and is able to control the Earth engine impactor via computer from earth. However, she says it's harder to pilot without direct control.

Akari has short orange hair with 2 purple hair clips and 1 green clip on her left. She also has purple eyes and has fair skin. Also wears a yellow tank-top with white straps and white buttons. Wears green shorts with a pink belt and white and yellow wedges with a yellow bow and white and red bangles.

(Source: Captain Earth Wikia)

name.native: ピーター・ウエストビレッジ

88476.description:
Kotori has the ability to switch with other people and things as well as allowing others to come with her when she uses her powers. However she can only use her powers once which then causes her to hang up. Despite this handicap, her ability has often come into place in vital situations. She is not familiar with other magicians when still lived in the lab.

Kotori is a clumsy but soft-hearted girl. She gets nervous easily, and when that happens, she will start to stutter. She likes all kinds of desserts and does eat a lot of food.

88477.description:
Akane is a female researcher who got mortally wounded during the B-rank magician's escape. She is most likely involved in the escape operation.

She gave Neko a package and entrusted her the following mission : "Save the world from utter destruction".

88479.description:
One of the strongest hybrid magic users ever known with the S-rank called a Valkyria. She is Chisato's side-kick and the next-generation magic user with a very complex harnest. Mako's power capability is very large, with 8 different abilities. Her strongest power is to create anti-matter which is capable of destroying a whole wide-range area. She can kill anyone in her sight within just seconds by dismembering them, and also has ability to teleport, and regenerate quickly. She has a sociopathic personality, and has deep feelings towards Chisato.

(Source: Wikipedia)

88480.description:
Ichijiku is the director at the research institute. His job is the supervision of "witches" and the management of "Sorcerian." He deploys people to capture and retake witches A-rank and above when they escape. He is cold and mercilessness demeanor meant that his regard for human life is meaningless. He treats every witches in a very cruel manner which for him they are merely his tools, he also has no hesitation of deposing any witch whom he sees unworthy to live.

It was later on reveled that his interest to join the clandestine research institute was to find a way to revive his long dead sister Rena, where he conducts his own experiment behind his superiors back where he feeds some of his sister's brain into Kotori's grane hoping that his sister's memories would live inside Kotori but with no success, however it did accelerated the grane inside Kotori to hatch sooner than he expected.

88481.description: Hatsuna is a magician who escaped the laboratory. She has the ability to resurrect herself so cannot be killed by any physical harm. However, she will still die if she stops consuming pills.

88486.description: The captain of the swim team at Sametsuka Academy.

88487.description: A member of the swim team at Samezuka Academy. He is a first year and [Rin Matsuoka](https://anilist.co/character/83019/Matsuoka-Rin)'s roommate.

name.native: ラティファ・フルーランザ

88505.description:
The princess and ruler of Amagi Brilliant Park. She is a very cheerful and positive girl often seen with a smile on her face. She cares deeply about the amusement park as she is seen being concerned about the future of the amusement park and willing to do anything in order to preserve it. 

~!Years ago, she was saved by a wizard who had been promised her in marriage. However, the King (Latifa's father) refused to keep his end of the bargain and tried to have the wizard executed. In revenge the wizard cursed Latifa with a spell that gradually removes her animus; a magical substance that all creatures from Maple Land require to continue living. However, as human happiness (or human animus) is a temporary source, she is able to draw sustenance from the park; albeit not sufficient for full strength, as she is seen to be permanently frail and weak. Her blindness in the novel may be derived from the same source.

Another effect of the Wizard's curse means that Latifa does not age normally. Upon reaching the 1st of August, the day that she was cursed, all physical changes and memories revert back to the previous year; meaning that she lives in a year cycle of being 14. [Moffle](https://anilist.co/character/88506/Moffle) explained that this has been happening for the last 10 years.!~

88506.description: A fairy of candies with the form of a mouse with a hat and Amagi Brilliant Park's main mascot who takes a mutual disliking towards Seiya. He is Latifah's uncle. His appearance resembles Bonta-kun, the fictional mascot from Full Metal Panic? Fumoffu.

88509.description: The fairy of water and the leader of the fairies of Elementario. Muse has a very energetic and cheerful personality and she is often seen with a smile on her face. Despite the lack of popularity of the Elementario, she still works hard. Of the four fairies, she is the best at singing. (Source: Wikipedia)

88510.description: The fairy of wind of the fairies of Elementario. She is an airhead, but also the best at performing of the four.

88512.description: The fairy of fire of the fairies of Elementario, who usually has a lazy and unmotivated personality when it comes to performing at the park. She seems to enjoy being on her phone when she is not performing and apparently engages in flaming wars.

88520.description: A high school sumo wrestler who aims to become the next Yokozuna.

name.native: アンジュリーゼ・斑鳩・ミスルギ

88525.description: She used to be a member of the nobility who had the title of "First Princess of the Misurugi Empire" until the day of her coronation when she was exposed as a "Norma" by her ambitious brother Julio. Stripped of her title and honor, and thrown into a remote island where her own kind are treated like tools for battling dragons, her once comfortable life of honor, privilege, and prestige now becomes a life of where everyday is a battle to stay alive as she struggles to accept her new life as one of the warriors of the First Troop.

88554.description:
A mysterious woman who fell from the sky. She, by all means, wants to reach the northern land called Helheim.

Amira is a very tall young woman with pale skin, violet eyes, and long, flowing, pink hair she ties in two ponytails. Her attire is somewhat unusual, consisting of a white blouse with a black vest above it, and a knee-length tan-colored shirt which acts as a coat, with a maroon and red vest covering her shoulders. She wears white and beige shorts, held up with a black belt, and two long, cowboy-looking boots with folded top edge, patched black in color.

88555.description:
Favaro makes his living as a bounty hunter. He can't live without women, money and wine. His life takes a turn when he meets [Amira](https://anilist.co/character/88554/Amira).

Favaro is a young man with an orange hair styled into an afro, and green eyes. He has a large X-shaped scar on his face. His armor consists of a left pauldron, plate on his left elbow, plates on both of his knees and plated boots.

Speaks with a carefree attitude and is somewhat of a self-proclaimed ladies' man. He doesn't like to be responsible for others and claims that he only watches out for himself.

name.native: カイザル・リドファルド

88556.description:
Kaisar used to be a knight from a prestigious family, but has since become a bounty hunter. He chases Favaro, blaming him for his current status.

Kaisar is a very tall man, with white pants, a green shirt with white stripes and golden buttons, and a dark green vest hung over it, with green arm covers and golden stripes on the wrists. He has his knight's sword sheathed in a navy blue scabbard on his left side at all times. At times he's seen in gray knight's armor; even when he takes the armor off he keeps the leggins of the armor on his legs. Can be often seen holding a knight's pose and usually bears himself with knightly demeanor.

He is a righteous man with a very strong sense of honor, and constantly follows his own ideal of justice. Kaisar is shown to be very empathetic and compassionate, as seen during his meeting with Rita. Because of his tragic past as a rebellious son who was distant from his family, Kaisar now highly values family and abhors other people who take their family for granted. Seems to have a crush on Amira, calling her a beauty on their first encounter.

88559.description:
Rita is a young child who lives in Nebelville, and is the daughter of the village doctor. She has short black hair and bangs, and usually wears a lopsided hat. She has somewhat of a quiet and timid personality.

~!She is actually a young necromancer. One day a monster invaded the village and killed everyone, leaving her as the only survivor of the massacre. Alone and scared, Rita used the Black Bible to revive her parents and the dead villagers, and concealed all of them behind an magical mist that made the zombies look as if they were alive. For two hundred years she lived with the zombified remnants of the town until she was, in the end, bitten by her own parents. After being spared by Kaisar and becoming an undead, she now follows the former knight in his travels.!~

88563.description: At school she gets tacks put in her shoes, glue put on her desk, her head shoved in a toilet, and even worse than that. At home, her older brother who is stressed from trying to live up to their father's expectations ties her up, strips her, and beats her to relieve his stress. All Aya thinks about every day amidst the hell that is her life is dying. But one day a strange website called "Mahou Shoujo Site" pops up on her computer.
