The next day, the bullies at her school push her past the limit once again, but this time things go a little differently.

88564.description:
__Height:__ 5'0"

She is a magical girl with the power to stop time. She tells Aya information about the magical girls and allies with her so they can be safer together. Unlike Aya, she does not have a problem using her power to injure or kill people who she dislikes.

She was born in a city called Kanagawa, her hobbies are sleeping, gaming, and swimming, her advantages are that she's friendly, fit and takes the initiative. Tsuyuno doesn't like meat or waking up in the morning, but does like vegetables, games on her phone, honey, yogurts, cute things and advertising mascots.

88565.description:
A girl in her third year of high school. She is [Kadode](https://anilist.co/character/88566/Koyama-Kadode)'s best friend.

She has long black hair, which she often wears in twintails, secured by skull-shaped hairties. Ouran has an older brother, [Hiroshi](https://anilist.co/character/89578/Nakagawa-Hiroshi) who is a NEET. She likes to play video games along with Kadode.

Ouran is a very flamboyant character. She often rambles on about her goal to enslave mankind or lead the human race to destruction. However, despite her seemingly flamboyant and sociable personality, Ouran tends to only show her true self to her friends and family.

88566.description:
A girl in her third year of high school. She loves the iconic manga character [Isobeyan](https://anilist.co/character/208124/Isobeyan). She also has a crush on [her teacher](https://anilist.co/character/89581/Watarase-Naoki).

[Her dad](https://anilist.co/character/208125/Koyama-Nobuo) went missing during the initial appearance of the alien mothership over Japan. She appears to have a rocky relationship with [her mother](https://anilist.co/character/89585/Koyama-Manami), who's constantly worried about her own health and the A-Rays that were released when the aliens invaded.

88572.description:
**Height:** 164 cm (5'5")

Emilia is a half-elf girl who is one of the candidates to become the next ruler in the royal election. [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) first meets her when her insignia is stolen by [Felt](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt) as she needs to possess it to be eligible to participate in the election. She introduces herself as Satella when she and Subaru met during the first timeline before introducing herself by her real name when she got her insignia back.

Emilia is good natured and likes to take care of others, though she herself refuses to admit it, instead thinking of it as her own selfishness. She is indifferent to her own appearance, leaving [Puck](https://anilist.co/character/90187/Puck) to take care of her clothes and hair. Because her appearance is similar to the [Witch of Envy](https://anilist.co/character/127242/Satella), she has received unfair discrimination from others. She sometimes acts like a child and is unacquainted with the world as she used to live in the woods with other Elves, though despite this she still works hard to become a ruler.

88573.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

On the way home from the convenience store, he suddenly finds himself transported into another world. He has the ability that he calls "Return by Death" to go back in time when he dies. Despite being a hikikomori and gamer in his real world, Subaru does a bit of workout and seems to know basic hand-to-hand combat, making him not completely weak.

While Subaru tends to not read the situation, he is loyal to those he holds dear, willing to help them, even if that means taking the thorny path. He has his resolve confirmed through the many situations and circumstances he faces in the fantasy world, originally having been one to always take the "easy" route. As a hikikomori, he is hopeful of the possibilities that being sucked into a new realm brings, but later realizes the realities of the predicament he is in. Ultimately, he resolves himself to be faithful and protective of the ones that he cares most about.

88574.description:
**Height:** 150 cm (4'11")

A thief that lives in the slums. Felt stole [Emilia's](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia) insignia, hoping for quick, easy cash. Though Felt can usually handle her own, she does consider [Rom](https://anilist.co/character/124117/Rom) to be like family.

~!After being chosen by the insignia, she is forced to participate in the Royal Selection and is currently a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica.!~

88575.description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1")

Rem is one of the twin maids working for [Roswaal L Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182/Mathers-L-Roswaal). She has medium length sky blue hair that covers her right eye, large light blue eyes, and young features. She also has hair clips towards left side of her hair, flower-shaped ribbon on the same side of her hair, and a maid hairband. She looks nearly identical to her sister [Ram](https://anilist.co/character/88576) apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. She usually wears a maid uniform, and since her chest is slightly larger than her sister's, she secretly changes the measurements to hide it. Rem tends to speak in a superficially polite manner and sometimes acts without thinking. She holds both respect to the point of worship and guilt toward her sister for an incident in the past. Because of her respect and guilt toward her sister, she used to think of herself as inferior.

88576.description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5’1”)

Ram is one of the twin maids working for [Roswaal L Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182). She has medium length light pink hair that covers her left eye, large darkish pink eyes, and young features. She also has hair clips towards right side of her hair, flower-shaped ribbon on the same side of her hair, and a maid hairband. She looks nearly identical to her sister [Rem](https://anilist.co/character/88575/Rem) apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. Ram is seemingly self-centered and does things at her own pace, however in actuality she maintains a distance from people to ascertain them. She believes that Roswaal is the greatest and no one else is as precious except for her sister Rem. She is slightly more outgoing in comparison to the generally taciturn Rem, who generally allows Ram to take the lead in their sisterly bond.

name.native: ラインハルト・ヴァン・アストレア

88577.description:
__Height__: 184 cm (6'0")

Reinhard van Astrea is the current Sword Saint and a member of the Royal Guard, currently acting as [Felt's](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt) knight. 

As the Sword Saint and the Knight of the Royal Guard, Reinhard embodies chivalry and elegance, treating everyone with exceptional respect. He is fair, brave, and always acts in the name of justice, whether on duty or simply strolling through the Royal Capital.

As a knight, Reinhard only uses his sword when necessary, since, in addition to being a rule, his iron-clad rule is to not inflict pain to others if not absolutely necessary, be it a normal thug or a member of the Witch Cult.

88602.description:
Jurai is the main protagonist of Ino Battle wa Nichijo-kei no Naka de. He is also part of the school Literature Club on his right hand he has a superpower called, "Dark and Dark."

Jurai is a goofy boy. Due to his Chunin Syndrome, he often falls into a world of his own, causing annoyance to those around him. Because of this he has developed a very care free personality that can often accept other peoples' faults without much trouble. When he gained his superpower, he was excited, saying that even though it didn't do much, he still loved it all the same, because every guy wants one.

(Source: Inou-Battle wa Nichijou-kei no Naka de Wikia)

88603.description:
She is a shy elementary school girl, she was accepted as an unofficial member of the Literature Club mainly because she is the club advisers's relative. Her special powers allows her to create anything out of thin air, she can also create portals, dimensions and she can also manipulate any materials down to its sub atomic level. 

Just like the rest of the girls in her club, she too has feelings for Andou.

(Source: Zinc View)

88604.description:
Tomoyo Kanzaki is one of the main characters of Ino Battle wa Nichijou-kei no Naka de. She has the superpower to manipulate time, "Closed Clock," and she is also part of the Literature Club.

A red-haired girl who is constantly bemused by Jurai's antics. Her power allow her to speed up, slow down, or stop time, though she cannot rewind it.

88605.description:
Hatoko Kushikawa is one of the main characters of Ino Battle wa Nichijo-kei no Naka de. She is also a part of the Literature Club.

She is a polite air-headed girl who often takes Jurai's chunibyo antics seriously. Her power is "Over Element," which gives her the ability to manipulate five main elements of the natural world: earth, water, fire, wind, and light.

She is also Jurai's childhood friend and next door neighbor, who sometimes drops by to his house to cook for him and his big sister, since both of them admit to being bad at cooking. She has a tendency to be jealous towards Jurai when she sees him with Tomoyo, though she keeps quiet about it.

(Source: Wikipedia)

88606.description:
She is a senior student and the president of the Literature Club. She is normally seen reading books, and there are hints that she has feelings for Andou. Her power is "Root of Origins" in which anyone she touches returns to his or her original state, although the exact nature of this remains vague. She a very refine girl, whose other hobbies, besides reading, includes ikebana, origami, and martial arts.

For some reason, she dislikes being called "cute."

(Source: Zince-View, edited)

88620.description:
A polite second-year middle-schooler who is skilled at cooking.
Living alone since her beloved grandmother passed away. Both parents are working overseas.
Is reliable, but has difficulty depending on others.

88621.description: [Ryou](https://anilist.co/character/88620/Ryou-Machiko)'s second-cousin of the same age. Childish, gluttonous and confident in her strength. Loves Ryou, dislikes carrots.

88622.description: Shiina the same art prep school as Ryou and Kirin. She is in her second year of middle school and can be somewhat mysterious.

88636.description:
A second-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She prides herself on being a hero, helping out others in needs and always remaining optimistic.

She fights the Vertex with her armored gauntlets and greaves. Her fairy familiar, Gyuuki, allows her to condense energy in her fist for her signature move "Hero Punch".

88637.description:
[Yuuna](https://anilist.co/character/88636/Yuuna-Yuuki)'s best friend and fellow classmate and club member who lives next door to her and often prefers to be called by her family name. Mimori takes pride in her national heritage and is always ready to defend her country and protect its people. She has lost the use of her legs, along with some of her memories, allegedly due to a car accident.

~! Two years before the main story, Mimori was adopted by the Washio family because of her high aptitude as a Hero Candidate. She went by the name Sumi Washio for the entirety of her time adopted by the Washio family. After her Mankai caused her memory loss, she was promptly returned to the Tougou family and was conveniently relocated by the Taisha as a neighbor to Yuuna. !~

88638.description:
A third-year in middle school, president of the Hero Club, and older sister of [Itsuki](https://anilist.co/character/88639). She doesn’t bother with trivial issues, but she sees the big picture and inspires the others to follow her like a big sister. She loves her younger sister and friends very much. She is good at cooking and housekeeping, and loves eating.

As a Hero, Fuu wields a large greatsword. The size of her blade allows her to use it as a shield just as often as a sword. She can also use the power of her fairy, Inugami, to increase her sword's size and attack a wide area.

88639.description:
A first-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She is Fuu's younger sister and respects her dearly. Unlike her older sister, Itsuki is very shy and timid. However, she is very kindhearted and enjoys helping people. She also becomes less shy around people she knows, and can even be snarky at times.

As a Hero, Itsuki fights with a tambourine-like ring lined with white flowers from which she can fire magical vines. These vines can ensnare and slice through enemies.

88640.description:
A second year in middle school, and member of the Hero Club. She is an experienced hero who transferred into [Yuuna](https://anilist.co/character/88636/Yuuki-Yuuna) and [Mimori](https://anilist.co/character/88637/Tougou-Mimori)'s class, joining the Hero Club to supervise the other heroes. Karin is depicted as a headstrong individual: stubborn, obstinate, and single-minded. She is very abrasive and finds it difficult when expressing her feelings towards others. However, she can't resist helping whenever someone is having trouble. She is rather self-confident and positive, initially believing her skills are far greater than the other members of the Hero Club. One could describe her as a "tsundere".

As a Hero, Karin dual-wields twin katana. She is also able to throw her katana to strike at range while being able to generate new ones. Karin also has powerful physical abilities and can sense things without being able to see them.

88641.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

Sonoko Nogi is one of the three main characters of the light novel Washio Sumi is a Hero. At the time of the story taking place, she's an elementary school 6th-year student chosen by Taisha to fight Vertexes as a Hero, along with Gin Minowa and Sumi Washio. She is a very easygoing girl who has a habit of spacing out. However, her cloud cuckoo lander personality masks a truly staggering intellect, and she can formulate plans in mere seconds. Sonoko is also a successful novelist who specializes in romance novels, and she enjoys imagining her female friends in romantic situations with each other.

88642.description: A mysterious blue-haired girl whom Nonoka first met seven years ago.

88643.description: The main heroine who returns to Lake Kiriya after moving away seven years ago. She lives with her father as her mother has passed away due to illness.

88644.description: An energetic girl who has a strong dislike for the saucer. She also seems to be on bad terms with her twin brother, Souta.

88645.description: An airheaded girl who works as a poster girl for a local shop.

88646.description: A stern girl who enjoys photography. She was once Nonoka's best friend but grew to hate her after she moved away.

88651.description:
**Occupation:** Production assistant for Musashino Animation

Aoi is cheerful and positive and has an interest in animation and was a member of the animation club in high school. However, she does not know what specific job she wants to do in the anime industry.

88653.description: Animator at Musashino Animation. Was a member of the animation club in high school.

88657.description:
Aspiring scriptwriter and university student.

The highly enthusiastic Midori is a former member of her high school animation club.

88663.description: Coming from a wealthy family, she is the kind and well-mannered president of the school knitting club and the only other member besides [Koutarou](https://anilist.co/character/88073/Satomi-Koutarou). Her closeness with him is a constant source of jealousy for the girls living with him.

88681.description: Nona is the manager of the Arbiter system, as well as the bartender of Nona Ginta located on the ninetieth floor. She is the boss of Decim, Ginti, Clavis, along with the rest of the other arbiters.

88683.description:
Ginti is bartender of a bar named Viginti, which is located on the 20th floor.

(Source: Death Parade Wiki)

88689.description: He is the infamous god of academics. He has several shinki, all of them women (including Yato's former shinki); and has his own shrine, much to Yato's envy. He would sometimes assume human form to intervene if, for example, Yato goes out of control playing around.

88690.description: Rabo is an enigmatic character and appears only in the anime. He is often seen conversing with Nora and has been known to be able to control Phantoms.

88691.description: Daikoku is [Kofuku's](https://anilist.co/character/88241) somewhat overprotective shinki. He regards himself as Kofuku's husband.

88692.description:
__Race:__ Shinki
__Occupation:__ Stray

__Nora__ is a former shinki of [Yato](https://anilist.co/character/84677/Yato). "Nora," meaning "stray," is how the gods call any shinki who has many masters and many names, most notable owners of Nora are ~! [Ebisu](https://anilist.co/character/89120/Ebisu) and [Takemikazuchi](https://anilist.co/character/159592/Takemikazuchi) !~

Nora, at first comes off as very gentle and kind. She seems to care deeply for Yato, and continually prompts him to use her, because she was once a human and all she wanted was to have a family that cared about her. 

~!Later, it is revealed how manipulating and cruel she is. She tries to kill Yukine, as well as taunt him, due to the fact that he was impure, but also because she wants Yato to use her instead of him. She also tries to kill Hiyori due to how close she has gotten to Yato and believing she has softened him. She is depicted to show interest in anything with beauty, as shown when she commented on Yukine's eyes. She, just as Yato, is influenced and controlled by the actions and demands of "Father". Although she is initially seen as a villain, she is another puppet in the grand scheme of Yato's father. !~

88707.description:
**Instrument:** Tuba

Kumiko's classmate. She was in the tennis club in junior high school, and is a beginner in music. She admired the trumpet and joined the wind ensemble, but ends up playing the tuba. She's a bright and perky mood-maker.

88708.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm  
__Instrument:__ Euphonium

Kumiko enrolled in Kitauji High School after long hoping to wear the uniform. She wasn't particularly dead set on it but decided to join the wind ensemble and continue playing the euphonium. She has a habit of immediately saying what she's thinking and changes her mind easily. She is very preoccupied with something she said to [Reina](https://anilist.co/character/88710/Kousaka-Reina) at a contest in junior high school.

88709.description:
**Instrument:** Contrabass

Kumiko's classmate. At an elite junior high school for young ladies, she learned to play the contrabass. She joined the wind ensemble to continue to happily play music. She has a positive personality, but worries about her name.

(Source: Anime News Network)

88710.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm
__Instrument:__ Trumpet

A girl who graduated from the same junior high school as [Kumiko](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko). Influenced by her dad, who is a pro, she has been playing the trumpet since she was little, so she continues at the wind ensemble in high school. She is stoic and cool, and tends to keep herself distanced from other people.

88717.description: Ex-student council secretary. She has an unstable stomach and often vomits to the point that friends and enemies alike call her "Pukey". She is often shown working many different types of part-time jobs and often runs into the club activities

88718.description:
A glasses-wearing girl with a perverted streak who often dresses up Sakuragaoka in girly outfits. She acts as Chitose's counterpart for the "real" Game Creation Club. 

(Source: Wikipedia)

88719.description: A boy with a very feminine appearance. Due to a misunderstanding during their first met, Kenji refers to him as a girl, which he never had a chance to correct.

88720.description: Shingo Andō is one of the minor characters in the manga series and also one of 5 guest judges for the B Block Preliminary Round. Reputed for his silent yet serious personality, this food critic is infamous for the cruel yet truthful comments that will spell doom to any unlucky restaurant.

88721.description: He is a student at Totsuki Culinary Academyand a resident of Polar Star Dormitory. he and the other resident students from this hostel befriended with their fellow roommate/kouhai, Yukihira Soma whom also seen the amazing skill of the freshman. It is due to he rarely cooks, Zenji is considered as the weakest chef among the Polar Star Gang despite his brains has seemly possessed with infinite knowledge about cooking and black-&-white documents.

88723.description: Tadokoro is a loud, confident person with a personality as big as his stature. He is a proud sprinter and has no qualms about boasting when he wins. However, Tadokoro also has a softer side, exemplified by how much he cares about Teshima and Aoyagi. He often argues with Naruko, who is also loud and competitive. Though he seems imposing, Tadokoro also gets flustered in certain situations such as when Onoda convinced him to sing an anime song and when he encountered some cosplay maids in Akihabara.

88724.description:
He is now a third year student at Souhoku High School, the former ace, Shingo Kinjou, appointed him as the ace of the cycling club, and he takes his role very seriously.

He is very smart and uses strategies to win races along with his close friend Aoyagi. He and Aoyagi decided to work together since they are both "average cyclists" who share the same dream of reaching the top. He is very supportive of Souhoku's cycling team as he helps to supply the team with water and energy food as part of the support team during the Inter High. Teshima believes in his teammates, and encourages others (particularly Sugimoto) to believe in them as well. (Source: Yowamushi Pedal Wiki)

88725.description:
He is now a third-year student at Souhoku High School and has been named vice-captain.

He is usually silent and only speaks when necessary. Even if he rarely speaks, he thinks a lot and cares a great deal about his friends and teammates. He is particularly close to Teshima, but he is shown to be friendly with all the Sohoku members in his third year. He seems to have developed a closer relationship with Naruko since they are both sprinters, and with Koga since he is a fellow third year. Aoyagi even refers to the team as a "six-man-team".  (Source: Yowamushi Pedal Wiki)

88726.description: Midousuji has a sadistic and eccentric personality; he'll do anything to win including constantly causing others emotional distress. He appears to particularly enjoy harassing Imaizumi, but anyone he races against becomes a target of his mind games. Midousuji has a tendency to call others, including his own team members "small fry." His most commonly used phrase seems to be the word "gross." Midousuji's desire to show off his teeth probably stems from the fact that his mother said his teeth were beautiful when he was a child.

88727.description:
Iroha is a 1st-year student of class 1-C in Sobu High school, introduced in Volume 7.5. Hachiman sees her as a “not cute [Komachi](https://anilist.co/character/67075/Komachi-Hikigaya)” or a “better version of [Sagami](https://anilist.co/character/85283/Minami-Sagami).”

She acts in front of anyone to maintain her “cute appearance” with the image of an innocent girl in order to keep her image well with others, but she is a sly and crafty girl underneath. She shows her true color to [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065/Hachiman-Hikigaya) and [Tobe](https://anilist.co/character/82543/Kakeru-Tobe), which irritates the former while the latter is unaware of it.

88732.description:
__Height__ : 178 cm (5' 10")

Arakita has a bad mouth and is a competitive cyclist. He adds the suffix "-chan" onto the names or nicknames of certain people (Fukutomi, Onoda, Manami), a habit that doesn't seem to match his otherwise gruff behavior. The meaning behind these nicknames is unclear, but they appear to be more playful than derogatory. Arakita often complains about being tired or overworked, but he still pushes himself to his limits in races.

He is now a freshman at Yonan University and a member of the Yonan University Bicycle Club with Shingo Kinjou, former Souhoku ace, and Eikichi Machimiya, former Hiroshima Kureminami / Kureminami ace.

88734.description:
Toudou has a very cheerful, childish, boastful, and loud personality. He constantly references his fanclub and his own beauty, a habit which often irritates others, resulting in them telling him to shut up or dismissing his claims. His personality turns serious whenever he's climbing, as he takes races very seriously. He is the vice captain because he established his position as the best climber early on, and he normally makes very level-headed decisions.

Despite his seemingly vain nature, Toudou shows concern for other people's well-being and encourages them to grow and shine by their own achievements, discouraging shortcuts like copying homework or things like unhealthy eating habits.

88737.description:
Manami is most distinctively characterised by two things: his love for slopes, and his desire to feel alive. This stems from his childhood as sickly and bedridden, in which he played video games to pass time but disliked them, yearning to feel the pain he sustained in-game as proof he was alive. When his childhood friend Miyahara introduced him to cycling, despite his initial struggle to keep up, he fell in love with the sport as the pain he experienced from the uphill struggle made him feel truly alive.

As he grew older, his deepening passion for cycling resulted in his current easygoing personality; he is often late to or napping in class because he feels dull and confined indoors. He relies on cycling and climbing slopes (when he exerts more energy to combat the incline) to feel alive. His eagerness to ride makes him highly attuned to nature and the direction of the wind, a skill which he utilises to surpass his competitors in races. (Source: Yowamushi Pedal Wiki)

88738.description:
Shinkai generally has a very laid-back and placid personality. He shown to be very caring; when he ran over a rabbit with his bike, he deeply regretted his actions decided to raise the rabbit's baby, naming it Usakichi. This event also traumatized him badly, so he didn't want to participate in races anymore because he felt his obsession with winning was dangerous. Shinkai rejected the offer to participate in the Inter High as a second year, and only returned in his third year because of the support of his teammates. He enjoys food, as seen by the fact that he is often seen carrying power bars around.

He is now a freshman at Meisou University and a member of the Meisou University Bicycle Club with [Juichi Fukutomi](https://anilist.co/character/88746/Fukutomi-Juichi), his best friend and a former teammate, and Koutarou Ishikagi, a former member of Kyoto Fushimi / Kyoufushi.

His pose is called "bakyun", often romanized as "BQN!", it is modeled after that of the cyclist, Alberto Contador. He uses it to challenge his opponents by pointing at them, as if he were shooting at them.

88742.description:
He is now a third year student at Hakone Academy, the former ace, Juichi Fukutomi, appointed him as the ace of the cycling club, and he takes his role very seriously.

Izumida is known for his long eyelashes as well as his extremely toned body, which is the result of vigorous weight training in preparation for the Inter-High. He sacrificed his performance in other road races to create the "perfect body" specifically for this competition.

He wears his jersey unzipped, exposing his abs along with his pecs Andy and Fränk, except for times when he is seriously competing. (Source: Yowamushi Pedal Wiki)

88745.description:
Ishigaki is kind and friendly, as exhibited by his relationships with his teammates and interactions with other characters. Before Midousuji entered the cycling club, Ishigaki and the other Kyofushi members referred to each other with affectionate nicknames (for example, he was "Ishiyan" and Mizuta was "Nobu"). Ishigaki was upset when he had to leave his comrades behind on Midousuji's orders. Ishigaki was also kind to Onoda during their first meeting when he picked up Onoda's water bottle and tried to help calm him down. However, Ishigaki clearly has the drive to obtain victory since he decided to follow Midousuji's lead. Despite Midousuji's underhanded tactics, Ishigaki respects his talent and determination to win.

He is now a freshman at Meisou University and a member of the Meisou University Bicycle Club along with Juichi Fukutomi, the former ace of Hakogaku and the former sprinter of the same club, Hayato Shinkai.

88746.description:
__Height__ : 180 cm (5' 11")

As his stoic face suggests, Fukutomi has a very serious personality. He puts a lot of effort into living up to the title of "kings" of Hakogaku. While his methods may seem harsh, it is clear that Fukutomi has incredible confidence in his teammates.

He is now a freshman at Meisou University and a member of the Meisou University Bicycle Club with Hayato Shinkai, his best friend and a former teammate, and Koutarou Ishikagi, a former member of Kyoto Fushimi / Kyoufushi.

His catchphrase is: I am strong / Ore wa tsuyoi.

88747.description:
__Occupation:__ Student / Executive producer / Director / Scenario writer / Manager

Tomoya is described as a 'hardcore geek'. However, he is one of the three most notable students at Toyogasaki Academy, along with [Utaha Kasumigaoka](https://anilist.co/character/88750/Utaha-Kasumigaoka) and [Eriri Spencer Sawamura](https://anilist.co/character/88749/Eriri-Spencer-Sawamura), due to his strong advocating of otaku culture at the school.

Tomoya is an otaku and prefers reading comics and light novels, watching anime, and playing visual novels above anything else. He is an enthusiastic fan of [Utaha](https://anilist.co/character/88750/Utaha-Kasumigaoka)'s novel Koisuru Metronome. He is the founder and representative member of Blessing Software, serving as the producer, director and programmer. He is also the manager of [Michiru](https://anilist.co/character/88752/Michiru-Hyoudou)'s cover band "Icy Tail". When motivated, especially by otaku-related factors, he can be shown to be very hardworking. After his encounter with [Megumi Kato](https://anilist.co/character/88748/Megumi-Katou), his strong desire to make his dream game drives him to take up several jobs for funding. He is extremely tenacious and would do anything to get what he wants, but is easily distracted. He was a typical consumer otaku who would spend the money at his part-time job on anime and games, but his money and time are later devoted to his own games. He is very friendly despite his eccentric personality, and he has a strong sense of morals and conviction when dealing with others.

88748.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Occupation:__ Student / Assistant Director / Main Heroine

Megumi Kato is the classmate of [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki), who is hardly noticed by others. After Tomoya had met her during the fate summons, she inspired him to make a dating sim game, featuring her as his Main Heroine. However, he is disappointed by her real personality. She is one of the main characters of the [Saenai Heroine no Sodatekata](https://anilist.co/anime/20657/Saenai-Heroine-no-Sodatekata/) series and is essentially the inspiration for the series title.

name.native: 澤村・スペンサー・英梨々

88749.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5’2”)
__Occupation:__ Student / Illustrator / Painter

Eriri Spencer Sawamura is [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki)'s childhood friend. She is a student of class 2G art club. She wears two hats as a student and a doujinshi artist. Eriri is one of the most beautiful girls to attend to Toyogasaki High School. Her family is very affluent. Her father is an English diplomat and she lives in a mansion. She is the secret illustrator for a famous doujinshi circle called ''Egoistic Lily'' under the alias Eri Kashiwagi when she participates in doujin activities. She was greatly influenced by her fujoshi mother and otaku father. She was the illustrator for Blessing Software.

88750.description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5’6”)
__Occupation:__ Student / Author / Scenario Writer

Utaha Kasumigaoka is an up-and-coming young novelist and a student in class 3C who has a secret identity as a writer.

She is a hardworking girl who easily finishes writing their game's plot in the span of a night. Her usual disinterested expression gives off the impression that she is an unapproachable person. When she is with the people in [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki)'s circle, she reverts to her disdainful self who enjoys making sarcastic remarks. She seems to be calm and quiet, but she actually has a sharp tongue. Utaha can be a little aggressive. Utaha is also very intelligent and is the smartest student in the school. She even writes plays for the drama club as a hobby. She is also a little bit self-centered, but she never talks back to her parents, making her well-mannered. However, when [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki) complimented her one time, she acted like a shy, embarrassed girl instead of her usual cold self and called [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki) by his first name instead of Rinri-kun.

88753.description:
Isla is a Giftia who has a childish appearance, is extremely clumsy, and doesn't show much emotion. She's also a veteran Giftia who is said to be the #1 in retrievals in the terminal service, and she is seen having a diary that records down what she has done with her retrieval targets. 
She is currently working on the same team as [Tsukasa Mizugaki](https://anilist.co/character/88754/Tsukasa-Mizugaki) and has previously worked with [Kazuki Kuwanomi](https://anilist.co/character/88757/Kazuki-Kuwanomi) years ago.

88754.description: After failing his college entrance exams due to medical problems, he eventually gets a job through his father on Terminal Service No. 1, although he initially does not know what they do. He is assigned as [Isla](https://anilist.co/character/88753)'s spotter and soon becomes attached to her.

88780.description: He is an elevator operator in the arbiter system, as well as a personal valet to Nona. His task is to transport arbiters and guests between floors. Also, he smiles a lot.

88792.description: Ozeki Shinya is a third year at Oodachi High, as well as the captain of its Sumo Club.

88797.description: He is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. Maehara is a nice guy and in every sense of the word, a playboy. He has a "live the moment" attitude about life in general. He is one of the few that is popular in the whole school despite being in the E Class. Despite that attitude, he is a caring person and isn't the type to pick on someone weaker than him. He also falls into the type of being honest, and often reacts strongly to things.

88798.description:
She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. She was a former elementary school genius but felt lonely and longed to be normal. When she got to middle school, she began shirking off her studies which landed her in Class 3-E.
She loves teasing the other students in her class (sometimes together with Karma Akabane)

88817.description:
A university student that was summoned to another world as the Shield Hero. Typically unsociable, he's friendly and easy-going to those close to him.

~!After being abandoned by [Malty](https://anilist.co/character/129808) and being treated as a criminal by the people of the world, He unlocked the curse series. The sin he has unlocked is Wrath (against the people of the world).!~

88823.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") (Human size), 23 - 24 cm (0'9") (doll)

He is shown to be completely clueless and unaware of others' feelings, not understanding the meaning of friendship. He often states things factually, not understanding how what he says can upset people. He decides to assist [Elizabeth](https://anilist.co/character/72923/Liones-Elizabeth) on her journey, not because of a desire for justice, but because he felt obligated as a member of the Seven Deadly Sins.

Since Gowther doesn't understand emotions, he goes to great length to understand them. For example, observing [Meliodas](https://anilist.co/character/72921/Meliodas) and [Ban](https://anilist.co/character/77605/Ban)'s friendship.

88838.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 164 cm
__Affiliations:__ CCG
__Quinque:__ Amatsu (Koukaku/Bikaku)
__Likes:__ making quinques, solving puzzles and cats

Akira Mado is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator and Kureo's daughter. She is currently partnered with Koutarou Amon.

She is an intelligent woman and seems to be always serious about work and her daily routine in general. Like her father, she has deep insight and intuition that helps her in investigation and determining what is going on around her while on the field. She shares her father's "quinque-mania," but it is not as extreme as his was.

Akira remains professional in most situations, no matter who she is faced with, and she isn't one to admit her own feelings on a subject unless provoked to a certain degree. Seen through her interactions with others, it is most likely that she would prefer to make a quinque rather than to interact with someone else.

88860.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

Bell Cranel is the captain of the Hestia Familia. Bell was raised by his grandfather in a rural farming village deep within the mountains near the labyrinth city Orario. He had heard and read many stories about heroes from his grandfather, forming his dream of aspiring to be a mighty one himself. After his grandfather's death, he took it upon himself to leave the village, traveling to the land of Orario to fulfill his dreams. Upon his arrival in the city, Bell attempted to enter numerous Familia, but was rejected by each one. [Hestia](https://anilist.co/character/87654/Hestia), a Goddess, unable to find members willing to join her Familia, asked him if he'd like to become the first member of her Familia. Bell gladly accepted, and so started his new life, finally with a Goddess' blessing.

Bell is a kind, straightforward, brave, yet shy boy who desires to be a hero like the ones he grew up reading about. He cares deeply for the people around him, especially his Goddess, Hestia, and his Familia. He considers them like family due to the death of his grandfather. Bell's goals didn't start out pure, as he wanted to be an adventurer in hopes of picking up girls, even thinking of starting a harem. However, after his experience with [Ais](https://anilist.co/character/87655/Wallenstein-Ais) and [Bete](https://anilist.co/character/122632/Loga-Bete), Bell seems to have forgone that dream and fell in love with Ais Wallenstein. He became determined to grow stronger so that he could be someone that could stand beside her. Ais saved Bell in an incident with a minotaur and that event made Bell fall in love with her and have fear of Minotaurs.

88869.description: Yukichi Fukazawa is a member of Southern Tennis Club and a friend of Eiichiro Maruo. He has knowledge of many recurring tennis players and calls Ei-Chan, Aniki (Big brother).

88882.description: Next door neighbor and childhood friend of [Takeo](https://anilist.co/character/80757/Gouda-Takeo), as well as his classmate. Because Makoto is so handsome, all of the girls Takeo liked ended up falling in love with Makoto instead. Makoto is always watching out for Takeo and is willing to sacrifice his own happiness for his friend.

88889.description:
**Race:** Raccoon & Tanuki

Raphtalia is a Tanuki-type Demi-Human who was the first real member of the Shield Hero's party after he purchased her as a slave.

~!Raphtalia later obtain one of the eight vassal weapons from another world granting her the title of Vassal Weapon Wielder and Katana Hero. Due to the passive effects of the Vassal Weapons her slave curse seal was removed.!~

88890.description:
__Race:__ Elf
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

Ryuu Lion is a waitress at the Hostess of Fertility.

Ryuu was a member of a family that cared for the sacred tree in their home forest of Ryumilua. As time passed, she began to think that beautiful Elves were the ugliest of all people, due to seeing her fellow Elves' behavior toward those of other races. No matter how much she tried to forget it, once she began thinking about it, the thought firmly planted itself in her mind. Eventually, the thought became enough to make her decide to leave the forest.

Ryuu is calm and stoic but also cares deeply for her friends. When a person related to her or her friends are in danger or in need of help, she is always ready to step in and help no matter the cost. Like many Elves, Ryuu is selective with who may touch her. However, she has been advised by [Alise](https://anilist.co/character/288478) to not let go of a man that was able to grab her hands, and began to follow [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860) with her eyes. Unlike most Elves, she doesn't bear the same hatred towards the Crozzo family or their magic swords for their role in the destruction of the forests the Elves lived in, stating that the event took place many years ago and that her village wasn't directly affected. 

~!After arriving in Orario, Ryuu became an adventurer known as Gale, belonging to the Astraea Familia. She was caught in a trap set by Evilus and all of her fellow Familia members were murdered. Overcome with vengeance, she persuaded [Astraea](https://anilist.co/character/288476/Astraea) to leave Orario as she didn't want her to see her revenge. After that, she single-handedly destroyed the Rudra Familia as a part of her rampage and those associated with Evilus through various trickery, traps, and assassinations, causing her to be branded as a fugitive as a result of the ensuing chaos. Her revenge finally fulfilled, she collapsed in an alley where she nearly succumbed to her injuries. Fortunately, she was discovered by Syr and nursed back to health by [Mia Grand](https://anilist.co/character/122206/Grand-Mia). Ever since then, she has joined the Hostess of Fertility.!~

88892.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7")
__Quirk:__ Explosion

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Katsuki is a crude, arrogant, short-tempered, and aggressive person, especially at the beginning of the series. Due to the constant praise of his abilities and powerful Quirk, Katsuki has developed a superiority complex, and because of that, he desires to be the first and best at everything. He loves to win above all else and cannot stand it when he doesn't, leading him to lose his already short temper if he achieves anything but a complete victory.

Katsuki is not only very athletic and talented at fighting, but also very intelligent and extremely perceptive, capable of strategic planning and improvisation. Additionally, his grades are among the highest of his class. Katsuki also possesses surprising talent in other areas, such as cooking and music, even though he doesn't show a particular interest in them. Overall, Katsuki is considered a natural-born genius with the potential to be one of the best Pro Heroes.

Katsuki's Quirk "Explosion" allows him to secrete nitroglycerin-like sweat from the palms of his hands and ignite it on command, allowing him to create strong explosions. The more Katsuki sweats, the stronger his explosions become. Not only can Katsuki use the explosions for attacking, he can also use them to propel himself and navigate through the air at high speeds, allowing him to fly at his opponents without giving them time to react, as well as evade incoming attacks, even while in the air. The shockwave from an explosion can even be used as a shield.

name.native: リーリス・ブリストル

88893.description:
__Blaze:__ Rifle

A rich girl from Great Britain. She is an "Exception" that came to make Tooru, the "Irregular", her Duo partner. Lilith's hobbies include hunting and DNL (Deathnewland).

name.native: ユリエ・シグトゥーナ

88894.description:
__Blaze:__ Twin Blades

A quiet girl from a foreign country in Europe, as well as a princess. The reason she came to Japan and Kouryou Academy is because she wants to get stronger to avenge her father's death, and so she seeks out Tooru for help and to teach her his Final Move.

Julie says "Yes" and "No" in Swedish: "Ja/Nej". Her Surname is also a name of a Swedish town.

88895.description:
__Blaze:__ Shield

The male protagonist, a kind boy with an irregular Blaze. His Duo is Julie Sigtuna.

88897.description:
__Race:__ Pallum
__Height:__ 110 cm (3'7")

Liliruca Arde is a member of the Hestia Familia. Originally a member of the Soma Familia, she converted to the Hestia Familia after securing her freedom after the War Game. Lili was born to Hobbit parents belonging to the Soma Familia, making her a member of the Familia from birth. However, her parents didn't look after her and ordered her to earn money for them instead. A while later, her parents were killed in the dungeon, leaving her to fend for herself. The Soma Familia didn't take care of her and bullied her, making her lonely and isolated. To earn money, she tried to be an adventurer, but didn't have the talent, eventually switching to being a supporter. As a supporter, she was constantly looked down on by those she partied with, fueling the hatred of adventurers inside of her. After a while, Lili decided to run away from the Soma Familia and become a normal citizen. However, the Soma Familia found her and inflicted misery on the old couple who took care of her, destroying their store and stealing money. She began to hate Soma himself, wondering why he created a Familia if he wasn't going to take care of it. From that time on, Lili began using her hatred of adventurers as an excuse to trick and steal from them. 

She also treated Bell the same way, however, his actions repeatedly caused her to question her own attitude. After she is saved by Bell, she becomes much closer to him and develops romantic feelings for him. Lili often uses her experience to gather information or do jobs that Bell and the other members of the Hestia Familia would be unable to do properly. She is also frequently amazed at how Bell seems to constantly get himself involved in trouble, yet she still cooperates with him in whatever he does.

Lili is regarded as the "brains" of the Familia, being that she is the most capable when it comes to developing battle plans and strategies. She advised Bell and Welf to travel to the eighteenth floor when they were trapped in the dungeon, and she was crucial in forming the Hestia Familia's plan of attack for the War Game. Lili also possesses a strong insight, forged through her time as a thief, as she was able to pick up Finn Deimne's speech patterns, mannerisms, and character after only one meeting with him.

88901.description: A cat spirit who acts as [Yuuta's](https://anilist.co/character/88902/Yuuta-Iridatsu) guide to being a ghost. He enjoys drinking sake and seems to reside in room 203.

88902.description:
Resident of room 103 in Korai House, who becomes a ghost through a mysterious out of body experience. He tries to keep a cool facade, but he has a strong sense of justice, compassion, and naivete. When he sees a girl's underwear, he gets a strong nosebleed and loses consciousness. 

~!In episode 6, it is revealed that Yuuta is biologically female. His registered legal name is Yuu Iridatsu (伊里達 遊).!~

~!Yuuta, originally Pine, had a body-switching accident, which resulted in Yūta's soul taking over [Chiyoko's](https://anilist.co/character/88903) body. Consequently, Yuuta has a male soul but a female body. In spite of this, Yuuta considers himself male.!~

alternative: Strange Juice (ストレンジジュース)

88903.description:
Mikatan is very positive and happy, as well as caring for her friends. She lives in room 101 and is a member of the idol group "She's Mei." In her free time, she also is a masked hero of justice named "Strange Juice" who uses super strength and a giant straw to fight evil.
~! As a child she grew up in a research lab under the name Chiyoko, but in an accident her soul ended up in the body of her friend [Guriko.](https://anilist.co/character/232658) !~
~!She is currently, in the history where humanity lives on, in her original body (the body [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/88902/Yuuta-Iridatsu) was using) with black hair.!~

88904.description: A shut-in game junky who lives in room 102 of Korai House. She's enrolled at a prestigious girl's school but is not going to class, instead spending her time on FPS games.

88905.description:
__Occupation:__ Hacker

A genius inventor who loves her grandfather.

88906.description: A fake spirit medium with a gyaru fashion sense who lives in Room 202 of Korai House. Her family has been mediums for generations so she followed the same path but she actually doesn't believe in ghosts. She has a pet turtle and is a friend of [Yuuta's](https://anilist.co/character/88902/Yuuta-Iridatsu) sister.

88907.description:
__Race:__ Human  __Occupation:__ Superhero 
__Level:__ S-Class; Rank 7
__Affiliation:__ The Heroes Association

Despite not being the highest ranked hero of the Heroes Association, he is considered to be the most powerful man on Earth, and it is due to this strength that he receives praise and respect from fellow heroes. His strength is so feared that criminals and mysterious beings will surrender before having to fight him. Appearance: King has slightly long, blonde, brushed back hair along with three long scars on the left side of his face. He wears a turtleneck sweater, has sunken cheeks, a defined jawline and a squarish chin. Notably, a loud drumming sound may be heard in his proximity. The King Engine is a rumbling sound that others claim occurs when King readies for battle or when he is generally serious having an intimidating effect on his opponents. ~! In actuality, it is simply the sound of King's heartbeat which, when he is frightened, is so loud that it can be heard outside his body, but because of King's intimidating reputation people mistake it for bloodlust. King is able to appear to remain calm in threatening situations as well as put out an extremely threatening aura. Despite the intimidating personality King projects, he is actually a coward and an otaku. He has been shown to get very excited about buying a dating game. Saitama saved his life many times, but always end up getting all the credits that was supposed to be for the latter. With this misunderstanding, he came to be known as "the strongest man on earth". He got his scars from the Octopus Claw man. !~

88915.description:
__Height:__ 171 cm
__Instrument:__ Euphonium

A third-year high school student. She is the vice president of the brass band club, and also leads the bass section. Like Kumiko, she plays the euphonium. Her standoffish nature has brushed people off time and again. Her red-rimmed glasses are her trademark.

88916.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm
__Instrument:__ Trumpet

Yuuko is a nice, friendly and cheerful person who is also shown to have confidence, determination and a strong personality. She can openly and confidently show others what she is thinking through her actions, her facial expression, and her words.
However, Yuuko is also an emotional person as she can easily get annoyed or angered when something didn't go in the way she wants it to. Yuuko does acknowledges these flaws of her and tries to improve herself and gets over her own pride for the success of the band.
By nature, Yuuko will put great importance on the people she cares about that she will do anything she can to ensure their happiness and well-being. Sometimes, this leads her to make some mistakes but other times it elicits very noble actions from her. On the opposite, Yuuko behaves acerbically towards individuals she dislikes or someone she perceives as a threat to her cherished friends.

88917.description:
__Instrument:__ Trombone

Shuuichi is a first-year high school student. He is Kumiko's childhood friend, and the two went to the same junior high school. He and Kumiko are not classmates in high school because they are studying different courses. He was originally a French horn player, but he gets to play the trombone after winning a game of rock-paper-scissors.

88918.description:
__Height:__ 184cm

Taki is the new music teacher in Kitauji High School and serves as the adviser to the concert band club. He is also in charge of Class 5 of the second-year students. He is polite and has a methodical personality. He emphasizes independence in his students, and to this end he pushes them to reach their goal of going to the national competition.

88919.description:
__Instrument:__ Tenor Saxophone

She is a third-year student who quit the Kitauji brass band, having played the tenor saxophone since junior high school.

Aoi was Kumiko Oumae and Shuuichi Tsukamoto's childhood friend, two years older than them. They lived in the same neighborhood, and often played together, but grew apart as they got older.

88920.description: Kumiko's older sister. She is a college student and was a trombone player in a brass band. She taught Kumiko to use a mouthpiece when she was a child.

88921.description:
__Instrument__: Baritone Saxophone

A third-year high school student. She is the president of the brass band club, and also leads the saxophone section. She plays a baritone saxophone. She has a kind heart as she leads the Brass Band Club.

88922.description:
__Height:__ 166 cm
**Instrument:** Trumpet 

A third-year high school student. She leads the trumpet section and is the madonna of the Brass Band Club who everyone yearns for.

88923.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm
__Instrument:__ Euphonium

Natsuki is a reserved girl who is seen rarely talking, and she has an aloof and calm attitude. It is later revealed that the second-years are like this because of an event which occurred the year before [Kumiko Oumae](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko)'s first year at Kitauji.

However, Natsuki is normally friendly to everyone, and tends to be mature and calm in most situations. She is also understanding of situations and takes everything quite nicely.

88925.description:
__Instrument:__ Tuba

A second-year student who is a tall, calm, and taciturn youth. He is the assistant leader of the bass section of the band.

88927.description: Laala has a bright and cheerful personality, and is often seen bouncing off the walls. As her house is a restaurant, she has a habit of saying her informal catchphrase Capisce! (Kashikoma!) when taking requests. Laala has a very loud speaking voice which she is very conscious about; when she is singing, she tends to be very quiet due to this. It seems that she can only gain the courage to sing loudly when performing in PriPara.

88928.description: Sophy has apparently been working in the idol industry since she was very young. She is also very popular at her school, and admired by many of the students. When she eats a Red Flash (pickled plum), her personality - likewise with her appearance - changes. Her public personality is cool and on top of things, while her other personality (aka 'Fancy Mode') is extremely disoriented and directionless. It is also hinted that she has low blood pressure. While she is in her Fancy Mode, she says "Pshu~" a lot. In Fancy Mode, she is quite naive and oblivious to what's around her, but since forming her friendship with Laala and Mirei, she has been working on improving herself.

88929.description:
Mirei Minami is a 7th grader at Paprika Academy. 

When performing, Mirei has lemon yellow hair that is partly tied up to two buns at the top with blue and yellow ribbons. Normally she has short lemon yellow hair that looks the same as her performance hair minus the buns and ribbons. She has bright blue eyes.
She also tends to say "pri" at the end of her sentences.  She is smart and very good at puzzles. Because of this, she is captain of the displicinary committee at school.

88931.description: A 15-year old God Eater who joins the Far East branch the same day as the protagonist. He is an old-type and wields an assault gun formally used by [Tsubaki](https://anilist.co/character/44395/Amamiya-Tsubaki). He has a mother and younger sister, Nozomi, whom he cares for deeply.

88933.description: The main protagonist of the story and A New-type god eater recruited by the Far East Branch. He cares for his subordinates so much that he forgets to take care of himself during a battle with the aragami. He is willing to give himself up for other people's safety. He soon is brought into the 1st Unit and learns a lot from his superiors. Lenka was named by his sister, Iroha Utsugi, after a flower that blooms from the mud.

88934.description: The sub-leader of first unit. She is a top-rank shooter, and her god arc is a sniper (old-type; long range).

88939.description: Tooru is a manga artist who specializes in erotic comics. He is Masamune's childhood friend, both of them having shared the same dream of pursuing soccer as a career when they were young. He lives in the same apartment block as his teammates. Due to his past, when he was betrayed by friends he trusted, he has low self-confidence and often worries that Masamune might abandon him. He is also the most sensitive to others, being the first one to notice changes in the member's moods.

88940.description: Masamune works as a Host, and is responsible for introducing Hotaru to the world of "Survival Games". He, together with his childhood friend, Tooru, form an alliance called the "Toy ☆ Gun Gun Team". He is unaware of the fact that Hotaru is actually female. To repay the damages caused by Hotaru to the club at which he works at, he offers her the chance to become a member of his team. Because of his past, he has abandonment issues, which later cause him to kick Hotaru out of the team, fearing she will leave him like his former friends/teammates and mother did. However, after Hotaru helps him face his past through a one-on-one challenge, he lets her rejoin. After Hotaru rejoins the team he develops feelings for her, but struggles with them as he does not know that Hotaru is female. There was a moment in his past where, after being abandoned by his mother, he grew suicidal. Nagamasa introduced him to survival games to convince him to live on.

88941.description:
Hotaru is the Student Council President and is known for her brute strength, good reflexes, and a strong sense of Justice. She claims to not let "evil-doers" get away with their evil deeds and is often noted to enjoy picking fights for the sake of what's correct to the point where she beats up a bunch of students who were extorting money from a helpless student and desires for revenge on learning that her best friend, Kanae was supposedly conned by a Host. 

Although confrontational, she becomes very guilty and apologetic when she realizes that she was mistaken, as shown when she kneels and bows her head in apology after arguing with Masamune, despite there being several other people present. She is noted to have terrible accuracy with a gun and a bad habit of charging into the field without delay, but outstanding speed, stamina, and strength, which she uses to her advantage in close-quarters combat. She uses a Heckler & Koch G3 SAS High Cycle, a submachine gun, as her weapon from episode 4 onwards. She is often mistaken as a guy due to her appearance. She is next-door neighbors with Masamune.

88942.description:
A girl whose words were sealed away.

(Source: Official website)

88943.description: A boy who avoids talking about his true feelings.

88944.description:
An honors student in the cheerleading club who is concerned about love.

(Source: Offical website)

88945.description:
An ex-baseball club ace who spends his days sulking.

(Source: Official website)

88946.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Quinque:__ IXA (Koukaku), Narukami (Ukaku), Yukimura 1/3 (Koukaku) 

Kishou Arima is a famed Special Class Ghoul Investigator known as the CCG's Reaper. He is undefeated as a Ghoul Investigator and at some point was formerly partnered with [Take Hirako](https://anilist.co/character/136023/Hirako-Take).

His investigative skills and prowess in combat has led many investigators such as [Koutarou Amon](https://anilist.co/character/88407/Koutarou-Amon) to admire him.

__Tokyo Ghoul:Re__

~!He later passes down his Yukimura 1/3 (Koukaku) quinque to [Sasaki Haise](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Ken-Kaneki), a rank 1 investigator and mentor of Quinx squad.

Along with [Akira Mado](https://anilist.co/character/88838/Akira-Mado), he is the overseer of the Quinx squad and keeps a check on Sasaki Haise along with the Quinx members.!~

88950.description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5' 8½")
__Ability:__ ~!Looting: an ability that allows its user to take over another person for 5 seconds. However, it can also be used to take abilities from other ability-wielders if they are possessed.!~
__Affiliations:__ Hoshinoumi Academy student council

Yuu is a first-year student at Hoshinoumi Academy. He is rude and bad at studying. He usually behaves as if he were smart, but he is actually a chronic cheater. He says things which sound clever, and he is a narcissist. He has the ability to take over another person's body for five seconds.

88951.description:
__Height:__ 154.5 cm (5’ 1")
__Ability:__ Imperfect Invisibility
__Affiliations:__ Hoshinoumi Academy student council

Nao is a first-year student and also the student council president of Hoshinoumi Academy. She has the ability to make herself invisible to any one person of her choosing at a time. She is a huge fan of the band Zhiend. She hates people who use their power for no good.

88952.description:
A first-year student and member of the student council. He can move at such high speeds that he looks like he's teleporting. However, he's not totally able to control where he stops, so he has to wear protective gear under his school uniform to prevent injury.

~!Takajou lets his ability be plundered by Yuu for his plan to succeed. He no longer possesses his ability.!~

(Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

88953.description:
Yusa is a first-year student and the vocalist for the band How-Low-Hello. She is able to speak to the dead. She uncontrollably channels her dead older sister Misa, who occasionally possesses her. When this occurs, her appearance changes, such as her eye color turning from blue to red.

~!Misa lets Yuu plunder her abilities after hearing his plan from Nao. Before that she had written a letter to Yusa, after her ability is taken she reads it and starts crying knowing that she was with her and everyone the whole time. She no longer possesses any powers.!~

(Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

88955.description:
A middle-school student and [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/88950/Otosaka-Yuu)'s younger sister. She likes stars. She is also a huge fan of the Idol [Yusa Nishimori](https://anilist.co/character/88953/Kurobane-Yusa).
~!She awakens the ability to make everything around her collapse, but ultimately, this awakening leads to her death. In episode 6, during a lunch break at school, Ayumi is threatened with a box cutter by a jealous classmate; she begins to run, but is soon cornered. Instinctively, she uses her ability, which collapses both the roof above her and the floor below; killing her.!~ ~!In episode 10, she is saved by her brother Yuu who traveled back in time using their brother [Shunsuke](https://anilist.co/character/125388/Otosaka-Shunsuke)'s ability of time leap. Her ability was plundered by Yuu after he had time leaped backwards, so she no longer has the ability.!~

alternative: Heaven Sent Child of Molecular Gastronomy

88956.description:
Alice Nakiri is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student and [Erina Nakiri](https://anilist.co/character/75284/Nakiri-Erina)'s cousin, whose cooking style is specialized in Molecular Gastronomy. 

Unlike her cousin though, Alice is much more friendly and cheery. She even will talk to her rivals casually, sometimes merely to poke fun at them, something she inherited from her mother. She is also a modern girl, eager to talk about love and gossip, even with the incredibly socially dense Erina. She is also very cunning, able to manipulate Erina using reverse psychology to keep her at a local public pool despite the latter's initial disgust at the location. She is quite bossy with [Ryō](https://anilist.co/character/88972/Kurokiba-Ryou), usually ordering him to do nearly everything for her. She tends to overreact when she is unhappy, throwing fits or snapping back at people. However, most of these are temporary and she will quickly return to normal in a few minutes.

88972.description:
Ryou Kurokiba is a 92nd Toutsuki Generation Student and Alice Nakiri's aide.

Generally lazy and gloomy, Ryou's personality drastically shifts once he puts on his bandana, becoming aggressive, short-tempered, and brash. He grew up in a port town in Denmark, where he became the head chef of a pub due to his commanding personality and great skill. Due to his heritage, he is an expert in seafood and he can judge the quality of any and all seafood with only a glance. Mainly seen to be beside Alice Nakiri and has known her since childhood.

88973.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm
__Group:__ Plasmagica
__Position:__ Vocals and Bass

A girl from the Dog Tribe who is a total internet otaku and smartphone addict. She usually puts on a cool facade, but deep down, she is incredibly shy. Whenever a topic she’s passionate about comes up, she gets so excited that she starts talking a mile a minute. Online, however, she’s quite the barker. She has an aversion to "normies" (people with active social lives) and clothing store clerks.

88974.description:
__Height:__ 161 cm
__Group:__ Plasmagica
__Position:__ Vocals and Drums

A naturally eccentric, high-energy space-sheep girl who arrived from a distant galaxy on a research mission. Her musical sensibilities are truly cosmic—unrivaled among the group members. She has a habit of blurting out whatever crosses her mind, which occasionally lands her bandmates in trouble. 

Her signature verbal tic—ending her sentences with "pyuru"—is apparently a communication code from her home planet.

88975.description:
__Height:__ 159 cm
__Group:__ Plasmagica
__Position:__ Vocals and Guitar

A rabbit-girl who embodies the "beloved class president" archetype: an honor student who is both dependable and organized, as well as sociable and charming. She serves as the de facto leader of the band and enjoys the deep trust of her fellow members. However, she also possesses an ambitious streak—secretly, and without the other members' knowledge, she is aiming to make a solo debut. 

She practices the guitar without fail every single day and takes a very earnest approach to her music.

88976.description:
__Height:__ 154 cm
__Position:__ Vocals and Guitar

A cat girl who cherishes a heart-shaped guitar known as [Strawberry Heart](https://anilist.co/character/153391/Strawberry-Heart)—a legendary instrument rumored to possess extraordinary power. Her guitar talent was recognized by [Maple Arisugawa](https://anilist.co/character/153403/Maple-Arisugawa), leading to her recruitment as a member of Plasmagica. Through her band activities alongside [Chuchu](https://anilist.co/character/88975/Chuchu), [Retoree](https://anilist.co/character/88973/Retoree), and [Moa](https://anilist.co/character/88974/Moa), she continues to grow and mature.

88993.description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")
__Race:__ Human
__Section:__ Moon Demon Squad 
__Demon Weapon Series:__ Black Demon 
__Demon:__ Mahiru-no Yo

He is a Lieutenant Colonel of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and the commanding officer of the Vampire Extermination Unit, Moon Demon Company.

Guren would become a wise leader who values teamwork, co-operation and friends, and determined those were necessary to ensure the survival of the human race from demons and vampires. Sometimes pretending to be lazy, in truth, he really works hard. He keeps many secrets to himself, and has no difficulty lying about them. When enduring hardships in battle, he will focus on winning and take the most direct path to that.

88994.description: A nerdy and chubby girl in second year of high school. She's a fujoshi obsessed with BL and otome games. After spending a week without eating due to sadness after the death of her favourite character, she loses weight and becomes stunning, earning four suitors.

89005.description: Ayame is the Vice-President of the Student Council and daughter of a disgraced former Diet member who unsuccessfully fought against the public morality laws. Ayame secretly acts outside of school as the perverted terrorist Blue Snow (also known as Blue Tundra), wearing panties over her face, spreading semi-pornographic leaflets, and shouting dirty jokes in defiance of the Japanese moral authorities. After kidnapping [Tanukichi](https://anilist.co/character/89004/Okuma-Tanukichi), she decides to form the group SOX with him and expand her activities to include the school.

89006.description: Being the president of the Student Council and a daughter to her influential parents, whom are both responsible in enforcing the ever stricter public morality laws, Anna is a soft-spoken and innocent yet strong and determined girl whose role is to get rid any materials that are deemed obscene or lewd not just in the school, but also in the society as a whole.

89007.description: Hyouka Fuwa is an "aspiring" scientist when it comes to "body-melding" (sex). She wishes to unlock the secrets of "body-melding" and to do so she preforms studies such as watching flies mate, and constantly harassing the main protagonist with questions. Overall Hyouka is a restless yet calm character who will go through any trouble to reveal the secrets of "body-melding."

89014.description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10.5")

Yuuichi Jin is an S-Rank agent and also a member of Tamakoma Branch. He is one of the strongest members in Border. He also has a Black Trigger named Fujin. Jin's Side Effect is Foresight, allowing him to predict future events. His mentor Soichi Mogami lost his life making Jin's Fujin. 

With the help of engineers at Border, Jin was able to create a new type of trigger, Scorpion, which was adopted by many Border agents.

~! Jin is demoted to A-Rank after he offers his Black Trigger in exchange for Yuma's safety and guaranteed enlistment !~

89019.description: A high school girl who is beautiful and intelligent, but at home she is lazy, and surrounds herself in games, anime, and manga. Nobody knows what she's like at home except her brother [Taihei](https://anilist.co/character/89020/Doma-Taihei).

89020.description: A company employee who lives together with his younger sister Umaru. With his kind and methodical personality, he easily handles his job as well as taking care of all the housework for the two of them. He warmly watches over his carefree sister and scolds her as she spends her time lazying around.

name.native: 橘・シルフィンフォード

89021.description: [Umaru](https://anilist.co/character/89019/Doma-Umaru)'s classmate. She sees Umaru as her rival. Though she acts like a young lady from a good family, she is also a bit of an airhead.

89022.description: Umaru's classmate. She lives on the first floor of the same apartment as Umaru. She has a shy and gentle personality, but has a strong stomach.

89023.description: Umaru's classmate. Because of her reserved personality and eyes that always look like they're staring, she's often left out in class. She's actually just shy.

name.native: レオナルド・ウォッチ

89025.description: A kind and humble young photographer who came to Hellsalem's Lot to help his ailing sister. A mysterious entity gave him the "All-seeing Eyes of God," granting him a variety of ocular powers, at the cost of his sister's sight.

89028.description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5'5¼")
__Quirk:__ One For All

Student in Class 1-A at U.A High School.

Although he was born without a Quirk, Izuku's innate heroism and strong sense of justice manages to catch the attention of the legendary hero [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224). Izuku has since become All Might's closest pupil.

Izuku is a very timid, reserved, and polite boy. Although initially portrayed as insecure, tearful, and vulnerable, Izuku gradually matures into a more confident and braver person. His infectious leadership skills, combined with his passion and strategic abilities, have turned Izuku into a central figure of Class 1-A. He is caring and emotional, never hesitating to help or rescue someone in danger, even if he knows that he might not be strong or otherwise qualified enough to do it.

Izuku is extremely (and sometimes scarily) enthusiastic about topics related to heroes. His dream drives him to write down notes about everything he learns about heroes' Quirks and fighting capabilities. Thanks to this practice, Izuku has developed a great analytical mind and can form complex battle plans in a few seconds, factoring in the best ways he can utilize the Quirks of allies and enemies alike for his own advantage.

Izuku's Quirk "One For All" was transferred to him from All Might. His Quirk allows him to stockpile an enormous amount of raw power, allowing him to significantly enhance all of his physical abilities to various boundless levels. This results in unbelievable levels of strength, speed, stamina, agility, and durability. Izuku can focus the stockpiled power into a single body part, or spread it across his entire body evenly, though, focusing the power in a single part puts a greater strain on that part of his body.

name.native: ロゥリィ・マーキュリー

89029.description:
A demigoddess and an apostle of Emroy, the god of darkness, war, violence and death. She is widely known as Rory the Reaper due to her wielding of her halberd as a scythe, slaughtering those who offend Emroy, and those she views are worthy of being punished by death.

Her gothic lolita dress is an outfit for priestesses. In terms of age, she is the third-youngest Apostle of the Twelve Apostles.

(Source: Gate - Thus the JSDF Fought There! Wiki)

name.native: レレイ・ラ・レレーナ

89030.description:
Lelei is generally an emotionless girl, with her face constantly fixed in an expressionless look. She is usually calm and silent amongst her friends and would always speak in a collected way. She rarely raises her voice, even in dire situations.

However, there are cases where she displays her emotions, such as surprise and awe when she was saved by the JSDF when she was nearly stomped by a horse.

She is a student of Grand Master Cato El Altestan, having moved in with him to the outskirts of Coda village when she was nearly 10 years old.

name.native: テュカ・ルナ・マルソー

89032.description:
This beautiful elf girl is the only survivor from her village, which was destroyed by the dragon. She was very dedicated to her father, who died protecting her. Saved by Japanese soldiers, Tuka Luna lives among the refugees in their military camp.

~!Unable to cope with the loss of her father, she first acts as though he is staying at the base, insisting on two rooms and extra portions of meals. Her mental stability deteriorates over time and eventually, she latches onto Itami, calling him "father." In an effort to bring her to her senses, Itami brings Tuka along on the hunt for the Flame Dragon and forces her to aid in its defeat. Having avenged her father, she recovers — but refuses to stop calling Itami "father," claiming it had become a habit.

(Source: Gate - Thus the JSDF Fought There! Wiki)!~

89033.description:
A first-year high school student, he has the power to summon or seal Phantoms by drawing them in a sketchbook.

Haruhiko keeps a massive library in his house, and is knowledgeable on all kinds of subjects. This often comes in useful when dealing with Phantoms, but his teammates do not always enjoy listening to his trivia.

89034.description:
Mai is a second-year high school student at Hosea Academy and the leader of her Phantom-hunting team. Her ability is called "Spirit of the Five Elements", which requires her to  channel a specific element from parts of her body into her fists, using the classic Chinese elemental system.

She specializes in close combat and fights on the frontline, with Haruhiko backing her up.

89035.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
__Affiliations:__ Hosea Academy, Team E
__Occupation:__ First year High School Student. Ability Wielder, Phantom Hunter

Reina Izumi is a first-year high school student who transferred to Hosea Academy in April. She has a special ability, and because of this she later joins the Phantom-Hunter club with [Haruhiko Ichijou](https://anilist.co/character/89033/Haruhiko-Ichijou) as a member of Team E. She does not get along well with her parents until some events that happen later.

Reina has a special ability to consume and seal away phantoms, hence why she was given the nickname ‘The Phantom Eater.’ This ability also satisfies her hunger. However, if she doesn’t want to eat the phantom then she won’t. She notably doesn’t require an incantation to use her ability, unlike her other teammates in Team E. Other than her sealing ability, she also has the ability to heal through mouth contact. As a practitioner of Aikido, Reina knows basic self-defense where she can easily throw people taller than her (like Haruhiko).

89036.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")
__Affiliations:__ Hosea Academy, Team E
__Occupation:__ 1st-year High School Student, Ability Wielder, Phantom Hunter

Koito Minase is a 1st-year high school student who transferred to Hosea Academy in April. Initially, instead of joining a club or fighting the phantoms together with the others, she chose to fight them alone. This is due to the fact that she has shut herself off from other people because of an incident that happened during her childhood. After Team E helped her on various occasions, despite wishing to work on her own, she decides to join them as an official member of the club.

In order to fight, Koito has a special ability that she commands with her voice. By using an incantation, she can create bindings that can capture, immobilize, and even destroy phantoms if she so chooses to.

89039.description:
The daughter of the Emperor Molt Sol Augustus and his concubine, Countess Nell. She has two brothers, Zorzal El Caesar and Diabo El Caesar both of whom were candidates for the next Emperor. She is also the leader of Rose-Order of Knights.

~!Later she becomes a mediator between Japan and her empire, and gets strongly influenced by the otaku culture.!~

89047.description: Sakurako Kujou is the titular heroine of the series Beautiful Bones: Sakurako's investigation, alongside [Shoutarou Tatewaki](https://anilist.co/character/89048/Tatewaki-Shoutarou). She is a trained osteologist with a passionate interest in skeletons and bones, which she collects and displays in her home.

89054.description:
Miki Naoki is one of the main characters of the Gakkou Gurashi! series. She is a second year student of Megurigaoka High School. She eventually joins the School Life Club as the youngest member after being rescued during the members' outing to the mall.
