Miki is very polite and kind, as she uses the honorifics and calls her seniors "senpai". Though she is usually quiet, Miki is very caring and supportive, as she comforts her friends when they feel down, and gives them words of encouragement when they need it.

Miki has had many appearances with "The Stand," a book by Stephen King, which is a post-apocalyptic horror/fantasy novel.

~!At first, Miki hates the way Kurumi and Yuuri accept Yuki's illusions, but later comes to understand their reasons and warms up to Yuki. Later considering her as one of her closest, if not, best friend.!~

89055.description: Megumi Sakura is a Japanese teacher at Megurigaoka Private High School and the faculty adviser for the School Life Club. She is affectionately called "Megu-nee" by her students (rather than her preferred "Sakura-sensei"). Megumi is a kind, patient young woman, who cares more for her students than herself. She has a soft tone in her voice and generally a calm demeanor when around others. Despite being an adult, she is also very innocent and meek at times, as Yuki states that she doesn't have much of a presence.

89057.description:
In the anime, Taromaru is notably an intelligent and tolerant dog, putting up with anything Yuki puts him up to and being able to open doors and escape.
He is able to avoid infected citizens and escape to the safety of Kei and Miki, and is later found by Kurumi in the mall. He is taken in by the School Life Club members as their "mascot."

After upsetting Taromaru at the mall by yelling at him, Taromaru dislikes being around [Miki](https://anilist.co/character/89054/Miki-Naoki), preferring to be with the other girls instead. ~!Before dying, he is seen cuddling with Miki as an act of forgiveness.!~

~!After he becomes infected, he becomes volatile, barking and attacking Kurumi before being sealed inside a locked room. However, he is shown to have slight consciousness, as he protects Yuki from other zombies!~

In the manga, Taromaru is a Shiba Inu puppy that Yuki found while exploring. ~!he only appears for one chapter, as it turns out he later turned into a zombie, due to a zombie bite found by [Megu-nee](https://anilist.co/character/89055/Megumi-Sakura)!~

89058.description:
He transfers to Seidoukan Academy to investigate his sister's disappearance and to figure out what he is supposed to do (~!he later says that it is to protect Julis!~).
Ayato sports a friendly, polite, and helpful personality with a penchant for ending up in awkward situations. He is indiscriminate as to who he is being friendly to and is helpful to a fault, as well as being a bit naive. However, underneath the soft facade lies a person with an indomitable will who always tries to do the right thing, regardless of the potential trouble that he will get himself into.

89059.description: Kirin is the top-ranking student of Seidoukan Academy. She is a shy and quiet girl who becomes the academy's top student as a 13 year-old and has not lost to anyone until Ayato challenges her a second time. She does not have a personal lux but rather carries a katana (Senbakiri) around as a weapon which often makes her greatly marveled by others as she tops the former No. 1 spot just by using a katana.

89060.description: Saya is Ayato's childhood friend. She moved abroad six years ago due to her father's career. She seems to be an air-headed stoic who has trouble waking up in the morning and is directionally-challenged. She uses a 38th generation Lux grenade launcher Helnekrom but later switches to a type 41 Gleaming Form - twin particle guns Waidenholt and Type 34 wave Motion heavy artillery Ark Van Ders for the Phoenix. Like Kirin, she enters the Phoenix for her father's sake.

name.native: クローディア・エンフィールド

89061.description: Claudia is the second highest ranking student of Seidoukan Academy and its Student Council President. She recommended [Ayato](https://anilist.co/character/89058)'s transfer to the academy. She has held the position of President since junior high.

89065.description:
Itami is an otaku who loves to read doujinshi and online novels. Work is nothing more then something that provides an income source for his interest. Itami is a selfless person, he will help anyone who need help no matter if it's friend or enemy. He also cares about other people who he hasn't met before as seen when he immediately saved a japanese woman who was Zorzal's slave. Itami doesn't like the idea of slavery in Special Region. He can become friends with almost anyone no matter what their race is, and he doesn't seem to be bothered by that. Unlike other people in Special Region.

He is desctibed as a bland man, but there is something captivating about him as stated by Rory.

Itami gets along quite well with his ex-wife Risa, despite her occasionally begging him for money.

89067.description:
A disciplinary committee member dispatched to guard Anna from harm and obscenities, however her sense of what is obscene or not is wildly off mark. She has a completely blank personality and is described as a "robot" by Anna's mother.

~!Tsukimigusa is actually a cross-dressing man.!~

89071.description: Yukika Amami is a girl from Takeo's and Suna's childhood. She has a crush on Suna after he blocked a ball from hitting her during dodgeball in their childhood.

89072.description: A classmate of Ai. They are both in the same seminar group at Ousaki University in Nagoya.

89073.description: Suna's pretty older sister and a student at Ousaki University in Nagoya. Takeo mentions that she, like her brother, is a great and kindhearted person.

89074.description: A classmate of Takeo. She begins to call Takeo "shishou" (master or teacher) after he trains her for a sports day relay race at their school.

89076.description:
An associate professor of architecture at National Nagano University. He has gained the good will of Moe, but he doesn't particularly care about her. He is extremely intelligent, he has detached himself from the world, and he doesn't care at all about fashion. He loves coffee and cigarettes, but he hates watermelon, red beans, and soybean flower

He is the older brother of [Setsuko Gidou](https://anilist.co/character/180419/Setsuko-Gidou)

89077.description:
The daughter of Sōhei's mentor, and a first year student in the architecture department of National Nagano University. She is a beautiful young woman from a high-class family. She has excellent insight, powers of observation, and calculation skills, but sometimes her thoughts jump to extreme conclusions. She loves the sound of car engines and mystery novels. She hates dried shiitake mushrooms, but because she believes they are good for anemia, she enduringly eats them every day.

(Source: ANN)

89078.description:
A genius programmer who was accused of killing her parents when she was 14, but she was found innocent due to her psychological condition. She lives in isolation at a private research lab on a remote island.

~!Her true name is Michiru Magata and she is actually the daughter of the real Shiki Magata!~

name.native: レクティ・アイゼナッハ

89102.description:
Eye color: Emerald
Hair color: Blonde

Lecty is ambitious and sincere, but she lacks confidence in herself and also gets very nervous while facing people, a reason why her results in battle exams are failing. Despite having low self-esteem she doesn't neglect her training to improve herself. She also has a tendency to apologize for the smallest things.

Weapon & Abilities: 

Ama no Hibakiri (Dragonslayer) - A pair of blue twin swords with light blue glyps on them. She is a close combat warrior and is also very efficient in using them but because she gets nervous she can't fight properly.

(Source: Kuusen Madoushi Kouhosei no Kyoukan Wiki)

89103.description:
He is the guild master of Ainz Ooal Gown and regarded as the highest of the Almighty 41 Supreme Beings by the NPCs of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. He is also the creator of [Pandora's Actor](https://anilist.co/character/89154/Pandoras-Actor).

A cautious and stingy person, Momonga always tries to plan and control details, avoiding any haphazard actions. Because he doesn't underestimate his opponents, he will usually overkill them. Since being transferred to a new world and becoming an actual Undead being, Momonga could feel himself becoming very cold and calculating, his emotions repressed.

Loyal to his friends and creations, since becoming Lord ruler of Nazarick in the new world he acts with a certain degree of nobility for his devoted followers. Momonga only does things that will benefit Nazarick or himself, whether its information or prestige. Although he does have a sense of justice and doesn't hate humans as much as his followers, he holds no attachment to them, and he feels nothing toward their deaths.

~!His real name is Satoru Suzuki.!~

name.native: クラウス・V・ラインヘルツ

89106.description:
The leader of Libra and young head of the noble Reinherz family. A large, very powerful man with a distinctive underbite, he is actually very well composed and gentlemanly and honest to a fault, with an unshakable will. Master of the Brain Grid Blood Battle Style, which he can use to create large cross-shaped weaponry and seal away vampires. 

~!The sealing power he owns is to seal away vampires only under a certain condition: knowing the vampire's real name.!~

Klaus is also very intelligent, being able to play the game "Prosfair," the complexity of which is known to drive humans mad (Klaus himself begins to bleed internally after playing the game for 99 hours without a break) and is a game usually reserved only for one distinct species in Hellsalem's Lot that has studied it for a thousand years.

89112.description:
Shinjuku Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department investigator. Has a strong sense of justice and has a serious personality.

(Source: Famitsu.com)

89119.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'3")

A girl from the city whose father owns a world famous sweets company. Since she will one day inherit the company, she desires to make it the best sweets company in the world. She is often amazed by [Kokonotsu](https://anilist.co/character/89168/Shikada-Kokonotsu)'s uncanny ability to create and design the perfect sweets without even trying.

Hotaru came to the sweets shop to hire Kokonotsu's father who is actually very well-known. However when he refused, she found out he would not leave until Kokonotsu was guaranteed to take his place as head of the store. She was horrified when she discovered Kokonotsu's natural talent would go to waste so she struck a bargain with his father: if she could convince Kokonotsu to become the head of the store, then his father would immediately join her father's company.

89120.description:
__Race:__ God
__Age:__ Ancient
__Occupation:__ God of Fishing and Commerce

__Ebisu__ is one of the Seven Gods of Fortune. He is the humorless God of Fishing and Commerce.

Initially, Ebisu appears very stoic, always bearing a near-emotionless facial expression and speaking in a reserved, polite, yet aloof tone. He is also highly pragmatic and resourceful, constantly progressing towards his goals and willing to go to great lengths to achieve what he is after. Despite his aloof appearance and personality, he can actually be a silly person, making him appear rather comically serious at times. He is a kind god at heart.

~!Ebisu is later revealed to be attempting to gain control over phantoms; a severe taboo if not sin in the eyes of the heavensl.!~

name.native: シャルティア・ブラッドフォールン

89121.description:
The Guardian of the First, Second, and Third floors of Nazarick, she has the form of a beautiful vampire girl. She's also in love with [Momonga](https://anilist.co/character/89103). She and [Albedo](https://anilist.co/character/89122) constantly clash for his attention. While the two don't mind sharing Momonga, they still fight for superiority and who would ultimately appeal to Momonga. Shalltear is one of the most powerful guardians, allegedly capable of going toe-to-toe with Albedo.

~!Due to an incident where she is subjected to mind control by a member of the Black Scripture, she ends up unintentionally rebelling against Nazarick.!~

89130.description:
Described as a hotheaded, hyper-sexual juvenile punk, he is easily annoyed, quick to lose his temper, and his juvenile actions often get him and others into trouble.

Despite this, he is supposedly good at looking after new members, and so was assigned as Leo's partner/bodyguard. He is also something of a ladies man, possessing several lovers in town.

For reasons unknown, he continuously tries to fight Klaus, only to be routinely smacked down.

89143.description: A high schooler forcibly sent to Mermaid Island after contracting the A-Virus. Mamori is a gentle girl who abhors violence. This puts her at odds with her ability to transform into a deadly weapon as an Extar. She is frequently teased over her family name being written with the same Kanji as "Virgin".

89144.description: A child soldier that arrives at Mermaid Island on the same day as [Mamori](https://anilist.co/character/89143/Tokonome-Mamori). Quickly establishing herself as a powerful Liberator, Mirei can be mistaken as cruel due to her stunted social skills and intimidating appearance. In reality, she is kindhearted and stoic unless Mamori is being bullied or threatened.

89152.description:
One of the Pleiades, combat maids of the Tenth floor under [Sebas Tian](https://anilist.co/character/89155). She's a Doppelgänger and, because she's one of the most human-looking of the maids, she is [Momonga](https://anilist.co/character/89103)'s companion in his exploration of the new world disguised as adventurers. Narberal takes great pride in this duty, often "wearing" it like a badge of honor. However, like most in Nazarick, she holds great disdain towards humans. This proves troublesome, as she becomes incredibly violent when human males make advances on her. 

While operating as a member of the adventuring guild, "Darkness", Narberal operates under the alias of "Nabe", which becomes "Nabe, the Beautiful Lady" when Darkness becomes famous. Narberal's beauty has been compared to that of the "Golden Princess of Re-Estize" by many of the country's inhabitants.

89154.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm 
__Race:__ Doppelgänger
__Affiliation:__ Great Tomb of Nazarick
__Occupation:__ Area Guardian of the Treasury
__Creator:__ [Ainz Ooal Gown](https://anilist.co/character/89103/Momonga) (Momonga)
__Hobby:__ Managing Magic Items

The Area Guardian in charge of the Treasury and finances of Nazarick, who was created by Ains himself. He's a Doppelgänger whose face is a simple egghead with three holes dressed in a Neo-Nazi-esque uniform. In Momonga's original design, he's the combination of everything that he thought was cool, with exaggerated gestures and body language. His existence embarrasses Ains, but at the same time knows he's the NPC he can trust the most and the only one who can perform all his master's tasks without misunderstanding his intentions.

He's on the same level as the Floor Guardians, and can copy the appearance and skills of anyone he has seen.

89156.description: Bad (バッド, Baddo), also known by his hero alias Metal Bat (金属バット, Kinzoku Batto), is the S-Class Rank 15 professional hero for the Hero Association. Metal Bat is a young man with black hair styled in a pompadour, and dark eyes that emphasize his hot temper. Metal Bat has a great deal of confidence in himself, stating that he did not care whether a threat is a Demon or Dragon level. Like [Saitama](https://anilist.co/character/73935/Saitama), he doesn't care about his rank, and accidentally kills his enemies faster than he intended.

89157.description: Toujou Basara is an ex-member of the Hero-clan. He lives with his two step sisters who are both Demons. Basara is determined no matter what to protect [Naruse](https://anilist.co/character/89158/Naruse-Mio) from anyone wanting to cause harm to her.

89158.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

Mio is a beautiful young girl of average height, with long waist-length red hair and violet eyes. She is noted for having a distinctly voluptuous body for someone her age. Mio has been seen wearing a number of outfits throughout the series, with several casual attires at home that are usually form-fitting or revealing, as well as a uniform for attending school. After forming a contract with [Basara](https://anilist.co/character/89157/Toujou-Basara), Mio gains a choker-like tattoo around her throat which takes the appearance of a love heart with two prongs extending around either side of her neck.

Mio normally displays a calm demeanor, preferring to remain quiet when around others; however, she is prone to outbursts when faced with inappropriate situations such as finding erotic magazines underneath Basara's bed or being left at the mercy of [Maria](https://anilist.co/character/89160/Naruse-Maria)'s succubus curse. Despite this, she is also caring and affectionate, genuinely appreciate Basara's kind treatment and protection as well as feeling uncomfortable about having to deceive innocent people. Deep down she is afraid of her current situation and constantly being under threat, but when faced with danger she won't hesitate to face the challenge.

89159.description:
__Height:__ 163 cm

Yuki is a member of the Hero Clan who watches over Mio Naruse. She is also Basara's childhood friend.

89160.description:
Maria is Mio's sister and guardian.

She is a rather childish person and likes teasing people no matter how serious the situation is. Despite this, she can be dead serious as seen when she revealed her real identity to Basara.

89161.description:
A Hero and the sister of [Yuki Nonaka](https://anilist.co/character/89159/Nonaka-Yuki). She is also an Element Master.

Kurumi is a petite, young girl who is surprisingly developed for her age. She has blue violet hair held up in a ponytail by a white scrunchy and yellow eyes like her sister. Her battle outfit tightly wraps around her slim figure and is the typical attire for female Heroes which is a navy blue leotard with a black collar and a white skirt. Kurumi chooses to wear short tights underneath and her limbs are covered by her Spirit Armor with her Spirit Gauntlet on her left hand.

89163.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

Chisato Hasegawa is the school nurse of Hijirigasaka Academy and a magic user. Originally she is one of the Ten Gods from the divine realm. At first, she acts as Basara's mentor often providing him with advice. Eventually, they develop a romantic relationship.

89168.description: He is an aspiring mangaka, who also happens to be the son of a once famous confectionery maker who now runs a lowly candy shop which was also been owned by his family for generations. He is always being pestered by his father to take over the business, much to his annoyance. During his spare time he would hang-out at Edo Cafe and chat with his childhood friends, [Tou](https://anilist.co/character/89171/Endou-Tou) or [Saya](https://anilist.co/character/89170/Endou-Saya).

89169.description: [Kokonotsu](https://anilist.co/character/89168/Shikada-Kokonotsu)'s father as well as the current owner of Shikada store. He is desperate to make his son 9th head of the shop so that his legacy will continue. He agrees to [Hotaru](https://anilist.co/character/89119/Shidare-Hotaru)'s bargain that if she can convince his son to be the next head of his shop, he would become part of Hotaru's company.

89170.description:
[Kokonotsu](https://anilist.co/character/89168/Shikada-Kokonotsu)'s classmate who runs a nearby cafe. She has a crush on Kokonotsu. At first alarmed by [Hotaru](https://anilist.co/character/89119/Shidare-Hotaru)'s presence, she quickly befriends her for their goals are aligned: Hotaru wishes Kokonotsu to run the store while she wants him to keep staying in town.

Saya has a hidden talent of toy mastery. At one point she defeats well prepared Hotaru at a Menko game, an event that leads Hotaru to start addressing her with suffix shi, an antiquated designation used by disciples to their masters.

She is the younger twin sister of [Tou](https://anilist.co/character/89171/Endou-Tou).

89171.description: Older twin brother of [Saya](https://anilist.co/character/89170/Endou-Saya) and a good friend of [Kokonotsu](https://anilist.co/character/89168/Shikada-Kokonotsu). A laid back person who usually wears Hawaiian shirt and sunglasses. He and Saya run a cafe named "Cafe Endō".

89180.description: She is a member of the Seven Deadly Sins. She has the mark of the boars sin of gluttony. She was regarded as the greatest mage in Britannia and is the master of [Vivian](https://anilist.co/character/131564) as well as a teacher of [King Arthur of Camelot](https://anilist.co/character/122210). She came to the aid of the sins in their battle against [Hendirkson](https://anilist.co/character/86679) but had to leave to tend to the King. She has not officially rejoined the sins but said she would as soon as she was finished with her other business.

89181.description: **Relatives:** Akemi (Mother), Gorou (Father) Tomo is a high school student with a tomboyish personality, exceptional skills in combat sports, and an earnest desire to win the heart of her childhood friend Junichiro. Despite her athletic abilities, she is self-conscious about her masculine traits and seeks to become more feminine.

89182.description:
Junichirou Kubota is the deuteragonist of Tomo-chan wa Onnanoko!. He is Tomo's neighbor, childhood friend, fellow dojo pupil and high school classmate. He is handsome but unaware of Tomo's affections towards him. He regularly trains with Tomo's father's dojo and feels jealous when she gives attention to other guys.
He does not get along with Misuzu, having briefly dated her in middle school.

89183.description:
**Relatives:** Misaki (Mother) Misuzu Gundou is the tritagonist of Tomo-chan wa Onnanoko!. She is Tomo and Jun's childhood friend and classmate. She is cunning and sometimes sadistic, often teasing Jun. However, she is also protective of her friend and dislikes the idea of Tomo and Jun progressing their relationship.
Misuzu teases Jun and they briefly dated for 3 days, but broke up because she couldn't keep up with his wild adventures. She has stated that she hates him for breaking up with her before she could break up with him.

89196.description:
__Height:__ 186 cm (6'1")
__Ability:__ All Men Are Equal

The president of the Armed Detective Agency, who manages the hooligans. Although he doesn't often come out, at a critical moment, he triumphantly takes command. Because Yukichi is a man of dignity and status, it seems even the frivolous Ranpo will actually work if he orders it.

89197.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Ability:__ Beast Beneath the Moonlight

He came to Yokohama after being driven out of a poor orphanage that was attacked by a man-eating tiger. On the verge of starvation, he meets [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu) and gets a job helping at the detective agency. Because he's never had friends or family and was labeled as "useless," he lacks self-confidence.

89198.description:
**Height:** 181 cm (5'11")
**Ability:** No Longer Human

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. He's a suicide enthusiast who searches for a place to die. However, he doesn't like pain, and would prefer a lovers' suicide with a beautiful woman. He's aimless, elusive, nonchalant, and jokes around normally, but, when he is serious, it is clear that he is an insightful and intelligent individual. He loves to annoy his fellow Agency member, [Kunikida](https://anilist.co/character/89200).

~!He was a former Executive of the city's worst underworld organization, the Port Mafia.!~

alternative: Ability User of Destruction and Disaster

89199.description:
__Height:__ 172cm (5'8")
__Likes:__ Curios and antiques, tea, figs
__Dislikes:__ Bonsai trees, dogs, baths

"The weak will die. Die, and make way for others."
A member of the notorious "Port Mafia" that operates by the harbor. Akutagawa has a black and white "survival of the fittest" view of the world, claiming that weak people should die and give way to the stronger ones. His ability is called "Rashōmon" (羅生門).

He is not afraid of pain and defeat, if only to hear a word from a "certain person". His ruthless, vicious nature makes him one of the Port Mafia's most dangerous members, feared by both ally and foe. Much of the obedience he receives from subordinates of Black Lizard , and the Mafia in general, largely stems from fear of his short temper and general intolerance of incompetence. 

In chapter 87,
~!it is revealed that Akutagawa doesn't have much time left to live, as he is suffering from a vital lung disease.!~

In chapter 88 of the manga,
~!Akutagawa turns undead, being bitten by Bram Stoker after a fatal blow which results in his death.!~

(Source: Bungou Stray Doys Wiki, Anime News Network)

89200.description:
__Height:__ 189 cm (6'2")
__Ability:__ The Matchless Poet

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. He carries a notepad with the word "Ideal" written on the cover, and what is written inside are guides for life. He has a straight-laced personality and hates nothing more than schedules going awry. As a partner to the free-spirited [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu), his troubles never end.

89201.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")

The great detective of the Armed Detective Agency. He possesses sharp observation skills that are acknowledged by his coworkers, and he settles difficult cases at the request of the police. Because of his self-confidence, his speech is brazen and child-like. His motto is "If you'll have me, everything will be ok!" He likes logical thinking and fantastic tales.

89202.description: Your ordinary anime protagonist with a typical talent to save damsels in distress. His hobby is lurking in caves and digging mysterious crystals, which he later examines with his microscope. Never he would guess you can find a cute loli in a crystal!

89203.description: Felia loves cakes and having fun. And smiling. And goofing around. Oh, did I mention she comes from a magical crystal? She's got a speaking pet who turns into giant mecha.

name.native: カオン・ランチェスター

89204.description: Not only pretty, but also against marriage and kids? Introduced while running away from her fiancee, Kaon Lanchester is an ideal girlfriend candidate with clear hots for Amagi. She just doesn't realize it yet.

89205.description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'8.5")
__Ability:__ Light Snow

He is a member of the Armed Detective Agency and the older brother of [Naomi](https://anilist.co/character/89209/Tanizaki-Naomi).

89207.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")
__Ability:__ Undefeated by the Rain

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. Before he was scouted, he lived in a rural area without electricity. He knows no suspicion, and will be understanding and considerate no matter who he is talking to. He has a lot of friends who call him "Ken-chan." He likes music, tempura soba, and Mitsuya cider.

89208.description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5'5")
__Ability:__ Thou Shalt Not Die

A modern woman with a bob cut who's a member of the Armed Detective Agency. Although she's an excellent doctor who is indispensable to the Agency, all members of the the Agency are scared to be placed into her care. It's recommended that you don't use outdated misogynistic expressions in front of her.

89209.description: Naomi Tanizaki is a member of the Armed Detective Agency and the younger sister of Junichirou.

89210.description: He is a 91st Toutsuki Generation student of Toutsuki Culinary Academy and the current 9th Seat of the Elite Ten Council. He is known as the Alquimista aka "The Alchemist".

89220.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") 
__Affiliation:__ U.A. High School
__Quirk:__ Half-Cold Half-Hot

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School, where he got in through official recommendations. He is the youngest son of the top hero [Endeavor](https://anilist.co/character/126158).

Shouto initially has a cold, aloof personality, which stemmed from his complicated family life. Focused and unemotional, Shouto preferred to keep things to himself instead of hanging out with others. After the events of the U.A. Sports Festival, however, he notably became more sociable and kinder than ever before. He even gained a sense of humor and would occasionally smile, although still retaining some fragments of his previous distant attitude and nonchalant demeanor. While usually quiet and reserved, Shouto initially possessed a moderate level of arrogance, which, combined with his solitary tendencies, sometimes made him take the initiative without considering the opinions of others.

Shouto's Quirk Half-Cold Half-Hot gives him the ability to generate ice from the right side of his body, and flames from his left side. Due to years of rejecting his father, Shouto has developed a habit of favoring ice, even when fire would be a better option. This grudge also caused him to have difficulty controlling his flames. If he overuses one element without utilizing the other, then his own body temperature will suffer.

89221.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")
__Quirk:__ Zero Gravity

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School

Ochako is an outgoing, lively person who thinks about everything positively, though she is objective enough to see flaws and virtues. She gets excited over little things very easily. Ochaco has been described by other students as "the most laidback girl" among her class, being very bubbly and kind of an airhead at times. She is often incredibly blunt without being aware of it. She is on good terms with everyone and is particularly close friends with several class members, including [Izuku](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku), [Tenya Ida](https://anilist.co/character/89222/Iida-Tenya), and [Tsuyu](https://anilist.co/character/89223/Asui-Tsuyu).

Ochaco's Quirk gives her the power to manipulate gravity upon touching solid things with the pads on her fingertips. The targets lose their gravitational pull, effectively making them weightless. She is able to activate or cancel her Quirk's effects by closing her fingers together, and is shown to be careful with her hands in order to avoid accidental quirk activation.

alternative: Turbo Hero: Ingenium (ターボヒーロー・インゲニウム)

89222.description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")
__Quirk:__ Engine

Class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School

Tenya may look severe, but he's actually just a very serious person, who takes everything, even the most insignificant thing, seriously. A testament to his generally hyperactive and intense behavior, Tenya often exhibits plenty of peculiar tics, such as moving his arms around in strange chopping patterns or sometimes twitching his body uncontrollably. Tenya is very humble, willing to admit to his mistakes, apologize for rude behavior, and improve in areas he lacks. Being part of the highly-esteemed Ida Family of Heroes, Tenya is proud of his lineage and works hard to meet his expectations. He greatly admires his older brother, [Tensei](https://anilist.co/character/129757/Iida-Tensei) (also known as the Turbo Hero: Ingenium), and aspires to become a similar hero.

Tenya's Quirk Engine gives him car-like engines in each of his calves, giving him incredible running speed and extreme kicking power. Tenya needs to fuel his engines by drinking orange juice. Tenya's engines have multiple gears; it is currently unknown how many, but it has been implied that there are more than three.

alternative: Rainy Season Hero: Froppy (梅雨入りヒーローフロッピー)

89223.description:
__Affiliation:__ U.A. High School
__Quirk:__ Frog

Tsuyu is a very straight-forward girl that always says what's on her mind and what she thinks about others. She prefers to be called by her first name.

89224.description:
__Height:__ 220 cm (7'2")
__Quirk:__ One for All

All Might is the No. 1 Hero and the "Symbol of Peace."

In his hero form, All Might is a very tall and over-muscular man whose design resembles the american hero comics. His hair spikes on top of his head and his whole body has more shadows than a normal human being.

However, in his true form, he is an overly-skinny man who spits a lot of blood out of his mouth and his clothes appear loose.

89225.description:
__Height: __183 cm (6')
__Occupation:__ Pro Hero, Teacher
__Affiliation:__ U.A. High School
__Quirk:__ Erasure

Aizawa's hero name, Eraserhead, was coined by [Present Mic](https://anilist.co/character/127425) when they were younger. Using the binding cloth, Aizawa has a unique fighting style that allows him to immobilize his enemies. He is known to expel students that don't meet his standards, however it should be noted that he did not expel anyone from Class 1-A. Aizawa is extremely vocal, able to voice his opinions very easily. Although seeming emotionless and reserved, he has a soft spot for his students and genuinely cares for them.

89226.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9)
__Quirk:__ Decay

Leader of the League of Villains and protégé of [All For One](https://anilist.co/character/125956/All-For-One). He was raised by his master, All For One, with the goal of killing [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori), and ultimately destroying the society he represents.

Tomura is a very twisted, malevolent, and maliciously warped young man, who is considered to be the polar opposite of [Izuku Midoriya](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku). He doesn't care for his or almost anyone else's life, having no qualms about performing evil deeds like murdering innocent people. Tomura was initially perceived to be a "man-child": arrogant, selfish, dependent, and demanding, becoming angry if things didn't go his way and likening reality to some sort of video game. Unlike his mentor, Tomura lacked subtlety, preferring to eliminate problems through force. Much like a child, Tomura seemed unable to cope with his own feelings, instead lashing out and abusing both others or himself, tearing at his own neck when he becomes frustrated. 

Initially, Tomura seemingly caused destruction just for the sake of it and felt directionless about the League's path forward after [Stain](https://anilist.co/character/126067/Akaguro-Chizome)'s arrest. It would take a fateful meeting with Izuku in a mall for him to develop an epiphany and become aware of his true convictions: to crumble hero society through All Might's death.

Tomura's Quirk allows him to disintegrate whatever he touches with all five fingers. It will take effect whether the target is organic or not. The disintegration spreads quickly and will spread through the victim's whole body if they don't amputate the decaying body part. His Quirk can even spread beyond what he's touching, allowing him to disintegrate large groups of enemies instantly.

89227.description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (4'5")

Chika Amatori is one of the main protagonists of World Trigger. Chika is very shy, and rarely says much. She has very few friends, because she voluntarily distances herself from others. She believes that she'll just get hurt when those she gets close to get kidnapped by the Neighbors. She is really patient and serious and can concentrate very well, but she has low confidence and can't see her own potential. After meeting Yuuma and joining Tamakoma Branch, however, she starts warming up to others and becoming more sociable and confident on herself. She is a kind-hearted person and admits that she is terrified of hurting others.

89228.description: A strange girl with supernatural powers that suddenly comes into [Nitta](https://anilist.co/character/89229/Nitta-Yoshifumi)'s house in a strange box. She usually has a problem communicating properly with other people and rarely shows emotion.

89229.description: The main character, a yakuza member. His life changes dramatically after he met [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/89228/Hina).

89231.description: He was raised by his abusive uncle and aunt after his family were killed in a car crash. The abuse he endured resulted in him trying to commit suicide by throwing himself from a tower block, but he was saved by [Nasse](https://anilist.co/character/89232).

89232.description:
Nasse is [Mirai](https://anilist.co/character/89231/Kakehashi-Mirai)'s life saving's angel, and as such, knows everything Mirai has been through, everything which is related to him, notably his being being mentally abused by his aunt and uncle since they have been fostering him.

She saved Mirai's life as he jumped off a building, and gave him the possibility to be happy, by giving him Freedom, and Love.

89233.description:
A member of the Martian private security firm CGS. Calm and collected, with a head for the big picture, he's undyingly loyal to his friends. The most experienced mobile weapon operator in CGS, he is assigned to pilot the Gundam Barbatos.

(Source: Gundam.info)

name.native: クーデリア・藍那・バーンスタイン

89234.description: A young girl who agitates for Chryse's independence from Earth.

89235.description:
A leader among the boys of CGS. Naturally gifted as a commander, and trusted implicitly by the others, he strives to live up to their admiration. He's especially close to [Mikazuki](https://anilist.co/character/89233/Augus-Mikazuki), who he's known since a very young age; their bond is closer than most blood brothers. His coup within CGS is launched to give the boys a place where they won't be betrayed anymore.

(Source: Gundam.info)

name.native: ビスケット・グリフォン

89236.description: A boy who takes on the role of strategic advisor to [Orga](https://anilist.co/character/89235/Itsuka-Orga). Mild-mannered, his favorite hobby is reading. He enlists in CGS in order to support his grandmother and younger twin sister. Having attended school, he is literate—a rarity among the boys.

89237.description:
Atra is the cook for Tekkadan. She has a close relationship with [Kudelia Aina Bernstein](https://anilist.co/character/89234/Bernstein-Kudelia-Aina) and [Mikazuki Augus](https://anilist.co/character/89233/Augus-Mikazuki) whom she has a crush on.

~!In season 2 of Iron-Blooded Orphans, Mikazuki and Atra conceive a baby together!~

name.native: マクギリス・ファリド
ガエリオ・ボードウィン

alternative: Bonbatsu Hero Creati (万物ヒーロークリエイティ)

89241.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")
__Quirk:__ Creation

Vice class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School. She was admitted to the school through official recommendations. 

Momo is a very prudent, dedicated person who acts as a natural leader. She is generally level-headed and calm in dangerous situations, but she isn't above falling into a panic. Momo can be blunt with her comments about people's mistakes and miscalculations, tending to be very direct and wishing to help her peers improve enough to become great heroes. 

Momo's Quirk gives her the ability to create any non-living material/object from her exposed skin by transforming the molecular structure of her fat cells. In order to create something, she needs to understand the molecular structure of which the material/object is made.

alternative: Gouken Hero: Red Riot (剛健ヒーロー 烈怒頼雄斗)

89243.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Quirk:__ Hardening

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Eijiro is a boisterous and outgoing guy with a fondness for manliness, often using the terms "manly" and "unmanly" to describe things and people he does or doesn't like, respectively. Eijiro is very honest and kind-hearted, having a straightforward way of thinking and following a specific code of chivalry that motivates him to live without regret. He is determined and selfless, bravely putting the safety of others before himself. He is also a big fan of Crimson Riot, a retro hero from whom he takes inspiration, including personal values and his hero name. Although Eijiro may not be as hot-blooded and competitive as [Katsuki Bakugou](https://anilist.co/character/88892), he does not shy away from comparing himself to him, with [Izuku](https://anilist.co/character/89028) stating that the two have managed to develop a relationship between equals. As a result, Eijiro is notably one of the few people that Katsuki holds in higher esteem.

Eijiro's Quirk gives him the power to harden and sharpen any or all parts of his body, causing his flesh to become jagged and rock-like. There is a limit to how much damage his hardened body can withstand, which causes the Hardening itself to slowly dissipate, and Eijiro to lose stamina from struggling to keep his Quirk active.

89244.description:
__Height:__ 108 cm (3' 6½")
__Quirk:__ Pop Off
__Affiliation:__ U.A. High School
__Fighting Style:__ Medium Ranged Support

Minoru Mineta, also known as the Fresh-Picked Hero: Grape Juice, is a student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School, training to become a Pro Hero.

name.native: マルヴィナ・アニアンス

89247.description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'3")
__Quirk:__ Acid

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Mina is a cheerful and easygoing girl who usually displays a smile. Highly social and excitable, she loves to hang out with her friends and is shown to become very upset when denied an opportunity to be at a gathering. She possesses a strong fashion sense and likes to go shopping. Due to her athleticism and energy, Mina enjoys and is very skilled at dancing. Mina is extremely courageous and is viewed as an ideal personality for hero work.

Mina's Quirk Acid allows her to produce a corrosive liquid from her body. She can control the solubility and viscosity of this corrosive liquid. There is a limit to how long she can produce the corrosive liquid until her skin gradually loses its natural resistance to it. Overusing her Quirk or pushing it too far can also be fatal, as it dehydrates her body very fast. Mina can use her acid offensively, but has shown utility with it as well, such as melting handholds for herself to climb with. She is also known to secrete a non-corrosive version of the acid from her feet in order to slide around.

alternative: Stun Gun Hero: Chargezuma (スタンガンヒーロー・チャージズマ)

89249.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")
__Quirk:__ Electrification

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Denki is a friendly, social, and energetic boy who enjoys hanging out with others. He is rather casual when interacting with other people, including the generally unfriendly [Katsuki Bakugou](https://anilist.co/character/88892/Bakugou-Katsuki). 

Denki's Quirk Electrification allows him to store and discharge electricity. While he can also discharge this energy over a distance, Denki has little to no control over it, meaning it will go everywhere indiscriminately. Denki is also able to absorb and neutralize electricity and other lightning-based Quirks. Whenever Denki exceeds his wattage limit, he loses his ability to discharge energy, with his entire personality changing into that of a giggling idiot for a certain period until he reverts to normal. In this state, he is always giving thumbs-ups as a way to let others know that he is okay.

89263.description:
__Race:__ Alien
__Height:__ 240 cm (7'10½")
__Occupation__: Space Pirate
__Disaster Level:__ Dragon (or higher)

Boros was the leader of the Dark Matter Thieves, a group of alien invaders responsible for the destruction of A-City. Like Saitama, Boros faced a self-imposed existential crisis, having become so powerful that no battle thrilled him.

~!Boros was the first on-screen opponent of Saitama that survived after getting punched, much to the hero's surprise. In fact, he is the very first of Saitama's opponents that took more than one punch to kill; Saitama even considered him to be the strongest opponent he had faced so far.!~

89265.description: Mari is a tsundere girl who loves her best friend Anna and truly hates men. But above all, she hates Natsuki, who tries to steal Anna from her and Tomoya, who for some reason seems to be interested in Mari.

89266.description: Anna is a polite girl who's good at studies and who lives at her own pace. That is, until she meets Natsuki and finds herself spending more and more time with him. She's usually accompanied by her best friend Mari.

89271.description: A lonely high schooler and student of [Kohei](https://anilist.co/character/89273/Inuzuka-Kohei) who gives Kohei the address to her mother's restaurant and ends up asking him to make meals and eat them with her (along with [Tsumugi](https://anilist.co/character/89272/Inuzuka-Tsumugi)). She is a shy, lonely girl whose mother is a good cook but is so busy she rarely has time for her daughter. Her parents divorced when she was in third grade. She is kind and gets along well with Tsumugi. She is a bad cook, partially because of having a large fear of knives. She has a large appetite.

89272.description: Kohei's adorable daughter who attends kindergarten. Though energetic, she is well-behaved and loves her father dearly. She always thinks of him and begins to truly enjoy eating when her father and Kotori start making meals together. She has large fluffy hair and is a fan of magical girls. She likes meat, particularly hamburger steak, and doesn't like green peppers.

89273.description: The single father of Tsumugi. His wife died of unknown illness and he is currently doing his best to take care of his daughter. He is a math teacher at Kotori's school. He currently works hard with Kotori to become a good cook to make his daughter happy. The three often hang out at Kotori's place and eat meals together. He is a bit plain and wears glasses, but is a very kind hearted and hard working person whose daughter is his life.

89275.description:
A struggling manga author with a supernatural power that enables, or rather, forces him to prevent deaths and catastrophes that happen near him by sending him back in time when an accident occurs, repeating the scene until the accident is prevented.

~!He falls into a coma for 15 years after he was nearly murdered by Yashiro!~

89276.description: A 10-year-old girl and the first victim of the serial killer/kidnapper. She went missing on the 2nd of March 1988. Her body was found a few days later once the snow had thawed.

89277.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'9")

Garou is a former disciple of [Bang](https://anilist.co/character/81141), but was kicked out from his dojo for going on a rampage. He's one of the strongest characters in the series and plays a major role as the main villain in the Hero Hunt arc.

Garou is introduced as an evil character with a hatred for heroes and a confident, vindictive personality. He hates being insulted and will attack or kill any who offend him. He thinks highly of himself and uses that assertion to threaten high ranking personal such as heroes and [Shicchi](https://anilist.co/character/137876/Sitch). He does not consider other human villains to be allies, wiping out a large group of them along with the heroes present. He will also attack low ranked hero and hero staff members if he encounters them. A large aspect of his personality seems to be some sort of disdain for his former master, Bang, enough to avoid using the Water Stream Rock Smashing Fist he was taught unless seriously cornered.

He has no remorse even for people who aid him, as he smashed [Licenseless Rider](https://anilist.co/character/81935)'s face soon after the latter defended him.

Although Garou is an evil character, he possesses some kind of morality: he lets heroes live so that they can grow stronger and fight him again.

In some ways, Garou can be considered the opposite to [Saitama](https://anilist.co/character/73935). Where Saitama wanted to be a hero who fought villains from his childhood, Garou wanted to be a monster who defeated heroes. While Garou is a genius fighter, Saitama had to work extremely hard to get his strength.

89278.description: A female soldier and member of the Third Recon Team. She is a veteran and has a badge for hand-to-hand combat.

89279.description: The fifth brother. He is described as being very cheerful, but equally stupid.

89280.description:
Ichimatsu is the "lone wolf" of the Matsuno brothers. He has an affinity with cats and prefers to spend time with them rather than with people. For this reason, his brothers consider him to be antisocial, but in reality, Ichimatsu has difficulty expressing himself. Of the six brothers, the one he gets along with best is [Jyuushimatsu](https://anilist.co/character/89279/Matsuno-Jyushimatsu), with whom he has a close relationship. We often see them together, helping each other.

He feels contempt towards Karamatsu, which he finds painful and false with the airs that he takes, ~!but it is only jealousy, he would like to be like him, able to express these feelings.!~

89281.description: The sixth and youngest brother of the Matsuno household. Enjoys being spoiled and makes a living off of it too. He is loved by everyone.

89282.description: The third brother. Since he is the only one among the sextuplets with common sense he often plays the tsukkomi role, but that doesn't prevent him from joining in on his brothers oddities now and then. He really likes cute girls.

89283.description: The second brother. Likes to play tough and cool, but so far he really isn't doing a good job. Is ignored by his brothers most of the time, so even the slightest compliments make him happy. Is the kindest of the six and will do anything for his family, incapable of saying "no" when asked for help. [Chibita](https://anilist.co/character/89285/Chibita) is his only friend, and, just like all of his brothers, is in love with [Totoko](https://anilist.co/character/89289/Yowai-Totoko). There is times when he gets serious and angry, but these moments are rare, only happening when the situation truly calls for it. He loves wearing sparkly pants, jackets, sunglasses and even his own merchandise sometimes, his fashion is often ridiculed by his brothers, but some of them secretly thinks it's cool and want to try to wear it.

89294.description: The story's protagonist. His sense of pain and his own feelings are dulled. His moods barely fluctuate, and he pays little attention to other people.

89295.description: A mysterious and beautiful girl who experienced kizuna (connection) with [Katsuhira](https://anilist.co/character/89294/Agata-Katsuhira) and the others, and assigns them missions. She is even more emotionless than Katsuhira, and feels no human kindness.

89301.description: Kuraha is a current Regalia to Bishamon. His regalia form is a male lion with a scar on his right eye.

89304.description:
Tsuguha is one of Bishamon's Ten Shinki. She transforms into Bishamon's bikini battle attire. Her vessel name is Shouki.
~!She becomes an ayakashi and is killed by Kazuma after finding out her birth name.!~

89305.description:
__Blaze:__ Lance

A shy, kind, and caring girl who is often panicking. Because she came from an all-girls school, she is very bad with the opposite sex (except for old men with a gentle atmosphere). Tomoe is the one who keeps supporting her when she wants to get stronger.

89306.description: A very human-like android made by the wife of the developer of the coil technology. After Yurizaki Shidou, the man she called father, disappeared she starts to work with Mabuchi Kyouma to recover illegal coils.

89307.description: A man who lives in the ruins and has a passion for 'vintage' gas-powered cars. He hates coils, and works as a recovery man to hunt down any misused coils.

89312.description:
__Blaze:__ Kusarigama 

A smart, mature, and talented student who knows a lot about martial arts. She has a dignified atmosphere about her, and cannot tolerate laziness.

Tomoe always cares for Miyabi who's bad at interacting with men. She also often advises her friends to eat vegetables for a balanced diet and to regain stamina and power.

Her blaze is a modified kusarigama with one end a sickle and the other end having a sharp dagger like point. The chain is made up of individual shards that are not connected, but acts as if they are.

89313.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 170 cm, 172 cm (Volume 8)
__Class:__ Thief

The main viewpoint character and Thief of the group. Haruhiro is the most well-rounded character of the series as he is neither arrogant in his nature nor humble. He is generally helpful and always willing to help out his party members.

~!He is later forced to become the group's leader after [Manato](https://anilist.co/character/89317/Manato)'s death. Eventually,​ he starts to pay more attention to his teammates' feelings, slowly improving as a leader.!~

89314.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 159 cm
__Class:__ Hunter

Brave and energetic, Yume is the Hunter of the group. She also has a tendency to try and protect [Shihoru](https://anilist.co/character/89316/Shihoru) because of her shy and timid nature. She has a good friendship with [Haruhiro](https://anilist.co/character/89313/Haruhiro) and they seem to get along well.

89315.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 168 cm, 170 cm (Volume 11)
__Class:__ Dark Knight

The Dark Knight of the group. He is brash, impulsive, and somewhat perverted, which leads him to constantly arguing with [Haruhiro](https://anilist.co/character/89313/Haruhiro). Ranta is the troublemaker of the group constantly causing problems and making rash decisions for he has a slight hint of arrogance in his character.

89316.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ Unknown
__Class:__ Mage

The Mage of the group. She is shy, only opening up to [Yume](https://anilist.co/character/89314/Yume) and [Manato](https://anilist.co/character/89317/Manato) which led to a one-sided crush on him. Yume is constantly trying to get her to interact more with the group.

~!Shihoru becomes completely heart broken because of Manato's death!~

89317.description:
__Class:__ Priest

Manato chose to become a Priest and ultimately assumed the role of the group's initial leader. He saw the positives in people and with that he was able to effectively strategize battle plans when the group began hunting goblins for the first time. As they progressed as a team, they began mapping out abandoned towns while hunting bigger goblin parties. ~!However, while resting the group was ambushed by more goblins than they were accustomed to. Effectively moving his party to retreat, a goblin archer was able to successfully hit Manato square in the back as they ran away successfully. He died soon after.

In a conversation after his death, Haruhiro mentioned that aside from missing his leadership and strategist plans, [Manato](https://anilist.co/character/89317/Manato) was also a defensive tank like [Moguzo](https://anilist.co/character/89318/Moguzo) and a front line attacker like [Ranta](https://anilist.co/character/89315/Ranta).!~

89321.description: [Haruhiro](https://anilist.co/character/89313/Haruhiro)'s Thief master. Barbara has short brown hair and wears glasses. She wears an outfit that has a brown band around her breasts and green shorts, and is outfitted with belts around her waist and legs to hold knives.

name.native: アルベルト・シューマン

89326.description: Sachiko is Satoru's mother and former news announcer. She possesses a sharp eye and is quick to observe any irregularities. She knows about the cold cases of serial kidnapping in her town but decided to keep quiet and ignore it due to her child's growth and safety.

89334.description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10.5")

[Mob's](https://anilist.co/character/89616) mentor and boss in the Mob Psycho 100 series. He owns a business exorcising ghosts and is a self-proclaimed psychic. 

He is Mob's moral compass. He was the first person to ever consider Mob as normal and his teachings have never failed Mob.

89335.description: [Shouko](https://anilist.co/character/80243/Nishimiya-Shouko)'s younger sister who is currently a middle school student. She cut her hair short so their [mother](https://anilist.co/character/124037/Nishimiya-Yaeko) would not cut Shouko's and has kept it that way ever since; due to this, she is often mistaken for a boy, with [Ishida](https://anilist.co/character/80491/Ishida-Shouya) even thinking that she is Shouko's boyfriend at first.

89340.description:
**Ranking:** A-Rank

Ikki Kurogane's younger sister. Unlike her older brother, she was well-respected as a child and was even forgiven due to her talent as a Blazer and was the only person in their family who didn't despise or look down on Ikki for being an F-Rank Blazer and was saddened after he left.

89342.description: An art thief who announces his thefts publicly. He is named so because his thefts were supposedly never successful.

89343.description:
An ex-convict, recently released from prison, who seeks out apprenticeship under the legendary Eighth Generation [Yakumo Yuurakutei](https://anilist.co/character/89345/) after witnessing his rakugo performance. He is taken in as Yakumo's first ever student, and is given the name Yotarou (rakugo slang for "fool").

~!After ten years of training under Yakumo, he is promoted the rank of shin'uchi. To celebrate, he shaves his head and takes on the title of the Third Generation Sukeroku Yuurakutei.!~

89345.description:
A legendary rakugo performer who is haunted by his past. He refused to take in any apprentices until he met [Yotarou](https://anilist.co/character/89343/Yotarou).

As a child, Bon had originally trained as a dancer until damage to his leg left him unable to dance. Bon's mother, a geisha, sent him to train as a rakugo performer under the Seventh Generation [Yakumo Yuurakutei](https://anilist.co/character/369125/Yuurakutei-Yakumo) alongside [Shin](https://anilist.co/character/89346/Yuurakutei-Sukeroku), a boy who shows up unexpectedly and is accepted on a whim. While he proved to be adept at the basics of rakugo, and possessed impressive potential to memorize stories, his performances were stiff and lacked emotion and passion. Shin, with his impressive love for rakugo, quickly overtook him. As an apprentice, he was given the name "Kikuhiko." In an attempt to find his own style, Kikuhiko began performing 'bawdy and erotic' stories and discovered his strong ability to personify feminine characters.

89346.description:
Shin was the [Eighth Generation Yakumo's](https://anilist.co/character/89345/Yuurakutei-Yakumo) lifelong friend and partner growing up, and [Konatsu's](https://anilist.co/character/89707/Konatsu) father. Apprenticed under [Yakumo Yuurakutei](https://anilist.co/character/369125/Yuurakutei-Yakumo) alongside Bon, he was originally given the name "Hatsutarou," but rejected it to instead perform under the name "Sukeroku." As a shin'uchi, his unique and passionate style of performing quickly earns him a name and reputation in the rakugo community, but also strikes a nerve with the traditionalist members of the rakugo association.

Sukeroku and Kikuhiko made a promise with each other to ensure rakugo's survival as an art form together—Sukeroku would practice rakugo that changed to appeal to the public and Kikuhiko would practice rakugo that never changed and stayed true to its roots. This promise would go unfulfilled when Sukeroku died a tragic death at a young age, but his impact on rakugo as an art never faded.

~!As a penniless abandoned child, Shin found himself drawn to a rakugo street performer named Sukeroku, who trained him—making Shin the Second Generation Sukeroku. In his prime, the First Generation Sukeroku was apprenticed alongside the Seventh Generation Yakumo, who sabotaged him and caused his downfall.

When Sukeroku was forced to leave the Yuurakutei household due to both his callous disregard for higher-ranked rakugo performers and Yakumo's own insecurities, he eloped with [Miyokichi](https://anilist.co/character/89577/Miyokichi), with whom he fathered Konatsu. Sukeroku and Miyokichi both died in the titular lovers' suicide.!~

89347.description:
**Height:** 152 cm (5'0")

She is the commanding officer of Harekaze. She has a cheerful, positive personality and is an optimist who believes that "shipmates are family"; no matter what difficulties arise, she maintains the attitude that "things will work out."

She possesses incredible luck—winning the top prize in a lottery on her first try, never drawing anything less than "Daikichi" (Excellent Luck) on a fortune slip, and cracking open eggs with double yolks on more than five occasions. She applied to the maritime school in Yokosuka to fulfill the dream of becoming a "Blue Mermaid" that she had shared with her childhood friend since they were young.

Her extraordinary luck extended to the entrance exam, where the topics she "happened" to study were the ones that appeared on the test. She successfully passed the exam for the Navigation Department (as evidenced by the official site, the insignia on her uniform's right shoulder, the specialization emblem in the manga version, and scenes of the practical exam) and became the captain of the *Kagerō*-class ocean-going training vessel *Harekaze*. She memorized the names of all 31 crew members and two animal mascots, addressing them as "—chan" (or "—san" in some cases).

89360.description:
Hiromi is one of Satoru's primary school classmates. 
~!He was one of the original victims in the serial kidnapping case.!~

89361.description:
Megumin is an archmage and the self-proclaimed top genius of the Crimson Demons, an order of magicians who are born with high intelligence and magical powers.

Despite being an archwizard, she can only use the high level skill 'Explosion', the strongest of all offensive magic, and only once a day as it consumes tremendous magical power. Due to this she is more often a liability than an asset.

Megumin speaks and dresses as a Chuunibyou and her only desire is to unleash explosion magic in the face of her enemies.

89362.description:
Aqua is a goddess of water. She guides humans who die young to the afterlife.

Due to her cocky attitude towards [Kazuma](https://anilist.co/character/89364), she ends up being dragged to another world with him to defeat the Demon King.

Aqua chose the advanced job of archpriest, as being a goddess she's naturally a strong wielder of healing magic. However, she spends most of her skillpoints on party trick skills.

89363.description:
A crusader and a masochist.

Despite being an advanced knight, she is extremely clumsy and none of her attacks ever hit their mark. However, she has great endurance and stamina and acts as the frontline of the party. She often throws herself in front of enemies to "shield" her party, but in reality it's just her masochism.

89364.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

A hikikomori (shut-in), otaku and NEET, Kazuma arrives in the afterlife after a traffic accident and decides to go to another world to defeat the Demon King, taking [Aqua](https://anilist.co/character/89362) with him.

He has the weakest job of 'Adventurer', but has decent intelligence and extraordinarily high luck. This is demonstrated whenever he uses his 'steal' skill.

89365.description:
Gaku is Satoru's homeroom teacher during primary school.

~!In the original timeline, Yashiro successfully murdered two children at Mikoto Elementary School—Kayo Hinazuki and Hiromi Sugita—as well as another student from Izumi Primary named Aya Nakanishi. After being a school teacher, he inherited his father-in-law's constituency and became a council member in his place. During his time as a council member, he is seen by Sachiko Fujinuma during his attempt to abduct another child. After Sachiko remembers his identity, she is immediately murdered and her son, Satoru, is framed for the murder.!~

~!
In the third Revival, while Satoru is unaware of Yashiro's true identity as the murderer, he completely renders Yashiro's plans useless. Yashiro attempts to murder Satoru by drowning him in a car in which he is locked in tight by a seatbelt. Satoru somehow survives, and Yashiro is left entertained about Satoru's persistence. Satoru goes into a coma for 15 years, and Yashiro watches over him until he wakes up again. Upon Satoru's awakening, Yashiro again tries to frame Satoru for murder, only to be caught by a plan formulated by Satoru.!~

89367.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm
__Species:__ Hedgehog
__Group:__ ShinganCrimsonZ
__Position:__ Vocals and Guitar

Fearless and utterly convinced—without a shred of doubt—that he is "the coolest and most popular guy in the world." His signature style features a raw yet razor-sharp vocal delivery that sends shivers down the spines of listeners. He hails from a dairy farming family and absolutely loves milk.

89371.description:
__Height:__ 186 cm
__Group:__ ShinganCrimsonZ
__Position:__ Drums

The band's leader, he possesses a fiery personality—one where his fists tend to fly before his words—and serves as the driving force that holds the members together.
He successfully balances his career as a company employee with his band activities.

89392.description: Ryousuke Kominato is a third year student at Seidou High School and the older brother of Haruichi Kominato. He was the second baseman of the first string.

89401.description: Makoto is a witch in training. She is a gentle person who likes doing things at her own pace. She has a poor sense of direction and will get lost rather easily. Her goal is to become a full-fledged witch, thus she transfers to the high school in Aomori. She is currently a freeloader living with the Kuramoto family.

89402.description: Kei's little sister and Makoto's cousin. Originally wary of Makoto and thought of her as strange when they first met, she quickly came to like her after Makoto took her flying on a broom. She is fascinated with magic and eagerly watches Makoto when she does something that involves witchcraft or something supernatural. She also enjoys sweets.

89403.description: He is Chinatsu's older brother and Makoto's cousin/classmate. He is good at cooking and doing housework which is not typical of boys his age. He does not do well when the topic of ghosts are brought up. He is often described as a girly boy.

89414.description:
A first year at Seidou High School and Eijun's classmate. Kanemaru lived in the dorms with Chris as his roommate. A very confident first-year and considered the leader of first years.

At first, he disliked Eijun because Kanemaru thought Eijun could only talk big, but he came to acknowledge him as an integral player in the first string.

89424.description:
__Class:__ Priest

~!Joining shortly after [Manato](https://anilist.co/character/89317/Manato)'s death, Mary effectively replaces him as the Priest of the party. Initially, there is a lot of friction between Mary and the rest of the team. She was actually a lot like Manato, but after a tragic incident that led to the death of some of her friends, she became cold and aloof. However, after [Haruhiro](https://anilist.co/character/89313/Haruhiro) tells her about their own situation, she slowly opens to her new party.!~

89425.description:
A 27-year old man who seems to fail at every job interview he partakes in. He accepts an offer to be part of the ReLIFE experiment in order to receive a recommendation to a company.

~!In Chapter 221, he learns that [Chizuru](https://anilist.co/character/89426/Hishiro-Chizuru) was a subject of ReLIFE and was shocked to discover she is older than him. After she briefly becomes sad at his possible disappointment, he assures her that he is happy with the revelation and hugs her which surprises but delights her. He then confesses his feelings for her that he is truly in love with her and wishes to be with her forever, and asks her to go out on a date with him. She is very touched by this declaration and states if he is okay with her she'll go out with him on a date, as they smile at each other and share their first kiss.!~

89426.description:
A prodigy who has the best grades among the girls in her class. She's extremely bad at communication. She has a habit of immediately looking up anything she doesn't understand on the internet.

~!Hishiro was in fact Test Subject No. 001 of the Kantou Branch of ReLIFE Laboratory. Her inter-personal issues had made her not able to keep any job for long, and the list of short-term employments on her resume eventually made her unemployable. Her first year of ReLIFE experiment was a failure, but she was given a second chance, and she made the effort to make friends the second year. With the help of [Kaizaki](https://anilist.co/character/89425/Kaizaki-Arata) and her friends, she was able to overcome her past issues and restore her feelings that were damaged in the past.

After her ReLIFE experiment ended, she joined the ReLIFE Laboratory in the Research and Development Division.!~

89428.description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5'0")

A third year in [Arata Kaizaki](https://anilist.co/character/89425/Kaizaki-Arata)'s class. She may be positive about everything she thinks about, but then she may not be thinking about anything.

~!However, she is in fact an employee of the ReLIFE Support Division and [Ryo Yoake](https://anilist.co/character/89427/Yoake-Ryou)'s junior supervisor in the ReLIFE experiment. She was actually going to be the support of Kaizaki, though this was changed. Her real age is 26-27!~

89442.description: Teru and Futaba's classmate. She declares herself Teru's rival but always loses. As an animal lover, she only gets along with Teru where animals are concerned.

89443.description: A friend of Nishiyama's, and the one who can calm her down. She has no ill will at all.

89444.description: A former Nishikawa family maid who now manages a candy store. She loves schemes and conspiracies.

89445.description:
__Height:__ 145 cm

Megumi is gentle and friendly with a light personality. She is sweet and always in a good mood, but she is genuinely shy about doing things before others. Although she doesn't show it off often, she is a talented ballet dancer and is noted for being really graceful.

89446.description:
He usually wears glasses, but during practice he uses contacts. He is a first-year student at Honan Academy and is one of the stride club's runners, and predominantly an anchor (final runner).

Takeru is always cool and stoic with sober eyes. He has little interest in things other than playing Stride. In middle school, Takeru was a famous Stride player in the under 15's category. He tends to feel people's legs to determine one's talent. Takeru has great cardiovascular fitness and running speed, so Nana must delay the call for him to start running. Despite this, he only has average parkour techniques.

The reason for his fixation on Riku is unknown.

89447.description: Riku has a bright and cheerful personality and is able to become friends with anybody. He is very athletic and has good motor skills but only has an average cardiovascular fitness. Riku has also been recruited for several other clubs (specifically basketball, volleyball and table tennis) in the school, more for his speed and agility rather than his ball skills. He has great acceleration and poor parkour skills because while he can jump and hurdle, he can never land safely.

89448.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm 

The main character of the franchise. She's a hardworking girl who's moved alone from Hokkaido to Tokyo and has transferred to Honan Academy. Soon after joining, she tries to become the manager of the Stride club, but ends up becoming the club's relationer. Her character is fearless.

89449.description: Looks cute, but actually loves terrible jokes and wants to work in the theater. Even if he's injured, he always carries a smile. The caring eldest son of a big family.

89450.description: Heath is full of manly spirit and has a dependable aura. He is half Japanese with a British mother and has two sisters, one is the president of a big company, and the other is a model. Heath himself also models sometimes against his will.

89451.description: Ayumu is a second-year student and a member of the combined Shogi-Stride Club.

89453.description: Kyosuke Kuga is a third-year student at Honan Academy and a former member of the Stride Club.

89464.description:
A mysterious, arrogant and playful yet exceedingly strong and brave girl who arrives at Aragane Station with unclear intent. She's very proficient with firearms and thrown weaponry, as well as incredibly strong physically, being able to chop off a Kabane's head clean off - using a blade concealed in her sandal - with one swift kick. 
Despite often appearing ruthless and full of bloodlust, she's great with kids.

89471.description:
A warrior who serves Ayame's family. He is understanding and treats people of all social classes without discrimination.

(Source: ANN)

89472.description:
A headstrong and passionate young Steam Smith and inventor from Hinomoto who makes a living in Aragane Station making iron and steam engines. He and his good friend Takumi developed a weapon called "Tsuranuki Zutsu" in order to defeat the Kabane. Everyone makes light of him now, but he looks forward to a day when he will be triumphant.

~!His hatred for the Kabane stems from past trauma, with his sister Hatsune dying by his hands folllowing a Kabane attack and Ikoma struggling to cope with his loss ever since.!~

89498.description:
__Height:__ 132cm (4'4")
__Affiliations:__ Hosea Academy, Team E
__Occupation:__ 4th-year Grade School Student, Ability Wielder, Phantom Hunter

Kurumi Kumamakura is a 4th-year grade school student at Hosea Academy. After getting to know [Haruhiko Ichijou](https://anilist.co/character/89033/Haruhiko-Ichijou), she joins Team E as a member of the Phantom-Hunter club.

In order to fight, she uses her special ability, Albrecht, a teddy bear in which she always carries around her wherever she goes. If she could, Kurumi would put her life on the line if it meant protecting him, as she considers him to be her childhood best friend (even if he doesn't talk). In fact, she loves everything that has to do with bears, from the animal itself, her favorite food, her birth place, and her last name which has "Kuma" (Bear) in it's name.

alternative: Rururaruri Rurararirararururirirari Rirararururararururararirari (ルルラルリー・ルララリララルルリリラリー・リララルルララルルララリラリー)

89499.description:
Ruru is a Phantom who accompanies Haruhiko. She is not the type of Phantom that is hunted, and is a self-proclaimed 'good girl'.

Her full name is Rururaruri Rurararirararururirirari Rirararururararururararirari.

~!She is a Phantom born from Haruhiko's mind!~

89500.description: The younger sister of Midori. Kohaku is often noted how closely she resembles her older sister. Kohaku is a shy and timid girl.

89508.description:
__Team:__ Aobajōsai (former Kitagawa Daīchi) (first year at Aoba Johsai)
__Height:__ 182.8 cm
__Number:__ 13 
__Position:__ Wing Spiker

He is a quiet and indifferent person, though it's mostly out of laziness. He occasionally skips practice as well and doesn't seem to put his full effort into matches; however, his true strength lies in his late game plays. Kunimi dislikes loud, energetic people and was dismayed when Koganegawa yelled at him to "go all out", which is one of his least liked phrases. He also refers to Hinata, Koganegawa, and Hyakuzawa as the "idiot squad" because of their energy. Kageyama has also mentioned that Kunimi is smart, though it's unknown if that refers to his game sense or general studies.

89510.description: Tomo's father. He runs the Aizawa Dojo and he has trained both Tomo and Jun.

name.native: キャロル・オールストン

89512.description: **Relatives:** Ferris (Mother), Kousuke (Distant Cousin) Carol is a classmate and friend of Tomo, Jun and Misuzu. A beautiful, doll-faced student of British origin with no filter between her brain and her mouth.

89513.description: Makoto's older sister and a full fledged witch. She contrasts Makoto in both personality and appearance. While Makoto is polite and soft spoken, Akane is more brash and loud mouthed, but still just as kind. She also has tanned skin and white hair, which contrasts with Makoto's pale skin and black hair.

89514.description: Makoto's classmate as well as Kei's childhood friend. She helps out with her parents liquor store for some extra money.

89515.description: She's a junior high school student with a passion for archaeology. She also helps out at her mother's café.

89516.description: A witch that specializes in fortune telling and is also Akane's friend. Due to an incident that happened in the past, she now has a face, ears, and tail of a dog and furry skin, and she can only return to her full human form at night. She has been looking for a way to contact Akane for a year to find a cure and return her to a human form permanently. Due to her half animal appearance, she wears a cloak that covers her face and body so she doesn't draw attention. Kei admits that she is his type of girl when in human form, and even Akane admits that she is very cute.

89520.description:
__Height:__ 140 cm

Maya is the excitable and mischievous friend of [Chino](https://anilist.co/character/88032/Chino-Kafuu) and [Megumi](https://anilist.co/character/89445/Megumi-Natsu). Like [Cocoa](https://anilist.co/character/84491/Cocoa-Hoto), she's energetic, and strives toward goals that may or may not be out of reach. She is usually in a perky mood.

She admires [Rize](https://anilist.co/character/88034/Rize-Tedeza) for her cool attitude and fast-thinking, and while she is loving towards her friends, she can show a blunt side with them. At home, she is shown to be a bit lazy as well, often relying on her older brother to do things for her.

Even though she often acts like a "fool", it is said that she is actually very inquisitive and has very good grades.

89537.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

In the past he was quite cheerful, having dreams to cleanse and destroy all Impurities and Magano, but after the Hiinatsuki tragedy, due to the fear of losing more "people that he cared about", he decided to stop fighting and quit being an exorcist. He often attempts to become someone big in various areas like: soccer, acting, etc. but he lacks all kind of talent and fails at everything, including simple things as map reading.

Even though he doesn't want to fight, he can't stand by and do nothing when someone needs help, and he is ready to risk his life to help those in need, for example, when he saved [Benio](https://anilist.co/character/89538/Adashino-Benio) from the impurity she had trouble defeating herself, and when he rushed to Magano to save [Ryougo](https://anilist.co/character/89701/Nagitsuji-Ryougo), not taking any dangers in consideration.

Rokuro is a bit reckless at times and is very talkative, or, as Benio calls him, "loud". He retains a lot of emotional pain but keeps a strong exterior to make sure none of his friends worry about him.

~!Rokuro was created by Abe no Seimei and was one of many clones constructed to look human.!~

89538.description:
Benio first comes off as a cold, quiet person, who dislikes talking and is easily irritated. However, regarding exorcism she is very passionate and can be very talkative. Since she comes from an important family, honor and pride are both very important to her. She is also very competitive, especially around [Rokuro](https://anilist.co/character/89537/Enmadou-Rokuro), and since she was taught to never back out from her words, she can be pretty stubborn and will use any argument to win.

Later on, Benio seems to be able to show her feelings comfortably compared to when she first met Rokuro, and seems to show her jealousy more openly than before.

~!Benio has lost her enchanted powers, due to the battle between her guardian and Sayo's guardian.!~

~!She marries Rokuro Enmado.!~

89546.description:
__Affiliation:__ History Club
