He is a high school student in his third year and head of the history club. He is also one of the four boys and one girl who are trying to win Kae Serinuma's affection.

Mutsumi is depicted having straight shaggy brown hair that is styled on either side, slanted light brown eyes, a calm expression and he is often seen with a soft, genuine smile.

~!In the manga, Kae Serinuma made her choice and asked Asuma to become her boyfriend. Seven years after Mutsumi graduated, they get married and have a son named Shion Mutsumi.!~

(Source: Watashi Ga Motete Dousunda Wikia)

89550.description: Shima Nishina is a first-year high school student, fujoshi, mangaka and cosplayer. She's in class 1-4, and is known to be quite popular and crafty. She's a smooth talker and can easily appear likeable to her peers.

name.native: ヤトリシノ・イグセム
マシュー・テトジリチ
シャミーユ・キトラ・カトヴァンマニニク

89564.description:
Chidori resembles the sin of Envy. Her updated sin is "Goody-Two-Shoes." Her identification when she experiences pain is D-5. 

Chidori was first portrayed as clumsy, emotional, and seemingly nosy at times. She seems to sincerely care about all of the other Kiznaivers, especially [Katsuhira Agata](https://anilist.co/character/89294/Katsuhira-Agata) _(Chidori's childhood friend)_ and tries to cheer them up when they're upset. She got embarrassed rather easily, and had been told by [Tsuguhito Yuta](https://anilist.co/character/89567/Tsuguhito-Yuta) that she was "too heavy" when it comes to her emotions. If too embarrassed or irritated, she would hit the person who caused those feelings. 

Chidori was called "Two-Goody Shoes" by [Noriko Sonozaki.](https://anilist.co/character/89295/Noriko-Sonozaki) She has a tendency to take care of others, as seen when she cooks meals for Katsuhira and [Hajime Tenga,](https://anilist.co/character/89565/Hajime-Tenga) and also when she tries to solve Katushira's problems for him by talking to the teachers about his being bullied and demanding that the bullies return his money. She is very defensive of her friends, especially Katsuhira because she knows he won't defend himself out of apathy. 

~!Chidori fell in love with Katsuhira during their childhood and very much wished for him to return to his original kind and funny personality. She was very upset when she realized that he would not return her feelings, but also understood that she could not make him do so and that continuing to try would be selfish of her.

In the end of the anime, it looks like she might end up having feelings for Tenga in the future.!~

89565.description:
Of the Seven Deadly Sins of Modern-Day Japan, Tenga's sin is that of the "Musclehead Thug." However, while he is known among his peers as an unpredictable and intimidating delinquent, his true personality holds a deep-seated desire to help others.

In the proper spirit of the "Musclehead," Tenga is an incredibly energetic and physically strong person who many times acts on a whim in order to push through and keep events moving along. In spite of his image, however, he in many situations can display some of the highest practical intelligence and observational skills among the seven Kiznaivers, easily able to glean the root of a problem without much effort.

Although his nature is typically thoughtful and concerned for others, when he is faced with strong negative emotions such as jealousy, Tenga is capable of displaying liberal amounts of selfishness to the point of extreme senseless violence. Still, even in such rare cases, he eventually comes to terms deep down that his actions were misguided.

89566.description:
Nico resembles the sin of Greed. In modern Japan, her sin is 'The Eccentric Headcase' _(Japanese: 不思議メンヘラ, Romanized: Fushigi Menhera, Official English Translation: "Screw Loose")._ Her identification when she experiences pain is D-6. 

Nico appears to be bright and energetic, often being the comic relief of the series. She tends to overreact or be very dramatic when experiencing new things, and acts very feminine.

However, Nico is shown to be rather perceptive in the series, much to her companions' surprise.

Since she came from a wealthy family, it is implied that she has polite and lady-like manners. 

(Source: Kiznaiver Wikia)

89567.description:
A bit of an opportunist and a lady's man in the classroom, he is revealed to be intensely ashamed of his immense chubbiness back in his grade school years, and goes through great lengths to conceal this fact. He places great emphasis on his own appearance and prefers the company of similarly attractive people, acknowledging these facts even, yet at the same time is shown in several instances to be able to look past people's superficial features; as a result of this, he can be surprisingly intuitive at times. Yuta speaks his mind with a candid tongue (such as when he told [Honoka Maki](https://anilist.co/character/89568/Honoka-Maki) that she had a "terrible personality"), and possesses a kind heart underneath the rest of his personality.

~!After the incident in episode 12, he is shown eating with Honoka. She only eats one bite and offers it to him. He gladly accepts because of an "indirect kiss" but he questions why she would do that. Honoka says that she wants Yuta to get fat so people will stop chasing him for his good looks. Yuta's whole face turns red and Honoka starts walking away with Yuta chasing after her. !~

89568.description: Maki is first introduced along with the other main cast after [Noriko Sonozaki](https://anilist.co/character/89295/Noriko-Sonozaki) confronts [Katsuhira Agata](https://anilist.co/character/89294/Katsuhira-Agata) about the Kizna Project. Her sin is revealed to be "Pride". She, along with the other Kiznaivers are then abducted by the Gomorin and has her senses connected together.

89570.description: An underclassman who is also a member of the art club. She moved to Japan with her parents for their careers and has been there for around 7 years. She got so used to living in Japan that she decided to continue living there even after her parents returned home.

89571.description: Maria Imari is a really cheerful girl who really enjoys manga and anime. Is a second-year student of Tsukumori Middle School. She has Chuunibyou.

89576.description:
**Height:** 148 cm (4'10 ft)

Sagiri was taught to draw by her mother at a young age, and by the time she was around the age of nine, she became [Masamune](https://anilist.co/character/121470)'s illustrator. A year before the events of the novel, Sagiri met Masamune, though she didn't realize that he was the author she was working with despite the similar names. After her mother died, she temporarily stopped drawing and going outside. After seeing a live video of someone drawing images and getting a response, Sagiri became interested in live video feeds and started drawing images on a camera disguising her face and voice so that nobody would recognize her or learn about her. She eventually started to interact with people who saw her video feed (while still disguised). At some point, Masamune was too busy to cook and she chose to go hungry rather than go outside her room to get food.

89577.description: A mysterious woman who originally worked as a geisha, thanks to [Yakumo the 7th](https://anilist.co/character/369125/Yuurakutei-Yakumo)'s help. She normally supports [Kikuhiko](https://anilist.co/character/89345/Yuurakutei-Yakumo) by giving him encouragement and watching his rakugo performances.

89578.description: The chubby older brother of Ouran, harmless to all, who has a handsome face. He bemoans the "sad" world and is a neet who spends his days "monitoring" the internet.

89579.description: She decided to come to Tokyo in order to participate in the efforts to protect the invaders.

89580.description: A classmate of Futaba's from middle school. He likes to wear women's clothing as he simply wishes to be cute and beautiful.

89582.description: Kadode and Ontan's friend. She is a quiet girl who is into boy's love. She is Ai's childhood friend.

89583.description: Kadode and Ontan's friend. She has a boyfriend named Kohiruimaki.

89584.description: Kadode and Ontan's friend. Rin's bespectacled childhood friend.

89585.description: Kadode's mother. She fears the negative health effects of the A-Lines.

89586.description:
She works in the public relations department at S.E.S.'s Hujin Development Center.

She is in a relationship with Watarase, Kadode's teacher.

89587.description: A journalist who was classmates with Sumaru-san.

89588.description: Kadode Koyama's mother's boyfriend. He plans on marrying her.

alternative: The Vampire of the Blue Moon

89590.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")
__Occupation:__ Doctor
__Partner:__ [Noé Archiviste](https://anilist.co/character/89835/Archiviste-No) (now), [Dante](https://anilist.co/character/155328/Dante) (former)

Vanitas is an average human being who inherited his name and the Book of Vanitas from the infamous vampire.

He seems to often take nothing seriously and almost always has a broad grin on his face. He acts more on emotions than thought most of the time since his plans are normally reckless. Also carries a mischievous air around him. 

~!When he was just a child, his parents were killed by a vampire. He was saved by the chasseurs and taken in. They trained him to become a chasseur but somewhere along the line, Vanitas caught Doctor Moreau's eye and became his research subject. According to Moreau, Vanitas went through multiple experiments that nearly killed him, and yet he never cried nor complained. The experiments continued until he and "no. 71" were rescued from Moreau's lab by Vanitas of the Blue Moon. Unlike no. 71, Vanitas hated Vanitas of the Blue Moon. The events that occurred afterwards are unknown, but Vanitas acquired the Book of Vanitas at some point. Since receiving the Book of Vanitas, Vanitas has dedicated his life to curing Curse-Bearing Vampires and considers himself a doctor of sorts as a result; using the power of the Book of Vanitas to restore a Curse-Bearer's true name.!~

89612.description: A first-year student from the blue world, Earth. She is the student council president. An EXR level Progress girl, one of the strongest fighters in the academy. Her Exceed ability allows her to summon a sword.

89614.description: The amnesiac girl from the red world, Terra Rubli Aurora.

89615.description: The android girl from the white world, System;White=E.G.M.A.

89616.description:
**Height:** 157 cm

He is the assistant and disciple of [Arataka Reigen](https://anilist.co/character/89334/Reigen-Arataka). He is also the newest member of the Body Improvement Club.

Shigeo is a quiet and polite individual who tries to live a normal life despite having strong telepathic power, he wants to be seen as a good human among the people in his social life. This often makes him naive and gullible when those with malicious intent want to use him for a laugh or to cause trouble but Shigeo has very strong beliefs to never use his powers to hurt another person because of an altercation he faced once as a child.

89617.description:
Ekubo is a self-proclaimed upper-class evil spirit who has aligned himself with [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616) after being defeated by him.

Ekubo wants to be a god. Specifically, he wants to be worshipped by all humanity. 
~!Despite having that kind of ego, he didn't hesitate to put himself at Mob's mercy in the hopes of using the boy to his advantage. At first, he wanted to steal Mob's body and use it to become a god, but he eventually decided to try to make Mob a god instead.!~

89618.description:
__Height:__ 159.4 cm

Ritsu is very clever and apparently serious, he also serves on the student council and excels in academics and everything else he tries. None of that matters to him as much as psychic power, however, his brother is more important to him than anyone or anything else.

~!Before he awoke his own psychic powers, he longed for the esper abilities his brother has always had and was frustrated by his own inability to do things like bend spoons. He may have a habit of carrying spoons around with him, for bending purposes. He is a perfectionist with a not-so-hidden dark side. Unlike [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616/Kageyama-Shigeo), he finds it okay to use psychic violence against people when necessary.!~

89621.description:
__Height:__ 161.4 cm

Hanazawa Teruki is an esper who was first introduced as an antagonist, but later became [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616/Kageyama-Shigeo)'s friend after being defeated by him. He was the shadow leader (urabanchou) of Black Vinegar Middle School, using his psychic powers to rule over the delinquents at his own school, as well as to defeat those from other schools.

Teruki is a talented, quick-thinking, and hardworking esper. In terms of raw power, he is nowhere near Mob's level, but he compensates for this by putting in effort and training diligently. He is able to analyze other espers' techniques and their weaknesses in a short amount of time, and often incorporates said techniques in his own fights. He is constantly training to improve himself, and is remarked by various espers as possessing a keen and powerful set of skills.

89630.description:
A mysterious girl who appears in front of Cocona. She's always bright and active, thirsting for adventure, along with having nearly no fear. She is also proficient at riding a hoverboard, often surfing the skies.

After becoming friends with Cocona, Papika insists on returning to Pure Illusion for more adventures. 

~!In the past, she was referred to as, "Papikana," when she was partners with Mimi.!~

89631.description: A second-year middle school student who lives with her grandmother. She's an honor student who serves as the class representative. Because of her cautious personality, she's unable to step foot into new opportunities.

name.native: アイリ・アーカディア

89638.description: Member of Platoon S128, who used to idolize Kanata, but since she was unconscious when he charged alone, she now sees him as a traitor like most of the academy.

89639.description: Chito is Makoto's familiar, a black cat.

89641.description:
__Birth Place:__ Tokyo, Japan
__Height:__ 149 cm

A high school graduate who joins the Eagle Jump game company as a character designer, as they made her favorite game, Fairies Story. Due to her small stature, she is often mistaken for a middle school student.

89642.description:
__Birth Place:__ Tokyo
__Height:__ 164 cm

The lead character designer of Eagle Jump. She spends a lot of time at the office, often sleeping there overnight in her underwear, and has a laid-back but stern attitude. She was the character designer for the game that inspired [Aoba](https://anilist.co/character/89641/Suzukaze-Aoba) to become one herself.

89643.description:
__Birth Place:__ Aichi prefecture, Japan
__Height:__ 158 cm

An art director and head of the background department. She joined the company at the same time as Kou whom she is very close friends with.

89644.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

Takimoto Hifumi is a character designer ~!(currently character team leader)!~ for Eagle Jump, a gaming studio located in Tokyo.

Hifumi is especially shy to the point of avoiding talking to people or looking at them directly. As a result, in order to not make her feel uncomfortable, the other employees interact with her through the company's computer messenger system. Although, in later seasons she becomes more lively and goes out of her way to try to improve talking to people. 

Contrary to her normal personality, she becomes very lively, outgoing, and cheerful while texting or messaging, often using emoticons in chat. She secretly enjoys cosplay and owns a pet hedgehog named [Sojiro](https://anilist.co/character/158503/Sojiro).

Some trivia about Hifumi:
- Her favorite colors are Blue and Pink
- Her favorite clothing style is "Sweet Lolita"

89645.description:
__Birth Place:__ Tokushima Prefecture, Japan
__Height:__ 167 cm

A motion designer who works in the character design department as there are no open seats in the animation department. She enjoys sentai shows and owns various prop weapons.

89646.description:
__Birth Place:__ Mie Prefecture, Japan
__Height:__ 151 cm

A character designer who designs monsters and often dresses in gothic clothing. She has two younger siblings.

89650.description: Ayase Ayatsuji is a third year student from Hagun Academy. She is a D-Rank Blazer who uses the katana-style Device Hizume.

89651.description: Irori is a woman who has a pale skin tone, long, flowing silver hair, purple eyes and wears light-colored lipstick. Her choice of attire is an indigo-colored kimono that is secured by a teal-colored obi. She also embellishes her clothing with a dark-colored cloth that has an baroque design in it and depicts her symbol, two snowflakes. Her dress is a tone darker to her kimono and completes her look by wearing a tabi and geta.

89652.description:
Komurasaki is Yaya's and Irori's younger sister, she is the youngest Automaton "daughter" of Shoko Karyusai.
cheerful and optimistic girl who smiles frequently, She is rather cheeky and tends to make sexual jokes.

89695.description: Jie Long's Rank #1 as well as its student council president. Wielder of the most formidable combat skills in all of Asterisk even though she is still nine years old, and she has been crowned “the most powerful.” Has inherited Jie Long’s fabled alias, Divine Revelations.

89697.description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")

The older brother of [Benio Adashino](https://anilist.co/character/89538/Adashino-Benio). 

~!Yuuto was also an old friend turned enemy of [Rokuro Enmadou](https://anilist.co/character/89537/Enmadou-Rokuro), and the mastermind behind the Hiinatsuki Tragedy.!~

89698.description:
__Height:__ 161 cm (5'3")

Rokuro's childhood friend and Amawaka Seigen's daughter.

89699.description: Seigen Amawaka is an exorcist. He is the father of Mayura Otomi and the husband of Yukari Otomi. He also mentored Shimon Ikaruga, Rokuro Enmado and Yuuto Ijika.

89703.description:
Shimon Ikaruga is an exorcist and Crimson Phoenix of the Twelve Guardians. He was born in the branch family of Ikaruga House of Tsuchimikado Island, and was later adopted by the main family.

He was the youngest member of the Twelve Guardians until Mayura Otomi took her father's place in the ranks. He is one of Seigen Amawaka's apprentices, as well as Keiji and Sayo Ikaruga's cousin and foster brother.

89704.description: Kamui is calm yet ruthless, having no mercy for humans or other creatures, he does not care about their feelings, comparing them to mere insects. Though, he tends to often let his opponents choose the death of their preference, and always gives them ten seconds to decide.

89707.description:
Konatsu is the daughter of [Sukeroku](https://anilist.co/character/89346/) and [Miyokichi](https://anilist.co/character/89577/), and Yakumo the 8th's ward. 

She normally fights back against what [Yakumo](https://anilist.co/character/89345/) says and wants, and will exhibit this sort of behaviour to anyone else she doesn't trust. She is also a great teacher of rakugo, although somewhat stern.

89708.description:
__Height:__ 157cm (5'2")

The cheerful protagonist who owns a Honda CB400 SF.

She initially became interested in motorcycles after getting tired of riding a bicycle uphill to school.

89709.description:
Her bike is a Suzuki GSX400S Katana.

She loves all Suzuki bikes unconditionally.

89710.description:
Her bike is a Yamaha SEROW225W.

She encouraged Hane to start biking, and believes only fellow fools can ride bikes.

89719.description:
Hayato Kisaragi is the main protagonist of Hundred. He is the older brother of Karen Kisaragi originating from Yamato prior to the Second Attack, but later moved to Gudenburg due to their father's job where he befriended Emilia Hermit until his parents' death, then moved to an insitutute in Yamato. 

Hayato was later scouted to enroll in Little Garden with both his tuition waived and under a scholarship under the condition his little sister would receive the treatment she needed due to his high aptitude for a Hundred, as a result of him being a variant and become a first-year student in Bugeika High School.

name.native: エミール・クロスフォード

89720.description:
Emilia Gudenburg is the main female protagonist in Hundred.

She is the third princess of the Gudenburg Empire.

Having snuck outside of the royal palace several times, Emilia befriended, Hayato Kisaragi under the alias of Emilia Hermit. During the Second Attack, she was turned into a variant after being attacked by a savage and was separated from Hayato.

She soon enrolled in Little Garden under the guise of a male student named Emile Crossfode where she had become the roommate of Hayato but was later removed after Claire found out she was a female.

89721.description: Claire Harvey is one of the three main female protagonists of Hundred. She is the first daughter and second child of Bill and Linis Harvey, thus making her the little sister of Judal Harvey and older sister of Liza Harvey. After being admitted into Little Garden, she became the highest-ranked Slayer known as the Perfect Queen and Rose Guardian.

89722.description:
Sakura Kirishima is a popular idol well-known worldwide as an Oriental Wizard, she later fell in love with Hayato Kisaragi who everyone regarded as a hero for saving Zwei Island from the savages after watching a viral video. Aside from her being an idol, Sakura is also a slayer 

~!She is also a Variant.!~

89723.description: Karen Kisaragi is the little sister of Hayato Kisaragi.

name.native: レイティア・サンテミリオン

89725.description: Latia Saint-Émillion is a first-year in Bugeika High School alongside her childhood friend, Fritz Glanz. She is also one of the main friends of Hayato and Emilia.

89730.description:
**Height:** 148 cm (4'9")

She serves as the Navigation Officer aboard the Harekaze, an ocean-going training ship of the Yokosuka Girls' Marine High School. Although she often handles the helm on the bridge, she has a terrible sense of direction.

She is an incredibly anxious and timid person who always seems somewhat jittery and prone to bursting into tears. Ironically, however, she becomes strangely energetic whenever she decides to make a run for it—sometimes even misusing her talent for running fast to facilitate her escape. Perhaps due to her constant worrying, she suffers from frequent stomach aches and always carries stomach medicine with her.

Having spent her life running away from things out of fear since childhood, she decided to become a Blue Mermaid in an effort to change herself. Encouraged by Akeno whenever she falls into a slump, she is striving to pick herself up and move forward.

Mayumi Uchida, a fellow member of the Navigation Department, is her childhood friend; she, too, has often been dragged into Suzu's habit of running away. Her family runs a shrine located on the water off the coast of Hinomisaki in Shimane Prefecture, and she serves as a shrine maiden there. Since the shrine is known for granting blessings related to matchmaking and good fortune, she visited Yokosuka's Suwa Shrine—famous for granting success in exams—during the New Year holidays to pray for her admission to the marine school. However, her flawless execution of the ritual purification (emizu) led a shrine official to mistake her for a fellow professional, and she ended up helping out with the work.

It remains unclear whether the two of them ever realized this connection after meeting aboard the Harekaze.

89756.description: Hideki is a first-year high school student who plays Legendary Age (LA), under the name Rusian, a male knight. He distrusts girls online after having been rejected by a girl who told him that she was actually a guy in real life. He is Ako's in-game husband in Legendary Age after reluctantly accepting her many repeated in-game proposals. Over the course of the series, Hideki begins to develop real feelings for Ako and attempts to help her differentiate reality from the gaming world. Outside of LA, he is an otaku.

89757.description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")

She is [Hideki's](https://anilist.co/character/89756/Nishimura-Hideki) "wife" in-game. In school, she is shy and quiet among her classmates, and has trouble telling the difference between game and reality.

89758.description: A petite twin-tailed blonde classmate, she despises otakus and scolds Hideki whenever he acts like one or tries to interact with her. However, she is actually a gamer herself under the moniker Schwein, a male knight (sword dancer). Her character name is German for pig, which she did not know until Kyo informs her offline, much to her chagrin. Although she is popular at school, she has turned down many boys so she can have more gaming time.

89759.description:
The student council president at Hideki's school and the leader of the Alley Cats guild in LA. She has long dark hair and goes under the character name Apricot (アプリコット, Apurikotto), a male mage at the beginning of the series. Her guild mates call her Master. She comes from a wealthy family; her father is on the school board, and her family has several companies. She often uses in-game purchases to boost her game attributes, but does not depend on her family's money but on her personal investments to fund it. Outside of the guild, she does not have any friends as her family does not give her much chance to socialize. She sponsors the creation of the school's game club.

(Source: Wikipedia)

89760.description:
Akane's friend who discovers she plays online games, and agrees to keep it a secret. Shortly afterwards, she begins playing LA under the character name Sette (セッテ)Ep. 5, who is a summoner. She has purplish blue hair then pink in the anime.

(Source: Wikipedia)

89761.description:
Yui Saito is Hideki's teacher who watches over him and the girls and becomes their club's advisor. She gives him advice on how to interact with girls and balance his gaming life. It is later revealed that she was the LA player Nekohime (猫姫), a catgirl who rejected Hideki's in-game proposal two years prior, stating that she was actually a guy.

In school, Yui is a hard-working and strict teacher that cares deeply for her students. Yui doesn't like it when they are doing something that is against the school rules or when they are acting out. Despite that, Yui wants nothing, but to help them and feel better in school. In the game, however, Yui acts more childish, cheerful to the point that some would mistake her for a teenager. Yui is known to be wise and understanding at young people, knowing how to handle them and treat their problems in a positive way.

89787.description:
**Height:** 167 cm

Tanaka is a listless student who is always dozing off and acting exhausted when awake. He is constantly sighing and refrains from any tiring work, all while being accompanied by his friend, [Oota](https://anilist.co/character/89788). Due to his disdain towards hard-work, he often relies on his family and friends (namely Oota) to assist him with activities. He's apathetic and hardly ever outwardly expresses how he feels. When he does, it's normally done in an impassive-seeming manner as well and thus makes it seem like he's mature at best and emotionless and uncaring at worst. He rarely does anything where he exerts more energy than required; however, he shows a surprising dedication to maintaining his lifestyle and daily routine, even going out of his way sometimes to maintain it even at the cost of expending energy he'd rather not use.

Tanaka is somewhat scatterbrained or clueless at times, coming up with eccentric-at-best ideas that hold some form of merit or have some argument behind them but end up resulting in something stupid or bizarre. Tanaka is very capable but chooses to use his head for things that interest him.

89788.description:
__Height:__ 184 cm (6'0")

A tall and stoic student, who is very reliable and is often looking after [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/89787/Tanaka). Tanaka states that because of Oota's caring nature, he sees Oota as the perfect candidate for marriage. He states on multiple occasions that he admires Tanaka's ability to be listless in any given situation, but also feels that Tanaka's personality causes him to miss out on things like romance and love.

He is serious, kind, and doesn't seem to be able to leave his good friend, Tanaka, alone. Oota is pretty much Tanaka's caretaker, always assisting him with different school activities, making sure he gets places on time, and even carrying him when necessary. He is very capable and responsible, and with that, everything Tanaka needs. Tanaka often states "you would be a good wife" to him. Oota seems to jump to conclusions relatively quickly. He seems to be patient at times. He is an optimist and is always encouraging people no matter the circumstances.

89789.description:
Tanaka's classmate with short stature. She admires [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/89787/Tanaka) for his listlessness. She constantly proclaims herself to be Tanaka's apprentice in listlessness, however he constantly decries her.

Miyano is an energetic girl who likes to make friends. She is [Echizen](https://anilist.co/character/89791/Echizen)'s best friend and admires Tanaka's listlessness and persistently approaches him to become his apprentice. Eventually, she comes to self-proclaim herself as his apprentice and calls others to be his apprentice too.

She is immensely loyal to those who are close to her, shown when she helps Tanaka and [Ohta](https://anilist.co/character/89788/Ohta) with their landscape sketches, takes pictures so that her club president could practice his art skills, and yells at her own "Master" (Tanaka) for being an idiot when she thinks that he had a girlfriend and worries about [Shiraishi](https://anilist.co/character/89790/Shiraishi)'s feelings for him.

Whilst looking oblivious to the eye, Miyano can catch on to situations quickly. This can be seen when she spots Shiraishi at the door staring at both her and Tanaka's conversation and later approaches Shiraishi in an oblivious manner which made it seem as if the latter wanted to become his apprentice too. After confirming the friendships of Shirashi and Tanaka, she sends a message to her saying that she will cheer on Shiraishi's pursuit in having a crush on Tanaka.

89790.description:
**Height**: 160 cm
**Hair Color**: Strawberry Blonde
**Eye Color**: Brown
**Hobbies**: Studying
**Occupation**: Class Representative

Shiraishi is a beautiful, intelligent, and popular student among males and females. She's a stylish girl with long and lengthy strawberry blonde hair brown eyes. Her hair is described as the idol hairstyle.

Shiraishi is responsible for her duty as the class representative. Due to her being a loner back in middle school, there are times when she's depressed whenever reminded of her "lame school girl" days.

Before meeting [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/89787/Tanaka) and [Ohta](https://anilist.co/character/89788/Ohta), she wore contact lenses and her hairstyle often bothered her. After meeting them, she retains her public style but wears red glasses instead of lenses. In private, she keeps her bangs up with a small hair tie while wearing a ponytail.

~!She develops a crush on Tanaka for believing that he was able to recognize her real-self despite her different looks. It was later revealed that it was thanks to her bust size, although this is unbeknownst to her.!~

89791.description:
[Ohta's](https://anilist.co/character/89788/Ohta) childhood friend. She loves [Miyano](https://anilist.co/character/89789/Miyano) as a friend and affectionately calls her Myaano.

Echizen is quite aggressive toward anyone, excluding Miyano. She gets upset or angry about small things; one example is whenever Ohta calls her 'Ecchan'. She also lacks the ability to eat sweets if they are "cute". She easily jumps to conclusions but is very dedicated to helping in what she believes in.

89792.description:
[Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/89787/Tanaka)'s little sister. She is a middle school student who is the manager of the Volleyball Club of her school.

Rino is often told that she is similar to Tanaka as they both have a listless look in them. Unlike her brother, Rino is more consistent and is normally the one doing the shopping, cooking, cleaning etc. She has grown the habit of cleaning leather shoes as shown when [Oota](https://anilist.co/character/89788/Ohta) paid a visit to Tanaka's apartment. It is also shown that Rino has Brother-Complex, or "brocon" as she purposely gave Oota dark chocolate knowing that he loves sweet things and gave Tanaka hand-made sweets. She expresses a dislike towards Oota, brought about by Oota and Tanaka's close relationship and sometimes gets jealous. She is friends with Oota's younger sister [Saya](https://anilist.co/character/89793/Saya-Ohta)

89793.description: [Oota](https://anilist.co/character/89788/Oota)'s sister, who goes to same school as [Rino](https://anilist.co/character/89792/Rino-Tanaka). She is a shy person with an unusually small voice. She belongs to the Volleyball Club.

89794.description: [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/89787/Tanaka)'s classmate. He is cool and intelligent, but has a weakness for girls. He looks so different when not wearing eyeglasses that he cannot be recognized.

89795.description:
[Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/89787/Tanaka)'s classmate. He is good at sports and loves soccer.

Katou seems to always be happy and active. He is usually seen with [Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/89794/Shimura) at school, and he likes to make jokes with his friends. Katou is also good at sports like badminton but his favorite is soccer.

name.native: クルルシファー・エインフォルク

89796.description: One of the main female characters. She is a transfer student from the Ymir Theocracy, a powerful nation from the north. She is the user of the Divine Drag-Ride "Fafnir".

89797.description:
Satou is an Ajin. He is referred to by officials such as [Yuu Tosaki](https://anilist.co/character/122294/Tosaki-Yuu) as Hat (帽子, Boshi). His real name is Samuel T. Owen.

While Satou's father is British and his mother is Chinese, he himself is from the United States of America. He was part of the United States Marine Corps in the past. Before dying for the first time he had a large x-shaped scar on the left side of his face and was missing his right leg.

He is passionate about video games and gaming in general.

name.native: フィルフィ・アインクラム

89800.description:
Lux's childhood friend who is frail, has a notably large bust, and has a sleepy expression on her face. She wields the Divine Drag-Ride "Typhon". She comes from the powerful and influential Aingram merchant house and took Lux and Airi in after their mother's death.

~!It is revealed that Philuffy was a victim of human experimentation using poisons and weapons by military authorities by the old Arcadia Empire who ignored her sister Relie's pleas for her release. It was this incident that made Lux decide to join Fugil's coup d'etat and pilot the "Bahamut" though he has since forgotten the incident after several years.!~

name.native: セリスティア・ラルグリス

89801.description:
Celistia Ralgris is the Third Year knight leader of the “Knight Squadron”. She was said to be the strongest of the Academy. She's a young woman of the Duke House, one of the four Great Nobles, and she's famous for being a man-hater.

She is user of the Divine Drag-Ride "Lindworm."

(Source: Saijaku Muhai no Bahamut Wikia)

name.native: リーズシャルテ・アティスマータ

89802.description:
Lisesharte Atismata is a princess of the New Kingdom of Atismata. At first, Lisha acts like a tsundere, but as series goes on she opens up to Lux little by little.

She is user of the Divine Drag-Ride "Tiamat."

(Source: Saijaku Muhai no Bahamut Wiki)

name.native: ノエ・アルシヴィスト

89835.description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'1")
__Occupation:__ Student
__Partner:__ [Vanitas](https://anilist.co/character/89590/Vanitas)

Noé is a gentleman vampire.

His story began when he received a letter from [The Teacher](https://anilist.co/character/230438/Sensei), which explained that The Teacher wanted Noé to fly to Paris immediately, as there had been rumors that The Book of Vanitas had been found there. The Teacher then specifically ordered Noé to discern The Book of Vanitas' true nature.

89853.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Chuuya is a Port Mafia member who detests [Osamu Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198) for betraying the mafia and joining the Armed Detective Agency. He's also constantly teased by Dazai what makes him hate Dazai even more. Chuuya is short but he's quick and uses powerful martial arts. 

His ability, "For The Tainted Sorrow," revolves around gravity manipulation, allowing him to manipulate and alter the gravity of anything he touches, keeping it that way until a certain period of time.

89854.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

A member of Port Mafia. He's a bomber wanted for the explosion at the Maruzen Building. He's an enthusiastic scientist who boasts that "death" is the "ultimate experiment."

89855.description: A beautiful and intelligent woman who wears pants. She belongs to a commando unit that answers to the leader of Port Mafia, and has authority over the military group "Black Lizard." She adores Akutagawa and calls him "senpai."

89856.description:
__Height:__ 148cm (4'10")

A docile young lady who dresses in a kimono, but also a member of Port Mafia. As she holds a killing ability, she was found by the organization and raised as an assassin.

~!She later joins the Armed Detective Agency.!~

89857.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm
__Race:__ Human

He is a high school student who is able to see yōkai and a part-time employee of the Mononokean. Hanae has a cheerful, amiable and straightforward personality and can easily sympathise with both human and yōkai. As Hanae can act rather childlike at times, with his naive innocence, impulsiveness and abundance of energy, he is quite often compared to and referred as a five-year-old (mostly by Haruitsuki).

89858.description:
__Height:__ 171 cm
__Race:__ Human

He is the second and current Master of the Mononokean. Haruitsuki is rather cold and shows no concern for humans, claiming that his work as an exorcist is for the sake of the youkai. He is far more polite with youkai, whom he wishes to help as he feels youkai can't find help in the human world while humans will always be helped by someone. It is also shown that in the past, humans looked at him with disdain, disgust or disbelief because of his powers, which contributes to his dislike of humans though he is slowly opening up to them. 

Because of his maturity, people tend to be surprised upon learning he is still a high school student.

89859.description: A new member of the motorcycle club who rides a Honda NSF100. She is very talented because she's been active on the circuit from a young age, but has a complex about how short she is.

89860.description: A former high school student from the Blue World, Earth. Though she is emotional, she is also brave and supportive when the situation calls for it. Before gaining her powers she was a completely normal high school student who barely had any kind of presence. She uses a lightsword in combat.

89861.description: A mature vampire girl from the Black World. She fights using blood but at the same time she thinks that feeding on others is embarrassing, and thus has not bitten anyone yet. However, after drinking Saya's blood in a desperate situation, she becomes completely attached to her and is able to use the full extent of her powers.

89862.description: A heterochromic android from the White World. She has a passion for speed and wants to become even faster than before. Her ability is to manipulate acceleration.

89863.description: An extremely friendly and energetic angel from the Red World. She is able to become friends with anyone. Her ability is to borrow abilities from her friends, but it only works if there is a mutual bond between them.

89864.description: A busty and mature girl from the Green World. She has the reflexes of a soldier (she is an ex-squad leader) but is also quite carefree and hates trouble. She is also very lazy, always trying to find excuses to avoid working. She feels guilty for what happened to Eins, as she was the one leader of her squad during the time the accident happened.

89885.description: Kaguya is the main protagonist in folktale, The Tale of Princess Kaguya. She has been given the title "Princess" after her adoptive father, Miyatsuku, found golden nuggets as a sign from the gods telling him that Kaguya has to live a noble life and therefore bought the title.

alternative: Taping Hero: Cellophane (テーピンヒーロー セロファン)

89895.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5' 9¾")
__Quirk:__ Tape
 
Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Hanta is amicable and has proven to be one of the more sociable members of Class 1-A. He can sometimes be loud and showy, often trying to impress his peers with his Quirk. He is often the only person to call his classmates out when they act crazy. He is pretty humorous and usually makes jokes with his classmates. However, when push comes to shove, Hanta is a brave hero-in-training who wishes to prosper on his own while helping others do the same.

Hanta's Quirk is that he has tape dispenser-like organs in his elbows, from which he can shoot long cellophane tape-like strips; he can also retract them. They appear to be somewhat sturdier than regular tape. Overuse of his Quirk will cause his skin to dry out. He can use his tape to wrap people, swing long distances, and create traps, among other applications.

alternative: Butou Hero: Tailman (武闘ヒーローテイルマン)

89896.description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'6")
__Quirk:__ Tail

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Mashirao has a very calm and noble attitude and a profound sense of dignity, which prevents him from accepting results he doesn't feel he earned with his own abilities. He is also described as a hard worker. Along with a strong sense of dignity, Mashirao can be described as sheepish and bashful, not very often enjoying the spotlight and being easily embarrassed. A recurring joke is that others view Mashirao as "plain," which profoundly upsets him.

Mashirao's Quirk is that he has a long, powerful, sturdy tail. His tail effectively functions as a third arm that he can use to grab things. Furthermore, it's attack power is strong enough to break objects made of metal, he can wrap it around enemies, and it can support Mashirao's body weight. Mashirao is incredibly adept at using his tail, combining it with his knowledge of martial arts to engage enemies in close-range combat, performing fast and acrobatic moves. His tail can also increase his speed and mobility by whipping it down against the ground to use it like a springboard.

(Source: My Hero Academia Wiki)

89897.description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1")
__Quirk:__ Earphone Jack
__Affiliation:__ U.A. High School
__Fighting Style:__ Medium Ranged + Support Combat

Kyoka is a petite, fair-skinned girl with a slender build. She has triangular, lazy-looking onyx eyes with notably long lower eyelashes, and rather small eyebrows. Kyoka has a pragmatic, unenthusiastic and teasing personality that is mostly shown to those she finds irritating. Kyoka is not always like this though, as she does enjoy socializing with others, in which case she is usually nice and friendly. Kyoka's Quirk (Earphone Jack) allows her to plug the jacks that hang from her earlobes into all sorts of things and channel the sound of her heartbeat into them; causing havoc inside the plugged objects. It's also used to catch sounds and vibrations from her surroundings.

alternative: Shikkoku Hero: Tsukuyomi (漆黒ヒーロー ツクヨミ)

89898.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm
__Quirk:__ Dark Shadow

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Fumikage is reserved, serious, and focused, albeit noble and valiant. Though not talkative, Fumikage will directly ignore questions or requests that seem in some way pointless. During combat, Fumikage is known to be fierce and dependable, with his strength and capabilities rarely being questioned. Fumikage is fond of darkness and other related concepts, considering himself a "creature of the dark" and employing archaic-sounding speeches that paint him slightly creepy or dramatic. 

Fumikage's Quirk "Dark Shadow" allows him to manifest a sentient shadow monster from his body that he can materialize and contract freely. Dark Shadow's energy is limited and can be drained by bright light. Dark Shadow retracts into Fumikage's body when it runs out of energy. The shadow entity's personality, strength, defense, and control depend on the lack of light. In bright light, Dark Shadow is weaker and smaller but still has considerable strength and defense and is easier to control, but in total darkness, Dark Shadow's size and parameters are drastically enhanced. It is powerful enough to rip out and cut down multiple full-grown trees easily. However, Dark Shadow is more difficult to control in the dark, causing it to rampage based on its own free will.

alternative: Shokushu Hero: Tentacole (触手ヒーロー テンタコル)

89899.description:
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'2")
__Quirk:__ Dupli-Arms

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Shouji is friendly and gentle, and he will work nicely with anyone. He is not the type to hold grudges, showing no ill will towards those that harm him unwillingly. Shouji is entirely selfless and willing to risk his life for anyone. He can be empathetic and understanding, but still shows a sense of maturity and responsibility that prevents him from acting under emotional impulses. He is very protective of his classmates, especially if they are hurt or injured. He is also quite thick-skinned, as he said he is used to being feared due to his appearance.

Shouji's Quirk grants him a set of tentacles alongside his arms. He can transform the tips of these tentacles to replicate other parts of his body (ex: mouth, ears, eyes). The duplicated body parts are more efficient than the originals; as a result, Mezo is able to hear better, see-through more angles at a time, and they grant him much higher degrees of strength. He uses these arms to talk most of the time through duplicate mouths, rather than his actual mouth.

alternative: Stealth Hero: Invisible Girl (ステルスヒーロー インビジブルガール)

89900.description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")
__Quirk:__ Invisibility 

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Tooru is a bubbly, cheery, and easygoing girl who does most things with an upbeat attitude. She is very socially eager and likes shopping, and her room suggests that she likes plushies and other cute things.

Tooru's Quirk is that her body is completely invisible. In addition to the stealth capabilities granted to her by her invisible body, Tooru can refract light that passes through her, allowing her to intensify the light into a blinding flash. She has further refined this application of her Quirk, achieving the ability to manipulate and redirect light-based attacks, such as [Yuuga Aoyama](https://anilist.co/character/127042/Aoyama-Yuuga)'s Navel Laser.

alternative: Fureai Hero: Anima (ふれあいヒーロー アニマ)

89901.description:
__Height:__ 186 cm (6'1")
__Quirk:__ Anivoice

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Contrary to his strong and powerful appearance, Kouji is very timid and quiet. He rarely speaks and prefers using sign language to communicate with his classmates. He hates violence due to his kind-hearted nature. Kouji appears to greatly enjoy the company of animals, as his Quirk allows him to interact with animals in ways others cannot. He owns a small rabbit as a pet.

Kouji's Quirk "Anivoice (生き物ボイス, Ikimono Voice)" gives him the ability to command any creature in the animal kingdom by speaking to them. Whatever command he gives, the animal will carry it out. However, he cannot exert control if they cannot hear his command. The target must also be a real animal and not merely animal-like. Kouji can also exchange information with the animals to find the locations of various people and potential enemies faster. Kouji has been shown to use the Quirk effectively with flocks of birds to create a smokescreen of animals and to attack an opponent, along with his use of insects to distract and attack his opponents. He has now also overcome his fear of bugs, so he often uses bugs to swarm opponents with numbers.

alternative: Sweets Hero: Sugarman (甘味ヒーローシュガーマン)

89902.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Quirk:__ Sugar Rush

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Rikidou is interested in sweets and baking, a valuable skill due to his Quirk. He is surprisingly talented at making sweets.

Rikidou's Quirk Sugar Rush allows him to increase his strength five-fold for three minutes. To activate his Quirk, he needs to consume 10 grams of sugar. When converting sugar into strength, his cognitive functions gradually drop, making him sleepy afterward. For every additional 10 grams of sugar he ingests, he extends the time of increased strength by another three minutes.

name.native: プリシラ・ウルサイス

89909.description: She is Irene's younger sister. She cares deeply for her sister, Irene, and is a lot more level-headed than her.

name.native: イレーネ・ウルサイス

89910.description: Rank 3 of Rewolf Black Institute. She wields the Gravisheath~!, until Ayato destroys it in their battle,!~ which influenced her fanged teeth allowing her to suck blood to power her ogre lux. She puts her sister Priscilla above all else.

89959.description: He claims to be Youko's fiancée and is attached to her, calling her "Big Sister." He tries to win Youko's attention by throwing money around.

89963.description: Akane's familiar. He is knowledgeable and knowledgeable about anthropology and archaeology. He has lived even longer than Chito, making him her senior as a familiar. He has a gentle personality and is always calm.

name.native: ヴィンセント・ヴァネッティ

89964.description: The boss of the Vanetti family who has an overwhelming presence, and is Nero and Frate's father. He is an object of Avilio's revenge.

89965.description: A young man who's hell-bent on revenge. His real name is Angelo Lagusa. He has a severe hatred for the Vanetti family, who killed his parents and younger brother. He hid away for seven years, but after receiving a certain letter, he appears in the Lawless district once more.

89966.description: The son of the Vanetti family's Don Vanetti. He has a bright and cheerful personality, and he values his family above all else. His sense of duty and empathy are strong, but he does not forgive traitors. He is an object of Avilio's revenge.

89967.description: Nero's subordinate and friend. He is mindful of his friends but gets heated up easily. He doesn't mind fighting as long as it's for his friends.

89968.description: A leader of the Orco family, who oppose the Vanetti family. His personality makes it impossible for others to know what he'll do next, and he might have madness brewing inside him.

89973.description: [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/89974/Hanakago-Saki)'s angel. He is rather calculating and manipulative, a trait that is considered by [Nasse](https://anilist.co/character/89232/Nasse) to be the reason why he was relegated to be a class two Angel, thus capable only of bestowing Saki with the red arrow.

89974.description: Saki is [Mirai](https://anilist.co/character/89231/Kakehashi-Mirai)'s classmate, his love interest, and coincidentally, a God candidate as well. ~!Once she learns that he does not intend to kill her, Saki joins forces with Mirai to deal with [Metropoliman](https://anilist.co/character/122073/Uryuu-Kanade).!~

89975.description: Yuma is in her second year of high school with her childhood and best friend Hotaru. She is in a relationship with Takeda, but she's very inexperienced as he's her first boyfriend and often times asks Hotaru for advice but gets unexpected responses instead.

89976.description: Hotaru is Yuma's childhood and best friend. Yuma was always around to protect her from various things such as bullying at school, but over time she has changed and even ended up having many boyfriends (though Yuma noticed she seemed uninterested).

89977.description: Fujiwara is Hotaru's ex boyfriend, and is friends with Takeda.

89978.description: Takeda is a classmate and friend of Hotaru, and is Yuma's first boyfriend. He comes across as a friendly, understanding guy who is aware of his girlfriend's shyness, and does his best to remedy the situation.

89979.description: Kotori's friend from another class, whose family runs a vegetable shop where [Megumi](https://anilist.co/character/284843/Iida-Megumi) often buys vegetables from.

89980.description: Kohei's friend since high school and childhood friend of Tae (Kohei's wife). He works at a restaurant. Kohei often depends on him to watch Tsumugi when he can't book a babysitter.

89981.description: A soldier from the Green World. She is the younger sister of Ageha who is quite airheaded and a bit immature but loves her sister very much. Unlike her sister, she is lazy and hates work.

89982.description: An android from the White World.

89983.description: A fairy from the Red World.

89984.description: The alpha-driver for Saya's team from the Blue World, Earth. Extremely clumsy and goofy yet also kindhearted and optimistic, Amane is the central point for the girls' motives. She loves teasing her friends, but is also easily hurt despite her carefree attitude.

90041.description: Rippou is the Legislator of the underworld and Haruitsuki's superior.

90107.description:
**Height:** 167 cm

Kusuo Saiki has an extremely uncaring, neutral personality. As a gifted psychic that can do anything he wants, he has long stopped caring about the world; however, he has shown to be extremely cautious, as he often runs from [Nendou](https://anilist.co/character/90108), the only person he fears and is prone to immediately teleporting to faraway places upon spotting an insect. Saiki has a sweet tooth, so he loves sweets, especially Coffee Jelly.

Fourteen days after his birth, Kusuo uttered his first word without moving his mouth and 1 month after birth he took his first step in midair. At the age of 1 was the first time Kusuo has voluntarily used his abilities, when his mother said they were out of mirin, Kusuo teleported away and returned with several bottles of mirin.

Kusuo Saiki is a gifted psychic. Having obtained his powers since birth, the first signs of Saiki's powers came from when he was able to hear the voices of his parents and he subsequently telepathically spoke back to them. Two months later, he demonstrated the ability to walk in the air. Saiki has stated that in three days, he can wipe out humanity. The full extent of all of his abilities is unknown.

90108.description:
Nendo has a simple way of thinking, but because of it, [Saiki](https://anilist.co/character/90107/Saiki-Kusuo) is unable to read his mind. Because Saiki is unable to detect Nendo's presence, Nendo is the only person who is able to sneak up on Saiki and making him think he will someday be a dangerous foe.

Nendo believes he is a friend of Saiki, but this is definitely not the case as Saiki despises Nendo. Saiki would often compare Nendo to a bug, as bugs are one of the few animals that Saiki cannot read the minds of.

90109.description: Kokomi Teruhashi is a student in [Kusuo's](https://anilist.co/character/90107/Saiki-Kusuo) class, considered very attractive by both women and men, who often stop and stare upon seeing her.

90110.description: Kuniharu Saiki is the father of Kusuo and Kusuke and the husband of Kurumi.

90111.description: Another psychic and one of two people outside of [Saiki](https://anilist.co/character/90107/Saiki-Kusuo)'s family to know of his abilities. He has the ability to see spirits and is haunted by the ghost of [Nendou](https://anilist.co/character/90108/Nendou-Riki)'s late father, but is only interested in using his ability to attract girls.

90112.description: Shun is a young man who considers himself to be the "Jet-Black Wing", a lone hero fighting against the evil organization Dark Reunion. He also believes his powers stem from a dark being living within his arm. To his friends and peers, including [Saiki](https://anilist.co/character/90107/Saiki-Kusuo), he's simply an immature kid playing a game that only he understands.

90113.description: Kurumi Saiki is Saiki's lovely mother.

90114.description: An overly hot-blooded, energetic, passionate student who enjoys sports and is constantly trying to get other people motivated. He is also [Saiki](https://anilist.co/character/90107/Saiki-Kusuo)'s class representative, but due to his nature, he is well-trusted by his classmates.

90115.description: A romantic and dreamy girl who easily falls in love with boys. She originally has a crush on Kusuo and tried her best to appeal to Kusuo. Kusuo in turn rejected her as hard as he could with his PSI powers. Kusuo even went as far as hooking her up with someone else but the relationship abruptly failed. She later develops a crush on Kaidou after he saved her from the unwanted attention of some guys at the beach.

90143.description: Elel's upperclassman and an angel. Although she has only one wing and can only use one eye, she is extremely kind and optimistic.

90144.description: An enhanced soldier, Expend, from the Green World and a top-rated soldier. She always has an emotionless look on her face and talks in monotone, but is quite arrogant and loves thinking about the world's destruction and just destruction in general. She used to be an energetic and hardworking rookie in Nya's squad until she had to be abandoned and was then modified even more, resulting her in becoming what she is now.

90145.description: Dr. Michael is a very intelligent young woman who comes from the blue world, Earth, and works on Seiran Island with the Progress to help eliminate Uroboros. She's actively trying to find an origin to this and to understand the intentions of the enemy.

90146.description: Stella's upperclassman. She adores her younger sister, Xenia, more than anything.

90147.description: Clara does her best to help Aurora, Dr. Michael, and her fellow comrades in planning a strategy that would prevent the Enemy to keep control of the corrupt Progress and the destruction of the worlds.

90148.description: Saya's upperclassman from the Blue World, Earth. She is a samurai-like girl who has mastered the ways of swordsmanship, and is quite strict towards her underclassmen.

90149.description: Mayuka's older sister and though she is serious and acts like a drill sergeant towards her, she is shown to love her very much.

90167.description: Reimi Sugimoto is Yoshikage Kira's first victim, and as a ghost, chose to stay on Earth in hope of finding someone to help her bring Kira to justice.

name.native: ヴァイオレット・エヴァーガーデン

90169.description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

Violet is described as a very beautiful young woman, being almost doll-like in appearance, with light-blue eyes, a fair complexion, and a slender frame. She is noted for her womanly semblance. She has waist-length golden hair with locks that frame her face. She either has her hair untied, in a low ponytail, or, after becoming a Doll, pulled up into two braided buns with two red ribbons. Due to losing her arms in the war, Violet received maneuverable prosthetic arms made of adamant silver. After the end of the war and on normal occasions, Violet is often seen wearing a white blouse, a green skirt and a pair of heeled brown boots.

~!Growing up as an orphaned child soldier in the army who was treated as a mere tool, Violet was not educated like a regular human being and did not understand human feelings well. She was raised and grew up as a person who had feelings, but couldn't perceive or express them. For this reason, she could be mistaken as emotionless, or apathetic. Even before she was found and taken into the army, she couldn't speak or understand speech, only understanding orders to kill. She did not possess any sense of right or wrong from the start; she didn't understand what could be considered righteous or erroneous. She merely chased after the adults who gave her orders. She followed the idea of "kill or be killed," thus she could kill countless people without feeling guilt or remorse. She did anything that was asked of her and always followed orders, which was a trait from her life as a soldier. Even after the war ended and she was discharged from the military, Violet had a habit of using words back from her life as a soldier; saluting, disliking being defenseless, and doing tasks without taking any breaks. She also continued to think of herself as a "tool" and believed that it would be appropriate to discard her if she can no longer be used as a weapon.!~ 

Violet is also aloof, expressionless and is said to have the attitude and the presence of a doll. Her expressions are mostly deadpan, so it is hard to tell her mood changes. This is why she sometimes has trouble expressing her own feelings and comes off as expressionless, which makes it difficult to get through her, but she will give a smile from time to time. Through her work as a Doll where she helps people write heartfelt letters, she slowly learns about human emotions, leading her to become more skilled at writing letters and conveying her clients' feelings, as well as becoming understanding of others. She is proven to be a good listener and someone who always thinks about other people's happiness.

name.native: ペテルギウス・ロマネコンティ

90170.description:
Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing sloth.

~!He was later killed by [Natsuki Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) with the help of [Julius Juukulius](https://anilist.co/character/90183/Euclius-Julius).!~

~!A hundred years earlier, Petelgeuse was a moderate, upright and rational man. He was close friends with [Fortuna](https://anilist.co/character/183732/Fortuna) and [Emilia](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia), enough to be described as being like a family. However, when [Regulus](https://anilist.co/character/174098/Corneas-Regulus) and [Pandora](https://anilist.co/character/137522/Pandora) attacked their village, he accidentally killed Fortuna through Pandora's power, causing him to go mad.!~

90171.description: An idol from Shanghai and StarRing's bright and cheerful mood maker. Her dream is to one day return to China to perform a concert.

90172.description: StarRing's self-styled leader who has an intellectual older sister-like appearance, but she is in truth an airhead. Her hobby is Lego blocks.

90173.description: A member of StarRing who has strong feelings that she doesn't want to lose to anyone, but she keeps those feelings hidden. She wants to be an idol like her great-grandmother, who was a stage actress. She studied abroad in China.

90174.description: Shadow's unit leader, and the youngest member. She is diligent, stable, and despite being the youngest she usually is the group's "straight man."

90175.description: A member of Shadow and a "lazy genius" who has a pet husky she is close with. She is from Dalian.

90176.description: A member of Shadow who is shy and likes to stay indoors. She likes to collect figures and merchandise, and her hobby is programming. Although she has good eyesight, she sometimes wears glasses.

name.native: アナスタシア・ホーシン

90177.description:
Anastasia Hoshin is the head of the Hoshin Trading Company and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica. Her knight is [Julius Juukulius](https://anilist.co/character/90183/Euclius-Julius).

Despite her surname being "Hoshin", she's not directly related to Hoshin of the Wilderness. She chose the name because she was inspired by his legacy.

90178.description:
**Height:** 173 cm (5'8")

Aldebaran, commonly known as Al, is [Priscilla Barielle](https://anilist.co/character/90186/Priscilla-Barielle)'s knight, though he claims to just be a subordinate. He has a frivolous personality and acts aloof, but shows insecurity regarding his disfigured face and wears a helmet to conceal it. Due to that, he is a man of both eccentric appearance and behavior.

~!Like Subaru, he is revealed to be from Japan and was summoned roughly 18 years before Subaru. Shortly after he was summoned, he lost his left arm in an unfortunate incident in the Empire of Vollachia. !~

name.native: エルザ・グランヒルテ

90180.description:
An assassin-for-hire from the Northernmost nation, the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, known as "The Bowel Hunter". Elsa wishes to make a trade for an insignia, as her client's wishes.  

~!Elsa Granhiert was an assassin working together with [Meili](https://anilist.co/character/175577) for an individual they refer to as "Mother" until her death.!~

90181.description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (4'7")
__Age:__ ~!400+ (Actual)!~

The caretaker of the library in [Roswaal](https://anilist.co/character/90182)'s mansion. 

She has a distinct way of speaking, adding "I suppose" and "in fact" at the end of some of her sentences.

~!Around 400 years ago, Beatrice was created by [Echidna](https://anilist.co/character/129330). She helped her with her experiments, such as the Sanctuary Barrier, though she wasn't told everything as she didn't know that [Ryuuzu Meyer](https://anilist.co/character/174072) would be sealed in a crystal. Sometime later, Echidna ordered her to stand guard over the library while she waited for "that person," an order which she diligently followed.!~

~!After numerous and painful attempts to convince her to leave the library [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573) succeeded, and Beatrice became his contract spirit.!~

name.native: ロズワール・Ｌ・メイザース

90182.description:
~!__Mental age:__ 400+!~
The lord of the Roswaal Mansion and a descendant of the original Roswaal.

He comes across as an eccentric due to his flamboyant appearance and odd speaking style, the latter which he shares with his grandmother. However, he harbors a more calculating and reserved side with a sharp political mind and gaze that reads others quite well.

~!It is later revealed that he is in fact the original Roswaal, Roswaal A. Mathers, who has been possessing his descendants' bodies to meet his teacher Echidna again at any cost, even if that means sacrificing himself or those close to him.!~

name.native: ユリウス・ユークリウス

90183.description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")

Julius Euclius is [Anastasia Hoshin's](https://anilist.co/character/90177/Hoshin-Anastasi) knight and a member of the Royal Guard. Julius lived with his family at the Euclius House. After his father, Klein Euclius died, he started to live with his uncle Alviero and he started to take care of Julius and became his adoptive father.

As a member of Lugnica's nobility, Julius acts in a proper fashion, always having an air of nobility and conviction. He is also considerate and doesn't forget to show care toward others. He also shows a strict side, giving out accurate assessments of others whether they're good or bad, which is a result of his upbringing as an elite, and in actuality, he believes that he and others can do better than they currently are.

Julius doesn't like those who forget their place, leading him to have bad relations with [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) for a while. While both have apologized to each other after the battle with the Hakugei, Subaru told him he still hated him. Julius said he didn't intend to be friends. They both became very intimate very quickly during the planning and attacking the Witch Cult. In the end, Julius directly considered Subaru as his friend.

name.native: フェリックス・アーガイル

90184.description: Felix Argyle commonly known as Ferris, is [Crusch Karsten](https://anilist.co/character/90185)'s knight. He is a beast human (demi-human).

name.native: クルシュ・カルステン
alternative: Goddess of War (戦争の女神; Sensou no Megami)

90185.description:
Crusch Karsten is the Matriarch of House Karsten and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugnica.

While normally calm and serious, Crusch is honest, sincere, right, being a type of person who is destined to stand above others, though she has talent and has worked hard to reach where she is now. She is already the head of her family, finishing her work better than her father. She prefers to act herself and has the pride of a warrior. Crusch is also gentle, often believing the false knowledge jokingly told to her by [Ferris](https://anilist.co/character/90184), and sometimes displays an airheaded side. Like her mother Helena Karsten, she is shown to be ruthless and reckless.

name.native: プリシラ・バーリエル

90186.description: The matriarch of House Barielle and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica. Her knight is [Al](https://anilist.co/character/90178/Aldebaran).

90187.description:
__Height:__ 7 cm

Puck is an Artificial Spirit that [Emilia](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia) was formerly contracted with. He is the current Great Spirit of Fire.

~!He is currently known as the Beast of The End.!~

~!Around 400 years ago, Puck was created by Echidna, though he had apparently left her by the time she moved into the Sanctuary. Seven years before the start of the election, Puck unfroze Emilia and began to act as her friend and mentor, and later on started to live at Roswaal's mansion where he was reunited with Beatrice.!~

Puck can be described as cute or adorable, thus his skin being pink around his cheeks. His fur is mostly grey with silver in certain spots (i.e. tip of the tail). His eyebrows are pretty small and rhombus-shaped. He also has a gold earring on his left ear. Sometimes, he carries a purple bag.

Puck is generally a nice spirit. He is very happy and stays at Emilia's side to protect her, affectionately calling her "Lia". He occasionally goofs around and gets along especially well with [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/90181/Beatrice). 

~!However, Puck's demeanor greatly changes in loops where Emilia dies, showing a complete disregard for anyone except her, and was even willing to destroy the world because of the condition in their contract.!~

90188.description: Descendant of a witch family that has been inheriting mysterious powers from generation to generation. She can endow magical powers to the things she touches with her hands and manipulate them at will. In order to hide that power, she has been traveling around Europe with her grandmother since she was a baby.

name.native: オルトフィーネ・フリーレリカ・フォン・エイルシュタット

90189.description: She is the only daughter and successor of the head of the principality of Eylstadt, Rudolph the 3rd. Thanks to her wisdom and kindness from when she was young, she has gained the love of not only the retainers but also the public. Because her father has fallen ill, she has been busy preparing against Germania's invasion in his stead.

90223.description:
Yuuri began skating at a very young age and aspires to become a great figure skater like his idol, [Victor Nikiforov](https://anilist.co/character/90225/Nikiforov-Victor). As stated by his teacher [Minako](https://anilist.co/character/169094/Okukawa-Minako), Yuuri is not a prodigy at skating, but his skills were honed by rigorous training, which also grants him good stamina. He is Japan's top figure skater; his greatest skating assets being his peculiar sense of rhythm and unique step. However, Yuuri succumbs to pressure easily following the death of his pet dog Victor, causing him to mess up at crucial moments. After failing his first appearance at the Grand Prix Final, his self-confidence was greatly affected, succumbing to extreme anxiety due to his shortcomings and performances in following competitions, thus leaving a black mark on his career, and resulting in his returning home after being away for 5 years.

Yuuri is kind, sensitive, and mild-mannered; he is also introverted and has a hard time opening himself up to others, preferring to be alone and practice ballet or ice skating than socializing with his peers. Despite having a lot of support from his family and friends, he greatly lacks self-esteem and is easily discouraged, causing bouts of anxiety. Contrary to how Yuuri sees himself due to his past failures, he is still considered Japan's best skater, having the loyal support of his fans and the juniors skaters that look up to him, much to his bewilderment. Under Victor's tutelage, Yuuri slowly becomes more self-assured and confident, aiming to reinvent himself and putting more input into his programs as he strives to win the 2016-2017 Grand Prix series.

name.native: ユーリ・プリセツキー

90224.description: A 15-year-old next-generation Russian figure skater who has won three consecutive junior world championships. Because of his looks, he is called the "Russian Fairy," but as soon as he steps off the ice he becomes vulgar and acts more like a delinquent. He is an ambitious person who believes without a doubt he will become the best in the world.

name.native: ヴィクトル・ニキフォロフ

90225.description: A 27-year-old "living legend" who has garnered the attention of the world. He is a skater who has won five consecutive world championships. He is popular with men and women of all ages, and he has a rock star-like charisma. Yuuri has been chasing after him since he was a child. Victor begins to take an interest in Yuuri for a strange reason.

96114.description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

A coolheaded dreamer from the countryside.

Originally hailing from the countryside, she enrolled in Tracen Academy after dominating the racing scene back home. She works to make her hometown proud, but try as she might, her clumsy side always comes out. At the academy, she's known as a fearsome gourmand, able to empty an entire pot of rice in the blink of an eye.

120229.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")

A student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the vocalist and rhythm guitarist in the band Poppin'Party.

When she viewed the stars one night as a child, she heard a sparkling "Star Beat" and had been searching for it. She believes that she found it after founding Poppin'Party. She also has a little sister named [Asuka](https://anilist.co/character/152338/Toyama-Asuka), who she calls "Aa-chan". It's not always clear who is the more responsible out of the two.

Cheerful and always in high spirits, Kasumi is a playful, active and generally positive girl that always finds something to be excited about. She is capable of sharing a mental wavelength with [Kokoro Tsurumaki](https://anilist.co/character/127272/Tsurumaki-Kokoro), something nobody else seems to be able to do. She is also the type to believe in (or fall for) the strangest explanations. However, Kasumi is also quite forgetful, tending to do important things by last moment (though unintentionally so). She loves to tease [Arisa](https://anilist.co/character/120230/Ichigaya-Arisa), but given Kasumi's kind personality, it's hard to tell if she is deliberately trying to provoke her or if she's oblivious. At times she can also behave melodramatically.

120230.description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")
__Instruments:__ Roland JUNO-DS 61 W and Roland AX-Synth (White)

Arisa is a first-year student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the keyboardist of [Poppin'Party](https://anilist.co/staff/153185/PoppinParty). In the second season of the anime, she is a second-year student and the student council secretary.

Arisa's grandparents run a pawnshop called "Ryuuseidou", and she lives in a big and traditional house, which includes a basement where the Poppin'Party members practice most of the time. When Arisa was younger, she started to learn the piano but then quit it halfway because she didn't have any motivation to continue - when she befriended [Kasumi](https://anilist.co/character/120229/Toyama-Kasumi) and heard about her plans to start a band, she picked it up again.

Arisa is an introvert whose hobbies include tending for bonsai plants and internet surfing. Even though she's basically a shut-in and admits being lazy by nature, she still manages to achieve excellent results in school. It was shown that in the past that Arisa was a lonely type. She is also quite moody and grumpy, and because of her sharp tongue, often gets into arguments with others (especially Kasumi). Usually, however, this is because she is unable to be honest with herself.

120231.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")
__Instrument:__ ESP Viper Bass

A student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the bassist of Poppin'Party. Outside of the band, Rimi is friends with Misaki, and similarly to Himari, one of Kaoru's fangirls.

Rimi's pink bass guitar is a hand-me-down from her older sister Yuri, who is two years older than her and is the lead vocalist of the band Glitter Green. During Rimi's high-school entrance ceremony, she heard Kasumi's self-introduction that was filled with boundless optimism, and this sparked her interest in her. Though Rimi wanted to change her cowardly and shy personality, she had initially been unable to do anything about it. At first, Rimi declined Kasumi's invitation to become a member of the band Poppin'Party because of her stage fright, but everything changed when she became inspired by Kasumi who sang on stage at Live House Space until Glitter Green, who were late because of the weather, arrived. She eventually found her confidence to overcome her stage fright and managed to perform with Kasumi and Arisa. After the show, she finally decided to join Kasumi's band as its third member and bassist.

Rimi is a shy and reserved girl who admires her older sister and often gushes over her. She tends to compare herself to the others frequently and wishes she could be more confident and be able to "speak up" more often. Rimi is cute and sweet-natured and often blushes when flustered, but at times can be very determined and strong as well. As Rimi used to live in the Kansai region, her Kansai dialect sometimes slips into her speech when she stumbles on her sentences or is very nervous; she is a bit embarrassed about​ this.

120232.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'5")
__Instrument:__ ESP Snapper Guitar

A student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the lead guitarist of Poppin'Party. The other members call her O-Tae.

Tae lives with her parents and 20 rabbits. She has considerable skill with the guitar, since she started playing it when she was in elementary school. As a huge lover of music, she started working part-time at a live house after entering high school. Tae at first doubted Kasumi's idea to audition at Space, because the band needed a considerable skill level to pass. But when Kasumi, Arisa, Rimi, and Tae performed for the first time in front of their friends and family, Tae realized how much fun she had performing with them and joined the band as its fourth member.

A relaxed individual who lives at a steady pace, Tae sometimes surprises the people around her with her keen observations and understanding of music. She carries a sense of knowing in her discussions with others, while always keeping an optimistic outlook on a situation. She loves rabbits and is constantly thinking about them, sometimes to the point of daydreaming and losing focus during a conversation. She affectionately refers to one of her rabbits, Odd-Eye (Occhan in Japanese and Oddie in the localized version), as her boyfriend.

120233.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
