__Instruments:__ Pearl Drums Antique Gold 4-Piece Reference Pure RFP924XSP-C102, Pearl Drums Electric Blue Sparkle EXX725/C 5-Piece Export Standard Drum Set with Hardware (1st season)

Saaya is a first-year student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the drummer of Poppin'Party. She became good friends with her classmate [Kasumi](https://anilist.co/character/120229/Toyama-Kasumi) during their high school entrance ceremony, and since then they often eat lunch together.

Saaya is the oldest of three children in her family; she has a younger brother named [Jun](https://anilist.co/character/152364/Yamabuki-Jun), and a younger sister named [Sana](https://anilist.co/character/152363/Yamabuki-Sana). Saaya's family owns the Yamabuki Bakery, at which she helps out, even during the school term. She also used to play in a girls' band called CHiSPA when she was in middle school, but quit because she didn't want to burden her bandmates and her family due to an incident that happened before a past performance. But thanks to Kasumi, who never gave up on her, and her mother's support, she regained her passion for music and her desire to perform in a band, thus became the last member of Poppin'Party to join.

A kind, empathetic and hardworking person who cares deeply about her friends and family, Saaya often lends an ear to Kasumi and [Rimi](https://anilist.co/character/120231/Ushigome-Rimi). She is generally level-headed and easygoing, and is like an 'older sister' to the other girls, always willing to help them out in hard times.

120241.description:
__Sigil:__ Worldwide Function
__Clan:__ Sunset Ravens

A player in Darwin's Game who is an information broker. Her sigil is analogous to Laplace's demon, a hypothetical being that knows the exact location and momentum of every atom in the universe.

120277.description: He's a salesman in the first sales department at the Genbu Shobou publishing company. Even though he's a salesman, he has a hard time conveying his thoughts in words to others. Starting with his meeting with Masashi, his language abilities begin to grow.

120278.description: He works for Genbu Shobou's dictionary editorial department. As his looks imply, he's quite frivolous. He has great communication skills, but he has no interest in compiling a dictionary. When he meets Mitsuya by chance in a bookstore, his skill at compiling a dictionary starts to manifest.

120279.description: A woman studying to be a chef. She is the granddaughter of Granny Take, who is the landlady of the building Mitsuya lives in. Kaguya also lives in the building, and begins to take an interest in Mitsuya.

120453.description: An elementary school student and Toto's younger twin sister. Yuyu is calm and collected, while also speaking with little to no emotion in her voice. Outside of Pure Illusion, Yuyu wears a cast on her left arm; however, while in Pure Illusion, she wields a power fist.

120454.description:
Cocona's childhood friend and classmate. Cocona relies on her for her cool and strong-minded personality. She cares for Cocona deeply, getting jealous when she gets a new friend.

~!Yayaka secretly works with FlipFlap's rival organization, Asclepius, to collect amorphous fragments. She is partners with Toto and Yuyu.!~

120455.description: A scientist who researches the, "Shards of Mimi," at FlipFlap, and created the TT-392 and other inventions. Hidaka is technical and excitable, especially when it comes to his work. He gives Cocona info about Pure Illusion from time to time; but, due to his excitability and technicality, often leads to it going over her head.

120456.description:
An unreadable man who is collecting the "Shards of Mimi," along with being the leader of FlipFlap. Salt is cold and almost always serious. Despite that, he does care about what happens to FlipFlap's employees.

~!Prior to leading FlipFlap, he was good friends with Papikana and Mimi; along with having a caring personality.!~ ~!Salt is Cocona's biological father.!~

120457.description:
An elementary school student and Yuyu's older twin brother. Toto, along with Yuyu, work under Asclepius to get amorphous fragments. Like his sister, he is calm and collected, even in dire situations. Furthermore, he speaks with little to no emotion. While in Pure Illusion, he uses a device that fires a barrage of missiles.

~!Toto, along with Yuyu, was created by Asclepius; thus making them the first two amorphous children.!~

120458.description: An operator that works for FlipFlap who, unlike Hidaka, is always worried about inventions.

120462.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")
__Affiliation:__ Special Fire Force Company 8
__Rank:__ Second Class Soldier

Since being accused of using his powers to cause the fire that took his family, his face's habit of tensing up into a bizarre smile when he gets nervous has earned him the derisive nickname of "devil". He joined the Fire Force to achieve his dream of becoming a hero and saving people from the fear of the flames, as well as uncover the truth behind his family's death twelve years ago.

Though a newcomer in the Special Fire Force, Shinra has posed a challenge to experienced members of the force and has even defeated a Captain. Being a Fire Soldier, Shinra is experienced in rescuing people and is strong enough to carry four people out of a building. While he mostly relies on his Ignition Ability in combat, he has exhibited skill in ordinary fighting as well, being able to pin an opponent to the ground and break their guard with a sturdy kick, as well as being capable of defending himself from ground-breaking attacks.

120466.description: A robot seemingly created by Hidaka. It has various functions and is often used by Papika. TT-392 is often beaten up, be it by friend or foe, but is always fixed. Contained in its body is a brain, which gives TT-392 its traits. ~!TT-392 is able to transform into a more muscular form.!~

120467.description:
Cocona's pet. It can grow and shrink and show various facial expressions. It likes small spaces. Its name is a reference to the German biologist Jakob von Uexküll. 

While in Pure Illusion, it has a human-like appearance.

120468.description:
A third-year at Cocona's school, and a member of the art club. Iroha paints many great art pieces, which Cocona sometimes is in awe of. She also believes that she doesn't deserve to wear nail polish, due to her past.

~!When Iroha was a kid, her parents were always fighting, so she'd visit her grandma's place often. During that time, she made a promise with her grandma, which she failed to keep, leading her to regret it. After Papika and Cocona keep up on the promise in Pure Illusion, Iroha's personality changes and she begins to wear nail polish.!~

120481.description:
[Kakushi](https://anilist.co/character/120482)'s kind daughter who loves her dad very much. As far as she knows, her dad works as a normal salaryman.

~!It is revealed that she has a step-brother, [Nantokaemon Ishikawa](https://anilist.co/character/175254).!~

120482.description: He writes vulgar manga and tries to hide it from his young daughter, Hime. He tends to be overprotective, which often leads to misunderstandings, but all he wants is for Hime to grow up well.

120540.description:
Kouhei Araki has been working at the Genbu Publishing house for several years, in the dictionary department. He's committed most of his time to his work and he's the responsible for a great amount of dictionaries. However his time is coming, and he's now looking to go into retirement and take care of his sickly wife.

In order to do this he's last mission is to find a suitable replacement  with the required abilities ton conduct his last project: "The Great Passage", a brand new dictionary.

After long unsuccessful searches, his choice lays upon Mitsuya Majime.

120562.description:
__Age__: 20
__Height__: 167 cm
__Grade__: University student
__Occupation__: Waitress

She behaves and acts like a delinquent and does very little work. When people reprimand her for her conduct, she retorts with trivia questions that are normally left unanswered. Higashida is one of the few people able to respond to her trivia questions, leaving her surprised. She has a daughter whom she usually leaves with her mother who dotes on her granddaughter too much, and just like her mother, seems to be smart.

120564.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm	
__Hair Color:__ Brownish Grey
__Eye Color:__ Grey

Muranushi is a young woman who shows little expression and speaks in a monotone, a trait inherited from her mother. She has the strange behavior of serving an invisible "elderly customer" despite claiming to not believe in ghosts as she has never seen one. Though rarely shows, she can be quite scary when she's angry. Like the rest of her co-workers, she has developed a trauma over Miyakoshi's home-made chocolates. And most of the time she doesn't talk. She claims that she actually want to smile but is confused by the reactions made by others who saw her smile, so she usually avoids doing so.

120565.description: A 20-year-old college student that was born and raised in another country. He can't speak or understand Japanese, but got hired by Sakaki anyways. Since Kondou was in charge of training him because she was the only one that could speak with him, his Japanese vocabulary is somewhat skewed.

120649.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

The vice president of the student council of Shuchiin Academy, member of the wealthy Shinomiya family, she is a multi-talented genius who can do anything if she sets her mind to it. Due to the way she was raised, she instinctively looks down on others and thinks of ways to use them for her own benefit. Kaguya rarely interacted with other people before she joined the student council, but that has begun to change. She is an incredibly sheltered girl, resulting in her lacking in several pieces of what might be considered common sense. She still doesn’t understand love very well, and her main objective is to make [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) fall in love and confess to her.

Later in the series: ~!She confesses her love to Miyuki Shirogane and they start dating.!~

~!In a [Oshi no Ko special chapter](https://anilist.co/manga/153520), it was revealed that she married Miyuki and changed her surname to Kaguya Shirogane!~

120675.description:
**Hometown:** Ohno City, Fukui

~! After the events of volume 11 of the light novel, he starts to date [Ginko Sora](https://anilist.co/character/120674/Ginko-Sora) !~

name.native: ハンス・オーベルマイヤー

120713.description: A major in the Eylstadt army.

120724.description:
__Instrument:__ Flute

Nozomi is a second-year student who used to play flute for the Kitauji High School's Bass Band Club in her first year. She and most of the first year members quit the club due to a conflict between the first-year members and the third-year members at that time.

Sound! Euphonium Season 2 Spoilers: ~!Nozomi tried to rejoin the band as well as get Asuka's approval. However, Asuka initially rejected due to the fear of Mizore possibly being affected by Nozomi's sudden return, causing a negative impact on Mizore's performance for the competition. However, due to an unexpected move by Nozomi to talk to Mizore causing her to run off, the latter managed to talk things out with Nozomi and restore their friendship. It is also revealed that Mizore played the oboe for the sole reason that it was the only thing that connected her with Nozomi.!~

Liz and the Blue Bird Spoilers: ~!In Liz and the Blue Bird, Mizore and Nozomi's relationship develops further. Mizore becomes less dependent on Nozomi and decides to go to a music school after graduating, while Nozomi decides to go to a regular university.!~

120726.description: Kei Nagai is an Ajin and the main protagonist of the series. Kei was first shown with an academic, serious personality. He is very intelligent and hardworking with ambitions to be a doctor who cures illnesses that don't yet have a cure; specifically to cure his sister [Eriko](https://anilist.co/character/290487/Nagai-Eriko). Despite Kei's lack of emotional investment in others, he seems to have strong personal values that he tries to live by. He demonstrates gratitude for [Kaito](https://anilist.co/character/120727/Kaito)'s help and cares about his welfare. He also doesn't begrudge [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/89797/Satou) for having killed others to free him, but does not support killing more people unnecessarily. (Source: Ajin Wiki)

120768.description: One of the protagonists, red-haired and energetic. She is a diligent and skilled craftswoman, but tends to get herself and others in dangerous situations nonetheless. She was homeless and on her own, before moving in with Mikochi, in the town of Makinata.

120799.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Nishikata is a middle school student in class 1-2. He sits in the back of the classroom next to [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800). He can't handle bitter things like black coffee, secretly watches/reads a romance titled "100% Unrequited Love", and gets frightened very easily. He does average academically.

120800.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

A middle schooler​ at an unnamed school. She sits at the back of class 1-2 next to [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799). Academically talented and physically capable, she claims her only weaknesses are her ticklish armpits and her inability to stop teasing Nishikata.

120801.description: One of the many members of ACCA. He is the second-in-command of the ACCA inspection agency, a small branch that monitors the other branches. He is a compulsive smoker, always carrying around his trademark cigarette case, earning him the title of "cigarette peddler". He is also absent minded, often forgetting his lighter despite his smoking habit. He maintains a dull uninterested demeanor, but has proven himself to be rather intelligent.

120808.description:
Childhood friend of Jean, he has been his friend at least since High School, he takes picture for some journal and sometimes keeps company to Jean and his sister since he is well known to the brothers.

~! He is the son of a man that is subordinate to the royal family, at very little age, he and his father abandoned their old lives to look over the princess who gave up royalty to see the world with that man, preventing his father of abandoning him to protect from that mission and live his life as his own, what didn't happened, he is one of the few ones that knew that Jean had real blood from the start, observing his relation to the coup from the background until telling him himself. He could go to school with Jean despite being much older than him by faking his age using only glasses. His real name is never revealed, Niino is the name he got in the new life and his father died in the same train accident that Jean's parents did. !~

120809.description: One of the five heads of ACCA.

120889.description: She travels with [Yuuri](https://anilist.co/character/120890) on their Kettenkrad. She can read and write in the current language, but not in kanji or Latin alphabets, because they became old languages in this world. She loves reading and collecting books she finds during traveling.

120890.description: Yuuri is a care-free, fun-loving girl. She is the direct foil and companion of [Chito](https://anilist.co/character/120889). She carries an Arisaka type 38 rifle and loves food more than anything else in the world.

120923.description:
The main protagonist. A biology teacher who is fascinated by demis and wants to learn more about them. He is occasionally referred to as "Iron Man" by his students, a pun on his bulky physique and his name. As he learns about demis, he starts to understand the problems they face, both as teenagers and demis, and strives to help them in any way he can.

(Source: Wikipedia)

120924.description: A highly energetic vampire. She usually avoids biting other people's necks, instead drinking blood packs sent by the government and using blood substitutes like tomato juice. Contrary to myths, she loves eating garlic and merely dislikes bright lights. She occasionally has the urge to nibble on someone, usually her sister. Despite her lackadaisical nature, she often strives to help others in need.

120925.description:
A shy dullahan whose head is always detached from her body, which has a blue flame coming from where the neck should be. Since she can't move her head by herself, she is always longing for contact with others. She develops a crush on Tetsuo, due to his kind and caring nature. She initially found it hard to make friends as people found it awkward to talk to her without bringing up her detached head in some way, despite her own acceptance of the concept and desire to joke about it. Incidentally, she does possess a neck, which allegedly exists in another space and serves as a wormhole between her head and body.

(Source: Wikipedia)

120926.description:
A timid snow woman whose body is always cold. She will sometimes spread cold air while experiencing negative emotions and is susceptible to heat. She initially dislikes her demi nature, fearing that she could harm others, though Tetsuo manages to show her that the only things she can actually freeze are her tears and sweat. She's also secretly a manga enthusiast and has a taste for multiple genres.

(Source: Wikipedia)

120928.description:
A succubus who works as a math teacher. Due to the aphrodisiac her body produces, she constantly has to take precautions to avoid inadvertently seducing her male students, such as wearing a tracksuit and taking early trains. While her nature as a succubus leads several males to become attracted to her, she herself develops a crush on Tetsuo.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name.native: 天真・ガヴリール・ホワイト

120937.description:
__Height:__ 144 cm

Gabriel is the main protagonist of the story and an angel who was the top of her class but turned into a 'Faillen Angel' after her newfound addiction to video games.

name.native: 白羽・ラフィエル・エインズワース

120938.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Raphiel is the second-ranked angel in Gabriel's class, who has since become a sadistic stalker who takes delight in teasing Satanichia and causing chaos for entertainment.

(Source: Gabriel DropOut Wiki)

name.native: 胡桃沢・サタニキア・マクドウェル

120939.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

The self proclaimed "Future Queen of Hell". Satanichia is a dimwitted demon who often thinks of petty ways to cause mischief which usually end in failure. She is often pestered by both [Raphiel](https://anilist.co/character/120938) and [a dog](https://anilist.co/character/133465).

name.native: 月乃瀬・ヴィネット・エイプリル

120940.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

The complete opposite of [Gabriel](https://anilist.co/character/120937/Tenma-White-Gabriel), Vignette is very responsible and often has to look after Gabriel, who lives in the same building as her, contrary to her actual role as a demon.

120969.description:
Kobayashi is a computer programmer and office worker. She finds herself living with a dragon named [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru).

Even though Kobayashi maintains a cool demeanor, she has been regarded as kind-hearted and reliable among her friends and colleagues. Level-headed and pragmatic, she stands as the source of reason when dealing with her dragon friends. However, when intoxicated, she tends to become rowdy and aggressive, especially in her interests in maids, and is not above subjecting Tohru to her drunken whims.

Before meeting Tohru, Kobayashi would don a stoic expression on her face. Now, she is more approachable and open to others, often seen smiling contentedly. Kobayashi often chastised Tohru for her lack of propriety on human standards. However, as time passes by, she grows accustomed to Tohru's quirks and would sometimes show small signs of affection and gratitude for the dragon, such as holding Tohru's hand or going out of her way to fulfill some of Tohru's wishes to ease her troubles.

120970.description:
__Faction__: Chaos
__Relatives__: [Damocles](https://anilist.co/character/172721/Damocles) (father)

Tohru is a female dragon with the ability to transform into a human girl. After [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) rescues her, she falls in love with her and decides to work for her as a maid.

As a Chaos Dragon, Tohru was raised to hate humans and was supposed to be a fierce and dangerous force of evil with nothing other than destruction in mind. However, this all changed when she met Kobayashi. She is now cheerful and kind to every human she meets, except for those who are real, or as it is in most cases, imaginary, threats to her love interest Kobayashi (such as [Makoto Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Makoto-Takiya)). She is also quickly influenced by what she sees on television or the internet and shares a fiery relationship with her rival, [Elma](https://anilist.co/character/120977/Elma).

As Kobayashi's maid, Tohru is a hard worker and cares deeply for the household, tending to all aspects of daily life, although this will often lead to trouble, such as when Tohru tries to feed her tail to Kobayashi, or when she molests Kobayashi's dirty laundry. Still, Kobayashi always shows her appreciation for Tohru's efforts and does her best to guide Tohru in the ways of modern life and human culture on Earth. Tohru is very protective of [Kanna](https://anilist.co/character/120974/Kanna-Kamui) and is essentially her mother figure and big sister combined. Having been accepted by Kobayashi even in her dragon form, Tohru quickly fell deeply in love with her. Even faced with Kobayashi's stoic character and often unrequited advances, Tohru never fails to make her unending love for Kobayashi known. Tohru's equally strong sexual attraction to Kobayashi often drives her to trickery, such as making a chocolate heart with a love potion secretly added, or finding different ways to attempt making Kobayashi eat her tail.

120971.description: An old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru), he is a male dragon with a strong distrust for humans which leads to him questioning much of Tohru's actions and ideals in his earlier appearances. He shares some resemblance to the traits of his namesake, such as his cold demeanour and disdainful mentality. He appears as a refined young man with long black hair and red eyes in his human form. ~!After Tohru's attempts to find a place to stay for him (under the name Takeshi Ooyama), Fafnir eventually comes to live with [Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Takiya-Makoto), becoming obsessed with video games and popular culture.!~

120972.description:
**Relatives**: [Georgie Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120978/Georgie-Saikawa) (older sister)

Riko Saikawa is [Kanna's](https://anilist.co/character/120974/Kanna-Kamui) friend and classmate in elementary school. A running gag involves her becoming overwhelmingly flushed with bliss every time she and Kanna make physical contact, along with her shiny forehead.

At first glance, Riko seems bossy and mean, but over time, she seems nicer as shown with Kanna, and very polite around people like [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi), although she originally mistook Kobayashi for Kanna's mother. She has a crush on Kanna and enjoys being around her. When being touched by Kanna or when she receives praise from her, she tends to grin goofily and get red in the face, becoming overwhelmed with excitement.

Though she initially tries to pick a fight with Kanna for her sudden popularity on the first day of her transfer to the school, she quickly becomes good friends with her. They often spend time with each other, walking home together from school and picking the other as their partner during school activities.

120973.description:
__Relatives:__ [Mr. Magatsuchi](https://anilist.co/character/248474) (father), Saori Magatsuchi (mother)

Shouta Magatsuchi is a young boy born into a family of mages in the modern world. He has shown to possess enough knowledge on the arcane arts to attempt summoning a demon. [Lucoa](https://anilist.co/character/120975) came out of a summoning portal Shouta created and starts living with him.

Shouta is an elementary school boy in 5th grade with both purple hair and eyes. His bangs reach well below his eyebrows. His appearance looks partly androgynous.

Shouta is quiet and shy most of the time when seen with Lucoa. When Lucoa attempts to seduce Shouta, he would run away with embarrassment and accuse Lucoa of being a demon.

As his father is [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s manager, she's asked to look after Shouta at times.

120974.description: [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970)'s friend from the dragon realm who got exiled from her world and wound up living with [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969) as well. She is very young by dragon standards, equivalent to a primary school student, which she attends as a third-year student bearing Kobayashi's surname later in the series. She initially assumes that Kobayashi seduced Tohru into staying and wanted her to return to their original world. ~!She grows attached to Kobayashi as the series progresses, viewing her as a mother figure.!~ Kanna's basis and tribal attire are inspired by the culture of the indigenous natives of Hokkaido and claims to be from Ushishir. She bears feather-like horns and a thin tail ending in a bulb, and is capable of charging with electricity.

120975.description:
**Faction**: Spectation

Quetzalcoatl often referred to as Lucoa, is a former dragon goddess and an old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). She was exiled from her seat after consuming cursed liquor that led her into a scandalous affair. As a member of the spectating faction, she does not interfere with any events involving the dragons or gods. She's by far the most powerful dragon in the series.

Quetzalcoatl appears to be laid-back and carefree who is rarely seen without a smile. She is wise, kind, and nurturing who often has advice for her younger kin. As a former goddess, she is better tuned to human customs, as seen when she explains to Tohru why Kobayashi was not receptive to Tohru's initial cleaning regimen. Despite this, however, Lucoa seems to lack some sense of dignity severely. She is not above using her body as a means of getting what she wants, as shown when she attempts to use her alluring figure as an offering to [Shouta](https://anilist.co/character/120973/Shouta-Magatsuchi), hoping to allow her to stay in his home.

Quetzalcoatl lives with Shouta but does not work for her stay. The two have a complicated relationship as Shouta sees Quetzalcoatl as a succubus or demon rather than a dragon. Quetzalcoatl will often try to get Shouta's attention, but due to her massive breasts, she often ends up flustering and embarrassing him instead.

120976.description:
[Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s co-worker who is initially believed by [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) to be a rival for Kobayashi's affections, but is really just an otaku who likes to talk about maids with her. Kobayashi helps him set up during Comiket every year.

~![Fafnir](https://anilist.co/character/120971) eventually decides to live with him to stay in the human world.!~

120977.description:
**Faction**: Harmony

Elma is a female dragon from the Harmony faction, the opposing faction of Chaos, which [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru) belongs to. She adopts the name Elma Joui as her human alias after she finds that she is unable to return to her world. Elma is the only dragon of the main cast who lives on her own in the human world.

Elma usually takes the form of a human woman with short black hair, large breasts, blue eyes, and a long spiral unicorn-like horn (which she can freely hide). In the anime and [Elma’s Office Lady Diary](https://anilist.co/manga/100756/Miss-Kobayashis-Dragon-Maid-Elmas-Office-Lady-Diary/), her hair also has purple tips. At work, she wears round glasses. She also wears a business suit which consists of a white shirt, light blue tie, a loose blue sweater, a grey blazer, and a dark grey knee-length skirt with light grey socks and black heels. Her casual attire in the anime consists of olive-green skin-tight trousers, a light blue jacket, a dark blue vest, and a yellow scarf. Her first outfit, which she also wears in her world while in human form, consists of a light tan scarf with a dark blue (sometimes black) leotard. She wears a purple kimono with pink piping and a dark blue sash over the leotard, with the top pulled down. She has bandages around her legs and sandals. She can be seen with a cobalt blue and turquoise tail (which she can freely hide). Sometimes, she carries around a long, brown trident.

In Elma's dragon form, she's a blue sea serpent with a brown horn protruding from her forehead and her brown trident is her tail. She can freely move around in the water because she is a water dragon.

120978.description:
**Relatives**: [Riko Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120972/Riko-Saikawa) (younger sister), unnamed parents

Georgie Saikawa is the older sister of Riko Saikawa. Her real name is Nae Saikawa (才川苗). She likes to pretend to be a housemaid.

Georgie wears an orange polka-dot maid outfit with a white apron. She also has a white cap and has her red hair in twin-pigtails. Her stockings are black striped.

Georgie is a sweet and gentle lady. She always supports Riko and her family. She seems to know a lot about maids and has a huge passion for them. She mentions that she's wanted to be one since she was a kid when she read a book about maids, but no one accepted her job offers, so decided to be one for her family.

Georgie and [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) automatically have a close bond as they both share an interest in maids. [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru) isn't fond of her and shows jealousy as she sees her as a rival through impersonating as a maid to win over Kobayashi.

(Source: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid Wiki, edited)

120989.description:
At the beginning of the story she's in love with [Narumi Kanai](https://anilist.co/character/120993/Kanai-Narumi), her childhood friend who is now her teacher. She immediately realizes that Narumi is in love with [Akane Minagawa](https://anilist.co/character/120991/Minagawa-Akane) and not her. She meets [Mugi Awaya](https://anilist.co/character/120990/Awaya-Mugi), who is in love with Akane, and starts a relationship with him to satisfy each other's loneliness.

She has different attitudes with each character: she's cheerful with [Sanae Ebato](https://anilist.co/character/120992/Ebato-Sanae), her best friend, timid with Narumi Kanai and sincere with Mugi because she trusts him a lot.

120990.description: He falls in love with [Akane Minagawa](https://anilist.co/character/120991/Minagawa-Akane) accepting the fact he has no chance of making her his. He is shown to be emotionless and revealed minimum expression, but as the story goes on, things start to change. He also shows a caring side for the ones close to him. Moka, a childhood friend, has deep feelings for Mugi, but he denies her feelings for him because he knows well he would ruin her.

120991.description: Akane Minagawa is a music teacher at Hanabi's school. She hides her true personality with a "mask" at the beginning of the story, but it's clear to see that she is very manipulative and takes pride in hurting others. ~!She is a compulsive cheater who would sleep with anyone to make her feel better about herself. She likes the feeling of being wanted and needed by someone. With that being said, both Mugi and Narumi fall in love with her, she doesn't mind playing with men and toying with their feelings.!~

120992.description: Sanae is introduced to the series as the best friend of the main character, Hanabi. She is shown to be a supportive character in the beginning, but when they're alone, she tends to be very possessive. ~!Her ill feelings towards men began when she was almost molested by a man on the train, although saved by Hanabi, leaving her scared. Sanae begins to have romantic feelings towards Hanabi as the story progresses.!~

120993.description: Narumi Kanai is amicable and benign. He is also a teacher at Hanabi's school, who he cares deeply about but never views her relationship wise, more like a precious little sister. ~!Narumi appeared to fall in love with Akane, although he knew that she had a hobby of sleeping with other men. He is prepared to cherish her for the rest of his life even if she cheats on him, he just cares about her happiness.!~

121006.description: She is the younger sister of [Masamune Makabe](https://anilist.co/character/81967/Makabe-Masamune) and currently attends middle school as a second year. She does not possess the same surname as her brother due to Masamune's choice of changing from Hayase to Makabe.

121007.description:
Masamune's class rep. She loves Yaoi and likes pairing Masamune to Kojuurou.

~!She confessed her feelings to Masamune once, but got rejected.!~

121008.description:
Yoshino is [Aki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/Adagaki-Aki)'s maid and follower. She seems to be a clumsy girl. However, beneath her clumsy and shy appearance she is actually extremely deceptive and cold, able to deceive and hurt Aki without a second thought. Unlike Aki, Yoshino easily gained weight from sweets.

~!Later it was revealed that Yoshino had disguised herself as Aki eight years before, rejected Masamune, and gave him the nickname "Piggy" due to jealously towards Aki's affection to him, but soon realized that her actions caused Aki to become estrange towards men. She has been regretting this and attempted to repay what she has done after Aki and Masamune reunited in high school.!~

~!She later falls in love with Makabe Masamune.!~

121011.description:
**Height:** 155 cm

Masamune's best friend who looks like a girl, but is actually a boy. ~!He has a small crush on Neko.!~

name.native: サンディ・マクドゥガル

121015.description: A student from the United States. She is quick to get along with anyone and has great physical abilities.

121016.description: She is a really sporty girl who rides a road bike that she got from her parents.

121017.description: She is a girl from a rich family who likes to take pictures.

121018.description: A new teacher at Minami High, who is in charge of Hiromi's class. Has rich knowledge of bicycles and is a good counselor to Hiromi.

121019.description: She is Tomoe's sister and her hobby is drawing.

121020.description: A kind-hearted, friendly girl who helps out a lot at her family's liquor store.

121021.description: She is the manager of the local bicycle shop.

name.native: ターニャ・デグレチャフ

121052.description:
While Tanya Degurechaff may look like a cute, adorable and innocent little girl, but deep inside, she is a cold-hearted and ruthless contractualist. This side of her is especially evident when she is in battle against her enemies; she shows no remorse as she weaves through a chaotic battleground inflicting maximum damage through whatever means necessary to accomplish her missions. Tanya strongly disapproves of failure and disobedience from her subordinates. She is loyal to her own job and always wants to finish it as soon as possible. Tanya will never let anyone discriminate against her appearance because of how fast she goes through the ranks in the military.

~!Tanya was originally a male salaryman who was murdered by a coworker after he fired them. Tanya was reborn as a young girl living in an alternate universe version of Europe during World War I. At just nine years of age, to avoid conscription into less work, Tanya volunteers for the Empire's Mages Division and is promoted to Second Lieutenant shortly after.!~

name.native: ハンス・フォン・ゼートゥーア

121056.description: Imperial Army General, Chief of Staff. A rationalist boasting enormous knowledge. Cooperates with [Rudersdorf](https://anilist.co/character/121059), Chief of Operations, to plan and implement strategies.

name.native: ヴィクトーリヤ・イヴァーノヴナ・セレブリャコーフ

121057.description: Viktoriya Ivanovna Serebryakov is a mage and a conscript in the Empire's army, and in the past were a member of Platoon 3 under [Tanya's](https://anilist.co/character/121052) leadership. After that, she joined the new Wing Battalion named "V601" to serve as Tanya's adjutant.

name.native: エーリッヒ・フォン・レルゲン

121058.description: A high-ranking officer in the Empire's Military Command, belonging to Strategic Headquarter. He is part of the General Staff's strategic advisory member that deals with the Empire's war tactics. A thoughtful and keen man, he quickly deduces the true nature of [Tanya Degurechaff](https://anilist.co/character/121052/Degurechaff-Tanya), calling her a demon. Even so, he trusts her ruthless efficiency to carry out tasks perfectly.

121101.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

He is a second year student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the student council.

Miyuki is a handsome young man with blond hair and blue eyes. Due to his constant sleep deprivation and nearsightedness, his eyes appear to glare. He usually wears the regular Shuchi'in Academy black male uniform adorned with the Aiguilette, the golden chain-like accessory around his neck. The Aiguilette symbolizes his authority as student council president.

Shirogane is a diligent student who, despite his underprivileged background, climbed his way to the top of his class through hard work and determination. Shirogane holds himself in high regard, consistently working to maintain his perfect image. He is textbook workaholic, enjoying his part-time job and often putting his own health at risk for the sake of his work. Due to his poor background, Shirogane values money greatly and goes to great lengths to not be wasteful, and generally dislikes expensive gifts.

~!Miyuki's mother left his family when he was a child. Miyuki's father's factory was shut down and currently has no stable employment. They live in an apartment that costs ￥50,000 (Approx $450) a month. Due to this grisly past, he has been led to a lifestyle of part time jobs and hard work. He passed the Level 2 Kanji Kentei exam and has passed Grade Pre 1 on Eiken. He has also got second place on the National mock exam.!~

~!Miyuki transferred into Shuchi'in Academy during his first year of high school on a scholarship. His first week was a disappointment in that a great majority of his peers were condescending to him because of transferring in. Miyuki was being recruited to serve as the new student council general affairs officer by the Previous Student Council President and helped clean up a swamp. There, he saw Kaguya Shinomiya saving a girl from drowning. It was at that moment where he was truly charmed by Kaguya. At the advice of fellow student council member [Momo Ryuuju](https://anilist.co/character/212390/Ryuuju-Momo), he adopted the confident genius personality he is shown to have at the story's beginning in order to attract her.!~

Even though he is obviously in love with [Kaguya Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/120649/Shinomiya-Kaguya), her wealth and talents greatly intimidates him, leaving him utterly terrified at the idea of confessing to her. He fears that all of his actions will lead Kaguya to look down him, causing him to overthink in many situations. Shirogane has never had a girlfriend and thus is actually quite clueless when it comes to romance, though his dignified demeanor leaves most of the students to think otherwise. Although he excels at studying, Shirogane has proven to be painfully talentless in a variety of other activities, such as sports, singing, dancing and more.

Despite this, Shirogane is unwaveringly kind and virtuous, never putting any of his goals above the well-being of others. He is extremely supportive and generous, willing to help any students with their problems, and will put aside his quest to get Kaguya to confess if it even has a chance of hurting someone else.

121102.description:
The treasurer of the student council of the Shuchiin Academy. He's extremely valued by [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101), given that he single-handedly manages all the school's funds. He's also terrified of [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649), though no one else is sure why that is. Yuu keeps to himself and rarely speaks up, often getting into trouble when he does. He has a depressed outlook on life while having an inferiority complex. In contrast to his attitude, he is willing to help those in need and will sacrifice his pride if need be. Unlike his high school self, he had a much different outlook and demeanor during middle school.

Later in the series: 
~!Ishigami develops a crush on Tsubame that he inadvertently confesses his feelings for her at the school's cultural festival. Ishigami does not realize that his actions were perceived as a confession by the rest of the student body and is therefore oblivious to the implications of having given Tsubame a heart-shaped gift (considered akin to a confession in Shuchiin tradition). After some convincing by Kaguya, Tsubame decides to seriously consider Ishigami's confession, with her original intention being to let him down as gently as possible. It isn't until Ishigami watches Tsubame's performance of the traditional play that gave rise to the aforementioned tradition that he realizes his actions had unintended meaning. Even then, Ishigami's thickheaded nature prevented him from recognizing the full meaning of his actions: a straight confession!~

~!On the day of the third years' graduation ceremony, Tsubame finally has an answer for Ishigami's proposal. Despite Ishigami doing his best to convince Tsubame to accept him, Tsubame ultimately rejects Ishigami. Tsubame promises Ishigami that the two of them will remain friends and Ishigami sees her off with a smile and a gift of flowers. Afterwards, Ishigami breaks into tears, finally learning what heartbreak is like.!~

121103.description:
The secretary of the Shuchiin Academy student council. She could not be predicted, her thoughts could not be read. A natural disaster who unconsciously threw everything into chaos simply by being present, also known as __Subject F__.

~!In chapter 222 of the manga, Chika reveals that she played piano because she wanted to be perfect, and she becomes a prodigy at the piano. The expectations of her family and her fans rose, forcing her to practice more. She quit piano after [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649/Shinomiya-Kaguya) told her to just quit if she didn't like the piano. Soon after Chika challenged Kaguya to a game battle and if she won, she would get to become Kaguya's friend. In the end, she becomes Kaguya's first friend.!~

121104.description:
Ai Hayasaka is a second-year student at Shuchiin Academy and a valet of the Shinomiya family. She is a member of the Hayasaka family, who have served the Shinomiya family for generations, gaining their trust.

Having been personally assigned to enter Shuchiin Academy with her, Ai supports [Kaguya Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) in her high school life and has been a part of Kaguya's life for ten years. Because of their close relationship, Ai is one of the few people around to which Kaguya's amiability is not an act.

Even if she demonstrates maturity as a valet, Ai still has the concerns of a young girl, such as caring to be in fashion and going out with friends, even if she does not have much time for herself due to work.

Ai helps Kaguya with the struggles about her feelings for [Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101).

~!She later leaves her job as a maid to Kaguya but still continues her friendship.!~

~!In the Doujin-ban universe, she starts dating and later gets engaged to Shirogane!~

name.native: フランシス・スコット・キー・フィッツジェラルド

121164.description:
__Height:__ 191 cm (6'3")
__Ability:__ The Great Fitzgerald

Francis poses as the leader for an american secret society, ''The Guild''. Said organization is composed by rich and notorious individuals, who all have some type of powerful influence in the USA. His ability, ''The Great Fitzgerald'', allows him to power up his own atributes and traits, according to the money he spent from his countless fortune. A fierce man, who loves his family, and would do pretty much anything to achieve his goals.

121168.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Ability:__ Vita Sexualis

Ougai Mori is the boss of the Port Mafia. Ougai is analytical and tactical. He often puts on overdramatic acts but rarely breaks his composure internally. 

He has been shown to be somewhat ruthless and unfaltering when it comes to violence. He hasn't, however, shown any particular enjoyment from killing. His ruthlessness comes from his pragmaticism.

Although he can be intimidating at times and emit a scary formal aura, he is often polite to the point of seeming approachable. He is polite to allies and enemies alike.

121309.description: Erotic illustrator for SOX, and double awarded painter who goes to Tokioka Academy with the rest of the main cast.

121310.description: Member of the Tokioka Academy Student Council.

121329.description:
He is a third-year student at Hakone Academy and the vice-captain of the Hakone Academy bicycle club during the second year 

Prior to joining the Hakone Cycling Club, Kuroda was somewhat arrogant and conceited because of his athleticism and skills in nearly every sport. However, after Arakita derided him and refused to fight him anywhere but the road, winning a race against the new member, Kuroda learned to observe around and take everyone into consideration rather than stay egocentric. He gained enough respect to earn himself the position as the vice captain of the team in his third year. Kuroda himself isn't above scolding and poking at other members, and also shows a composed personality when he tells other members of his team to control themselves. 

He seems to be skilled climber that's well-respected by Izumida.Izumida also comments that he has become a more tactical rider, to the point that he would deliberately hold back and not challenge for the Climber's Checkpoint in order to help the team win. Arakita also noticed he has become more flexible around his knees, making him better at cornering and overtaking on the outside, even when it only lasted for a brief moment in the Third year's Farewell Race. In season 4, Izumida noticed his teamwork with Ashikiba, so he worked hard to learn to pull on the flats in the winter, making him an all-rounder, or as he suggested, a puncheur because his muscles look defined, they are very squishy and flexible, as a spectator in the race attests.

He also learnt to ride super close while cornering from learning from Arakita, but his skills seems unrefined, as he rides so close to the edge to the point that he drew blood from scraping his shoulders on the advertisement boards.

121355.description:
He's one of the male protagonists of the Fukumenkei Noise series. He's a high school student and guitarist of 'No hurry to shout'.
He is a boy with blue eyes and long eyelashes, black hair, partly gathered in a small ponytail. He also has a mole next to his left eye.
He has a slim complexion, and his stature is inferior to the general male stature. He can usually be seen wearing his school uniform.

121356.description:
He is one of the male protagonists of the Fukumenkei Noise series. He is a high school student and bass player of 'Silent Black kitty'.
He has black hair and his eyes are honey colored. He always seems to have a serious expression. He has worn glasses since he was little.

121357.description: He is a high school student and bassist of 'In no hurry to shout'.

121358.description:
She is one of the main characters of the Fukumenkei Noise series. She is a high school student and vocalist of 'Silent Black Kitty'. She was an 'In no hurry to shout' member before.

Miou has dark, short hair, with a fringe to the left side, and her eyes have a violet hue. She has a thin silhouette, and can usually be seen wearing her school uniform.

121359.description: He’s one of the male protagonists of the Fukumenkei Noise series. He’s a high school student and drummer of ‘No hurry to shout’.

121408.description: A girl with the ability to teleport and create anything she can imagine, Sana was being studied at a secret research facility until she decided to escape. She eventually crosses pass with Zouroku, who decides to take her in.

name.native: ミリアム・C・タチバナ
エリアス・エインズワーズ

121430.description:
He is an ancient magician with both human and fae characteristics. Despite his appearance, he is gentle and polite with humans and shows a great interest in them. He understands why humans feel the emotions they do, but has never experienced them himself. 

One day, he buys [Hatori Chise](https://anilist.co/character/88344/Chise-Hatori) from the black market and makes her his Mage Apprentice.

121446.description:
Nomura is a pacifist by nature, but his freedom-loving ideals as well as his cheeky attitude often finds himself rebelling against figures of power and authority. Ultimately, though, he’s a relatively laid-back guy with a cheerful demeanor.

Nomura was originally a talented user of the Jigen-ryū school of Japanese swordsmanship; however, due to extremely harsh and rushed training enforced by his former master, his body was broken beyond repair, which made him incapable of picking up a sword ever again. Instead, he developed his capabilities in hand-to-hand combat, and eventually crafted a powerful technique known as “Madan” (Magic Bullet). This technique utilizes muscle control to focus his strength into the palm of his hand, allowing for a devastating palm strike akin to a shock-wave from any position he so chooses.

121447.description:
Leader of the Tenka Goken. Onigawara is known for being merciless and a prominent hater of men, causing many to quit the academy. However, she softens significantly after meeting Nomura, showing many signs of affection.

When her father abandoned their family after having an affair, Onigawara had to deal with the mental backlash of her distraught mother. Because she resembled her father, her mother would call her “ugly” or “ the child of a demon” and would demand her to wear a demon’s mask whenever she was around. This would cement the thought that Onigawara was hiding her “shameful self” by wearing the mask and continued to do so even after she left home.

Onigawara is a skilled practitioner of the Kashima Shinden Jikishinkage-ryū school of Japanese swordsmanship. This style places an emphasis on proper breath control, allowing for improved strength and speed.

121449.description:
A deranged psychopath carrying an unhealthy obsession with [Fudou Nomura](https://anilist.co/character/121446/Nomura-Fudou), seemingly stemming from a twisted sense of love where she demands his total submission before her and is willing to kill him otherwise. She earns the title of “Empress” after defeating two members of the Tenka Goken simultaneously.

Amou specializes in Uechi-ryuu, a traditional style of Okinawan Karate that emphasizes toughness of the body by being attacked and pained while practicing nukite based counter-attacks to a point of being able to respond reflexively. This is the basis for her technique “Auto-counter”.

121453.description:
Tsukuyo is a child prodigy that skipped several grades, making her the youngest member of the Tenka Goken. Despite being so young, however, she is unquestionably the strongest member. 

While blind, she has excellent hearing, to the point that she is capable of hearing most things going on in the academy. Even though she carries a calm and collected demeanor, she can still act childishly, much like the many instances where she likes to show off her knowledge resulting in long rambles.

Tsukuyo is a skilled user of the Yakumaru Jigen-ryū, the descendant style of the Jigen-ryū that Nomura practiced.

121457.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

A member of the Tenka Goken. Satori is said to be reminiscent of a creature of sorts attempting to imitate human-like behavior. Since she primarily lacks the ability to empathize, she tends to act in various extreme ways as a means to compare and explore herself and others. As a result, she can be incredibly unpredictable as said actions are often irrational.

~!Her real name is Misogi. The name “Satori” originally belonged to her twin sister currently known as “Misogi”. The original Satori, fueled by hatred and jealousy towards Misogi, attempted to push her sister off the top of a jungle gym, however, Misogi ended up being the one to throw her off. Since that day, Misogi started imitating Satori’s behavior, and eventually took on her entire identity to where even their mother started calling her “Satori”.!~

Satori is a user of the Keishi-ryū, a kendo style that consists of 10 different kata of several Ko-ryū and is the style used by the Japanese Police Force.

121458.description: While Hanasaka fronts a blatantly evil persona, she only acts that way for the sake of her beloved pet bear, Kyoubou. Many have attempted to get rid of Kyoubou from the premises of the academy, so Hanasaka rose to the position of one of the Tenka Goken so that no one would oppose her. Hanasaka is a user of the Taisha-ryū.

121460.description: Mary is a prim and proper French-Japanese student and is a member of the Tenka Goken. She is an expert in western-styled fencing in combination with techniques of the Jigen-ryū style. She is also into executing the buriburi style of torture.

121470.description:
__Height:__ 176cm 

Izumi Masamune is the protagonist of the story. He is a novelist that goes by the pen name "Izumi Masamune," his same name. He started out his novels in middle school after winning a light novel writing contest. He hopes to get closer to his younger step-sister.

121471.description: Sagiri's classmate and the class president.

121472.description: The editor for Masamune and Yamada at a publishing company.

121473.description:
Yamada Elf is [Izumi Masamune](https://anilist.co/character/121470)'s fellow author and neighbor.

~!Her actual first name is Emily, as she confesses to Masamune during a stroll through the forest that served as the model for the Elven Forest in Emily's debut novel.!~

121477.description:
Gourai is a test model for Frame Arms Girl that was mistakenly delivered to Ao. When it comes to being a Frame Arms Girl, the system, weapons, and equipment, she is a wealth of knowledge. However, her knowledge is lacking in what human emotions like “happiness” and “sadness” are.

(Source: Honey's Anime)

121478.description:
Ao is an extremely normal first year student in high school. When Frame Arms Girl Gourai is accidentally delivered to her, she boots it up. As a result, she becomes the only person in the world to have a Gourai model. Ao is completely in the dark when it comes to Frame Arms Girls and plastic models, but she learns that if she battles, she can win prizes. So, she decides to treat it like a part time job and tries out a test battle with Gourai.

(Source: Honey's Anime)

121482.description: A proud F.A. Girl who has a particularly obsession with the Sengoku period and specializes in ninja techniques. She is characterized by her eyepatch and antiquated speech patterns.

121484.description:
Baselard may appear to be an innocent young girl, but actually she is sharp and has bountiful knowledge. Baselard loves things that shine and sparkle, so she unintentionally collects them. She loves to cause problems, so if everyone gets sucked in, she is pleased with herself.

(Source: Honey's Anime)

121485.description:
Stylet is a tsundere and is very proud. However, when she is with Baselard and Gourai, she plays the straight man. In order to dispel the frustration she feels from losing when she fought Gourai, Stylet lives with Ao in her room.

(Source: Honey's Anime)

121514.description:
**Height:** 163 cm
~!**Age after timeskip:** 25-26!~

She lives in a small town called Itomori. She is a part of her family's shrine and participates in old traditions as a shrine maiden with her younger sister [Yotsuha](https://anilist.co/character/121518/Yotsuha-Miyamizu).

121516.description:
~!**Age after timeskip:** 22-23!~

He lives in Tokyo, juggling between his part-time job at an Italian restaurant, his relation with his friends, and his dreams to eventually become an architect.

121530.description:
__Height:__ 153 cm

Yoshino Koharu is the main heroine. She grew up in a rural area in Japan and went to college in Tokyo in hopes of landing a job in the city, but after failing to land a job, she gets an offer to work for the tourism department of Manoyama village.

~!At a young age, Yoshino had visited the Chupakabura Kingdom and became its 100,000th visitor. The milestone was celebrated by allowing her to don the cape and crown usually worn by the queen and having her photograph taken with the Manoyama community.!~

121533.description: Ririko hates her countryside town of Manoyama Town, but she does not have the courage to leave. After graduating high school, she was not able to find a decent job, so she ended up becoming a hikikomori spending her days surfing the net. Ririko has an issue with communicating. She does have one friend. That person is her childhood friend [Shiori](https://anilist.co/character/121534/Shinomiya-Shiori).

name.native: セレジア・ユピティリア

121560.description: The heroine of the franchise "Elemental Symphony of Vogalchevalier".

121561.description:
A mysterious girl who wears a military uniform and can freely travel between worlds. She is the one who brought the other fictional characters into the real world. She claims to do this in order to overthrow their creators and force them to improve the living conditions of their worlds. However, she is actually aiming for the destruction of the real world.

She is capable of flying and manipulating dozens of swords through telekinesis at once for both attack and defense.

~!It is eventually revealed that she is a fan-fiction character from an online video called "Altair: World Étude," created by Souta's friend Setsuna Shimazaki before her suicide.!~

name.native: メテオラ・エスターライヒ

121563.description:
An NPC from the open world RPG "Avalken of Reminisce." She is an intellectual person who is silent, stoic, and speaks in a dry tone. However, she tries her best to be to make puns to cheer others up. She is also a bit of a glutton, enjoying real world food.

She is capable of flight as well as creating magical shields, but lacks offensive abilities, relying on real world artillery to make up for her weakness.

~!Her Creator, the planner of "Avalken of Reminisce," is already deceased.!~

121612.description:
__Nationality:__ Japanese
__Occupation:__ High School Student 

Aimi Tabata is one of Hiyori's friends from school. Not much has been shown about her personality. However, it is known that she is kind and supportive of Hiyori. She seems to be reasonable, calm, and mature. She often worries for Hiyori when she falls asleep (due to her soul slipping out of her body).

121616.description: Makkachin is Victor Nikiforov's pet poodle and constant companion.

121629.description: He is the fallen angel since he dared to disobey the God himself. He now tries to get hold of the God's key.

121638.description: Glenn is lazy, and constantly bored by everything, with his primary focus being sleeping. He becomes the substitute teacher in [Sistine](https://anilist.co/character/121639/Fibel-Sistine)'s class, after the retirement of her favorite teacher. While he may seem incompetent, he is actually very skilled in magic, but not in the traditional sense. Glenn used to be as passionate about magic as Sistine, but became disillusioned by it due to [Sara Silvers](https://anilist.co/character/191611/Silvers-Sara)' death and his past as the infamous military assassin known as "The Fool." He developed his own type of magic, called "The Fool's World" which negates the activation of all magic within a certain radius, including his own. However, this does not nullify spells that have already been cast. While nullifying the enemies' magic he then beats them using superior hand-to-hand combat skills. He cannot use combat magic coherently due to it being far away from his area of expertise, but he has an in-depth understanding of the concept of all types of magic, which makes him a good instructor.

name.native: システィーナ フィーベル

121639.description: Sistine admires magic greatly and wishes to discover the secret of the Flying Castle, which no one knows. She maintains a strict, no-nonsense demeanor throughout, and often scolds [Glenn](https://anilist.co/character/121638/Radars-Glenn) for his lackadaisical attitude. She initially hates Glenn, believing him to be as incompetent as he looked due to his lack of enthusiasm. When he actually starts doing his job, however, she begrudgingly begins to respect Glenn as a highly effective teacher. Her personality and appearance resembles [Sara Silvers](https://anilist.co/character/191611/Silvers-Sara), whom Glenn was very close to. As the series progresses, it seems as though Sistine has developed feelings for Glenn, but is too shy to speak of them. She is called "Sisti" by [Rumia](https://anilist.co/character/121640/Tingel-Rumia), and "White Cat" by Glenn.

name.native: ルミア ティンジェル

121640.description: Rumia is [Sistine](https://anilist.co/character/121639/Fibel-Sistine)'s best friend who lives with her family. She is close to [Glenn](https://anilist.co/character/121638/Radars-Glenn), who often treats her well, in contrast to the teasing that Sistine faces from him. ~!Rumia's real identity is the Princess Ermiana El Kel Alzano, the "cursed" princess who was supposed to die three years ago. She possesses a high level of spiritual essence, marking her a primary target pose by greedy scientists. She remembered Glenn being the one who saved her life when he was the infamous assassin named "The Fool" three years ago.!~

name.native: クトリ・ノタ・セニオリス

121661.description:
She describes herself as "responsible and mature." Chtholly is a Leprechaun Fairy Soldier who lives at the Fairy Warehouse on Sky Island 68. She is the oldest fairy of her generation and she is also the wielder of the strongest sword of the Emnetwiht race, Seniorious. As the oldest fairy of the warehouse, she tries to be a good example for the little ones, she even avoids eating sweets in front of the little ones because she thought it was childish to do so.

She's not very honest with herself.

121700.description:
__Height:__ 145 cm
__Farm Identifier:__ 22194

Norman seems to be logical, well-meaning, and devoted, with a slightly naive side. He can easily plan his actions in advance and he anticipates on other's actions. He is one of the top 3 ranking orphans, along with [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/121725/Emma) and [Ray](https://anilist.co/character/121724/Ray). Norman loves Emma and he is helpful and loyal towards her.

121701.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm
__Farm Identifier:__ 73584

Isabella worked as a Mama at Grace Field House, taking care of the orphans that reside within.

121702.description: Sister Krone runs the Grace Field House orphanage with [Madam Isabella](https://anilist.co/character/121701/Isabella). She has the desire to usurp the position of "Mama" from Isabella.

121703.description:
A small, timid, and unfathomable girl who grows attached to [Raidou](https://anilist.co/character/121704/Raidou-Shouta) after he begins talking to her. She has a bad sense of distance.

~!She eventually confesses her love to Raidou.!~

121704.description: A tall, calm, and generally nice guy who looks after [Reina Aharen](https://anilist.co/character/121703/Aharen-Reina). He wants to help her with her problems, despite them not being his own to deal with.

121705.description:
__Race:__ Shinki

Mayu has a very honest personality and a strong sense of justice. During the time she worked for Yato, she couldn’t stand his attitudes because not only he always lazed around, but he also often talked about killing and didn’t seem to care about humans that needed his help. Because of this she complained a lot and always insulted and badmouthed Yato after she quit.

Despite her attitudes towards Yato, she also respects Yato and cares for him. She often gets worried whenever Yato got into trouble even when she is serving Tenjin. At one point she volunteered herself to help Yato, who was impure due to Yukine’s actions.

121724.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm
__Farm Identifier:__ 81194

As one of the three perfect students at the orphanage, Ray is very logical, smart, cunning, extremely patient and is usually shown to read books by himself. Although he is extremely book smart he says that he never liked to study. According to data obtained by sister [Krone](https://anilist.co/character/121702/Krone), his weakness is that he gives up easily.

121725.description:
__Height:__ 145 cm
__Farm Identifier:__ 63194

Emma acts as an older sister to the other children and loves her family very intensely. She is sweet, heroic, caring, and has a big heart. She can also be naive and reckless, and doesn't hesitate to put herself at risk to ensure the safety of the group. The other kids describe her as having monster reflexes and an astounding ability to learn, which enables her to think fast in difficult situations and makes her a very good strategist. She could be considered a beacon of hope for the rest of the children.

name.native: オタベック・アルティン

121765.description:
Otabek is a Kazakh figure skater. He is generally stoic and tends to be introverted, preferring to spend time alone rather than with other skaters. While he himself is shy and quiet, his skating is very eloquent and expressive.

He is hugely popular in Kazakhstan and is considered a national hero.

121775.description:
**Height:** 165cm

Fumino is a genius with liberal arts but terrible with math. Left-handed. She is a blue-haired girl whose dream is to be able to reach for the stars just as how her mother dreamt of studying the stars. Her father is a professor and teaches Math, but she genetically relates to her mother where they both can't do math. Along with being one of the main heroines of the series, she teaches [Yuiga](https://anilist.co/character/121777) about the feelings of a woman, not knowing that she would later fall for him in the series. She is quite insecure with her chest size, and tends to hurt anyone who makes fun of it, such as [Ogata](https://anilist.co/character/121776) comparing her test scores in which she thought it was a comparison between their chests.

121776.description:
**Height:** 143cm

Rizu is a genius with math and science but terrible with liberal arts.

Rizu is one of the four students that is being tutored by Yuiga in Liberal Arts. She is smart when it comes to Science and Math, but is terrible with liberal arts. She is also terrible at understanding people's feelings and reading the mood of the conversation. She tends to see everything in a logical manner whenever something related to emotions such love and awkwardness arise.

121777.description: Yuiga has been appointed by the principal as [Rizu](https://anilist.co/character/121776) and [Fumino](https://anilist.co/character/121775)'s tutor to get them into their desired universities. Later is also asked to tutor [Uruka](https://anilist.co/character/121778).

121778.description: Uruka is a genius when it comes to sports, having earned several titles in freestyle swimming, but her lazy nature and hatred for studying has made her terrible with her other academics.

121810.description:
Student of class 3-1 who belongs to the track and field club. She's an easy going character, but can be self-conscious and timid at times. When feeling nervous, she would squeeze her potato mascot plushie. Akane moved to Kawagoe, Saitama when she was a fifth grader in Primary school. ~!She secretly starts dating Kotarō, but later reveals this to Chinatsu and Takumi, who inform the class about that.!~

~!When she is forced to move to Chiba due to her father's work, she becomes anxious over her future relationship with Kotarō, but cheers him on as he tries to get into the same school as her. When Kotarō fails to get in, she again becomes anxious, but finds new hope when she reads his online story, which is a promise to love her forever. The final shot at the end of the anime shows them married with a kid years later.!~

(Source: Wikipedia)

121812.description:
Student of class 3-1 who belongs to the literature club. He's aiming to become a novelist and is inspired by Osamu Dazai & Natsume Soseki who are both Japanese novelists. He generally has a calm and composed attitude. He initially is too embarrassed to show his novels to other people, but upon learning Akane's love for running and openness to use embarrassment as a method of improving oneself, he begins to open up to that prospect. From early childhood, Kotarou has received instruction in the performance of traditional dance and festival music accompaniment, Hayashi, at a local Shinto shrine. ~!He secretly starts dating Akane, but later reveals this to Takumi.!~

~!When Akane is forced to move to Chiba due to her father's work, Kotarō tries to get into the same school as her, despite his parents' objections, but is unsuccessful. He is unable to see Akane off on her moving day, but publishes an online story promising to love her forever. Despite their long-distance relationship, they are shown to still get in contact and visit each other. The final shot at the end of the anime shows them married with a kid years later.!~

121824.description:
**Height:** 165 cm (5'5)

She is the most popular girl of the school, but also a huge video game nerd. She's the club president of the Game Club, she invites [Keita](https://anilist.co/character/121826/Amano-Keita) to join but he rejects the invitation each time.

~!She develops a crush on Keita Amano after she overhears Amano's admiring words about her, as he stood up to [Tasuku Uehara](https://anilist.co/character/121828/Uehara-Tasuku)!~

121825.description:
She is a classmate of Karen Tendou from class 2-A at Otobuki High School and a member of a non-school recognized gamer appreciation group together with Keita Amano and Tasuku Uehara. Chiaki is a shy girl and very reclusive. She did not seem to care about her looks at first until Keita and Tasuku came into her life. She did not socialize much and mostly preferred to play games on her own.

~!After she discovered that Keita was both "Tsucchi" and "Yama" was her online gaming friend she develops romantic feelings towards Keita!~

121826.description:
**Height:** 159 cm

He is the protagonist of the GAMERS! series. He is the older brother of Kōsei Amano, a student from class 2-F and a member of a non-school recognized gamer appreciation group together with [Chiaki Hoshinomori](https://anilist.co/character/121825/Chiaki-Hoshinomori) and [Tasuku Uehara](https://anilist.co/character/121828/Tasuku-Uehara).

(Source: GAMERS! Wikia)

121827.description: Aguri is Tasuku's girlfriend. In the anime, she is a petite girl with pink hair and purple eyes. Aguri is immature and tends to be a clingy girl towards Tasuku though this is because he now spends his time hanging out with others. She also tends to be somewhat of a ditz, she does not play video games nor does she have an interest in them. ~!She fell in love with Tasuku after he gave her a plushie doll in middle school, and she changed her appearance as well in order to get closer to him. She becomes jealous that Tasuku is being friendly with Chiaki, but allies with Keita to help him relate better with Karen.!~

121828.description:
He is a classmate of Keita Amano from class 2-F at Otobuki High School and the boyfriend of Aguri Sakurano.

~!In middle school, he wore glasses and his hair was in a different style. He was a considered a nerd before he decided to alter his appearance for high school. He is well-known for his looks among the popular boys.!~

121830.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

A high school gyaru who is very soft and has a very close friend who's also a gyaru.

121832.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

She is the classmate of [Junichi Hashiba](https://anilist.co/character/121831/Hashiba-Junichi).

121835.description:
__Height:__ 179 cm

A self-professed and unapologetic loli-con, he dreams of one day dating a girl who will write him, "a love note written in crayon."

121843.description: A 16 year old girl that left her hometown of Aomori and came to Kyoto to follow her dream of becoming an apprentice geisha, but is now working as a cook.

121845.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

A beautiful and popular girl who everyone likes. After hearing [Yukari](https://anilist.co/character/121846)'s confession, Misaki also confess that she likes Yukari but is reluctant to enter a relationship with Yukari due to the government's arranged marriage policy. She became friends with [Ririna Sanada](https://anilist.co/character/121847) after discovering that Ririna is Yukari's marriage partner.

121846.description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'6")

A shy young man who has less spine than a scarecrow, yet kind and understanding. He first fell in love with [Misaki Takazaki](https://anilist.co/character/121845) after lending her half his eraser and seeing her smile. Yukari however, is forced to be engaged with [Sanada Ririna](https://anilist.co/character/121847) by the government marriage policy after confessing to [Misaki Takazaki](https://anilist.co/character/121845).

121847.description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")

The marriage partner chosen by the government for [Yukari Nejima](https://anilist.co/character/121846/). Ririna is somewhat of a tsundere. She is mostly very blunt and speaks what's on her mind which earned her the nickname Snooty Sanada. She claims to have no special feelings for Yukari and acts as a love cupid for Yukari and [Misaki](https://anilist.co/character/121845). She is very interested in romantic stories and encounters.

121848.description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7")

Close friend of [Yukari Nejima](https://anilist.co/character/121846). Yuusuke first met Yukari when an angry guy confronted Yuusuke for "stealing his girlfriend". Yuusuke is portrayed as a cool and handsome young man. He is very popular with the girls and even had a few ex-girlfriends. 

~!It is hinted that he has a special relationship with [Misaki](https://anilist.co/character/121845) which caused Yukari to think that Yuusuke might also like her. However, Yuusuke is still shrouded in mystery and whether he likes Misaki or not is unclear.!~

121874.description:
**Height:** 160 cm

She is a high school girl who is stupid both academically and socially. She even gets zeroes on multiple choice tests.

Yoshiko is a complete crack head that is addicted to bananas, to put it simply. She is an incredibly eccentric person who is also very annoying towards [Akuru Akutsu](https://anilist.co/character/121875/Akutsu-Akuru), even though she truly wants him to love her. Yoshiko even goes so far as to let him see her panties. [Yoshie Hanabatake](https://anilist.co/character/121879/Hanabatake-Yoshie) even goes as far as to beg Akuru to be her boyfriend. Her idiotic actions towards Akuru caused her to get beat up by him. Akuru went as far as to punch her so high in the air it literally knocked her out. She downright annoys him. As a result of stupidity, her social skills are beyond abysmal, and generally makes the worst first impressions.
Yoshiko is quite perverted, as she enjoys groping the disciplinary committee president's breasts, has sneaked into Akuru's room and started sleeping around him, and likes to peek in the men's room just to see Akuru.

As a child, she showed a strong proclivity towards great agility and speed. She is strong for a girl despite her petite stature, as when she carried Akuru with little to no effort above her head when they were children. She can jump from one balcony to another, and is shown to have fast reflexes, with the exception of Akuru’s fast punches.

121875.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

He is a smart and serious high school student who is constantly annoyed by [Yoshiko](https://anilist.co/character/121874/Hanabatake-Yoshiko)'s antics. He is Yoshiko's neighbor, childhood friend, and classmate.

Akuru is an intelligent and serious high school student who is forced to deal with Yoshiko Hanabatake’s stupidity. Though only interested in studying, he is unwittingly dragged into many of Yoshiko’s escapades much to his dismay.

Throughout the series, Akuru is seen as the straight man, constantly dealing with the eccentric personalities of those around him (especially Yoshiko) and is quick to make rude remarks. He is very upfront about his disgust for Yoshiko, often resorting to physical violence whenever she annoys him.

Despite this, Akuru is said to be strange himself as he is completely antisocial, having few friends due to his abrasive attitude. The only people Akuru gets along with is [Sayaka Sumino](https://anilist.co/character/121877/Sumino-Sayaka) and [Dog](https://anilist.co/character/121880/Inu) who are the only beings besides him to have sense.

121877.description:
Sayaka is Akuru and Yoshiko's classmate who ends up becoming friends with the two. She is level-headed and assumes the straight-man role, often moderating interactions between Yoshiko and others.

Sayaka is kind and worries about being boring. She is very sensitive, especially when others point out her small chest, which appears slightly small, even after she pads it. She sometimes loses her patience. Most people acknowledge her kind aura and the binding and relaxing effect it has on everyone.

121879.description:
The perverted mother of Yoshiko Hanabatake, who desperately wants Yoshiko to be normal or find a husband so Yoshie can retire. She is very skilled in hand-to-hand combat and can tell a woman's intentions by looking at her panties.

Yoshie is not an idiotic person like Yoshiko as Yoshie wishes for Yoshiko to be a normal person. She is shown to be rather devious schemer, as she longs to be free of her idiot daughter and retire happily. To do this, she hopelessly tries to set Yoshiko up with Akuru, who wants absolutely nothing to do with her in the future. She is willing to stoop to deprave methods to assure this, such as trying to find ways to get Yoshiko to "seal the deal" with Akuru to ensure he'll marry her in the future once he gets a well-paying job. The extent of her immorality is best shown when she encouraged her daughter to drug Akuru and then "seal the deal" with him after leaving him vulnerable, showing just how far her depravity goes.

Like her daughter, she is rather dirty-minded.

121882.description: Ryuuichi Kurosaki is a delinquent guy whom Yoshiko Hanabatake interacts with and he becomes her disciple, calling her big sister. When Ryuuichi first appeared, he was shown to be just your typical delinquent. However, after meeting Yoshiko Hanabatake and Akuru Akutsu, he became a lot nicer and shows his idiotic side more.

121883.description:
Akuru's little sister who is in the fifth grade.

Ruri is a hardworking elementary school student who devotes her time to studying and she is determined to become smart and dependable. Despite this, she utterly fails at nearly everything she does, which prompts Yoshiko Hanabatake to see her as a fellow "idiot".
