Much like Akuru Akutsu (Ruri's older brother), Ruri dislikes Yoshiko and she is mortified at the idea of becoming just like her.

Unlike Yoshiko, Ruri has a good amount of common sense, though sometimes her childishness will come out at points.

121887.description: The third of the gyaru classmates. She has long dark hair. She is only one of the three who has a boyfriend, although she is extremely shy about it. Kuroko is a usually calm and collected girl who is often seen as socializing with Akane Eimura and Kii Hiiragi.

121889.description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5'5")

A girl who transfers into Hyakkaou Private Academy. She might look like an attractive young lady, but she is actually a "Kakegurui," someone who finds pleasure in taking risks.

Attractive, smooth as silk, and silver-tongued, Yumeko is a natural-born gambler. Gathering the attention of her peers and the entire student council, there's no denying she enjoys the attention she receives. Despite all odds in a gambling match, she somehow manages to turn the tables in the most daring ways, often times using her perceptiveness to decipher her opponent's tricks.

121942.description:
A participant in the 12th Juuni Taisen burdened with the title of the 'rabbit' from the Chinese Zodiac.
His details are a mystery.

121943.description: Himeno's cousin who is in kindergarten. She loves Himeno very much.

name.native: ケツァルコアトル・サスサススール

121945.description: A foreign exchange student from Antarctica who resembles a snake. Since her race has a logical way of thinking, she feels like an alien within Japanese culture, but she is gentle, friendly and adaptable.

121956.description:
**Height**: 168 cm (later 169 cm)
**Position:** Goddess
**Relatives**: [Shousuke Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130870/Shousuke-Komi) (younger brother), [Shuuko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130867/Shuuko-Komi) (mother), [Masayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130865/Masayoshi-Komi) (father), [Yuiko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130875/Yuiko-Komi) (grandmother), [Akira Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130876/Akira-Komi) (cousin), [Sadayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130873/Sadayoshi-Komi) (uncle)

Shouko Komi is the main character of the series. Though she's regarded as the *Madonna* of their school, she's incapable of socializing with others to such a level where it can be called a communication disorder.

Shouko is described by her admirers as a girl with glossy dark purple/black hair that flows to her lower back, a slender body, and an incredibly beautiful face. She is usually seen wearing her school uniform.

Shouko hardly talks with people. She is unable to utter a word nor sound in her daily life due to her crippling anxiety and fear of rejection by her peers. She often writes whenever she can on her notebook and to the blackboard in class to answer people. She dreams of overcoming her adversity and desires to build friendly relationships with others and make 100 friends.

Shouko's first friend was [Hitohito Tadano](https://anilist.co/character/78093/Hitohito-Tadano). He was the first to discover her bad communication. He helps her make friends and cares for her well-being.

121995.description:
Tetsu Sendagaya is the Eve of Old Child, the Servamp of Pride. He works at a family-owned hot springs resort. Although he is only 14, he is often mistaken for a university student because of his great stature and muscular figure. He has blonde hair, with two blue clips on either side of his face, and blue eyes. His usually seen wearing white pants, a dark blue singlet, a white vest and a white and blue scarf with the hiragana for 'yu' (ゆ) on it. He is also usually seen carrying his lead, a large black coffin with an advertisement for his family's hot spring resort painted on it.
(Source: MAL)

121998.description:
At first meet, he seems to be arrogant, impolite and cold towards others. This only covers up his otherwise kind and caring personality. Despite his offbeat and arrogant character, Misono is shown to care for his friends deeply. Because he was very lonely in his childhood without a single friend, he now cherishes his new friends very much, especially Mahiru Shirota, who was his first true friend. Mahiru understands this, and disregards Misono's aloof nature knowing that he cares for him all the same. He has a very weak constitution and proves to be extremely sensitive about his height and health. What he hates the most is that it's usually him who is being protected by others. To remedy this, he wants to get stronger so that he is able to protect everyone. He is extremely bullheaded and always wants to get his way - he only accepts the answers he wants to hear. Misono is a very caring guy and always worried about his friends. He likes to be an adult, but actually acts in many ways like a child - which is also fault of his father who wants to prevent him from become an adult. Mikado always tries to keep Misono safe in his garden; he still sees him as a child. As a result, Misono goes to bed early, (and can't stay awake much longer than 9-10 pm), still believes in Santa Claus, is often treated like a child. Misono is a spoiled character and is afraid of many things little kids are afraid of like darkness, getting snow into his clothes, or bubbles into his eyes. Because he never had friends in his childhood and was overprotected, he doesn't know most games kids use to play like a snow ball fighting. However, he never admits to ignorance and always pretends that he just wants to confirm that his knowledge of the rules are right. When he was a child he was a very friendly and happy child according to what Mikuni and Mikado say. He in fact did love his older brother, Mikuni, yet he calls him "idiot" or "bastard" after the incident that forced Mikuni's leave.
(Source: Servamp Wikia)

122010.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm

Lawless is the Servamp of Greed and has a contract with a famous pianist [Licht Jekylland Todoroki](https://anilist.co/character/122011/Todoroki-Jekylland-Licht). He is a strong Servamp who often quotes Shakespeare and has a habit of killing his Eves once he grows bored of them. Lawless is self-centred and particularly emotional. After ~!Ophelia's sacrifice, Lawless lost all motivation in living for himself and only chases after the shadow of Ophelia's desire.!~ He has no faith in the world and would much rather bring his Eves to the ground to prove his own selfish belief. He is sensitive and stubborn, and he typically acts impulsively to block any suspicion on his actions. For this reason, he is regarded as being unconventional and otherwise very dangerous.

~!Through Licht, it's revealed that Lawless is simple and has no aspirations for himself, he is otherwise driven by his own loneliness. He is shown to long for someone to love him, and his extravagant methods of switching Eves was only a means of refusing to face this fact.!~

Overall, however, Lawless is extremely energetic and obnoxious with penchant to poking fun at others and tends to introduce himself and others through extravagant means. He tends to be self-serving but an otherwise positive presence.

name.native: リヒト・ジキルランド・轟

122011.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Occupation:__ Pianist

Licht Jekylland Todoroki, also refered to as Licht Todoroki, is a famous pianist from Austria who thinks he's an angel. He is the Eve of "[Lawless](https://anilist.co/character/122010/Lawless)", the Servamp of Greed. Although Licht is already 18 years old, he often behaves like a naive child. He thinks himself of an angel and means it; he seems to be far off reality and is often described as a denpa. Since he considers himself as an angel, he is very violent towards vampires that he refers as demons in general, having no hesitation to attack them. When it comes to it, he even has a very short temper and usually attack first without thinking.

~!Behind his violent words and actions, he has soft spot for small animals and always referring them with suffix "-san", which is the reason he initially picked up Lawless in his hedgehog form. In fact, one of his childhood dreams is to have an ability to speak with animals.!~

Although he is still childish at heart, there are times he can be sharp and aware, particularly regarding Lawless. He believes that if people want something and working towards it they can be unique. Licht preserves with his aspiration and has the strong constitution to follow through with his goals.

122012.description:
Tsubaki is the main antagonist at the beginning of the story. He is the 8th Servamp who should, originally, not exist - that may be the reason the other Servamps did not know of him at the beginning. He is also called "Who is coming?" Tsubaki is the Servamp of Melancholy. He often laughs for no reason just to find it boring a few seconds later. When he is in animal form, he has the shape of a two-tailed fox. In contrary to the subclass of the other Servamps - his subclass can face the sunlight and are often good fighters.

Tsubaki has a strange sense of humour, often laughing at the simplest thing only to find it boring a few seconds later. He claims to hate humans and his vampire siblings, seeking to start vampire-human war. When it comes about fulfilling his goal, he is merciless and has no hesitation to kill innocent humans because he doesn't like them, simply stating that it's fair.

122013.description:
Belkia is one of Tsubaki's subclass and also one of his best friends. Belkia is rather eccentric with his appearance. He has long pink hair tied back in a ponytail with matching glasses. He wears a white suit with a white top hat as well. He wears a black band around his neck, like many of Tsubaki's subclass do. Belkia is capable of turning into a doll version of himself in a way similar to how the servamps transform into animals and, like the servamps, he is still capable of talking while in this form.
(Source: MAL)

122019.description: She is the younger sister of Chiaki Hoshinomori and the Student Council President of Hekiyō High School.

122044.description: Tsurugi Kamiya is a member of C3, a greatly feared neutral organization among vampires. He has pale skin and is smaller than his teammates at C3. He is often seen wearing his C3 uniform, which resembles a straitjacket. He wears bands around his wrists that hang down and sway when he walks.

122064.description:
Yuuichi Katagiri is a hardworking lad who believes friends are more important than money. In reality, he is a dead broke student with multiple part-time jobs. In secret, he is "the mind" of the team, and often, even when things seem dire, Yuuichi manages to swing the odds to his favor with every ounce of his might. His past is heavy--and often, for it, he is called a "devil" and considered dangerous.

~! In Chapter 99, it is revealed that Katagiri Yuuichi is the one who created the prototype for the "Tomodachi Game". !~

122073.description: The main antagonist of the series who intends to become God by all means necessary, including killing all other candidates. ~!He is the grandson of the principal of the prestigious Joso Academy and wishes to become God in order to bring [his dead sister](https://anilist.co/character/260799/) back to life.!~

122079.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

A high school senior with no hopes and dreams, he goes to school every day looking depressed, wanting to sleep. He doesn't really have a reason for participating in the Juuni Taisen - he's just going with the flow. He has an oddly philosophical personality; only when he's eating cheese does he tense up.

122080.description:
__Height:__ 181 cm

Ushii is presented as a stoic and levelheaded man, considered to be smart and quick witted by other warriors. He has a cold and analytical personality and looks at things with a logical outlook. 

He fought his first battle when he was five, killing everyone else. Has wanted to be hailed as a genius ever since. The name of his saber is Gobouken. While the saber itself isn't very special - it's just a regular mass-produced item - he wields it with great care. Despite looking thin, he's quite the big eater. As a warrior, he does not consume alcohol. He knows exactly where to go when he wants to eat by himself.

122081.description:
**Height:** 154 cm

A participant in the 12th Juuni Taisen burdened with the title of the ‘tiger’ from the Chinese Zodiac.

This clawed girl kills her enemies by damaging them with increasing pain and intensity. If there was a survey on "which warrior you never want to meet on the battlefield," she would no doubt be one of the top answers. She likes to keep her claws looking stylish, but carefully removes any nail polish before heading to the battlefield. On her days off, she often goes shopping with her girlfriends and always ends up drinking.

122082.description:
A participant in the 12th Juuni Taisen burdened with the title of the ‘dragon’ from the Chinese Zodiac.
Real name: 積田 長幸 Tsumita Nagayuki Birthday: November 11 (according to family registry) Height: 164 cm Weight: 58 kg
Fights as one with his younger twin brother. As more or less the older one, he acts as the commander. The twin brothers look so identical from head to toe that there is only one way to tell them apart: their first person pronouns. The elder brother addresses himself as "ore-sama". To compliment the younger brother's flamethrower [Hitokage], he carries the icethrower [Yuki-onna] on his back. The tank is filled with liquid nitrogen. Frankly, he thinks that [Hitokage] is the less convenient of the two. Hitokage:人影 (silhouette), which is homophone of 火蜥蜴 (salamander). Yuki-onna: 逝女 (deceased woman), which is a homophone of 雪女 (the yokai).

122085.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

A young warrior who fights as one with his elder twin brother. While it is exceedingly rare for powerful warriors to cooperate on the battlefield, the brothers known as Dragon and Snake fight together in a conventional two-man cell. It goes without saying that this gives them an advantage. At home, he keeps various species of reptiles as pets, and secretly manages a pet training program that is very popular among enthusiasts on his street.

122087.description:
__Height:__ 230 cm

Uuma is the current head in a long line of heads of the Souma family, and its largest member. Known for being taciturn; excluding his self-introduction as one of the warriors, the only people who can hear him speak are close associates whom he deems worthy. On the battlefield, his taciturn nature befits his stoic fighting style that is famous throughout the land.

122088.description:
__Height:__ 140 cm

Hitsujii is originally an arms dealer, he has gone in and out of the battlefield many times to conduct business as someone deeply involved in the ravages of war - this is what distinguishes him as a warrior. He took pride in the fact that every family in the Wetlands accepted him as one of their own after only meeting him once. Recently, he's been engrossed in a new smartphone game that doesn't suit his age. He always downloads the most popular apps and, from his senior center, has become respected in that game's world as a warrior.

122089.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm

She was trained as a warrior on a certain sacred mountain by three sages named Mizaru, Iwazaru, and Kikazaru. Her ability to freely manipulate liquids, solids, and gases means that her combat prowess is off the charts. However, she never uses the sage techniques she learned to hurt other people. Her hobby is making dango. Her homemade desserts are so delicious that she eats too many before realizing it.

122090.description:
__Height:__ 153 cm

A participant in the 12th Juuni Taisen burdened with the title of the ‘rooster’ from the Chinese Zodiac.

No words can describe the abuse she suffered growing up; she has no memories of the time before she was fifteen. The weapon she's wielding isn't a trident but a pitchfork. It lacks a name, so for the sake of convenience she calls it Tosakazashi. When she feels her stress reaching the limit, she heads to an onsen. That's why she's somewhat happy that the battlefield this time is known for its onsen.

122092.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm

A participant in the 12th Juuni Taisen burdened with the title of the ‘dog’ from the Chinese Zodiac. He does not use weapons on principle; his fighting style involves biting with his teeth. His fangs, which can crush anything, are referred to out of fear as Kyoukenbyou. In his private life, he's picked up calligraphy. At first, he could not understand what he had gotten himself into. Nevertheless, he didn't lose heart and continued to write, making his critics shut up with only his sublime, perfected brushstrokes.

122093.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm

A participant in the 12th Juuni Taisen burdened with the title of the ‘boar’ from the Chinese Zodiac.

The daughter of a noble family with over 300 years of history. She dual-wields the machine guns [Aishuu] and [Inochigoi]. She is well-versed in handling heavy weaponry and can freely operate all types of large weapons, especially those two, which she regards as extensions of her own body. At the moment, even after wholesomely socializing with the male zodiac warriors, she is still looking for a boyfriend.

122100.description:
A middle school girl who had always dreamed of becoming a Magical Girl, sharing that dream with her childhood friend Souta Kishibe. She vowed to be a righteous and pure Magical Girl after transforming for the first time. Her ability allows her to hear the voices of anyone under distress.

~!She survives the elimination game without killing anyone. However, her ideology is shattered as a result of what she had seen. She now desires strength in order to prevent large scale conflicts.!~

122101.description:
A high school student who lives alone. She wears ninja-style attire as her Magical Girl outfit. Her ability allows her to never miss a shot with her shurikens.

~!She lives through the events of the exam as a result of killing both Swim Swim and Fav, but loses both her left eye and arm.!~

122103.description:
Souta Kishibe is a childhood friend of Koyuki's. He moved away from her school and became invested in playing soccer. He shares her love of Magical Girls and secretly wanted to be one. One day, his wish was granted and was transformed into La Pucelle. His magical ability is to alter the mass and size of his sword at will.

~!He is the third magical to die after being severely beaten by Cranberry and pushed in front of an oncoming car.!~

122124.description:
A high school girl of self-professed low standing who has reincarnated as a spider. 

In her former life, she lived as a shut-in and immersed herself in video games, but now she uses her remarkable mental strength to fight for survival. She uses battle tactics that make up for her low stats with her mastery of agility, spider thread, and poison fangs.

~!Kumoko later takes on the name of Shiraori after deification, becomes the Tenth Demon Army commander and the transcended protagonist of the series. After the events of the battle with the G-Fleet, Kumoko was forced to transcend the limits of the System and become a god, losing access to the System, but in return gaining an incredible amount of energy at her disposal as well as the ability to create unique magic.!~

~!Shiraori came into being when Kumoko eats a GMA Bomb in a panic because it was going to explode, thinking maybe she could digest and absorb it in a similar fashion to [Ariel](https://anilist.co/character/130477/Ariel)'s skill Gluttony. The GMA Bomb was being used as a generator to power a large pre-system flying machine and its army of fighters and robots. Devices that utilized MA Energy as a power source is the technology that led to the destruction of the world and the necessity of the System. After absorbing the MA Energy from the GMA Bomb, Kumoko reaches Divinity Expansion Level 10 and undergoes Apotheosis, transcending the system, and is reborn as Shiraori after 47 days.!~

122187.description:
Hashimoto Shun, a gay novelist in the making, lived on the island Okinawa with his family. On Okinawa, he met a boy named Chibana Mio, who later left to pursue his studies for three years. When he returned, he confessed his attraction to Shun and developed a relationship with him.

Originally from Hokkaido, he moved to Okinawa to live with his grandmother after his parents discovered his sexual orientation.

122188.description: Mio is a 20-year-old freeter. After his mother's death, he briefly moves to Okinawa, where he meets Shun. Initially offended at Shun's attitude, he soon falls in love and pursues him romantically when he returns to Okinawa. Mio attempts to get better understanding of Shun's concerns, despite Shun constantly dismissing his advances.

122189.description:
__Height:__ 184 cm

He specializes in video games, but he also reads a lot of manga and watches a lot of anime. (He likes all kinds of games, but he's especially fond of FPS games, fighting games and action games, where it's not necessary to level up.) He goes for one person in video games and finds everything from visuals to status as being important.

He prefers e-mail for communication as the tension isn't as high as it is otherwise.

122190.description:
__Height:__ 154 cm

Manga, comics and cosplay are up her alley, and at one time she had a superficial knowledge of the fashion scene. She's a fan of multiple genres, loving many of them at the same time.

She's known [Hirotaka](https://anilist.co/character/122189/Nifuji-Hirotaka) since childhood (the one responsible for getting her into the otaku life) and he is the only one who really knows about her being an otaku.

122191.description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'6")

She likes things like drama and stage theatre. She also has a soft spot for anime and manga, as well as BL. She admires wifely characters who love someone with all their might. She doesn't have much tolerance for alcohol, so she doesn't bother to drink often, and she smokes very rarely.

122192.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

He's majorly into manga and games, which he has good taste in. He also has good taste in the merchandise he owns. Compared to the typical otaku, however, he falls a little short. Before he gets into new characters, he takes into consideration the guilty feeling he has about crime fiction and married life genres, former wives and current wives meeting genres, and the system type of wife-donos entering temples.

122193.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm

Naoya is a university student and the younger brother of [Hirotaka Nifuji](https://anilist.co/character/122189/Hirotaka-Nifuji) who wants the best for Hirotaka and he is genuinely happy when good things happen to him. He works as a barista in a coffee shop that is next to the office building where his brother is working to. 

Naoya has a cheerful personality who is often portrayed as a cat due to his cat-like smile and he seems to love his work as a barista since having satisfied customers makes him contented.

122207.description:
__Maiko name:__ Momohana

Kiyo's childhood friend and apprentice maiko.

name.native: アーサー・ペンドラゴン

122210.description:
Named the king of Camelot after pulling a sword from the stone that hundreds of holy knights could not.

Arthur is a polite, young man who is still adjusting to his role as king. He takes his responsibilities very seriously, but usually undertakes them with a smile and has a very warm, and happy-go-lucky demeanor.

He marched toward the kingdom of Liones with an army of illusions created by [Merlin](https://anilist.co/character/89180/Merlin) in hopes of meeting with the king; however, he was confronted by [Hendricksen](https://anilist.co/character/86679/Hendricksen) who tried to kill him before [Meliodas](https://anilist.co/character/72921/Meliodas) came to his aide.

122212.description:
A beautiful 17-year-old high school sophomore who attends Kazamizawa High School. She is an odd and reserved person. Because of it she has problems expressing her emotions, and as a result, people around tend to misunderstand her.

She was once the top athlete in the women’s track and field club at her school, but due a severe foot injury during a race she was forced to give it up. She harbors vague regret and bitterness about leaving the track and field club, therefore she consciously tries to avoid anything related to it, even contact with former teammates.

She started to work as a part-time waitress in a family restaurant called “Café Restaurant Garden” afterwards. There she meets [Masami Kondou](https://anilist.co/character/122213/Kondou-Masami), the restaurant manager, a 45-year-old divorced man. 

After seeing her down, Kondou tries to talk to her. The conversation becomes a turning point for Akira as she regains hope. She starts to fall in love with him from that point on.

122213.description:
__Occupation:__ Garden Manager

He is a kind and easygoing person who gets along amicably with almost everyone, though he strives to be friends with his subordinates at work. However, his soft nature makes him "weak" in the eyes of [Kubo](https://anilist.co/character/130559/Kubo-Kayoko), the assistant manager, owing to his lack of assertiveness. He puts in an adequate amount of effort at work, with his mind seemingly fixated on his other passion – literature. He appreciates belles-lettres or "fine writing" immensely, and is a man of the arts. Easily lost in the book he is reading, he does not notice his surroundings or the people he is with.

He remains cheerful conversing with others, though he faces much negativity due to past events and him being "a 45-year-old man who is timid" and one who is "afraid of getting hurt again". As such, he is easily agitated when [Akira](https://anilist.co/character/122212/Tachibana-Akira) confesses to him. Her fierce stare also intimidates him greatly.

He is professional and a gentleman. He keeps a notebook around at all times, scribbling important work-related points like avoiding sexual harassment and making sure that he does not smell like a middle-age man, which is bluntly stated by [Nishida](https://anilist.co/character/130561/Nishida-Yui).

name.native: リィエル＝レイフォード
alternative: Imperial Court Mage Corps Special Forces Executioner #7

122239.description: Her name, Re=L, stands for Project Revive Life. Her name was given to her by Rainer. She is a clone of her original self, Ilushia. While Ilushia has red hair, Re=L has blue hair. Her brother died when he attempted to convince Rainer to leave the organization. Unfortunately, Rainer, in return killed Shion and mortally wounded Ilushia. Glenn then saved Re=L and escaped with her, while Ilushia died.

122289.description: He is the male representative for the month of August and is a member of the unit Procellarum.

122292.description: He is the male representative for the month of June and is a member of the unit Procellarum.

122293.description:
He is the male representative for the month of January and is the leader of the unit Six Gravity.

(Source: Tsukiuta wiki)

122294.description: Yuu Tosaki is a high-ranked member of the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare. Generally, Tosaki has a commanding air about him and wears a serious expression. His answers are always short and to the point. He is also quite blunt and lacks patience. He's quick to anger with certain triggers, such as multiple instances in which he snaps at the mispronunciation of his name - "Tozaki" as opposed to what he claims is correct, "Tosaki". From the very start, Tosaki is shown to be morally ambiguous. It isn't above him to resort to violence through either his own force or those beneath him to get something done. If the consequences of his actions don't have a direct effect on him, his reaction is mild at best. Tosaki relies heavily on Izumi Shimomura to protect him from the Ajin and their IBM with her own abilities, threatening her with the prospect of being locked up and experimented on if he dies.

name.native: ソフィー・トワイライト

122298.description: Sophie is a doll-like vampire who prefers to buy blood online rather than drinking it from humans. She's also an anime otaku.

122299.description: Akari is a high school girl who loves dolls. After meeting Sophie, who looks like a doll, Akari barges into her house and ends up living with her.

122300.description: Ellie is a vampire who is an old friend of Sophie's. She just recently woke up from a 100 year nap, so she doesn't know much about the modern world, and is bad with technology. Unlike Sophie, who purchases blood online, Ellie prefers to drink from cute young girls.

122330.description:
Ayana Sakanagi is a quiet, young schoolgirl who idolizes Ruler, her Magical Girl mentor. She aspires to one day be just like her and is extremely obedient. As Swim Swim, her ability is to go through the ground and swim through it like water.
~!She is the fourteenth and final magical girl to die, killed by Ripple.!~

122334.description:
Sanae Mukuou is a Magical Girl (known as Ruler) that presides over four other Magical Girls (Swim Swim, Tama, Yunael, and Minael) in a temple. She is very strict and commanding, but deep down inside, she truly cares for her subjects. Her ability is to give a command that one must obey.

~!She is the second magical girl to die after being betrayed by Swim Swim and placing last in the second ranking.!~

122404.description:
He is the male representative for the month of April and is a member of the unit Six Gravity.

(Source: Tsukiuta wiki)

122406.description: He is the male representative for the month of November and is the leader of the unit Procellarum.

122430.description: The sadistic, hollow, and manipulative cousin of [Akane](https://anilist.co/character/122435/Hiyama-Akane) and [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/122433/Kichougasaki-Yuzu).

122433.description:
She is in love with her sister [Akane Hiyama](https://anilist.co/character/122435/Hiyama-Akane).

~!She latter falls in love also with [Seiji Aino](https://anilist.co/character/122437/Aino-Seiji). Marrying him at the end of the story together with her sister and [Guri](https://anilist.co/character/122436/Guri).!~

122435.description: The school's idol who [Seiji](https://anilist.co/character/122437/Aino-Seiji) is in love with, she turns out to be a yandere. Although they have different surnames, she's also the older sister of [Yuzu Kichougasaki](https://anilist.co/character/122433/Kichougasaki-Yuzu).

122436.description:
An Angel/Cupid. She often treats her duty as a Cupid like a joke, forming almost exclusively gay couples due to her love for male romance.

~!She is the daughter of [God](https://anilist.co/character/155539/Kamisama) and is set to take his place soon, and her mom is a demon, thus why she has a hard time understanding love.!~

122437.description: Seiji is a more-or-less level headed individual, trying to please all the women around him without hurting them. He is a high school student and older brother of [Akua Aino](https://anilist.co/character/122432/Aino-Akua).

122443.description:
**Occupation**: Delver
**Relatives**: [Lyza](https://anilist.co/character/122465/Lyza) (mother), [Torka](https://anilist.co/character/161856/Torka) (father)

Riko is the only child of the legendary White Whistle [Lyza](https://anilist.co/character/122465/Lyza), the Annihilator. When she was two, her mother began her last dive to the bottom of the abyss. She was left under the care of the Belchero Orphanage. Her dream is to become a White Whistle, a legendary type of  Delver, and explore the depths of the abyss to learn its many secrets and find her mother.

Riko is a good-natured, joyful, and energetic child. She has a quick and inquisitive mind, gathering and properly organizing all the information available on subjects that interest her. Growing up, she diligently studied to become a Delver like her mother was, enchanted by its mysteries and secrets. By the age of twelve, she had become an Apprentice Delver with the right to explore the shallowest level of the abyss on her own. Compared to [Reg](https://anilist.co/character/122444/Reg), she is fragile and lacking in physical prowess. However, her ability to keep a cool head under pressure to make rational decisions allows her to tackle the abyss.

122444.description:
Reg is a robotic being who appears to be a little boy. His actual age, origins, and even name are unknown because he cannot recall anything about his life before his encounter with [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko). He is named after a dog Riko used to have. Having a seemingly artificial body, Reg might be the only being completely immune to the Curse of the Abyss. Because of this, he is sometimes referred to as "The Treasure of the Deep."

Reg’s body is extremely durable, even to the point that [Ozen the Immovable](https://anilist.co/character/122464/Ouzen) couldn’t break him even when slamming him into the floor with all her strength. Despite his high durability, Reg is agile and weighs little. His wounds heal at a faster rate than a human’s, and has a very high pain tolerance. His senses of smell and hearing are strong, one comparable to a dog. His arms can extend up to 40 meters each and can shoot them to the top of cliffs or grab things very far away. The cords attached are very durable. He is also equipped with an incinerator, which is a powerful incendiary cannon built into his hands and feet, emitting a beam of light, indicating the area to eliminate, penetrating through objects. Objects within the range of the light break apart and are absorbed into the spinning axes. The incinerator is connected to the Abyss in an unknown way, having the power to rewrite the rules of the Abyss. Reg passes out for 2 hours upon use, but it can be fired multiple times in the 10-minute deadline, and can also be set to not affect living beings.

Despite being a formidable fighter, Reg is rather shy, naive, and unassertive. He blushes easily and often cries when in distress. However, when forced into danger or an unpleasant situation, he is shown to be hot-tempered and sharp, compared to Riko's analytic, noncombatant role. Regardless of his skittishness, Reg has made it his sworn duty to protect Riko and doesn't hesitate to put up a fight when she is in harm's way. According to Ozen, the way he speaks and handles his body is similar to [Lyza](https://anilist.co/character/122465/Lyza). One of his favorite words to say is "irredeemable," which was a word that Lyza often said.

name.native: アリエス・スプリング

122588.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")
__Hometown:__ Rosapop District

Aries is a very cheerful, optimistic, and spacey girl. According to her friends, she is also careless and can't take a hint. She is also a very grateful person that would repeatedly thank someone who helps her.

~!Although she is a bit spacey, she actually has photographic memory.!~

~!In the end, she marries Kanata.!~

122612.description:
__Class:__ 1-5
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Position:__ Midfielder

A first-year student at Fujimi High School and the ace of the soccer team who wears the #10 jersey. His soccer skills are so great that he is the U-16 representative midfielder for Japan. He's so obsessed with cleanliness that out of principle, he refuses to head the ball or slide. For a "certain" reason, he attends Fujimi High School.

122613.description:
Height: 190 cm
Position: Midfielder
Class: 2-3
A second-year student at Fujimi High School and the passionate forward of the soccer team. He was wearing the #10 jersey before Aoyama joined the team. He at first thought Aoyama was creepy, but gradually approved of him once he saw the hidden passion that Aoyama has. He's the eldest son of the Zaizen conglomerate, and his father dotes on and spoils him.

122614.description:
__Height:__ 151 cm
__Class:__ 1-3

A first-year student at Fujimi High School, who doesn't belong to any club. She talked to Aoyama once in elementary school, but he's forgotten her. Unable to forget the one time she spoke to Aoyama-kun in elementary school, she still has a secret crush on him. She carries around a spiked bat with a floral pattern on it as her trademark.

122675.description:
The owner of Western Restaurant Nekoya, a historic restaurant in the basement of a multi-tenant building in one corner of a shopping district. He inherited the restaurant from his father ten years ago. He is skilled at cooking not only Western cuisine, but Japanese, Chinese, and even desserts, among many other dishes.

(Source: Official Site)

122687.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

Mary Saotome is a deuteragonist of _Kakegurui_, and also the main protagonist of the spin-off series _Kakegurui Twin_. She is a student at Hyakkaou Private Academy, and a classmate of [Yumeko Jabami](https://anilist.co/character/121889) and [Ryota Suzui](https://anilist.co/character/122688) who is the first character in the entire series that challenges Yumeko and loses against her.

At first, Mary is shown to be incredibly sadistic and twisted, such as how she treats her classmate Ryota Suzui after he turned into a "housepet", due to his low social status within the academy, and is shown cruelly taunting her fellow opponents during their gambling matches. She's also shown to be extremely egotistical both in and out of matches, often being confident in her victory. Mary also possesses a habit of mocking her opponents and laughing at them, especially when match seems to be her win.

After losing to Yumeko Jabami and experiencing the life of being a housepet, Mary became desperate to regain her status within the academy, having no other goal in her mind. Soon after being humiliated, Mary eventually loses her pride, having a mental breakdown during a match against [Yuriko](https://anilist.co/character/122694/Nishinotouin-Yuriko) and falling into the state of grief and shame. After regaining her status, she seems to be no longer this arrogant and cruel, sometimes being only nettled by Ryota's cowardice or Yumeko's reckless behavior, but still deeply caring about them. She also developed a huge hatred towards the student council, wishing them to pay for what they had done to housepets.

122688.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

Yumeko’s classmate. Cowardly and poor, he quickly ends up being treated as Meari’s livestock, and is called ‘Pochi’ (a common name for a dog). However, he is saved from this predicament by Yumeko.

122690.description: Secretary of the Student Council and the right hand of Student council president. She is determined to become Kirari's 'Number 1,' and thinks of Yumeko as a plague. Sayaka is intelligent, serious and deeply cares about school and Student Council. She's endlessly loyal to the Student Council President, Kirari Momobami and will do anything for her. It seems that she has a crush on Kirari, as she expressed concern and sadness when she drove off without telling her where she went and what she was doing. While she seems to be reserved and calm, her subduing of a violent student, Jun Kiwatari and telling him what he now owes in the debt recollection game shows that she's every bit as terrifying as the rest of the Student Council.

122691.description: A third-year student and head of the Student Council Beautification Committee. She gets pleasure from taking risks such as starting games of Russian roulette by herself.

122692.description:
A second-year student and student council treasurer. He has a strong desire for power and is very ambitious, to the point where he is plotting to overthrow his seniors, even in the student council, as soon as he has a chance. 
He is the manipulative Treasurer of the Student Council, having his own goal to take down Kirari Momobami.

~!Became a Housepet with 10 billion Yen debt after losing to Jabami. As a result from his gamble with Yumeko Jabami, his hair turned white. This is an alleged condition called Marie Antoinette syndrome that causes the hair to turn white after facing an abundance of emotional stress.!~

122693.description: Kirari Momobami is the 105th student council president at Hyakkaou Private Academy, and as well as the one responsible for the current hierarchy on the academy.

122694.description: A third-year student, member of the student council, and president of the Tradition Culture Research Society. She ends up challenging [Yumeko](https://anilist.co/character/121889/Jabami-Yumeko) to an original gambling match.

122696.description:
She's a first-year student belonging to the "flower" class at Hyakkaou Private Academy and a member of the Student Council. Her father is the president of a prominent toy company in Japan. Her hobby is collecting other people’s nails.

~!Since [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/122692/Manyuda-Kaede) betted his lifeplan [Yumeko](https://anilist.co/character/121889/Jabami-Yumeko) received it, but gave it to Itsuki. Its apparent, that she actually has feelings for him. She watches over him, as he lays in bed, still under shock. She goes on to collect quite a few votes during the election. And she is also present during Yumemis battle against Kawaru!~

122698.description:
She is a member of the Student Council and also a leader of the Election Committee, serving as a referee during election gambling matches.
~!Runa is a sadistic and two-faced person, who seems to be very cute and nice at first but in reality she enjoys watching other people fail and loves to mock them.!~

122699.description:
A young demon girl who found Western Restaurant Nekoya while jobless and down on her luck, and ended up being hired there. Through the people she’s met at Nekoya, she’s found some job leads back in her own world, as well. She always looks forward to eating the master’s cooking on meal breaks.

(Source: Official Site)

122700.description:
The avatar of a black dragon who, like Aletta, works at Western Restaurant Nekoya. When she comes to the restaurant, she takes the form of an elf girl and uses her power of telepathy to speak to others. She has a bit of an obsession with chicken curry.

(Source: Official Site)

122701.description: A majestic scarlet red dragon goddess and a regular at Nekoya. She is always seen visiting Nekoya during closing hour when it is empty to order her favorite food, beef stew. She considers Nekoya and all the staff there to be a part of her clan and will protect them from all harm.

122702.description:
A young treasure hunter. After meeting Aletta at Nekoya, she took in the young demon as a live-in maid. Her favorite is minced meat cutlets.

(Source: Official Site)

name.native: ハインリヒ・ゼーレマン

122703.description:
A knight captain who saved the duchy from disaster and was given a fortress as a reward. Because he was born in a port town, he prefers seafood. His favorite is fried shrimp.

(Source: Official Site)

122704.description:
One of the four heroes who ended the war with the demons, known as the legendary Great Sage. He is the most senior of Nekoya's regulars. His favorite is pork loin cutlets.

(Source: Official Site)

122705.description:
A legendary swordsman whose exploits have been sung about all over the world by minstrels. Friends with Artorius. His favorite is teriyaki chicken.

(Source: Official Site)

122706.description:
An assistant of Professor [Jun Shiomi](https://anilist.co/character/144632/Shiomi-Jun), Akira comes from overseas; they met when he was an orphaned child and warned her about adultered spices in a market (presumably in India). Jun recognized the dormant talent in him and brought him back to Japan, where he was adopted by her teacher, Hayama. Akira quickly learned Japanese and studied spices and aroma under Shiomi. Jun became a mother figure for him, and his motivation to succeed at cooking stems from wanting to give something back to Jun. Akira specializes in curry dishes, with a wide knowledge of spices and aroma.

He is a tall and handsome man with tanned skin and silver hair. Like [Sōma](https://anilist.co/character/75216/Yukihira-Souma), he aims to be at the top of the Elite Ten. His nose is very sharp when it comes to spices, capable of identifying ingredients and grade of cooking by the first smell, considered a worthy match of Erina's God's Tongue and being identified as an "Aroma Master". Although Jun and Akira are both experts in spices, she uses theoretical knowledge while he depends on his sense of smell. In contrast to Jun's naive, ditzy, easily angered and dependent persona, Akira is mature, reliable, street smart, cool and down-to-earth.

122708.description: Erina's secretary and close friend, Hisako specializes in medicinal-based dishes. She thinks of Erina as the best, that only she could be Erina's number two and nobody could ever get past her to Erina's level.

122730.description:
Touya is a young boy who has come to this other world. For the most part, he is very well-mannered, but when he feels that those close to him could be harmed, he also has a side that will not hesitate.

(Source: Honey's Anime)

122750.description: The wisecracking goalkeeper of the team.

122751.description:
Height: 165 cm
Position: Defender
Class: 2-3
A no-nonsense defender with leadership qualities.

122752.description: The coach of the Fujimi High School's soccer team.

122753.description:
__Height:__ 181 cm (5'11")
__Hometown:__ Mousanish District

Kanata is naturally athletic and a steadfast person that wants to become a space explorer. He is also a very selfless person who would willingly help anyone in distress and would take any risks necessary to save them. He acts like a leader and wishes to be acknowledged as one by his comrades. 

~!Later in the story it's revealed that  the reason why he wants to become a space explorer was the influence of one of his middle school teacher's that passed away in a fatal accident that happened during a school trip. That accident was also the reason why Kanata started training to the point of becoming a decathlete. He competed in the decathlon event in the latest Under-20 World Championships and took home the overall bronze medal.!~

~!At the end of the series, he marries Aries Springs.!~

name.native: キトリー・ラファエリ

122754.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
__Hometown:__ Mousanish District

She likes being fashionable and doesn't feel comfortable around strange animals. Although she's not good at socialising, [Zack](https://anilist.co/character/139432/Walker-Zack) and her have been friends since they were little due to their parents being coworkers.

Quitterie's mother is the head doctor at a hospital and she wishes to become a doctor like her in the future, so she's studying medicine. She never knew her father.

~!Later in the story it is revealed that she was actually raised solely by her family's servants. Because of that and the other kids' jealousness she never learnt how to interact with others normally and grew up a little self-centered and bossy.!~

~!She ends up marrying Zack.!~

122768.description:
Originally an orphan, he started training with a weapon at 11 in order to become a Brave. A jack of all trades, he exceeded in a myriad of techniques - earning him the title of  "strongest" Quasi Brave. After an hard fight, several curses caused by his techniques hit back, resulting in his 16 year old body being petrified in a frozen lake for 525 years.

When the events take place, he has been freed from the ice for two years with a deeply broken body caused by the petrification.

By the help of his boggard friend [Grick](https://anilist.co/character/163065/Graycrack-Grick), he becomes the caretaker over a military base run jointly by the Guarding Wings Military and the Orlandry Merchant Guild, where they keep special weapons - the Leprechauns.

122777.description: She is the vice president of the student council and is seen almost entirely throughout the whole time wearing a mask that covers her whole face. Ririka is a very quiet and stoic person. She often acts as an observer.

122778.description:
A second-year student in charge of PR for the student council. She also works as an idol, but there’s a huge gap between her facade and her true face.

Yumemi has a two-faced personality. On the outside, she is a sweet and lovely girl who loves her fans above all. However, in reality, she's an arrogant, calculated and sadistic person, who will do everything to be on top. She's also disgusted by her fans as she often calls them 'pigs' but at the same time, she doesn't want to turn in meetings with them, due to her dream of becoming a famous actress in Hollywood and winning an Academy Award.

Yumemi never enjoys the dancing routines the fan club comes up with and has shown to be disgusted by their 'sweaty gross palms'. She is motivated by stating on top and achieving an academy reward which is why she involves herself with the fans as much as she can. Even though she is mostly focused on herself, she manages to remember the birthday dates of all her fans in her fan club which she tries using to her advantage when she gets herself caught in a gamble with [Yumeko Jabami](https://anilist.co/character/121889/Jabami-Yumeko).

~!She soon develops a more humble personality later on in Season 2 during her encounter with [Kawaru Natari](https://anilist.co/character/136599/Warakubami-Sumika), an A-List Japanese Hollywood actress whose real identity is Sumika Warakubami.!~

name.native: ヴィクト・アレキサンダーヴィチ・プーチン

122800.description:
Ange is a genius spy with artistic skills. She is adept in telling lies and she can tell when someone is lying to her. She also possesses a special device that allows her to fly for short periods of time. Despite her lying nature, Ange can be shown to be a nice and kind person

~!In Episode 2, it Ange is shown to show her personality only to the [Princess](https://anilist.co/character/122804/Princess).!~

~!It is revealed that her real name is Charlotte.!~

~!During episode 9 it is revealed that Charlotte was accidentally switched with Ange during the start of the revolution. Thus, Charlotte, who is the actual princess took Ange's name and lived on the other side of the wall.!~

122801.description: A noblewoman who serves as Princess' aide and close friend. She can mimic voices of other people using a mechanism that her father implanted in her throat. Her father has treated her as a test subject for his experiments.

122802.description: An exchange student from Japan. She is highly proficient in samurai-style swordsmanship. She often acts naive and has a hard time adapting to the culture differences. She is a spy for Japan tasked with observing the Commonwealth and Kingdom so that her superiors can determine which country to ally with.

alternative: Daisy McBean (デイジー・マクビーン)

122803.description: An undercover student. She is actually 20 years old and acts as a leader to the spies. She is good at shooting, seducing and driving vehicles.

122804.description:
The niece of the [Duke of Normandy](https://anilist.co/character/123069/Duke-of-Normandy) and a princess of Albion Kingdom who is fourth in the line of succession for the throne. She has an oddball personality, but she gets along well with others.

~!She knew [Ange](https://anilist.co/character/122800/le-Carr-Ange) from ten years ago. She works with Ange in hopes that she will help her ascend to the throne. Princess's true name is Ange.!~

~!During episode 9 it is revealed that Ange, the current "Princess" was switched with the real princess when the revolution started. Thus, she had to learn all the etiquette and mannerisms of being a princess on her own and adopted the role of "princess" in place of Charlotte.!~

122806.description:
Position: Midfielder
The only player on the team with a girlfriend.

122807.description:
Position: Midfielder
A narcissistic player who views himself as a step above Aoyama.

122809.description:
Height: 186 cm
Position: Defender
Class: 2-3
A gentle player who loves to eat.

122871.description:
Kumatetsu is a potential successor to the throne of the Beast Kingdom. He has to choose someone to be his apprentice and he ends up choosing a human boy named [Ren](https://anilist.co/character/122894) (and later names him Kyuuta).

~!Near the end of the movie, Kumatetsu battles Iozen to see who will become the new lord. Kumatetsu wins but is badly injured right after his victory. Later on, Kyuuta ends up getting in big danger. Since Kumatetsu couldn't help due to him being injured, he decides to reincarnate as a sword and he becomes a part of Kyuuta's soul.!~

122894.description: A young boy who runs away from home and ends up accidentally going to the beast world. He meets a beast named [Kumatetsu](https://anilist.co/character/122871), who is a potential candidate to become lord of the beast world. Kumatetsu ends up making Ren his apprentice and later names him Kyuuta.

122960.description: Eita is a transfer student who has lived away from the town where Mio and the others lived for four years, but has now returned. He had been close friends with Haruto since middle school, and his transfer into their high school is a reunion for them.

122961.description:
Mio was Eita and Haruto's classmate during middle school. She plans to enroll in college and is studying hard to make that happen. Her unrequited feelings for a middle school crush still influence her.

(Source: ANN)

122962.description:
Ena is a second-year student, and a member of the photography club that is close to being disbanded. In order to save the club, she plans to enter a photography competition. In search of a good photo, she witnesses the reunion between Eita and Haruto.

(Source: ANN)

122963.description:
Hazuki is a member of the school concert band who has already decided on her preferred college. Her family has tended to a farm since her grandfather's time. She does not stand out in class, and seems uninterested in romantic relationships.

(Source: ANN)

122964.description:
Haruto is a baseball team member who has already secured a job after graduation. He plans to hit the home run that he couldn't hit during the summer competition, and confess to someone he likes.

(Source: ANN)

122998.description: In class 2-4 and a member of the soccer club.

123022.description: He is a straightforward dominant boy and is the student council president. He is in class 3-8.

123023.description: She is a friendly girl from class 2-1 and is both the female class representative and a member of the soft tennis club. She likes teasing people.

123024.description:
He is a spontaneous boy who appears whenever love advice is needed. He is from class 3-5 and is the president of the drama club. Shinichi is a quirky and upbeat teenager. He tends to speak in short English phrases at times; he also tends to be a playboy around girls (though he may not be aware how much it affects their feelings) and even calls himself a "Dating Master" and "Love Master", much to everyone's annoyance and amazement.

~!In a later chapter, it is revealed that Shinichi has been fighting an illness that causes him to cough up blood. Because of this, he has been repeating years at high school. So many times in fact, that he originally attended high school even before the current third years began high school.!~

123025.description: A muscular boy with few expressions who is from class 2-4 and is in the volleyball club.

123036.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")

The Student Council President of Shikou Gakuen.  His real surname in the devil world is Arlond. He is considered the "Prince" of the school and most of female students adore him. He tends to spend his time in the Student Council room, which is known as the "Third Library." Outside of school, Rem lives in a mansion with several maids and butlers to attend to him.

Rem has a hard-working and cool personality. His song "My Name is Rem Arlond" claims he has an icy heart, but he seems to care about Ritsuka Tachibana. He is shown to be quite dense when it comes to his own feelings, much to the rest of the student council's aggravation. He has a protective side to him as well, willing to put himself in harm's way to save Ritsuka.

123037.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm 
 
An ordinary girl who lives with her mother. She is part of the Art Club, and likes oil painting.

123040.description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'5")

One of the members of the Shikou Gakuen Student Council. He's a "fallen angel" instead of a devil like the other members. Shiki is a sadistic character who enjoys feeling pain and watching other people's pain.

Shiki comes off as a strange, aloof person to most students, and many claim that he's rarely seen at school, even during the student council's announcements. Shiki mostly acts and speaks mischievously, often with a smile and snide remark. He's also extremely destructive and gets enjoyment out of breaking things. He's insensitive of the feelings of others and enjoys getting a rise out of people. He has a short, violent temper, and tends to disappear abruptly without explanation. Despite his childish manner, Shiki is rather clever and can be serious when he has to.

123041.description:
__Height:__ 188 cm 

He's a demon and a member of the student council.

123042.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm 

A demon. He is the vice president of Shikou Gakuen and is popular with the girls in school. His reputation is the elite inccubus.

123043.description:
__Height:__ 182 cm 

The brother of Ritsuka Tachibana. He is an exorcist at the same time he is a vampire who loves Ritsuka and will protect her even if it costs him his life. ~!In episode 9, he tells Ritsuka that they aren't sister and brother, but cousins. Lindo confesses his feelings for her.!~

123044.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'4")

~!He is the Pomeranian dog that hangs around with Rem and the other devils.!~ ~!Initially he seems loyal to Rem and the other devils, but it is revealed he has been working for Maksis.!~

123045.description: Ritsuka's friend. ~!She's an exorcist.!~ ~!She's killed by a vampire.!~

123058.description: She is a shy timid girl from class 2-4 and is a member of the tea ceremony club.

123059.description: She is delinquent from class 3-8 and often smokes behind the school.

123078.description:
**Height:** 156 cm (5'1")
**Character:** Sadistic

Because she usually has an unpleasant look in her eyes, she was worried that she didn't pass the interview, but the shop manager hired her to work at Stile. Her dream is to one day study abroad. She is the "Do S" (extreme sadist) waitress.

123079.description:
__Height:__ 135 cm (4'9")
__Character:__ Little Sister

She looks young but she is actually a college student. She's usually quite calm but when she starts work she becomes a sparkling "little sister" character. She loves children's anime. She is the "little sister" waitress.

123080.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'4")
__Character:__ Tsundere

A popular blond, twin-tailed high school shop clerk who is so obsessed with games that sometimes leads her to spend too much money on it.

123085.description: Morioko is an insecure, socially anxious woman who quit her job and turned into a NEET. She scarcely leaves her apartment, spending her days playing the game Fruits de Mer as her in-game character Hayashi, a blue-haired ikemen guy. Morioko calls herself an "elite NEET" because she chose this life for herself.

123092.description: Sakurai is a half-British elite employee who works in a trading company. He is not very good at socializing and is timid when outside of work.

123093.description: He is [Sakurai](https://anilist.co/character/123092/Sakurai-Yuuta)'s senior. In the past, he worked in a different department at [Moriko](https://anilist.co/character/123085/Morioka-Moriko)'s workplace. He often interferes between Sakurai and Moriko.

123095.description: Morioko's character in the game Fruits de Mer.

123096.description:
Lily is a kindhearted healer in the "@Home Party"  guild. She spends too much money for gacha rolls.

~!Her player in real life is [Yuuta Sakurai](https://anilist.co/character/123092/Yuuta-Sakurai).!~

123145.description: Ozen's assistant and a Blue Whistle Diver.

name.native: ヴィクトリア・サマナーク

123174.description:
The elder sister of the duke, and a brilliant sorcerer. Both her parents were human, but she was born a half-elf and chose the path of a sorcerer. Her favorite is pudding a la mode.

(Source: Official Site

123175.description:
An elven culinary researcher. She won't eat any foods that contain animal products. Inspired by Nekoya's cuisine, she travels around the world learning all she can about cooking. Her favorite is tofu steak.

(Source: Official Site)

name.native: シリウス・アルフェイド

123176.description:
The heir to the Alfade Company. His grandfather Thomas, the former head of the company, introduced him to Nekoya. His favorite is meat sauce, but he struggles to replicate it.

(Source: Official Site)

123177.description:
The first princess of the empire. While on sick leave at the palace villa, she began visiting Nekoya regularly and began to gradually recover. Her favorite is chocolate parfaits.

(Source: Official Site)

123178.description: She's a house pet​, who gambled against Yumeko Jabami, Mary Saotome, and Jun Kiwatari in order to lower her debt.

123179.description:
Jun is portrayed as a typical bully. He is aggressive, arrogant and sadistic person, who loves dominating others. 
~!Rank: Housepet
Debt: 310 Million Yen

He made use of Tsubomi Nanami's housepet status and cut her long hair, probably only because she really valued them and threatened Yumeko Jabami when she didn't strip in front of him and his friends. He battle's Nanami, Yumeko and Mary. In that battle, he was cheating with Nanami. That's the reason why Yumeko and Mary were allies. In the end, he lost and end up being a Housepet.!~

123181.description:
Chisa Kotegawa is Iori's cousin and a first-year mechanical engineering student at Izu University. Chisa appears to more level-headed and serious compared to other characters. She has a clear dislike for rowdy behavior and can be quite hostile, especially when it is directed towards her (especially with Iori). She rarely takes part in drinking or crazy antics and is usually seen sitting off the side as an observer. She loves diving and looking at diving equipment. Chisa is one of three female students in her class idolized by her male classmates due to her major's lack of females.

~!It is later revealed that she and Iori are not related by blood since Iori's father is adopted by her maternal grandparent.!~

123182.description: Iori Kitahara is a first year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University. Despite no initial interest, Iori comes to love diving and spending time with the members of the club, whom he becomes friends with and cares about despite their rambunctious behavior and endless crazy schemes.

123183.description: A ram-horned girl who has a cheeky personality. She is a lesbian who is in a relationship with Inukai, but enjoys teasing other girls too.

123184.description: An alicorn-horned girl and Mitsuyo's girlfriend.

123185.description:
Hablog (called Habo-san by Riko and the other children) is a well-known Black Whistle Delver and was the person who delivered Lyza's White Whistle and final notes to the surface.

Hablog is a very bright and kind person with a rather high level of curiosity, as is seen when he first meets Reg.

123212.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")

Ayanokouji is an inconspicuous and unobtrusive student. He is shown to be extremely intelligent and possesses a profound insight to study the emotions of people around him. Almost everything about his life prior to the entrance exams is unknown. He is shown to be extremely calculating and possessing superhuman intellect, perception, and strength. He's skilled at fighting and is able to easily manipulate the people around him. He is quite fond of his friends and protects those that he can without standing out. He has little regard for others' feelings and will coldly let them suffer to succeed, occasionally even his friends.

123213.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")

A beautiful girl who sits next to [Ayanokouji](https://anilist.co/character/123212/Ayanokouji-Kiyotaka). She is the opposite of Ayanokouji when it comes to friendship; she disregards it and thinks of making friends unnecessary, thus she does not communicate much with her classmates. She is not convinced that she was placed in the D class, therefore she aims to get promoted to the A class.

123214.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

She boasts tremendous popularity among men and women as the D class' idol. She aims to be friends with everyone not just in D class. She wants to get along well with her classmate, [Horikita](https://anilist.co/character/123213/Horikita-Suzune).

123230.description: Misaki's best friend since middle school who seems to know the reason behind Yukari's sudden partner change.

123283.description:
__Height:__ 161 cm (5'3")

Noelle Silva is a member of the Black Bulls and was inducted into the squad around the same time as [Asta](https://anilist.co/character/123285). She is the second daughter of one of the Clover Kingdom's royal families, House Silva, and the younger sister of the captain of the Silver Eagles, [Nozel Silva](https://anilist.co/character/124442). She likes sweets.

~!Her family disowned her due to her lack of control on her magic and having [their mother](https://anilist.co/character/124972) die while giving birth to her.!~

123284.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7")

Yuno was left, along with [Asta](https://anilist.co/character/123285/Asta), in front of a church in a village called Hage when he was an infant. He grew up at the church and spends most of his day with Asta. Sometime later, a thug tries to take his necklace away from him and sell it for money. Fortunately, Asta steps in and tries to take it back. In the end, the thug decided to leave without the necklace after Asta keeps charging at him. Since then, Yuno stopped crying and decides to take Asta's dream to be the Wizard King as his own as well.

123285.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

An orphan who was left under the care of a church in the village of Hage. He dreams of becoming ​the Wizard King but is unable to use magic, so he trains to build up his physical strength. He is the wielder of a five-leaf clover anti-magic grimoire and is a 3rd Class Junior Magic Knight of the Clover Kingdom's Black Bull and Royal Knights squads.

123287.description: ~!A clone of the original Weisse Hexe created by the Germanian Weapons Design Division 9. Born without a mind of her own, Sophie depended on Izetta's blood to awaken her consciousness. Embittered by the treason she suffered under the ancient Eylstadtians, and brainwashed by the Germanians, she has become their willing tool in their quest for world domination.!~

123293.description: He is in charge of the kitchen at Stile. He loves yuri.

123294.description:
He is Italian, and scouted Maika to work at Stile. He has a bad habit of getting a nosebleed when he gets too excited.
He has a crush on Maika Sakuranomiya.

123295.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")
__Character:__ Idol

An employee at Stile who dreams of becoming a cute idol.

123296.description:
**Height:** 163 cm (5'4")
**Character:** Big Sister

She normally wears glasses and is active in a doujin circle. She is the "older sister" waitress at Stile, but surprisingly, she is easily excitable.

name.native: レイチェル・ガードナー

123327.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")

An amnesiac little girl who finds herself in a mysterious building. Being very calm and collected, she's often described as being extraordinarily dull but painfully honest, with some even remarking that she resembles a porcelain doll due to her difficulty in visibly expressing emotions and always having a strange, blank stare regardless of her mood. She's fixated on the idea of God, often overthinking her relation and worth to him, as well as projecting his will onto various events in her life, even desiring punishment and death once she labels herself a sinner.

~!She exhibits a strange obsession with desiring "ideal" things, often stitching them together in order to make them "hers" and panicking if they don't meet her criteria, regardless of whether they are objects, people, or dead animals.!~

~!Ultimately revealed to be the master of floor B1, which is modeled after her family home, although filled with absurd traps. A number of items have been added to it by [Danny](https://anilist.co/character/123330/Dickens-Daniel), such as toys and fake flowers.!~

~!Her obsession with sewing things together stems from an unspecified mental health issue affecting her ability to feel empathy. Following an incident in which she stitched together a dead puppy's corpse, her parents' arguments escalated, with each of them blaming the other for Ray becoming the way she is.!~

name.native: アイザック・フォスター

123328.description:
__Height:__ 186 cm (6'1")

An illiterate serial killer in charge of floor B6, the lowest in the building. He despises liars and dishonesty above all else and sees himself as a monster. His favourite weapon is a scythe, which was given to him by [Gray](https://anilist.co/character/127275/Gray-Abraham). He seems to have unnaturally strong destructive tendencies, going into a frenzy whenever he's allowed to let loose, as was the case with him destroying [Eddie](https://anilist.co/character/123329/Mason-Edward)'s graveyard on floor B4. Due to his tendency to speak his mind and being brutally honest, he swears very frequently.

Ever since he was a child, he sympathized with the villains of slasher films. Due to his strange behavior, his mother's partner attempted to burn him alive, forcing Zack to cover up his burns with bandages for the rest of his life. Soon after, he would be sent into an illegal orphanage, where his apparent insensitivity to death and pain would cause the owners to use him as an errand boy, disposing of other children's corpses and being forced to eat garbage. After escaping the orphanage and killing the owners, filled with a newfound hatred for people who see him as a "tool", he would go on to briefly live together with a blind old man who took him in on a whim - however, following the old man's death at the hands of a mugger, he would go back to living on the streets and killing those unlucky enough to run into him at night. 

At some point, Gray would scout him out and get him involved in his project.

name.native: エドワード・メイソン

123329.description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'0")

Master of floor B4. A very immature gravedigger who's grown infatuated with [Rachel](https://anilist.co/character/123327/Gardner-Rachel) after seeing her documents, often seen obsessed with the idea of giving her the most beautiful burial and grave he can. He despises [Zack](https://anilist.co/character/123328/Foster-Isaac) for his lack of subtlety and finesse.

Born into a family that had been graveyard workers for generations, Eddie would pour all his heart into it, with creating beautiful graves quickly becoming his one true passion. He was always appreciated by his father, who'd often remark that he's the best worker in the family.

Despite that, due to being the third sibling - with one younger brother and two older ones - he'd always receive hand-me-downs from his older brothers, and would eventually be forced to give up his belongings to his younger brother (even boots which he purchased with his own money), thus never truly having anything of his own. He'd even be told that the family pets - which he not only loved, but took great care of - belonged to everyone and not him alone. Even when he had to bury the family's pet bird which his oldest brother killed in a fit of rage, he still felt like it wasn't "his" - only when he was forced to put down and bury the family cat would his heart find peace, leading to him developing an obsession with making things "his" by burying them in graves of his own making.

His oldest brother, Albert, developed severe anger issues that went untreated, prompting him to destroy items around the house and harm the family pets. In order to avoid that, Eddie would often let his brother use him as a punching bag, believing that if he endures his abuse, they would all be safe - however, he could never bring himself to hate his brother or tell his parents about what was going on, with his obsessive devotion to grave-digging eventually worsening and becoming a way to cope with both his own mental problems and the physical harm his brother would inflict.

~!At some point, he had grown closer to a little girl of similar age to him, who would often accompany him during his grave-digging at night, but refused to talk about herself despite wearing tattered clothes and being covered in bandages, prompting Eddie's concern. Soo after, as Albert's condition worsened and his abuse became much worse, Eddie's psyche would reach its breaking point, with him opting to kill and bury all the family pets so that they would never be hurt by his brother ever again. At the same time, the girl he had befriended arrived once again, revealing that she had run away from an abusive foster family and had nowhere to go. Seeing that she's suffering, Eddie would put her out of her misery with his own hands, later burying her in a grave of his own making, happy that she was not only free from abuse, but also, became truly "his".!~

name.native: ダニエル・ディケンズ

123330.description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")

A psychiatrist in charge of floor B5 who claims to have been Ray's counselor. Despite his gentle facade, he hides a much more sinister persona.

He was born without his right eye, alienating him from other kids and adults alike. Despite his mother's mental health gradually declining as a result of seeing him struggle to fit in and blaming herself for his imperfection, he constantly attempted to show his affection towards her by staring into her empty, despair-filled eyes, eventually leading her to take her own life. Since then, he developed an obsession with people's eyes, chasing the same sort of despair and emptiness he'd seen in his mother's stare. 
When he worked in the same prison as Cathy and Lucy, he'd collect prisoners' eyeballs. His fixation would reach its peak the moment he met Ray - considering her eyes the most beautiful ones he's ever seen, he wishes to remain by Ray's side forever, going to extreme lengths to keep her in his care.

~!Prompted by his strange attraction to Ray, he was the one to decorate her floor of the building, not only replicating her family home, but also bringing her toys, stuffed animals, fake flowers, and even a music box that was given to her by her parents back when they were a happy family.!~

He has a quirk of swapping out his regular prosthetic eye for one with a double iris whenever he gets excited.

123331.description:
__Height:__ 176cm (5'8"); 166cm (5'4") without boots

An ex-prison guard in charge of floor B3 of the building, thoroughly devoted to her role as a self-proclaimed judge and executioner, guided by her twisted sense of justice. A cheerful and sassy sadomasochist who enjoys torturing those sent to her using elaborate traps and challenges in order to create a game show-like spectacle for her own entertainment. She views Zack as an exemplary sinner, attempting to punish him thoroughly for her amusement, and tends to disregard Ray as "dull" despite her initial interest in her.

As the only child of a respected family of doctors, she attended a prestigious all-girls' school, where many other students initially idolized her and admired her beauty. However, after her parents committed malpractice and were murdered by a relative of their patient, a number of rumors began circulating, leading to her schoolmates heavily ostracizing her.

123338.description: A young fisherman. He was caught in a storm at sea and was on the brink of drowning before the mermaid, Arte, saved his life.

123339.description:
The prince who made iced coffee popular in the Land of Sand. He has fallen for the "Lovely Lady" Adelheid. His favorite is coffee floats.

(Source: Official Site)

123340.description:
Princess of the Land of Sand. She speaks in a masculine manner around her half-brother Shareef. Her favorite is soda floats.

(Source: Official Site)

123341.description: A human and the little sister of Sarah Gold. Unlike her sister, she is more lady like and has no interest in adventures and treasure hunting. Sia deeply cares for her sister and worries about her as she does not want her to follow in their late grandfather's footsteps and encounter the same fate as him.

123342.description: A wood elf from the Elvin Capital and a regular at Nekoya. Being a friend of Fardania's parents, he too discovered Nekoya and his new favorite foods, miso and tofu. Ever since his first visit to Nekoya, he has been trying to find a way to replicate miso and tofu with elven beans.

123343.description: A mermaid living in the other world and a regular at Nekoya. She first discovered Nekoya many years ago and began visiting every week after experiencing their hamburger steak.

123384.description:
**Hardness**: 2

The only gem who goes on night patrol. Due to their body producing Mercury (which is harmful to gems and living things), they are isolated and insecure. They hate fighting and hate to be seen.

According to [Rutile](https://anilist.co/character/123399/Rutile), Cinnabar has an extraordinary amount of talent and combat ability, but is too much to handle due to their uncontrollable poison. Cinnabar's silver poison gathers faint light at night, which keeps them awake and aware while night patrolling. According to [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou), the night patrol is something Cinnabar came up with themselves. They used to spend their time during the day in Hollow Cape, waiting for the Lunarians to take them since they thought they may at least be of use to them. They are knowledgeable about things other gems don't know about.

[Phosphophyllite](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) was recommended by the gems to see Cinnabar for the encyclopedia. After accidentally hearing their secret and wish, Phos promises to help Cinnabar find a job more suited to them than night patrol, saying, "a fun job only you can do." When encountering Phos each time, Cinnabar seems doubtful of their words, but they are the only gem they regularly speak to. Although they try not to show it, they have a tiny sliver of hope that Phos will be able to fulfill their promise.

Cinnabar is able to pull out an abundant amount of mercury. They're able to manipulate it in the air, from a distance, and around them. They seem to not be in full control over it and sometimes release it without wanting to.

name.native: フォスフォフィライト

123385.description:
**Hardness**: 3.5 ~!(legs: 7; head: 5)!~

The main protagonist and the youngest gem when the story began. They're weak, brittle - not suited for battle - and their clumsiness makes them difficult to maintain any roles, even though they've always wanted to be useful. Phos' initial job was to make a natural history encyclopedia which they progressed very little on. They promised to help [Cinnabar](https://anilist.co/character/123384/Cinnabar) find a job suited for them as well.

Phos is a young, overconfident, clumsy, and naive gem, who is the only one capable of getting away with talking back to [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou). Many gems describe them as lazy and useless due to their fragility and incompetence, although Phos does display a drive to help Sensei and the others, often held back by their low hardness.
