While ruthless to his enemies, he is loyal to his friends and crew and does have clear lines of morality, being disgusted with how the Tekkadan's crew were fitted with the Alaya-Vijnana system despite being children by their former employer.

127251.description: A civilian who encounters [Orga](https://anilist.co/character/89235/Itsuka-Orga) and [Mikazuki](https://anilist.co/character/89233/Augus-Mikazuki) aboard Saisei. Seeing that Orga cannot handle his alcohol intake, Merribit gives him her handkerchief. Merribit is later introduced as Teiwaz's liaison assigned to oversee activities aboard the Isaribi.

name.native: ユージン・セブンスターク

127252.description: A boy member of CGS, and the leader of the boys until [Orga](https://anilist.co/character/89235/Itsuka-Orga) joined. While physically and intellectually gifted, his impulsiveness renders him somewhat unlikable. Unhappy at having his position usurped by Orga, he begins to nurture a grudge.

127253.description:
Commander of Gjallarhorn's Outer Earth Orbit Regulatory Joint Fleet, a position most see as largely ceremonial. A member of the most powerful family in the Seven Stars, she is known to be fond of dramatic flair and strict codes of conduct. She is also determined to demonstrate her fleet's capabilities to the Seven Stars without external help, but is easily outraged if things do not go according to plan.

She used to be friends with [McGillis](https://anilist.co/character/89238/Fareed-McGillis) and [Gaelio](https://anilist.co/character/89239/Bauduin-Gaelio) in childhood, but now considers them to be annoying rivals at best, not hesitating to pull rank with Gaelio to keep him in line. On the other hand, she seems to have longstanding feelings for McGillis, but refuses to admit it to others and herself. She was made the ward of Iznario Fareed at some point in the past because of her father's chronic illness.

127254.description:
Azee is a pilot under Teiwaz with a cool personality, she carries out orders from Naze Turbine calmly during combat. 

Azee is a highly skilled pilot and is easily far more capable than most pilots, even those who utilize the Alaya-Vijnana system. Only those of extreme skill and/or talent could be considered greater than herself. However, her skill only truly shines when she's fighting alongside her companion Lafter as both are highly trained to fight in sync with the other.

Not much is known of Azee's past other than that like Naze's other wives she was rescued from poor circumstances and accepted the offer to join his crew the Turbines years ago. Ever since then she has served as one of Naze's most skilled pilots, and one of his wives, alongside her partner Lafter, also a wife of Naze. 

Unit:
STH-05 Hyakuren
STH-05R Rouei
STH-16 Shiden
STH-20 Hekija

name.native: クラッカ・グリフォン
マクマード・バリストン
ラフタ・フランクランド

127259.description:
She is the member of Teiwaz. She is usually quite cheerful, outgoing, and a little childish. As a pilot, she can display a playful but ruthless streak, toy with her enemies before finishing them off. Like most of the Turbine members, She acts as a mentor/big sister for the young members of Tekkadan.

Lafter is an excellent pilot, able to keep up with Tekkadan pilots even without the use of Alaya-Vijnana system. Lafter shares a close and friendly relationship with her partner Azee in all things including the battle where both tend to fight together in sync to completely overwhelm their foes.

127266.description:
Yachiyo's friend and Suzu's classmate who often serves as the straight-man trying to bring Yachiyo and Suzu's relationship back down to reality.

(Source: Wikipedia)

127272.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

A happy-go-lucky student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the leader and vocalist of Hello, Happy World!. Her family is ridiculously rich and lives in one of the biggest houses in the area. She's the only member of her school's astronomy club.

Kokoro is an idealistic and charismatic young girl whose goal in life is to make the entire world smile. She effortlessly attracts others to her with her bright and bubbly nature, often sweeping them up into her easygoing pace. She is easily able to do and get what she wants, no matter how absurd the request, mostly thanks to "the suits": three bodyguards that follow Kokoro around that can seemingly accomplish anything she wants like magic, appearing out of nowhere when they're needed. As a sheltered rich girl, Kokoro is ignorant about certain normalities like taking the train.

Kokoro is also very curious and easily amazed, charmed by new things she discovers in the world around her. Even though she has the optimism and charm of a natural leader, she appears rather scatterbrained and unable to accomplish much without others' help. Despite this, however, she has also shown hints of being something of a genius with her ability to master almost any skill instantly, and of being surprisingly perceptive to the people around her, although she rarely shows it. Kokoro doesn't seem to understand negative emotions; she's stated that she doesn't know what it feels like to be sad, and Marina once had to explain to her what it means to be stressed. Kokoro describes people who aren't happy as simply not smiling or having "forgotten their smile", and as per her dream, she does always her best to combat any kind of negative feelings.

name.native: エイブラハム・グレイ

127275.description:
An extremely eloquent and stern elderly priest residing in a cathedral on floor B2. He attempts to make Ray doubt her choices and beliefs, being deeply obsessed with exploring what religious beliefs truly mean to people.
He's also proficient in using illusions and hallucinogenic drugs (which, as Ray remarks, make him give off a strange, sweet scent) in order to lead his subjects into a state of mania and expose their true selves.

While not much is known about his past, he had apparently always shown a keen interest in studying what makes people believe in God and follow a religion. At some point he had become a reverend in a small town's church, gaining many followers thanks to his mesmerizing speeches and strange ability to learn their true nature (secretly derived from his proficiency with hallucinogenic drugs). After his curiosity reached its peak, he would come up with the idea of an experiment in which he'd use a group of ruthless, self-righteous serial killers - which he'd call his "Angels" - in order to determine what is it that makes people - whom he'd call his "Sacrifices" - religious.

Shortly after, Danny and Cathy visited him, having heard of him from a prisoner who was a religious fanatic. With the two fulfilling his critera of "Angels", he would recruit them to be part of his experiments. At some point in time, he would take in Eddie and Zack the same way, even giving Zack a scythe to encourage him to join.

127277.description:
A top idol and Kokomi's older brother. He has a serious sister complex and hates it when Saiki is near her.

(Source: Wikipedia)

127278.description: Jinshi is the eunuch in charge of the affairs of the inner palace. He is described as having a face capable even of outshining the consorts in beauty, amazing women and men alike. He is constantly accompanied by his attendant [Gaoshun](https://anilist.co/character/244317/Gaoshun) and has taken an interest to [Maomao](https://anilist.co/character/126824/Maomao)'s intelligence and active demeanor.

127292.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Marcille is a mage who is part of [Laios'](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios) party. She is an elf from the Northern Continent.

~!She is actually half-elf and half tall-man. Her mother is an elf, and father was a tall-man who passed away when Marcille was young.!~

Marcille is kind, intelligent, principled, and loyal to her friends. However, she can also be very high-strung and has a difficult time dealing with things far outside her comfort zone (such as eating monsters). She has a lot of confidence in her magic ability due to her background, and can feel lonely when she's unable to help the party. She was one of the best students at the Magic Academy, where she joined the research program specializing in dungeon-making; this is where she met [Falin](https://anilist.co/character/130508/Thorden-Falin), and is still her closest friend to this day. Marcille can also be a bit naive at times, believing that friendships alone can keep a party together.

127318.description:
Emilico is the main protagonist of the Shadows House series and narrates some of the chapters. She is a Living Doll working as a maid in the Shadows House and as a "face" of [Kate Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/127319/Kate).

Emilico is cheerful and hard-working. Her top priority is taking care of her master Kate Shadow, whom she is friends with. She likes making friends and spending time with them. Although she is inexperienced and sometimes clumsy, she is also dependable. She keeps a positive attitude and stands up for others. Emilico is curious and eager to learn new things. She enjoys cleaning in the Shadows house and always tries to improve.

127319.description:
Kate is a young girl in the Shadow family, a noble family. Her "Living Doll" is [Emilico](https://anilist.co/character/127318/Emilico). Like the rest of the Shadow family, Kate is a shadow. Her whole body including her hair is black. She wears a red dress with a white frill underneath. She is a very calm and intelligent young girl.


__Season One Spoiler__
~!At the beginning of the story she is very distant with Emilico although she cares about her. She apparently suffers a lot because of a shadow and her emotions are not easy to understand. But with the help of Emilico, she opens up more socially, though is still quite distant with the other master shadows. Kate is also against the illustrious Grandfather and is organizing a revolution against him.!~

127391.description: Chika used to date Rikuo in high school. She eventually broke up with him to date someone else. She has tendency to never turn someone down when they confess their feelings towards her, which leads to rumors and her nickname the "Queen of Disaster."

127393.description: Rou is a childhood friend of Shinako's and considers her family. Even though he treats her like an older sister, he has feelings for her.

127417.description:
Platelet is a type of cell working under the Platelet Division. She and her coworkers are responsible for reconstructing injuries and forming blood clots in the human body. Due to the Platelet's actual cell size, they are depicted as children. Platelet is a small, adorable cell with waist-length caramel blonde hair and brown eyes. She wears the Platelet uniform and is always seen working with her fellow workers.

Platelets play an important role in healing the body. They are powerless against threats; however, they are small and nimble thus able to move through bacterium under the protection of white blood cells to cover up wounds. Platelets also can aggregate together to close an open wound. They use a protein known as "Von Willebrand Factor" to help them, which functions similar to super-glue. Then, the "Coagulation Factors" in the blood will work to coat the blot with a net of Fibrin, causing it to solidify. She has a polite, bouncy personality that manifests a strong leadership to other Platelets. Her innocent and humble character made her loveable to other cells.

127420.description:
Aina is a first year at Oumi Women's University. She joins Grand Blue Diving Club after getting to know Iori and Kouhei. She is a really shy girl and hates having to expose her skin. She soon becomes good friends with Chisa.

~!She used to wear strong makeups to appear attractive not realizing her very makeup was a turn-off for men. She was part of the Tinkerbell Tennis Club but she was always looked down upon and made fun of by her seniors. Iori and Kouhei came to her rescue when she had it enough during the Miss Izu Contest as she resorted to getting drunk and broke down in tears in front of them.!~

~!Iori's words after saving Aina from the depth of despair during the Miss Izu Contest moved her so much so that suddenly her heart skipped a beat for him. She soon finds herself having feelings for Iori but she has been keeping her feelings to herself and she is yet to tell Iori how she feels about him. Iori is also the reason why she approached Azusa to let her join Grand Blue Diving Club.!~

alternative: Demon Lord of the Soul Krebskulm

127423.description:
《Demon Lord of the Soul, Krebskulm》 is the ruler of the Fallen (Demonic Beings).

~!She was once one being with the other Demon Lords but were split apart after being defeated by God. She was sealed in Rem Galleu's ancestor and was passed down from mother to daughter up to Rem.!~

alternative: Voice Hero: Present Mic (プレゼント・マイク)

127425.description:
__Height:__ 185cm (6'1")
__Quirk:__ Voice

Pro Hero. He also works as an English teacher at U.A. High School and as a radio talk show host.

Yamada maintains the eccentric persona of a radio host. He often poses when he talks and maintains a certain level of excitement or volume, regardless of the situation. Though he tends to be a jovial individual, Hizashi is capable of great rage when it comes to his friends and colleagues.

Yamada's Quirk "Voice" allows him to increase the volume of his voice, giving him an ability that is similar to a sonic scream. The sound from his Quirk is strong enough to cause people's ears to bleed from far away. The only known weakness of this Quirk is that the loud sounds do not travel well underground, making this Quirk ineffective against anything that is underground or separated from him by layers of earth.

alternative: Juu-hachi Kin Hero: Midnight (18禁ヒーロー ミッドナイト_

127427.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")
__Quirk:__ Somnambulist

Pro Hero. She also works as a Modern Hero Art History teacher at U.A. High School.

Nemuri is a very playful and flirtatious person with an unpredictably serious and temperamental side to her. She gets angry whenever someone interrupts her or insults her. She is especially sensitive about her age. Despite her flirtatious personality, Nemuri was intelligent, perceptive, and articulate. While she comes off as a hero who enjoys her fame derived from her beauty and sex appeal, Nemuri has demonstrated true heroism and bravery, willing to fight on the front lines and put her life at risk for others.

Nemuri's Quirk "Somnambulist" allows her to put nearby people to sleep by exuding a sleep-inducing aroma from her body. Her Quirk works better on males than females.

127430.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

Satowa is a first year student and the daughter of a famous koto family, Houzuki. She has been learning to play koto since she was little and has won many contests. Although she is a koto prodigy, Satowa was debarred from Houzukikai. She claims that she joined the koto music club because she wants to become known as "young virtuoso koto player that led a no-name school club to become number 1 in nation" when she makes professional debut. She loves koto.

127436.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Kaoru is a celebrity at her school and belongs to the theater department there. She is very popular with ladies, who she dubs her "little kittens". In particular, [Himari Uehara](https://anilist.co/character/128154/Uehara-Himari) and [Rimi Ushigome](https://anilist.co/character/120231/Ushigome-Rimi) have a tendency of blushing furiously in her presence. She likes to read philosophical books and poetry, but doesn't really understand it. Outside of the band, she is also friends with [Chisato Shirasagi](https://anilist.co/character/128165/Shirasagi-Chisato).

127441.description: Main protagonist of the series. One day, she founds herself in a weird world where masked people try to kill her. After realizing that her brother is in the same world as her, she is determined to stay alive and meet her brother.

127451.description:
Hanako's family servant.
Maeda has vowed to always assist and teach Hanako, even if it means lying to her as to appear all knowing and helpful, he's been doing that since her childhood though, she does act more disdainful towards poor Maeda but both still are fairly close.

He often appears out of nowhere to assist Hanako and the rest.

His loyalty goes as far as to ~!go to Nichome gay district and experience anal as to help Hanako's friend (Kasumi) with her story!~

127465.description:
Wei Wuxian is the founder of the Demonic Cultivation and a former disciple of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect. The son of Cangse-Sanren and Wei Changze.

Also known as the Yiling Patriarch, he died in the first siege of the Burial Mounds thirteen years prior to the start of the story. He was then reincarnated into the body of Mo Xuanyu through a sacrificial ritual.

127466.description: Lan Wangji is the second young master of the Lan clan. Titled as HanGuang-Jun, Lan Wangji is one of the Two Jades of Lan alongside his older brother, Lan Xichen.

127518.description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5'0")

Transformed into a demon and left mute, Nezuko travels with her older brother [Tanjirou](https://anilist.co/character/126071/Kamado-Tanjirou) in a box on his back. She can change her size at will, and is a capable fighter when she needs to be, but has never killed or eaten any humans. Instead of gaining nourishment from humans, it seems that she recovers her energy by sleeping for long periods of time.

127538.description:
__Death:__ August 30, 1997

Formerly a biker who conquered the entire Kyushu with her biker gang Dorami. Saki has a tough and rebellious attitude, calling [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/127540) a goody-two-shoes, and outright stating that she has no respect for those who don't have guts. However, after a successful performance, Saki takes being an idol very seriously and becomes leader of Franchouchou. Saki also occasionally shows a soft side, as seen in episode 6 where she comforts [Ai](https://anilist.co/character/127539). When she was alive, she was fond of her Tamagotchi and enjoys going to Drive in Tori. 

~!She died in a game of Chicken against a rival Biker Gang driving over a cliff.!~

127539.description:
__Death:__ August 4, 2008

She was a popular idol in the early 2000s from the idol group called Iron Frill.

~! __Cause of death:__ struck by lightning during a concert. Because of how she died, she is afraid of lighting. !~

When alive, Ai demonstrated a cheerful and determined personality, but after becoming a zombie she became rather skeptical and suspicious. As she gradually begins to warm up to her group, she begins to act like herself. She has shown a supportive side when aiding the other members with her idol experience.

127540.description:
__Year of death:__ April 7, 2008
__Cause of death:__ Collision with a pickup truck on her way to an idol audition

Before becoming a zombie, Sakura was an ordinary girl with nothing special going on in her life. She is shown to be an energetic girl and becomes very passionate whenever she is singing as an idol. 

~!When she regains her memories of her life but loses her memories of her Zombification, Sakura becomes very defeatist and detached due to the failures she kept facing in life no matter how hard she tried. After she regained all of her memories with the encouragement of her friends she regains her confidence and her love of performing.!~

127546.description: [Pekola](https://anilist.co/character/127126/Pekora)'s former subordinate, who seeks to kill Pekola so she can take her place as a fully-fledged angel. ~!However, she loses her powers after [Jashin](https://anilist.co/character/126884/Jashin-chan) eats her halo, taking up jobs as both a ramen shop worker and an idol.!~

127559.description: A third year and the captain of the Fredericia Girls' High School badminton club.

name.native: ボリス・フォイルナー

127568.description:
is a member of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District. 

Boris came to Annie's defense when she got late to her duty, telling others to give her a rest. He stated that being the only one to experience the actual combat (Defense of Trost district) among her squad, Annie must be still suffering trauma from it. 

When Marlo tells his colleagues of his ambition to reform the Military Police, Boris tells Marlo good luck, albeit with nonchalance

127572.description:
Dimo Reeves is a merchant that leads the company that's named after him. He's stationed in Trost District.
~!After the Battle of Trost, his company was assigned a mission to kidnap Eren and Historia by the Military Police Brigade.!~

name.native: モブリット・バーナー

127573.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Executive Officer, Fourth Squad.

A veteran member of the Survey Corps and [Hange Zoe](https://anilist.co/character/71121/Hange-Zoe)'s second-in-command within the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad. He also serves as Hanji's assistant and messenger.

He comes across as an intelligent and responsible person, which may be the reason he was tasked to keep his overzealous and eccentric superior out of trouble. Much of the time, this leaves him in a state of near-panic, having to constantly remind Hange to be more careful or yanking them to safety. That he remains at Hange's side constantly suggests he is a loyal person, and that he cares deeply for his superior's safety, regardless of the stress involved with being under their command. He is also able to show signs of a serious nature when it comes to missions, going out of his way to investigate problems and put himself in danger before others.

127574.description: Yuuri is [Yukiko Shirato's](https://anilist.co/character/130053/Yukiko-Shirato) bodyguard and the current champion of Megalolania, a massive megaloboxing tournament headed by the Shirato Group. He seeks out the underground fighter [Junk Dog (Joe)](https://anilist.co/character/125369/Joe) after he had insulted both him and Yukiko, meeting him in the underground ring where he easily defeats him and challenges him to work his way up to Megalonia if he wants to fight him again. Yuuri is equipped with a unique prototype state-of-the-art "integrated" Gear, which is surgically grafted directly to his arms.

127585.description: The sole female member of Gridman Alliance and Yūta's classmate, who found the amnesiac boy in front of her house. Out of her teammates, she desires a normal life but wishes Yūta to keep fighting as Gridman to save her friends. ~!Once discovering Akane's double life as the creator of the monsters, Rikka becomes committed to reason with her friend despite the former's insistence that their friendship was not genuine. Before Akane leaves for her world, Rikka gives her a purse case as a departure gift.!~

127587.description: Akane is noted to be a kind and popular girl, liked by all her classmates, and especially admired by Utsumi. ~!However, behind that facade lies a mentally troubled individual with sociopathic tendencies, easily harboring petty grudges against anyone who wrongs her, even if it was an accident. She is also shown to be extremely manipulative and violent. Alongside Alexis Kerib, she serves as a central antagonist in SSSS.Gridman.!~

127592.description:
Gridman (グリッドマン, Guriddoman) is a Hyper Agent from the Hyper World and the titular hero of SSSS.GRIDMAN and GRIDMAN UNIVERSE. 

~!In SSSS.GRIDMAN, he chose Yuuta Hibiki as his host to stop Alexis Kerib in order to save Akane Shinjou. However, the injuries he sustained from the fight against Alexis resulted Gridman split into six fragments. Whereas Gridman's master fragment resided within an old computer aptly named "Junk", Four of the fragments spawned new Hyper Agents that became both hosts of said fragments and new assist weapons at the simulated city while the last one ended up possessing his new partner Yuuta, resulting the latter's seemed amnesia.!~

~!In GRIDMAN UNIVERSE, his power of creation was being manipulated by a sentient kaiju named Mad Origin, which resulted in the creation of Kaiju using the Hyper Agent's thoughts for the purpose of harvesting the negative thoughts of humankind from various universes. Multiple universes were trapped inside Gridman's true form, resulting in a chaotic overlapping between universes akin to The Big Crunch. He was ultimately saved by Yuuta Hibiki and Akane Shinjou with the help of the imprisoned Alexis Kerib!~

127594.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")

Natsuo is introduced as a second-year high school student who loves writing novels, so he frequently heads to the rooftop during his lunch breaks to develop his passion. It is there that he meets the rookie English teacher named [Hina Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana), who becomes his first crush. His current appearance is far different from his junior high days thanks to following the suggestion of [Fumiya Kurimoto](https://anilist.co/character/135349/Fumiya-Kurimoto) (Natsuo's best friend), who forced him to wear contact lenses instead of eye glasses and have his curly hair flattened daily.

127595.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'4")
__Occupation:__ Teacher

She is the elder sister of [Rui Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127596/Rui-Tachibana), but soon after [Tsukiko Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/135347/Tsukiko-Tachibana) (Hina's divorced mother) marries a widower named [Akihito Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/135352/Akihito-Fujii), Hina becomes the stepsister of [Natsuo Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii).

~! It is also pretty much likely that due to a necessity of a paternal figure added to the kindness of [Shuu](https://anilist.co/character/135346/Shuu-Hagiwara), she developed a crush on him, which led her to get involved into an affair with him time after they ran into each other as she was in her fourth year at the university. !~
It is not so clear if she feels becoming a teacher is her true call, even though she admits she has worked really hard to get her license. She is really into comedy shows. She does enjoy festivals in general, not only for the food but for the different attractions, especially the goldfish scooping. She is afraid of cockroaches to the point of running away from seeing them, without worrying if she is wearing something or not. She also freezes up with thunder storms.

127596.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Occupations:__ High school student, Apprentice Chef

Rui is the younger sister of [Hina Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana), but soon after [Tsukiko Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/135347/Tsukiko-Tachibana) (Rui's divorced mother) marries a widower named [Akihito Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/135352/Akihito-Fujii), Rui becomes [Natsuo Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii)'s step-sister.

At first glance, Rui is an aloof and blunt girl who is hard to read emotionally. Her standoffish personality has made it difficult for her to socialize. As her first meeting at a mixer, she didn't do much to interact with the others. Once someone passes through her cold demeanor, Rui is actually a very kind and loving girl throughout the series. In spite of this, it can be hard for her to express her feelings towards someone she genuinely likes. She is very supportive of people she cares about, in spite of their flaws and even if their desires conflict with her own. Rui has a tendency to pout when things don't go her way, though [Natsuo](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii) finds this feature of hers adorable. Rui is also surprisingly easy to embarrass in spite of her stoic personality. When [Natsuo](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii) lists all of her behaviors he finds cute, especially to other people in front of her, she becomes overwhelmingly flustered.

127603.description:
__Race:__ Beastman
__Species:__ Black Cat
__Class:__ Swordlord

Fran is the main female protagonist of the Tensei Shitara Ken Deshita story. 

She is normally stoic and expressionless, Fran can be quick to anger when her race is insulted and is almost completely unafraid of the idea of displaying violence and mercilessness for the sake of achieving her goals. She views most Blue Catkin with hostility due to their betrayal and selling of her people into slavery. Fran will express happiness or excitement at the prospects of fighting a strong opponent or eating curry. Anyone, that insults that which she takes pride in, will face her wrath. Fran does not completely understand metaphors and will take things literally.

127613.description:
__Height:__ 5'4" (162 cm)

She is the younger sister of Sakuta Azusagawa. 

~!Suffered amnesia and gained a different personality after her ordeal with Adolescence Syndrome stemming from online bullying. Since then, she has lived with Sakuta and has not attended school.!~

127625.description:
Part of Group K who battled against Group C in Tomodachi Game

~!Secretly the genius/real leader of Group K!~

~!Played again with Katagiri, in the adult version of Tomodachi Game!~

~!Later accepted as part of the Katagiri group as a friend!~

127626.description: The leader of Group K who battled against Group C in the third round of Tomodachi Game.

127629.description: Shi Fen's best friend with whom Shi Miao falls in love.

127630.description: The older brother, Shi Fen is a first year at high school. He occasionally gets beaten up by his sister due to his stupid tendencies.

127631.description: The younger sister, Shimiao is a third year at middle school. Her specialty is sports.

127633.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")
__Talent:__ Explaining any strange phenomenon with science

She is [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Azusagawa-Sakuta)'s classmate, who is always cool and calm, always willing to give various advice on puberty syndrome. She is also the sole member of the Science Club, and known as an eccentric person at the school. 

(Source: Aniplex USA)

127635.description: Tomodachi game management. Serves as an observer for the K group of [Juuzou](https://anilist.co/character/127626/Kadokura-Juuzou) and others.

127636.description: An observer of Tomodachi Game who is fascinated by [Yuuichi](https://anilist.co/character/122064/Katagiri-Yuuichi) and his strange tactics.

127637.description:
A shy girl who used to get bullied in primary school that participated in Tomodachi Game alongside her friends. She is considered to be weak and helpless so she is oftenly used by [Yuuichi Katagiri](https://anilist.co/character/122064/Katagiri-Yuuichi) in order for his plans to succeed.

~!Is one of the traitors of group C!~

~!She has a second personality that she keeps deeply hidden from her friends is dark and twisted. Yutori has no qualms about hitting her own mother and is actually very rich, though it is unknown where she gets most of her money from. Yutori is an unstable person as she is insanely obsessed with Yuuichi, even using her own money and attempting to kill others in order to make Yuuichi love her. This side of Yutori has no loyalty to any of her friends, even Yuuichi. It is unknown when Yutori developed her obsession with Yuuichi, however it was revealed in the manga that she knew Yuuichi before he met her in high school.!~

127638.description: A solemn female student that is respected by her classmates for her hard working and serious nature. She participated in Tomodachi Game alongside her friends.

127639.description: A strategist/genius with grades at the top of his class who participated in Tomodachi Game alongside his friends.

127640.description: Administrator of Tomodachi Game. He tends to change his appearance and personality based on what type of game is currently being played in Tomodachi Game.

127641.description: A somewhat idiotic guy who comes from a rich family and has an obvious crush on [Shiho Sawaragi](https://anilist.co/character/127638/Sawaragi-Shiho). He participated in the Tomodachi Game alongside his friends.

127643.description: Kazunao Yamada takes no interest in the personal lives of his students and is very apathetic. He has no motivation to work hard and only shows interest in Bishoujo style games and cheap food. He also enjoys teasing his students.

127644.description: An assistant mechanic to Nadi Yukinojou Kassapa who works on the mobile weapons.

127653.description: A high-spirited member of CGS, later Tekkadan.

127689.description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (4'7")

Senshi is a member of [Laios](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios)' party. He is a dwarf from the Eastern Continent.

Having spent 10 years studying monster cuisine and living a self-sufficient life inside the dungeon, Senshi loves cooking and is more than happy to share his knowledge and skills. He is dependable and strong, but can also be rather stubborn and set in his ways. He helps maintain the natural environment and ecology of the dungeon, and considers  himself part of it. He dislikes magic and treats it with a great deal of gravity and caution.

127691.description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6'3")
__Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer, Teacher
__Affiliation:__ Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical College, Gojou Family
__Grade:__ Special Grade Sorcerer
__Cursed Technique:__ Six Eyes, Limitless

Satoru Gojou is one of the main protagonists of the Jujutsu Kaisen series. He is a special-grade jujutsu sorcerer and is widely recognized as the strongest in the world. Satoru is the pride of the Gojou Family, the first person to inherit both the Limitless and the Six Eyes in four hundred years. He works as a teacher at the Tokyo Jujutsu High and uses his influence to protect and train strong young allies

127745.description: An ex-Air Self-Defense Force soldier who becomes the Takanashi family’s maid. She claims to only be interested in girls who haven’t menstruated yet, forming a particular attachment towards Misha.

127746.description:
A Russian girl who has become a rebellious recluse following her mother's death. She is fearful of Tsubame's behavior and often tries to find ways to get rid of her.

(Source: Wikipedia)

127754.description:
Misha's father, who becomes over delighted when Misha shows her any kind of interest.

(Source: Wikipedia)

127760.description:
**Hometown:** USA
**Motto:** Con pan y vino se anda el camino (With bread and wine, you can walk your road).

A girl who grew up in Los Angeles. Good with English, but terrible with Japanese kanji. Since she was raised by her grandmother in place of her parents who were busy with work, she is very close to her grandmother. Her favorite food is smashed cucumbers with plum dressing.

(Source: Official Website)

127767.description:
A young man who is dismal in various facets of life: He's not academic, he's not athletic, and he's not very attractive. The only thing he's got going for him is an insane amount of mad gamer skills. He rules the arcade scene as "Beastly Fingers Haruo", until he meets his match during a fateful encounter with [Akira Oono](https://anilist.co/character/126962/Oono-Akira) while playing Street Fighter II. Undeterred, he seeks to challenge and one day out play her, considering her his rival.

While he starts off as a snarky brat with an ego bigger than any winning streak he could rack up in Street Fighter, he eventually grows out of it. However, he never abandons his dedication and love for gaming, which almost borders on unhealthy obsession. On the bright side, this pure passion for gaming is what leads him to finding some of his closest friends.

127768.description:
Meganee is one of the supporting characters in PriPara and a staff member at Prism Stone. There is more than one of her active in PriPara. She seems to be a cheery, kind, and friendly person. She is a helpful, supportive character.

(Source: PriPara Wikia)

127780.description:
Reona is the younger twin of Dorothy West and is of Canadian (father) and Japanese (mother) descent.

Reona is quite shy and would wither away if not for Dorothy. Often Reona follows whatever Dorothy does as an example, such as pretending to faint if she would or dislike someone if she does. This changes as the season continues and Reona starts to gain more confidence to do more without Dorothy and also becoming slightly more outgoing.

Reona is relaxed and can easily calm others, most notably young children. This is emphasized by the catchphrase "(Tension) relax!". Reona is also shown to be quite feminine.

(Source: Pripara Wiki)

alternative: Faruru Bokerdole (ファルル・ボーカルドール)

127781.description: Falulu is a mysterious vocal doll who appears in episode 1 and later makes her debut as an idol in episode 17. At the beginning of the series, she is very naive and doesn't know a lot of words so she tends to repeat the words and actions of others (even copies Laala's and Mirei's catchphrases and actions). Her voice sounds slightly robotic, and she tends to call certain things (like the Prism Voice and Laala) sparkling. Despite not knowing what emotions are, she still expresses anger, fear and happiness. She is also very smart, being able to solve long equation problems within seconds. Episode 37 spoilers ~!After her re-awakening in Episode 37, Falulu's personality becomes much more human-like and vivacious and her speaking voice, as well as her singing voice, loses its robotic quality. She also became more responsible and worrisome since she now has 100 little sisters to watch over.!~

127785.description:
Non is Laala's younger sister. She is a 4th grade elementary school student and fan of Pink Actress, as well as an admirer of Falulu, Aromageddon, and Fuwari Midorikaze.
Unlike her older sister, Non is very mature, intelligent and knows a lot about idols. She also tends to act as the older sibling in the family, taking care of Laala when she's sick and scolding her when she does something silly.
Even though she often says that she wants to surpass her sister, and even mocks and scolds her sometimes, she respects Laala greatly and is ready to defend her when someone says anything bad about her.

127808.description:
A girl in [Haruo](https://anilist.co/character/127767)'s class throughout junior high. Goes to an all-girl school with Onizuka throughout high school. Previously an introverted girl who spent much of her time studying alone, she develops into a more sociable person and develops an interest in gaming after spending time with Haruo over a new Neo Geo MVS that gets installed in front of her family's store.
~!She has a natural instinct for fighting games, which transforms her into a powerful forced to be reckoned with as both a gamer, and a rival for Haruo's affections. After a fateful showdown at her and Haruo's usual stomping grounds, she developed a bit of a sadistic side whenever Haruo's around. This frightening skill garnered the attention of the "Mizonokuchi Force" leader, Nikotama, who helped Koharu truly awaken her love for fighting games.!~

127840.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

A typical 1st year high-school student at Minegahara High School who can take hints, but is slightly scatterbrained. Being overly concerned about how people look at her, she hides her Hakata accent, which comes out when she panics or is relaxed.

(Source: Aniplex USA, edited)

127841.description:
__Height:__ 158cm (5'2")
__Talent:__ Changing clothes quickly

Mai's half-sister, related through her father. A member of the idol group "Sweet Bullet" and designated as the most fashionable within the group. Despite her flashy looks, she attends an elite all girls' high school. She is confident and can be competitive.

(Source: Aniplex USA)

127843.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")
__Talent:__ Early to bed, early to rise

A girl who has the same first and last name as [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Azusagawa-Sakuta)'s first crush. She is a shy middle school girl, but reliable and kind.

She bumps into Sakuta, while holding an umbrella over an abandoned cat in the rain.

~!It is later revealed that the older Shouko that Sakuta encounters is from the future, and is able to return to the past due to her puberty syndrome.!~

127924.description:
Yoshida is the main male character of the Hige wo Soru. Soshite Joshikousei wo Hirou. series. He is an office worker in Tokyo who lives alone in his apartment. One night, after being rejected by his boss, [Airi Gotou](https://anilist.co/character/127927/Gotou-Airi), he had a fateful encounter with a runaway high school girl named [Sayu](https://anilist.co/character/127925/Ogiwara-Sayu).

Living alone most of his life, Yoshida grew to be a highly independent person. He is an exceptional and reliable employee who's always dedicated to his work; pulling off overtime daily and even helps lighten the load of tasks of his colleagues. He is a man of virtue. Even though he barely knew Sayu he was more than willing to let her stay at his place and felt a sense of responsibility of guiding and watching over her. He is very kind towards others which baffles almost anyone who knew him. He is also a huge gentleman. Unlike most other men, he resists firmly to temptation as seen when Sayu was initially very seductive of him and asked him to make love with her. He believes that he should only do that with a woman whom he loves and that his feelings are also being reciprocated.

Because of his upright and serious nature, Yoshida is not good at dealing with women especially those who can control the flow of conversation. He only had one girlfriend throughout his life and it was a high school senpai. Yoshida openly admitted that his type is mature, older woman.

127925.description:
Sayu Ogiwara is the main female character of the Hige wo Soru. Soshite Joshikousei wo Hirou. She is a runaway high school girl from Hokkaido who ended up in Tokyo, in which she had a fateful encounter with a stranger named [Yoshida](https://anilist.co/character/127924/Yoshida).

After running away from her hometown and family for unclear reasons, Sayu was forced to adapt and live her new life as a runaway high school girl. With no money to sustain her basic needs like food and shelter, she gathered her resolve and resorted into seducing men, using her body as a bargaining chip in order to survive. As she kept this lifestyle for about half a year, she became shrewd and adopted a playful, flirty mask to hide her pain and used her bright smile for deceit. To mask her identity, she used aliases. She also developed a high level of maturity and strong mental fortitude, traits which are uncommon for a normal high school girl to have at her age. She hated what she was doing at first, but after a while, being wanted by those men made her feel she could be herself and that she was needed. For her, it was simple and she liked it that way. Because she was already used to that kind of arrangement, she was conflicted when Yoshida let her stay without any significant demands.

~!Sayu is a daughter of the Ogiwara Family, a prominent family hailing from the city of Asahikawa, Hokkaido. Her older brother, [Issa Ogiwara](https://anilist.co/character/184100/Ogiwara-Issa), is a CEO of a famous food corporation.!~

~!Sayu has romantic feelings for Yoshida but decided to suppress it in order not to get in the way of Yoshida's lovelife and put a strain to their relationship.!~

127927.description: [Yoshida's](https://anilist.co/character/127924/) superior. Her refined manners and care for others make her a character who is idolized within the company. The subject of Yoshida's unrequited love of 5 years.

127928.description: A fresh recruit who [Yoshida](https://anilist.co/character/127924/) is responsible for training. She often makes mistakes, but always manages to slip away from trouble with a smile that people find hard to dislike.

127973.description: Tarou is a first-year student currently attending Yezo Agricultural High School. He is in the Food Science department.

128002.description: Hajime is a first-year student currently attending Yezo Agricultural High School. His family grows potatoes.

128040.description:
Shuna is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962), evolving her from an Ogre to a Kijin. She was originally the princess of the Ogre tribe and even though she had the talent for using Magic, she was a sheltered girl, but quickly got along with the Goblinas

Shuna is the daughter of the late ogre chieftain and she is also [Benimaru](https://anilist.co/character/128038)'s younger sister, which is why she's nicknamed "Oni Princess" by Rimuru. Very skilled and knowledgeable in domestic matters, she essentially becomes Rimuru's chief economic advisor together with [Rigurd](https://anilist.co/character/129348).

128066.description:
The leader of 1st Year High School division of the "Black Dogs". He has been in love with Juliet since their childhood and has always secretly protected her during the group's war. He is a romantic when it comes to dating Juliet and is often timid when making advances. However, he will always confront problems head-on, especially regarding Juliet or fellow students. Whilst physically strong, he struggles with his studies and is unable to swim.

He is currently a servant under Teria's care whilst aiming to become one of the "Black Dog's" prefects. He is also now the leader of 2nd Year High School division of the "Black Dogs".

(Source: Wikipedia)

128075.description: Hitomi is a reserved girl who hesitates to interact with people. She cannot see the colours around her and sees everything in monochrome. Hitomi is sent back 60 years in the past by her grandmother and tells Hitomi to meet her younger self from when she was in high school.

128076.description: Chigusa is a first-year and the youngest member of the art & photography club.

128077.description: She is the grandmother of [Hitomi Tsukishiro](https://anilist.co/character/128075/Hitomi-Tsukishiro) who sends her back to 2018 to explore the past, make friends and regain her sense of color.

128078.description: She is a member of Art & Photography Club who likes to taking photos of rabbits. Shou is Asagi's childhood friend whom she has a crush on.

128080.description: Yuito Aoi is one of the main characters of Iroduku Sekai no Ashita kara. He is a member of the photography club whose hobby is drawing and Hitomi Tsukishiro is able to see his drawings in color for some reason.

128096.description: In class 2-1 and the cooking club.

128105.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")

A struggling university student living in Tokyo. He studies at Nerima University. Kazuya possesses a wishy-washy nature and is susceptible to yielding to his selfish desires. His lies often get him into trouble, because he cannot muster the strength to tell the truth. On the other hand, possessing a straightforward kindness that cares for those around him. He has also developed feelings for [Chizuru](https://anilist.co/character/128106/Ichinose-Chizuru).

128106.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

Chizuru Ichinose, alternatively known as Chizuru Mizuhara in her "rental girlfriend" persona, is a college student at Nerima University who is majoring in Literature and she currently lives in Room 204 of Royal Hills Nerima, just next to [Kazuya Kinoshita](https://anilist.co/character/128105/Kazuya-Kinoshita).

128143.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
__Instruments:__ Roland FA-08 and Roland AX-Synth (Black)

The student council president of Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the last member to join Roselia as their keyboardist. She is also part of the library committee at school. Rinko is very shy, and is at first scared of the idea of performing in a live concert. She is also the band's costume designer and sews their outfits all by herself. Her hobbies are reading and playing online games, the latter through which she met her best friend, [Ako](https://anilist.co/character/128144/Udagawa-Ako).

Socially awkward, Rinko is a shy and asocial girl who was initially too frightened to speak in front of others, let alone perform before them. She has a tendency to stammer when speaking, and usually keeps quiet until she feels comfortable. When she is set on or passionate about something, however, she does so with conviction, like piano or online games. Rinko also tends to get very excited about her passions, to the point where when she was explaining how Neo Fantasy Online worked to the other Roselia members, she was speaking in an alarming speed.

128144.description:
__Height:__ 148 cm (4'10")
__Instruments:__ DW (Drum Workshop) Collector Series: Pure Maple five-piece drum set

Ako is a student at Haneoka Girls' High School and Roselia's drummer. She admires [Yukina](https://anilist.co/character/128146/Minato-Yukina) and her older sister [Tomoe](https://anilist.co/character/128155/Udagawa-Tomoe), and is the best friend of [Rinko](https://anilist.co/character/128143/Shirokane-Rinko), whom she calls "Rin-rin".

Ako has chuunibyou tendencies, and has illusions of grandeur and magical powers. Rinko suspects this is the result from her playing online games frequently. She enjoys playing the role while keeping a realistic mentality. She is very cheery and noisy, and, despite only being two years younger than the other band members, is treated like the kid sister by the other characters due to her childlike appearance and personality.

Ako often wonders how she can be a "cooler" person, and sometimes feels inadequate compared to her other band mates, especially since Yukina and [Sayo](https://anilist.co/character/126259/Hikawa-Sayo) occasionally ignore her or scoff at her ideas at times.

128146.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

Yukina Minato is a second-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and is the cold and fierce leader of [Roselia](https://anilist.co/staff/153170/Roselia). She is a powerful vocalist, sparking the admiration of the other Roselia members. She is next-door neighbors with [Lisa Imai](https://anilist.co/character/128147/Imai-Lisa), who is also her childhood friend, and considers [Ran Mitake](https://anilist.co/character/128153/Mitake-Ran) somewhat of a rival. 

Yukina has a cold-blooded and cut-throat attitude towards reaching her goals, cutting down any obstacles in her path. She expects nothing less than perfect and takes practice very seriously. Because of this, she has no qualms with chiding or insulting someone if she feels they are underperforming. She is openly dismissive and unkind to people she deems below her standards.

However, with the people she warms up to, she is not quite as nasty as usual. She also has a soft spot for cats, though she refuses to admit it.

128147.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")
__Instrument:__ ESP BTL Roselia Lisa Bass

A student at Haneoka Girls' High School and Roselia's bassist. She follows gyaru fashion, but keeps her interest in amigurumi secret, since it does not match her image. She is good at baking cookies and is part of the dance club at school. Lisa is best friends and next-door neighbors with [Yukina](https://anilist.co/character/128146/Minato-Yukina), and they have been good friends since they were young. Outside of the band, Lisa is also friends with [Moca](https://anilist.co/character/125931/Aoba-Moca), who is her coworker at her part-time job at the convenience store

Lisa is a friendly and lively girl who appears mature and calm. Despite her appearance, Lisa acts as the mediator in tense situations. She's often credited with keeping Roselia together despite the members' contrasting personalities and disagreements at times. She often chides the others if she feels necessary, and brings balance to the group. Lisa is very caring in nature; she's able to notice when a friend is troubled and is often the first to try and help. She does her best to do what she can for others, sometimes to a fault, putting her all into helping someone regardless of her own feelings. She sometimes calls herself an "onee-san" (older sister), but the other characters have also compared her to a mother.

Despite her proficient skills as a bassist, Lisa believes she is the least skilled member of Roselia. She gets sentimental and easily cries when her friends, especially Yukina, reaffirm just how much she is needed in the band or in general.

128153.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
__Instrument:__ Gibson Les Paul Custom Chambered Blackout Stallion Red Guitar

A student at Haneoka Girls' High School and the main vocalist and rhythm guitarist of [Afterglow](https://anilist.co/staff/156176/Afterglow). She is the only child of the masters of a flower arrangement school that dates back to over 100 years ago. Ran is strong-willed, hates losing, and treasures her friends and family deeply. Despite this, she founded Afterglow with her childhood friends as an attempt to rebel against her father, who wants her to inherit the school. She considers [Yukina Minato](https://anilist.co/character/128146/Minato-Yukina) somewhat of a rival.

Ran has an aloof nature, which hides her loneliness from other people. Deep down, she wishes to become closer to others, but can be socially awkward and has a tendency to trip over her words. She can be easily flustered and is somewhat hot-blooded. She keeps her problems to herself and brushes off others' attempts to help, but while she may appear cold or detached, the warmer side to her is best seen in her quiet fondness towards her friends, primarily the other members of Afterglow. Ran observes the other members while remaining unobtrusive and cares for them greatly; she often asks about their well-being or laughs at their jokes, albeit subtly.

She has a tendency of saying "same as always" (itsumodoori), which usually means the band has done their best. She also has a habit of leaving others "on read", only reading text messages sent to her without replying to them.

128154.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

Himari is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and is the leader and bassist of Afterglow. She is a huge fan of Kaoru.

Himari is cheerful, good-natured, and is the band coordinator. She struggles to read the mood of a situation, which means she sometimes does things that have no effect. She's weak to tear-jerkers and sentimental episodes, and is fairly romantic. She is also weak to being teased.

Himari enjoys comparing the different sweets she buys from convenience stores and likes making them as well. She also likes cute things like clothing and stuffed animals, but wants to be seen as "cool" by others. Her ideas are normally teased or rejected - but her bandmates try to show support in their own way.

128155.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")

Tomoe is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and Afterglow's drummer. She is the older sister of Ako. Tomoe is friends with the adults who work in the shopping district, and often attends her hometown's festivals to play the taiko drums. Outside of the band, she is also friends with Saaya and also works part-time at the fast food restaurant.

Tomoe is a fairly relaxed person, who never says anything bad about other people or holds grudges against them. She keeps the band from falling apart. She is idolized for her cool, but mature way of handling things.

Despite her mature, punk look, she is very caring towards others and is always there to lend support or a shoulder to cry on. While she is unable to understand Ako's behavior at times, she loves her sister and supports her. Tomoe is also shown to be hot-blooded and the type to rush into things head-first if she thinks someone she loves has been hurt. This has a tendency to backfire on her at times.

(Source: BanG Dream Wikia)

128156.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")

Tsugumi is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and Afterglow's keyboardist. She is often called "Tsugu" by her friends. Eve works part-time at Tsugumi's family's cafe, and Tsugumi herself also helps out there. 

Tsugumi views herself as the most normal girl in the band. However, she is a very hardworking and optimistic person who rarely gets discouraged. Her optimism really buoys the other members' spirits. She is the one who also pushes the band to do and try different challenges - for example, entering the Girls Jam in Afterglow's band story, and Tsugumi was even the one behind the girls' idea to start a band. She can easily get flustered however, and tends to panic or have trouble with dealing with people whom she hasn't met before.

(Source: BanG Dream Wikia)

128157.description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")

Hagumi is an energetic first-year student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the bassist of Hello, Happy World!. She is in the same class as Kasumi. Outside of the band, she is friends with Saaya.

Hagumi is the only daughter of a family of butchers. They own a meat shop, where their bestselling item is their croquette. Her parents fight often and her father sometimes "disappears for three days because 'it felt so good'" and her mother tends to break things when she's mad. She also states that her parents don't allow her to be loud at home, which explains her energetic attitude outside. As such, she uses sports as an outlet. Hagumi also has an older brother, who taught her to play the guitar a bit in the past, which made learning to play the bass easier for her.

Lively and passionate for sports, Hagumi is known for her sunny disposition and energetic nature. She is cheery and can be a bit of a show-off, but she usually doesn't take things too far. She tries to convince others to indulge in her sporty hobbies at times. Despite her tomboyish personality, Hagumi has an affinity for cute things and has a complex over her boyish appearance. She especially loves Michelle's costume due to how it resembles a large stuffed bear. She can also be surprisingly sensitive and cautious of others' emotions as well.

(Source: BanG Dream Wikia)

128158.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")

Kanon is a second-year student and was the first to be roped in by [Kokoro](https://anilist.co/character/127272/Tsurumaki-Kokoro) to become a member of Hello, Happy World!. Kanon is very clumsy, quick to burst into tears, and has a bad sense of direction. Outside of the band, she is good friends with [Chisato](https://anilist.co/character/128165/Shirasagi-Chisato), whom she has known ever since middle school. She also works part-time at the fast food store together with [Aya](https://anilist.co/character/128160/Maruyama-Aya).

Sensible and responsible, Kanon is one of the members within Hello, Happy World! that manages to keep the band running smoothly, although she is likely to space out and start thinking about jellyfish. She is fairly shy and easily flustered, and can become a nervous wreck at the drop of a hat and start crying if she feels overwhelmed. Whenever she gets nervous or overwhelmed she tends to say "fuee". However, she is also shown to have moments where she is determined and takes matters into her own hands.

128159.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")

Misaki is a member of Hello, Happy World!. Under the "guise" of the mascot character Michelle, she is the DJ and composer of the band; as Misaki, she is the composer and Michelle's "agent". Misaki is a first-year student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School.

She began wearing the bear costume at her part-time job when she was roped into joining the band by her classmate Kokoro. Despite Misaki telling her bandmates multiple times that she and Michelle are the same person, none of them aside from Kanon believe her. Outside of the band, Misaki is friends with Rimi.

Misaki is kind, reserved and considerate, however she is also known to reply sarcastically and sometimes struggle with the other girls in her band, with the exception of Kanon, whom she considers the only other reasonable member. Naturally, she ends up becoming the "straight man" of the group, scolding or commenting on the antics of the other members in immediate response. Despite her hardworking nature, especially towards Hello, Happy World!, she tends to debase her achievements and say how anyone else could've done it instead of her. For example, whenever people praise her for being able to understand Kokoro's hums and make them into songs, she'll shrug it off with a "it's nothing special".

(Source: BanG Dream Wikia)

128160.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")

Aya is a second-year student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the lead singer of Pastel*Palettes. She also works part-time at the fast food store with [Kanon](https://anilist.co/character/128158/Matsubara-Kanon).

Aya has always admired idols ever since she was young, and the reason she wanted to become an idol was because of the idol group Marmalade's lead, Ayumi. Aya then spent three years being a trainee idol before she was chosen to become the lead singer for Pastel*Palettes.

On the outside, Aya is very cheery, high-spirited, and bubbly. She is also very nice and has always been in love with idols. She is unselfish in her pursuits, helping others for the sake of being kind. Deep down, however, she is a sensitive girl who suffers from a complex stemming from her desire to be noticed. Adding to this, she does not wear her disguise outside because she wants to get noticed, and even looks up constantly what people think of her on the internet. She gets worked up easily and tends to cry a lot, thus her improvisation skills are poor.

128163.description:
__Height:__ 161 cm (5'3")

Yamato Maya is a second-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and the drummer of Pastel*Palettes. She is also classmates with Yukina. Prior to joining the band, Maya was a studio musician. Originally, she wasn't intended to be a member of the band, but was prompted in by Chisato due to their lack of finding a drummer, and after they had seen Maya without her glasses.

Maya is a tomboy who appears awkward around other people; she isn't very social and does not take care of her hair and skin, and used to be a bit socially withdrawn prior to becoming a drummer. But around musical equipment, she becomes ecstatic and is impossible to stop when talking about her beloved hobby.

Maya admires Eve for her looks and is also good friends with her, and Aya as well for her dedication on becoming a great idol. Because of her awkward nature, she is also often teased by Hina (unintentionally most of the time)​ and gently scolded by Chisato because of her unique "Huhehe" laugh.

(Source: BanG Dream Wikia)

128164.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")

Hina is a second-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and is the guitarist of [Pastel*Palettes](https://anilist.co/staff/156177/PastelPalettes). She is the younger, more bright-eyed twin of [Sayo](https://anilist.co/character/126259/Hikawa-Sayo).

A natural genius with an impeccable memory, Hina can acquire and master new skills very quickly, often even with just one attempt. She is very cheerful and carefree, but her relaxed mindset also makes her unable to understand other people's emotions, and as such doesn't sometimes notice if she's insulting them. With this, Hina is also very candid, always being honest and sure of both herself and her actions, though at times she ends up being more blunt than honest.  

Unlike Sayo, who dislikes being a twin, Hina seems to embrace it. She is very supportive of her sister and loves her regardless of how she treats her, but they often get into arguments due to their conflicting personalities. To add to this Hina wants to do most things together with her, but this ultimately has lead to Sayo quitting most of her hobbies as she felt like Hina was just copying her and then always did it better than her, thus feeding into her inferiority complex more.

128165.description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")

The bassist of the band Pastel*Palettes and a student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School.

Chisato is polite, mature, and responsible, however she can also be very blunt and come across as cold or condescending. Prior to joining the band, she was a child actress and did not know how to play the bass. Outside of the band, she is also Kanon and Kaoru's childhood friend; the former she met in middle school, and the latter a lot ​earlier through their parents.

As she has been in the entertainment industry for a long time, Chisato is quite a realist when it comes to it and disliked Aya's idealistic view of it at first. She gets slightly embarrassed by people bringing up her past and past works as a child actress. She also dislikes when everyone thinks that she can do anything.

(Source: BanG Dream! Wikia, edited)

128166.description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")

Eve is half-Japanese and half-Finnish, hailing from Finland. She is a student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and Pastel Palettes's keyboardist. Before joining Pastel Palettes, she was a model at the same agency, and had some skill in playing the piano. She finds Japanese culture exciting, often citing bushido, the code of Japanese warriors.

She is a bright girl who tackles everything standing in her path full throttle. She is enthusiastic and chipper, eager to learn all that she can about Japan. At times her thought process can be strange, and when going on about Bushido and other samurai-related things, which she takes quite seriously, she comes off as humorous. Her actions also tend to confuse Aya and the people around her. Eve is easygoing, polite and loves hugging people. Though she has some misconceptions about Japan and sometimes misunderstands what other people say, Eve always tries her best to learn.

128254.description: A dwarf and a member of the party with Lizard Priest and High Elf Archer. They team up with Goblin Slayer and Priestess in order to infiltrate some ruins invaded by goblins. As a silver adventurer, he is an experienced spell caster. Well-built and with good physique despite his short stature, Dwarf Shaman's long hair is completely white, which he ties up in a ponytail, and the beard he often strokes is elaborately braided. His earlobes have been elongated and are pierced by earrings. His priest garment is completely white, which contrasts with his dark colored gloves and bracers and the piece of armor he wears on his lower torso. He is cheerful and happy most of the time and can be often seen arguing with High Elf Archer over the most trivial matters, but they do so without malice.

128273.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5’8)

Minato Narumiya is the protagonist of the series. He is a first-year at Kazemai High School where he is a member of the kyudo club.

Minato is a reserved and withdrawn person, which resulted from after his accident in sixth grade and his target panic incident at his last middle school tournament. He is serious and responsible, always doing his chores and cleaning the school kyudojo proactively. His seriousness often causes him to get flustered by more cheerful individuals like [Nanao](https://anilist.co/character/128275/) and [Ryouhei](https://anilist.co/character/128277/).

Despite seeming calm and indifferent, Minato has a deep passion for kyudo and is extremely loyal to his friends. He is earnest about the things he wants to do, such as improving at kyudo. Ryouhei has noted that he seemed like a "wild child" as he doesn't mind running on snow-covered roads or doesn’t get a cold when he was wading through a cold river. He has a sarcastic side to him when it comes to dealing with more eccentric people, such as [Masaki](https://anilist.co/character/128729/). He is also prone to having an overactive imagination and believing scary stories.

Minato has a love for fluffy animals, especially Kuma ([Seiya](https://anilist.co/character/128274/)'s dog) and Who (Masaki's owl).

128274.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5’9)

Seiya Takehaya is a first-year student at Kazemai High School and a member of the kyudo club, as well as serving as the club head and captain of the boys' division.

Seiya is viewed as a mature, reliable, and kind character, determined to facilitate and oversee [Minato](https://anilist.co/character/128273/)'s success in kyudo. However, as he himself stated in episode two, when he gets serious, he has no need for compassion. Seiya and Minato have been friends since childhood due to being neighbors. Along with [Ryouhei](https://anilist.co/character/128277/), the three of them were kindergarten and elementary school friends and have had many ventures together.

128275.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5’7)

Nanao Kisaragi is a first-year at Kazemai High School and a member of the kyudo club.

Ever since he was little, Nanao has attracted many female admirers due to his looks and charisma. However, the side effect of this was that he also received many jealous attacks, so his mother and aunts decided to have [Kaito](https://anilist.co/character/128276/), his cousin, act as his bodyguard. This worked well in elementary school, and though they went to separate middle schools, they were still in extracurriculars and cram school together. Some time in the past, Nanao used to go to the prefectural budokan to practice kyudo by himself, and one time met with a judge's teacher, from whom he learned many things about kyudo.

Gets along with [Ryouhei](https://anilist.co/character/128277/Yamanouchi-Ryouhei) due to their similar personalities. The two like to joke and laugh around together.

128276.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5’10")

Kaito Onogi is a first-year student at Kazemai High School and a member of the kyudo club.

Kaito comes off as short-tempered, overly serious, and aggressive. He is easily riled up, especially when his cousin [Nanao](https://anilist.co/character/128275/) calls him Kacchan or when he perceives someone to not be taking something as seriously as he does. He is blunt with his words and not afraid to say what he really thinks. He tends to jump to conclusions. This causes people to be afraid of him. A large part of his current personality might be due to being treated as someone scary ever since he was little due to his intimidating face.

However, he is also fiercely loyal to those he becomes close to. He is a good observer, such as noticing [Seiya](https://anilist.co/character/128274/)'s issues with kyudo. He often serves as the straight man to the antics of others. His fellow members tease him for being a tsundere, much to his annoyance. He is good with cats, and has a white cat named Lucy.

128277.description:
__Height:__ 182 cm (6’0)

Ryouhei Yamanouchi is a first-year student at Kazemai High School where he is a member of the kyudo club.

Ryouhei was childhood friends with [Minato](https://anilist.co/character/128273/) and [Seiya](https://anilist.co/character/128274/) and went to kindergarten and elementary school with them until he transferred in fifth grade and went to a different middle school than them. In middle school, he took kyudo classes as part of his required martial arts course.

Ryouhei greatly admires Seiya for his intelligence and kindness to everyone, and frequently praises him for it. He steadfastly refuses to believe Seiya can do anything bad. He gets along with [Nanao](https://anilist.co/character/128275/) very well due to their similarly cheerful and chatty personalities. The two of them often joke around and laugh together. Their interactions are the specialty of the kyudo club.

(Source: Tsurune Fandom)

128424.description:
Height: 172 cm (5'8)

Kakeru has short, straight black hair and slate-colored eyes. When he runs, the wind pushes his hair to the back. He has a lean and athletic build that was developed over the years of competitive running. He often maintains a serious expression and he is usually seen wearing his sky blue sports jacket and gray sweatpants.

Kakeru is a first-year sociology student at Kansei University and the current resident of Room 103 of Chikuseisou. A prodigious athlete since high school who became disillusioned due to an incident in his old Track and Field team. He first joined the Chikuseisou after Haiji met him stealing from a convenience store. Personality-wise Kakeru is rather cold towards his fellow runners and takes running very seriously. He also doesn't like when he has to slow down to match the pace of others. However after joining Kansei Track and Field time he slowly learns what it really means to run.

128425.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7)

Haiji Kiyose is the deuteragonist in the series Run with the Wind. He is a 4th year literature student in Kansei University Student and a long time resident of Chikuseisou. He is the resident of room 101 of Chikuseisou. He has a friendly and outgoing personality, but underneath has a bit of a manipulative side. He's never willing to compromise on his dreams, even if it means reasonably threatening his housemates in the process. Despite this, he is very caring towards his teammates. He has shown concern towards them throughout the show. 

 He is the cook of the Chikuseisou.

128452.description: Eiryo Ashihana is the puppeteer of Polichinelle, and member of the Assassins Clan.

name.native: スコット・フォールド

128468.description: Juliet's right hand man. A fellow 1st Year, he is in love with Juliet, having apparently been saved by her in the past. As a result, he is often seen stalking Juliet, often tracking her from distance. More recently, he has become a target of Chartreux's sadistic tendencies.

name.native: シャルトリュー・ウェスティア

128469.description:
Persia's childhood friend in the White Cats House. She is one of the people who is aware of Persia's secret romantic relationship with Romio Inuzuka.

Chartreux is quite sadistic, and takes pleasure in using others as tools. She likes using others as a 'play things', in which she orders them around to do activities such as acting like animals. Her sadistic and terrible personality is what gives her the nickname 'The Tyrant Princess of the West'.

Besides her sadistic nature, she also has a burning lust for Persia. While she treats Juliet happily, she treats Inuzuka in a cold manner; not only is she jealous of Persia and Inuzuka's relationship, she also reassures to keep it a secret.

128470.description:
Romio's right hand and childhood friend. Initially timid and withdrawn as a child, she meets Romio when he praises her for her intellect after assisting him with his homework. Her interaction with Romio made her become more outgoing and passionate with others by the start of the series. She is grateful for Romio's friendship and as a result, falls in love with him. She is the only one on the Black Dogs side to know about Romio and Juliet's relationship, after Romio confesses the truth to her. While she initially disapproved, Romio convinces her to keep his relationship with Juliet a secret.

She currently ranks 2nd overall in terms of academics for the 1st year, only behind Juliet. Because of her academic prowess, she often runs intense tutoring sessions to prevent her fellow "Black Dogs" from failing, especially Romio. She also has a younger brother named Kougi.

128471.description:
A 1st year student and a popular figure within the "White Cats". Initially hailing from a lower status background, he was bullied as a child together with Somali. He aims to become a prefect to prove his worth and earn the admiration of others. To this end, he resorted to underhanded tactics throughout the Sports Festival in order to defeat both Romio and Juliet, whose popularity threatens his goal. He believes he's the only one who can keep up with Somali's antics. He is a currently a servant under Cait's care.

(Source: Wikipedia)

128473.description:
One of the two-second-year prefects of the Black Dogs dormitory, and Teria's twin sister. She is known as the Pharmacy expert, with expertise regarding medicines. Despite their small stature, they are actually 14 years old, having skipped grades because of their intellect. Kochou is the more outgoing of the twins. It is hinted she has feelings for Airu Inuzuka, and affectionately calls him "A-chan."

(Source: Wikipedia)

128478.description:
One of the two-second-year prefects of the Black Dogs dormitory, and Kochou's twin sister. She is known as the Engineering expert, with expertise regarding machinery. Despite their small stature, they are actually 14 years old, having skipped grades because of their intellect. However, Teria only joined so that she could be by her sister's side. Teria is shy and timid but is willing to step up to the challenge to help others. As Romio continues to help her, Teria falls in love with him and is pushed by her sister to be more proactive with him.

(Source: Wikipedia)

128551.description:
Height: 167 cm (5'6)

Takashi Sugiyama is a third-year business student at Kansei University. He is the resident of room 205 at Chikuseisou. Generally considered an honor student by the other residents of Chikuseisou, Takashi is an earnest student from the Yamagata Prefecture- a mountainy region. He used to walk ten kilometers through the mountains to get to school and back every day. He was the first convinced by Haiji to give running a chance and has been a significant driving force behind the others. His dedication towards training originally stemmed from wanting to inspire and impress his family, but eventually became something entirely his own.Shindou has light brown hair and curved eyes. He has a mole under one of his eyes. He has a pretty small stature compared to his teammates. He is often seen wearing sweatshirts and pants. Shindou is shown to be very determined and dedicated to running, despite just starting out. He is very pure and wants to help his friends.

128554.description:
Height: 170 cm (5'7)

Yukihiko Iwakura is one of the Aotake runners. He is a 4th-year law student at Kansei University and the resident of room 102 at Chikuseisou. Yuki is a rather slim yet lean young man. His skin is a pale peach color. He has side-swept black hair and an undercut. He also wears glasses and piercings on his ears. He is often seen wearing a blue sweatshirt and black pants. He is short-tempered and gets easily annoyed by his teammate's actions. However, he does care about his teammates and often jokes with them. He is very detail-oriented as seen when he points out Shindo's lower center of gravity. He is an avid clubber and often boasts the fact that he passed the lawyer's bar exam in one go to any girl he meets. Yuki was initially reluctant to run and was bent on defying Haiji's enthusiasm, but eventually got drawn into it as the others members did. He hates the smell of tobacco coming from Akihiro's smoking until he quit for running.

128556.description:
Height: 178 cm (5'10)

Akihiro Hirata is a 3rd-year science and engineering student at Kansei University. Hirata is resident of room 104 at Chikuseiso. Nico is the tallest among the Aotake runners with a muscular statue. He also has a light beard and chin-length brown hair, which he wears in a low ponytail. He is often seen in sweats. His nickname, Nico-chan-senpai, comes from the abbreviation of the word nicotine due to his past cigarette addiction. It is also seen that the residents of Aotake will just draw a cigarette doodle in place of his name on the chore chart. In an effort to stop smoking, he took up wire sculpting, quickly accumulating dozens of little metal figurines. Yuki later capitalizes on this and sells them to help fund the track team. Prior to entering Kansei University, he ran Track during high school but quit due to his coach. As Akihiro picked up running again under Haiji's influence, he stopped smoking and began to make small metallic figures as a substitute.

128557.description:
Height: 167 cm (5'6")
