Nicknamed "Prince" because of his good looks, Prince is a 2nd year literature student at Kansei University. He is most notably known for having copious amounts of manga in his room and being the slowest runner in the group with the most unique running style. Prince currently stays in room 204 in Chikuseisou. Prince is rather inactive and occasionally speaks in dramatized speech. It is noted by Musa that he speaks in a more proper Japanese than the rest of the team. He began as one of the most reluctant and slowest members due to his lack of physical stamina and indoor tendencies. Akane picked up his training after Takashi had his family send over a treadmill for him to remain indoors to read manga. After finding true inspiration from his friends at Chikuseisou and Kakeru's presence, he pushes himself beyond his limitations.

128561.description: Owner of a small café. Riko's girlfriend.

128563.description: Doujima is a first-year high school boy and a member of the student council.

128590.description: Reina Gojou is the student council vice president of Oodachi High and Yuuma's younger sister.

128594.description: He is a third year student at Ishigami High School and the captain of its sumo club.

128595.description: She is a first year student at Oodachi High School and one of the managers of the school's sumo club.

128596.description: He is a sumo wrestler from Eigadai Affiliated High School. He is the son of the last Japanese yokozuna, Yamatokuni. He won the the title of High School Yokozuna during individual bouts in his first year. Upon entering his father's stable he took the shikona of Kusanagi Sousuke. He holds the rank of Ozeki, and has yet to win a yusho.

128597.description:
Height: 162cm
Weight: 50kg
Hair Color: Brown
Eye Color: Brown 

He is a student at Oodachi High School and a member of its sumo club. Chihiro Kunisaki calls him, Hotaru.
While he lacks size, stamina and strength, he is extremely adaptable and receptive to Tsuji's orders, especially when he was the first person who witnessed his knowledge when he quickly defeated every member of Oodachi High using simple dodges except Hinomaru.

128606.description:
Mano is [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799/Nishikata)'s and [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800/Takagi)'s classmates and has an undisclosed relationship with [Nakai](https://anilist.co/character/128607/Nakai). 

Mano is generally shy, anxious, and sheepish towards other people, especially when she is trying to talk to Nakai. She also has noticeable anger issues, as she quickly becomes impatient when bothered or pestered by others. Regarding her relationship with Nakai, she often second-guesses herself while trying to interact with him. She wishes that Nakai would show more interest in the relationship, but loves him regardless. They are seen happily watching the fireworks together at the summer festival, showing that the two are able to enjoy each other's presence despite their issues with each other.

128607.description:
One of the classmates of [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799/Nishikata) and [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800/Takagi) and the boyfriend of [Mano](https://anilist.co/character/128606/Mano). 

Nakai has a very calm, friendly and laid-back demeanor who enjoys hanging out with his male friends more than he does with Mano. He explains that it's hard for him to hang out with Mano, although he still greatly cares for her.

alternative: Crazy Knife (クレイジーナイフ)

128651.description:
__Age of Death:__ 13

Hanako is a ghost haunting the old building of Kamome Academy. He resides on the third floor female bathroom, in the toilet of the third stall. He governs over the Seven Mysteries as School Mystery Number 7.

~!Hanako's real name is Yugi Amane. He attended Kamome Academy as a student and his goal was to become an astronaut and go to the moon someday. He was to become a science teacher at Kamome Academy as an adult, but his future changed for unknown reasons. He ended up with the fate of killing his own twin brother, of dying as a kid, and of then becoming one of the Seven Mysteries to protect the students and to fulfill their wishes in order to atone for his sins.!~ 

~!It is hinted multiple times that Hanako has romantic feelings for [Yashiro](https://anilist.co/character/128652/Yashiro-Nene), and that he is madly in love with her.!~

~!He confesses his love to Nene Yashiro and gives her a kiss.!~

128652.description: Yashiro Nene is a normal student, and one day she listens to a rumor about ''Hanako-san'' who makes wishes for anyone, but the wishes come with a price. She visits him in the hope of getting her crush to fall in love with her. She becomes friends with Hanako-san soon after meeting him then. She is in the gardening club.

128694.description:
Polpo is a minor character and antagonist featured in Vento Aureo.

Polpo is the first of Passione's capo Giorno Giovanna encounters and is responsible for recruiting new members. He then tasks Giorno to keep a lighter lit for 24 hours as a test. Polpo is a Stand User and his Black Sabbath automatically attacks Giorno during said test.

(Source: JJBA Wikia)

128984.description: The first friend Bocchi makes upon entering middle school. She has a tough appearance but is actually kind and supportive of Bocchi. Her name is derived from sunao na ko (素直な子, "honest child").

128985.description:
The public morals officer in Bocchi's school. Her name is derived from kurai kako (暗い過去, "dark past").

(Source: Wikipedia)

128986.description:
__Height:__ 145 cm (4'9")

Hitori Bocchi (meaning "all alone"), is shy and has extreme social anxiety. A kind person and clumsy at times. She cries frequently, her legs cramp when she gets nervous, and she faints from happiness and excitement. It's challenging for her to talk with new people. Bocchi, however, wants to be able to have fun interacting with friends. She does everyday things in quirky ways, doing things like making scripts for daily conversations, only for it to fail. Her favorite food is rice with natto (finely crushed).

128987.description: The vice representative in [Bocchi](https://anilist.co/character/128986)'s class. She often puts on an appearance to hide the fact that she is actually somewhat of a loser. Her name is derived from honshou aru (本性ある, "having a true nature").

128993.description: [Bocchi's](https://anilist.co/character/128986/Hitori-Bocchi) classmate who comes from another country and considers herself to be a ninja. Her name is derived from soto kara kita ("came from outside").

128995.description:
Bocchi's classmate, and the most popular person in class. Her classmates call her Mīna. She is a terrible (and loud) singer.
She used to go to the same elementary school as Kō Futō, who was her only friend then. Since Kō refused to go to school, she decided to make her classes fun so that Kō doesn't feel nervous. Her name is derived from mina ga warau (皆が笑う, "everybody laughs").

128998.description:
The homeroom teacher of Bocchi's class who is called "Teru-chan" by her students. She is afraid of Nako. Her name is derived from oshieteru yo (教えてるよ, "I'm teaching").

(Source: Wikipedia)

129080.description: A former gold-ranked adventurer who currently serves as the Temple of Law's Archbishop of the Supreme God.

129090.description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'3")
__Instrument:__ Oboe

Ririka is a first-year student of Kitauji High School and an oboe player in Kitauji Concert Band Club.

She has a light and cheerful childlike personality who tries to build a good relationship with [Mizore](https://anilist.co/character/125960/). However, according to [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/133462/), Ririka is aware of her ability to pass off any rude or suspicious behaviour as innocence with her smile. When Ririka's interested in something, she starts from the beginning and goes step by step.

Her special skill is making friends.

129130.description:
**Height:** 164 cm (5'4")
__Combat Style:__ Beast Breathing

Inosuke is usually seen wearing a grey boar mask, with a shirtless version of the Demon hunter uniform. Without the mask he has messy shoulder length black hair and large green eyes with long eyelashes. He is described as having a girly looking face which greatly contrasts with his muscular body.

Inosuke is extremely short-tempered and proud, and makes a big deal out of fighting opponents stronger than him claiming that's his only hobby. He is a sore loser and is always trying to compete with Tanjiro and provoke him into fighting him, and usually failing. Due to growing up in the mountains by himself Inosuke has trouble interacting with others and only cares about himself most of the time. Though he's often seen with 2 swords in hand, Inosuke is left-handed.

129131.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'4")
__Combat Style:__ Thunder Breathing
__Affiliation:__ Demon Slayer Corps
__Occupation:__ Demon Slayer

Zenitsu Agatsuma is one of the main protagonists of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba and along with [Inosuke Hashibira](https://anilist.co/character/129130/Inosuke-Hashibira), a traveling companion of [Tanjiro Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/126071/Tanjirou-Kamado) and [Nezuko Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/127518/Nezuko-Kamado).

129132.description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")

He is the Demon King, the first of his kind, and the progenitor of all other demons in existence. Muzan is also the leader of the Twelve Kizuki, an organization of the twelve strongest demons in existence that serve directly under him.

~!A millennium ago, during the Heian Era, Muzan was turned into a demon during an experimental treatment trying to cure his terminal illness, and his goal since then was to live without the fear of death and become truly eternal. He believes that Sun Breathing users are his only threat. He has a grand total of seven hearts and five brains.!~

129133.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")
__Combat Style:__ Flame Breathing

He is greatly enthusiastic in regard to his duties as Flame Pillar and often cheerfully eccentric. He is amiable, kind and boasts extraordinary flame techniques and swordsmanship stemming from strict practice and discipline. 

He is an honourable warrior who adheres to his code of morals and principles that was instilled into him by his mother at a young age - the most significant being that those who were born strong have a duty to protect the weak.

name.native: ジオルド・スティアート

129134.description:
__Magic Type:__ Fire

Gerald is the third prince of the country, and the capture target that is Katarina's fiance. Even though he looks like an orthodox blonde-haired, blue-eyed prince, Katarina thought otherwise that on the inside he’s actually an evil sadistic prince.

However, even though Gerald in the game was supposed to be “not interested in Katarina at all, and almost never visited her, before she noticed, he would come over to her house once every three days. And, he even helps Katarina harvest the fruits and vegetables from the field, and would always bring her sweets as presents, and were completely friends now. They have a lot of contact.

__Game Description:__ Gerald, though have a prince out of a fairy tale look but his personality was twisted and schemer. He is a genius who can do anything. He has no particular interests and is bored with his everyday life.

129135.description:
__Magic Type:__ Earth

Keith is the capture target that was adopted into the Claes family seven years ago for his powerful magic. He’s a handsome boy with flaxen hair and blue eyes, and since he was neglected by his stepmother and stepsister, had a lonely upbringing and became a playboy type character because of it. And when he entered school, his loneliness was supposed to be healed by the heroine and he would fall in love, but to prevent that from happening, Katarina has been pulling him out of his room every day. During this time, without Katarina having to pull him out anymore it turned out that they were always together.

Game Description: The 3rd capturable character in the game Fortune Lover and the stepbrother of Katarina Claes. He was adopted from a branch family because of his huge magical powers. he is treated coldly by his stepsister and stepmother. As a reaction to this lack of affection, he grew up to be a playboy.

(Source: Destruction Flag Otome Wikia)

name.native: アラン・ステイア一 ト

129136.description:
__Magic Type:__ Water

Alan is the fourth prince of this country, and is Gerald’s younger twin brother as well as a capture target. He’s a beautiful prince with a wild streak, with silver hair and blue eyes, and he’s always being compared to Gerald, so he’s constantly in pain from feelings of inferiority, and it should have been set that he hates his brother, but Alan didn’t seem to be troubled by an inferiority complex or anything at all now, and it doesn’t seem like he hates Gerald either. Katarina didn't know she was the reason why the twins relationship has been reasonably good.

Although Alan route Katarina didn’t appear as she wasn’t a rival, in the game she should have had hardly any contact with Alan but he would come to visit her almost every day, and his talent for music has completely bloomed so Katarina always receive invitations to his piano and violin concerts and would always go together with everyone. Katarina and Alan were completely friends now.

__Game Description:__ Gerald’s younger twin brother, the fourth prince of the country. Until he was five, he was quite sickly, and almost died. Because of that, he was raised over protectively, and became a rather spoiled prince. However, compared to his older twin that can do anything, he’s a bit perverted. He always had a strong sense of rivalry and inferiority towards his older twin, and barely interacted with him at all.

129137.description:
__Magic Type:__ Earth

The main villain of the Fortune Lover game, however, after she recalls her previous life as a Japanese student, her personality underwent a massive change and she became much nicer and more humble.

Game Description: The quintessential villainess. A selfish, spoiled princess type. Because [Prince Gerald](https://anilist.co/character/129134) injured her during childhood, they had gotten engaged. Because of this scar, she considered the prince to be hers, and bound him to her. In addition, she didn’t think highly of suddenly getting a stepbrother, and often bullied him.

129138.description:
__Magic Type: Wind__

The fourth capturable character of the otome game Fortune Lover.

He’s the taciturn, expressionless son of the prime minister, and also a capture target. With black hair and eyes, and a perfect doll-like face, he’s a handsome boy with a devilish charm that can even capture men as well as women with his unique atmosphere.

Game Description: Nicole Ascarot, the prime minister’s son, Alan and Gerald’s childhood friend. He’s one year older than the heroine, and is a taciturn senpai type of character.

(Source: Destruction Flag Otome Wikia)

129140.description:
__Magic Type:__ Wind

Sophia, Nicol's sister and rival for the path of Nicol. She is as beautiful as her brother and should not have been in contact with Katarina, but now she is her companion, and one of her best friends, like Mary.

129141.description:
__Magic Type:__ Light

Maria Campbell was the main character of the game Fortune Lover.

Maria worked hard and actively participated in household chores, never complained or said anything selfish, and desperately studied. When she entered magic school, her long years of hopes for magic school were immediately shattered when she learned she was the only commoner. What’s more, she was also bullied for the audacity of having magic powers despite only being a commoner.

129247.description: An Ainu and an old friend of [Asirpa's](https://anilist.co/character/124701/Asirpa) father.

129378.description: A tall, masked man who bids farewell to the Winter season, signaling the coming of Spring. When he hears that Makoto moved to town, he decides to pay her a visit.

129379.description: He is Chinatsu and Kei's father.

129380.description: Chinatsu and Kei's mother. She writes children's books.

129384.description: Elias' magician master, commonly referred to as Lindel, who lives in the Land of Dragons.

129385.description:
Cartaphilus is a sorcerer that serves as a recurring antagonist of the series. ~!Later is found out that Cartaphilus is actually an unknown being that has lived for over 2000 years, that was found by and later fused with a man called Joseph.!~

(Source: The Ancient Magus Bride Wikia)

name.native: オーロラ・栖夜・リース・カイミーン

129563.description: The princess of the human kingdom. Kidnapped by the [Demon King](https://anilist.co/character/181143/Maou-Tasogare), she spends her days waiting for the heroes to rescue her. At least, that's how it was supposed to be...

129571.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Sorcerer, Student
__Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High
__Grade:__ Special Grade Sorcerer

The main protagonist of Jujutsu Kaisen prequel series [Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical School](https://anilist.co/manga/105469/Tokyo-Toritsu-Jujutsu-Kodo-Senmon-Gakko). He was initially a Special Grade Cursed Victim haunted by his late childhood friend, [Rika Orimoto](https://anilist.co/character/208533/Orimoto-Rika). [Satoru Gojou](https://anilist.co/character/127691/Satoru-Gojou) mentored Yuuta and enrolled him at Tokyo Jujutsu High.

129639.description: Former Air Force colleague of Tsubame, whom she has an unrequited love for. Exhibits highly masochistic and self-deprecating behaviour.

129725.description:
Kotetsu Katsura is a tower witch and an underling of Medusa. She is transferred with other tower witches after the second loss of Tanpopo Kuraishi, to Honoka Takamiya's class.

(Source: Witchcraft Works Fandom)

129726.description:
Kanae Hozuki is one of the caretakers of Ayaka Kagari in middle school along with Touko. They helped her to interact with society. She is almost like a manager to Ayaka in middle school. She is member of Ayaka's fanclub as well as a student council member.

(Source: Witchcraft Works Fandom)

129727.description:
Kasumi and Honoka's mother. She can be very optimistic and at the same time very pessimistic. She can't handle pressure and harsh words from others. She was once scolded by Kasumi and went into her cycle of depression.

Komachi is also friends with Kazane. They've known each other ever since high school and they were said to be so close that they could marry each other. However, they couldn't because both of them are women and so they promise each other that they would let their children do the marrying for them.

(Source: MAL)

129744.description: Mary is a devout follower of the Goddess Mater that granted her the title of Mater's Daughter.

name.native: ウィリアム・G・マリーブラッド

129745.description:
He is a lone human from the City of the Dead, born with vague memories of a past life and raised by a group of undead until the age of adulthood, he swore an oath to [Gracefeel](https://anilist.co/character/129753/Gracefeel) and leaves the city in search for adventure and civilisation while he restores the faith of his guardian deity.

He was brought to the City of the Dead as an infant by demons with the intention to be used as a sacrifice to break the seal placed upon the High King, however, he was found and taken in by a group of undead, these three undead were [Blood](https://anilist.co/character/129746/Blood), [Mary](https://anilist.co/character/129744/Mary), and [Augustus](https://anilist.co/character/129747/Augustus).

William recalls that he had a previous life in Japan, he can only vaguely remember certain events and common knowledge, his previous life was lamentable which becomes his determination to lead a proper life in his current one.

129746.description: He is massive skeletal humanoid male who that was previously human, his hair is red and his eyes are will-o'-wisp.

129748.description: Reystov was a highly skilled adventurer and companion of William. He retired as an adventurer and decided to settle down with his newly-wedded wife, Anna.

129750.description:
Meneldor is a half-elf outcast and most loyal friend of William. He was previously an adventurer and hunter.

He is a half-elf a mix race between humans and elves. His hair is silver that is tied up into a ponytail and his eyes are the colours of jade.

Meneldor was born in Grassland to the north, in the Great Forest of Erin where the elves live. Because of his mixture of elf and human blood he was an outcast and couldn't get along with any of the residents, he later decide to run away and become an adventurer. However, he was betrayed and poisoned by one of his companions, after killing the traitor and losing his comrades, he bumbled his way to a village in a weaken state where he was later found and taken in by Marple.

(Source: Saihate no Paladin Wiki)

129758.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")
__Quirk:__ Arbor

Pro Hero. 

Underneath his helmet, he has puffy red leaf-like hair, though his face has remained unseen since he has only been shown while wearing his mask. Shinji is a very serious and focused person when it comes to being a hero in his hero duties; however, he easily feels down when someone takes his glory or credit. 

Shinji's Quirk "Arbor" (樹木, Jumoku) allows him to enlarge and control his wooden body parts into strong tree branches. These branches are excellent for binding.

129762.description:
Naomasa Tsukauchi is a police detective in the Police Force.

Naomasa is a tall man with short black hair and black eyes. As a member of the police force, he is normally seen in his uniform. He wears a signature tan overcoat and a matching hat. He also sports a black suit underneath with matching slacks and dress shoes. 

Detective Tsukauchi is an earnest, hardworking individual who has earned the right to be a close friend of All Might. Enough so, that he was even entrusted with the truth about One For All and the latter's true form.

He appears to have a close relationship with All Might, as he even leaked sensitive information to the hero just because he felt it was the right thing to do.

129785.description:
__Height:__ 115cm
__Farm Identifier:__ 48294

Conny is nice and lovely towards Emma, Don and the other orphans. She always carried her stuffed rabbit Little Bernie around with her. Her intellect level seemed to be average for her age.

name.native: マルティ・メルロマルク

129808.description: The first princess of Melromarc who betrayed [Naofumi Iwatani](https://anilist.co/character/88817) in the beginning of the series. She is notorious for manipulating other people in order to satisfy her selfish desires.

129809.description:
A university student summoned to another world as the Spear Hero. He is an easy-going and handsome womanizer.

~!After being abandoned by [Malty](https://anilist.co/character/129808), He has developed an obsession for Filolials. After Fio tried to cheer him up, he can now only see women as pigs in the literal sense. He raised three Filolials, called Kuu, Marin and Midori because he couldn't get Fios attention. He also unlocks the curse series. His sins are Lust (for Fio) and Envy (for Naofumis position of being loved by Fio).!~

129812.description:
A high school student who was summoned to another world as the Sword Hero. He's considered a bishounen and tends to stay quiet.

~!After his companions die, he fell into despair, and, thus, he followed [Malty](https://anilist.co/character/129808) when she offered kind words to him. After being abandoned by her, he had a brief stint as a bandit, after which he came under the Female Knight's tutelage. He also unlocked the curse series after being abandoned by Malty. His sins are Greed (For Power) and Gluttony (For Power).!~

name.native: メルティ・Q・メルロマルク

129813.description:
The second princess of Melromarc.

Melty is in many ways the exact opposite of her sister, [Malty](https://anilist.co/character/129808/Melromarc-Malty). This includes their personality, appearance, magic specialty (water vs fire), and color schemes (blue and white against red and brown).

129814.description:
A high school student summoned to another world as the Bow Hero. He is usually calm and well-mannered. However, He has a messiah complex, and is pretty much a justice maniac. He vanquishes evildoers without thinking of the consequences of his actions. However, this is just because he is immature. He doesn't actually have any bad intentions.

~!When the Spirit Turtle revived, Itsuki and the party was forced to challenge it, but the party ran away, leaving him as a sacrifice to the Turtle.!~

129823.description:
Nena is a minor antagonist appearing in Stardust Crusaders.

She first appears in India alongside Hol Horse and tries to assassinate Joseph Joestar while passing as an ordinary woman. She is a Stand User who uses Empress. Nena first looks like a beautiful young Indian woman in typical Indian attire. However, this is only a disguise and Nena is truly a short, ugly and overweight woman wearing a bikini. Nena also possesses a bud on her tongue. Nena used her Stand Empress to kill a beautiful young woman and wore her skin to hide her true form. 

(Source: Jojo Wiki)

129838.description:
Richeh is a young witch in training and a disciple of [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/Qifrey). She wants to keep her magic essentially "pure" and unchanged and resents having to do what others tell her to do. 

Richeh specializes in crystal magic, particularly in creating transparent crystal ribbons. She also excels at drawing small, intricate glyphs, and has been shown to be adept at connecting these together to form magical portal holes. She has a seemingly emotionless and childish personality. She avoids showing much emotion, though others can still notice emotions on her. She is particularly prone to showing that she's angry at people.

129839.description:
Tetia is a young witch in training at [Qifrey's](https://anilist.co/character/129841/) Atelier. She loves clouds and dreams of creating the perfect cloud magic.

She's perpetually energetic and has a habit of thanking people for thanking her. Tetia is an extremely upbeat, loving girl that tries to help everyone she knows and keep the mood high. She is also the one who often gets everyone grounded and keeps the mood up by being loving to her friends.

129840.description:
She is a young girl who becomes an apprentice witch under the witch [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/) after her initial accidental use of forbidden magic turned her mother to crystal. She hopes to search the Tower of Books for the book containing the magic, in order to reverse its effects on her mother.

She is quite a dork for magic, with a child-like (even for her age) widen eyed look whenever she sees things that are common for every other witch. The very magic that inspired her was simple magic made by Qifrey's watcher that caused glowstone path to light up.

129841.description:
Qifrey is a witch and [Coco's](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco) teacher. He runs an atelier and currently has four disciples.

He is a caring teacher who patiently teaches his students magic. This is especially true for Coco, who has no special abilities as a witch at first but he continues to encourage her until she can draw magic skillfully. He is protective of all his disciples, as seen from how he protects them from being taken by Esheath from the Magic Security Council. However, Qifrey is overly obsessed with his goal to locate the Brimmed Hats, with his gentle attitude oftentimes replaced by a buried hatred he has always hidden. It appears he had a personal agenda against the Brimmed Hats, as well.

~!The reason Qifrey has a grudge towards the Brimmed Hats is that they are responsible for taking away his memories and right eye as a child. He was later locked in a coffin, buried under a tree, and left there to die as it slowly filled with water. Thankfully, people from the Magic Security Council and Sage Beldarut found him and rescued him from his miserable condition, which later on he would become the pupil of Sage Beldarut. Qifrey also went to the Tower of Books in order to find an answer on how to solve the problem of his missing memories and right eye, but for that, he must use forbidden magic, and as such his issue remains unsolved.!~

name.native: アガット・アークロム

129842.description:
Agott is a witch in training and [Qifrey's](https://anilist.co/character/129841/) student. She belongs to the famous Arkrome house, who have served as librarians at the Tower of Books for generations.

She has a tendency to focus on how much more she still needs to accomplish, leading her to express dissatisfaction with her current progress. Agott suffers from self-esteem issues over being considered merely average and she takes that out on others who she doesn't think either deserves magic or have the talent to do so, which is usually [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco).

129917.description: Dord, the middle brother of Garm and Mild. He is known for his first-­rate craftsmanship. Dord focuses more on dyes and high class attire.

alternative: The Weakest Hunter of All Mankind

129928.description:
__Class:__ Mage
__Relatives:__ [Park Kyung-Hye](https://anilist.co/character/209396/KyungHye-Park) (Mother), [Seong Jin-Ah](https://anilist.co/character/138791/JinAh-Sung) (Sister), ~![Seong Il-Hwan](https://anilist.co/character/138790/IlHwan-Sung) (Father), [Cha Hae-In](https://anilist.co/character/138789/HaeIn-Cha) (Wife), [Seong Su-Ho](https://anilist.co/character/306654/Suho-Sung) (Son)!~ 
~!__Guild:__ Ahjin Guild (Guild Master)
__Affiliation:__ Korean Hunters Association (helper), White Tiger Guild (helper), Hunters Guild (helper), Knights Guild (helper), Ahjin Guild (Guild Master)!~

Seong Jin-U is known as an infamously weak E-Rank Hunter. He is a humble and benevolent individual who cares deeply for his family and has an ardent desire to become stronger. As a result, he shares a close relationship with his sister and his mother, and rarely wastes an opportunity to refine his skills and gain more power.

~!He becomes an S-Rank hunter after being given a chance to become stronger by the System.!~

129973.description: Sale is a Passione operative and Mario Zucchero's partner, and also a Stand User. In order to get Polpo's fortune, he follows Team Bucciarati up to Capri and battles Guido Mista with his Kraft Work.

129989.description: A wealthy inventor who manipulates Nene into working with Clarion to solve the mystery behind the attack.

129990.description:
A full-bodied cyborg girl whose entire body is mechanical. She comes to Cenancle to live with her aunt and soon comes across Uzal and Clarion. By placing her fingers inside Clarion's body, she is able to use the Pandora Device, which allows her to master any skill for a short period of time, ranging from wielding firearms to cookery. She is also able to transfer her brain between different artificial bodies.

(Source: MAL)

129992.description: Nene's aunt who lives on Cenancle Island and is close friends with Uzal. Takumi is usually overwhemed with social anxiety and has to hide behind her Gertsecommas whenever somebody sees her face-to-face. She does all her work in cyberspace and never leaves her mansion.

129994.description:
B.U.E.R (Base of Unearth Extra Resources). A giant boring robot owned by Uzal's company that possesses a giant laser. While its main body resembles a giant eyeball, its Central Nervous Unit, which detaches itself after the main body is shut down, takes the form a gentlemanly but perverted lion-esque creature with five legs. He tends to be injured by Clarion when acting perverted, or locked in a safe-box to stop Takumi from analyzing him, but the darkness traumatizes him.

(Source: MAL)

130025.description: Owner of Happy Internet Cafe and the boss of Team Happy. She plays under the account Chasing Haze, a Launcher class.

130027.description: Plays a Battle Mage by the name of Soft Mist in the game of Glory.

130050.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")
__Combat Style:__ Water Breathing

Water pillar in the Demon Killing Corps. Giyuu is reserved and displays little emotion, instead giving off a calm feeling most of the time. As a water breath user, Giyuu has created his own style. The eleventh style, Lull, gives him the ability to nullify any oncoming attacks, though rapid attacks can pierce through it.

Though Giyuu is reserved, he does have a few friends, such as [Tanjirou](https://anilist.co/character/126071/Kamado-Tanjirou) and, in the past, [Sabito](https://anilist.co/character/137809/Sabito). [Shinobu](https://anilist.co/character/136070/Kochou-Shinobu) often pokes fun at Giyuu and is merciless when doing so, such as saying he has no friends and that others don't like him.

~!He is one of the only Pillar, aside from [Sanemi](https://anilist.co/character/137774/Sanemi-Shinazugawa), who survived during the final fight against [Muzan](https://anilist.co/character/129132/Muzan-Kibutsuji).!~

130070.description: Edinburgh-Class Light Cruiser. As the head of the Royal Navy, she is very dutiful and affectionately calls the Commander “master”.

alternative: Akai Chainsaw Man (赤いチェンソーマン)

130102.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8"), Devil Form - 180 cm (5'11")

Denji is Chainsaw Man's Human Form. He became Chainsaw Man after his dead body was resurrected by his pet dog, [Pochita](https://anilist.co/character/170266/Pochita).

He is a Public Safety Devil Hunter who works under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of an experimental squad in Special Tokyo Division 4. He works alongside his partner [Power](https://anilist.co/character/137079/Power) and under the supervision of [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa).

Denji's personality is both brash and naive as a result of being unable to have a formal education and socialize due to living in severe poverty. He comes off as rude and harsh, yet in an almost childish way. He doesn't know how to be clever or wise but he knows how to lighten the mood. As the Chainsaw Devil, he has the ability to grow chainsaws out of his body.

130109.description: Luca, commonly known by his nickname "Leaky-Eye Luca" due to a previous facial injury that makes his right eye tear up, is a member of Passione who antagonizes Giorno Giovanna over the tithe he must pay after swindling tourists near the airport. When he tries to smash a frog created by Gold Experience, the attack is reflected back at him. His head is bashed in and Luca is put into a coma. Later Bruno Bucciarati finishes him off and uses his remains to torture Giorno.

130127.description:
She is the single mother of [Josuke Higashikata](https://anilist.co/character/13085/Jousuke-Higashikata).

A single mother and teacher, Tomoko is known to show a strong temperament, disliking it when guys try to hit on her (as she still loves Joseph) and she gets annoyed quite easily. She also seems to be mildly perceptive, noticing that the seal on her milk that Angelo had given her was broken. Despite her sharp temperament, she is mostly a kind person, particularly to her family and friends.

130128.description:
Terunosuke is a man of average height and slim build. He has skin of a medium tone, light eyes, and light hair that is styled in a criss-cross pattern, framing his face and curling upwards at its ends.

He wears a long, light coat closed to the end of his chest. Underneath is a dark top wrapped in three ornate belts and fitted dark pants. The inside of his coat has the word "ENIGMA" printed at its bottom.

130129.description:
Yoshihiro Kira is a ghost, having the appearance of a lightly-built, balding old man. Yoshihiro has a small mustache and a goatee of dark hair.

While he was human, Yoshihiro is shown to have fancied modest, respectable attire; consisting of a striped green button-down shirt with a purple tie, yellow cardigan and a loose fitting lime-green suit. As a ghost, however, Yoshihiro now only wears his striped green shirt with matching pants.

130130.description:
Aya is a woman of average to above-average height and slim build. Of fine features, she wears her light hair in an arrangement between a slight beehive and a ponytail; her bangs divided in two, in a clean arch reaching cheek level. Her dark eyebrows rest high on her forehead.

She wears a pink dress with a thick corset belt at her waist, two smaller belts buckled around it. She is depicted with a more notable cleavage in the anime.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130131.description:
Angelo is a tall muscular man with short spiked hair, prominent facial features and a lack of eyebrows. Outside his prison attire in flashbacks, he's only ever seen wearing a milkman outfit consisting of a long sleeve shirt and overalls.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130132.description:
Yuuya Fungami is a minor character in Diamond is Unbreakable. He is featured as an antagonist in Highway Star, and as an ally in Enigma Boy.

Yuuya is a motorcycle gang member who was made into a Stand User by [Yoshihiro Kira](https://anilist.co/character/130129/Kira-Yoshihiro) and prompted into attacking the Joestar Group. Selfishly attacking [Rohan](https://anilist.co/character/12659/Kishibe-Rohan) and [Jousuke](https://anilist.co/character/13085/Higashikata-Jousuke) in a high-speed road chase with his Highway Star, Yuuya later assists Jousuke in the fight against Terunosuke.

130133.description: Hayato is the son of Kosaku Kawajiri and [Shinobu Kawajiri](https://anilist.co/character/130141/Kawajiri-Shinobu). He does not like to interact with his family and spends most of his time inside his bedroom.

130134.description:
Masazo Kinoto is a scrawny man, having an undercut with two wild locks of hair, and cauliflower ears. He is seen wearing casual business attire: a collared shirt, khaki pants and a large trench coat. Masazo is a quiet and timid architect, but a little greedy.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130136.description:
Tamami initially appears as a tall and intimidating man. With pronounced epicanthic folds, he wears hair of dark to medium tone combed in the manner of a pompadour into a sort of thick helmet; and he has a small cross-shaped scar beyond the bottom-left corner of his mouth.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130137.description:
A teenage male, Hazamada is initially tall, but later in the story, like Tamami, he shrinks to Koichi's height. In the anime, he is simply depicted as already being short in stature.

He has long, straight dark hair and wears a school uniform with the character "間" along the collar and several belts spread vertically down the chest- mirroring a strait jacket.

He has dark color upper eyelids.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130138.description: Before showing that he wore a mask, he didn't look very unusual, aside from some facial markings. After he revealed this, his eyes' colors invert, his hair is more tucked into his hat and his ears become exaggeratedly large. The mask's opening also suddenly becomes visible around his neck.

name.native: トニオ・トラサルディー

130139.description:
Tonio is a man of average to above-average height and medium build. He keeps short, light, neat hair; and he often wears a genial expression.
Tonio is only shown in his chef's uniform, comprising a light or white double-breasted jacket, a loose tie, an apron, and a tall, cylindrical hat. He wears the small, metallic emblem of a "T" at the upper corners of the chest his jacket and apron, and at the frontal fold of his hat.
(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130140.description:
Ken is a young boy of short stature, slim build and medium straight hair. His attire consists of a headband, open ankle-high sandals and shortalls with both straps on one shoulder; the garment is adorned on all sides by several large safety pins. He has ginger hair and brown eyes in the colored manga,and white hair and gold eyes in the anime.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130141.description: Shinobu has reddish-pink hair (brown hair in manga) that is parted to the right and tied back in low ponytail. Sometimes, like in her first appearance, she will tie back several locks of hair that are part of her bangs.

130143.description: Ghiaccio is a man of average height and slim to medium build.

130144.description:
Illuso is a man of average height and slim to medium build; according to the height chart in Vento Aureo, he's actually the shortest of the La Squadra members at roughly 5'9" / 175 cm (which is actually close to the Italian height average). He has light-colored eyes and past shoulder-length hair tied into six pigtails. His outfit is entirely quilted: a vest with long sleeves with matching pants. With this outfit he wears dress shoes in a similar style to Giorno's and metal cuffs on the sleeves. He also has on circular knee and elbow pads with straps and a belt with a square, metal buckle. Holes are cut into the outfit to reveal most of his abdomen and neck areas.

 (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130145.description:
Squalo is a young man of slim build, keeping braided light hair.

Squalo wears a dark jumpsuit with studded shoulderpads. He also wears a dark large headband and gloves, as well as three dark armbands on each arm.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130146.description:
Formaggio is a short-haired man of athletic build and average height.

Formaggio wears a mesh shirt with assorted arm warmers, over which he wears a leather jacket decorated with studs on the shoulders. He also wears a pair of dark trousers.

 (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130147.description:
Zucchero is a man of average build and height, keeping his hair attached in a strange looking ponytail that points straight back before curlying at the end 

Zucchero wears a long sleeve collarless shirt with spikes on his shoulders, sleeves, and back. He has long trousers that cover his feet, acting as boots.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130148.description:
Pericolo is a short, mature man, adorning a beard connected to his short hair and a mustache. One of his eyes constantly wanders, alternating between the two but never at the same time.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130149.description:
Cioccolata is a man of average build, having short hair save for mushroom shaped hairlocks on the top of his head. He also bears marks on his forehead and cheeks, and wears earrings, as well as a dark neckband.

Cioccolata wears a stylized bright longcoat, in which a cross shaped lace partially reveals his chest and sporting multiple T-shaped holes on the arms. Under the same bright trousers, Cioccolata wears a dark thong.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130150.description:
Tiziano is a man of slim build and average height, having dark skin and long, straight, light hair.

Tiziano wears loose light-colored overalls, as well as a dark headband and dark gloves, and typical sandals.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130151.description:
Very little is known about Secco, as not even the boss was able to find concrete information regarding his past. Apparently he was once a patient of Cioccolata, but sharing Cioccolata's warped mind and thoughts of spreading suffering, they formed a partnership.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130152.description:
Carne is an overweight man sporting a hairstyle which can be described as an inclined crewcut. Carne lacks a nose, having only nostrils, and has black circles under his eyes. His mouth appears in a small grin a majority of his appearance. His pupils are heavily miotic, constantly staring forward. Overall, his expression appears ominous and intimidating.

Carne wears a stylized dark jumpsuit, on which shoulder-pads are added. He also wears saggy open-crotch pants and sports a large dark headband with the same symbols that pattern Bucciarati's suit.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130153.description:
**Height** 174cm (5'9")

Melone is a minor antagonist and is a member of La Squadra Esecuzioni. He is a young man of athletic build and average height. He keeps long straight hair descending down to his shoulder. Inspired by Venetian design, Melone's most distinctive feature remains his clothes. He wears a dark suit with a concentric circle motif, lacking the right sleeve and a large part of the right side. Melone also wears matching gloves and shoes, as well as a transparent mask covering his right eye. Over his trousers, Melone sports two decorative chains at the shins' level in each leg.

Melone shows himself to be a polite man in most circumstances. Approaching every activity with cold professionalism, he physically and mentally inspects his future victims, looking at them more like tools to create his Stand than fellow human beings. The TV anime portrays a rather lecherous nature, showing him openly licking his lips in delight as he observes a beautiful woman's legs and feet; something his teammates are humorously disturbed by, as well as looking at a woman's legs in the train station near the end of the Baby Face arc. Both of these scenes are absent in the manga, and only present in the TV anime.

Melone always reacts jovially when circumstances match or exceed his expectations, exclaiming "Di Molto!" On the other side, when things do not go his way, he becomes nervous yet remains cool-headed enough to issue tactical instructions, likely due to the fact that he is not the one facing immediate danger.

Melone wields the Stand Baby Face, which is a computer-like humanoid Stand he uses to create autonomous long-range Stands also named Baby Face he can direct to kill his targets. He needs to find a blood sample of his target and a woman to host said Stand before he can act.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Wiki)

130185.description:
__Stand__: Doobie Wah!
__Nationality__: Japanese

Aisho is a slender man of average to below average height. His usual outfit is composed of a skin-tight black bodysuit with a hole in the chest, khaki shorts with a belt, and what appears to be layered sleeves tied around his neck. He also wears what appears to be a pair of sleeves wrapped around his head, allowing some of his hair to poke out through the holes.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130186.description:
Tamaki Damo claims he is 23, though he appears much older, seeing as his hair is styled into a comb-over to hide his bald spot. His facial hair is styled into a goatee and horseshoe mustache. He is introduced wearing aviator sunglasses and a dark-colored tracksuit with spiked sleeves and an image of a saxophone on the left breast. He is much shorter than Hato and is considerably overweight.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

name.native: ドレミファソラティ・ド

130187.description:
Doremifasolati Do is described as a Rock Animal with a caterpillar-like body. Its face vaguely resembles that of a dog or bear with the tongue constantly sticking out. Its head sports several grooves, having deeper grooves extending from its eye-sockets. The rest of its torso is made up of several flat rectangular stones, adorned with designs resembling human arms. These flat stones provide excellent defense from attacks and can be shifted rapidly like tank treads to mobilize underground.

On each side of Doremifasolati Do's torso are two stones that are topped with spinning rock-like human hands. Doremifasolati Do also has a tail in the shape of humanoid legs that is made up of the aforementioned stones, allowing it to stand when above ground. Its torso lacks any internal organs, instead being hollow. This functions as a makeshift cockpit, allowing a person to hide within its body like a shell.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130188.description:
Karera Sakunami is an agriculture student in love with Josefumi Kujo. She usually acts laid-back and carefree, but is also temperamental, crude, and unpredictable. Her stand, Love Love Deluxe, allows her to grow and manipulate hair.

Karera is a serial con artist who uses her ability to commit petty crimes and scams for her own benefit. She also has a characteristic wobbly staggering gait, always looking as if she is going to fall sideways when she walks.

130189.description:
Yagiyama is a man of slim build and average to above-average height, claiming to be 28 years old. He has shoulder-length, straight black hair with short bangs. His eyes are black with small triangular highlights.

He wears a headpiece of leaves and a collar with a pin bearing the letter H. His arms, stomach, and legs are clad in a dark, leathery material studded with small metallic spikes. Over this, he wears a crop top and a pair of floral-printed bloomers. Attached to his belt is a small pouch.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130190.description:
~!__Stand__: Soft & Wet!~
__Nationality__: Japanese

Josefumi is a man of slim to medium build and seemingly average height. He is similar to Part 4's Josuke Higashikata in appearance, wearing metallic peace sign and heart pins on his clothes and styling his hair into a pompadour with the sides bleached. Josefumi wears a checker-patterned sweater over a loose-collared shirt with dark slacks.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130191.description:
Dr. Wu sports a bizarre-looking flattop consisting primarily of small light-colored spheres. He has dark spiked bangs covering the front, with similar tufts of hair outlining the top of his head. His uniform features a long closed jacket with three "DoCToR" name tags on it: two on the front and one on his shoulder.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130192.description:
Urban Guerrilla is a well-built man dressed in minimal clothing. He wears a set of bracers on his forearms and a pair of trousers with three vents on the thighs and metal knee guards. Over Urban Guerrilla's head is a complex hood which features a breathing apparatus hooked into his mouth, along with goggles stylized with six-pronged eyelashes and a lens wiper on the left side.

~!He is also known as Ryo Shimosato (下里良)!~

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130193.description:
Poor Tom is a short, overweight man, easily mistaken for a child if not carefully looked at. Despite his child-like appearance, Tom is covered in wrinkles and is seen smoking cigarettes.

Aside from his shorts and sandals, a majority of Tom's attire appears to be drawn onto his body with certain parts shaded in. Spikes can be seen protruding from the lighter-shaded portion of his head. Other, seemingly drawn-on accessories include a tie with his name on it, a "Coda" pin, referencing the Led Zeppelin album, and a pocket watch.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130194.description:
Rai Mamezuku is a reclusive plant appraiser secretly employed by the Higashikata Fruit Company. Rai is an eccentric, blunt, quick-witted, and analytical man who often comes across as cold-hearted. He is extremely antisocial, going to great lengths in order to stay isolated. His stand, Doggy Style, allows him to unravel his body into band-like cords.

~!He is struck by calamity after trying to attack Wonder of U, and as a result, is killed by Josuke's bubbles.!~

name.native: フェルディナンド博士

130205.description: Dr. Ferdinand is a geologist and paleontologist who works as one of [Valentine](https://anilist.co/character/20147/Funny-Valentine)'s henchmen. His stand is Scary Monsters, which allows him to turn people into dinosaurs.

name.native: スカーレット・ヴァレンタイン

130206.description: Scarlet Valentine is the wife of [Funny Valentine](https://anilist.co/character/20147/Funny-Valentine), making her the first lady of the United States. She is a strong and ambitious woman.

130207.description:
Blackmore is one of [Valentine](https://anilist.co/character/20147/Funny-Valentine)'s loyal men, and an especially skilled assassin. His mission is to recover the Saint Corpse Parts that [Johnny](https://anilist.co/character/19492/Johnny-Joestar) and [Gyro](https://anilist.co/character/11772/Gyro-Zeppeli) had so far collected.

His stand, Catch the Rainbow, allows Blackmore to manipulate rain, including by halting falling drops, making them into threatening obstacles or a path he may cross in air; and relocating functioning parts of/or his entire body with their moving touch and force.

130208.description: Mike O. is [Funny Valentine](https://anilist.co/character/20147/Funny-Valentine)'s personal bodyguard. His stand, Tubular Bells, allows him to create deadly metal balloons.

130209.description: Axl RO is one of [Funny Valentine](https://anilist.co/character/20147/Funny-Valentine)'s henchmen. His stand, Civil War, materializes his opponent's guilt and uses it to attack them.

name.native: メアリー・ジョースタ

130250.description:
Mary Joestar is the late mother of Jonathan Joestar and wife of George Joestar. Never shown in person in the series, the only thing known about her story is that she accompanied her husband during a trip to London and died protecting her baby when her carriage had an accident and fell into a ravine.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130257.description:
N'Doul is a man of athletic build and medium height, keeping unkempt dark hair and whose blank eyes are always near shut due to his blindness. He wears a simple T-shirt over which he keeps a stripped overshirt and a drape to protect himself from the sun. N'Doul also wears armbands and simple trousers and shoes. He wears a headband and two earrings which look like bracelets.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130258.description:
Nijimura Sr. is a short, rotund creature with rough, blistered green skin, mismatched eyes, no ears, a squished nose, and puffy lips resembling a beak. He has a mohawk-like hairstyle with small bald patches in between. He wears a sleeveless shirt along with shorts.

Before his deformation, as seen in a photograph, he was a man of masculine features and short, dark hair, wearing a genial expression.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130259.description:
Donovan is a mature athletic man whose dark hair is slicked back. His skin is colored differently around his eyes, starting from a wide area on his hairline and converging to the side of the root of his nose.

Donovan wears a sleeveless officer outfit.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

name.native: マリオ ・ ツェペリ

130260.description:
Mario Zeppeli is characterized as hard-working, trustworthy, and a wholesome family man. Although he loved his family, Mario had to abandon them in order to investigate the Pillar Men.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130261.description:
Loggins is a tall, muscular man with chiseled features and somewhat glazed eyes. He wears a tunic, an over-sized fez, and armbands.

Loggins displays a very demanding demeanor when instructing Joseph and Caesar, often forcing them to do tough trials during their Ripple training. Despite this, he seems to have, along with Messina, a sense of humor as the two would often tease their disciples. 

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

name.native: ジョージ・ジョースター 2世

130262.description:
George resembles his father Jonathan and his son Joseph. He is only seen wearing a military dress uniform.

Assumed to be a capable fighter pilot, George was one of the first to fly an aircraft during World War I. It's hinted that he may have had a talent for the Ripple much like his father and son, though he was never given any training to properly use it.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130263.description:
Messina is a tall muscular man with short hair tied into a ponytail and a Fu Manchu mustache. He wears a long hat, a sleeveless tunic, and armbands.

Though much of Messina's personality isn't focused upon, he displays the characteristics of a stern, yet effective instructor to Joseph and Caesar. Despite this, Messina seems to have a sense of humor as he, along with Loggins, would often tease his disciples during their training.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130267.description: Jiang Wanyin is the current leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect and the uncle of Jin Ling. He is more commonly known to other cultivators by his courtesy name, Jiang Wanyin, or his title, Sandu Shengshou.

130304.description:
[Yuuma](https://anilist.co/character/130307/Yuuma-Kunimi)'s girlfriend. Popular within the school and can be a standoffish person, but she shows great affection towards Yuuma. She is quite protective of him and often clashes with [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Sakuta-Azusagawa) as a result.

~!It is revealed that Saki has an older sister whom her parents often compare her to, causing her to develop low self-esteem. Sakuta believes this to be the reason why she is so protective of Yuuma's image and her own, as in her eyes she already has a fragile self-image.!~


~!After graduating she attends the same college as Sakuta and goes into health studies, in the hopes of becoming a nurse in order to help Yuuma whenever she can due to his decision to partake in firefighter training.!~

130307.description: A good friend of [Sakuta Azusagawa](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Sakuta-Azusagawa) and [Rio Futaba](https://anilist.co/character/127633/Rio-Futaba), as well as the boyfriend of [Saki Kamisato](https://anilist.co/character/130304). He is a member of Minegahara High's basketball team, being quite athletic and popular within the school.

130429.description:
__Race:__ Kitsune+
__Height:__ 135 cm (4'5")

Her name is Senko, and she’s a divine messenger fox of 800 years! Her mission is to ease the anxiety and darkness plaguing humanity, and thus she has come to pamper and take care of [Nakano](https://anilist.co/character/130431/Nakano-Kuroto) by cooking, cleaning, and more!

130430.description:
__Height:__ 140 cm

Another fox goddess, who appears at [Nakano](https://anilist.co/character/130431/Nakano-Kuroto)’s house after [Senko](https://anilist.co/character/130429/Senko). Her pure white tail is a proof of her pure blood! She has special abilities like reading people’s hearts and seeing visions.

130431.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Nakano is a depressed salaryman working for an exploitative company, until [Senko](https://anilist.co/character/130429/Senko) intrudes into his life!

130477.description: The current Demon Lord. ~!She is the Origin Taratect, Ancient Divine Beast, and Ruler of Gluttony. She is the origin of all Taratects in the System, and thus all spiders can be considered her kin. The Queen Taratects and Puppet Taratects are her closest kin, having wills and personalities of their own, and are not dominated by Kin Control, even though she has this skill.!~

130478.description:
Wrath, formerly known as Sasajima Kyouya, is one of the students that reincarnated. After reincarnation, he found himself reborn as a Goblin in a Goblin Village with the special skill to create weapons.

~!He is the commander of the Demon Lord's eighth army.!~

name.native: カルナティア・セリ・アナバルド

130479.description:
The daughter of Duke Anabald.

In her previous life, she was a boy named Ooshima Kanata, but she reincarnated as a beautiful girl. She's a prodigy on par with [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487/Schlain-Zagan-Analeit), and has been his best friend since their former life. Her speech is normally elegant and refined, but when talking with others who have reincarnated, she talks like a boy.

name.native: フィリメス・ハァイフェナス

130481.description: In her previous life, she was Okazaki Kanami, homeroom teacher to the kids who were reincarnated, and they affectionately call her "Oka-chan." After reincarnating, she began attending school with [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487/Schlain-Zagan-Analeit) and the others as their classmate. Since she reincarnated as an elf, she looks younger than she actually is. She's a caring teacher who continues to follow her students after their reincarnation, but she has many secrets.

130482.description:
Sophia Keren, formerly known as Negishi Shouko in her previous life, is one of the reincarnated students. She was reincarnated as a True Vampire in a noble human family, the Kerens. Her relatives are normal humans, so she hides the fact that she is a Vampire.

~!Sophia works for the demons as a soldier of the 10th Demon Army under direct orders of [Shiro](https://anilist.co/character/122124/Kumoko) to hunt the various clones of [Potimas](https://anilist.co/character/130480/Harrifenas-Potimas).!~

130483.description:
[Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487/Schlain-Zagan-Analeit)'s pet Earth Wyrm.

In her previous life, she was a girl named Shinohara Mirei, but she reincarnated as a monster instead of a human. As a monster, her stats grow at a very fast rate, and she has excellent situational judgment. She has a cheerful, open personality, but she was a bully in her former life, and this shows in her behavior.

name.native: チルチャック・ティムズ

130509.description:
__Height:__ 110 cm (3'7")

Chilchuck is a member of [Laios](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios)' party. He is a half-foot from the Eastern Continent.

Chilchuck is shrewd, practical, and sharp-tongued. He refuses to take jobs unless he is paid in advance. His specialties are lockpicking and identifying and disarming traps. He's more open to eating monsters than [Marcille](https://anilist.co/character/127292/Donato-Marcille) is, but like her, draws a hard line at humanoids. He generally goes along with whatever the party does, but will speak frankly when they do something that can get them killed. His job as the party rogue puts him on edge, as failure to undo or avoid traps can lead his companions to immediate mortal danger. When his party members ignore his warnings, he quickly becomes agitated. He prefers to keep his private life separate from his work, so he doesn't tell his party a lot about himself.

~!He has a wife and 3 daughters, but hasn't seen them in years.!~

130556.description:
__Occupation:__ Garden Staff

A chef in the restaurant who had a sexual interest in Akira. When he learns about Akira's infatuation with Masami, he blackmails her by forcing her to date him in order to keep her secret intact.

He is a perceptive and observant person who is quick on picking up the thoughts of other people and the underlying story. He tends to be very straightforward in pointing out weaknesses and flaws in everyone, caring not a whit about the impact of his harshness. He can be rude and aloof at times, especially when Yoshizawa attempted to be friendly to him.

He is handsome in the eyes of girls but is seen as a player with a flirtatious nature, hence making his female coworkers avoid him. When paired with his cunning personality, he easily manipulates a situation to his own desire, much to the annoyance of others.

While generally perceived to be a terrible person, he does good at his work of cooking, putting in effort when the other staff are on leave and when the restaurant is in a peak period.

130558.description:
President of the Track and field club and childhood best friend of Akira. They were extremely close in the past​ but almost stopped communicating after her trauma. Haruka feels that Akira hides some deep problems and it worries her a lot.

She is a supportive and caring person who cares deeply for her friends, including Akira, and is quick to defend her friend. She can be adamant about things that she truly believes in, and is persistent in getting what she wants.

130559.description:
Kayoko works at the family restaurant Garden as assistant manager. She has a harsh personality who often barks orders at her coworkers and she is strict on Masami Kondou's performance as her superior in the restaurant and frequently chides him for being "weak". She also has gripes about her salary and the benefits often.

Nevertheless, she serves as a mentor for the younger staff like Akira Tachibana and she provides help and advice when needed. She has a soft spot for children and small animals, like Yuuto Kondou's hamster.

130569.description: Forever is a malicious orangutan in DIO's service who confronts the group in the South China Sea aboard a freighter. Said ship happens to be possessed by Forever's Stand: Strength.

name.native: シェリー・ポルナレフ

130570.description: Sherry Polnareff is Jean Pierre Polnareff's little sister who was raped and murdered by J. Geil, prompting Polnareff to seek revenge against her killer.

130571.description:
Anne is a minor character appearing in Stardust Crusaders.

Joining the Joestar Group before departing for Singapore, she somehow follows them from there to Pakistan and appears regularly alongside the main characters.

130572.description: Gray Fly is an assassin sent by DIO who attacks the group aboard a plane traveling from Tokyo to Cairo, eventually crashing it into the ocean near Hong Kong. He is a Stand User and wields Tower of Gray.

name.native: 鋼入りのスティーリーダン
alternative: スティーリー ダン

130573.description:
Steely Dan is a Stand User using the microscopic Lovers.
Steely Dan is sent to assassinate Enya the Hag and then confronts the Joestar Group in Pakistan.

130574.description: Devo the Cursed is an infamous Native American shaman and assassin in DIO's service. Devo ambushes Jean Pierre Polnareff in his hotel room in Singapore. He is a Stand User and uses Ebony Devil.

130575.description:
Cameo (カメオ Kameo) is a minor antagonist featured in Stardust Crusaders.
He isolates Polnareff from the Joestar Group on a secluded island in the Red Sea while they are there to retrieve Avdol. Cameo is one of DIO's henchmen, and the Stand User behind the genie Stand, Judgement.

130576.description: Mannish Boy is an evil genius baby and Stand user in DIO's service. He tries to murder the Joestar Group inside the nightmare-world of his Death Thirteen.

130577.description: Arabia Fats is another of DIO's goons, who ambushes the Joestar Group in the middle of the Arabian desert with his Stand: Sun.

130579.description: ZZ is another of DIO's assassins who confronts the Joestar Group. He is a Stand User who drives his Wheel of Fortune.

name.native: 偽キャプテン・テニール

130580.description:
The impostor Captain Tennille is a minor antagonist appearing in Stardust Crusaders.

He is an assassin sent by DIO who fights the Joestar Group in the middle of the ocean on their way to Egypt. He is a Stand User and wields Dark Blue Moon.

130581.description: Midler is the last of DIO's assassins the heroes encounter before entering Egypt. She is a Stand User, and her High Priestess attacks the group as they travel by submarine in the Red Sea.

130605.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm 
__Stand:__ Manhattan Transfer

Johngalli A is a man of average to above-average height and medium build. He has long, light hair, including a small braid bordering the left side of his face; and his cheeks are marked by a thin, vaguely tribal symbol. Johngalli A. has cataract, making his irises appear entirely white. He also possesses a tattoo of Earth on his back.

Johngalli A. wears a plain shirt and dark trousers, which feature regular nearly full circular cuts, so that round patches dangle from the clothes. He also wears a holed tie with a square end.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130606.description: Miraschon is an inmate in Green Dolphin Street Prison to whom Enrico Pucci gifts the Stand, Marilyn Manson, and sends to assassinate Jolyne Kuujou. She then gambles with Jolyne, Hermes Costello and Foo Fighters in order to harvest their organs and take Jotaro Kujo's Stand disc.

130607.description:
Sports Maxx is a man of average to above-average height and medium build. He has short, sparse hair in soft spikes; and eyebrows in the shape of large, light circles, tapering into short tails. He wears a long, light coat and light pants, both patterned by a dark paisley design.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130608.description:
__Height:__ 171 cm
__Stand:__ Goo Goo Dolls

Gwess is a young woman of average build and height, with long dark hair. She dons three dots under her left eye. Gwess wears a horizontally stripped body suit, supported by another layer of clothing over her breasts, over which she wears a typical Green Dolphin Street inmate jacket. Her pants are covered with stripes over her thighs with different colored normal pant legs behind and down to her feet. She also sports a pair of boots, decorated outside the pants by long accessories that are incrementally indented. She wears a voided hat furnished with a bird feet motif, out from which her hair sticks out, as well as a thick collar around her neck.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

name.native: ミュッチャー・ミューラー

130609.description:
Miu Miu is described by Gwess as giving off air from having come from an upper-class socialite family. She is the corrections captain of Green Dolphin Street Prison and she clashes with Jolyne Cujoh and Emporio Alniño when she comes to stop Jolyne from breaking out of prison. She is a Stand User and uses Jail House Lock to manipulate the memories of her enemies.

Jail House Lock is a humanoid Stand capable of making one or several people able to only memorize three new pieces of information at once, the oldest memory being replaced by the newest memory.

130610.description:
D an G is a man of average build and height, wearing a fleece-like multi-colored toga, wristbands, and a spiked metal helmet.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130611.description:
Kenzou is a small yet athletic old man, with a heavily wrinkled and clean-shaved face, but he has unusually long eyebrows over slanted eyes. He has several thin braids on the back of the head.

Kenzou wears a furred bodysuit open on the chest, a jeweled skullcap on which are several big pearls, and a similarly jeweled necklace.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130612.description:
Lang is a man of average to above-average height and medium build.

Very little can be seen of his face, as he is clad in an assortment of makeshift gear designed to insulate him from the effects of his Stand. This includes a flat-topped hat covering his face to below his eyes with a serrated bottom edge, and goggles. As such, nothing of his hair or even eyes can be distinguished, leaving his actual face enigmatic.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130613.description:
Ungalo is one of Dio's children recruited by Pucci to try and kill Jolyne and her friends. Unngalo is a drug addict who tried to stab Pucci to death when he first met him.

His stand, Bohemian Rhapsody, can give life to drawn/fictional characters, like the ones in a comic or the stickman in a road sign.

130614.description:
Rikiel is a young, decently built man with a long face. He has dark hair styled into several dreadlocks. He wears a sleeveless and hooded bodysuit patterned after the hide of a stereotypical cow with an opening on his chest. He wears an assortment of arm warmers.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130615.description: The Green Baby resembles a gremlin in appearance, with two lines going down either side of its cranium. It has large, pointy ears and green skin, which is patterned with leaf shapes. It has eyes that resemble seeds. It also has what appears to be a leaf-shaped mark on its forehead and the Joestar Birthmark on its back.

name.native: サンダー・マックイイーン

130617.description:
__Height:__ 181 cm 
__Stand:__ Highway to Hell

Thunder is a man of average to above-average height and medium build. An "M" shape appears across the right side of his forehead.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

name.native: ヴィヴァーノ・ウエストウッド

130618.description:
__Height:__ 186 cm
__Stand:__ Planet Waves
  
Viviano Westwood is a muscular man with a sharp square face. After his companion violently punches him, a significant part of his inner mouth, gum and teeth included, is visible. He has dark hair and an undercut. Westwood wears the uniform of the Green Dolphin Street Jail guards.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

name.native: グローリア・コステロ

130620.description:
Gloria Costello is Hermes Costello's late sister. At age twenty, Gloria inherited her father's Mexican restaurant and managed it, constantly chastising her sister Hermes for not helping her.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130621.description:
Perla is a beautiful young girl of slim build, who has long blonde hair and two thin braids on each side of her head.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130622.description:
Guccio is a scrawny man with a triangular face, wide open eyes, a small flat nose, thin eyebrows, and a perpetually open mouth showing his teeth. Guccio sports a pencil mustache and a bowl cut, with two shoulder long strands of hair on each side of the head.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

130645.description: A boy who lives in a house with his father, mother, and dog named Yukko. He felt the most loved until the birth of his younger sister, to which now he feels jealous of the attention his little sister is getting.

130646.description: Kun's little sister who comes from the future to talk to him. She would eventually be a big part in many of Kun's adventures in the story, teaching him many things along the way.

130664.description:
Shinichi Sakurai is a tall, introverted college student with short brown hair. Shinichi enjoys peace and quiet and likes playing video games. He prefers to be left alone, but despite his objections, he often ends up hanging out with [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/130665/Hana-Uzaki). Shinichi works at a college café run by [Mr. Asai](https://anilist.co/character/169505/Akihiko-Asai).

~!After learning his feelings for Hana, he quickly confesses resulting in the two going out.!~

130665.description: Hana Uzaki is a short, silver-haired college student with an energetic personality. Her antics often annoy her senpai, [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/130664/).

130712.description:
__Height:__ 189 cm (6'2")
__Affiliation:__ Special Fire Force Company 8
__Rank:__ Captain

The popular and charismatic leader of the newly established Company 8. His goal is to investigate the other companies and uncover the truth about spontaneous human combustion. He has no powers, but uses his finely-honed muscles as a weapon in a battle style that's on even par with [Benimaru](https://anilist.co/character/130848)'s. Loves bodybuilding to an almost creepy extent.

Despite not being a Pyrokinetic like most other known Battalion Commanders, Akitaru has a very fit physique, which allows him to face Infernals. In battle, he is seen using different weapons, suitable for the situation, like the Core Annihilating Pile Bunker or a fire fighting axe, which he can veil in white steam and thrust at the opponent. His weapons appear to be designed in order to impale an Infernal's core with low difficulty. He is able to carry up to 30kg of equipment each time he is on a mission to fight an Infernal. As a fire fighter, Akitaru was recognized enough to be decorated twice, though both were revoked due to actions prioritising saving citizens lives at the expense of defying orders.

130713.description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'6")
__Affiliation:__ Special Fire Force Company 8
__Rank:__ First Class Fire Soldier

A former member of the military, she is an excellent fighter who controls fire. She's a cool lady but is mad about love stories, and her beauty is overshadowed by her "head full of flowers and wedding bells". She's friendly but goes berserk when anyone comments on her muscles. Apparently,​ she used to be slender.

Maki possesses Second Generation abilities, having adapted to Spontaneous Human Combustion by becoming able to control flames from a long distance. In doing so, she can handle herself against two Third Generations simultaneously, being able to extinguish and absorb their generated flames into a giant fireball. Maki's abilities provide defense for her entire team, as she can reflect incoming fire attacks and use an opponent's flames against them. While she is unable to deflect or redirect a fire with too much driving force, she is still able to alter its shape in order to reduce its impact.

130714.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")
__Affiliation:__ Special Fire Force Company 8
__Rank:__ Lieutenant

A dry, unemotional ex-military man, whose stern disciplina is feared among the new recruits. He helped [Oubi](https://anilist.co/character/130712/Oubi-Akitaru) to found Company 8. He never allows the soldiers to play with fire. The gun he uses is a cherished memento from his friend who became an Infernal.

Takehisa is a Second Generation, who has awakened the ability to manipulate flames through the use of firearms, such as a machine gun or a pistol, which he wields on the battlefield. Takehisa's ability allows him to control the gunpowder inside bullets, making the impact they make stronger or weaker, depending on the situation. He can use this ability to make his bullets non-lethal.

130715.description:
**Height:** 174 cm

He trained at the academy with [Shinra](https://anilist.co/character/120462/Kusakabe-Shinra). Although he follows his own personal code of chivalry as the self-proclaimed Knight King, he is incredibly stupid. But girls love him. 

Being a Third Generation Pyrokinetic, Arthur has been identified by individuals as having a strong will of fire. By raising the temperature of the flames he creates, he can fabricate and control plasma, which either elevates or diminishes in relation to Arthur's disarrangement from reality. The more delusional he is, the stronger Arthur becomes.

Being able to use his Ignition Ability on hilt-like objects, Arthur can weld, cut through metal, and generate electricity. He mainly uses his ability on his blade-less sword Excalibur, which is most effective using his right hand and cannot be easily extinguished by an experienced Second Generation. Using it, he can deflect and fend off against flames.

130716.description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'0)
__Affiliation:__ Special Fire Force Company 8
__Rank:__ Nun

A sister of the Holy Sol Temple, her prayers are an indispensable part of extinguishing Infernals. Personality-wise she is no less than an angel.

name.native: キース・風間・フリック

130730.description: Keith Kazama Flick is a character in B: The Beginning. On a winter eight years ago, his sister, Erika Flick, was murdered by someone, causing him to go into depression and eventually retire from the police force. During present day, he is called out of retirement by his old friend, Eric Toga, to help the R.I.S. criminal investigation force to track down the serial murderer known as "Killer B".

130732.description:
Koku is one of the main characters in B: The Beginning. He works as a Violin Craftsman under Lily's father and has the ability to transform into a black-winged, heteromorphic being. He is also the true identity of Killer B, a name derived by his unusual way of writing the number "13" at his murder sites.

~!Since the attack on Jaula Blana orchestrated by Gilbert Ross that took the lives of several of his classmates including Dr. Heath Flick, Koku has spent the last seven years in search of his love, Yuna, in hopes of reuniting with her.!~

130733.description: Lily Hoshina is one of the main characters in B: The Beginning. She comes from a family of violin repairers and is a detective that works for the Royal Investigative Services.

130734.description: Brian Brandon is an inspector with the RIS and one of the supporting characters in B: The Beginning.

130735.description: Eric Toga is one of the main supporting characters in B: The Beginning and a member of the Royal Investigative Service's Special Criminal Investigation Section.

130751.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")
__Affiliation:__ Special Fire Force Company 8
__Rank:__ Second Class Soldier
