~!Originally a rookie member of Company 1, she was caught up in the treasonous plot of her superior officer Hoshimiya, and is currently being disciplined under Company 8's watch.!~ A tough girl with an unfortunate "lucky lecher lure" condition, she nevertheless has a pure heart.

Being a Third Generation, she is immune to being burnt by flames and can use her Ignition Ability to gird herself in pink flames, which grant her various cat-like traits, including cat ears, two forked tails and nails on her fingertips, an ability she dubbed "Nekomata". With her Ignition Ability active, Tamaki's agility and mobility is substantially increased, allowing her to run on all fours. She can use her forked-tails to generate a blast of fire, which is strong enough to break through building walls, restrain her targets in a circle of fire by lengthening them, or using them as a distress signal by the same process.

130821.description:
__Height:__ 149 cm

Momiji is the younger sister of [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/130819). She is in middle school, and is in the same class that [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822) enters when they reenter school. Momiji likes to dress, look, and act as a tomboy, and many times she is taken for a young teen/tween boy. However, Momiji gives no indication that she is in any way a transgender tween. She appears to only be gender non-conforming.

However, she can be quite feminine in appearance on select occasions, like when she wears the middle school female uniform, a cute jumper dress, to school. She forms a strong friendship with Mahiro, and helps Mahiro navigate the middle school academic and social challenges of school.

Many times she comes to Mahiro's defense when Mahiro is bewildered or frightened by somebody or something happening at school, or if it is perceived that the boys are picking on her. She is part of a tight-knit social circle foursome of friends at school, with the other three girls being Mahiro, [Asahi](https://anilist.co/character/130824), and [Miyo-chan](https://anilist.co/character/130820).

130822.description: He was a hikikomori neet and loner, until he woke up one morning as a little girl thanks to his [younger sister](https://anilist.co/character/130823/Oyama-Mihari) drugging him.

130823.description: [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822/Oyama-Mahiro)'s little sister. A genius scientist that skipped grades and is now attending college. She is responsible for drugging Mahiro, turning him into a young girl.

130944.description:
__Height:__ 169.5 cm
__Likes:__ Math, Physics, Finances

Kindhearted, charismatic, and intelligent, albeit only in certain areas. Nasa Yuzaki decided he had no need for a high school education, and, well, he was mostly right. He is the type of person who would worry if his friends got hurt when they tripped over a pebble, while he ended up falling down a cliff. He is very in love with his wife.

131028.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

She is a student and mangaka. She is the next door neighbor of [Kuroto Nakano](https://anilist.co/character/130431/Nakano-Kuroto) and [Senko-san](https://anilist.co/character/130429/Senko).

Spoiler: ~!Later, Shiro comes to her place and begins pampering her similar to how Senko-San pampers Nakano.!~

131106.description:
**Height**: 154 cm
**Relatives**: [Tokiko Tsukuyomi](https://anilist.co/character/188292/Tokiko-Tsukuyomi) (grandaunt), [Enishi Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/190386/Enishi-Yuzaki) (father-in-law), [Kanoka Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/190388/Kanoka-Yuzaki) (mother-in-law)

Tsukasa Yuzaki is the wife of [Nasa Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki). Not much is known about her, but what is known is that she's mysteriously cute.

Tsukasa has long pink hair with a clasp on the back and pink-red eyes. She wears elegant clothing and a skirt. While at home she is usually seen wearing modern clothing. During her trip to Kyoto, she wore a floral Yukata.

Tsukasa comes across as calm and level-headed; seemingly unsurprised by Nasa's rash and illogical actions. Despite this, she agreed to marry him and love him dearly. She gets embarrassed easily whenever Nasa proclaims his love towards her and how cute she is. She has a huge love for movies, games, and pop-culture. She has a wide range of knowledge concerning aspects of Japanese history. This includes how to handle a Katana properly and information regarding various locations and landmarks. Tsukasa talks about such things as if she had experienced them herself but never elaborates.

~!Tsukasa is immortal and over 1400 years old, but maintains the appearance as a 16-year-old girl.!~

name.native: ウィルソン・フィリップス

131129.description:
Wilson Phillips is a minor character featured in Stardust Crusaders.
Despite being a powerful American Senator, DIO hijacks his car and forces Wilson Phillips to become his chauffeur in order to pursue the Joestar Group in the streets of Cairo.

131208.description: He is a member of the Military Police Regiment who serves as Nile Dawk's aide

name.native: ダリウス・ベーア＝ヴァルブルン

131456.description: A team leader of the Scout Regiment who participated in the 57th expedition beyond the Walls.

131457.description:
A member of the Scout Regiment and participated in the 57th Exterior Scouting Mission.
~!Dieter appears very unconditioned and mentally cracking. He shows great distress over the death of his friend Ivan, and disobeys his superiors when they refuse his request to retrieve his body; resulting in the death of his friend Jurgen. When confronted by Captain Levi, Dieter bursts into tears, cracking under the mental stress he had endured. Though he shows passion for his friends, this passion manifests itself in the form of recklessness resulting in comrades deaths!~

131475.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

A college student who is shy around strangers and spends most of her time indoors. She becomes smitten by [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476) and starts making her snacks in exchange for getting her to dress up in cosplay outfits she makes.

131476.description:
__Height:__ 142.3 cm (4'8")

An elementary school student who is classmates with [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/131477). She is often disturbed by [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475)'s behavior but puts up with it in order to eat her snacks.

131477.description:
__Height:__ 140.7 cm

[Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475)'s younger sister and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476)'s classmate. She is particularly fond of her sister, who she nicknames "Mya-nee".

131478.description:
__Height__: 138.6 cm (4'6")

A class representative in Hana's class. She aspires to be someone that everyone can rely on, but is often unreliable herself.

131479.description:
__Height:__ 141 cm (4'7")

Another class representative in [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476)'s class and [Koyori](https://anilist.co/character/131478)'s best friend. She is kind and often seen as very reliable, much to Koyori's chagrin.

131480.description:
__Height__: 142.7 cm (4'8")

[Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476) and [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/131477)'s classmate who moves next door to [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475) and Hinata. She constantly sees herself as cute, often becoming downhearted when someone else (usually Hana) is said to be cuter.

131519.description: An ex-yakuza who now lives peacefully as a househusband.

131521.description: Tatsu's wife. A graphic designer who loves Policure

131522.description: The mother of Nadeshiko and Sakura Kagamihara.

131523.description:
A substitute teacher, soon become the advisor for Outdoor Activities Club.

It is later revealed that she has already met Nadeshiko and Rin. ~!She was seen drinking incredible amounts of booze while camping with her little sister.!~

alternative: リンの祖父 (Rin no Sofu; Rin's Grandfather)

131524.description: Rin's grandfather, who passed his passion for camping on to his granddaughter.

131535.description:
__Eye Color:__ Blue
__Hair Color:__ White
__Occupation:__ Student
__Debut:__ Volume 1 (Light Novel) / Chapter 5 (Manga) / Episode 3 (Anime)

Hakua Shiodome is one of the main female characters. She is a genius in fields such as engineering, math, and science, and even has a special lab built specifically for her use at the academy.

_Appearance:_ Hakua is a teenage girl below average height for a fourteen year old, who has very pale skin and is often mistaken for a elementary student. She has short silver-white hair with a blue tint to it that only reaches down to her ears. She also has big, blue round eyes. Hakua is usually seen with her school uniform; which consist of a white shirt and a brown collar, with a orange-brownish ribbon on it. And also a white and rather short skirt, white stockings and brown shoes. Otherwise, she is seen with a long, loose sleeved button up with lace at the top, with a string tied in a bow, along with a murky purple skirt that is rather short, with white fold over socks that have lace on them.

_Personality:_ Hakua has a very air-headed and quiet personality, and a very soft-spoken voice. She is shy and a extremely youthful autistic genius who was very antisocial. But she has a very reserved demeanor, showing very little emotion and speaking very little. Despite this she is prone to eccentric behavior, that involves her unconsciously stripping off her clothes and recording things such as complicated mathematical formulas anywhere she can. Hakua is an expert in mathematics and the sciences, and habitually documents new equations on any convenient walls. She goes into a strange daze at such times, and wriggles out of her clothes as she writes. While she gives the impression she only prefers to talk to [Kimito](https://anilist.co/character/131538), she called the other girls ([Aika](https://anilist.co/character/131536), [Reiko](https://anilist.co/character/131537) and [Karen](https://anilist.co/character/126377)) her other friends as well which left them surprised and touched. This shows that she has no problems with them as she is shown giving them a riddle. Hakua also seems to not like losing in anything, shown when [Kimito](https://anilist.co/character/131538) gives her riddles that she could not answer. This prompts her to ask for more just to prove that she is good with riddles. She also displays this kind of personality when she plays rock, paper, scissors with Kimito and always loses, prompting her to demand a rematch until she wins.

131536.description:
__Eye Color:__ Light Brown 
__Hair Color:__ Orange
__Occupation:__ Student
__Debut:__ Volume 1, Prologue (Light Novel) / Chapter 1 (Manga) / Episode 1 (Anime)

Aika Tenkuubashi is the female protagonist of the series.

_Appearance:_ Aika is a young girl with a petite frame, with a mixture of the colors orange, peach and blonde as her hair color. Her hair is short and straight, only reaching down to her shoulders, which is usually seen being tied into twin-tails, with red ribbons on each side, and she has big light brown eyes. Aika is usually seen with her school uniform; which consists of a white dress with a brown collar, that has a ribbon on it, that matches with Aika's haircolor, white stockings and brown shoes. 

_Personality:_ Aika is childish, naïve, and shy about talking to others. This distances her from them even though she wishes to be popular among her peers. Aika is strongly fascinated of the outside world; things like the PSP, ramen, and manga are but a few of her interests. Aika is also very air headed and cheerful. When she first met [Kimito](https://anilist.co/character/131538), she wasn't shy at all and was willing to kiss him so her wish would be granted. Her wish was to become one of the popular persons in the school, like [Reiko](https://anilist.co/character/131537). According to [Kimito](https://anilist.co/character/131538), she is very pure, to an unbelievable degree. She easily believes idiotic lies and yet cannot tell lies herself, and she is afraid of being hated or feeling a bad vibe. Aika is practically incapable of telling lies, and often says what is on her mind, regardless of how others might react. For this reason she has distanced herself from her classmates. She is also very gullible, causing her to be easily tricked by the mischievous [Kimito](https://anilist.co/character/131538). Aika also has a tsundere-like personality, getting embarrassed and blushing very easily. She hides her true feelings for [Kimito](https://anilist.co/character/131538), but never admits it, although her feelings are very obvious, and because of this, she can get quite mad when she is wrong or when it comes to romance. But inside, she has a soft and cute personality.

131537.description:
__Eye Color:__ Blue
__Hair Color:__ Blond
__Occupation:__ Student
__Debut:__ Volume 1, Chapter 1 (Light Novel) / Chapter 1 (Manga) / Episode 1 (Anime)

Reiko Arisugawa is one of the main female characters in the [Shomin Sample](https://anilist.co/anime/20771) series. Reiko is one of the most popular girls in her school, and many want to be popular like her, including [Aika](https://anilist.co/character/131536). She also acts as the representative of the first year high school students. 

_Appearance:_ Reiko is a tall, busty and very beautiful girl with straight, blond hair, reaching down to her shoulders and below, and she has turquoise-sapphire eyes. She has fair skin. She always has a white flower clip on the left side of her fringe to style her hair. Reiko is usually seen with a normal Seikain Jogakkou school uniform. 

_Personality:_ Reiko is considered the most innocent, pleasant, and cheerful girl in the school. She is someone who always acts positive, however, her personality drastically changes when she learns about [Aika](https://anilist.co/character/131536)'s plan to help her reconcile with her friends and classmates after an uncharacteristic outburst. She doesn't want to accept [Aika](https://anilist.co/character/131536)'s help and bitterly confronts her about her actions. In the end, the situation is resolved amiably, but in turn this breeds a rivalry for [Kimito](https://anilist.co/character/131538)'s affections.

Reiko is a highly respected and influential member of [Kimito](https://anilist.co/character/131538)'s class at Seikain Jogakkou. She welcomes [Kimito](https://anilist.co/character/131538) after he first arrives at the academy. Like most of the other "Ojou-samas" at the academy she is ignorant to, and also captivated by, almost anything related to commoners.

131538.description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5’8”)

Kimito is a commoner who is forced to enroll at Seikain Jogakkou after being kidnapped.

He is known to be a kind person, he is calm and he often helps other people and is always ready to do so; like helping [Aika](https://anilist.co/character/131536) to become popular. Although he is a little dense when it comes to romance and the girls' feelings around him, he is strong-minded and has a friendly disposition, which results in the girls becoming attracted to him. He also has a strong work ethic and takes everything in stride.

131539.description: Chaka is an Egyptian farmer who found Anubis in a pile of rubble and got possessed, prompting him to go battle Polnareff.

131540.description: Mariah is one of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods. She separates the group in Luxor and attempts to take out Joseph and Avdol using her Stand, Bastet, while Alessi confronts the rest of the heroes.

131541.description: Anubis is a minor antagonist featured in Stardust Crusaders. It's unique in being a userless Stand who can possess anyone who wields it, and repeatedly tries to kill the Joestar Group's members in Egypt.

131542.description: Alessi is one of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods and attempts to assassinate Polnareff in Luxor as Mariah battles Joseph and Avdol. His Stand is Sethan, a rejuvenating shadow.

131543.description:
__Stand:__ Tenore Sax

Kenny G. is a minor antagonist featured in Stardust Crusaders. When the Joestar Group enters DIO's Mansion, he casts an illusion on it to make it look like a labyrinth to them but is quickly taken out.

131544.description: Khan is an ordinary barber and is possessed by Anubis as he gives Polnareff a shave. Consequently, he battles both Polnareff and Jotaro.

131560.description: Zaratras was a Great Holy Knight and was once the strongest in the order of Liones' Holy Knights before his death ten years prior to the beginning of series. He is also the father of the Holy Knight, Gilthunder, and was the Seven Deadly Sins' superior.

131561.description: Liz, or Elizabeth, was a knight from an enemy kingdom of Danafor, which attempted night ambush at Danafor, but got captured and sentenced to death. She was saved by Meliodas, the leader of the Holy Knights of Danafor and ended up living in Danafor and eventually also became Meliodas' lover. She is believed to have been killed during Danafor's complete annihilation.

131564.description: Vivian is an enigmatic Holy Knight once directly serving under Great Holy Knight [Hendrickson](https://anilist.co/character/86679/Hendricksen) and used to be an apprentice of [Merlin](https://anilist.co/character/89180/Merlin), the Boar's Sin Gluttony. Vivian is regarded as the kingdom of Liones' greatest mage.

131565.description:
The eleventh king of Liones and father of Elizabeth.

He was held captive after the Seven Deadly Sins were framed for killing the great holy knight Zaratras.

131567.description: Gustaf is a Ruby ranked Holy Knight and Jericho's older brother.

131618.description:
Igarashi is a short young adult woman of a relatively slender build and is often confused for a child. Because of this, she gets treated like one which annoys her. She usually has her shoulder-length green hair tied in a ponytail and forest green eyes. She can be seen in a suit in the office area.

From the moment she met her senpai Takeda, she gradually gets annoyed at everything he does and says. Takeda annoys her all the time with the things he says, his laugh, his size, and the way he pats her head. However, in time her feelings for him started to be romantic, although she doesn't want to confess it to herself.

131619.description:
Sakurai Touko is one of the secondary characters in My Senpai is Annoying. Sakurai is a young adult woman with long black hair. She has a mole under her right eye.

She is a senpai at Igarashi Futaba's company and is very popular among male employees because of her looks and friendly personality. She works alongside Igarashi and has a secret crush on Kazama Souta.

131620.description:
Takeda Harumi is one of the main characters in My Senpai is Annoying. He is a senpai to a junior employee at a company who finds him annoying. He is reliable but dense.

Takeda is a large well build man with short black hair. Takeda is a nice man who gladly helps out his coworkers. He is in charge of Igarashi and will always try his best to support and help her, and will even apologize to their boss for her mistakes. He cares for her.

131621.description:
Kazama Souta is one of the secondary characters in My Senpai is Annoying. He is a senpai at Igarashi Futaba's company.

Kazama is a young adult with short black hair, who can be seen in a white button-up shirt with black working pants and occasionally, a blue necktie. Kazama is boring and gives a boring look, and seemingly doesn't have many friends. He prefers to spend the New Year alone playing video games. He also has a hobby of making origami. His ears are sensitive.

131622.description: Natsumi Kurobe is a childhood friend of Futaba Igarashi since middle school. She genuinely cares about her friends, but likes practical jokes.

131650.description: Nise was bullied and neglected by classmates and family alike. Thus, she learned to not trust anyone. This behaviour reached extreme heights when she reached this world, turning her into a seemingly cold-blooded killer, that is, until she met [Yuri Honjo](https://anilist.co/character/127441/Honjou-Yuri).

131651.description: Shinzaki Kuon is a God Candidate. She is sometimes referred to as the Railgun User.

131653.description:
Sniper Mask also known as the "White Grim Reaper"
~!After Kuon Shinzaki's "death" her powers were transfered to him. Becoming a God Candidate.!~

~!His real name is Yuuka Makoto (誠勇火).!~

131712.description:
Harutora's homeroom teacher. A fairly quirky fellow who tends be more laid back then one would expect from a teacher, to the point where some would accuse him of being irresponsible. Despite that, he's usually good at giving solid advice to students and is known activist against the school's harsh policies when comes to education. He lost his leg in a clash with Ashiya Douman and now has a prosthetic leg. He was a former Magic Investigator and Divine General nicknamed "The Shadow" who worked under Daizen Amami to investigate the Twin Horn Syndicate until he gave his resignation and started working as a homeroom teacher of Onmyo Preparatory School in order to observe and protect Natsume.

(Source: Wikipedia)

131779.description:
Kaede is a kind girl who meets [Ren](https://anilist.co/character/122894) in the human world. Humbled by his kindness, yet baffled by his horrible Japanese, she offered to tutor him for free and they became good friends.

~!At the climax of the show, she is protected by Ren from Ichirouhiko, and later shows up in the beast world to support Ren in the end!~

131810.description:
Yuusha is a young girl who became a platinum-ranked adventurer after defeating the Demon Lord.
Along with her party, she battles the Demon Lord's forces and other powerful threats.

- In the light novel Yuusha has dark cyan-colored eyes and long black hair, with a single strand pointed upward.

131811.description:
An adventurer who was a member of a party of steel-ranked adventurers. He is a greedy and selfish individual who attempts to keep up a friendly facade. 
~!However, when he loses his composure, he is willing to kill people to vent his frustrations.!~

131812.description:
Race: Human
Job: Adventurer
Rank: Silver
Affiliation: Adventurer's Guildis 

A silver ranked adventurer. He is currently acting as an instructor teaching new adventurers basic combat.

131813.description:
His family runs a dairy farm just outside of town for several generations. When his younger sister married, she moved out of the Dairy Farm to her husband's village, leaving him the sole heir to the farm.

He is the uncle of Cow Girl and the landlord of Goblin Slayer.

131815.description:
A former adventurer who retired after her disastrous first quest.
~!Along with two of her friends, they decided to become adventurers. They recruited Priestess to be part of their party before taking on a goblin slaying quest. As they entered the caves, they are ambushed by goblins who critically injure Wizard and maul Warrior to death. She tells Priestess to take Wizard and leave her to fend off the goblins. She easily took down some of the goblins until the hobgoblin entered the fray, who easily overpowers her. The goblins proceeded to rape her until Goblin Slayer came to her rescue. After the incident, she became traumatized and unresponsive, thus was immediately relinquished from being an adventurer. She was then seen being brought to a temple with the other women who were also captured by the goblins to recover.!~

131817.description:
A spell-casting adventurer who was part of a porcelain-ranked party on a goblin slaying quest.
She had graduated at the top of her class from the academy in the Capital where she had learned her spells.
~!After graduating, she joined a party who decided to take a goblin slaying quest. Entering a cave, they were soon attacked by goblins from side tunnels they had failed to notice and quickly overpower Wizard. In a fit of rage she flailed wildly, but stopped after being stabbed in the abdomen. Unable to save the other party members, Priestess attempted to heal Wizard's wound, but only worsened her condition. When Goblin Slayer arrived, he revealed that the dagger she was stabbed with was poisoned. Wizard begged him to kill her, which Goblin Slayer obliged.!~

131818.description: One of the Demon Lord's sixteen generals. Ogre was arrogant and vicious, shown when he told Goblin Slayer's party that they will all die with certainty. He also cared nothing for the goblins he had made his subordinates. However, Ogre shared the sadism of the goblins, as he had confined an elf for use a plaything.

131819.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Job:__ Adventurer
__Title:__ Paladin+__Affiliation:__ Adventurer's Guild

She is a young woman with long blonde hair and is clad in white body-fitting armor and a cape, although the anime shows the former to be grey with gold bits.

131889.description:
Slader was kidnapped and raised as a child by savages who held no regard for his worth as a human. After being freed by the king of Liones he pledged loyalty and resolved to hunt down any who wronged the kingdom.

He is a member of Dawn Roar who holds a rivalry against Gowther of the Seven Deadly Sins.

131891.description:
A holy knight of the weird fangs. Golgius uses underhanded and deceitful tactics in order to get his way. Contracts a doctor to poison Melodidas while holding his daughter hostage and making off with Elizabeth and his sword, also tries to assassinate Melodidas while holding his hands up in surrender.

He has the power of transparency, which he claims to be teleportation

131904.description: Mead is an orphan, adopted by the villagers of Bernia after his parents, who were travelers, became victim to an epidemic when they stopped by Bernia.

131905.description: She is the sister of Luigi. She knows the way into the Capital of the Dead.

131906.description:
Weinheidt was a member from the group of Holy Knights, Dawn Roar and was the marksman of the team.

Weinheidt was a well-built man with a short beard and mustache and wears a set of medieval archer clothing with a small cloak draped around his shoulders.

Like the other Dawn Roar members, Weinheidt was willing to kill anybody for the mission. He was faithful to whatever mission his team is assigned to and doesn't care about the motives behind the mission as long as the job gets done, although he can be curious sometimes.

Despite the Holy Knights' coup, Weinheidt retains his loyalty to the king along with his teammates when Baltra ordered Dawn Roar to stop Slader from hurting himself, to which Weinheidt complied.

131907.description: Friesia is a Holy Knight with the ability to manipulate insects. Belonging to the infamous Weird Fangs stationed at Baste Dungeon, she aided in the capture of the Deadly Sin, Ban.

131908.description: A Holy Knight and father of Guila and Zeal. Although Dale is labeled as a traitor after his disappearance, the incident is shrouded in mystery

131909.description: A Holy Knight, and one of the four Weird Fangs of Baste Dungeon who captured and imprisoned Ban. Jude is known to have tortured Ban mercilessly during the Sin's imprisonment.

131910.description: is a mountain bandit-turned merchant, and a three-time champion of Vaizel's annual fight festival

131911.description: A holy knight of the weird fangs whom wishes to bring ruin to the seven deadly sins. Claims his body is his true armor, and more durable than steel. Hypnotizes both Melodidas and Diane into fighting each other with his bell. Easily defeated by Melodidas after Elizabeth tore the hypnotizing bell off his staff.

131912.description:
Twigo is an apprentice Holy Knight who is stationed near Caines Village. 
~!After his defeat by Meliodas, he, wanting to gain greater powers, drank the demon's blood, but died since he was incompatible.!~

131913.description:
is an elderly doctor who resides in Dalmary Town, and has a daughter named Sennett.
Dr. Dana is a level-headed person and is extremely dedicated to his work as he did not stop "treating" Meliodas even when Friesia was destroying the town.He cares deeply about his daughter as he was willing to even poison Meliodas to have her released from imprisonment

131914.description: Marmas is a Holy Knight. He led Guila and Jericho in the assault on Byzel

131915.description: Alioni is a member of the group of knights, Beard of the Mountain Cat, which was garrisoned at the base of the mountain in Kaynes Village, and claimed to serve under a Holy Knight. He was first seen beside his fellow knights trying to capture to capture the enigmatic and infamous Rust Knight who had appeared at the mysterious bar, the Boar Hat.

131917.description:
is the daughter of an elderly doctor, Dana who works at Dalmary Town.
Sennett is a polite and caring person. She loves her father very much, and was worried about him when she left; she was extremely happy when he is revealed to be alive.She also cares about her dagger as it is a memento of her mother

name.native: ルーシー・モード・モンゴメリ

132222.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

A member of Ability User Society "Fellowship of The Guild." 

Her ability is known as "Anne of Abyssal Red".

~!She helped [Atsushi](https://anilist.co/character/89197/Nakajima-Atsushi) escape the Guild because they bonded over their past trauma and loneliness.!~

132230.description: Kazuki Yasaka, a second-year middle school student. He used to love soccer and used to have a bright personality. ~!Due to the feeling of guilt of causing his step-brother to lose his ability to walk in an accident, he desperately seeks redemption in the form of "connecting with his brother" by crossdressing and pretending to be Azuma Sara, a local idol and his brother's favorite idol and talk to him everyday without fail through "Lucky Item Selfies".!~

132231.description: Kazuki's childhood friend. When they were in a soccer club together, they were called the "Golden Combo". ~!He's secretly in love with Kazuki, he even goes as far kissing him while he's asleep.!~

132232.description: A second-year middle school student who transferred into Kazuki's class. Introduced as a gloomy, rowdy delinquent on the neighborhood, he met with Azuma Sara on the day of his transfer, trying to break into a car.

132241.description: Yuna is one of the main characters in B: The Beginning. She is the childhood love of Koku and the reason behind what Koku does as Killer B.

132264.description: He was raised by Maquia after losing his mother as a baby.

132265.description: Barou is a half-Iorphian traveling merchant who helps Maquia on a few occasions.

132266.description: She used to live in the same village as Ariel.

132267.description: Maquia is a 15-year-old Iorphian orphan. She adopts Ariel after her country is destroyed in an attack by the Mezarte nation.

132268.description: Lang lived with his younger brother Diol and mother Mido in a cottage in the countryside for most of his adolescent life. In his adulthood, he enlisted in the Mezarte Kingdom as a soldier and later rose to the ranks of Commander.

132269.description: Krim is an Iorphian. After the Mezarte Kingdom’s assault on the Irorphian land, he became cold and calculating yearning to get back Leilia but also have revenge against the kingdom that took her from him.

132270.description: Izol is the Chief of the Mezarte army. He is in charge of Leilia's safety.

132271.description: Leilia is an Iorphian who is kidnapped by the Kingdom of Mezarte and forced to produce an heir.

132285.description: Aoi and Hinata's classmate. She is good friends with Mio and Kasumi.

132287.description: Aoi and Hinata's classmate. She is good friends with Yuri and Kasumi.

132303.description: Captain of the soft tennis club, he was the only one on the team who earnestly tried to play in matches until he recruited Maki to be his partner.

132304.description:
A transfer student, as well as a part-time worker, and the son of Aya Katsuragi and the latter’s ex-husband, Kenji Kyobate. Despite having no past experience in soft tennis, he joins the Shijo Minami Junior High boys’ soft tennis club and is quickly discovered to have a natural talent for the sport. He plays as the front player with Toma Shinjo as his partner. 

(Source: Stars Align Wiki)

132443.description: Jīya is the butler of the Ouno resident, and the driver serving Ouno Akira. He shows very deep feelings for Akira, being her personal driver for many years. He goes out of his way to bring Ono to arcades around the town, even going as far as to defend her against her strict tutor.

132445.description:
__Appearance:__ Makoto is a college student who almost looks like her younger sister Akira, except her hair is a bit more curly, and her face is very similar to Akira’s.

__Personality:__ She is like the polar opposite of Akira. She's loquacious, carefree, and a little bit of a tomboy. She makes it no secret that she dislikes the parenting of her family and frequently runs away from Gōda Moemi, to the point that Moemi decides to give up on Makoto.

132494.description:
__Type:__ YoRHa B-Type (Battle model)
__Affiliation:__ YoRHa Soldiers
__Height:__ 168 cm (heels incl.)

An all-purpose battle android deployed as a member of the YoRHa Soldiers and dispatched to the surface for the 243rd Descent Operation. She specializes in close-quarters combat. She tries to follow YoRHa's regulations that emotions are prohibited, and even amongst androids of the same type, 2B is comparatively cool, calm, and collected.

132576.description:
Saionji is an employee for WacDonalds.  She works part-time at a public pool as a pool-attendant as well.

Saionji is an eager worker and enthusiastic about her job. She is easily unnerved and misunderstands [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/89787/Tanaka) and [Ohta](https://anilist.co/character/89788/Ohta) due to appearances. However, she finds them interesting due to their contradictory actions.

132615.description:
He was born mutated because the normal cell who grew him made a copying error in his DNA. His mutation causes him to appear different from normal cells and to replicate uncontrollably, causing potentially deadly cancer.
~!He was killed by U-1146 twice. It is still uncertain whether he will remain dead or return.!~

132708.description:
Having lived a long life, the Goblin Lord fancies himself as being far more cunning and intelligent than the other Goblins in his forces. To that end, he is willing to sacrifice them for the sake of getting away, knowing he can grow even more clever and resourceful over time.

However, despite his ambition and position as a leader of goblins, he does not care about the others of his kind and views them as dispensable resources. As such, like every goblin, he prioritizes his personal preservation above all else. He loathes begging for his life and bending the knee to any others, especially to humans, and only uses it as a means of getting the upper hand​.

132710.description:
__Age:__ +20
__Race:__ Rhea
__Job:__ Adventurer
__Rank:__ Bronze
__Affiliation:__ Adventurer's Guild - Heavy Warrior's Party

Druid Girl has a kind disposition and is friendly towards others. She tries to give advice to newer adventurers when given the chance.

132729.description: Treyni is a dryad that resides in the Jura Forest.

132753.description: One of the children who were incompletely summoned. Ryouta has a shy personality, but he generally gets along well with [Kenya](https://anilist.co/character/132751/Misaki-Kenya).

132847.description:
Yue is a vampire who was imprisoned in the abyss. She was betrayed by her uncle and peers because of her monstrous magic and regeneration that made her nearly immortal.

With a fateful encounter, Yue met [Hajime](https://anilist.co/character/132848/Nagumo-Hajime) in a sealed room in the abyss. After being rescued, Yue was the person who suppressed Hajime's madness before he became a monster and she soon became Hajime's "special" person after what transpired in the Abyss.

Her appearance was described to be like the highest grade bisque doll with blonde hair and crimson eyes. She is 323 years old despite her small physique because she is a Vampire Princess. Her name Yue isn't her real name and was only given by Hajime so that she could leave her dark past and move on.

~!Her real name is Aleytia.!~

132848.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

Hajime was a complete otaku and always came to class with a sleepy expression. He was always bullied and was disliked by both of his male and female classmates for being close to their idol-like classmate [Kaori](https://anilist.co/character/132849). After wishing for his annoying classmates to be summoned to another world, the next thing he saw was they were on top of a pillar like structure in another world to become heroes.

He obtained the job of "Synergist" and continued to be bullied due to also being weak in this new world. He eventually fell into an abyss due to being hit by a classmate's fireball where he survived though a hell-like environment to become the powerful man he is today.

Hajime at the beginning of the story is said to have black hair and also has a slim body. He also had a kind face and attitude. But after falling in the abyss and eating a wolf-like monster, his body began to violently degenerate. When he drunk the sacred water, it made his body heal by destroying his bones and muscles then healing over and over again until he got a very muscular body due to overcompensation.

Due to the stress of breaking and healing, his hair turned white, a victim of the Marie Antoinette syndrome. His eyes also turned red and his body gained tattoo-like red lines which is the sign of him becoming a demonic monster similar to the monsters he ate that also possessed red lines along their bodies.

His personality was at first kind though he was considered incompetent. But after falling in the abyss, he became cruel and would kill any person who wants to cause him misfortune. He would also smile in front of danger which made [Shia](https://anilist.co/character/132850/Haulia-Shia) call him a new species of monster called "Predator." He may be cruel but he cares for his comrades.

132856.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Hibiki Sakura is the main protagonist. As Hibiki struggles with her hobby of devouring all types of food, she'd realize that her body weight has been increasing very significantly due​ to her eating habit.

132857.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
 
Like all women in her family, Akemi has a muscle fetish, and she is way more blunt about it than her sister, Shion. She tells Hibiki that she chose to join the Silverman Gym in order to live a healthy life. By her own account, she was never really interested in anything before she discovered her love of muscles.

She is unaware of how impressive her life is compared to the average person, as it is completely normal to her.

132858.description: Satomi is a history teacher at Koyo Women's Academy and joins the Silverman Gym shortly after Hibiki and Akemi. She is secretly a famous cosplayer who uses the alias Yuria Riko.

132859.description: Machio is a personal trainer and bodybuilder of the Silverman Gym in Japan. He has well-defined muscles and likes flexing them. Due to his enormous muscle sizes he rips off his clothes when posing.

132860.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
A Russian girl that moved to Japan to study abroad.

132920.description:
He is the firstborn of his noble family, and was considered to be the next head of his family until he was ostracized and cast out of his family for being cursed.

As the single possessor of a curse that allows him to unintentionally kill any living thing with a single touch, he lives alone in a decrepit mansion located deep within a forest with his servants, [Alice](https://anilist.co/character/132921/Lendrott-Alice) and [Rob](https://anilist.co/character/132924/Rob).

name.native: アリス・レンドロット

132921.description: Alice is a maid who assists the protagonist of the story, [Duke](https://anilist.co/character/132920/Bocchan), with his daily life. She is responsible for maintaining Duke's mansion and helping him with his day-to-day functions along with the family butler, [Rob](https://anilist.co/character/132924/Rob).

132922.description:
Viola is [Duke](https://anilist.co/character/132920/Bocchan)'s younger sister.

Viola is the youngest child in the family and is in love with [Rob](https://anilist.co/character/132924/Rob), Duke's servant. She loves old men and sweets.

132924.description: An old butler that was sent to serve the [Duke](https://anilist.co/character/132920/Bocchan) in his solitary, alongside [Alice](https://anilist.co/character/132921/Lendrott-Alice).

132948.description:
A back alley psychiatrist who tries to rehabilitate carnivorous animals that crave meat. The wounds on his face were made by violent patients. 

Despite his gruff appearance and rough character, he's gentle and caring.

132972.description: Musashi Goda is a student of Salt Middle School and the Body Improvement Club's President. Musashi has a strong sense of justice but strongly disagrees with senseless violence

133040.description: Chiharu is Mayuta's younger sister. She loves her older brother dearly and is in search of the women who made him quit his gang. Also has a questionable habit of trying to poke other peoples backsides

133041.description:
__Type:__ YoRHa S-Type (Scanner model)
__Affiliation:__ YoRHa Soldiers
__Height:__ 160 cm

Of the YoRHa Aircraft Soldiers, he specializes in exploration and research. His main role is collecting information, but by making full use of his hacking, he also supports combat models like [2B](https://anilist.co/character/132494). Due to his role and characteristics, he is full of curiosity. Amongst androids of the same type, 9S is comparatively varied in his emotional expressions.

133103.description:
The landlady of the apartment complex Jahy resides in. Her sister is the owner of the restaurant Jahy works at.

She is ready to resort to violence in order to get her rent and, unlike her sister, is ready to throw Jahy on the streets at any moment. However, the landlady fears her sister, a fact that Jahy sometimes abuses.

133104.description:
Former denizen of the Dark Realm.

As Jahy's loyal servant, she is willing to anything and everything for her master.

133105.description:
The owner of the restaurant Jahy works at. Her sister is the landlady of the apartment Jahy lives in.

She is a nice person who cares for Jahy. She tends to call Jahy "Hy-chan," even though Jahy tells her otherwise. When she found out that Jahy can transform, she found Jahy to be even more cute. She isn't afraid of Jahy and instead sympathizes with her situation.

133203.description: Mukai is an esper and a former member of Claw. She was the youngest member of the upper echelon called "Scar".

133204.description: Toichiro is an extremely powerful esper and the founder and leader of Claw.

133205.description: Kaito is an esper, the twin brother of [Daichi Shiratori](https://anilist.co/character/133206/Shiratori-Daichi), and one of the children who was invited to the Awakening Lab.

133206.description: Daichi is an esper, the twin brother of [Kaito Shiratori](https://anilist.co/character/133205/Shiratori-Kaito), and one of the children who was invited to the Awakening Lab.

133207.description:
Shouchou was a spirit who appeared early on in the anime adaptation.
He was the leader of a biker gang. They all died while riding through Honeido Tunnel when the rider at the front slipped on a banana peel and caused an explosive pile-up

133208.description: Terada is an esper and a former member of Claw. He was part of the upper echelon called "Scar".

133230.description: She is a feminine-presenting classmate who the Pastimers suspect of actually being male, leading them to go to great lengths to uncover Tsugumi's true identity. Tsugumi keeps their identity ambiguous and enjoys teasing the club in return.

133231.description: A rich guy who transferred schools so people wouldn't look at him for his wealth. He becomes [Shifen](https://anilist.co/character/127630/Shi-Fen) and [Kaixin](https://anilist.co/character/127629/Zhen-Kaixin)'s friend.

133276.description: A classmate who started talking to Haruki, since meeting Haruki and Sakura. For some reason, he offers a piece of gum to Haruki whenever they talk.

133277.description: Class representative who is in love with Sakura. He is very obstinate and gets jealous easily yet hides it to keep face with his classmates.

133333.description: Kazuya Souma is the main male protagonist of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series. He is an earthling who was summoned to another world as a hero, but with the accurate announcement of the previous king, Albert Elfrieden, he became the King of Elfrieden Kingdom and to avoid rebellions of people thinking Kazuya has usurped the throne, the king gives his daughter's hand in marriage to Kazuya. Because Kazuya introduced himself to others using the Japanese form of family-name/surname first, most people in the Kingdom think that "Souma" is his given name, thus referring to him as "King Souma". Only a few know that "Kazuya" is his given-name, while "Souma" is his family-name.

name.native: アイーシャ・ウドガルド

133334.description:
Daughter of the Chief of the Dark Elves of the God Protected Forest. One of the 5 people discovered during the gathering of Gifted People after winning the Martial Competition. Serves as Souma's bodyguard after he teaches the Dark Elves how to save their forest and gradually falls deeply in love with him. She is often compared to an animal as she's very food motivated and loyal.


~!Becomes Souma's second fiancée in recognition for her actions in the war against the hostile Principality of Amidonia. In volume 6 she fights alongside Naden and Souma to save the dragons from a mysterious futuristic cube.!~

name.native: リーシア・エルフリーデン

133336.description:
__Race:__ Human

Liscia Elfrieden is the main female protagonist of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series. She was the princess of Elfrieden, the daughter of the previous king, [Albert Elfrieden](https://anilist.co/character/237299/Elfrieden-Albert), and the first primary queen of Freidonia as the tentative fiancée of [Souma](https://anilist.co/character/133333/Souma-Kazuya).

133337.description: Juna Doma is one of the female protagonist of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series. She is the granddaughter of [Excel Walter](https://anilist.co/character/214660/Walter-Excel).

133338.description:
__Race:__ Mystic Wolf

Tomoe Inui is a recurring character of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series.

(Source: Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki Wiki)

133342.description:
__Race:__ Human

Roroa Amidonia is one of the female protagonist of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series. She is the daughter of Gaius Amidonia and the younger sister of Julius Amidonia.

(Source: Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki Wiki)

133377.description: She is Hawk's mother and the extremely large, green pig who transports the Boar Hat bar. She is introduced to live underground and transports the bar Boar Hat with her head. So far, her name remains unknown but she has gained many aliases.

133381.description: He is the president of the student council at Salt Middle School.

133383.description: He was a spirit who appeared early on in the series. He was the first ghost to appear and be exorcized.

133384.description: He is part of the Body Improvement Club and a student of Salt Middle School.

133385.description: He is a student of Salt Middle School and a member of the Body Improvement Club.

133388.description:
Takenaka is originally introduced as an image-conscientious character pushed into the Telepathy Club similarly to Mob. However, once it is revealed that he is a Telepath, he is shown to be standoffish despite his humor and tendency to tease others. He feels lonely given his telepathy and is overwhelmed by the consciousness of society.

~!Takenaka had previously filled a gap in the Telepathy Club to maintain the minimum number of members needed for the club. He had no interest in the club or in telepathy. He worried about how people looked at him because of his club membership, so he decided to leave the club. As a result of him leaving the club, Tome Kurata had to find a new member to keep the club open. He is later revealed to have joined the tennis club.

In chapter 98 he is revealed to be a telepath. He returned to their former club room investigate the telepathic ringing generated by Mob and Shiratori brothers. He is subsequently recruited to help contact extraterrestrial life, although he only joins out of obligation.

Later, he is revealed to have actually memorized the summoning formation and incantation despite knowing it to be a hoax, as he didn't want to ruin their memory. He proceeds to spend his New Years' with the others after successfully coming into contact with alien lifeforms.!~

133420.description: Known as "War Nurse" due to her power based on healing techniques, Kurumi was part of the Magical Five, the group of five magical girls that saved humanity from the beasts of the Netherworld three years ago. She now works as a Magical Warfare Research Officer in the 2nd Research Division of the JGSDF.

133425.description: Tamara Volkova is a Magical Girl with the designation of Phoenix who works for the United Nations (formerly the Russian Military) and is one of the surviving Magical Girls from the Distonian War, the 'Magical Five'.

133426.description: Known as "Rapture," Asuka is the former leader of the Magical Five, the group of five magical girls that saved humanity from the beasts of the Netherworld three years ago. Due to the scars that the life on the battlefield left on her, she vows to never become a magical girl again and to live a peaceful life away from war.

133459.description:
She is named after the .410 Winchester shotgun. Chiester 410 wears a blue uniform and has short teal hair. Unlike Chiester 45, 410 has a childish, silly smile on her face most of the time. Her duty is the main sniper using the information from Chiester 45.
~!She is the fantasy version of one of the ceramic bunnies that Maria used to play with.!~

133461.description:
She is named after the "00 buck" shotgun load. Chiester 00 wears a black uniform and has long blonde hair. She has an eyepatch over her left eye, and her left bunny-ear has a scar. As the leader of the summoned Chiesters, She is very composed and serious in her work. She is in charge of guard and recon. 
~!She is the fantasy version of one of the ceramic bunnies that Maria used to play with.!~

133550.description: Metori Saiko is the scion of the top-notch Saiko Conglomerate. He later transfers to PK Academy after falling in love with [Kokomi](https://anilist.co/character/90109/Teruhashi-Kokomi) when he was in the city. His defining traits are being rich and smug.

name.native: チューズデイ・シモンズ

133660.description:
__Singing Voice:__ [Celeina Ann](https://anilist.co/staff/139883/Celeina-Ann)

Tuesday is a kind, somewhat airheaded daughter of a prominent politician. She ran away from home with her Gibson acoustic guitar to become a musician. She's from Mars.

name.native: キャロル・ステンリー

133661.description:
__Singing Voice:__ [Nai Br.XX](https://anilist.co/staff/139884/Nai-BrXX)

An outgoing orphaned girl from Earth trying to survive in Alba City by working multiple (short-lived) part-time jobs, while pursuing her dream of becoming a musician.

name.native: アンジェラ・カーペンター

133662.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Singing Voice:__ [Alisa](https://anilist.co/staff/144934/Alisa)

A famous model and child actress from Mars working with Tao to become a singer.

At first, she seems childish and selfish, and seemingly only wants to become a singer because being she finds being a model and actor is "boring". She speaks very rudely to her managers, degrading them and often firing them very quickly. Though she does what she does for the people, and her mother wants her to become a singer, so she is to please her. Angela wants her mother to finally accept her, and appears genuinely happy when people cheer for her debut song.

~!It is revealed that Dahlia is not her real mother, although Angela did not know this until Dahlia confessed it to her with their dying breath. Tao eventually tells her that he and Angela don't have real parents: they were genetically engineered by a professor who is now in prison for it. Tao was the professor's first creation, and Angela was the second.!~

133663.description:
Music producer responsible for a record number of contemporary hits. The full profile is classified.
~!In episode 24, it was revealed that he is a child genetically engineered by professor Zeeman, who also did the same with Angela.!~

133664.description: Ertegun is a self-obsessed famous DJ and music producer from Mars. He also manages apparel brands.

133665.description: Roddy is a freelance AI programmer and system engineer from Mars. He likes collecting robot figurines, watching Star Trek and mecha anime, and listening to cheesy Vocaloid songs from the old days.

133667.description:
**Height:** 175 cm (5′9″)

Haruki is described as sharp and somewhat rambunctious. He's also incredibly ambitious, putting his all into every piece of work he contributes to and keeping a tight focus on his work, to the point where he's forced to take breaks if found out. Despite his outgoing personality, he still has trouble talking to his crush, and is very similar to her in that they both don't have the courage to confess to one another.
 
When it comes to something he likes, he's said to be constantly criticizing it instead of praising it because he finds it fascinating, in what Yu calls a tsundere fashion. His criticism of Miou's work also stems from that aside from the obvious assistance.

133668.description:
**Height:** 153 cm (5'0")

Miou is very demure as a teenager, making her presence small wherever she goes. Her shyness extends to romantic interactions, particularly with Haruki; she doesn't make any overt gestures of affection to him, but she does show her love passively, like waiting for him so they can walk home every day. Aside from being shy, she's also very fragile; she cries when she thinks that Haruki may like someone else and bursts into happy tears when Haruki returns after seven years.

Compared to her friends, Miou is a lot more self-criticizing. She recognizes that she was not forward with Haruki and does not like that she cannot muster up the courage to push their relationship forwards, but has come to terms with their initially doomed romance.  She gains a more nostalgic perspective on the matter in adulthood.

133669.description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5′2″)

Akari is seen as a beautiful and gentle person. She has a positive personality, trying to make the best of a situation. It surprisingly morphs into a motherly personality around her friends, comforting them when they are heartbroken or being their cheer squad in the background when it comes down to their hopes for the future.

She's also described as a bit of an airhead. Her attitude and thought process towards her work is unusual compared to her peers and friends, something only Haruki seems to share with her. Despite her experience with her friends, she's clueless about what the concept of "love" means to her, leading to her not falling in love until her high school third year, and is ignorant of the feelings of those infatuated with her for that same reason.

133670.description:
**Height:** 183 cm (6′0″)

Saku Akechi serves as Sakuragaoka High School's Japanese teacher. He is considered to be an admirable teacher by most of his students for his cool head and his stoic personality. He has a habit of giving his various students advice whenever they're stuck, many of them koans from various Japanese texts, and applies them to their situations. His laid-back attitude also allows him to approach the students easily.

As a teenager, his personality was comparable to Yu's; while he's still more outwardly put together than his friends, he still was very emotional and enjoyed his time. He also used to tutor Haruki along with playing with him.

In adulthood, he took up a habit of smoking. He's been trying to cut back down on it for personal reasons and because he's a teacher, so he substitutes it with lollipops in between cigarettes.

(Source: Confession Executive Committee Wikia)

133671.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5′10″)

Yu's a boy that gets along easily with boys and girls alike, and is generally seen as a "cool" character. He's not one to anger easily, and keeps a cool head when he's around his more energetic friends. He doesn't wear his emotions on his sleeve, but sometimes they slip out in muted ways.

When it comes down to romance, he does get naturally fixated on [Natsuki](https://anilist.co/character/133673/Enomoto-Natsuki) and watches any potential suitors to her with suspicion. Though he takes his relationship with Natsuki for granted, he is still possessive of her, citing their history as childhood friends as the reason why. He still wants her to come to a decision on relationships without others influencing her.

Because of his experiences with [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/133897/Setoguchi-Hina), [Kotaro](https://anilist.co/character/133900/Enomoto-Kotarou), and Natsuki, he's adopted a nurturing image that reportedly makes him look "more mature".

133672.description:
**Height:** 165 cm (5′5″)

Earnest and straightforward. His feelings are pure, but he tends to get jealous. Since he has a childish face, his friends make fun of him. His nickname "Mochita" comes from combining his name and the word "yakimochi" (jealousy).

Despite being nice, his main insecurity is his possessiveness. He obviously wants the object of his affections to be happy, but he wants to keep her to himself and imagines scenarios where she's either saddened, heartbroken, or made unhappy by somebody else. It heavily comes into conflict with his low self-esteem; despite thinking that he wants her for his own, he doesn't think he's even worthy of a shot with her considering all of the mean and negative thoughts he has on a daily basis.

133673.description:
**Height:** 161 cm (5′3″)

Energetic, passionate, and loud, Natsuki has a very active and tomboyish personality. She's not very good at activities usually considered feminine, like cooking or applying makeup, but she wants to improve at them for herself and for the sake of a relationship with Yu.

She's a very emphatic person, but a lot of the time she's oblivious to the feelings of others. Although in love with Yu, she takes for granted that they've known each other for years and didn't stop to think about his feelings when she hangs out with Koyuki or Haruki. She doesn't think much of Koyuki's intention to take her out to something she likes, thinking that his intentions were completely platonic.

She often compares herself to Miou and Akari in terms of what to be as girls and as fellow artists, given that they're always winning critical reception and Natsuki is very small time. She tries to hold herself to standards she can't reach and doesn't know what she wants out of life. When touching upon subjects with heavy weight to them, she dances around ideas by shifting the conversation to something else, and saves the conversation for a later date.

133676.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'3")

Marin is an extravagant, messy, and while quite mature, she's also clumsy. She isn't very skilled at handiwork. Marin is a cosplayer and a huge otaku, being a fan of magical girl anime and adult video games. 
She is very kind, friendly, cheerful and outgoing. She loves eating but still despite that she manages to maintain her slender figure.

~!Marin realizes she is in love with [Wakana](https://anilist.co/character/133678), and throughout the series, continually does whatever she can to invite him to places and spend time with him.!~

133677.description:
A famous cosplayer that [Marin Kitagawa](https://anilist.co/character/133676) looks up to. 

Her younger sister is [Shinju](https://anilist.co/character/207937/Shinju-Inui).

133678.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Hobbies:__ Hina Dolls

Wakana Gojou is a fifteen-year-old high-schooler who is not very social, and doesn't fit in well with his fellow classmates, leading to him having no friends at the start of the story. Gojou has a strong appreciation for hina dolls and loves making them, although he is not as skilled as he wants to be. This changes when Gojou ends up meeting someone who doesn't find his love for doll making weird, and instead is amazed at his artistic ability and craftsmanship.

133699.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 183 cm
__Occupation:__ Curse User
__Grade:__ Special Grade Curse User
__Cursed Technique:__ Cursed Spirit Manipulation

Suguru Getou is an antagonist in both the Jujutsu Kaisen series and its prequel Jujutsu Kaisen 0: Jujutsu High. 

~!He was originally a student of [Masamichi Yaga](https://anilist.co/character/189237/Yaga-Masamichi)'s alongside [Satoru Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691/Gojou-Satoru) and [Shoko Ieiri](https://anilist.co/character/158154/Ieiri-Shouko) at Tokyo Jujutsu High. His experiences as a jujutsu sorcerer bred a deep hatred for non-sorcerers, leading to an incident where Suguru massacred over a hundred civilians in a single night, later being expelled from Jujutsu High and called for immediate execution as a result.!~

133700.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer, Student
__Affiliation:__ Tokyo Jujutsu High
__Grade:__ Grade 3 Sorcerer

She is a first-year student and grade 3 jujutsu sorcerer at Tokyo Jujutsu High studying under [Satoru Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691) alongside [Yuji](https://anilist.co/character/127212) and [Megumi](https://anilist.co/character/126635).
 
Nobara is a confident and brash young woman with an unshakable character. More than anything, Nobara is determined to stay true to herself no matter what. She takes great pride in being both a pretty girl and a strong fighter, refusing to let anyone influence her.

Initially, Nobara can appear to be a very obnoxious and arrogant person. She first introduced herself to Yuji and Megumi by expressing how inferior they were. She also argued with Yuji for the greater part of their first mission together. Despite her abrasive attitude, Nobara is actually an incredibly caring and dutiful person, but would never let most people see that side of her. After fighting alongside each other in several missions, Yuji and Megumi grow to become Nobara's closest allies.

133701.description:
__Species:__ Human, Reincarnated Sorcerer

According to the legend, Sukuna was a demon with four arms and two faces who lived in the golden era of sorcery 1000 years ago. Sorcerers of the era gave their all to defeat him, but to no avail. Without ever being defeated, his body was split into 20 separate indestructible cursed objects, which allowed him to live on and traverse the ages to come. In 2018, [Yuuji Itadori](https://anilist.co/character/127212/Itadori-Yuuji) consumed one of the aforementioned cursed objects, and Sukuna was reincarnated. 

~!In reality, Sukuna was not a demon, but rather a deformed human sorcerer. His body was able to be split up into 20 cursed objects because he received assistance from [Kenjaku](https://anilist.co/character/289584).!~

Sukuna is hedonistic and has no regard for the suffering of others, believing that suffering is natural for the weak. He is selfish, and always wants to stay in control of the situation without caring about the consequences.

133702.description:
__Grade:__ Special Grade
__Cursed Technique:__ Idle Transfiguration

Mahito is one of the primary antagonists of the Jujutsu Kaisen series. He is a Cursed Spirit allied with [Suguru Getou](https://anilist.co/character/133699/Getou-Suguru), [Jougo](https://anilist.co/character/156991/Jougo), [Hanami](https://anilist.co/character/172743/Hanami) and several others. Their ultimate goal is the eradication of humanity and ultimately replacing the population with Cursed Spirits.

133704.description:
__Height:__ 184 cm (6'0½")
__Occupation:__ Sorcerer
__Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High
__Grade:__ Grade 1 Sorcerer
__Cursed Technique:__ Ratio

He is a Grade 1 Jujutsu Sorcerer and a Tokyo Jujutsu High alumni. 

Nanami is a very intelligent and reserved man who at first appears to be someone who is just very serious about his work. He knows how to separate sentimentalism from service and claims he's only a Jujutsu Sorcerer because it's slightly less idiotic than regular careers. As one of [Yuji's](https://anilist.co/character/127212/Yuji-Itadori) mentors, Nanami is a complete contrast to [Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691/Satoru-Gojou), who is far more outspoken and easy-going.

133722.description: The slave dealer that sells Naofumi Iwatani many slaves. He also conducts slave and monster seal rituals. Despite his appearance and his trade, he is an honest salesman. Upon Naofumi’s request, he searches for and collects slaves who were former villagers of Raphtalia’s village

name.native: オルトクレイ＝メルロマルク３２世

133723.description:
The king of Melromarc. He shows obvious favoritism towards his daughter [Malty](https://anilist.co/character/129808) and animosity towards the Shield Hero [Naofumi Iwatani](https://anilist.co/character/88817).
~!
It was revealed that Aultcray is the Wand Hero who led his country in a war against demi-humans and beastmen. Through that experience, he holds hatred towards non-human species and promotes the idea of human supremacy in Melromarc. He shows biased hatred towards Naofumi because the Shield Hero is revered as the protector of demi-humans and beastmen.

When Queen Mirelia Q Melromarc comes back to Melromarc after resolving diplomatic issues, she strips Aultcray of his authorities due to his ineptitude to properly lead the people and officially changed his name to Trash as punishment for his abuse of power.!~

~!The king's real name was Luge Lances Forbrey and used the alias Luge Lancarose to hide the fact that he was of royal blood when he battled in the front lines during the war. The name Aultcray Melromarc XXXII was adopted when he married Mirelia and became king.

He was the third legitimate heir to the throne of Forbrey, but lost that privilege when the Hakuko race killed his parents and loved ones. Due to that fact that Forbrey did nothing to retaliate against the Hakuko residing in Siltvelt due to political reasons, Luge began to despise both countries and moved to the human supremacy-promoting country of Melromarc. He later challenged and defeated the Hakuko king.!~

133724.description: Erhard is a blacksmith and a weapon shop owner in the castle town of Melromarc. His shop is the only shop in Melromarc to sell shields while others don't for religious reasons.

133744.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")
__Instrument:__ .strandberg* Boden J6 RAS LOCK Caribbean Light Blue Guitar

A first year high-school student at Haneoka Girls' High School. She goes by the moniker LOCK as the guitarist for the band RAISE A SUILEN. She is a Poppin'Party fan. Rokka usually wears large glasses, but takes them off when she performs.

She is from Gifu Prefecture. She attends Haneoka instead of Hanasakigawa, the closer school, due to Haneoka's scholarship program. She in the same class as Asuka and Ako. Rokka works at Galaxy Live House, as well as her relative's bath house where she lives.

Ever since she was at elementary school, Rokka failed at everything she tried, including her studies. Playing guitar was the only thing she had worked hard at. Because of that, she formed a band with her fellow schoolmates Toriko, Berry, and Pat (all monikers). However, after Rokka went to see SPACE live house's last show in Tokyo, she fell in love with Poppin'Party (who performed their song "Mae e Susume!" there) and began dreaming of moving to Tokyo. Rokka's middle school band disbanded when she was finally able to move to Tokyo and make her dream come true.

Her father was at first against her decision to study in Tokyo, but Rokka persuaded him by finding a place to live and a school that offered a scholarship that made the tuition cheaper than that her local high school's. After intense studying and hard work, Rokka later passed Haneoka High School's entrance exam and moved to Tokyo.

133817.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm

Director of Tokyo City Esperion FC Youth, and Head Coach of the A Team. He was born in Ehime, Japan but moved to Tokyo to attend high school. He joined Tokyo City Esperion FC of the J-League (Japan's top professional football league) at the age of 18 and became a regular at 20. At 23 he was signed by the Spanish club Sabadell FC who had been recently promoted to Spain's top division, La Liga. A while later, his mother married [Hana Ichijou](https://anilist.co/character/162035/Hana-Ichijou)'s father and he became her step-brother. Fukuda happens to meet [Ashito](https://anilist.co/character/133818/Ashito--Aoi) in Ehime, discovers his talent, and invites him to try out for Esperion Youth.

133818.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__ Jersey Number:__ 33
__Position:__ FW ~!DF!~

Ashito is a brash and naïve kid from a remote prefecture called Ehime who has dreams of becoming the world's greatest forward. He currently lives in Tokyo as a first year high school student and member of Tokyo City Esperion FC.

133823.description: Brother of [Hyakkimaru](https://anilist.co/character/14864/Hyakkimaru) and the second son (successor) of [Kagemitsu Daigo](https://anilist.co/character/33887/Daigo-Kagemitsu). Born after Hyakkimaru was abandoned.

133825.description: Mio is a young girl who lived in an abandoned temple with orphans who lost their parents in the war. She is kind and caring as she tends to put others in priority instead of herself.

133835.description:
__Race:__ Human-Mutant
__Abilities:__ Regeneration
__S-Class:__ Rank 8
__Affiliation:__ Hero Association

__Personality:__ Zombieman is stated to be nihilistic, possibly due to the fact that he has "died" several times, therefore he is always calm. In addition, he prefers to work as a lone wolf and dislikes gathering, although he still respects common courtesy. However, he appears to have a sadistic side, since he enjoys killings that create rivers of blood, he is also shown to be a rather smart individual, with detective-like thinking. In comparison to the other S-Class heroes, Zombieman is more thoughtful and respectful.

__Abilities__: Zombieman possesses one of the best regeneration capabilities in the series. He is able to regenerate any part of his body no matter how severe the injury is, and he was able to heal his broken arms in an instant. He needs only a few minutes to recover from an extremely mutilated state and regrow his left arm, however this regeneration does not give Zombieman full immortality, as he will die if he is reduced to mincemeat. Zombieman has an incredible threshold for extensive physical activity, displaying one of the most impressive feats of stamina in the series and being able to fight for hours on end while his expedient recovery rate handles the more serious of injuries he suffers.

133876.description: An alien life form who made a young girl, yuzuka hanami, a magical girl, thus his master. He is often punished for certain things by yuzuka, and punishments include hard scrubbing, a hot pan on the head, and being trapped in water by yuzuka.

133877.description: Yuzuka is a carefree and shy girl living a normal life until she found a creature in a garbage dump who made her a magical girl. However, her magical form is a swimsuit!! She is in middle school and has medium brown hair. She excels at cooking, and her parents are rarely home. Although, she tends to get embarrassed very easily.

134167.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Maki Zenin is the older twin sister of [Mai Zenin](https://anilist.co/character/134168/Mai-Zenin). Maki is a grade 4 sorcerer and a second-year at Tokyo Metropolitan Jujutsu Technical High School. She is from the main branch of the Zenin clan, one of the "Prominent Three Families" of the Jujutsu world.

She left the Zenin family in order to prove herself capable of being a Sorcerer after being deemed uncapable, since she lacks Cursed Energy.

~!Because Mai and Maki are monozygotic twins, their strength is considerably limited to one another. Monozygotic twins are considered as a single individual in the Jujutsu world and are a sign of bad omen.!~

~!After the death of her twin sister Mai, Maki has lost all of her cursed energy and gained a Heavenly Restriction. This causes her skills and human capabilities to be on par with [Toji Fushiguro's](https://anilist.co/character/162722/Touji-Fushiguro).!~

134168.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Mai Zenin is the younger twin sister of [Maki Zenin](https://anilist.co/character/134167/Maki-Zenin). Mai is a grade 3 sorcerer and a second-year at Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School. As a child, Mai always relied on Maki since she was afraid of Cursed Spirits. 

~!Because Mai and Maki are monozygotic twins, their strength is considerably limited to one another. Monozygotic twins are considered as a single individual in the Jujutsu world and are a sign of bad omen.!~

~!In chapter 149, Mai decides to sacrifice herself in order to make Maki stronger.!~

134269.description: Akira Oda is an ordinary high schooler. He lives with his sickly mother and sister. Each time the school ends, he goes to do part time odd jobs to fulfill his family's expenditure. One day, a king of Retice Kingdom from the world called Morigan has Akira and the classmates Summoned to the kingdom to defeat the demon king and protect them from the threat.

name.native: ゴブリンチャンピオン

134322.description: Heroes of the Goblin race; those that have become large enough to even be seen as ogres in terms of strength. They often lack in intelligence, but are capable fighters that can give even veteran adventurers trouble. (Considered to be the silver-ranked among goblins).

134327.description: He is a student in Shuchi'in highschool and always asks [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) for advice about love. [Kashiwagi](https://anilist.co/character/134330)'s boyfriend.

134328.description: Maki is a classmate and friend of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/134330). She has short hair styled in short pigtails. She is friends with Nagisa and is secretly jealous of Nagisa's relationship with her boyfriend, as she too liked Kashiwagi's Boyfriend, but could not confess before. As a branch member of the Shinomiya clan, she is [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649)'s second cousin twice removed so she sometimes refers to Kaguya as "Auntie". [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/121102/Yuu-Ishigami) observe she acts very tsundere (cold on the outside but wanting to be affectionate), and similar to Kaguya in personality. She declares Yuu and Miyuki as her friends, due to their support in helping her process her failed romance, much to Kaguya's horror

134329.description: Moeha is [Chika](https://anilist.co/character/121103)'s little sister who is in junior high. She is the student council vice-president at the junior high. She admires [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) as well and hopes to confess someday. She has a habit of voicing dark ideas, which unnerve [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) a great deal.

134330.description: Nagisa is a classmate who occasionally asks [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) about what to do in her relationships. [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/134327)'s girlfriend.

134425.description: Tsubasa is Juri Yukawa's elder brother and socially withdrawn, refusing to go outside.

134460.description: As his mother, she quietly and protectively watches over Haruki. Though she rarely intervenes, she has very good instincts.

134461.description: Sakura’s best friend since they were little. She is protective of Sakura and will not let anyone who may be harmful near her. Very assertive.

134462.description: A humble and genuinely nice father, whose relationship with Haruki is neither good nor bad. Has a good relationship with his wife.

134463.description: A very kind hearted woman, who strives to grant all of Sakura’s wishes since her daughter’s diagnosis.

134470.description: Holds a leadership position among the Logicalists. Takes a tough attitude towards Yoshichika. Can both study and exercise, and is a serious class president type. Contractor of "Goddess of Love and Beauty, Venus."

134522.description:
Galo Thymos is the Burning Rescue's newest recruit. Set with a burning passion to extinguish all that is wrong, you can expect Galo to rush in first to the scene of an emergency. His 'Burning Soul' is his strongest characteristic.

Galo isn't one for planning ahead of time and often speaks his mind. He is willful and often relies on that to get through battles. While Galo appears to be all brawn and no brain at first, he is actually deeply compassionate and hates to see others hurt. Furthermore, his plans, while odd, have been shown to work. Said plans consistently use the likes of hikeshi and Matoi as a basis such as his first rescue. He also has a heavy interest in Edo period firemen. This has resulted in him giving PowerPoints on the subject and incorporating them into his personal mech.

134523.description: The leader of Mad Burnish. Lio seems like someone who keeps his cool, but it's actually the opposite. Lio aims to burn everything with the power of a special flame called "Burnish Flare".

134524.description: A member of Burning Rescue, in charge of heavy machinery. He's a muscular guy in his 30s, and he's always training his body. He partners with the diminutive Lucia when out on a job.

134525.description: A small mechanic at Burning Rescue. She handles the development and maintenance of Burning Rescue's equipment. She also constructed Galo's Matoi.

134526.description: The captain of Burning Rescue, in his 30s. On missions he makes wise decisions and leads the other members. He trusts his team and they trust him.

name.native: アイナ・アルデビット

134527.description: A member of Burning Rescue who, like Galo, is in her teens. She is cool, calm, and professional at all times, and does things at her own pace. She plays the straight man to Galo and Varys.

name.native: クレイ・フォーサイト

134528.description: The administrator of the Independent Republic of Promepolis and chief director of the Foresight Foundation. He used to research fireproof building materials, but successfully developed an instant-freeze bullet that can put out a Burnish fire. Galo looks up to him.

134529.description: The vice-captain of Burning Rescue. He's a good-looking guy in his 20s, and he is as smart as he looks. He is an indispensable adviser to the captain Ignis.

134538.description: The DJ, who was a member of the Knights.

134539.description:
Chisa Yomoda is Lain's classmate. She's the one that initially gets Lain involved with the Wired.

~!She commits suicide at the beginning of the story and later contacts Lain from within the Wired saying "There was no reason for me to stay in the real world any longer. In the real world, it didn't matter if I was there or not. When I realized that, I was no longer afraid of losing my body."!~
