134560.description: She is Takezou's classmate and joins the koto music club after hearing their first performance. She has knowledge of koto due to the influence of her grandmother. She becomes the koto music club's vice-president.

134561.description: President of koto music club. He's shy and weak in difficult situations. After his failure at the exam, depressed, Takezou saw his senpai's performance, where she was giving her all even though no one listened and koto's string had been broken. He was deeply moved by her performance, so he joined the club. After senpai's graduation, he became an only member of koto music club and had to find strength to protect it.

134562.description:
A math teacher at Tokise High and the Koto Club's advisor.

~!Initially he feigned ignorance of his musical background, though it's later revealed that his parents are world renowned musicians. As a child, he had no interest in playing music whatsoever other than listening to it. When he was seven, his father discovered his talent for writing musical scores and quickly took upon him to brand his son as a child prodigy. Because of this, Suzuka began to disdain music but his interest is later revitalized after becoming the advisor for the Koto club. He often writes pieces for the club as well as gives practice advice, while leaving the actual koto teaching to [Akira](https://anilist.co/character/134569/Doujima-Akira).!~

134566.description: Kota Mizuhara is a second year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club.

134572.description: Tetsuki has been classmates with Chika since middle school. He's worried about his friend, because he knows Chika's circumstances. He seems to be a quiet person, but in reality he shows his true colors when fighting. He comes from wealthy family, his father is the director of a large hospital.

134752.description:
An innocent high school otaku and best friend of [Tsutsui](https://anilist.co/character/83235/Tsutsui--Hikari). He is known for wearing cat ears on his head often causing his classmates to distance themselves from Yuuto. He is a very caring and kind person who supports Tsutsui in every way he can.

Ito is very kind and cares for his friends. He is awkward when meeting new people.

134773.description: Subaru's editor at the publishing company. He tries hard to get Subaru to get out of the house, but often to no avail.

134774.description: Subaru's childhood friend. He often visits unannounced to drop off food for his friend, usually startling Haru.

134775.description: Clerk at Sunny's Pet Store with a fondness for cats. She helps Subaru learn to care for Haru. Has two cats, one of which being Haru's younger brother.

134893.description:
Father of [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Kei Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/126144).

~!His wife left him and their factory shut down leaving him to not have any stable employment.!~

~!He later becomes a youtuber.!~

135016.description:
A gyaru senpai who is a part-time worker and [Sayu](https://anilist.co/character/127925/Sayu-Ogiwara)'s best friend who works in the same part-time job at a convenience store in Tokyo.

(Source: Higehiro Wiki)

135018.description:
__Rank:__ ~!As of now in the Manga, Iruma achieved Rank [5] *He*.!~
__Familiars:__ ~!His very first and only familiar is a demon named [Callego Naberius](https://anilist.co/character/135021/Callego--Naberius), whom he managed to summon in the form of a flying owl in episode 2 of the series.!~

A human boy whose parents sold him to a demon named [Sullivan](https://anilist.co/character/135023), who subsequently transports him to the Demon World and adopts him as his grandson. He starts his new life by being enrolled into Babyls Demon School, where he constantly has to hide the fact that he is a human in order to avoid being eaten. However, after quickly making friends with fellow classmates [Asmodeus](https://anilist.co/character/135022/Alice-Asmodeus) and [Clara](https://anilist.co/character/135019/Clara-Valac), he eventually grows accustomed to his new lifestyle through both his numerous adventures and encounters with other demons.

135019.description:
__Height:__ 153 cm
__Rank:__ ~!As of now in the Manga, Clara has achieved rank [4] *Daleth*.!~
__Familiars:__ ~!Falfal: a green-looking creature that is very eccentric, much like its owner.!~
__Inherited Magic:__ ~!Dimensional pockets: Clara can flawlessly duplicate or conjure any thing or object she has previously seen and pluck it out of one of her skirt pockets.!~

Clara is one of the stranger students at the school, acting very much like an excited child. She has abundant energy that most students can't keep up with. Other students find her weird and hard to deal with, but are drawn to her because her inherited power is so convenient. Since she had no friends, she would give students snacks and drinks as "payment" for playing with her. She is the second friend [Iruma](https://anilist.co/character/135018) made at Babyls.

135020.description:
__Height:__ 190cm
__Rank:__ ~!As of now in the Manga, Ameri has achieved rank [6] *Vav*.!~ 
__Relatives:__ [Merize](https://anilist.co/character/326718) (Mother), [Azazel Henri](https://anilist.co/character/155682/Henri-Azazel) (Father)
__Familiars:__ ~!It is yet unknown.!~ 
__Inherited Magic:__ ~!Romanticist: Ameri can pull out her utmost power by trusting in her own strength, making it the Azazel Family's mightiest buff magic as it releases all of their power without limit. Because it is the greatest kind of self-hypnosis, it may be a double-edged sword that can even harm the user if they are afraid of the opponents they confront.!~

Ameri is the president of Babyls' Student Council. She is convinced humans exist, despite them only being myth in the demon world, and believes [Iruma](https://anilist.co/character/135018) to be one. Ameri hides the fact that she enjoys manga, "the forbidden books of the human world", and has Iruma read them to her in secret.

~!During the Student Council Training Arc is revealed that she is in love with Iruma!~

name.native: アスモデウス・アリス

135022.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Rank:__ ~!As of now in the Manga, Asmodeus has achieved Rank [5] *He*.!~
__Familiars:__ ~!Gorgon Snake: a dragon snake that can manipulate fire.!~
__Inherited Magic:__ ~!Fire Magic: Alice has exceptional and effective control of fire magic. Furthermore, he may utilize it both offensively (through fireballs or a sword made of flames) and defensively (by the ability to make fire barriers). He also gained the ability to produce blue flames, which are thought to be more powerful than his usual flames.!~

Alice Asmodeus is the top student of his class at Babyls. His rank and power exceeds those of most other freshman. For a very short time, he was antagonistic, but later became [Iruma's](https://anilist.co/character/135018) first and closest friend.

135044.description:
Being X is the main antagonist of the Youjo Senki series. It is, in its own words, "God", but [Tanya](https://anilist.co/character/121052) in her first meeting with it labeled it as the devil. Being X is a mysterious being. It claims to be a God, the God of the Bible, the one that gave the 10 commandments to Moses. 

However, there are a number of Gods and Archangels overseeing the world(s), which goes against what is postulated in the First Commandment. Its goal appears to be the increase of the number of faithful people in the world.

135052.description:
She is the sole daughter of [Anson Sioux](https://anilist.co/character/135048).
~!Mary Sioux is one of the main antagonists of the series, the ultimate rival and the tool used by [Being X](https://anilist.co/character/135044) in order to stabilize a neutral war against [Tanya Degurechaff](https://anilist.co/character/121052). After her father's death, she became rather more vengeful and serious. Her hatred grows when she hears the name "Devil of the Rhine," she will begin to rage but resulting exposing herself in a controlless side. She is the only person who can match Tanya von Degurechaff in many battles.
!~

name.native: マテウス・ヨハン・ヴァイス

135058.description: He is the vice captain of the 203rd Aerial Mage Wing, and the captain of the 2nd Aerial Mage Squadron belongs to it.

135073.description:
Kenjirou has a bright and innocent (if not naïve at times) personality. He is very supportive of Yuuri and his opponents during their FS program performances and is shown to be wanting to try new things, such as wanting to try performing a quad even though he has never landed one before. He is also very energetic and can get nervous in stressful circumstances, as seen when he is about to perform his FS program.

Kenjirou treats Yuuri as his idol and strives to be just like him, taking every gesture from Yuuri to heart. He has a habit of letting his emotions get the best of him, especially when he is happy or in the presence of someone he looks up to.

135127.description: He's a captain of the Palace Guard and is married to Hermina. After being introduced to Nobu by a subordinate he becomes a frequent customer.

135128.description: Baron Brentano's servant. A small man.

135129.description: A baron that holds territory and a forest for hunting just outside of the ancient city.

135130.description: Izakaya Nobu's waitress. The daughter of Nobuyuki's former employment. Became a waitress for Izakaya Nobu after running away from an arranged marriage.

135131.description: Rolf and Corona run an inn called “The Flying Wheel” together.

135132.description: A junior Palace Guard in Aithera, he is a regular patron after being introduced to the restaurant by Nikolaus.

135133.description: The owner of Izakaya Nobu. Established the restaurant after he left his former employment. Cooks for customers from the other world.

135135.description: A Palace Guard in Aithera, he introduced his fellow peers to the restaurant.

135136.description: A count. Possesses territory just outside of the ancient city.

135138.description: A waitress at Izakaya Nobu and Berthold's wife, she grew up in a fishing town.

135139.description: A tax collection agent in the ancient city. Famous for squeezing tax money out of even the most resilient of citizens.

135144.description: A dishwasher at Izakaya Nobu, she was hired after she tried to take a water facet on a mistaken pretense.

135146.description: Master of the water transport guild, Water Dragon's Scale. A member of the city council.

135147.description: Head representative of the Backeshof trading company. Chief of the city counsel.

135148.description: Fox spirit maintaining the dimension magic connecting Nobu to the other world.

135151.description: Rolf and Corona run an inn called “The Flying Wheel” together.

135152.description: Master of the water transport guild, Golden Willow Boat. A member of the city council.

135154.description: Honorary meister of the glass crafting guild. Hans' father. A member of the city council.

135155.description: The previous emperor of the ancient city.

name.native: ビスカス . T . バルマス

135197.description:
The highest priest of the Three Heroes Cult. 
~!He used his deep connections in the nation to do away with any opposing authority in the kingdom. He was so narrow-minded that he calls all of his actions "the will of God". He also claims that his followers who died in the fight against the Shield Hero will go to Heaven as a holy reward.

When wielding the replica of the Legendary Weapons, Biscas shows a visible "God complex," as he proclaimed himself God while labeling evil anyone who opposed him. he masterminded many events and tried to kill all of the heroes. He killed the queen's right-hand man who happens to be Eclair's father so that the authority rest with King Aultcray Melromarc XXXII, who was at the time was very gullible and easy to manipulate.!~

135198.description: The queen of Melromarc. She holds the true power of the crown and is generally a just ruler. She is known for her diplomacy and negotiation skills.

135211.description:
A magical creature with the form of a flying penguin. He accompanies Mafuyu.

Source: Wikipedia

135212.description:
Yuzuka’s friend who deems Yuzuka as “most important friend” and truly cares about her; for example, she is on guard against Miton for the good of Yuzuka. She is usually emotionless and speaks in mono-tone voice. She can see and hear Miton, and has the aptitude of a magical girl; however, the limitation in Miton’s capacity prevents her from really becoming one. She is fascinated by Yuzaka’s status and figure as magical girl.

Source: Wikipedia

135213.description:
Another magical girl who is met by Yuzuka and Chiya, and then befriends them. She is one grade higher in school than Yuzuka and Chiya. After she transforms, she is fit into a Santa Claus dress. She can control the size of her bag.

Source: Wikipedia

135214.description:
She is Yuzuka’s acquaintance, and later gets acquainted by Chiya. She is a cute girl, much younger than Yuzaka and Chiya, and behaves very politely and considerately so that she even affects the usually emotionless Chiya. She seems to be able to see and feel Miton.

Source: Wikipedia

135225.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm 

Taka-kun's neighbor and childhood friend. Despite her constant teasing, they're always stuck together.

135227.description:
__Height:__ 196 cm

A high school student feared by his giant stature and scary face, but at heart he is a kind person.

~!Later he marries his teacher and they live together!~

135228.description:
__Height:__ 148 cm (4'8")

Takashi is a first year at Kawanuma-higashi High School and the student council treasurer.

135229.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'6")

He's an 'average' high school student who somehow seems to get into ridiculous situations with his teacher, [Kana Kojima](https://anilist.co/character/135226/Kojima-Kana). He also has zero luck with girls.

135230.description:
__Height:__ 146 cm

A kind teacher revered as a saint by the students of the school. She's small, but has a big bust.

135231.description: Chizuru Tachibana is the 24 year old school nurse at Kawanuma East who is known as "Absolute Zero Tachibana" for her cold and expressionless attitude towards the students.

135232.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'7")

Kou is a 3rd year at Kawanuma-higashi High School.

135259.description:
Height: 187 cm
Weight: 83 kg

He is a teacher at Fujou High who teachers Japanese Classics. Kenji Kazama claims that he's special because he owes his life to him so thats one of the reasons why he attends his class even though he's a delinquent.

He's a very laid back guy that actually allows his students to get away with most things and he just makes an excuse according to the situation to allow them to finish what they were doing. According to Kenji Kazama's entire class and Takao he's awesome!

135263.description: Azuma is the former student council treasurer. She is also the childhood friend of Tama Sakai and Shinsen.

135346.description:
__Occupation:__ Biology researcher

Shuu Hagiwara is a teacher and the ex-boyfriend of [Hina Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana) due to fact that Shuu is married, therefore his relationship with [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana) for the last two years is an illicit affair and he also seems to have a good friendship with [Reiji Kiriya](https://anilist.co/character/135462/Reiji-Kiriya).

Shuu is a friendly and thoughtful person who has a playful side to him, owing to his puppets and ventriloquism skills. According to [Reiji Kiriya](https://anilist.co/character/135462/Reiji-Kiriya), Shuu was constantly sad and fatigued with having to deal with his wife. Because of his unhappy marriage, Shu was ready to take risks with his affair with [Hina Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana). Unfortunately, he has been indecisive on ending the marriage for some time. When he noticed that [Natsuo Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii) was in love with her as well, Shuu was a bit vexed, but nonetheless let [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana) choose between him or [Natsuo](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii).

135347.description:
Tsukiko Tachibana is the mother of [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana) and [Rui Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127596/Rui-Tachibana) who began to date [Akihito Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/135352/Akihito-Fujii) after Jou Mikimoto (Tsukiko's ex-husband) left her for another woman. Tsukiko becomes the stepmother of [Natsuo Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii) after she got married to [Akihito](https://anilist.co/character/135352/Akihito-Fujii).

Tsukiko is a kind and warm woman who is pleasant to be around that she tends to think of others before herself and almost divorces [Akihito Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/135352/Akihito-Fujii) because she thought their marriage put a strain on their children. Again, her cheerful can turn into anger immediately whenever mention of her ex-husband is involved. She has long spoken ill of him to her girls, which had a negative affect on [Rui Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127596/Rui-Tachibana). However, Tsukiko has since been full of joy after meeting [Akihito](https://anilist.co/character/135352/Akihito-Fujii).

135348.description:
__Occupation:__ College student / Ob-gyn

She is a member of the Literature Club and a friend of [Rui Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127596/Rui-Tachibana).

She fits the 'Genki' female archetype in the manga as she is constantly an energetic girl with a bubbly personality who is also incredibly eccentric and overly friendly to some people as shown when she gave [Rui Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127596/Rui-Tachibana) a nickname and one of the dolls from her bag upon their first meeting. As noted by the girls in her class, Momo is also very flirtatious towards boys, flirtations that are rumored have evolved into sexual relations on more than one occasion. She also exhibits a childish side, as shown by her nicknames like "Rui-Rui" and calling sex "making love-love". She has a massive crush on [Natsuo Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii), which has often gone to obsessive extremes like clinging to his arm and feeding him boxed lunches she made without his knowledge. However, beneath her flirtatious and bubbly nature lies deep vulnerability and a possible self-loathing. Her parents have a very bad relationship and they are almost always working, which leaves Momo by herself for nearly whole days on end.
~! As a result of this and her poor relationships with her peers, she once began self-harming. One of the reasons she loves [Natsuo](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii) is due to the fact that despite knowing about her self-harming and her attitudes towards boys, he is still nice to her. !~

~! She has several overlapping scars on her wrist from her "short phase" of self-harm. Very few people, save for her sexual partners and Natsuo have seen them, with the latter being the only one who empathized with her. !~

~! She later falls in love and marries Ritsu Osaka, and has an unnamed daughter by the end of the series. !~

135349.description:
__Hair color:__ Brown
__Occupation:__ Waiter at L'Amant

Fumiya Kurimoto is [Natsuo](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii)'s best friend and confidant. He is a waiter at L'Amant along with [Masaki Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/135548/Masaki-Kobayashi) and Ayano. Kurimoto lives in an apartment with his mother and younger sister. Before high school, he used to attend the same class as [Natsuo](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii) and lived in the same apartment building. He is currently attending Tokyo University with aspirations of becoming a lawyer.

_Appearance:_ Kurimoto has a neatly trimmed professional haircut. He appears stocky, if not more portly compared to [Natsuo](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii), though he is apparently stronger seeing as he tends to get the upper hand when they wrestle each other. He's almost never seen without his glasses.

_Personality:_ Kurimoto cares for [Natsuo](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii) and has his best interests at heart. Kurimoto will always help him out whenever he can, whether its to listen to his problems and offer solutions, or let him stay over in his room if he's having problems at home. Despite that, Kurimoto is envious of his encounters with women, and he will express his disdain verbally or by putting [Natsuo](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii) in a wrestling hold. Though Kurimoto is older and in college, he longs to have romantic experiences with women. He is especially attracted to older women.

135363.description:
She is the owner of the tailor store. Her name was never mentioned so she is referred to as the Tailor.

She made her debut in both the light novel and anime​ but never made her debut in the manga. She was only mentioned by the Magic Shop Owner as being a friend of hers.

135364.description:
She is an older woman who runs a magic book store at Castle Town of Melromarc. She was mentioned to be a witch by herself.

She gave magic books free of cost for Naofumi and his party to learn magic.

135452.description:
__Height:__ 153 cm

She is the youngest of the ‘Three Saints’. She has magical talent that is rare even among the saints. Because of that rare talent she grew up as if she were a rose among weeds. She is extraordinarily selfish.

135453.description: Aku was cast out of her village as a sacrifice to the Devil King Greol; however, as she is being chased through the forest by Greol, she comes to a clearing where she encounters a mysterious man.   This man defeats the Devil King with a single knife, causing Aku to become frightened for her life.  The man assures her that she has nothing to worry, he introduces himself as Hakuto Kunai.  Aku repeatedly refers to Kunai as "Demon Lord", which he tries time and time again, to tell her that's not his name.  He eventually gives in and lets her call him the Demon Lord, as they begin their journey together.

135466.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Rank:__ Extra

Rachel, also known as Michelle Light was Baam's best and only friend as she was the only one to visit him in his "cave". She longs to see the stars which is one of the fabled rewards waiting at the top of the Tower, because she "fears the Night".
~!Like Baam she is an Irregular.!~

135543.description: A student at Fujou High School, delinquent and a member of 14 Orchestra of Evil. He belongs to Team B in "Space Porn Book War Game ver 1.02 Arc," get beaten up Along with Myoukaku. He have Twin dragon Attack together with Myoukaku however it's useless, and just like most other members at his gang. Haijima sometimes also don't appreciate Odawara as their leader.

135592.description: Commonly known as "The Witch of the Highlands." A girl who was reincarnated as an immortal witch with the appearance of a seventeen-year-old. Before she knew what was happening, she'd become the strongest being in the world. Although she's had some rough times, it has ultimately given her a family, and she's delighted about it.

135593.description: A dragon girl and [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/135592/Aizawa-Azusa)'s apprentice. She's fastidious and cares a lot about what others think, but she's a good, earnest, and hardworking girl. Gothic Lolita clothes, maid outfits, and other frilly things suit her very well (which embarrasses her).

135594.description: A young elf woman and [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/135592/Aizawa-Azusa)'s apprentice. She is an upstanding CEO who runs a company using her knowledge of mushrooms, but in the house in the highlands, she's known for her knack for screwing up.

135649.description: He's the former student council vice-president. He boasts about watching every single anime that airs live at midnight. He covers his eyes because they are always filled with fatigue and with these eyes, the teachers wouldn't be aware if he fell asleep in class.

135801.description:
Keiki is a kind-hearted, friendly and considerate guy. He cares for his close friends and family, and is, in turn, cared for and liked just as much by them. His kindness is pointed out, by [Shouma](https://anilist.co/character/138711/Shoma-Akiyama), as his good trait and as to why girls would have a reason to like or love him.

Keiki also wants a girlfriend and is annoyed by the many couples he sees and is quite envious of them.

He cares very much for his sister [Mizuha](https://anilist.co/character/138709/Mizuha-Kiryuu) and spoils her with affection, to the point of being described as a sis-con by [Mao](https://anilist.co/character/138710/Mao-Nanjo) 

He also has a rare trait as a harem protagonist as he is not very dense. He has been able to figure out the feelings some girls hold for him in some respect, but did not know their perverted sides. He also seems to have quite a bit of confidence/courage when interacting with the girls as shown when he confronts [Sayuki](https://anilist.co/character/135802/Sayuki-Tokihara) about her secret (which he thinks is her romantic feelings for him). He is quite assertive when it comes to finding out who is in love with him.

He may not be dense, but he has a hard time understanding the emotions of girls and doesn't seem to completely grasp the situation. He also believes that there should be 'love' behind his acceptance of the girls' true nature towards him.

135802.description:
She is a third year student and the Calligraphy Club's President. On the outside, she is a mature upperclassman, with a playful attitude and a kind spirit. She enjoys calligraphy and tends to make a huge mess whenever she is writing. She always seems to be at odds with [Yuika](https://anilist.co/character/135803/Yuika-Koga) and teases/picks on her, the same goes both ways.

~! However deep down Sayuki is actually a huge masochistic pervert. She has a fetish for being dominated and wants [Keiki](https://anilist.co/character/135801/Keiki-Kiryuu) (whom she likely holds feelings towards) to make her his pet. She proclaimed that she was envious of a dog and owner whom she interacted with as she wants to have that master-servant/owner pet relationship with Keiki. !~

135803.description:
On the outside, she is a cute and outgoing girl who is playful with her friends, especially [Keiki](https://anilist.co/character/135801/Keiki-Kiryuu). She can sometimes be childish and jealous when Keiki is around other girls, especially [Sayuki](https://anilist.co/character/135802/Sayuki-Tokihara). She does not get along with Sayuki and is always picking on her and the same goes both ways.
~! However, on the inside, Yuika is actually a huge Sadist/Femdom. She wants to dominate Keiki and wishes for him to become her slave, the polar opposite of Sayuki. !~

135818.description:
Sakuya Watanuki is Mahiru Shirota's best friend.
~!He is a vampire, a subclass of Tsubaki's. He commits suicide some time after his sister was pushed to committing suicide as well, so that their parents could get money from it.!~

135854.description:
Keisuke was Shouya Ishida's friend in elementary school. Although he did bully Shouko Nishimiya, he wasn't a huge participant and usually seemed uncomfortable picking on her. However, he was more than happy bullying Shouya later on.

~!Keisuke stayed close with Kazuki after graduation and along with him brings Shouya from the river after he falls down after saving Shouko.!~

135856.description: Ishida's older sister. She is significantly older than him as she already graduated from college when he was still in elementary school. Curiously, she is the only character with lines whose face is never seen. According to Shouya, his sister had dated numerous men, one of whom has a younger brother who was bullied by Shouya. Later, she dated a Brazilian man named Pedro; this time, her relationship stuck, and she had a daughter, Maria, with him.

136024.description:
Yoshimura is a ghoul and the manager of the Anteiku cafe. He tries to help every ghoul, especially those who can't hunt themselves. He takes in Ken Kaneki and tries to help him survive being a ghoul.

~!He is Eto's father.!~

136069.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Combat Style:__ Mist Breathing

Muichiro is an air-headed individual who seems to constantly wander off in thought and never focus on one thing. Impassive and, at times, obtuse, he tends to think only for himself and operates on logic alone, never letting emotion guide him. Despite this, he has been shown to get serious when it is required and is devoted to his position as the Demon Slayer Corps' Mist Hashira. Alternatively, he seems to display a cold and arrogant side as well. ~!He later died at Kokushibo's hand.!~

136070.description:
__Height:__ 151 cm (4'11")
__Combat Style:__ Insect Breathing

Shinobu is a demon slayer and the Insect Pillar of the Demon Killing Corps. She is 18 years old and one of two female pillars. 

Shinobu appears rather laid back, and always has a smile on her face regardless of the situation. Despite her relaxed exterior and her initial claim of wanting to get along with demons, she can be rather cruel and harbors a great deal of anger towards them. She is generally kind to other humans, but is rather sadistic in her treatment of demons. As a pillar, she is a top-class fighter despite her small stature. She is also well-versed in medical knowledge, and can concoct poisons and medicines alike. 

~!During the Infinity Castle Arc, she encounters the Upper 2 demon [Douma](https://anilist.co/character/144591) and is slain by him in a fight. However, since she poisoned herself before the fight, Douma is severely incapacitated after eating her.!~

136071.description:
__Height:__ 198 cm (6'6")
__Combat Style:__ Sound Breathing

A Demon Slayer, and the Sound Pillar of the Demon Slayer Corps.

Tengen is a very eccentric person, always wanting to complete actions as flashy as possible. Although he has displayed an uncaring and forceful attitude towards some people, he also has a caring side that is mainly only shown towards his most treasured ones, most notably his three wives, [Makio](https://anilist.co/character/250554), [Suma](https://anilist.co/character/250555), and [Hinatsuru](https://anilist.co/character/250556). He also shows a somewhat nicer side towards [Tanjiro](https://anilist.co/character/126071) after their mission and starts to accept him more as the series goes on.

136072.description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'5")
__Combat Style:__ Love Breathing

Demon Hunter and the Love Pillar of the Demon Killing Corps. Mitsuri is a soft and kind person. She is very emotional and passionate, constantly complimenting people in her head, which probably contributes to her nickname of "the Hashira of Love". Although she is rather shy and is easily flustered, she is always kind to others, most notably towards [Obanai](https://anilist.co/character/137777), whom she appears to share a strong bond with. Besides her rather emotional personality, she can also come off as somewhat childish at times.

~!She was taught by Rengoku to use the flame breathing. However, although Mitsuri has learnt it, she was not as skillful with it and cannot fight to her fullest using it, leading her to solely develop the Love Breathing.!~

136073.description:
__Magic Type:__ Fire

Korean C-Rank Hunter and kumdo teacher. He is also one of Jinwoo's old friends, having known him since he was a E-Rank Hunter.

136077.description: He is a S rank hunter and master of the White Tiger guild.

136322.description: He poses as a student of Hijirigasaka Academy and serves as Mio's observer. He is also known as the Demon Lord Lars

136385.description: 26 years old and a member of “Jaeger”. Muscular Irish-American guy, who is tough both physically and mentally.

136386.description: A 17 years old half-werewolf with exceptional physical ability. He has sworn to take revenge on the vampires who destroyed his homeland and became a “Jaeger” ever since.

136390.description: 27 years old. Hispanic beauty who is part of the “Jaeger” and also Willard’s right hand.

136391.description: Young vampire prince of the Royals.

136392.description: Royal Female vampire, who came to Japan via Shanghai. She is beautiful and graceful in the public but act and speaks rough when showing her true-self.

136393.description: 29 years old. He is a secret agent of Military Affairs Bureau in the Ministry of the Army, and belongs to one of the most important office known as “Kudan Satellite Office”.

136394.description: Yuliy’s older brother. He was born in a rural village known as the dog-ville and lived peacefully with Yuliy and their mother.

136395.description: Royal vampire who serves Yevgraf. Willards and V shipping company had been after him for some time.

136396.description: She is the only daughter of the family whom Willard’s team stay with while they are in Japan.

136398.description: Mad scientist who teamed up with the Vampires to achieve long held desire.

136403.description: 14 years old. A British born member of the “Jaeger”. He is the youngest in Willard’s team but his skills as Jaeger is exceptional.

136446.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

Kaseki is an elderly craftsman from the Ishigami Village. When Senku arrives at Ishigami village, Kaseki is introduced as an artisan, and through Senku, his dedication to his craft is reignited tenfold.

136541.description:
**Relatives:** Unnamed [mother](https://anilist.co/character/202865/March-no-Haha) & [father](https://anilist.co/character/201554/March-no-Chichi), [Risa](https://anilist.co/character/202890/Risa) (baby sibling)

March is a young girl from Ninannah. When running away from her village, she stumbles across [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) near a pond.

March is very skilled at climbing trees. She's also small enough where she can easily crawl through tight spaces adults can't.

March was born in the village of Ninannah. Years later, she is chosen as a sacrifice to the [Spirit Bear](https://anilist.co/character/202861/Oniguma), a god her village worships to bring peace and prosperity, but is rescued by [Parona](https://anilist.co/character/136544/Parona).

136544.description:
**Relatives:** Unnamed mother, father, and [sister](https://anilist.co/character/201557/Paronas-sister).

Parona is a girl from Ninannah and a close friend of [March](https://anilist.co/character/136541/March). She looks after March like an older sister.

136548.description:
**Age:** ~!~800 years!~
**Relatives:** [The Beholder](https://anilist.co/character/136553/Kansatsusha) ("father"; creator), [March](https://anilist.co/character/136541/March) (adoptive "mother"), [Gugu](https://anilist.co/character/136554/Gugu) (adoptive brother)

Fushi is an immortal being created by The Beholder and placed on Earth to preserve the world.

Fushi is an immortal being that can take the form of anything that has given him stimuli. His original form was a featureless white sphere. Without consciousness, he copied the first thing he bumped into, which happened to be a rock. Soon afterward, he became moss and stayed like that for some time. When a wounded wolf wandered close in the middle of winter and died, the immortal copied the wolf. He retains the ability to turn into these things. Later, after the death of the [nameless boy](https://anilist.co/character/201555/Unnamed-Boy), he mimicked the boy's appearance and took the form of a young boy with white hair, a pale complexion, and green eyes. He wears a short, brown fur cloak and a light blue shirt and pants with fur boots. A rope dangled from his hand and neck as the nameless boy died holding [Joaan](https://anilist.co/character/163694/Joaan)'s leash, though the latter soon disappeared. Fushi commented on the form, saying it felt like it belonged to him the most.

Other than the nameless boy (whose form he usually defaults to), he can also take the form of many others; most notably: ~!March, a little girl with long black hair wearing a simple white dress; Gugu, a young man with defined muscle who hides his face behind a salamander mask; and [Parona](https://anilist.co/character/136544/Parona), a young woman with black hair and a slender body.!~

Fushi appears to be a good listener, is curious, brave, and a fast learner. Before learning how to speak, Fushi would learn how to do things by mimicking other people's actions. After learning how to express himself via words, Fushi speaks his mind - no matter how mean it may sound. He cares deeply for others and dislikes death. He also blames himself for the [Nokkers](https://anilist.co/character/232832/Nokkers)' attacks, believing that destruction follows wherever he goes. Fushi finds it extremely hard to make friends because he knows he will have to see their lives to the end; they will always die while he lives forever.
136548.gender: Male (in his main form; can be any)

136550.description:
__Affiliation:__ Tonari's Group (former)

Tonari is a girl that [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) meets on the island of Jananda. She has short brown hair, green eyes, and tan skin. She's seen wearing a blue jacket and shorts, a black and white shirt, and has a pet owl named Ligard. 

~!Sometime after Fushi left the island of Jananda, Tonari began ingesting different types of poison to develop strong immunities to them.!~

136553.description: The mysterious being and observer who cast the orb onto the Earth. His goal is to preserve the world. He sent [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) to acquire various kinds of information from the world and aid his observations.

136554.description:
Gugu is a young man from Takunaha who originally worked at [Booze Man's](https://anilist.co/character/136555/Sakejii) shop. As [Fushi's](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) sworn brother, he fought the [Nokkers](https://anilist.co/character/232832/Nokkers) and anti-Fushi faction members on several occasions to create the peaceful world the immortal desires.

He wears a mask to hide his face.

~!His head got crushed by a wood log while trying to save [Rean](https://anilist.co/character/136551/Cropp-Rean). He has been wearing a mask to cover it ever since.!~

136556.description: Pyoran is an old woman from Takunaha. She comes to Ninannah as a shaman.

136613.description: She is the manager of the Student Council's Head of Public Relations, Yumemi Yumemite. She is the daughter of a big time producer

136705.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm
__Ability:__ Midwinter Memento

A commander of the Black Lizards, the Port Mafia's squad of hitmen. Though he puts up a tough and violent front, he cares deeply for his friends. Very skilled gunner, especially when dual wielding.

136789.description: Elrasla Grilaroc more commonly known as Granny is an old woman who states that her level is the same as her age. She hit the level cap a long time ago. The sole successor of the Mushin Tensou style of martial arts.

136790.description:
Fitoria is the queen of the Filolials, who rules over them all.

She has silver hair with thin streaks of light blue, cut in a short bob with three tufts of hair standing up vertically from the crown of her head, like cowlicks. Her eyes are red and her face is small and well composed. She's dressed in a red and white gothic lolita-style dress. She's about the same height as Filo.

136792.description:
__Race:__ Wanui
~!Gender: Female!~

Keel was born and raised in the same village as Raphtalia. Naofumi purchased them as a slave in order to rebuild the village destroyed by the first wave.

136793.description:
L'arc has spiked red hair and is muscular. He has a tattoo of a scythe on his upper arm and appears to be handsome

He is carefree and laid back, taking a very relaxed path to every problem. He is, according to Naofumi, an older-brother kind of character. Even though he has become a king, he likes his freedom. Just like Glass, he has a warrior spirit which is shown during his fight with Naofumi.

He is a good judge of character just by looking at someone. He did have a childish side which shown by the way, when he acted too excited for the ship ride to Cal Mira island. He had the habit of calling the younger persons "Kiddo". He has high morals and doesn't want to hurt any others who are irrelevant to his mission.

name.native: リーシア＝アイヴィレッド

136794.description:
__Race__: Human

Rishia is the daughter of the House of Ivyred, a noble family. Due to an unfortunate string of events, the family had grown poor and she was forcefully taken as ransom by a neighboring family in exchange for gold. She was rescued by The Bow Hero, whom she would later devote her life to.

~!To show her gratitude and support for her savior, Rishia would go on to join Itsuki's party. She would then be treated as an errand girl, carrying food and supplies for the Bow Hero's party, leaving her talent in magic unused and untapped.!~

136796.description: A mysterious girl who seems to be an enemy. ~!She was able to defeat the Sword, Lance and Bow Heroes single-handedly, but lost to Naofumi. She was mistaken as a calamity when she first appeared.!~

name.native: テリス・アレキサンドライト

136797.description:
A companion of Lar'c Berg.

She has a white skin which looked like ivory. Her hair was bluish green which sparkled in sunlight.Her hair was pulled back into a braid of three thick strands and draped. She wears bangles with massive gem on both hands.

As a jewel she's able to obtain energy from the different gems that she owns and use it to cast powerful spells.

136837.description:
__Race:__ Human

Cid Kagenou, under the moniker of "Shadow," is the founder and leader of the secret organization "Shadow Garden." He founded the organization to help realize his fantasy of becoming an “Eminence in Shadow". However, unbeknownst to him, his fabrications are often revealed to be quite genuine in reality. Cid is the reincarnation of Minoru Kagenou.

136842.description:
__Height:__ 184 cm

Akihiko Kaji is a college student in Given. Also the drummer in Ritsuka's band, he can play not only the drums but also violin, guitar, and bass.

136843.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5′8")

Ritsuka Uenoyama is one of the main protagonists of the Given Series. He is a high school student and has a guitar prowess despite being just a high schooler. He is a considerate and compassionate guy and is also a genuine younger brother of his sister [Yayoi](https://anilist.co/character/167937/Uenoyama-Yayoi). Uenoyama shows little consideration for small talk and can be quick to be irate. He can be smug when showing his high test scores, and says he can understand theory based subjects. Uenoyama can be very attentive to the feelings of others, particularly [Mafuyu](https://anilist.co/character/136844/Satou-Mafuyu).

136844.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

One of the protagonists of the manga-anime. He has a quiet, calm and mysterious personality, he can't express his thoughts and emotions very well, despite being a sincere boy. After all he is a strong person who has endured many bad things in his past. He lives with his mother (who works a lot and is never shown in the manga and anime) and his dog named [Kedama](https://anilist.co/character/230878/Kedama), but he usually calls him Tama (cat name). His best friends in the past were [Hiiragi](https://anilist.co/character/167930/Kashima-Hiiragi), [Yuuki](https://anilist.co/character/153048/Yoshida-Yuki) (his ex-boyfriend) and [Shizusumi](https://anilist.co/character/167938/Yagi-Shizusumi) (they were friends since childhood), his current best friends are [Uenoyama](https://anilist.co/character/136843/Uenoyama-Ritsuka) (his current boyfriend), [Kaji](https://anilist.co/character/136842/Kaji-Akihiko) and [Haruki](https://anilist.co/character/136845/Nakayama-Haruki), although he still maintains some contact with Hiiragi.

136845.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Haruki Nakayama is a film major graduate student, and the bassist in the band Given. He is the oldest in the group and the leader of the band. Haruki “prefers lighter music (compared to other guys) and pop. Drawn to Japanese rock and light, slow tempo dance.”  He is “extremely good natured and kind” and is easily flustered. In the manga it is revealed that Haruki’s “stand” is a kind elderly man. He lives on his own in an apartment and is friends with [Ritsuka Uenoyama](https://anilist.co/character/136843/Uenoyama-Ritsuka), [Mafuyu Satou](https://anilist.co/character/136844/Satou-Mafuyu), and [Koji Yatake](https://anilist.co/character/174907/Yatake-Koji). 

~!In season one of the anime it is clear he has romantic feelings towards his band-mate [Akihiko](https://anilist.co/character/136842/Kaji-Akihiko), and as of now in the manga is the boyfriend of Akihiko.!~

136897.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3'')

Izuku Midoriya's mother. Her quirk allows her to pull small objects towards her.

136956.description: He is the accessory Merchant protected by the shield hero from Bandits and was also the founder and first president of the Hickwaal Company.

136957.description: The Leader of Melromarc Knight is the highest rank of Knights in Melromarc. His actual name was never revealed in the series.

136958.description: He is the bandit who has the most frequent unfortunate encounter with Naofumi. Later, he founded the Chivalrous Thief Guild with the guidance of Naofumi.

136969.description:
A third year who has transferred to Tanashi High School. She is a gal who is good at street performance.

An extreme brother complex who loves her younger brother Ma-kun.

136970.description: Masashi is a transfer student and Saki-chan's younger brother. He and his sister join the Magic Club.

136971.description: He is an underclassmen and a member of the Magic Club.

136972.description: Senpai is a high school girl who is a skilled magician when no one is watching. However, she easily gets stage fright, is very embarrassed and clumsy, and often blunders her magic tricks when even one person watches her perform.

136973.description: President of the chemistry club. Madara is a very intelligent student but does not believe in magic.

136976.description:
**Height:** 162 cm (5'3.2")

She is an energetic, mischievous, and popular classmate of [Fumiya Tomozaki](https://anilist.co/character/136978) who is in the track and field club together with [Aoi Hinami](https://anilist.co/character/136977). She has a close friendship with [Hanabi Natsubayashi](https://anilist.co/character/161223). Although she maintains a cheerful demeanor, in truth she has insecurities about herself and her personality that gives in easily to not ruin the mood. She is also known to be quite persistent in what she wants to achieve, such as pestering the lonely Hanabi into being her friend.

136977.description: Aoi is [Tomozaki](https://anilist.co/character/136978)'s classmate, and the number two ranked player at the fighting game 'Tackfam'. She excels at everything she tries due to her hard-working attitude, so much so that many regard her as being outright perfect. To most people, she seems like a happy-go-lucky, carefree student. However, Tomozaki soon learns that she's a very serious, accommodating, supportive, yet somewhat harsh and rude person.

136978.description:
Fumiya Tomozaki is a high school student who is a friendless loner and an outcast in school. To escape from his lonely existence, he dedicated himself to a fighting game called Attack Family, or 'Tackfam' for short, so much so that he's the number one ranked player in Japan, his username being nanashi. 

Tomozaki sees himself as a "bottom-tier character" in life: someone born unlucky and destined for loneliness. However, after meeting his online rival, [Aoi Hinami](https://anilist.co/character/136977/Aoi-Hinami), he agrees to learn from her how to socialize and improve himself, treating life as a game to be mastered.

136979.description:
Fuuka is a reserved and book-loving classmate of [Fumiya](https://anilist.co/character/136978/Tomozaki-Fumiya) who often spends time at the library. As she is an aspiring novelist, she loves to speculate about and study different people's motives for their actions and experiences that shaped them to who they are today. 

Her favorite author is Michael Andi.

136983.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'8")
__Instrument:__ Spector EURO 4 LX RAS LAYER -Twilight Amber-

A second-year high school student. She goes by the moniker LAYER and is the vocalist and bassist for the band RAISE A SUILEN. She is Tae's childhood friend. Due to Rei's mature attitude, she has a tendency keep a certain feeling of distance with others.

She has liked singing since she was young, and now she is a professional singer who can sing any song. In addition to temporary part-time singing jobs, she used to play bass in a back up band for famous artists. Rei had also attended the same music school as Tae and Arisa.

136984.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")
__Instrument:__ Pearl Reference Twilight Fade Drums

A second-year high school student. She goes by the moniker MASKING and is the drummer for the band RAISE A SUILEN. Despite her sharp gaze and rough, delinquent-like appearance, she likes cute things and is skilled at baking cakes.

She is the daughter of the owner of Galaxy Live House. Masuki's longing for her father made her start playing the drums, which she plays violently and is called a "mad dog" because of that.

(Source: BanG Dream Wikia, edited)

136985.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")
__Instruments:__ ROLAND FA-06 / ROLAND FA-08

An energetic second-year middle school student. She goes by the moniker PAREO and is the keyboardist for the band RAISE A SUILEN. She adores CHU² and has said she admires her deeply, calling her "CHU²-sama" and sometimes even "Goshujinsama" (lit. Master).

Reona was originally learning the Electone, but switched to the keyboard when she was scouted by CHU². Reona's favorite band is Pastel*Palettes. 

(Source: BanG Dream Wikia, edited)

136986.description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (4'7")
__Instruments:__ Pioneer DJ XDJ-RX2 DJ System + PIONEER DJ TORAIZ SP-16

A returnee who attends an international school. She goes by the moniker CHU² (read as CHUCHU) and is the leader and DJ for the band RAISE A SUILEN. She is also a music producer who uses DTM (Desktop Music) to compose music, and she's the one who scouted PAREO as a keyboardist.

Chiyu is 14 years old but due to her excellent grades, she is currently a 10th grader or a first year high school student. Chiyu is both very professional and confident of her band and ideas, and although she tends to be arrogant sometimes, she's not rude. She dreams of changing the world with the strongest music.

As a result of her studying in an international school, Chiyu often talks in English or adds English words to her sentences.

136996.description: A mysterious woman who works at the dental office and also coaches Aoyama in chess. She has memories of her parents and growing up by the coast. ~!It is revealed she is from the world of the sphere.!~

136997.description: A precocious boy who keeps a notebook of things he learns. He has a crush on the Lady and a fascination with breasts. He has never seen the ocean.

136998.description: A shy boy who is friends with Aoyama. He is bullied by Suzuki.

137017.description: She is a student of the Highso Private Girls' Academy and was a client of Arataka Reigen.

137026.description:
He was a client of Arataka Reigen, he wanted to speak with his deceased father about a password to a safe.

~!He attempted to stab Reigen to get the combo but was knocked out by Reigen.!~

137056.description: Fubuki-Class Destroyer. She has difficulty understanding things outside of fighting and is confused by certain human interactions. Her nickname is “The Demon”. Her verbal tic is “desu".

137079.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Power is a fiend, a dead body possessed by a devil.

She is a Public Safety Devil Hunter who works (against her will) under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of an experimental squad in Tokyo Special Division 4. She works alongside her partner [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji), and under supervision by [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa).

Power is childish, greedy, and almost entirely self-motivated. She tends to fights if she has something to gain and is certain of her victory and has no problems in running away from a fight where she is outmatched. She also feels the need to boast her superiority over her fellow Devil Hunters due to her status as a fiend. She has no loyalty to humanity, openly admitting that she will join the winning side. Power is often rude, unkempt, and feels as though those around her should clean up after her. She self-admittedly rarely bathes or flushes the toilet and sees humans as being sensitive for caring about their hygiene so much. As the Blood Fiend, she has the power to freely manipulate the blood within her own body.

137080.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")
__Affiliation:__ Public Safety Devil Hunters

Makima is a Public Safety Devil Hunter, who took [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) as her human pet. She is one of the leading figures of Public Safety in Japan and has a considerable reputation among experienced Devil Hunters.

137081.description:
__Height:__ 182 cm (6'0")
__Devil Contracts:__ [Fox Devil](https://anilist.co/character/290671/Kitsune-no-Akuma), [Curse Devil](https://anilist.co/character/174265/Noroi-no-Akuma), ~![Future Devil](https://anilist.co/character/172887/Mirai-no-Akuma)!~
__Relatives:__ [Hahaoya Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/291241/Hayakawa-Hahaoya) (Mother), [Chichioya Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/291240/Hayakawa-Chichioya) (Father), [Taiyou Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/174261/Taiyou) (Younger Brother).

A Public Safety Devil Hunter working under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. He is partnered with [Himeno](https://anilist.co/character/144596/Himeno) and tasked with supervising both [Power](https://anilist.co/character/137079/Power) and [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji).

Aki Hayakawa generally appears to be a very stoic person. He acts mature and dependable when he's with his fellow Devil hunters but is actually very soft when he is alone. He has a tendency to get attached to others easily, and hates to see people get hurt, especially his close friends. Aki's primary goal and reasoning for becoming a Devil Hunter is to kill the [Gun Devil](https://anilist.co/character/208942/Juu-no-Akuma) to get revenge for his family.

~!He later loses his contract with the Fox Devil and gains a new contract with the Future Devil!~

137105.description:
Narumi Toi is Kanata Higa's former beach volleyball partner.

Together with [Ayasa](https://anilist.co/character/126575/Tachibana-Ayasa), Narumi is a consecutive champion of local beach volleyball competitions and even adapting her "idols" status of this sport.

137165.description: A kind homeless man whom Anzu gets to know and teaches her about the value of money.

137221.description:
Yugi Tsukasa is a ghost haunting Kamome Academy. He currently resides at the school's broadcasting club room, with its members Sakura and Natsuhiko.
~!He is the younger twin brother of Amane Yugi. He is said to be the polar opposite of Hanako. Where Hanako grants the wish of a living person, Tsukasa grants the wish of a dead person's lingering spirit!~

137222.description: Minamoto Kou is a student at Kamome Academy's Middle School Division, and a member of a renowned family of exorcists, the Minamoto Clan.

137223.description: Nanamine Sakura is a 3rd-year student at Kamome Academy's High School division. She made a contract with [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/137221/Yugi-Tsukasa) and is now bound to him. She is a member of the school's broadcasting club.

alternative: Garan no Gabimaru (がらんの画眉丸)

137260.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Fire
__Occupation:__ Shinobi
__Affiliation:__ Iwagakure (Formerly)

Gabimaru is an elite shinobi assassin formerly from Iwagakure. He is the husband of [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/151771/Yui) and the son-in-law to the [chief of Iwagakure](https://anilist.co/character/301607/Osa).

Gabimaru is calm, level-headed and rarely shows any emotions. He is calm to the point where he is unfazed by any sort of crisis, such as being executed or when he is confronted and attacked by a strong enemy. As noted by [Sagiri](https://anilist.co/character/137263/Sagiri), once Gabimaru calms down he tends to complain. He prefers to stick with his main objective at hand and not get tangled with anything else that doesn't involve his goals. Although he is viewed as being obnoxious (mainly by Sagiri), he can also be respectful and polite at times.

~!During his time in Iwagakure, Gabimaru was known and admired by his peers for his cruelty and ruthless killings of his victims, but after being married to Yui, Gabimaru underwent a major change. Even though he was influenced by his leader's words of ridding himself of his emotions to become strong, Gabimaru was also influenced by Yui's kind and caring nature into believing that having emotions made him truly strong and would turn him into a true warrior. This overwrote his cruel nature as a ninja and made him want to avoid unnecessary killing.!~

He served as Iwagakure's most infamous shinobi until he was betrayed by his village for wanting to abandon his role as a murderer and live a peaceful life with his wife, resulting in him being handed over to the authorities to be executed. However, after the shogun calls for convict criminals to acquire the Elixir of Life from the dangerous island known as Kotaku, in exchange for a pardon for their past crimes, Gabimaru accepts the invitation to be a part of the competition mission in order to reunite with Yui and live the life he so desired. Upon taking the mission, Yamada Asaemon Sagiri was chosen as his assigned monitor.

~!Shortly after, Gabimaru becomes a part of a united front formed from the remaining surviving criminals and executioners to defeat Lord Tensen, work together in capturing the elixir, and have everyone escape the island.!~

alternative: Yamada Asaemon Touma (山田浅ェ門桐馬)

137261.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Earth
__Occupation:__ Asaemon (Unofficial)
__Affiliation:__ Yamada Clan

Toma is a relatively new member of the Yamada clan trying to rise in their ranks and is the assigned monitor of [Chobe Aza](https://anilist.co/character/137269/Chobe-Aza).

~! He turns out to be the younger brother of Chobe Aza and had a mission of infiltrating the Yamada clan to rescue him from prison. !~

Toma believes that the key to surviving in life is adapting to ones environment. Toma tends to act rather unfriendly when someone tries to communicate with him on friendly terms. He also displays a cocky attitude.

~! He is very caring and loyal to Chobe since he has been his protector since they were children and stresses out whenever harm comes to him. Because of how his father died fighting for his allies, Toma is reluctant to cooperate with anyone except for his brother. In his own eye, Toma views himself as an extension of his brother instead of an ally and stated that the bandits that followed the two were merely pawns for them to use. However, Toma soon realizes that his reliance on his brother to protect him interferes with his growth rate to look after himself. !~

~! Toma and Chobe were born as sons to a retainer under the service of the daimyō of Akō Domain, Asano Takunori. However, after Asano Takunori attacked the court official Kira Yoshinaka at Edo Castle, he was sentenced to commit seppuku. As a result, their father and the rest of the retainers had their status removed and were left as ronin, leaving their family in poverty. Their mother eventually died of an illness and their father was executed for being a part of the Akō Incident, leaving the two siblings left alone to defend for themselves. They were eventually taken by bandits who planned on selling them but later came to live amongst them after Chobe managed to become their leader. !~

137262.description:
__Height:__ 138 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Water

Nurugai is the last remaining member of the Sanka and a wrongly convicted death-row criminal. Her assigned monitor is [Tenza](https://anilist.co/character/137265/Tenza).

Nurugai looks down on samurai, viewing them as stupid. Her disdain for them stems from the fact that they were partially responsible for killing her people. Because of this incident, Nurugai feels a strong guilt for leading her village's extermination, even believed that the reason why she is on a dangerous mission is because she was receiving divine punishment for her actions and accepted death. 

Nurugai was raised with the Sanka Mountain People in a village where she had lived with her grandfather. Nurugai and her grandfather were in a friendly, familial relationship where she would learn off her grandfather's wisdom. Her village however were considered rebels against the current shogunate, refusing to submit to [Tokugawa](https://anilist.co/character/301606/Nariyoshi-Tokugawa). Because of this, samurai were sent to locate the hillside tribes they defined as Emishis. One day, Nurugai crossed paths with a party of lost men, encouraging Nurugai to offer her help by seeking rest in the security of her village. Nurugai recognized her mistake when she realised that these men were samurai under the order of Tokugawa, who began a mass killing of her village that would leave her as the sole survivor.

alternative: Yamada Asaemon Sagiri (山田浅ェ門佐切)

137263.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Wood
__Occupation:__ Asaemon
__Affiliation:__ Yamada Clan
__Rank:__ 12th
__Relative:__ [Kichiji](https://anilist.co/character/302527/Kichiji) (Father)

Yamada Asaemon Sagiri is the 12th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan. After the shogun sent criminals to Kotaku to find the Elixir of Life, she was tasked with being [Gabimaru's](https://anilist.co/character/137260/Gabimaru) executioner.

Sagiri generally displays a calm demeanor when taking on her role as an executioner. However, after landing on Kotaku, she allowed herself to act casual around others as long as she continued to do her job. She is very polite and caring towards her fellow Asaemon members, despite the fact that she is aware that some view her as being unworthy of becoming a samurai. However, she is not afraid to speak her mind and to stand up for herself. Though she takes matters seriously, Sagiri does possess a sense of humor, often laughing at [Shion's](https://anilist.co/character/137267/Shion) jokes. 

~!After her experience with working successfully with criminals and witnessing the deaths of her fellow clansmen, Sagiri resolved to abandon her role as an executioner on the mission and viewed everyone that came not as a criminal or an executioner but as allies so they can work together to return home safely.!~

When she was young, Sagiri watched as her father skillfully decapitated a condemned performer with a single swing of his sword. From that day she became inspired to walk the path of an executioner and achieve the same level of skill as her father. As she began her training on how to wield a sword, Sagiri was looked down on by her fellow Yamada members, as well as her father, for being a female following the path of a samurai. Sagiri was also shunned by other children because of the clan's bad reputation. Despite the harsh treatment she faced, Sagiri managed to earn her name as a Yamada Asaemon.

137264.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Age:__ Unknown
__Tao Attribute:__ Fire

Tamiya Gantetsusai formerly known as Tetsunosuke is a renown master swordsman known throughout as the Blade Dragon and Eight Provinces Unparalleled.

He considers fighting to be fun and lives to seek out and battle strong opponents that can make him feel a thrill whenever he has to draw his blade. Even when critically injured, Gantetsusai's carries a satisfied smile from the adrenaline he gets from fighting and feels as though as he is becoming stronger with each injury. However, he is not very disciplined, preferring to recklessly fight his opponents head on without thinking of a clear strategy, or listen to his allies, and hates it when others try to interfere in his enjoyment. Gantetsusai also has a perverted side as he took note and commented on [Yuzuriha](https://anilist.co/character/137270/Yuzuriha)'s physique during the selection process. Despite his perverted behavior, Gantetsusai has morals as he felt disgusted of the thought of the Dōshi using [Mei](https://anilist.co/character/148755/Mei) for sexual intercourse to complete their Tao training.

~!Gantetsusai has a massive ego and wishes to go down in history as a legendary figure. He believes that by performing extraordinary feats and people remembering his name throughout generations is the true form of immortality rather than gaining the Elixir of Life.!~

At a young age, Tetsunosuke was trained in the art of swordsmanship. After being defeated by his master, Tetsunosuke asked how he was able to despite his old age. He explains to Tetsunosuke that he has become greedy with wanting to become stronger and says that he must throw away his strength in order to see everything in what he has left. Despite this lesson, Tetsunosuke was unable to understand what his master was telling him. As he grew up, Tetsunosuke renamed himself to Tamiya Gantetsusai and went around searching for strong opponents, eventually making a name for himself as a fame swordsman.

alternative: Yamada Asaemon Tenza (山田浅ェ門典坐)

137265.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")

Tenza is the 10th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan. After [the shogun](https://anilist.co/character/301606/Tokugawa-Nariyoshi) sent criminals to Kotaku to find the Elixir of Life, he was chosen as [Nurugai's](https://anilist.co/character/137262/Nurugai) assigned monitor. From youth, Tenza started off on the streets but was eventually picked up by [Shion](https://anilist.co/character/137267/Shion) and made into his apprentice in the Yamada Clan. 

Tenza is energetic and confident. He is a practitioner of bushido, taking in the lesson of continuing on forward no matter what is blocking his way. Tenza is also extremely righteous and does not let his duties as an Asaemon get in the way of doing what is right. He believes that Nurugai is innocent and does not deserve to die on the island. Although righteous he is, Tenza does not think things through, believing that without the elixir he would be able to convince his superiors to turn a blind eye. Tenza has a strong will to protect the people he cares about.

alternative: Yamada Asaemon Senta (山田浅ェ門仙汰)

137266.description:
__Race:__ Human

Yamada Asaemon Senta is the 5th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan. After the shogun sent criminals to Kotaku to find the Elixir of Life, he was tasked with being [Yuzuriha's](https://anilist.co/character/137270/Yuzuriha) executioner.

Senta is very nervous around others and tends to frequently sweat. He usually remains in the background and goes along with whatever is happening around him but will speak up when he feels that whatever he has to say would be helpful. Senta is capable of assessing the situation and makes good judgements as to how to approach them. He dislikes his role of killing people but feels that he has no choice in the matter and chooses to abandon his dream of becoming an artist. After observing Yuzuriha, he becomes envious and enchanted by her innate freedom. Despite his nervous demeanor, Senta is fearless and stands his ground no matter who he is up against.

alternative: Yamada Asaemon Shion (山田浅ェ門士遠)

137267.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Race:__ Human 
__Tao Attribute:__ Wood

Shion is the 4th rank Asaemon of the Yamada clan and is the one chosen to be [Akaginu](https://anilist.co/character/302523/Akaginu)'s monitor. 

Shion is a strict but kind man. He is well aware of the brutal nature of his work as an executioner, opting to spend the rest of his time helping others. Like the other Asaemon, he possesses a strong loyalty to the Yamada clan. Shion also has a witty sense of humor, often making puns and jokes regarding his eyesight, which has become a major part of his character to the people around him. Shion is shown to be fearless, showing no fear or hesitation when facing extremely strong enemies.

alternative: Yamada Asaemon Fuchi (山田浅ェ門付知)

137268.description:
__Height:__ 148 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Metal
__Occupation:__ Asaemon
__Affiliation:__ Yamada Clan
__Rank:__ 9th

Yamada Asaemon Fuchi is the 9th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan and was chosen to be [Tamiya Gantetsusai](https://anilist.co/character/137264/Gantetsusai-Tamiya)'s assigned monitor. 

Fuchi is a rational thinker that has a good sense of judgement in situations and carries a no-nonsense view when it comes to matters that he deems are unscientific, pointless, and illogical. He has great pride as a Yamada Asaemon and does not tolerate anybody speaking disgracefully about the Yamada clan. He is very close with his Asaemon comrades and gives them nicknames instead of using honourifics. Even though the Yamada clan mainly deal with testing new swords and executions, Fuchi preferrs, and has a deep passion, for studying the human anatomy to improve medical science that came with the trade. He whole-heartedly believes that anatomical research would save lives and despises those who thought so little of this study.

~!Although he was an executioner, after his experience working together with the surviving convicts, Fuchi found that both "crime" and "evil" were entirely different from one another, with Tamiya Gantetsusai as an example. From a scientific view point, Fuchi found that samurai and criminals were not so different since they are structured the same and had a will to live, which was reason enough for the survivors to band together in trying to return home.!~

~!With both him and Gantetsusai badly injured Fuchi musters up the rest of his strength to administer first aid to Gantetsusai instead of himself resulting in him dying. In his last thoughts, Fuchi warns [Shugen](https://anilist.co/character/148752/Shugen) not to underestimate the survivors since they are not willing to die easily and wishes the best of luck to both his allies and enemies.!~

137269.description:
__Tao Attribute:__ Metal
__Occupation:__ Bandit
__Race:__ Human (Formerly), ~!Semi-Immortal Human!~

Aza Chobe also known as the Bandit King, is a well-known bandit leader in Iyo that is responsible for multiple crimes committed.

Chobe is an extremely barbaric individual who attacks anyone or anything that poses as a threat to him. He prefers to do things of his own accord and would rather resort to violence than talk things through. Chobe is also very sadistic whenever he engages in fights with his enemies, Chobe always stuck to taking on the role of the villain, and holds grudges to those that have bested him. Although he tends to act like a brute, Chobe is a rationale thinker that knows what is the best course of action in a serious situation.

~!Chobe and [Toma](https://anilist.co/character/137261/Touma) were born as sons to a retainer under the service of the daimyō of Akō Domain, Asano Takunori. However, after Asano Takunori attacked the court official Kira Yoshinaka at Edo Castle, he was sentenced to commit seppuku. As a result, their father and the rest of the retainers had their status removed and were left as ronin, leaving their family in poverty. They were eventually taken by bandits who planned on selling them but later came to live amongst them after Chobe managed to become their leader.!~

137270.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Age:__ Unknown
__Tao Attribute:__ Earth
__Occupation:__ Kunoichi

Yuzuriha also known as Yuzuriha of the Keishu, is a kunoichi and one of the few criminals recruited to acquire the Elixir of Life.

Yuzuriha is friendly and cheerful around others with a typical teenage girl personality. She is shown to be carefree and prefers to do things at her own pace. Because of her reputation as a criminal, Yuzuriha has no problems when it comes to killing or who she has to sacrifice to achieve a goal. Underneath her friendly attitude, Yuzuriha's true nature is that of a complete narcissist, only focusing on her own well-being and shows little concern for others. This attitude stemmed from her past vow to her little sister to live only for the both of them. As a kunoichi, Yuzuriha uses her charms to get what she wants, but despite that she is shown to be a terrible liar after trying to make up her backstory.

~!Though selfish, Yuzuriha can show compassion to others. As [Senta](https://anilist.co/character/137266/Senta) was dying, she consoled him and had him die in peace by making him forget about his duties as an Asaemon and gave him the last bit of freedom he had to think about what he wanted to imagine as his last memory.!~

~!Despite her beautiful appearence, with her mucus abilities she actually hides a body full of scars.!~

Yuzuriha grew up in a shinobi village living with her little sister, [Saya](https://anilist.co/character/306735/Saya), who was suffering from an incurable disease and eventually died. From then on, Yuzuriha swore to live her life for the both of them and started her career as a kunoichi. Sometime ago, Yuzuriha raided the Sagiwa Castle and defeated the retainers defending it.

137277.description: He is one of the Juvenile Knights of Melromarc.. He accompanied the Knight squads to Lute Village in times of the wave, to assists the heroes.

137302.description: She cares a lot about Yuriko Nishinotouin and is very worried, when Yuriko collapsed after being poisoned by Miyo Inbami.

name.native: ルーシー・モーンスタン

137430.description: Fuyuto Kyogoku is a character in Kabukichou Sherlock. He is an anime original character. Fuyuta has neatly combed short jet black hair parted to the left and green eyes. He wears glasses, a black suit, an indigo tie, dark brown dress shoes, and white gloves. Fuyuto is a serious and astute person. He displays full confidence in his detective perspective nature. In his opinion, he believes that Sherlock is a pervert.

name.native: ミッシェル・ベルモント
ジェームズ・モリアーティ
alternative: James Moran (ジェームズ・モラン)

name.native: メアリ・モーンスタン
シャーロック・ホームズ

137468.description: Issei is a 3rd year student from Aobajohsai High; he is one of the middle blockers.

137470.description: Takahiro is a 3rd year wing spiker at Aobajohsai High.

137471.description: Sadayuki is the coach of Aobajohsai High.

137473.description: Tamahiko is a first year setter and a pinch server at Nekoma High.

137484.description: Yutaka is a second year wing spiker of the Date Tech High Volleyball Club.

137485.description: Kousuke is a first year libero at Date Tech High.

137506.description:
__Affiliation:__ League of Villains
__Quirk:__ Warp Gate

Kurogiri has a level-headed personality, which often serves to ground Tomura Shigaraki's immaturity. He is intensely loyal to both All For One and Tomura. He is very polite and well-spoken, even to enemies.

~! Kurogiri is actually an intelligent Nomu made from the corpse of Eraserhead and President Mics high school friend Oboro Shirakumo made to serve Tomura Shigaraki. Although he remains unaware of his previous identity after Eraserheads efforts to talk to him it’s shown that a small part of Oboro is still in Kurogiri!~

name.native: チェレステーノ・チャルディーニ

137508.description:
The former coach of Yuuri Katsuki and Jean-Jacques Leroy and the current coach of Phichit Chulanont. Celestino is usually quite cheerful, both on and off the ice. He tends to be a bit rigid in making decisions for his skaters' programs, rather than bending towards their opinions.

(Source: Yuri!!! On Ice Wikia)

137509.description:
Takeshi Motoba is Taihei Doma's childhood friend and coworker, his nickname is Bomber.

Unlike Taihei, Takeshi is laid back and lazy, similar to Umaru Doma. He likes to goof off at work, and mess around when out and about. 

Takeshi has been friends with Taihei since at least high school, and followed each other to work in the same office. Takeshi has a little sister, who is also friends with Umaru, Kirie Motoba. His relationship with his sister is violent, with her becoming furious with him after upsetting her.

137512.description: Ryuunosuke's younger sister and a member of the "Black Lizards" Assault Unit. It seems she is in good terms with Dazai.

137513.description: She's been helping the bathhouse for a long time. Despite being young, she is very mature and always gives good suggestions to [Nasa](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki) to help him out with his couple life. Like her mom, she really likes dirty jokes and apparently, she has no fear of cleaning the males' bath while Nasa is in there. She isn't shy and prefers a direct approach.

137514.description: She is [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/137513/Kaname-Arisugawa)'s older sister. She is a lazy ditz but, [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/137513/Kaname-Arisugawa) considers her on the "genius side" for her great learning capacity. In contrast with that, she usually misunderstands important things and she gets really confused in the blink of an eye. Her favorite hobby is probably playing video games and she usually nags [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/137513/Kaname-Arisugawa) into playing with her.

137515.description:
Apparently, [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/131106/Tsukasa-Yuzaki) saved her from falling off a cliff when they were children. Chitose wants to use her own life for the sake of [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/131106/Tsukasa-Yuzaki) to pay her back. She obviously doesn't want [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/131106/Tsukasa-Yuzaki) falling into [Nasa](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki)'s hands. She has two maids: [Aurora](https://anilist.co/character/137516/Aurora) and [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/137517/Charlotte). Chitose has a personality that quickly bends from being strong to whining. She considers [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/131106/Tsukasa-Yuzaki) her sister.

(Source: Tonikaku Kawaii Wikia)

137516.description:
She is one of [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/137515/Chitose-Kaginoji)'s maids. She is usually serious and cold-minded. Probably the exact opposite personality of [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/137517/Charlotte): the second maid of [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/137515/Chitose-Kaginoji). She always appears with [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/137517/Charlotte) and she usually tries to stop her from being too impulsive. 

(Source: Tonikaku Kawaii Wikia)

137517.description: She is one of [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/137515/Chitose-Kaginoji)'s maids. She quickly changes her personality from being simple-minded and innocent to going berserk with a giant sword in her hands. However, she is always happy with a big smile on her face. She will probably do everything [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/137515/Chitose-Kaginoji) tells her to do without hesitation.
