137541.description: Ikkei is the former coach of Karasuno High's Boys' Volleyball Club. He once led the team to nationals and was well-known. After being hospitalized, he resigned from coaching the team.

137549.description:
Lala Hitomi is a minor character in the Hibike! Euphonium series. In the main series, she is a first-year student at Kitauji High School who plays the Horn in F. She is also the member of Monaka team.

(Source - Hibike! Euphonium WIki)

Child Emperor is a young boy with large eyes. He wears a plain T-shirt with two buttons both of which are buttoned, along with a black school bag on his back.

As a genius, the Child Emperor values education, which can be seen when he mentions about going to cram school even after hearing about the Earth being in danger. He easily becomes infuriated when being labeled as childish by others. He is very analytical, observing the situation and formulating plans in a calm and collected manner.

137773.description: Retired member of the Demon Slayer Corps, previously holding the title of Water Hashira. He is the main cultivator of the Water Breathing style, having trained [Makomo](https://anilist.co/character/137806/Makomo), [Sabito](https://anilist.co/character/137809/Sabito), [Giyuu Tomioka](https://anilist.co/character/130050/Tomioka-Giyuu), and [Tanjirou Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/126071/Kamado-Tanjirou).

137774.description:
__Height:__ 179cm (5'10½")

Demon Hunter and the Wind Pillar of the Demon Killing Corps. He is the older brother of [Genya Shinazugawa](https://anilist.co/character/137776).

Sanemi specializes in Wind Breathing, which has 9 forms. The technique consists of drawing the air from around the user to create whirlwind attacks that follow the user's movements. Form names include Dust Whirlwind Cutter, Claws-Purifying Wind, Clean Storm Wind Tree, Rising Dust Storm, Cold Mountain Wind, Black Wind Mountain Mist, Gale - Sudden Gusts, Primary Gale Slash, and Idaten Typhoon.

137775.description: Retired member of the Demon Slayer Corps, having previously held the title of Thunder Hashira. He trained Zenitsu Agatsuma and Kaigaku.

137776.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Genya Is a Demon Hunter of the Demon Killing Corps. He is also the younger brother of the Wind Pillar [Sanemi Shinazugawa](https://anilist.co/character/137774).

~! Due to his lack of breath forms he is dependent on using his shotgun and demon form. His shotgun pelts are made from sun steel to be effective against demons. His demon form is active when he digests anything from a demon to gain demon like strength and abilities. He is the only demon hunter to have this ability given that it is drastically rare !~

137777.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'3")

Obanai is a Demon Slayer and the Snake Pillar of the Demon Slayer Corps.

A young man of short stature and a pale complexion. He has straight-edged black hair of varying lengths, the longest reaching down to his shoulders and the shortest stopping at his cheekbones, which he wears down with two shorter strands hanging between his eyes. He wears a navy blue version of the standard Demon Slayer uniform, along with a black and white pinstriped haori, the hem and cuffs of which are striped lengthways rather than vertically, which covers his hands. Obanai also sports bandages in place of the leg-wraps around his calves, as well as another set of bandages that cover his mouth, and blue-strapped zori on his feet.

He is also always seen with his white snake, Kaburamaru, wrapped around his shoulders.

137778.description:
__Height:__ 220 cm (7'2½")

He is a Demon Slayer and the Stone Hashira of the Demon Slayer Corps. Gyomei also serves as the mentor of [Genya Shinazugawa](https://anilist.co/character/137776/Shinazugawa-Genya).

137806.description:
A cute and mysterious girl who wears a floral pattern kimono. Her fox mask has two flowers on its right cheek.

~!She is a former apprentice of [Sakonji Urokodaki](https://anilist.co/character/137773/Urokodaki-Sakonji).!~

137808.description: He is the head of the Ubuyashiki Family and 97th leader of the Demon Slayer Corps known mainly as "Oyakata-sama" ("Master") by his subordinates and peers.

137809.description:
He is a former apprentice of [Urokodaki Sakonji](https://anilist.co/character/137773/Urokodaki-Sakonji).

137816.description:
__Light Novel Volume 9 spoiler__

~! Nanahoshi Shizuka is a Japanese girl that was saved by [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) in his past life, but instead of reincarnating like Rudeus, she was teleported to Asura Kingdom and was saved by [Orsted](https://anilist.co/character/187382/Orsted). !~

137864.description:
__Species:__ Intelligent Weapon

Master is the main protagonist of the Tensei Shitara Ken Deshita series and the main weapon of [Fran](https://anilist.co/character/127603/Fran).

His personality is that of a father/guardian of sorts towards Fran, he takes care and protects her while also assisting her by providing his abilities and bonuses to Fran. Towards other people Master acts in a kind and well mannered way, except if that people disrespect or try to hurt Fran in any way or shape.

In sword form, Master looks like a white longsword with three blue lines on it. Beneath the pale gold hilt there is the sculpture of a courageous wolf and a decorative blue string. The handle is wound with a latticework of blue and white strings.

Before being reincarnated into a sword, he appeared to be a 30-year old salary man who enjoyed anime, manga, VRMMOs, and light novels. He had a friendly personality, enjoyed eating curry, and had some level of proficiency in cooking but had never dated before. He is killed at the start of the story by an oblivious driver who was texting and driving.

137972.description:
He is a witch and serves as the Watchful Eye for [Qifrey's](https://anilist.co/character/129841/Qifrey) atelier. He has a gruff way of speaking but his magic is often described as "warm". He has created a lot of magical items, such as the Glowstone Path, the Snugstone and the Searneedle Wand. His specialty is fire-based magic.

He is very caring to the apprentices and gives them things that might be helpful, as well as rushing to Qifrey's aid, but every time someone points out he's acting very nicely, he tries to brush it off as something anyone would do or to his work as watchful eye.

He is sentient and has three cores inside the doll body: the youngest brother "Panda", the eldest brother "Gorilla" and a sister.

137975.description:

Toudou is a third-year student at Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School who possesses inhuman physical strength, durability, and speed. 

~!He is able to use a technique called Boogie Woogie, in which he can switch the position of two things that posses a certain amount of curse energy within his range.!~

138100.description: __Height:__ 99.5 cm (3'2") __Occupation:__ First-Grade Student, Test Subject (Formerly) __Affiliation:__ Eden Academy, Unknown Organization (Formerly) __Relatives:__ Loid Forger (Adoptive Father), Yor Forger (Adoptive Mother) Anya Forger is the deuteragonist of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is a young girl who Twilight finds at an orphanage. Believing her to be a smart child, he decides to adopt her for his mission. What he doesn't know is that Anya is an esper who escaped from the Lab that gave her the power to read minds. Starving for excitement in her life after spending most of it so far in a lab, Anya actively sought to be the one adopted by Loid and then make sure Loid and Yor got together, so she could have a spy and assassin for parents. Anya is the only Forger aware of just about everyone's Secret Identities, but keeps it to herself out of fear that if her psychic powers are exposed she'll be put in a lab again.

name.native: ロイド・フォージャー

138101.description: __Height:__ 187 cm __Occupation:__ Psychiatrist, Spy (Covertly) __Affiliation:__ Berlint General Hospital, WISE (Covertly) __Relatives:__ Yor Forger (Wife), Anya Forger (Adoptive Daughter) Loid Forger is the main protagonist of the SPY x FAMILY series. He is the top spy of the Westalian Intelligence Bureau, who is only known by his code name Twilight. In order to investigate the activities of a highly ranked politician, Donovan Desmond, Twilight has assumed the identity of a psychiatrist named Loid Forger. Further, to appear like a normal family man and get close to his target, Loid then adopted a young orphan girl, Anya, and entered a Marriage of Convenience with an Ostanian woman named Yor Briar... who unknown to Twilight are themselves a Telepath and Professional Killer respectively.

138102.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm
__Occupation:__ City Hall Clerk, Assassin (Covertly)
__Affiliation:__ Berlint City Hall, Garden (Covertly)
__Relatives:__ [Loid Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Loid-Forger) (Husband), [Anya Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Anya-Forger) (Adoptive Daughter), [Yuuri Briar](https://anilist.co/character/150425/Yuuri-Briar) (Younger Brother)

Yor Forger is the tritagonist of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is a clerical employee at the Berlint City Hall. She is soft-spoken and mild-mannered, but has a strong sense of humor. She has a bad drinking habit and falls into a coma when she drinks. At home, she struggles to be a good wife and a kind mother. Although her cooking skills are not very good, she likes to keep clean and is good at cleaning.
While she works in the capital of Ostania's city hall... or at least that's her civilian cover. In truth, she is an infamous Professional Killer known as "Thorn Princess". After becoming overly fixated on the idea her cover might be blown after a coworker ribs her about not being married or even having a boyfriend, Yor suggests to Loid a Marriage of Convenience, which he accepts, as he needs a mother for Anya for his own mission.

~!As of Mission (Chapter) 44, it is revealed that Yor is part of Garden, a powerful paramilitary assassin organization operating within Ostania.!~

138136.description: He is a member of a wealthy family who happened to have close relations with Lord Seaetto. He is respected by the Demi-humans of his region. His name was not mentioned and Naofumi nicknames him as "Nice Guy."

138137.description:
Makoto Misumi is the Main Protagonist of this series. He is a one of the three World Traveler's who got sent to the [Goddess](https://anilist.co/character/221535/Megami)' World.

Originally meant to be the only person to be sent to the other world as per the contract between his parents and the Goddess, but because of her own preferences in beauty standards, she abandons and throws Makoto to the edge of her world into the Wasteland, while secretly kidnapping two other people from Earth and sending them to her world as Heroes. [Tsukuyomi](https://anilist.co/character/195917/Tsukuyomi), the Moon God of Earth who worked as the middleman for the completion of the contract, helped Makoto and provided him with his blessing and told him to be free and live as he wants to.

~!In the Goddess' World, he is also known by the alias "Raidou Kuzunoha" (in WN/LN) or "Makoto Kuzunoha" (in Manga), a powerful merchant and skilled teacher.!~

138138.description:
Tomoe is one of the Greater Dragons, existing in the World of the Goddess. She is presently in servitude of [Makoto Misumi](https://anilist.co/character/138137/Misumi-Makoto).

She tends to have an easy-going personality, likes taking on new challenges and learning interesting things related to the Edo period of Japan. Different from her previously lazy and disˈinterested outlook of the world.

She's not serious at times to a dangerous degree.

She finds great enjoyment in seeing what changes would come from Makoto and especially learning things from his memories.

138139.description: She is previously referred to​ as the Black Spider of Calamity and is a unique existence in the Goddess' World. She is presently in servitude of [Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/138137/Misumi-Makoto). She can be single-minded and straightforward in her loyalty to Makoto to the point that it reaches a dangerous level. She has no qualms about destroying anyone who intends to do harm to Makoto.

138595.description:
__Species:__ Mixed Blood (currently), Demon (formerly)

Anos is the reincarnation of the man who was feared as the Demon King of Tyranny 2,000 years ago. He is resolute, stalwart, and invincible. His absolute power instils a veritable self-confidence that is only surpassed by his ego. Because of his overwhelming prowess, Anos possesses an easy going attitude and an unrivalled sense of perseverance when facing any challenge that may come his way.

Despite his title as the Demon King, Anos has a definitive moral compass and generally has a kind and caring outlook. He takes a great interest in the well-being of not only his family, but also his subordinates and followers, and is quick to reward them for their loyalty. He is willing to go through great lengths to assist in their development, in order for them to reach their full potential. Other people may see him as cruel, but his personal creed is not to kill people needlessly. Even if he would never admit it, Anos is very protective of his fellow subordinates and followers.

While Anos is not inherently evil, his chaotic and sometimes ruthless methods when dealing with his enemies, earned him his title. While he originally never proclaimed himself as the Demon King, he has openly embraced it as the rest of the world views him as such. Those who oppose him, fear his power, and are threatened by the mere fact that a single man possesses such power. 

(Source: Maou Gakuin wiki)

138596.description: Misha is a student at Delzogade, the Demon King Academy. She quickly becomes friends with [Anos](https://anilist.co/character/138595/Voldigoad-Anos) after they meet. Her magic power is quite high among most students at Delzogade.

138598.description: Kanon is a hero that battles against Anos. He seems to have a mutual respect with Anos, with both of them understanding each other. Before Anos was slain by Kanon, Anos wished they could be friends in 2000 years, should they ever meet.

138709.description:
Mizuha is a kind and cheerful girl and acts somewhat air headed and cute at times. She is good at giving different types of advice to her brother [Keiki](https://anilist.co/character/135801/Keiki-Kiryuu) and cares for him dearly. She enjoys being pampered by him.

~!She appears to be a normal girl who gets along well with her brother, but is later shown to be a pervert as she is an exhibitionist who not only strips in her brother's room, but also does not wear her panties to school on a regular basis.!~ 

~!She is revealed to be the 'Cinderella' that Keiki was looking for and after this is also shown that Mizuha is actually not blood-related to Keiki.!~

138710.description:
She is somewhat of an introvert, she's quiet, passive and is a bit of a loner. The only person she is seen talking to in class is [Keiki](https://anilist.co/character/135801/Keiki-Kiryuu) whom she most likely has romantic feelings towards. She is shown to be quite open with Keiki however and gives him advice as well as acting like a tsundere towards him at times.
~! She turns out to be a fujoshi who wants to create a yaoi manga/doujin involving Keiki and his friend [Shouma](https://anilist.co/character/138711/Shoma-Akiyama). !~

138713.description:
Yao Chen has long white hair and wide red eyes. His skin is very pale and has a tall, lean figure. Have great pride, protective and benevolent.

He was abandoned by his own clan, Yao clan because he born with a very thin amount of Dou Qi in his blood.

He founded Falling Star Pavilion along with Feng Zunzhe before going out to adventure. In the past, Yao Lao traveled the world with his friends who were all Dou Zun.

He won the first place in a competition held by Pill Tower and asked to join the inner circle of Pill Tower but he turn down the chance and also an elder of the Pill Tower holds romantic feelings towards him.

He spent 8 years waiting for the Bone Chilling Flame.

He was the most respectable and skilful alchemist in the whole southern region of the Central Plain. He is the master of the Yao Wang, Han Feng and Xiao Yan's mother, Gu Wen Xin, but been betrayed and killed by his disciple Han Feng who got the help from Spirit Hall. After his death, his first disciple Gu Wen Xin seal his spirit in a ring to keep him safe from Han Feng. After Gu Wen Xin passed away, she give the ring to his son, Xiao Yan.

Yushiro is a traveling companion of Tamayo and close ally of Kamado Tanjirou. He was turned into a Demon by Tamayo. Yushiro was a human who was under the care of Tamayo as she was practicing as a medical practitioner. He was in the frail state fighting disease when Tamayo gave him the choice of succumbing to his illness or to live longer as a Demon. He agreed to become a Demon and has since stayed by Tamayo's side serving as an assistant as well as her guard.
~!Yushiro would become the last known survivor of the Demon race. In time he would dedicate himself to a life of art and become a world famous painter in the present day under the name of Yushiro Yamamoto, known for his paintings of Tamayo to wide critical acclaim!~

138847.description:

Tamayo is a doctor and close ally of [Kamado Tanjirou](https://anilist.co/character/126071/Kamado-Tanjirou). She was turned into a Demon by [Kibutsuji Muzan](https://anilist.co/character/129132/Kibutsuji-Muzan).

138849.description: [Mitsumi](https://anilist.co/character/138851/Iwakura-Mitsumi)'s classmate and her first friend in Tokyo. Her popularity among boys made her develop a complex about being shunned by other girls. She studied abroad in her childhood and has blonde hair, so people assume she is good at English, but according to herself she is not that good at it.

138850.description: [Mitsumi's](https://anilist.co/character/138851/Iwakura-Mitsumi) classmate who is popular with girls. He is known for sabotaging the entrance ceremony and skipping classes. Though he planned to skip the entrance ceremony, he meets Mitsumi and they run to school together.

138851.description: First-year high school student who moved to Tokyo from the outskirts of Ishikawa Prefecture near Suzu. Raised a child prodigy, she entered high school at the top of her class; however, she has no athletic ability. Her pure personality unintentionally influences the people around her. She has a younger sister and brother.

138875.description: Kahaku is the sixth successor of the Defense Corps and the first male successor of [Hayase](https://anilist.co/character/136545/Hayase)'s will.

name.full: Bonchien Nicoli La Tasty Peach Uralis
name.native: ボンシェン・ニコリ・ラ・テイスティピーチ・ウラリス

138876.description: Bonchien is the prince of the Uralis Kingdom.

138897.description:
Sumireko Sanshokuin is one of the three initial heroines introduced in the series. Her nickname, Pansy, is a wordplay from her full name 三色院菫子. When the 院 and 子 removed, the remaining character (三色菫) form the Japanese name for Viola tricolor or Wild Pansy flower. She is usually called by her nickname to those who are close to her. Initially introduced as a librarian committee member with a petite build and plain face, she spends her time observing people who come to the library and somehow took interest in [Kisaragi Amatsuyu](https://anilist.co/character/138900). She is known to be gloomy by the majority of the student. She usually ties her hair in braids. In actuality, she hid her true looks behind plain getup and a "sarashi" to bind her chest to make it smaller than it actually is. Amatsuyu describes her true looks as "Big Breasted Cuties". In her true form, she is admittedly beautiful, even rivaling the school's beauty queens, [Cosmos](https://anilist.co/character/138899) and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/138898). Her personality is generally polite to her peers, only turning sharp-tongued when interacting with Amatsuyu. She is shown to be a rather observant character, as she is able to assess a situation from the sideline. She also has above-average intellect, shown by her capability to tutor her fellow friends. Beneath her gloom and timid look, she hides a strong charismatic presence. Although she is beautiful, she is not comfortable showing people her true form as she stated that she'd only let Amatsuyu see her in her true form when asked to change her looks in general by Amatsuyu. She is good at Classic Literature. She doesn't like Math. 

She is the original affection object of Taiyou Oga. The thing she wants the most is "a preserved, confined, and ornamented Joro". When asked whether she wants a dog or a cat, she picked Amatsuyu, reinforcing the fact of her infatuation for Amatsuyu. She also has never read a manga before. She compared herself to a chameleon, alluding to her double-faced nature that hides her true look to blend with the background. She likes to stalk Amatsuyu, as she stated that it'll be the most likely thing for her to do first thing in the morning. She's a morning person. She likes Western Food. Her favorite season is Spring. She hates eating konyaku and she also hates cars.

138898.description: Aoi Hinata is a second year high school student and is also the ace of the school's Tennis Club.

138899.description: Sakura Akino is a third-year high school student and the Student Council President who is in love with [Taiyo Oga](https://anilist.co/character/138901).

138900.description: Amatsuyu Kisaragi, nicknamed Joro (如雨露 Jōro )is a second year High School student and the Student Council secretary (being replaced during the Confession Arc) who is the object of affection of [Sumireko Sanshokuin](https://anilist.co/character/138897), [Sakura Akino](https://anilist.co/character/138899), [Aoi Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/138898), [Asaka Mayama](https://anilist.co/character/152047) and [Hina Hanetachi](https://anilist.co/character/149583).

138901.description: Taiyou Ooga is a second year High School student and the ace of the school Baseball Club. He is in love with [Sumireko Sanshokuin](https://anilist.co/character/138897/Sanshokuin-Sumireko) and was once the target of affection of [Aoi Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/138898/Hinata-Aoi) and [Sakura Akino](https://anilist.co/character/138899/Akino-Sakura).

138981.description:
__Race__: Human
__Age__: 25
__Abilities__: Superhuman Speed and Agility, Master Swordsman, Ninjutsu Master
__Occupation__: Superhero
__S-Class__: Rank 13

__Personality__: Flashy Flash is a calm and serious man but he also appears to be quite arrogant. Despite his collected composure, Flashy Flash has a tendency to be hasty and reckless. 

__Abilities__: As an S-Class hero, Flashy Flash is very powerful. In terms of speed, Flashy Flash is arguably the fastest S-Class hero in the association, except for Blast and Saitama. Flashy was shown to be strong enough to combat and kill two Dragon-level threats simultaneously. He can deliver powerful kicks that can stun Dragon-level monsters. He can also easily cut massive pieces of stone and create giant explosions throughout his fighting.

138988.description: The Hand Demon was a notorious Demon that killed thirteen of Urokodaki Sakonji's apprentices, including Sabito and Makomo.

138990.description: Hotaru Haganezuka is a swordsmith affiliated with the Demon Killing Corps.

139038.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1½")

Kanao Tsuyuri is a Demon Hunter and the Tsuguko, who is personally looked after by the Demon Killing Corps' Pillars. She uses Flower Breathing.

~!When Kanao is first introduced, she is an indecisive and quiet girl due to the abuse she endured in her past before meeting the Kocho sisters. She became unable to make decisions by herself and repressed her emotions as a defense mechanism. In order to help rectify this, Kanae gave her a coin to flip to decide which path to follow when she didn't know what to do.

Later on, Tanjiro helps Kanao overcome her indecisiveness and Kanao soon becomes more confident in making decisions with or without her coin.

Kanao and Tanjiro would eventually marry and start a family, having two great-great-grandchildren by the names of [Kanata Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/171144/Kanata-Kamado) and [Sumihiko Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/171145/Sumihiko-Kamado) between them.!~

139039.description: Kanae Kocho was a Demon Slayer and the late Flower Hashira. She was slain several years prior to the present story. She is also the biological older sister of [Shinobu Kochou](https://anilist.co/character/136070/Shinobu-Kochou) and the adoptive older sister of [Kanao Tsuyuri](https://anilist.co/character/139038/Tsuyuri-Kanao).

139159.description:
Mugi's senior at high school. Mugi turned to her after being unable to initially confess to Akane and they had sex. Afterwards, Mei apologizes to Mugi for rushing him into it.

(Source: Wikipedia)

139285.description:
She is Yoshichika's Covenanter and a goddess from Tetra Heaven.

She found Yoshichika's lost Logic Card and asked him to make her his Covenanter. It is hinted that she might be in love with Yoshichika.

139307.description: A mysterious, jolly and seemingly supernatural salesman who offers people a chance to "fill the gap in their heart" free of charge. He always presents a specific set of conditions to follow in order for his client's wish to come true and warns them of the consequences that could follow. Over the course of each series, he punishes those that break the rules of their respective agreements - despite his warnings - using his signature "Boom!" ("ドーン!") gesture.

139308.description:
Appeared briefly in episode 8. He was bullying Manabu Ogiwara.

~!After Manabu confronts him, he peed his pants out of fear.!~

name.native: フレア・アールグランデ・ジオラル

139397.description:
She is the Magic Hero and the main heroine. She is the princess of the Jioral Kingdom.

~!After Keyaru's revenge on her, she becomes Freia, Keyaruga's companion and slave.!~

name.native: ノルン・クラタリッサ・ジオラル

139398.description:
She is the second princess on the Jioral Kingdom and the younger sister of Flare.

~!Keyaruga later wipes her memories and tells everyone that she is his little sister who he recently reunited with.!~

139400.description:
As a child, Keyaru was a simple and kind boy. After discovering that he is a hero, he sets out to save the world and meets [Flare](https://anilist.co/character/139397/Arlgrande-Jioral-Flare), but he does not realize her true intentions. After being imprisoned, beaten, drugged and raped his behavior changes and he becomes a vengeful and sadistic person. After defeating the demon queen, he use her Philosopher's Stone to go back in time 4 years and swear revenge on Flare.

After the time reset, he recovers his memory and he gains new skills by making a pact with the spirits of the stars. He also acquires the skill Toxin Resistance, useful in resisting drugs.

Being the healer hero, his main power is Heal, which has many variations and different effects.

name.native: クレハ・クライレット

139401.description: Kureha Clyret is a former knight of Jioral Kingdom. She is highly renowned as the Blade Goddess and Sword Saint. She initially opposes Keyaru's party, but eventually allies with them and betrayed the Jioral Kingdom after learning of her kingdom's atrocities and misguided preconceptions as well as realising that she was only a pawn to them.

139402.description: Setsuna is an Ice Wolf Clan, female, Demi-human, who was captured and sold into slavery by Knights. She was Purchased by Keyaru, joining his party to become stronger and to seek revenge on the Jioral Kingdom.

139414.description:
A girl who was rescued by Kidou in the beginning of the series after her father died. She was said to be raised in a pasture. 

She was actually conceived for the pure purpose of controlling bugs. She has a unique ability to turn people nearby who hear her screech into a cagaster and control them.

139415.description: Kidou is an exterminator that lives in Trade City E-05 in Soutwest Asia on the borders of the Extreme East. His profession forces him to live a life of danger, and he is extremely efficient at killing Cagasters.

139432.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Weight:__ 76 kg (168 lbs.)
__Eye color:__ Blue
__Hometown:__ Mousanish District

Zack is a genius with an IQ of 200 whose field of expertise is space science. He even has a spaceship pilot's license. He and [Quitterie](https://anilist.co/character/122754/Raffaeli-Quitterie) have been friends since they were little due to their parents being coworkers.

~!He ends up marrying Quitterie.!~

139437.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")
__Hometown:__ Mousanish District

Luca is deft with their hands and has a strong artistic sense.

~!Luca is an intersex person and possesses both male and female sexual and reproductive organs. He currently identifies as male, but he explains how being male or female can feel fluid to him and can fluctuate by the day.!~

~!He was adopted and raised by [Senator Marco Esposito](https://anilist.co/character/157841/Esposito-Marco).!~

139460.description:
~!Kiriya Ubuyashiki is the son and middle child of Kagaya Ubuyashiki.
He is the current head of the Ubuyashiki Household and leader of the Demon Slaying Corps!~

139461.description:
Yayoi is the main protagonist of the Dark Gathering series. She is a young girl with a spiritual constitution who's collecting dangerous ghost in order to get enough power to rescue her mother's spirit from an evil ghost, the Spectre of Death.

She's obsessed with the occult stemming from her desire for revenge on the Spectre of Death for taking her mother's spirit. She will do almost anything to save her. That includes using any kinds of ghost, even if they are extremely evil.

Despite this obsession she has a strong moral compass. She will punish ghost that have killed many people, but she will be kind to those who unwillingly became corrupted. She knows that what she is doing is dangerous and will always put the safety of others as her top priority. She loves her friends and family dearly and has a strong desire to protect them.

139462.description: Keitaro Gentoga is a young man with a spiritual constitution, the tutor of Yayoi Hozuki and the childhood friend of Eiko Hozuki. He can feel the presence of supernatural beings, and his presence attracts supernatural beings, even Yayoi who can see supernatural beings is often ignored. In order to not be easily possessed, Keitarou was taught by his grandmother to exercise and meditate regularly, because supernatural beings have difficulty possessing people with healthy bodies and minds, as a result, Keitarou is quite athletic, able to run around the altar, then carry Yayoi while escape from the pursuit of malicious gods and spirits.

139463.description: Keitarou's childhood friend and Yayoi's cousin. ~!She has installed a GPS tracker, listening devices, etc., to spy on Keitarou. Shares the same curse as him and wears a white glove on her left hand as a result.!~

139523.description: A wing spiker on the Karasuno Neighborhood Association Team.

139525.description: A college student and a middle blocker in the Karasuno Neighborhood Association Team.

139541.description: The third amorphous child who replaces Yayaka. Unlike Toto and Yuyu, Nyunyu is lively and expresses many emotions. She gets along with TT-392, though she has wrecked it once. ~!Nyunyu quickly changes sides from Asclepius to Flip Flap, and continues to hang out with the crew.!~

name.native: ココナのおばあちゃん

139542.description: Cocona's grandmother who has looked after her for years. She is paraplegic, being unable to use her legs. She cares for Cocona, usually asking her if anything is wrong if Cocona is distressed.

139543.description:
An invasive Pure Illusion Defense Mechanism from the desert world. Welwitschia is manipulative, reading into Cocona and saying how she feels deep down about Papika. She's also quite resilient and strong, causing her to be a difficult foe. When Cocona first meets her, she is seen with a harem of girls in bondage gear.

Welwitschia has a wild personality, often making suggestive remarks, be it visually or verbally. Additionally, she is a sadomasochist, enjoying it when she hurts others or is hurt herself. Despite her human-like appearance, Welwitschia is able to turn into a hideous monster, likely being her true form.

139544.description:
An inhabitant and creator of the futuristic city in Pure Illusion. Pops is an eccentric inventor that has created many things, including the mechas that Cocona and Papika piloted. 

Pops is a small man, being shorter than Cocona and Papika. He has heterochromia, with is left eye being yellow and his right eye being blue. Pops sports a large ego, which makes up for his size. He's also the same age as Cocona and Papika.

139545.description:
The girl Cocona sees in her dreams. 
~!Mimi is Cocona's mother and former partner of Papikana. She lived her life in the Asclepius factory, being experimented on due to her ability to go to Pure Illusion. During her time in the factory, she was good friends with Papikana and Salt.!~~!Her love and wish to protect her daughter manifested into a split personality. That personality led to her usual caring self being turned into an overprotective mother; who was willing to harm old friends, and even Cocona, to protect her. As such, she is ruthless and nearly unstoppable while her overprotective personality is in control.!~

139557.description:
The mother of reincarnated Anos. She cares for [Anos](https://anilist.co/character/138595/Voldigoad-Anos), loving him constantly. She is married to [Gusta](https://anilist.co/character/139560/Raizeo-Gusta).

When Anos brings home [Misha](https://anilist.co/character/138596/Necron-Misha), Izabella is quick to jump the gun and assumes that Anos is together with Misha. She decides that is the case and supports it through and through.

name.native: エミリア・ルードウェル

139558.description: The homeroom teacher of the class [Anos](https://anilist.co/character/138595/Voldigoad-Anos) is in. Initially, Emilia holds no respect towards Anos; however, that changes after he proves himself to her.

139559.description: Considered a demon duke by some, Zepes is an arrogant student at Delzogade. He is the younger brother of Leorig Indu.

139560.description:
The father of reincarnated Anos. As a father, he cares for Anos and is accepting of his abilities. He is also married to Izabella.

When Anos brought Misha to his place, Gusta figured Anos hooked up with Misha, accepting it right away; even willing to distract Issabelle so they can do the deed, to Anos' dismay.

139561.description: A pure-blood descendant of the Demon Lord. Leorig dislikes disgraceful people that tarnish the pure-blood descendants of the Demon Lord. He is also the older brother of Zepis Indu. Like his brother, he is arrogant, but not to the same extent.

139562.description:
A member of the House of Necron and direct descendant of [Ivis Necron](https://anilist.co/character/186471/Necron-Ivis). Sasha Necron is called the, "Witch of Destruction," by others.  She has the Demon Eyes of Destruction, which allow her to destroy anything she chooses within her field of view. 

Sasha is the older sister of [Misha Necron](https://anilist.co/character/138596/Necron-Misha). Sasha has a cold personality towards her sister, calling her a, "defective doll." Towards others, she acts superior and above them, due to her status. Though she does act as such, she is able to respect others and be friendly towards them.

139576.description:
Pyotr is a social media celebrity who participated in the Mars' Brightest. He later forms a duo group with GGK.

(Source: Carole and Tuesday Wiki)

139631.description:
__Height:__ 160cm
__Family:__ [Mamoru Yotsuya](https://anilist.co/character/250703/Mamoru-Yotsuya) (Father), [Touko Yotsuya](https://anilist.co/character/199025/Touko-Yotsuya) (Mother), [Kyousuke Yotsuya](https://anilist.co/character/199026/Kyousuke-Yotsuya) (Younger Brother)

Miko has the ability to see frightening supernatural things that most people can't, but she pretends that she can't see them to avoid conflict. Her Spiritual-Awareness power overpowers her sight, like the reflection in glass is overpowering and you're unable to see what lies beyond it.

She tries to have a stoic exterior when confronted with spirits, but is internally frightened by them. She also cares deeply for her friend [Hana Yurikawa](https://anilist.co/character/139632/Hana-Yurikawa), using her power to protect her in various ways, such as diverting her from certain routes with spirits and bringing her food when she was sick with a form of spiritual drainage. Miko prefers to ignore the spirits and she denies seeing them whenever she is confronted by others for her talents.

139632.description:
__Height:__ 156cm

[Miko's](https://anilist.co/character/139631) close friend. She is clueless of the supernatural terrors that afflict her friend, but she does unknowingly attract a lot of them due to her unusual amount of life energy.

139671.description:
The leader of the Pretty Boy Detective Club. Also known as "Manabu the Aesthete." Mayumi calls him "the leader."

He is so stupid that he claims to be uneducated and acts cheerfully and arrogantly without reading the atmosphere, but always seeks beauty and will not do anything that goes against aesthetics. Although he often does nothing but gives orders, he is recognized as a leader by the group.

~!It's revealed at the end of the first volume that he's a 5th grade at Yubiwa Academy Elementary School.!~

139703.description:
He is [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/139710)'s younger brother who is an elementary student. Despite being young, he is popular with the girls due to his "mature behavior".

(Source: Tenki no Ko Wikia, edited)

139709.description:
__Height__: >173 cm

Hodaka is a high school student of average build with medium length black hair and light brown eyes. He is often seen wearing a plain black t-shirt and jeans along with his yellow knapsack that he carries along everywhere he goes. Hodoka ran away from his parents and home to live a new life in Tokyo as his previous life was too "suffocating" for him. However, after arriving in Tokyo, he struggled to live the new life he was hoping for and was forced to live in manga cafes and in the streets. Fortunately, he met [Keisuke Suga](https://anilist.co/character/139707/Keisuke-Suga), a writer for a small editing company, who took him in as an employee and gave Hodoka a roof over his head.

Hodoka is a courageous boy as he was able to leave his home by himself and start a new life in Tokyo. Accompanying his courageous trait however is an impulsive nature which often leads him to make irrational choices that cause many misunderstandings.

139710.description:
__Height:__ > 160 cm

Hina is a young and cheerful girl with long black-blue hair tied into twin ponytails and large blue eyes. She wears a blue stone necklace and often wears a grey hoodie over a sleeveless dress. Hina takes in many jobs in other to support her younger brother who is still in elementary school. She possesses the ability to clear the weather for a short period of time in a desired area by praying to the sky which she obtained after praying and walking through a Torii (traditional Japanese gate) on the roof of an abandoned building.

Hina is a cheerful, energetic, and strong-willed teen. She is also a caring and kind individual as seen when she gives [Hodoka](https://anilist.co/character/139709/Morishima-Hodaka) a free burger when she noticed he looked lost. She uses her power to clear the weather to brighten people's days and see the smiles on their face.

~!It was later revealed that she's only 15 years old.!~

139737.description:
__Race:__ Demon
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")

Enmu is a sadistic and cruel demon  Who is only driven by his liking to making humans suffer. He is shown to be completely loyal to [Muzan](https://anilist.co/character/129132/Kibutsuji-Muzan). Caring about him probably more than what he cares about himself. He also hates the other lower moons, labeling them as "Fools".

~!Enmu was a member of the Twelve Demon Moons, having held the position of Lower Moon One.!~

~!Enmu was aboard the infinity train, and starts eating humans in order to make himself more powerful. He knocks them unconscious, promising them that he will gift them with nice and peaceful dreams but in reality, after giving them a nice dream, he always likes to follow it up with a horrifying nightmare because he thinks it is so much fun.!~

~!In the end, Tanjiro's Hinokami Kagura cuts through Enmu's train spine and kills him.!~

139738.description:
~!Kyougai was a member of the Twelve Demon Moons, having held the position of Lower Moon Six. He is also known as Drum Demon.!~

(Source: Kimetsu no Yaiba Fandom, edited)

139739.description:
~!Rui was a member of the Twelve Demon Moons, having held the position of Lower Moon Five.!~

(Source: Kimetsu no Yaiba Fandom)

139740.description: ~!The Older Brother Spider Demon was a member of the Spider Family.!~

name.native: グレゴリオ・ツェペリ

139789.description:
Gregorio Zeppeli is a side character featured in Steel Ball Run who is Gyro's father and an executioner of the nation of Naples.
Gregorio Zeppeli is a somber and serious man, whose loyalty lies in his king and his family. Stating that true happiness lies in the family, Gregorio considers that protecting and honoring one's family is one's true obligation. He has taught his eldest son Gyro everything he knows, wishing to impart all of his family's traditions and honor his ancestors' work.

139795.description: Azusa Sumiyoshi was one of the top high school players during his high school days. He was seeded 2nd for the All Japan tournament. He reached the semi finals of the same tournament.

139799.description: Takahashi Kousuke was the top seed in the All Japan Tournament during his 3rd year high school. He was the semi finalist in the tournament which was later won by Yu Nabae.

139886.description: He sent Tamahiko to his family's mansion in Chiba and purchased a bride for him for ¥200,000.

139894.description: A young man born into a wealthy family in Meiji 38. A year before the manga starts, he was in a car accident that resulted in his mother dying and the loss of complete use of his right arm. He was given his family's mansion in Chiba, and a bride was purchased to assist him for ¥200,000.

139895.description: Tamahiko's bride. She was purchased for ¥200,000 by Tamahiko's father.

140036.description: The mother of Kumiko and Mamiko.

140039.description:
Rin Nanakura is the main protagonist of Pseudo Harem. She is a part of Kouban High's drama club and uses her acting skills to tease her fellow club member, [Eiji Kitahama](https://anilist.co/character/140040), with various personas in hopes of making him fall for her.

She has a friendly personality, although she is somewhat shy about her feelings for her crush, leading her to adopt a pseudo-personality for his enjoyment. She can also make others laugh and enjoy laughing herself.

Rin is a highly skilled actress who can imitate various personality types of girls for Eiji, including cheeky, tsundere, "cool," and cute. She's also a hard worker.

140040.description: Eiji Kitahama is the love interest of [Rin Nanakura](https://anilist.co/character/140039). While attending Kouban High, he meets Rin at his drama club. Rin decides to fulfill his wish of having a harem.

140043.description:
He was a member of an idol group and also acted in some movies. He disappeared during the event of 8/31. When she was younger, Kadode was obsessed with him.

~!His body was taken over by an invader child during the 8/31 event and ever since he has been living as an invader in the human body.!~

140276.description:
Kazuki's younger brother.
~!He has to use a wheelchair since he got hit by a car.!~ ~!Later revealed to be Kazuki's stepbrother!~

140290.description: Nagamasa is the leader of the survival game team Hoshishiro, which is the name of the hospital he works as a doctor at along with his teammates Fujimon and Ichi. He initially appears to be a very kind man, but he is the object of Tooru and Masamune's resentment due to what took place in the past. It is revealed that he beat up two former Toy Gun Gun players, but it was all within the rules of TGC. He and Masamune used to be close partners, but after being told by another survival game player that Masamune was also a strong vanguard, Nagamasa was convinced to end their partnership. Although brutal during survival games, Nagamasa is known to show kindness outside of it. He knows that Hotaru is a girl but kept a secret though it ended being a blackmail for Hotaru.

140292.description: Kanae is Hotaru's best friend​ and was first aware of her being a girl. Kanae has a very feminine and lively persona. Although her actions and words can be perceived as immature and spontaneous, she genuinely cares about the well-being of others and is very encouraging.

140293.description: Ichi is a skilled sniper in her Team Hoshishiro and is deeply devoted to Midori to the point where no one can touch him except for Ichi herself. Ichi works at a hospital, and that's where she meet her teammates Midori and Fujimoto. As part of the strongest and most feared team, her sniping and surviving skills may be considered top notch along with her teammates.

140294.description: Fujimoto works in the same hospital as his teammates in Hoshishiro, and he is very loyal to Nagamasa Midori, and is also verbal abused by his other teammate Ichi Akabane. He is known as the Assault Destroyer, being able to defeat enemies quickly and without them feeling the pain. He carries a machine gun which weighs 20 kg but doesn't put him in a disadvantage.

140404.description:
__Affiliation:__ Adventurer
__Species__: Human

Yukikaze is an Adventurer of the series Maou-sama, Retry! 
He presents as female and expresses lustful interest in Hakuto Kunai. Yukikaza is referred to as a "girlish boy".

140636.description:
__Species__: Demigod

Brunhilde is the eldest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the main protagonist of the series.

She is the one who chose humanity's finest and strongest warriors in Ragnarok to stand up against the strongest gods in combat and slay them in an attempt to save Humanity.

140637.description:
Adam was a very calm, collected, and carefree individual; speaking to Zeus in a very casual manner, much to the chagrin of the other gods present.
We later find out that Adam holds no grudge against heaven, despite the fact the Serpent assaulted Eve and then framed her when he was elsewhere, resulting in humanity's banishment from Eden. However, at the same time, he did not hesitate to kill the Serpent the moment he attacked them.

Adam loved Eve, so much so that he abandoned the paradise of Eden without a second thought when his wife was banished.

Adam displayed selflessness to the highest degree, pushing himself past his limits in his fight against a god to give humanity a bit of hope. Adam's love for his children was strong enough that, even in a battle for his life, he only thought of protecting humanity from anyone who'd try and do them harm. 

~!He was Humanity's representative in the second round of Ragnarok.!~

140638.description:
__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Similar to Lü Bu, Thor is a battle maniac and takes great interest in fighting; especially with strong and/or worthy opponents. Furthermore, he only shows happiness and joy in combat, displaying his finest smile in the first round of Ragnarok. Thor is also a man of few words, not speaking unless absolutely necessary or when in combat. He often does not show this and has a more stoic and aloof expression on his face most of the time, making him seem unapproachable to others.

~!Thor is the Gods' representative in the first round of Ragnarok.!~

140640.description:
__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Zeus is a prominent deity and the Supreme God in the Greek Pantheon. He is also the chairman of the Gods' Council and often referred to as the "God Father of Cosmos"

When addressing his fellow gods, Zeus is extremely calm and authoritative while possessing a very formal and wise disposition. Like most gods, Zeus holds his own kind to a superior and extremely high standard, always expecting them to win no matter the odds, and seething with anger when they lose to humans. Zeus is also an eccentric individual, having random exaggerated emotional outbursts, breaking into a dance at the start of the second round of Ragnarok in front of everyone present, even being called the most shameful god by Hermes.

However, after several rounds of Ragnarok passed, Zeus became more humble, even acknowledging Humanity's strength. He is also extremely faithful and confident in those of the Greek Pantheon.

~!Zeus is the Gods' representative in the second round of Ragnarok.!~

140641.description:
Poseidon is a prominent deity in the Greek Pantheon as the God of the Seas.

~!Poseidon is the Gods' representative in the third round of Ragnarok.!~

140668.description: Enta's older sister, and teacher to Kazuki and Toi.

140696.description: A young human girl who is found by [Golem](https://anilist.co/character/140697/Golem) in his forest. She has endless curiosity, which usually gets her in trouble. She wears a hood on her head with minotaur horns to hide her human features since humans are a delicacy in the monster world.

140697.description:
An ancient automaton protector of the forest who stumbles upon [Somali](https://anilist.co/character/140696/Somali) while patrolling the woods. He exhibits no emotions, but instinctively protects Somali from any potential threat. He acts like Somali's father and is referred by her as "Dad".

~!It is soon revealed that every Golem only lives 1000 years, and this Golem is approaching it's 1000th year. It feels a responsibility to deliver Somali to humans before that happens!~

140802.description: Nao Sadatsuka is a 92nd Tootsuki Generation student of Tootsuki Culinary Academy. Nao holds a deep harboring affection towards Erina Nakiri. Nao would do anything to get close to Erina including sending her 30 letters daily or watching her from afar using binoculars.

140828.description:
Melida is a girl born in a family of Holy Knights but with no talent with mana.

(Source: ANN)

140829.description:
Elise is Melida's cousin and a Holy Knight who can use mana unlike Melida. She boasts the most talent in her class despite her stoic, silent nature.

(Source: ANN)

name.native: クーファ=ヴァンピール

140830.description:
Kufa is dispatched to Melida as her tutor (and her possible assassin), but continues to train Melida in defiance of his orders.

(Source: ANN)

name.native: ロゼッティ=プリケット

140831.description: Rosetti is an elite member of the holy city guards. She is currently Elise's tutor.

alternative: Supreme Ruler of the Century's End

140845.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

The pompous star of the stage. Her laugh fills the room!

Opera O's behavior is always over-exaggerated, sometimes loudly, and you will often hear her proclaiming her greatness in some way or other. She seriously believes that those who do not know their own beauty and strength are unhappy, and she works tirelessly every day to enlighten them. She's friends with and admired by [Meisho Doto ](https://anilist.co/character/211557/Meishou-Dotou).

A member of Team Rigil as well as rival to [Narita Top Road ](https://anilist.co/character/273332/Narita-Top-Road) and [Admire Vega ](https://anilist.co/character/273331/Admire-Vega).

140856.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Second-year high school student at Ichinan High School in Saitama. Isagi grew up watching soccer and aspiring to be like [Noel Noa](https://anilist.co/character/268966), a forward for France's National Team. Due to this, he dreams of becoming the best striker in the world. In turn, Isagi played striker for his school soccer team, who was defeated in the Prefectural Finals by Matsukaze Kokou High. After this loss, Isagi is invited to participate in the Blue Lock Project, ranked 299th of 300 strikers, and is assigned to Team Z.

Isagi is easygoing and has a generally friendly, cheery personality, but his simple and innocent habits often get on the nerves of the people around him. As time goes on, Isagi develops a more assertive presence on and off the field, becoming the foundation for Team Z and garnering the respect of some of the best players in Blue Lock.

140918.description:
Helbram is a Holy Knight, Geera's master, and the subordinate of the Great Holy Knight, Hendricksen.

He wears a set of copper-colored full body armor, adorning it with a purple coat on top. He usually covers his face with a unique helm with a skyblue crest on it. Helbram has a serious personality, but also a playful side, which is seen when he jokes that Meliodas' decoration of Geera's face was not very bad. Helbram was also shown to like doing research, even taking notes during battle.

~!During the fighting festival in the Byzel Arc, he disguised himself as a referee with the alias of Love Helm.!~

140953.description:
The class's homeroom teacher. He is only attracted to female university students. He also regularly has consultations with Yamai; a running gag involves his glasses breaking when Yamai mentions something regarding her chunibyo behavior. 

~!Outside of school, he is secretly a Vocaloid producer who goes by the name Teishotoku-P.!~

140968.description: A classmate of Aoyama's and a bully. He has a crush on Hamamoto.

140969.description: An intelligent girl who has a crush on Aoyama. She is jealous of the Lady.

141060.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

Shinei Nouzen is the field commander of Spearhead Squadron. His Personal Name is Undertaker.
Having survived five years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, he is considered one of the most elite Processors alive. Among the Eighty-Six, he is known as the Reaper of the Eastern Front. His ability to hear the voices of the Legion allows him to locate the Legion without the use of detection systems like radar.

Born on May 19th in Republic Year 351, Shin lived with his family in the First Sector of the Republic before the war with the Giadian Empire began. It is implied he lived a sheltered life, surrounded by "only kindness and affection". He also appeared to have developed his extrasensory ability early on, hearing "voices that spoke without words" from his family.

~!He would often play with the daughter of his father's colleague, [Henrietta von Penrose](https://anilist.co/character/210923/von-Penrose-Henrietta), whom Shin called Rita.!~

name.native: ヴラディレーナ・ミリーゼ

141061.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Vladilena Milizé, more commonly known as Lena by her friends and as Handler One to her subordinates, is an elite Republic commissioned officer who rose to the rank of Major at the young age of 16. She is the commander of [Shinei Nouzen](https://anilist.co/character/141060/Nouzen-Shinei) and the Spearhead Squadron, whom she communicates with via the long-distance communication device known as the Para-RAID. 

~!After the Spearhead Squadron's departure, she becomes known for demanding orders and highly competent leadership, earning the nickname of Bloody Regina among the Processors.!~

141077.description: Taiyu Ishigami is a clumsy boy with a shy personality who plays tennis to deal with anxiety. He can't decide anything by himself.

141079.description: Nao Tsukinose lives in his own world.

141080.description: A member of the soft tennis club and partnered with Rintarou Futsu. The brother of Namie Ameno, a member of the girls soft-tennis team.

alternative: Desir Arman (デジール・アルマン)

141151.description:
__Magic Circle Rank:__ Tier 3 (Analysis Magic)

Desir Herrman is the central protagonist of A Returner’s Magic Should Be Special. After his return to the past upon the failure of clearing the Shadow World, he resolves to strengthen his allies so that the future doesn’t get repeated. In Hebrion Academy, commoners are frowned upon and put into the Beta class whilst the nobles are designated the alpha class, Desir is one of the commoners who hates the class system and wants things to change. As a result he and his friends set out to close the gap by showing the teachers and aristocrats that commoners can have as much potential as the nobles if given the right circumstances.

141152.description:
__Circle Tier Level:__ 3 (Wind Mage)

When [Desir Arman](https://anilist.co/character/141151/Herrman-Desir) first meets Romantica after returning from the Shadow Labyrinth she exhibits a superiority complex due to her position as a noble which slowly decreases as the story progresses and she gets to know Desir Arman. 

~!Later on in the it is discovered that Romantica is the illegitimate child of a baron and the only reason that she has the title of a noble is that her mother traded her life so that Romantica wouldn't have to live the impoverished "commoner's" life. As the story progresses Desir offers her a chance to join the beta class and because of her distaste of how the nobles treat the commoners and so accepted his offer along with [Ajest](https://anilist.co/character/141154/Kingscrown-Azest) and [Pram](https://anilist.co/character/141153/Schneider-Pram).!~

alternative: プラム・シュナイザー

141153.description:
__Circle Tier Level:__ 3 (Swordmage)

Pram is a member of Desir Arman's alpha party made of commoners.

~! Pram’s weapon of choice was a rapier made of Blankšum, left by his noble father (The super light rapier). The sword was originally in a rusted hilt and was sold to a pawn shop for little money. Later on, Desir Arman and Pram go back to take the sword back, and after a disagreement, Desir is forced to fight the merchant's bodyguard and take the sword back to its rightful owner !~

alternative: アゼスト・キングスクラウン

141154.description:
__Circle Level Tier:__ 4 (Swordmage)

Azest Jedgar F. Roguepalace was the firstborn of Gilltian Jedgar F. Roguepalace, the current emperor of the Hebrion Empire and thus the heir to the Hebrion throne. Initially Azest was a cold person and she tends to be uninterested about other people unless they consist of her close friends in the Desir group.
~! Azest was one of the six survivors of the Shadow Labyrinth who defeated Brohmier Napolitan along with Desir Arman. She was the core figure of their attack force and their swordmage. She dealt the final blow to kill the boss of the shadow world. !~

141269.description: Hanako is a close friend of Masamune. During a practice match, Hotaru temporarily becomes a member of her team and she instructs her to observe how the game is played.

141287.description: Kazusa's friend, a melancholic girl who the guys call a "crane" because of her fragile beauty. Initially, Niina ignores the boys because of a harassment experience in her childhood but gradually begins to develop feelings for Izumi because of his caring and kindness. Thus, her loyalty to her friend and their common love of one boy quickly becomes one of the main conflicts of the story.

141290.description: A shy girl and Kazusa’s best friend. At first, like the other girls, she becomes interested in relationships with boys. However, as the story progresses, she gradually realizes her true feelings and growing attraction toward other girls. At first, she dismisses it as a misunderstanding about why girls like boys, but eventually she develops a one-sided crush on Sugawara.

141292.description: The president of a literary club, a tall, prudish girl who is ashamed of her interest in the opposite sex because of her strict upbringing and serious nature. Nevertheless, in spite of her purism, she gets the most healthy relationship with guys compared to other girls. Over time she comes to realize that romantic affection and sexual attraction are not the same thing, thus she begins to lower her guard and starts a relationship with [Shun Amagi](https://anilist.co/character/141291/).

141294.description: A blunt girl aspiring to publish erotica novels. Being a virgin, she relies on online adult chatrooms to get inspiration and feedback on her sexual writing. When her editor describes her first draft as if it was written by a virgin 40 year old man, she decides that she needs to go further on her journey for sexual knowledge.

141296.description: A boy who attends the same cram school as Momoko and tries to start a relationship with her.

141297.description:
Kazusa is the series main lead. 
Since childhood, she has been in love with Izumi, but all this time she was afraid to take a step forward, while the mockery of more popular classmates did not motivate her to be more active in an attempt to attract his attention. However, as the story progresses, she notices that Izumi is clearly sexually attracted to Sugawara’s outstanding beauty and tenderness. She is Sugawara's friend and is childhood friends with Izumi and Momoko.

141418.description: A Mafia member sent from the US to research the Gokudols.

141457.description: **Momo Chiyoda** is the magical girl who is protecting the town of Seiiki Sakuraga-oka. As a magical girl, she is a maniac of muscle training, and her physical power overwhelmingly surpasses that of her rival [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461), the succubus in town. Her magical girl career is mysterious, including rumors that she had once saved the world.

141458.description: **Mikan Hinatsuki** is a Magical Girl who arrives in town to support [Momo](https://anilist.co/character/141457). She suffers from a curse that brings misfortune to those close to her whenever she gets overly excited or anxious.

141460.description: **Lilith** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461)'s demon ancestor. She appears in her dreams one night and gives her demon powers, and tasks her on defeating a magical girl.

141461.description: Yuuko Yoshida is a demon whose power is suddenly awakened in her first year of high school; aims to overthrow the magical girl in town to break her family's spell. However, although she has the ability to sneak into others' dreams, her physical strength and stamina are much weaker than the ones of her rival, the magical girl [Momo Chiyoda](https://anilist.co/character/141457).

141462.description: **Ryouko Yoshida** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461)'s younger sister. Ryouko's dream is to support her sister in becoming a fearsome demon.

141532.description:
He was presented at Nana's restaurant as a degenerate lower number, beyond that, fortunately for Hina, he is one of the Legendary Red Barons possessing a powerful force for justicing his path.

His "Count" is, initially, -999.

~!Even though Nana stated that his Count stands for how many girls have turned him down, his count becomes -1000 after Hina calls him a liar and says that she hates him.

His "Ballot" count is 5700 and stands for how many heads he had cut off. In chapter 10, it states that he is actually hiding his true power. During his battle, his count increases by 10 times, reaching the amount 57000.

It is revealed in later chapters that Licht's real name was Sakai Rihito (坂井離人), Sakai Tokikaze's childhood friend and adopted brother. It is also shown he was shorter and even more perverted than he is 300 years later, even so he still cares about how people feel.

After he became the Red Baron, his appearance was slowly changed and his awareness was slowly controlled by the power and he went berserk, he cut off Mizuka's left arm and killed his childhood friend, Tokikaze, which has caused him to be in regret for 300 years.!~

141533.description:
She is a solitary girl who lived before with her mom on the mountains. Now she had been traveled around this world looking for The Legendary Red Baron.

Her "Count" is, initially, 441.

~!Her Count stays for how many hundreds of kilometers her mother walked. 44100 km, accordingly.

In chapter 2, her Count is increased to 760 after Licht wins the game of "The Startheft Bout" for her.!~

141589.description: She is the mother of [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138) and [Ylva](https://anilist.co/character/27876), and the wife of [Thors](https://anilist.co/character/13021). ~!She's the daughter of the Jomsviking Chief.!~

141590.description:
__Height:__ 170cm

[Thorkell](https://anilist.co/character/17440)'s first mate. Asgeir is one of the few characters Thorkell outwardly respects, meeting him at eye-level in conversation, listening to his advice, and putting him in charge of strategies and planning. Asgeir is often shown yelling at Thorkell and becoming easily worried and even panicked when Thorkell is in danger.

141615.description:
__Race:__ Spirit

Aerial or Airy is the first Spirit summoned by Taichi Nishimura and becomes one of the main characters of the Isekai Cheat Magician series.

Aerial has platinum green hair with teal colored eyes and pointed ears similar to an elf. She is shown to be wrapped in a green hagoromo like sash with four feathered wings sprouting from and wing like accessories in her hair and three diamond markings on both of her legs. She generally takes on the form of a young female fairy.

Aerial is shown to be a very loving and caring spirit with a strong sense of duty and loyalty, despite the fact that she wished Tachi could have summoned her sooner so that she could help him, she could not disobey the conditions needed in order to summon her and feels both sad and regretful that she could not aid him when he needed it most in the beginning. Since her summoning she has done everything she can to be both helpful and useful to Tachi and is shown to be very loyal and protective of him, telling Tachi that she would never abandon him. 

~!Originally she introduces herself as a simple Wind spirit named Aerial, but as Taichi's power rises, she finally evolves back into her original form, Sylpheed (Sylphy) her true identity.!~

(Source: Isekai Cheat Magician Wiki)

141616.description: After being summoned to Altia alongside her childhood friend Taichi Nishimura, she decides to become an adventurer with him in the hopes of finding a way back home.

141617.description: An Elf swordswoman and a former apprentice of Lemia, she is a Dual Magician capable of using the magical elements Fire and Earth. She is known under the title "Golden SwordsWoman" for her skill with the blade. Impressed with Rin's abilities, the two girls become fast friends.

141618.description: A Master Triple Magician whom everyone in the kingdom knows who she is due to her magical prowess, thus her nickname as the Magician of Fallen Leaves. She taught Muller magic before teaching Taichi and Rin.

141619.description: He is a 16-year-old high school student and role-playing game fan blessed with good reflexes but lacking ambition.

141624.description:
The goddess charged with guiding [Seiya](https://anilist.co/character/141625/Ryuguin-Seiya) to defeat the Demon Lord.

~!Seiyas companion in his life before.!~

141625.description:
__Hair Color:__ Black

Seiya is a very tall and handsome young man who is portrayed as extremely muscular under his armor with spiky yet still well-kept haircut that is down turned and leans to his right, which is commonly seen covering his right eye, but this is an effect caused by angles and it has never been seen obscuring his vision though as Seiya likely would not allow this (In the manga, his hair is more swept back, unkempt and it seems to move around with his movement more than the anime), black eyes, he is almost always seen with a calm and pensive expression, unless he is annoyed or angered and he is unanimously thought of as attractive by just about anyone he meets, even gods or enemies.

Seiya is defined by his overly cautious nature who refuses to face any enemy he isn't sure that he can beat and he will attack defeated enemies repeatedly on the off chance that they can revive themselves, and worries that any stranger he meets could be an enemy or carry a deadly illness, even his own partner. However, his cautious nature also makes Seiya extremely diligent when it comes to preparing for future battles. He'll grind for levels for days at a time and is almost tireless in his training.

Seiya also tends to speak bluntly to others and is quick to express his dissatisfaction with the opinions and actions of others. He seems rather inexperienced and ignorant of socialization, as he has been unable to spot other people's clear romantic feelings for him and has no trouble pouring holy water over strangers heads or picking hairs off [Ristarte](https://anilist.co/character/141624) while she sleeps yet still is unaware of why these actions upset people. Despite coming off as a guy who doesn't care about anyone, his actions are driven by a want to avoid harm or death coming to those he cares about, even if it means pushing them away. In reality, he truly cares about both the people around him and the world he must save.

Seiya also seems to have no real hobbies or interests outside of things that will help him defeat his enemies. When confronted with things such as tasty food, celebration, or even sexual encounters he is always dismissive and uninterested.

(Source: cautious-hero.fandom.com)

141692.description:
Like most demons, she is cruel, unfeeling, and murderous towards humans. Though after much time with him, she developed fear for Rui and the Father Spider Demon who abused her for being weaker than expected.
~!She was a member of the Spider Family.!~

141817.description:
__Eye Color:__ Blue
__Hair Color:__ Black
__Occupation:__ Maid
__Debut:__ Volume 1, Chapter 1 (Light Novel) / Chapter 1 (Manga) / Episode 1 (Anime)

Miyuki Kujou is one of the main female characters, (though being more like a ''Supporting-Main Character''), of the series. She is [Kimito](https://anilist.co/character/131538)'s ''personal maid''.

_Appearance:_ Miyuki is a beautiful young girl that has short, straight black hair and blue eyes. She is usually seen with an expressionless face and doesn't show her emotions. She has a ''beauty mark'' under her eye, and is usually seen with her maid dress.

_Personality:_ Miyuki is a sadistic maid. She isn't shy at all and is always willing to help [Kimito](https://anilist.co/character/131538) change clothes, Miyuki is also a little perverted sometimes, but also clever. In the past, however, Miyuki was a little shy and reserved.

141818.description: Eri has ''two masks''. Eri is currently working as an idol seiyuu (voice actress), so she is quite popular and has often been called the most beautiful seiyuu in the industry. She has a cute but air headed personality. She was a scaredy cat and she often relied on other people to help her, usually Kimito. She is also very kind, innocent, cheerful, ''moe'' (described by Kimito), and slightly childish, calling herself ''Eri-rin''. However, her other personality is mean spirited, scary, and a little sadistic.

141945.description:
**Height:** 170 cm

She is a 1st-year post-graduate science and technology researcher at Saitama University. Having fallen in love with her academic rival [Shinya Yukimura](https://anilist.co/character/141948), she embarks on a mathematical and logical journey with him to prove this love when he demands such proof. She can be snarky, but is usually serious and logical above all else, making her stick to her quest above all else.

141946.description:
**Height:** 162 cm

She plays the role of a storyteller, who is close to the reader's point of view. She is constantly pushed around by [Ayame](https://anilist.co/character/141945) and [Shinya](https://anilist.co/character/141948), who are conducting insane experiments, and she goes along with them, saying what they are up to and mercilessly criticizing them in her head.

(Source: Official Site, translated, edited)

141948.description:
**Height:** 177 cm

He is a 1st-year post-graduate science and technology researcher at Saitama University who works closely with [Ayame](https://anilist.co/character/141945). After finding out that she loves him, he realizes that he knows nothing about love nor about his feelings for her, so he embarks on a series of mathematical and logical experiments with her to see if they truly love each other. He is somewhat easily embarrassed, but otherwise completely serious and logical like Ayane, keeping him stuck to her mathematical quest as well.

141949.description: Ena loves playing video games and doesn't really have any other motivation for work or ambitions. She also likes to mess with [Shinya](https://anilist.co/character/141948/Yukimura-Shinya) or make fun of [Kosuke](https://anilist.co/character/141947/Inukai-Kosuke), just to entertain her or bring chaos. Ena is quite smart and whimsical and sometimes acts like a cat.

142005.description:
Dai Mubai is a short tempered person who is often impulsive. He is well aware of his strength and limits. He is a loyal person who cares much for his friends.

~!Dai Mubai is the second prince of the royal household in the Star Luo Empire. The heir to the throne is by tradition the strongest in the royal family, so he and his older brother are rivals. Dai Mubai since the birth of Zhu Zhuqing was promised in marriage to her as per agreement of their families.!~ Dai Mubai left home in order to become stronger and never lose to anyone. He is the senior at the Shrek Academy and he broke the record for being the youngest to attain the thirtieth rank at the age of 13 which however was subsequently broken by Tang San and Xiao Wu.

142006.description: Ma Hongjun was found by Flender for his unique spirit and was recruited by him to the Shrek Academy at the age of 11. Ma Hongjun thus became Flender's disciple.

142007.description: ~!She and Dai Mubai have been promised to each other in marriage since a very young age. Following Dai Mubai's departure to Heaven Dou Empire, she follows him and enrolls in Shrek Academy to be by his side.!~

142010.description: At her Spirit Awakening she received a rank of 9, and was considered an exceptionally talented Spirit Master. She was spoiled by all the members of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan, with her being their little princess.

142131.description: She is a silent person that usually looks unapproachable because she prefers to read and be alone instead of spending time with her classmates. She is very confident and serious about her decisions which is another reason she stands out most of the time. Gradually as the story progresses, she slowly opens up to some people around her because the main protagonist [Katagaki Naomi](https://anilist.co/character/142129/Katagaki-Naomi) was the first person to ever reach out and trying understand her. She is also very old fashioned and uncomfortable using electronic devices like her phone.

142133.description:
Katagaki Naomi is an ordinary high school student and especially doesn't have any social skills. He is usually seen reading novel books, but he gets to a point where he wanted some friends. His shy type of personality had eventually made him a loner. Naomi's failed attempts garnered him no friends even in his class, except Ichigyou Ruri.
~!He eventually ends up dating Ichigyou Ruri.!~

name.native: シャルロッテ・エーベルフレイヤ・ドロッセル

142149.description: She is the princess of Drossel, and the narrator for the 5th episode of Violet Evergarden.

142471.description: Appeared in episode 5. He is the God of Turtles. He's the one that brought the "Aging Box" by Momiji's orders to make Ichiko get old.

142505.description: Main character. Wants to be the best sax player in the world.

142533.description:
__Race:__ God
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7"), ~!162 cm (5'4") (as Syr)!~
__Affiliation:__ Freya Familia, ~!Hostess of Fertility (as Syr), Maria's Orphanage (as Syr)!~

Freya Is the head of the Freya Familia. Long ago, Hera, at the request of [Zeus](https://anilist.co/character/142554/Zeus), asked Freya for help in their goal to save the world. Freya made her a challenge, telling her that she would help her if she won. Having lost the challenge, Freya was forced to stay in Orario as part of the deal, in addition to losing several members of her Familia as a result. Some time later, Freya met a girl named Syr. After telling her that she would rescue her, Freya asked the girl what she wanted. Hearing that she wanted to be like her, Freya decided to offer her a deal, which she accepted.

Freya is flirtatious, loves to tease, and has an unending appetite for talented adventurers. She seeks the best and most talented adventurers and will obtain them no matter the cost. She holds an obsession over [Bell Cranel](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell) and actively does anything in her power to see him grow as an adventurer. Freya doesn't like to be bound by anyone, though she doesn't wish to become an arrogant ruler either. She is very impatient. She constantly interferes with Bell's activities knowing it might kill him but wanting to see him grow as fast as possible. At the same time, she is just as willing to help Bell to see him grow, such as when she gave up a grimoire just to speed up his progress. Freya is intrigued by his resistance to being charmed, making her want him even more. She doesn't take kindly to others trying to claim what she wants, as she invaded and ruthlessly destroyed the Entertainment District with her Familia when [Ishtar](https://anilist.co/character/146789/Ishtar) tried to claim Bell and ended up sending her back to heaven. She said that she won't let any woman other than herself have him. She was also shown to show a little jealousy when Bell trained with [Ais](https://anilist.co/character/87655/Wallenstein-Ais) the first time and when Bell and Ais danced at Apollo's Banquet. Despite her usual straightforward method of acquiring those she takes a fancy to, Freya has decided to watch over Bell instead, stating that she could claim him whenever she wanted. Usually, she stays in her room in Babel, not making public appearances, but has recently started to come out to gather information about Bell or see him in person at the God's Banquets and Denatuses.

~!Freya obtained [Syr](https://anilist.co/character/340415/Hrn) name and the ability to transform into her, while in exchange the girl obtained the name Horn and a magic that allows her to transform into Freya.!~

~!As Syr, she shows a cheerful and kind demeanor, normally she is lightly mischievous, and at times, scary. She enjoys teasing Bell and others close to her, but is weak to getting teased herself, which usually ends up with her blushing beet red. She is kind, but tends to take advantage of others, usually to raise her family business, or avoid getting in trouble. She sometimes takes days off to care for the children at Maria's Orphanage in Daedalus Street.!~

142657.description:
**Hometown:** Aichi Prefecture, Japan
**Motto:** If you can change your mind, you can change your life – William James, psychologist
**Years Active:** 2017-2021

A model student that is honest and hates anything crooked. An unreliable father has had some effect in shaping her personality. She is usually a responsible girl, but sometimes she can act airheaded, and people tease her for that.

(Source: Official Website)

142659.description:
**Hometown:** Osaka Prefecture, Japan
**Motto:** Good things come to those who smile.
**Years Active:** 2017-2021
