A bright, energetic, talkative girl from Osaka. Oldest of seven, she takes good care of her siblings. A mood-setter. Loves comedy shows and she can be both the comic or the straight man. Her favorite food is okonomiyaki (Japanese savory pancake).

(Source: Official Website)

142661.description:
**Hometown:** Kanagawa
**Motto:** Talent is given to those who can show effort.

A stoic, hard worker. She makes a daily effort to become the ideal idol that she envisions in her mind. She is harsh on herself as well as others, and sometimes sounds harsh when talking to those around her. Her favorite animal is a rabbit.

(Source: Official Website)

142662.description:
**Hometown:** Saitama
**Motto:** None in particular.

Introverted and not good at conversing with others. Due to her slightly awkward personality, she has problems smiling in front of the customers at her part-time job. Thinks dearly of her mother and little sister.

(Source: Official Website)

142664.description:
**Hometown:** Toyama Prefecture, Japan
**Motto:** Life is an amusement park. It's a waste if you don't enjoy it once you're inside.
**Years Active:** 2017-2021

An overwhelmingly bright girl. Oftentimes she goes too far and people feel she is an idiot. She has her childish sides, but she's always true to her heart and tries her best in everything she does. Loves fried food and sweets.

(Source: Official Website)

142666.description:
**Hometown:** Tokyo
**Motto:** Others are others, I am myself.

Youngest of three sisters. Her older sisters have caused her to be a bit more philosophical. She forges her own path and remains unaffected by others. She has a strong will, but also has a side that looks out after others. She is the most charismatic one of the group.

(Source: Official Website)

142729.description:
Classification: Human
Height: 163 cm
Weight: 49 kg
BWH: 72-56-78
Likes: wind chimes, competition
Dislikes: Failure
Affiliation: Homurahara Academy, Year 2 class A, track team

Kaede is a friend of Rin Toosaka and known at Homura academy as the leader of track team. Even though she wishes to be called "Black Panther of Homura", her real nickname is simply "Maki."

(Source: Type-Moon Wikia)

142730.description:
Classification: Human
Weight: 39 kg
Height: 155 cm
BWH: 75-57-78
Likes: cooking, taking care of her brothers
Dislikes: sports
Affiliation: Homurahara Academy, Year 2 class A, track team

Yukika is a gentle, cheerful girl and the mascot of the famous Homura Academy track girl trio, along with Kaede and Kane. She also is one of the few non-magi who can see Assassin sitting in front of Ryuudou Temple.

(Source: Type-Moon Wikia)

142731.description:
She is a student at Homurahara School. She is a friend of Yukika Saegusa and Kaede Makidera, they are known as Class 2-A's famed track girl trio and she generally plays the straight man of the group. She is the track team's high-jumping ace.

She is considerate and intelligent. She is the brains of the trio. She is quiet, reserved, and doesn't speak that much as well. She is Minori's best friend and has a passion for gossip, especially if it involves those around her.

(Source: Type-Moon Wikia)

142801.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3'')

[Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/142802/Shiki-Tsubasa)'s 16-year-old classmate at Kitami Hokuryo High School, who is popular and talkative. She follows the gal subculture; dyeing her hair blonde, wearing short skirts in winter, and refusing to wear gloves in the winter so that she can still use her phone. She seems to have a crush on Tsubasa and enjoys flirting with him to make him embarrassed and flustered.

(Source: Wikipedia)

142802.description:
__Height:__ 179cm (5'10'')

He is a city boy who is quite a fool. He speaks his mind at times when he'd rather not let those thoughts slip out. He is very weak to the cold.

142837.description:
Ryuusaku is a comrade of Kei's in the resistance movement who claims to be Kei's brother, but it is implied that this is not the case.

(Source: Fandom.com)

142838.description: Nezu was a parliament member who is also the leader of the terrorist resistance movement against the government.

142840.description: Lady Miyako was a former test subject known as "Designated #19" from the Project. She is the high priestess and leader of a temple in Neo-Tokyo and a major ally of Kaneda and Kei as the story progresses, who plays an important role in the final battle with Tetsuo Shima.

142888.description: Ayano's childhood friend, though also a member of the school's badminton club, she serves more as the club's manager.

142905.description: She was the princess of the fallen nation of Koto, later becoming an assassin for the Old Arcadia Empire and then a student of the New Kingdom's Royal Officer Academy.

142923.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
__Affiliation:__ Hestia Familia • Takemikazuchi Familia (temporary leave)
__Level:__ 2
__Skills:__ Yatanokurogarasu • Yatanoshirogarasu
__Magic:__ Futsunomitama
__Weapon:__ Kotetsu • Chizan • Shunsan • Shakuya

Yamato Mikoto is a member of the Hestia Familia and the Takemikazuchi Familia, having converted to aid the former during the War Game. Mikoto originally hails from the Far East. Her parents died several years after her birth. Tsukuyomi and [Takemikazuchi](https://anilist.co/character/142543/Takemikazuchi) took the young girl into their orphanage, where she lived for years, eventually joining the Takemikazuchi Familia. Mikoto and the other members of the Takemikazuchi Familia used to sneak [Sanjouno Haruhime](https://anilist.co/character/142551/Sanjouno-Haruhime) out of her mansion at night to play with her. They were eventually caught, damaging relations between Haruhime's father and the shrine. They pursued their nightly fun regardless. Two years before the story, Mikoto and the other Takemikazuchi Familia members moved to Orario to earn money to help support the shrine.

Mikoto has a serious and honorable personality, unwilling to use cowardly tactics even in an emergency, as shown through her disapproval of Pass Parading the monsters that were chasing them onto the Hestia Familia. She also has a softer side as she cares for the well-being of her friends and is fiercely loyal to them.

142935.description:
Yu Ziyuan was the wife of the former leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect, Jiang Fengmian, and the mother of Jiang Cheng and Jiang Yanli. She also went by the titles Madam Yu and the Violet Spider.

~!She was killed during the Massacre at Lotus Pier when her Golden Core was melted by Wen Zhuliu!~

142968.description: This turtle is a gift to Team Bucciarati from the Boss of Passione. It serves as a mobile hideout for the gang thanks to its Stand, Mr.President.

143291.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Dae-Wi is one of the main protagonists in The God Of Highschool. He was once part of the legendary duo named 'Mad Cows' and he is a very skilled fighter. Over time, he will become a close friend of [Mo-Ri](https://anilist.co/character/124136/Jin-Mo-Ri) and [Mi-Ra](https://anilist.co/character/153293/Yu-Mi-Ra). He is a practitioner of the Kyokushin Karate (Full Contact Karate).

 ~!After training from Executive Q Dae-Wi is able to summon the charyeok Haetae!~

143297.description:
__Nationality:__ Japanese
__Height:__ 149 cm

A shy girl with a burning passion. Akin to her hero name, Momijiyama is a timid hero who has trouble communicating with large groups of people. Despite this, she cares very much about others and wants to provide them with help if she can.

143315.description: One of Yuko's cats. She is a level headed Russian Blue.

143316.description: Yuko's friend/classmate and a popular girl in their class. She is from a rich family and has a cat named Elza.

143317.description: One of Yuko's cats. She is a mischievous Munchkin who loves to explore.

143318.description: A gyaru-ish girl and Azumi's self-proclaimed rival, who often challenges her, and has a fear of cats.

143319.description: A fifteen-year-old girl who is shy by nature and has 3 cats (Maa, Shii and Ro).

143320.description: One of Yuko's cats. She is a laid back Singapura cat. She is very shy and sweet, but can also be a bit of a crybaby.

143398.description: Touka Toudou is the current student council president of Hagun Academy and is considered to be the strongest student in the school.

143399.description:
__Occupation:__ Homicide detective (formerly) / Mizuhanome pilot / Brilliant Detective (Sakaido persona) 
__Affiliations:__ Kura 
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") 

He was once a happy man with a family. Two years ago, his daughter was assaulted and later bashed to death by the serial killer, [the Challenger](https://anilist.co/character/164167/Denshin-Katsuyama). This later spiraled Ayako's severe depression, and despite Narihisago's best efforts, committed suicide out of grief soon afterwards. Disdained and vengefully driven, Narihsiago shot the Challenger out of vengeance after finding out his true identity, unintentionally saving [Kiki Asukai](https://anilist.co/character/160111/Kiki-Asukai). After this decisive victory, Narihisago was sentenced to prison for Katsuyama's murder.

Two years later however, having killed someone, he now is capable of entering ID-Wells and retrieving information about serial killers using their murderous intent. Once he enters the wells, he is known as Sakaido "the brilliant detective", with no prior memory of his real identity, he assists in investigating and analyzing the serial killer's subconsciousness. Over the next year, he would go on to aid in the capture of at least four serial killers, among them being "[the Face-lifter](https://anilist.co/character/164168/Hitoshi-Sonoda)", "Tongue-tearer", "Arm-twister" and "Thigh-severer".

143539.description:
__Height:__ 85 cm
__Quirk:__ High Spec

Nezu, also known as Mr. Principal is a Pro Hero and the principal of U.A. High School. He is an extremely rare case of an animal who manifested a Quirk.

He can be very long-winded at times when explaining or educating.

143542.description:
Thirteen is a wise, well-mannered person. As a rescue hero, Thirteen has displayed how passionate they are about saving people through their teachings. They even developed their own training facility - the Unforeseen Simulation Joint - to train future heroes in search and rescue tactics. They are very passionate about Quirks, specifically on the topic of using Quirks for creation and assistance rather than for destruction and battle. 
Thirteen has also been shown to be very brave. Despite not being a combat type, they do not hesitate to use their Quirk to fight against villains in the name of protecting others

143796.description: The younger twin sister of Hisui (Majo).

143812.description:
__Affiliation__ Village Bunnies, Demon Lord Kunai Hakuto, Satanists (former)
__Species__ Cambion (half demon)

A cute, melancholy-looking little girl dressed in black she and the image of a gothic lolita. Tron is very melancholic because of her stalking past that she suffered in the demonic kingdom and the human world, she once said that she had forgotten how to smile. After being saved by [Zero Kirisame](https://anilist.co/character/189442/Zero-Kirisame), she became more open and cheerful. Tron can fly freely, she also has superhuman strength due to her half demon blood. Her most remarkable ability and her ability to see a person's emotions and soul (human or demon),

144332.description: Roger is the manager of the “Wammy’s House” whenever Watari is not present.

144447.description: Christina is the landlady of Juzo's office. She has a very understanding and lenient person, especially to Juzo. She tends to act too affectionately with those she considers cute and is often seen pinching their cheeks, similar to an aunt.

name.native: スカーレット・ゴズリング

144448.description: Scarlet is a young lady who is in love with Juzo and is the daughter of Juzo's barber. She lives in the same building as Juzo and is often seen persuading her father to keep the barber shop running so Juzo can continue visiting.

144449.description:
An Over-Extended working as a private investigator dealing with cases related to the Extended. Due to stylizing himself after a stereotypical hard-boiled detective, he maintains a serious and collected demeanor and encourages others to solve their own problems, his motto being "_Wipe your own ass_". However, he often struggles to hide his love for cheesy one-liners, pretty women, and kitschy romance stories, the latter two often making him struggle to stay calm.

~!During the war, he was part of a group consisting of Over-Extended from the Gun Slave Unit series, designated "Number 13". At one point, he was ordered to dispose of the rest of his unit, gaining the moniker "The Brother Killer, Verrat Dreizehn" or "Traitor Thirteen".!~

144451.description: He is the son of CEO of Beruhern Corp. Soichiro Arahabaki. He has been used for experiments and has been implanted with a Harmonie device allowing him to take complete control over extends. Due to his past life, he has a strong hatred against the people responsible for experimenting and hurting children. Tetsurou has a noble heart and always has good intentions but tends to make bashful decisions that cause trouble for himself and others.

name.native: メアリー・シュタインベルグ

144454.description:
Mary is a young engineer who performs maintenance for extends. She is very forward with her reasoning and doesn't overthink things. She is a bit of a flirt. She uses her connections to the mafia to find affordable and good quality parts for her customers.

(Source: No Guns Life Wikia)

144530.description:
He is a part of the Althea Royal Guard army, having the rank of squad leader with the title of Lieutenant. 

His "Count" is 900.

~!Jail maintains his true count hidden so as not to be promoted to a higher rank, so that he can continue with field missions. His original count is 12500, later decreasing to 12498, due to the events of the series. Later, the possession of his second glove is revealed, containing the count of 45,000, thus showing how great his conviction is.!~

144531.description:
Lyne Mei is the secondary female character of Plunderer. She is a sergeant, who protects Hoemmh which is located at the side of a hill. 

Amiable to a fault, Lyne is always eager to help others, and boosting her count is not the sole motivator. She is genuinely a good person, if not a little daft because of her sweet nature. She is easily misled because of how quick she is to want to do good. Lyne is also short-tempered when anyone called her weight to be too heavy.

She is unafraid to use physical force to protect others and fulfill her duties as a soldier.

144532.description:
Pele is friends with Lyne.

~!It was later revealed that Pele Poporo isn't his real name, his real name and true identity was Gespenst Zerlegen the Pierce Baron, and the founder of Special Service faction.!~

144533.description: She is an owner of a mobile tavern, and one of the 7 Legendary Red Barons, known as the "Insight Baron".

144593.description:
__Height:__ 194 cm
__Devil Contracts:__ ~!Claw Devil, Knife Devil, Needle Devil!~

A Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 1. ~!After the assault on the Special Divisions, he became captain of the Special Division 4.!~

Kishibe is a grizzled man with scraggly facial hair and a stitched scar running across his left cheek from his mouth. He normally wears the standard Public Safety devil hunter uniform with a large overcoat. He has two piercings on his left ear, and one on his right ear. He is often seen with a hip flask which he frequently drinks from. Kishibe is a stoic, straightforward individual. Due to his immense strength and skill, he often undertakes his work with a calm formality, displaying little emotion as he does so. Though he tends to speak in a relaxed, polite manner, his actions often showcase an immense brutality garnered through many years of Devil Hunting. Though he sometimes expresses emotions such as surprise and sadness at certain events, his face and voice remain entirely neutral. Kishibe has been hunting devils for a long time, making him somewhat insane. He espouses a belief that the most fearsome devil hunters to devils isn't the brave or the strong, but the craziest as they are the ones without fear. He admits that he enjoys booze, women and killing devils.

~!He is the former partner of [Quanxi](https://anilist.co/character/162123/Quanxi).!~

144594.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

A Public Safety Devil Hunter, she is a new recruit working under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. She is partnered with [Hirokazu Arai](https://anilist.co/character/174263).

She is not very courageous and gets scared easily by devils. Kobeni is shown to easily crack under pressure and break into tears during serious moments. Even though Kobeni is timid, she is pretty talented as a devil hunter. When Kobeni gets into action, she has proven to be cool-headed and efficient in battle, only breaking down in a panic once the fighting is over. Kobeni chooses to keep her devil contract a secret.

144596.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")
__Devil Contract:__ [Ghost Devil](https://anilist.co/character/174262/Yuurei-no-Akuma)
__Relatives:__ [Unnamed Younger Sister](https://anilist.co/character/174283/Himeno-no-Imouto)

A Public Safety Devil Hunter, working under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. She is partnered with [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa), whom she shares a close personal bond with.

Himeno is shown to be a mature and experienced superior to the new recruits working under her. She generally carries herself with an upbeat body language and is capable of staying calm under extremely stressful situations. Himeno is very efficient and blunt in her duty as a Devil Hunter. Himeno is also shown to be a rather caring and empathetic person, however she does have a sterner side and little tolerance for behavior from new recruits that would endanger or harm her subordinates. 

Himeno holds an extremely pessimistic worldview as a result of having witnessed multiple partners die suddenly in her line of work. Her knowledge that Devil Hunters typically die as a result of their career combined with the teachings of her [master](https://anilist.co/character/144593/Kishibe) eventually lead to her developing a nicotine addiction as a coping mechanism. She also tends to acts extremely aloof and sexual, enjoying a hedonistic lifestyle. However, similarly to her smoking addiction, her hedonistic ways are not used as pleasure, but rather as another defense mechanism.

144597.description: The underboss of the Inada Group, and the initial supplier of Washizu's victims. He, along with Yasuoka, sets up the death match between Akagi and Washizu, hoping to use Akagi as an assassin to bring down Washizu once and for all. For this purpose, he bets his own arm on the outcome of the match.

144598.description: Washizu's right-hand man and his partner in Washizu Mahjong.

144621.description: Naomi is a former Parasite from the Thirteenth Plantation with the codename "703". She is the former partner of [Hiro](https://anilist.co/character/124380/Hiro), who held her back from becoming a pilot due to his inability to pilot FRANXX.

144632.description:
Shiomi is a 74th Generation Toutsuki Academy Alumnus and a former resident of the Polar Star Dormitory. She is one of the lecturers in Tootsuki Culinary Academy as well as the professor of the Shiomi Seminar. Shiomi Jun is leagal guardian of Hayama Akira.

Jun is the youngest lecturer in the academy, but is actually older than she physically appears. Despite the fact that she in her 30s, she is shorter than both Souma and Megumi and has a noticeably youthful face, causing both Souma and Megumi to mistake her as a middle school student of the academy.

144665.description:
**Height:** 156 cm (5'1")

Sumi is a college student who works as a rental girlfriend for the Diamond app. She's extremely shy which initially made the job quite difficult for her, but she started to improve after spending time with [Kazuya](https://anilist.co/character/128105/Kinoshita-Kazuya).

144674.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

He is a second-year high school student with remarkably high grades despite his delinquent lifestyle. Yatora feels like his life is dull and predictable, that is, until he comes across his senpai, [Maru Mori](https://anilist.co/character/157117/Mori-Maru), painting in the school's art club. He discovers his passion for painting and dedicates his remaining school years to it, aiming to pass the Tokyo University of the Arts entrance exam.

Although Yatora is very hardworking and looks composed, there is an underlying insecure part of him that is further exposed when he starts making art. He has an extroverted nature and can easily understand what others are looking for in a relationship, further adapting himself in order to please everyone around him. For that reason, he tends to oppress his own feelings and wishes. Yatora relies a lot on his studied social skills whenever he is under a stressful or unfamiliar situation, but when he is caught by surprise or can't keep up his composed act he has an emotional outburst, often resulting in him crying and speaking more honestly. Yatora is especially hard on himself, putting high standards on himself while constantly undervaluing his own work and comparing himself to others, which ends up overwhelming him. Whilst comparing himself with others, he has great respect and admires the art that others around him create.

name.native: サルトリーヌ・アルダレイク

144683.description:
Saltherine Aldarake, or Sally, is a bright, cheerful princess who wants to go on an adventure because she is bored of her tiny little castle in the countryside. 

Sally has a kind-hearted spirit who craves for adventure. She is always protective of her friends and longs to fulfill her goal of having humans and Oni live together in peace. When she activates her Peach eyes she takes on a form almost identical to the one Mikoto takes while fighting Oni.

144717.description: Adachi Sakura is a high school student. She is found skipping class on the second floor of the gym by [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura) one day. The two of them gradually became friends and began to spend a lot of time together. Adachi had an extremely introverted personality. Before meeting Shimamura, she never had someone whom she can call a friend. Adachi was said to be cold toward other people and didn't attempt to make friends with other people in the past. She also gets very jealous when Shimamura is together with her friends, and as a consequence usually ends up running away.

144718.description:
Shimamura Hougetsu is a high school student. She met [Adachi](https://anilist.co/character/144717/Sakura-Adachi) while skipping class on the second floor of the gym in her school when Adachi accidentally walks in on her one day. (In both manga adaptations, it was Shimamura who walked in on Adachi in the gym when they first met instead of the reverse.) The two instantly took a liking for each other and began to hang out together all the time. Shimamura has tail-bone length, dyed brown hair, which she keeps out of her face with two clips on the right side. Her eyes are also brown. Despite playing basketball in middle school, Shimamura is on the shorter side. She has a slim figure. Shimamura tends to think of interpersonal relationships as bothersome since she feels that it requires too much effort to maintain a balanced relationship.

~!During a summer break in their second year of high school, Shimamura is confessed to by Adachi at a summer festival, and chooses to accept her feelings, thus becoming her girlfriend.!~

144797.description: The lead singer of idol group Sweet Bullet. Her nickname is Zukky.

145078.description: Mikine's senior in the biology club who, much like her cow-like name suggests, has ample breasts.

145120.description:
__Sigil:__ Lie Detector
__Clan:__ Sunset Ravens

He is a participant in the Darwin Game and uses a machine gun as a weapon. His sigil enables him to know if people are lying or not. He seems to have a personal grudge against "One", the leader of the clan "Eighth".

145127.description:
__Sigil:__ Light of Pollux
__Clan:__ Sunset Ravens

A player in Darwin Game who has the sigil to control water. Souta's twin sister.

145157.description:
Shuichi is a third-year high school student and wants to be a normal person and wants things to stay the same forever. but he is scared of himself as he has the ability to turn into a monster.

His abilities allow​ him to transform into a mascot character which gives him enhanced physical strength and sense of smell. It also has a zipper which can be unzipped so that someone can go inside of him. This will allow that person to control Shuichi's body. 

If he and the person inside of him have the same goals, he can collaborate with them and join forces and fuse together to become one being and their soul, body and memories will be connected and they will be able to overcome their limits.
~!In the past, Shuichi and Elena were a couple.!~

145159.description:
A female freshman from Shuichi's highschool that in the beginning of the series attempts to commit suicide by immolation due to the death of her parents to the hands of a "monster." She is saved from this situation by Shuichi. Whilst being saved, she discovers Shuichi's other form and with this information she later convinces him into doing what she wants him to do.

She is a rather smart girl that takes advantage of any opportunity to gain the upper hand in any given situation be it by using her female attributes (mostly against Shuichi) or by using the enemies' secrets and goals against them. She is also quite emotionally complex, being very caring and concerned for the people that she cares about while at the same being able to kill someone in order to ensure that she and the people closest to her survive but feeling terrible with herself after the fact. She also massively enjoys the power that comes with teaming up with Shuichi to the point of almost sexual pleasure.

145224.description: A former colleague of [Akihito Narihisago](https://anilist.co/character/143399/Akihito-Narihisago), he heads the Kura division that operates the Mizuhanome System.

145226.description: Sarina Togo is Inspector Momoki's main assistant and general analyst.

145228.description:
Koharu Hondoumachi is one of the protagonists of ID:Invaded. She assists [Matsuoka](https://anilist.co/character/145232/Kokuryuu-Matsuoka) in tracking down serial killers in the field.

~!After incidents involving [Tamotsu Fukuda](https://anilist.co/character/154397/Fukuda-Tamotsu) and [Haruka Kazuta](https://anilist.co/character/161511/Haruka-Kazuta), she becomes one of the brilliant detectives under the name Miyo Hijiriido.!~

145288.description: She is a Demon Slayer, though she works as a servant in the Butterfly Estate rather than taking to the front lines.

145341.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

He is a founding member and the leader of Tokyo Manji Gang.
 
Mikey is usually a carefree teenager who loves to joke and play pranks around those he considers his close friends. He cares for them greatly and is determined to protect their honor. He rarely shows any sign of weakness, as he believes himself to be the foundation and support for Toman, and if the pillar himself were to display weakness, Toman would also be weakened.

~!Younger brother of [Shinichiro](https://anilist.co/character/221297/Shinichirou-Sano), older half brother of [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/171924/Emma-Sano) and younger "adoptive" brother of [Izana](https://anilist.co/character/170484/Izana-Kurokawa)!~

145342.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Takemichi learns that the girl he dated in middle school—the only girl he ever dated—has died. Then, after an accident he finds himself in a time leap back to his middle school years. He vows to change the future and save the girl, and to do that he aims to rise to the top of the Kantou region's most brutal delinquent gang.

~!After the fight with Valhalla he becomes the First division Capitan of Toman.!~

~!He later became the eleventh President of the Black Dragons as well as the captain of the First Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang, and a member of Brahman.!~

~!Takemichi is also the president and founder (with [Chifuyu Matsuno](https://anilist.co/character/145344/Matsuno-Chifuyu)) of the Thousand Winters (later renamed as Tokyo Manji), created to defeat Kanto Manji.!~

145343.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

Captain of the 1st division and one of the founders of the Tokyo Manji Gang.

Baji has a wild personality. He loves the thrill of adrenaline and [Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341) himself says that he would punch someone out on the street for no apparent reason, only because he feels like it. In combat, he is never without his trademark grin.

alternative: Vice-Leader of The Tokyo 卍 Gang

145345.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")

Draken is [Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341/Manjirou-Sano)'s best friend and one of the founders of Toman. 

Draken is a muscular teenager who is exceptionally tall for his age. His head is shaven on the sides and back to expose his signature dragon tattoo on his left temple. His blonde hair is long on the top of his head and kept in a neat braid. Draken is a serious teen who lives in a brothel, he does not know his biological parents and was 'taken in' by the owners of the brothel.

~!His mother was a prostitute who abandoned him at birth and died when he was two years old.!~

~!In the future, Draken owns a bike shop, and is a member of Brahman.!~

145715.description:
**Height:** 168 cm (5'6")

A character with semi-long hair. She likes to make fun of people.

145716.description:
**Height:** 157 cm (5'2")

A girl with a tan and soft wavy hair. She actually has a "haraguro" personality.

(Haraguro: a character that is kind or friendly on the outside but uses those traits as a means to manipulate others.)

145717.description:
**Height:** 171 cm (5'7")

The art club president. She has long hair that frames her face with dark-brown eyes. Her personality is stern and serious based on her interactions with [Senpai](https://anilist.co/character/124697), but she treats him with respect unlike [Nagatoro](https://anilist.co/character/124696). She also bears a resemblance to a female character in one of the manga Senpai wrote. 

[Sunomiya](https://anilist.co/character/226964/Sunomiya) is her younger cousin.

145718.description:
**Height:** 160 cm (5'2")

A natural airheaded twintail girl. She is a moron who likes [Gamo-chan](https://anilist.co/character/145715) as she usually repeats or follows her up with something she has just said. Yoshi also seems to like animals as she’s been seen with a gorilla shirt and she has a pet dog. She also seems to be into cute things as she once accepted a “Squiddy” plush from [Nagatoro](https://anilist.co/character/124696) in return for [Senpai](https://anilist.co/character/124697) in a contest.

145729.description:
__Occupation:__ Student Council President

She is a perfectionist and wants to be the best at everything. She has an ability called "The still untouched, unknowing maiden. (The eternal aisle)". Every time she takes off a piece of underwear she can make what was done into something it wasn't.

145730.description: Once he is introduced to Takane Takamine, he is soon told that he will become her "closet", in which he has to replace her underwear once she has used her ability.

name.native: アストルフォ・グラナトゥム

145998.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Paladin of the Chasseurs

He is a human who at the age of fifteen became the youngest Paladin in the history of the Chasseurs, and having been subject to the bias that all Vampires are inherently evil, has dedicated his life toward their eradication in the name of his faith. 

Astolfo displays psychotic behavior in the face of battle. He relishes the slaughtering of both humans and vampires alike for grievances as petty as being mistaken for a woman. His belief that a Chasseur's duty is not to protect humans but to hunt vampires enables his lust for blood. He has also shown short-temperedness, particularly when called a woman or when his skills are compared to fellow Paladin, [Roland Fortis](https://anilist.co/character/139554/Fortis-Roland).

146057.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'7")

A reliable university student who wants to become a civil servant. Works part-time under [Richard](https://anilist.co/character/146058/Richard-Ranashinha-de-Vulpian).  Like his name, he's straightforward until he encounters an unusual situation - then he becomes a heedless "ally of justice" ('seigi no mikata' in Japanese). As a child, his parents were divorced with his mother taking custody of him; he then lived with his maternal grandmother. His maternal grandmother was also a single mother who stole to make a living. One of the items she stole was a pink sapphire engagement ring, which she thought the loss of led to the death of the woman who it belonged to. In her guilt, she kept it until her death where she bequeathed it to Seigi. Seigi's quest to return the ring to its rightful owner marks the beginning of his association with Richard de Vulpian.

name.native: リチャード・ラナシンハ・ドヴルピアン

146058.description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'8")

A skilled jeweler who speaks fluent Japanese, despite being both Japanese and British with Sri Lankan heritage. His age is unknown and he has a level of unrivalled beauty that dumbfounds people, regardless of their gender. Richard tends to keep to himself for the most part. He is soft-spoken and very formal. As his relationship with [Seigi](https://anilist.co/character/146057/Seigi-Nakata) develops, his stoic facade begins to fade as he opens up more, revealing a kind and caring person. Though he remains stoic, he has a love for sweet things.

name.native: ネルヴァ=マルティーリョ

146260.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

He is a world-renowned violinist. He is [Akihiko](https://anilist.co/character/136842/Kaji-Akihiko)'s room and classmate, and on-again-off-again boyfriend as well as a University student. He has been classmates with Akihiko since their high school days. Though he is Akihiko's roommate, he sometimes goes abroad and sometimes he stays in Japan.

Ugetsu is very intelligent and a prodigy violinist. He is generally a cheerful and friendly person, he is warm and affectionate towards others, such as welcoming Akihiko home. He is very sharp about other people‘s feelings.

Ugetsu is very emotional and capable of overwhelming feelings but he doesn’t know how to express them properly except through his music. When Ugetsu is under pressure he is easily irascible and unstable; in fact he shows to be moody, and violent as well, hitting Akihiko on the face and breaking or throwing things around him.

146448.description:
Hakua's personal maid. She also documents everything that Hakua tendency writes. Unlike the other maids, Sakimori is opening minded about leaving Hakua under Kimito's care. In an extra chapter, Kimito dreams about being married to Sakimori, with a daughter named Yukari, whom a grownup Hakua occasionally visits to tutor.
(Source: Wikipedia)

146450.description: Reiko's older brother who is very protective of his sister, resulting in having a sister complex. He is firmly against Reiko's arranged marriage and turns to Kimito for help.

146534.description:
Namikoshi is Akechi's best friend during middle school.
At some point it is revealed that Namikoshi is also the starter of the Twenty Faces (二十面相 Ni-jū Mensō) phenomenom and the first Twenty Faces itself.
(Source: Rampo Kitan Wiki)

146535.description:
The medical examiner who delivers the results of autopsies in frantic scenes of exposition.
Her personality is revealed to be much more twisted due to an incident where her little brother, who was terminally ill, committed suicide in order to make it less painful for her, but the plan backfired and caused her to become one of the Twenty Faces.
(Source: Wikipedia)

146536.description:
Kage Otoko is a phantom thief, capable of disguising himself as anyone (except young girls). Thus, it is unknown who he really is.

(Source: Rampo Kitan Wiki)

146582.description: She's the owner of a cafe in Arabi called 'Port Lounge Ossicle' that Mikochi frequently visits.

146584.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Hair Color:__ Blue
__Eye Color:__ Blue/Grey
__Body Physique:__ Three Thousand Star Constitution

Xiao Yan from Battle Through Heavens (Doupo Cangqiong) was a the genius of the Xiao family until his mother passed away and he lost his cultivation prowess. He aims to take back his glory and reach the pinnacle of the cultivation path where no one can stand against him, the rank of Dou Di. Xiao Yan practices the Flame mantra Dou Qi training method and as such can quickly cultivate up the ranks and conquer his enemies one step at a time. ~! The reason later on as to why he lost all of his power was due to a ring left by his mother, The ring housed a legendary alchemist who was regaining his power using Xiao Yan. After the ring stops absorbing his powers and Yao Lao gains most of his power back he chooses to use the wisdom of Yao Lao to take revenge on the members of his family that disliked him and treated him like trash after his mothers death. !~

146626.description: Shitai-kun is the doll Minami beats up when she is demonstrating autopsies.

146628.description: Kuro Tokage is a criminal housed in an unknown prison, assumedly in Shinjuku. She has a preexisting relationship with Akechi. Also, she has two man-servants who obey her every command including when she wants to torture them.

146633.description: Veteran criminal investigator of the Shinjuku Police Department.

146640.description: Watanuki is a repeat criminal offender.

146645.description: Chiyoko Higashikouji is a worker for Komoda and Hitomi's company.

146936.description: She is Usa's former middle school classmate from West Junior High, where she was one of the oddballs who was associated with Usa. She later on changes her looks and attitude upon attending high school.

147005.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

Ruka Sarashina suffers from arrhythmia and seeks a lover that will help her cope with her condition. She's seen as being a very pushy and possessive kind of person. This personality of hers developed after learning of her condition and being alienated from her peers. Because of this, she became very fixated on the idea that getting a boyfriend would help her in having a faster heartbeat.

Along with her rather brash personality, she doesn't like giving up easily; often making poor decisions to get what she wants.

name.native: シャルロット・シャルゼン

147082.description:
__Height: __ 172.72cm

He is the leader of "Welter" (The Guardians)—the self-governing body of "Feste" (The Castle) located on "Mermaid," an artificial island where those infected with the Armed Virus are quarantined—and refers to himself as "Boku."

Known as "Gouverneur" (The Governor), he wears a white, high-collared military-style uniform. As the only male on the island, he possesses both charisma and striking good looks; addressed as "Akira-sama," he is the object of admiration for the island's girls—including Shojo Mamori, who admires him enough to have a poster of him in her room.

~!In reality, she hails from the wealthy "Hiiragi Zaibatsu" (conglomerate). She had entered the island disguised as a male under orders from her mother, Yui. Although she has a busty figure, she binds her chest tightly while in male disguise; however, she occasionally ventures out secretly wearing a long-haired wig and feminine clothing (she also wore her hair long before coming to the island).!~

147089.description:
He found [Seven](https://anilist.co/character/147093/Liuqi-Wu) on a beach 2 years ago and saved his life, but because of this, he's now covered in medical bills that he has to pay off. To pay for them all, he attempts to put Seven into all kinds of odd jobs, but eventually pushes him into an assassinating job. 

Dai Bo gives his invention, the GaiBa Egg, to Seven and instructs him on how to become a killer. He also introduces him to [Xiao Fei](https://anilist.co/character/147099/Xiaofei-Ji) and tells him to use him to flee the scene when he needs it. He soon realizes that Seven is useless as a killer as he always loses, can't bring himself to kill most of his targets, and even saves them.

147092.description:
Thirteen is a mysterious masked assassin, anti-hero, and the thirteenth daughter of the Plum Blossom swordsman. 

Having been trained as a cold-blooded assassin, Thirteen is first seen as a detached and cool headed person but also prideful of her skills. When her mask is broken, it shows an easily flustered young woman who seems to have some troubles to completely disregard her feelings of rights and wrongs. [Seven](https://anilist.co/character/147093/Liuqi-Wu) happens to develop a crush on her after their second encounter, and tends to hit on her. When Seven hits on her _(which is during most of their interactions)_, she tends to act like a tsundere towards him.

~!She also developed feelings for Seven as shown at the end of season 2 when she was seen waiting by the ocean with a dress she bought herself and the bag with the swimsuit he bought her.!~

147093.description:
He's a 21-year-old barber who suffers from amnesia. Alongside his boss _(and best friend)_ [Dai Bo](https://anilist.co/character/147089/Dabao-Ji) and [Xiao Fei,](https://anilist.co/character/147099/Xiaofei-Ji) works as an assassin for hire to gain a lot of yuan to retrieve his lost memory. He was found by Dai Bo and Xiao Fei on a beach in Chicken Island when he was 19 and has been living with them for 2 years and runs a barbershop business. 

His assassin rank is 17, 369. Before his memory loss, his assassin rank was 1. 

Seven is goofy, a little absent-minded at times, and is a bit of a pushover. He decided to become a killer supposedly because he lacks any morals and is only interested in becoming rich, but he never manages to kill his targets. This is partly because of his incompetence, but also because he actually doesn't want to actually kill others. As the series progresses, his sense of justice slowly comes more and more into the spotlight. 

He's a hopeless romantic and constantly hits on [Thirteen](https://anilist.co/character/147092/Shisan-Meihua) despite her clear disinterest in him.

147099.description:
Xiao Fei is the son of Da Fei and adoptive son of [Dai Bo.](https://anilist.co/character/147089/Dabao-Ji) He's a flying chicken and always follows [Seven](https://anilist.co/character/147093/Liuqi-Wu) around. 

Dai Bo introduces Xiao Fei to Seven as a means to fly away from tough situations. Since then they are always together and Xiao Fei becomes more and more attached to Seven as he keeps helping people. 

Happy and innocent of the time, he can also get angry if someone he knows is hurt or in trouble. Xiao Fei is also very brave as he is willing to fight to protect Seven even against opponents that are stronger than him.

147574.description: Zen Seizaki is the main character in Babylon and a prosecutor at the Tokyo District Public Prosecutors Office.

147575.description: A colleague of Zen Seizaki who helps investigate the pharmaceutical scandal.

147580.description:
Shinobu Kujin is an inspector at the Tokyo District Public Prosecutors Office. 

Shinobu is approached by Zen Seizaki for his help in investigating the crimes of a pharmaceutical company.

147582.description:
In the series, he's 30 years old and is one of the candidates in the mayoral race. 

~!he pushes for law reform to legalize suicide.!~

147759.description:
__Occupation:__~!Security Devil, Babyls Teacher!~

Sullivan's servant who does the chores around the house.

Opera was Kalego's upperclassman when they were both students at Babyls.

Opera has a serious, down to earth personality. They often act as a voice of reason for Lord Sullivan, but are usually ignored. They are mostly reserved with their opinion, but will voice the occasional concern or cynical remark, and will sometimes dispense helpful advice.

Their interactions with Kalego reveal that they have a somewhat more mischievous and sadistic side not normally shown in their professional behavior, which was especially prominent when they were students at Babyls.

147782.description: Ai Magase is a mysterious yet beautiful woman who manipulates several powerful figures who got involved in the "Shiniki Initiative Conspiracy" by disguising herself as several beautiful women to do her bidding.

147892.description: Maple is the main heroine, who has just started playing NewWorld Online. A shielder class. Since she doesn’t want to get hurt, she always puts her skill points into vitality. Due to this, many think of her as useless offensively, but much to their surprise, she manages her own. She's a bit silly, though surprisingly intelligent, and often abuses the game's mechanics in ways the game developers don't expect. Most of her actions in-game are done for the sole purpose of having fun, and though she participates in in-game tournaments often, she's only competitive insofar as it's enjoyable to her.

147893.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

[Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/147892)'s gamer gal pal who invited her to the VRMMORPG NewWorld Online. She is a professional gamer, having numerous achievements that certify her capabilities. Being the swashbuckler class, her reflexes are considered abnormal.

Sally is extroverted, cautious, and practical, reflecting on her past experience with other games. She also has a creative and tricky side to her, evidenced by her choice to become a swashbuckler so that her party with Maple "would never take any damage", as opposed to the more conventional choice of being a mage so she could support Maple from the rear.

148035.description:
Manager of the boys’ soft tennis club. They are the younger sibling of Izumi and Hikari Asuka. 

~!
Their sisters and Maki call them a more gender-neutral “Yuu”. Unbeknownst to Touma, Yuu has a crush on him. 
Yuu is revealed to be non-binary and questioning their gender in episode 8.!~
(Source: Stars Align Wiki)

148212.description: A 10-year-old fifth grader and Masamichi's only son. Masatsuga has black hair and gray-ish eyes. Even though there is an age gap, he says that Aoi was his “First love”, and he pursues her consistently throughout the film.

148213.description: A classmate of Aoi. She dreams of getting a boyfriend who is in a band.

148214.description: A former drummer in Shinnosuke's band, and high school classmate of Akane and Shinnosuke. He divorced his cheating wife and has a crush on Akane.

148215.description:
Occupation(s):
- ~!Guitarist (31 years old)!~
- Student (18 years old)

Shinnosuke is a struggling guitarist at the introduction of the movie. He and Akane Aioi were supposed to move in together after graduating high school, but after the death of her parents, she decided not to. He and Akane drift apart while he leaves to chase his dreams, but he fails to achieve the aspirations he set for himself and as a result has many regrets weighing on him. 

~!An ikiryou (living ghost) of his younger self appears and meets his ex-girlfriend’s Akane Aioi's little sister Aoi Aioi. They discuss life and what it means to chase your dreams. His present self later marries Akane in 2022!~

148216.description: Aoi is a second-year high school student. She is an aspiring musician who was influenced by Shinno. She grows up thinking that Akane did not go to Tokyo with Shinno because of her.

148217.description: Aoi's 31-year-old reserved older sister who has been supporting both of them after the death of their parents. She broke off her relationship to Shinnosuke Kanamuro after the death of her parents. They later meet years later, and are able to reflect on how their lives turned out in comparison to what they imagined as teenagers.

148333.description: Leader of an evil organization set out to destroy Earth. On his days off, however, he indulges in plenty of Earth pleasantries, ranging from food to looking at his favorite animal, pandas.

148365.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm
__Charm:__ Gungnir

A refugee who was deprived from her home by the Huge. When her life was saved by [Yuyu](https://anilist.co/character/148366/Yuyu-Shirai), she pursued her dream to be miraculously enrolled at Yurigaoka Jogakuin. Riri has the belief that even people with different opinions can understand each other. From this philosophy, she will fight with many Lilies and gradually emerge in the battle against the Huge. She a hard worker and works hard on everything. A little natural but bright and gentle personality. Her favorite food is Ramune juice.

148366.description:
__Charm:__ Dainsleif
__Height:__163 cm
__Rare Skill:__ Lunatic Trancer

The Lily who represents all of Yurigaoka. She has fought the Huge in the front lines and has stood victorious across many battlefields. Being one of the most prominent Lilies at Yurigaoka Jogakuin and wielding incredible combat power, Yuyu holds a rare skill called 'Lunatic Transer,' and has garnered many fans because she fights hard with mental instability. Although she was nicknamed 'Shinigami,' having lost her friend from her negligence, Yuyu overcomes many trials and grows into a great Lily.

name.native: ミリアム・ヒルデガルド・V・グロピウス

148370.description:
__Nationality:__ German
__Height:__ 153 cm
__Rare Skill:__ Phase Transcendence

A bright and friendly personality, but a genius-like troublemaker that causes trouble. Miriam can't control her curiosity and the feeling of playing games, and she loves people and loves talking to people. She has a cute side, so she's not disliked by her peers, but she tends to be shunned by serious people.

148371.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm
__Nationality:__ French-Japanese
__Charm:__ Gungnir
__Rare Skill:__ Register

A prodigy who ranked number one in the high school transfer examination at Yurigaoka Jogakuin. Kaede is half-French and half-Japanese, and comes from a family who carries the bloodline of both Japanese and French nobility. She boasts high intelligence, a good personality, and a high combat ability that overwhelms the Huge. Known as an impeccable Lily, Kaede has an over-the-top personality of 'loving cute girls.

148372.description:
__Charm:__ Asterion
__Height:__ 163 cm

Yujia is a self-confident girl thanks to growing up as the middle child of three sisters. Because she is quiet and not good at showing her emotions, she is often misunderstood as "angry". She is roommates with Kuo Shenlin.

148373.description:
__Charm:__ Masolelic
__Height:__ 165 cm
__Nationality:__ Taiwanese

An elegant young lady from Taipei who attends Yurigaoka. Shenlin will speak out against what she believes is wrong, but is usually a very kind girl. She is roommates with Wang Yujia.

(Source: Assault Lily Wiki)

148740.description:
Reze is a young girl who met [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) in a phone cabin. She works at a local café and is a kind and gentle girl who seems to have a crush on Denji soon after meeting him. She laughs at his jokes and isn't afraid to get close to and intimate with him.

~!‌‌‌‌‌‌‌‌She is secretly the Bomb Devil hybrid, owned by the Soviet Union and allied to the Gun Devil. Her true personality is manipulative and brutal, as she is shown killing many Devil Hunters without care or mercy. She does, however, not enjoy killing and prefers to avoid it, unless necessary for her mission. Her objective is to retrieve the Chainsaw Heart from Denji, but the feelings she developed for him quickly made things more complicated.!~

148749.description:
Saki is [Kurou Sakuragawa](https://anilist.co/character/125947)'s former girlfriend. She works as a traffic division officer at the local police department.

She is a mature young woman who likes to think things through rationally but is easily scared by yokai.

(Source: Kyokou Suiri Wiki)

alternative: Yamada Asaemon Shugen (山田浅ェ門殊現)

148752.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Water
__Occupation:__ Asaemon, Assistant Instructor
__Affiliation:__ Yamada Clan
__Rank:__ 2nd

Shugen is the 2nd ranked Asaemon, as well as an Assistant Instructor, in the Yamada clan. Shugen is the leader of the second team sent to Kotaku after the [shogun](https://anilist.co/character/301606/Nariyoshi-Tokugawa) became impatient waiting for the first team to comeback. 

Shugen is very dignified and diligent in his duties as an Asaemon. Shugen cares greatly for his Yamada clansmen, having spent his years with them and being taught what they know. He greatly expressed his concern for their safety on the island and vowed to bring them back home no matter what the means were. Furthermore, Shugen has a tendency to become emotional whenever he thinks about his comrades. He's one of the only Yamada clan members who doesn't look down on women in the clan and vouches for their qualifications as executioners. He greatly despises all criminals and truly believes that they are evil no matter who they are. At a young age, Shugen could not understand the Yamada clan's way of thinking when executing criminals and believed that they should all deserve a painful death.

Shugen believes in order of all things in the world; the order in which those who abide by the law are to be protected while those who break them should be punish without mercy.

148753.description:
__Height:__ 173 - 185 cm
__Race:__ Tensen
__Tao Attribute:__ Earth
__Occupation:__ Ruler of Kotaku
__Affiliation:__ Lord Tensen

Mu Dan is a member of Lord Tensen, as well as one of the rulers of Kotaku.

Mu Dan has a cheerful, yet very sadistic attitude. He is very blunt with his words and is not afraid to tell his enemies what they want because of the confidence in his own power. Mu Dan views humans as simply research material and "toys" that he can do whatever he wants with.  He seems to get along quite well enough with the other Tensens, shown as they were all having a nice conversation. However, he shows no signs of pity for them no matter what. Mu Dan stated that he is a believer in functional beauty and preferres the male gender because there was nothing wasted in its composition.

148754.description:
__Height:__ 173 - 185 cm
__Race:__ Human; Tensen (Through her puppets)
__Tao Attribute:__ Earth
__Occupation:__ Leader of Lord Tensen, Ruler of Kotaku
__Affiliations:__ Lord Tensen

Rien is a Tensen-class Sennin serving as the true ruler of Kotaku, the creator of the Tensens, and the leader of Lord Tensen.

~!At some point during 3rd century BC, Rien was married to [Jofuku](https://anilist.co/character/306854/Jofuku) and went with him on his voyage to the East to acquire the Elixir of Life for the ruler of the Qin Dynasty. Their journey ended on an island where they decided to use the island's resources and their knowledge of Taoism to discover the secrets to gaining immortality. This resulted in many experimental creations. As part of their research, Rien used her Tao to create a clone of herself that she could remotely control. After receiving a new body, Rien used the Tao puppet to create another fabricated clone named [Mei](https://anilist.co/character/148755/Mei), who assisted both her and Jofuku, along with six fabricated newborns. These seven then came to be known as Tensens. After Jofuku's death, Rien made a commitment to revive him. With the Tensens she created, Rien formed the group known as Lord Tensen to maintain order over the island and trained the six young ones in the ways of Tao.!~

148755.description:
__Tao Attribute:__ Water

An islander from Kotaku. Mei is a shy and quiet girl. She is innocent and can easily be frightened when harm comes to her. Mei is especially kind and caring to the people around her that she views are her allies and can also be accepting of others when seeing their good qualities. When they first met, Mei was afraid of [Gabimaru](https://anilist.co/character/137260/Gabimaru) because of his intimating demeanor but after showing signs of respect towards her she wasn't afraid to come near him.

~!Mei is a Tensen that was formerly affiliated with [Rien](https://anilist.co/character/148754/Rien) and [Xu Fu](https://anilist.co/character/306854/Jofuku) but escaped after disagreeing with Rien's methods to unlock immortality. She then resided with [Hōko](https://anilist.co/character/305440/Houko) and soon became an ally of Gabimaru and his group in their attempt to retrieve the elixir known as Tan from Lord Tensen and escape Kotaku.!~

alternative: Yamada Asaemon Jikka (山田浅ェ門十禾)

148756.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Earth
__Occupation:__ Asaemon
__Affiliation:__ Yamada Clan
__Rank:__ 3rd

Jikka is the 3rd ranked Asaemon in the Yamada clan. After the shogun sent criminals to Kotaku to find the Elixir of Life, he was tasked with being [Hōrubō](https://anilist.co/character/302525/Hourubou)'s executioner.

Jikka is a laid-back individual who compared to his fellow clan members, especially Shugen, is less dedicated to his work as an Asaemon. He is rather dishonest and goes as far as to lie to shogun's officials. Jikka is also rude and disrespectful to others around him regardless of who they are, even towards his fellow Asaemon. Also, unlike his clan members who each show concern for one another, Jikka is the only member shown to have little to no concern over the safety of the other Asaemon. 

Jikka stated that he is an individual that prefers to enjoy life to the fullest rather than focus on status and rank. This way of thinking greatly shows in his life as an executioner as he has been reported to attend his execution assignments while intoxicated and even sold his own sword as a way to collect money for his vulgar exploits. As a result, Jikka has received a bad reputation amongst his peers in the Yamada clan. Despite being so lazy and laid-back he is a very analytical individual and is incapable of being fooled through deception.

~!He is one of the most mysterious people of the Yamada clan and also one of the strongest despite the attitude towards his duties, he is in fact so strong that he's the only person known who has come back from Kotatsu island alive and in perfect condition. Having sold his sword he now carries a simple takemitsu (bamboo sword), but even then he still manages to cut off criminal heads and kill monsters with ease.!~

Jikka believes that he and [Gabimaru](https://anilist.co/character/137260/Gabimaru) are similar in that they value life more than anything.

148767.description: Carrier of the Sakura Empire's Fifth Carrier Division. Older sister of Zuikaku.

148768.description: Carrier of the Sakura Empire's Fifth Carrier Division.

148966.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'1")

Tsubasa and Minami's classmate who, with her raven-hair, reserved personality and choice not to use the Hokkaido dialect, is the exact opposite of Minami. She is very into video games, but pays attention to her appearance; reading fashion and make-up magazines in order to fit in. Because she sweats a lot, Sayuri avoided all forms of exercise, which eventually found her avoiding people in general. Because she has no friends, Sayuri felt a kinship with Tsubasa, and she becomes friends with him and Minami.

149041.description:
__Occupation:__ Witch

Saya is a character introduced in the [Majo no Tabitabi](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. She is an apprentice witch who [Elaina](https://anilist.co/character/125736/Elaina) meets in the Land of Mages as a novice.

Saya has black hair tied back in a small tassel on the left side and blue eyes. She initially wears a charcoal grey outfit, black stockings, and white boots.

Saya is a person with a kind personality on the outside, but is slightly manipulative in her thinking as shown when she manipulated Elaina to stay with her for a while.

She also has a desire to have company and friends, which mostly stemmed from her younger sister returning back to her homeland without her.

149042.description:
__Occupation:__ Witch

Fran is a character introduced in the [Wandering Witch](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. She is [Elaina](https://anilist.co/character/125736/Elaina)'s master and a witch.

Fran has long black hair, blue eyes, and has a beauty mark underneath her right eye. She wears a midnight-blue hat with a red ribbon coiled around it and a matching color outfit both of which have a stary night pattern in the interior. She also wears beige-colored pants, red earrings, brown boots, and her witch's brooch on her right chest.

She's portrayed as an elated and jocular woman. Compared to the other witches in Robetta, she's shown to be a non-judgemental person.

149048.description: The village chief of Kunlun Village.  She secretly has a crush on Lloyd and frequently teleports to the capital to check up on him. ~!While she resembles a twelve-year-old girl she is actually hundreds of years old, and an incredibly powerful magic user.!~ ~!She deliberately filled Lloyd's mind with stories of the army to convince him to leave.!~

149050.description:
A teenage Witch who lives in the East side slums of the capital of Azami, selling potions to the residents, usually for information rather than money on account of the poverty in the East side. She is a former pupil of Alka. 

~!She is secretly the missing princess of the kingdom, Maria Azami.!~

149051.description: A mercenary with one arm. Her left arm has been replaced with a powerful mechanical prosthesis. She joined the army as part of an agreement with the military instructor Merthophan Dextro in exchange for having her criminal record expunged. She's constantly watching for ways to use others to her benefit.

149052.description: Lloyd is a teenage boy from the legendary town of Kunlun who left to become a soldier in the kingdom's army. In his village he's known as a weakling who can't perform any typical jobs to the "normal" expected level. However, the standards of this town, in the most dangerous region of the world, are incredibly skewed and truthfully he is terrifyingly powerful by outside standards. He's kind and generous, eager to help and very humble. He excels at cooking and cleaning, but cannot be convinced of his true power.

149053.description: Also known as the "Cursed Belt Princess." Daughter of a noble, Selen was cursed as a child by a magic belt that wrapped tightly around her head and could not be removed by any known magic. This accident led to scandal and shame to the nobility. She desperately developed her strength on account of a claim that power greater than the belt would break it, and came to the capital to join the army and further hone her power. When Lloyd broke the curse on their first meeting, she developed a powerful crush on him. She has a tendency to talk of herself and Lloyd as already being mutually in love and showing animosity toward those she perceives as rivals.

149088.description: The show's main character. One day she stumbled upon a ChamJam performance. Ever since then, she's been the biggest fan of Maina, spending most of her income on concerts and merch. Usually wears a salmon pink tracksuit, the same color as Maina's clothes.

149090.description:
__Height:__ 152 cm
__Birthplace:__ Kurashiki City, Okayama Prefecture
__Member color:__ Salmon pink

As the least popular member of ChamJam, she has very few fans. She's very shy and often has trouble getting her feeling across.

149187.description: Death Arms is a Pro Hero. He took part in the fight against the Sludge Villain, and later witnessed the U.A. Sports Festival from outside the arena, along with Mt. Lady and Kamui Woods.

149542.description: **Birth date:** November 20, 1975The leader of F Squad in Public Safety Division 5.

149543.description: A police officer who is assigned to F Squad during their investigation of the terrorist group CCC.

149544.description:
A police officer who is appointed leader of F Squad during their investigation of the terrorist group CCC.

Despite his dark under-eye circles, he is not a devil. He just stays up late reading manga and light novels.

~!He is secretly a member of the CCC, where he acts under the code name 13, or Jason.!~

~!His real position is within Public Safety General Affairs, the 6th Public Safety Investigation Division, Section 11. He infiltrated the CCC in order to obtain enemy intel.!~

149545.description:
The leader of A Squad in Public Safety Division 5.

~!He is secretly the commander of the anti-devil terrorist group CCC, where he acts under the code name 02. He infiltrated Public Safety Division 5 to gain intel from the police forces about devils.!~

149583.description: She is a second year student in High School and a member of the school Newspaper Club who is in love with [Amatsuyu Kisaragi](https://anilist.co/character/138900).

149676.description:
Asakusa is a freshman at Shibahama Highschool who likes anime. She is full of curiosity and imagination, yet not that sociable. Her policy is “Anime is all about its setting” and she has kept various settings inspired by her daily life in her sketchbook. 

[Sayaka Kanamori](https://anilist.co/character/149677/Kanamori-Sayaka), Asakusa’s classmate, used to be the only person who knows about Asakusa’s passion, but when they visited Anime Club together they got along with [Tsubame Mizusaki](https://anilist.co/character/149678/Mizusaki-Tsubame), which led them to start up Eizouken. Her goal is to explore her own “Incredible World”.

149677.description:
[Asakusa's](https://anilist.co/character/149676/Asakusa-Midori) classmate who is tall and long-legged. Though she has neither interest nor knowledge of anime, she somehow took interest in Asakusa and hangs out with her. Kanamori loves the activity which makes money and she tries to find the way even in small talk. 

After starting up Eizouken, she takes on the role of producer, being the only realist in the team, and proves herself through negotiating with the school and student council. Asakusa and [Mizusaki's](https://anilist.co/character/149678/Mizusaki-Tsubame) nature of being creators always troubles her though she respects their abilities.

149678.description:
Asakusa’s classmate who is a charismatic amateur model and is famous in the school. She is expected to be an actress in the future as both of her parents are actors, but she actually wants to be an animator and is especially good at capturing motion of characters. 

As Mizusaki has been banned from joining Anime Club by her parents, she joins Eizoken instead and starts to create anime together with Asakusa and Kanamori. She has different sense of money from two of them as she comes from a rich family.

149900.description:
**Height:** 157 cm (5'2")

Claire François is a proud noble who in the original [Revolution] is the villainess who bullies the heroine. 
~!In the original Revolution game, she is doomed to be executed, along with the rest of nobility, as a result of the revolution.!~
Claire is prideful with a competitive side to prove her worth as well as her family name. Her threatening behaviour conceals her fragile heart that comes from her childhood experiences. Becomes more prone to jealously as people she cares for may leave her. Her arrogant personality is mainly influenced by her father doting on her in her childhood more than anything.

149938.description: She's a professional karuta reader, often reading for championships or higher level events. She has a granddaughter, Rion Yamashiro.

150027.description: The one and only female member of the Pretty Boy Detective Club. Mayumi is a beautiful girl, though she cross-dresses when in the club. Students often call her literal starry eyes beautiful, though she does not like being called beautiful at all. Due to this, she wears glasses to make her starry eyes less prominent.

150254.description:
The Dog familiar. His knight partner is Shinonome Hangetsu.

(Source: The Lucifer and Biscuit Hammer Wiki)

150255.description:
The Mantis familar. His partner is Sorano Hanako.

(Source: The Lucifer and Biscuit Hammer Wiki)

150256.description:
The Horse familiar. His knight partner is Nagumo Souichirou.

(Source: The Lucifer and Biscuit Hammer Wiki)

150257.description:
The Swordfish familar. His knight partner is Akitani Inachika.

(Source: The Lucifer and Biscuit Hammer Wiki)

150259.description:
The Mouse familar. His knight partner is Kusakabe Tarou.

(Source: The Lucifer and Biscuit Hammer Wiki)

150260.description:
The Snake familiar. His knight partner is Hakudou Yayoi.

(Source: The Lucifer and Biscuit Hammer Wiki)

150261.description:
The Rooster familiar. His knight partner is Hoshikawa Subaru.

(Source: The Lucifer and Biscuit Hammer Wiki)

150264.description:
The Crow familiar. Her knight partner is Shinonome Mikazuki.

(Source: The Lucifer and Biscuit Hammer Wiki)

150417.description:
__Height:__ 5'9 (175cm)

[Official Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ryuji_ayukawa/)

Yatora's classmate and fellow art club member, they are responsible for inviting Yatora to the art club. Yuka has a talent for modern street fashion.

They are closest to their grandmother, who is the reason why they decided to pursue Japanese Art. Yuka will often put on a bright demeanor in front of themselves, and when placed in stressful situations they are often brash and impulsive. Yuka's mother and father both disapprove of their identity and lifestyle. It's shown that they don't have a very happy home life, and can only find solace in the company of their Grandmother, who is accepting of them and their aspirations. It is implied that they often go out at night to get away from home, and that their parents suspect them of trading dates with men for money.

Prefers to be called "Yuka", as they choose not to go by the name "Ayu" since their idol is singer Ayumi Hamasaki. Yuka is known to often crossdress and test gendered standards of clothing. ~!In chapter 20, Yuka tells Yatora about their bisexuality, explaining how they fell in love with a female middle school friend, but also feels an appeal towards men as well.!~

name.native: ベッキー・ブラックベル

150423.description:
__Affiliation:__ Blackbell Family, Blackbell Heavy Industries, Eden Academy, Cecile Hall
__Occupation:__ Student

The daughter of the CEO of Blackbell, a major military manufacturer. Attends Eden Academy as part of Cecil House, Group 3. Best friends with [Anya Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Forger-Anya).

Becky is a very kind child but with her being the daughter of a major military manufacturer, she is shown to be somewhat prideful and tries to be mature, attempting to take Anya under her wing as an act of benevolence when she views Anya as a brat. She does not attempt to get close to [Damian Desmond](https://anilist.co/character/150424/Desmond-Damian) despite his social position, even looking down on their classmates who try to befriend Damian and Anya who is initially bullied by Damian's group. Anya's confident smile later wins over Becky's admiration.

name.native: ダミアン・デズモンド

150424.description:
__Height:__ 110 cm (3′7″)
__Affiliation:__ Desmond Family, Eden Academy, Cecile Hall
__Occupation:__ Student

The second son of [Donovan Desmond](https://anilist.co/character/180192/Desmond-Donovan) and attends Eden Academy as part of Cecile House, Group 3.  

A young child with an arrogant and rude personality, caused by him being the second son of Donovan Desmond, the leader of the National Unity Party, a group important and powerful enough to threaten the peace between the East and the West. This has caused Damian to gain a highly respected status among his peers and making him incredibly arrogant, assuming [Anya](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Forger-Anya) gained a crush on him when she stared at him. He is shown to prefer being called Lord Damian when spoken to. He gets angry when he is looked down upon by Anya's smile, quickly resorting to insulting her with his limited vocabulary and harassing Anya.

150425.description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5′10")
__Affiliation:__ Ostania, Ministry for Foreign Affairs (Cover), State Security Service
__Occupation:__ Diplomat (Formerly, Cover), Counterintelligence Agent

Yor Briar's younger brother who works in the State Security Service (SSS). He keeps his job at the SSS a secret from Yor, while pretending to be a normal civil servant at the foreign ministry.

Yuri has a sister-complex, and even at an early age, he would be doing everything he could to get Yor to praise him with affection. Though this could be due to his mother dying at a very early stage in his life causing him to get very attached to Yor as a mother figure.

150818.description: Kenji Kyoubate is the divorced husband of Aya Katsuragi and biological father of Maki Katsuragi. Kenji is tall and gaunt. He has short disheveled black hair and wears slightly curved rectangular shaped lightly tinted sunglasses. Kenji acts in a crude and intimidating fashion, especially towards his son Maki Katsuragi. He's abusive, noted as taking delight in and enjoying abusing his son both physically and mentally. He's a trashy man as stated by himself, and is a horrible person all around.

150869.description: Ruler of Heaven and Earth. Tian is the strongest warrior of Ancient Gods and the leader of the new Gods. He created the human race along with the rules to guide them. His Divine Power: Monochrome is known as the strongest Divine Power of the Gods.

151205.description: Torajirou was part of a yakuza gang that had a rivalry with Tatsu. He became a food truck owner after serving time in prison.

151306.description:
__Nationality:__ Japanese
__Height:__ 156 cm

A kind girl with a secret pain inside of her, but despite that is very strong-willed and thoughtful. Her headband is decorated with a crescent moon on it. She used to be a hardworking member of the rhythmic gymnastics club at her previous school. Her love for superheroes was influenced by her little brother, Kinakomochi.

name.native: ペペシャ＝アンドレアノワ

151307.description:
__Nationality:__ Russian
__Height:__ 174 cm

A flying alcoholic and bubbly Russian lady with a penchant for being at the right time. At first, it was planned for her to be a more serious older sister type of character. She is Shy's mentor and assists her on multiple occasions.

151337.description:
__Race:__ Dwarf Oni

Shizuno works as an herbalist with his assistant Yabashira.

151351.description:
__Height:__ 181 cm

The descendant of a Yuki Onna. Himuro freezes things surrounding him when he feels certain emotions. Even though his surroundings are always cold, Himuro is a warm and kind person. He likes flowers and cats, but he can't get too close to either of them. In his daily life, he spends a lot of time working and socializing with his co-worker [Fuyutsuki](https://anilist.co/character/151352/Fuyutsuki-Mio).

151352.description:
__Height:__ 154 cm

Fuyutsuki is a calm woman with a laid-back personality. She is Himuro's coworker and spends her daily life with him in the office. She is also always there for Himuro whenever he is facing some kind of trouble. Fuyutsuki has a black cat named Nyamerou.

151353.description:
__Height:__ 163 cm

She's a descendant of the fox spirit.

name.native: ウィリアム・ジェームズ・モリアーティ

151486.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Hometown:__ East End

A noble, a mathematics professor and the antiheroic protagonist of the manga. He is a genius who attempts to overthrow evil nobles and destroy the class system that has caused misery and pain to the poor everywhere.

~!He and his brother were orphans who were adopted by [Albert Moriarty](https://anilist.co/character/151489/Moriarty-James-Albert) after noticing his capabilities and his ideals of overthrowing the evil nobility. At Albert's request, he concocts a plan to kill the remaining members of the family and make it look like an accident. After burning the entire manor down, he adopts the name of the one he killed, William James Moriarty. He assumes the position of the second son of the Moriarty household, and lives under the guise of a noble.

He adopts the title of crime consultant as he, along with his gang, go around destroying the corrupt caste system from the shadows.!~

name.native: ルイス・ジェームズ・モリアーティ

151488.description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (6')
__Hometown:__ East End

William's younger brother. When young, he was often very ill, but was later treated after moving in with the Moriarty family. Louis often serves as the family butler, despite being a nobleman.

name.native: アルバート・ジェームズ・モリアーティ

151489.description:
__Height:__ 188 cm (6'2")
__Hometown:__ London

The eldest son of the Moriarty family.

name.native: シャーロック・ホームズ

151495.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Hometown:__ North Riding, Yorkshire

He is the antagonist to Moriarty and also the figure around which Moriarty's plan revolves. He enjoys puzzles, is a violin player, has a prodigious observational skill, well-versed in hand-to-hand combat and has a machiavellian attitude when it comes to something he wants. He is a detective consultant and can be considered an intellectual match and rival to Moriarty himself.

151496.description: John H. Watson is a doctor and also the new roommate of Sherlock Holmes. He's an ex-soldier back from Afghan.

alternative: Yamada Asaemon Isuzu (山田浅ェ門威鈴)

151770.description:
__Height:__ 215 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Age:__ Unknown
__Tao Attribute:__ Water
__Occupation:__ Asaemon, Female Combat Instructor
__Rank:__ Unranked

Isuzu is an unranked Asaemon in the Yamada clan. After the shogun became impatient of the first team acquiring the Elixir of Life, Isuzu and [Kiyomaru](https://anilist.co/character/151776/Kiyomaru) were chosen to join [Shugen](https://anilist.co/character/148752/Shugen) and [Jikka](https://anilist.co/character/148756/Jikka) to be a part of the second team sent to acquire the elixir.

Isuzu is very respectful towards her allies and wishes to avoid any conflict between them. In battle, or when one of her allies steps out of line, such as Kiyomaru, Isuzu behavior changes and becomes more serious and fierce. She is also capable of self restraint, that is greatly expressed on her face, when dealing with a troublesome situation. Isuzu highly respects Shugen and follows his view of justice in believing that criminals should not be given mercy or to those that protect them as well.

~!Similar to her brother [Genji](https://anilist.co/character/302049/Genji), Isuzu follows the samurai code of honor known as bushidō. After [Gantetsusai](https://anilist.co/character/137264/Tamiya-Gantetsusai) brought [Fuchi](https://anilist.co/character/137268/Fuchi)'s dead body, Isuzu was prepared to commit seppuku for the death of her fallen Asaemon comrades on the island and hoped that her death would appeased the shogun.!~

As a child, Isuzu was sensitive about her stature and would often be referred to her as a gorilla. However, after receiving words of encouragement from her brother about gorillas being strong animals, Isuzu no longer took it as an insult and believed that gorillas embody the concept of bushidō.

151771.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Occupation:__ House Wife
__Affiliations:__ Iwagakure
