Yui is the daughter of the [Iwagakure chief](https://anilist.co/character/301607/Osa) and the wife of [Gabimaru](https://anilist.co/character/137260/Gabimaru).

Yui is very kind, caring and gentle. She truly loves Gabimaru and believes that he is not completely emotionless as people make him out to be. She accepts the fact that he kills people and is not terrified being around him. Yui is also shown to be wise as she gave Gabimaru words of wisdom on why he should relax his body while giving him a bath. She is very civilized as she taught Gabimaru basic manners when they became a couple.

Yui was born as the daughter of the Iwagakure chief. Being born a female, Yui was not trained in the ways of the shinobi and instead lived a semi-normal life within the village. 

~!At some point, during her time with her father, the chief burned her face to make sure that she gave up on her dreams of ever living a normal, peaceful life as a woman. After Gabimaru proved his worth to the chief, Yui was forced by her father to marry him. The two then came to love each other as their days went by. Wanting to give his wife a peaceful life, Gabimaru came to the village chief requesting to abandon his duties as a shinobi, resulting in him being betrayed by the village and handed over to the authorities to be executed. After hearing news of her husband's captured, Yui went into a state of depression and refused to speak to anyone or eat as she waits in hopes for Gabimaru's return.!~

151772.description:
__Height:__ 173 - 185 cm
__Race:__ Tensen
__Tao Attribute:__ Fire
__Occupation:__ Partial Ruler of Kotaku
__Affiliation:__ Lord Tensen, Xu Fu

Ju Fa is a member of Lord Tensen, as well as one of the rulers of Kotaku.

Ju Fa is very short tempered and has aggressive tendencies towards anything that irritated him at the slightest, which also applied to his fellow Lord Tensen members. While its true that all members of Lord Tensen have a negative view on humans, Ju Fa is the one that truly despises them with a passion and believes that they are nothing more than "livestock". 

He is very protective of [Tao Fa](https://anilist.co/character/151778/Tao-Fa) since they had been by each others side from the moment they were born, because of that [Rien](https://anilist.co/character/148754/Rien) stated that the two were special in that they are in fact two of a whole. Despite their ability to heal themselves, Ju Fa hated when Tao Fa got hurt and was told that he cared greatly for Tao Fa as his partner.

Ju Fa found the male gender to be well-suited for him because of his moods and how he is able to easily handle situations.

151773.description:
__Race:__ Tensen
__Tao Attribute:__ Water
__Occupation:__ Partial ruler of Kotaku
__Affiliation:__ Lord Tensen, Xu Fu

Ran is a member of Lord Tensen and part ruler of Kotaku.

Ran is very loyal to [Rien](https://anilist.co/character/148754/Rien) and carries the same view of seeing the Tensens as family. Like all the members of Lord Tensen, Ran has no sympathy for humans and uses them as they see fit. He believes that it is a futile effort for the trespassers to invade the palace and try their hand at opposing the Tensens, showing signs that he views them inferior compared to his family. However, he is not above praising or admiring them if they show impressive skills. Due to specializing in Dō'in, Ran is extremely passionate about the physical work of the body and fighting styles that can only be obtained through diligent training.

~! Upon transforming into his Kishikai form, Ran expressed his physicality while attacking [Gabimaru](https://anilist.co/character/137260/Gabimaru) and [Yuzuriha](https://anilist.co/character/137270/Yuzuriha). He was also up to the challenge of facing the two in their use of ninjutsu in order to strengthen his Dō'in training. !~

~! He is bested in a fight against Gabimaru and Yuzuriha and is killed. Ran slowly dies with his last thoughts about Rien. !~

alternative: Yamada Asaemon Eizen (山田浅ェ門衛善)

151774.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Unknown
__Occupation:__ Asaemon
__Affiliation:__ Yamada Clan
__Rank:__ 1st

Eizen is the 1st rank Asaemon in the Yamada clan. He joined the Shinsenkyo Island expedition and was assigned to keep watch over the criminal, [Rokurōta](https://anilist.co/character/302052/Rokurouta).

Eizen has great pride for the Yamada clan and believes that no task is impossible for them when it came to executing people, such as his assigned criminal Rokurōta. As an executioner, Eizen acts professional in his line of work as he knows that defiling the execution grounds by trying to bring pain to the condemned with his blade would defile the magistrate and he follows the Yamada clan's ideal way of ending lives by cutting his victims with no pain or emotion, a concept which he tried to impart to a young [Shugen](https://anilist.co/character/148752/Shugen). 

Eizen is also kind and caring as he promised to look after Shugen when he was young, which brought a great influence to him in the present. Like his fellow clan members, Eizen believes that women in the Yamada clan should not follow the path of a samurai and is antagonistic when [Sagiri](https://anilist.co/character/137263/Sagiri) took the shogun's mission.

~! Upon arriving in Shinsenkyo, Eizen is almost instantly crushed by Rokurōta and dies. Shugen becomes devastated after finding Eizen's corpse and took the time to lay his soul to rest despite the fact that his team was being under attack. His death went on to impact Shugen on his mission to the extent that he vowed to kill everyone on the island in order to avenge his master. !~

Eizen has a profound influence on Shugen as he is the one person the young man looks up to the most.

151775.description:
__Height:__ 173 - 185 cm
__Race:__ Tensen
__Tao Attribute:__ Water
__Occupation:__ Partial Ruler of Kotaku
__Affiliation:__ Lord Tensen, Xu Fu

Zhu Jin is one of the rulers of Kotaku and one of the seven Lord Tensen.

Zhu Jin carries themselves with a calm and relaxed demeanor even when handling threats. Like their fellow Tensen, Zhu Jin has no sympathy for humans when it comes to killing them. Zhu Jin is also very perceptive of their opponents skills and can quickly adjust to them, causing them to become unfazed by whatever move they make. Zhu Jin can become easily irritated with troubling matters. Despite usually keeping a straight face at all times, when faced with an unbelievable crisis, Zhu Jin can break into a state of panic and fear and will take matters seriously. 

Zhu Jin follows [Gui Fa](https://anilist.co/character/170488/Gui-Fa)'s example of taking the Middle Way in terms of the two sexes. Therefore, unlike the other Tensens, Zhu Jin does not carry a preference to either being male or female and allows themselves to switch in and out of the two chi's over time.

alternative: Yamada Asaemon Kiyomaru (山田浅ェ門清丸)

151776.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Age:__ Unknown
__Tao Attribute:__ Metal
__Occupation:__ Asaemon
__Affiliation:__ Yamada Clan

Kiyomaru is an unranked Asaemon in the Yamada Clan. After the shogun became impatient of the first team acquiring the Elixir of Life, Kiyomaru and [Isuzu](https://anilist.co/character/151770/Isuzu) were chosen to join [Shugen](https://anilist.co/character/148752/Shugen) and [Jikka](https://anilist.co/character/148756/Jikka) to be a part of the second team sent to acquire the elixir.

Due to his young age, Kiyomaru is very immature. While departing to Kotaku, Kiyomaru spoke rudely to one of his superiors and childishly did as he pleased, such as cutting one of the ninjas mask to prove his strength and ordered one ninja to kill themselves to prove their loyalty. Kiyomaru is also very arrogant, as he declared that he was far superior to everyone that came along on the mission and hates it when people look down on him for not having a ranking.

~! Despite being loyal to Shugen, because of the dire situation escalating in Hōrai, Kiyomaru and a few others decide to cooperate with the Vanguard Party. After discussing the plan to destroy the Banko's tandens scattered around Hōrai, Kiyomaru is paired with Isuzu to strengthen her Water Tao with his Metal Tao and goes after the tandens.  !~

alternative: Yamada Asaemon Kishou (山田浅ェ門期聖)

151777.description:
__Height:__ 173cm
__Race:__ Human

Kishou is the 11th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan and was assigned to keep watch over the criminal, [Warped Keiun](https://anilist.co/character/302522/Keiun).

Kishou is an individual who is known for never losing his composure and rarely acting assertive. He is able to see the big picture in situations and finds it annoying when people question his way of handling them. Kishou has shown that he doesn't mind taking the easy way out, offering to cut down [Gabimaru](https://anilist.co/character/137260/Gabimaru) to help [Sagiri](https://anilist.co/character/137263/Sagiri) return home instead of following through with the mission. He also doesn't like to be pushed around.

151778.description:
__Height:__ 173-185 cm
__Race:__ Tensen
__Tao Attribute:__ Wood
__Occupation:__ Partial Ruler of Kotaku
__Affiliation:__ Lord Tensen, Xu Fu

Tao Fa is a member of Lord Tensen, as well as one of the rulers of Kotaku.

Tao Fa is very cheerful and always seems to be in a good mood. Unlike the other members of Lord Tensen, Tao Fa is rather friendly towards humans, or at least ones that are willing to cooperate with Lord Tensen's plans. However, she still carries the same view of using them as tools and shows no signs of sympathy towards them. Because she specializes in Bōchū Jutsu, Tao Fa is quite vulgar and often likes to flirt with others.

Tao Fa is always being protected by [Ju Fa](https://anilist.co/character/151772/Ju-Fa) since they had been by each others side from the moment they were born, because of that [Rien](https://anilist.co/character/148754/Rien) stated that the two were special in that they are in fact two of a whole.

Tao Fa had stated that they preferred the female gender because of their liking to their appearance. As such, they also acted feminine on top of their appearance.

152231.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Angel Devil is a devil who embodies the fear of angels, and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4.

The Angel Devil is a unique case among devils having virtually no hostility towards humans. He dislikes being ordered around and doesn't seem inclined towards combat. His extreme laziness holds him back from being a strong fighter and he often refuses to work, even claiming to prefer dying to working.

name.native: ジニー・フィン・ド・サルヴァン

152258.description:
**Race:** Succubus

A young succubus who got bullied a lot by Elrado and his gang even through their childhood. She began to worship Ard after he came to her rescue.

152259.description:
**Race:** Human

Socially awkward Demon Lord whose goal is to make friends.

name.native: イリーナ・リッツ・ド・オールハイド

152260.description:
**Race:** Elf

Ireena Litz de Olhyde is the childhood friend of the Ard Meteor.

~!She is from the Olhyde family, but it was just an alias as her family comes from the true and real bloodline of the nation's royal family, making her the real princess of the Laville.!~

~!She is also a descendant of Lydia which explains why she reminds Ard of her.!~

152324.description:
A boy often mistaken for a girl because of his fair build. He joined Maple Tree when [Maple](https://anilist.co/character/147892) invited him.

Kanade is quiet and clever, showing a fascination with puzzles and mysteries of every kind. He will usually devote an entire day to any task he finds interesting.

152327.description:
Yuri is [Rimi](https://anilist.co/character/120231/Rimi-Ushigome)'s older sister, as well as the lead vocalist and guitarist of [Glitter*Green](https://anilist.co/staff/155955/GlitterGreen). She and the other members of Glitter*Green were members of the Hanasakigawa Girls' High School student council.

~!After graduating, Yuri went to study at a college overseas. She and Rimi keep in contact through text every day.!~

152328.description:
The keyboardist for Glitter*Green. She and the other band members were part of the Hanasakigawa Girls' High School student council, with Nanana as the student council president.

She wears glasses, but removes them when performing.

(Source: BanG Dream! Wikia, edited)

152329.description:
Glitter Green's drummer, and an inventory worker at Edogawa Music. She and the other members of Glitter Green were members of the Hanasakigawa Girls' High School's student council before graduating.

Hinako is a friendly and loud girl with an interest in "cute" things - namely girls. She tends to be invasive towards others if she takes a liking to them until pulled away or distracted by something else. Initially Hinako appeared to be the "silent, untalkative" type since she never spoke during performances, but as it turned out, she was told by [Rii](https://anilist.co/character/152330/Uzawa-Rii) to stay quiet to avoid "ruining the band's image."

Adding to her energetic personality, she tends to give people nicknames and also views everything through her unique worldview, which she calls the "Hina-chan World".

152330.description:
The bassist for Glitter Green, and a salesperson at Edogawa Music. She and the other members of Glitter Green were members of the Hanasakigawa Girls' High School student council.

Rii is a calm girl who usually keeps a check over [Hinako](https://anilist.co/character/152329/Nijikki-Hinako) and tries to make sure she doesn't get into trouble or ruin their band's "image". Despite that, she has a plush demon called Debeko which she occasionally uses as a puppet.

152337.description:
The owner of the Live House SPACE where the band Glitter*Green often performs. She is quite strict and has a no-nonsense personality and very high standards when it comes to music. The cast always referred to her as "Owner" instead of her real name.

Shifune was a member of a nationally renowned band that had live tours. To dispel the image that "livehouses are scary", she launched the livehouse SPACE where anyone was able to perform. However, after a band did not finish their performance she began to hold auditions to determine if a band is suitable to stand on the SPACE stage.

(Source: BanG Dream! Wikia)

152338.description:
Asuka is [Kasumi](https://anilist.co/character/120229/Kasumi-Toyama)'s younger sister. Currently, she attends Haneoka Girls' High School and is classmates with [Ako](https://anilist.co/character/128144/Ako-Udagawa) and [Rokka](https://anilist.co/character/133744/Rokka-Asahi). She previously attended Hanasakigawa Girls' Junior High School, where she was in the same swimming club as [Yuri](https://anilist.co/character/152327/Yuri-Ushigome).

Asuka is a year younger than Kasumi, although Asuka appears to be the more responsible one of the two. She is calm, level-headed, and tends to be sarcastic and bad at showing her affection towards her sister.

152342.description:
A student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School. She is the vocalist and lead guitarist of the band CHiSPA and is friends with Saaya Yamabuki, a former member of CHiSPA.

(Source: BanG Dream! Wikia, edited)

152343.description: CHiSPA's keyboardist. She goes to the same high school as [Fumika](https://anilist.co/character/152345/Mori-Fumika).

152344.description: A student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and CHiSPA's drummer. She's the newest member of the band, who replaced Saaya's position as drummer after she quit. Satomi is "quiet, but her performance is flashy."

152345.description: CHiSPA's bassist. She goes to the same high school as [Mayu](https://anilist.co/character/152343/Kawabata-Mayu).

152359.description: Saaya, Sana, and Jun's mother. She's weak and often suffers from anemia.

152362.description: The owner of Yamabuki Bakery and Saaya, Jun, and Sana's father.

152366.description: Arisa's grandmother. She's very kind and forgiving.

152367.description:
An employee at the SPACE live house.

~!After the closure of SPACE she ends up working as a staff member at the live house RiNG, where she oversees part-timers Toyama Kasumi, Yamabuki Saaya, and Shiina Taki.!~

ChamJam's oldest member and leader.

152489.description:

152493.description:
**Height:** 147 cm

Aya has long plum-colored hair tied back in two ponytails by two green bows and matching colored eyes.

152498.description: [Aharen](https://anilist.co/character/121703/Reina-Aharen)'s friend since middle school. She is very shy, constantly watching over Aharen-san from a distance, very good at hiding. She's also very good at martial arts.

152622.description: Yuuna is [Kouko Matsumoto](https://anilist.co/character/136814)'s little sister who appears for the first time when [Miyako Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/131475) and [Hinata Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/131477) go outside to go shop.

152673.description: The main character of the otome game.

152674.description: Our main character, who finds him reincarnated in an otome game after tripping down some stairs.

name.native: マリエ・フォウ・ラーファン

152675.description: ~!The sister of [Leon](https://anilist.co/character/152674/Fou-Bartfort-Leon) from Japan, who was also reincarnated in the otome game.!~

name.native: アンジェリカ・ラファ・レッドグレイブ

152676.description: The villainess of the otome game, who is befriended by [Leon](https://anilist.co/character/152674/Fou-Bartfort-Leon) and [Livia](https://anilist.co/character/152673/Olivia).

153048.description:
He is a childhood friend of [Mafuyu](https://anilist.co/character/136844/Satou-Mafuyu).

~!He is Mafuyu's ex-boyfriend, who died one year from an apparent suicide prior to the events of the series. He played guitar in a band with [Hiiragi](https://anilist.co/character/167930/Hiiragi-Kashima) and [Yagi](https://anilist.co/character/167938/Shizusumi-Yagi).!~

153148.description:
Shouko Tanimoto is a second-year education student at Kasaba University. She has an English class with [Seigi Nakata](https://anilist.co/character/146057).
~!After graduation, she becomes a middle school science teacher!~

153149.description: Haruyoshi Shimomura is a friend of [Seigi Nakata](https://anilist.co/character/146057/Seigi-Nakata) who attends Kasaba University.

153293.description: Yu Mira is the 25th Master of the Moon Light Sword Style. She was invited to participate in the God Of High School Tournament. ~!During the World Tournament and RagnarÖk, she received Original Greed and through it Ultio R bequeath her Okhwang's physical power (which he had previously stolen). Due to that, Sang Man-Duk recognized her as the Jade Emperor's successor.!~

153395.description:
__Height:__ 148 cm
__Group:__ Criticrista
__Position:__ Vocals and Guitar

A female guitarist of the Purineko tribe. Within the Student Council, she serves as both Secretary and Treasurer. She is a top-tier honor student—a distinction she has held since the very inception of MIDI Girls' "Special Performing Arts Department"—and graduated at the top of her class in both "Dance" and "The Art of Cuteness." Contrary to her somewhat self-centered personality, she possesses a knack for using calculated words and gestures to skillfully capture the hearts of both fans and adults alike. 

It seems she enrolled at MIDI Girls for a specific, special reason... but what could it be?

name.native: ヴェンデリン・フォン・ベンノ・バウマイスター

153472.description: Poor son of a nobleman who lives in a remote area far from the royal capital. Formerly, Shingo Ichimiya, a salaryman who works for a food-related trading company, woke up after taking a nap and became a small child in a different world. Since he could not succeed to the territory, he was aiming for independence with one point that he was blessed with magical talent in the situation of being stuck.

name.native: ルイーゼ・ヨランデ・アウレリア オーフェルヴェーク
ヴィルマ・エトル・フォン・アスガハン

イーナ・ズザネ・ヒレンブラント
ルキウス・オリフラム

153506.description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Occupation:__ Grand Duke
__Partner:__ [Jeanne](https://anilist.co/character/89836/Jeanne)

He is a Vampire of noble birth born to inherit the title of Grand Duke, Luca is close to The Queen, though he is still too young to accept the role himself, thus allowing his uncle, [Lord Ruthven](https://anilist.co/character/155326/Ruthven-August), to act on his behalf.

153541.description:
A tanuki-human high school student who secretly escaped to Anima City. She is communicative and has a bright and cheerful personality.

(Source: Official Website)

153542.description: A social worker Wolf Beastman. He despises humans and fights for the rights of Beastmen.

name.native: アラン・シルヴァスタ

153544.description: A close friend of the main character, Michiru Kagemori.

153786.description: A first-year that follows Takumin in joining the Photography Club.

153787.description: A first-year that joins the Photography Club

154110.description: A 14 year old boy who took a liking to ballet since he was younger. He cut his aspirations short after his father, a stunt performer, passed away. Due to being the only male of his he took his uncle's advise to become more "masculine" to be a pillar of support to his family and quit ballet, instead practicing Jeet Kune Do under his tutelage. Upon his encounter with Miyako, Junpei's passion for ballet is reignited and begins to rediscover himself and his meaning of masculinity after seeing Luou dance. Although a talented dancer, Junpei struggles in learning ballet due to lacking the fundamentals of the art as he lacked continuous training and tends to prioritize his own emotions over proper technique. However, he is noted by many to have prodigious characteristics and an ideal body for ballet. Through multitude tribulations, he comes to grasp the essence of ballet while humbling himself in the process, growing more mature as a person and dancer.

154172.description: Sayo Aizawa is one of Hina's classmates. The bespectacled girl helped her peers discover Hitomi's secret job as a bartender and enjoys playfully teasing the girl about her profession.

154224.description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5'2")

She is a freshman at Nerima University and the ex-girlfriend of [Kazuya Kinoshita](https://anilist.co/character/128105). 
~!She dumped him after only one month. Even though she broke up with him, she can not fathom Kazuya moving on and seizes every moment attempting to sabotage his happiness.!~

154397.description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6'2")

Tamotsu Fukuda is a prolific, mentally disturbed serial killer known as "The Perforator", he murders his victims by drilling holes in their heads, under the belief that he is helping them achieve a new, better state of mind.

154577.description: Fangzhu Baoqing is a demon fox girl who owns a demonic shop. She has a human face that is very charming and deceiving but she also has a fox face at the back of her head that is mean and harsh. She sells demonic objects and she is also capable of turning a human into a demon, but not without a certain price of course.

154584.description: Xiaohei is a cat spirit who lived in a forest for years before humans cut it down. He was angry with humans at first, but eventually grew to like them.

154747.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Species:__ Bakedanuki

A detective that specializes in the occult. Inugami runs a Kemono detective agency in Tokyo. After meeting [Kabane](https://anilist.co/character/154749/Kusaka-Kabane), he took him with him in order to help him find his parents. Inugami is a calm person who doesn't like conflict and is kind enough to follow Kabane and the others casually. He is good at taking care of the children, even helping them in their own various circumstances. As the head of the detective agency, he is good at solving and making sure the job is done right.

154749.description:
__Height:__ 151 cm __Species:__ Half-Human/Half-Ghoul __Abilities:__~!• *Regeneration:* Kabane is able to regrow body parts that have been ripped off. Even as to being decapitated, he can regrow his body. His regeneration powers are also seen even his body is burnt leaving only his skull alone. Due to this, his regeneration powers are utilized by [Nobimaru](https://anilist.co/character/154753/Homuramaru-Nowaki) to defeat [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/154756/Yui). However, there are restrictions to his regenerative powers, he cannot regrow back his body when enclose in a small space like a suitcase. If his body is set on flames, there is a possibility that the rate at which he burns will exceed the way he regenerates, possibly resulting to his body breaking down. When decapitated, his separated body cannot be attached back to his head, hence, the separated body will remain as a corpse.
• *Regenerative Healing Powers:* Kabane can heal from any physical wounds at a fast rate.
• *Immortality:* Because Kabane is half-ghoul he cannot die but will stop moving if he is decapitated.
• *Superhuman Strength:* Kabane has shown immense strength.
• *Pain nullity:* Because Kabane is half-ghoul, he doesn't feel pain.
• *Body Dismemberment:* Kabane can separate a part of his body and use it however he means.!~ Kabane has been taken care of by his aunt since he was young, as a favor for her older sister, Kabane's mother. Since then, Kabane has lived with his aunt, [Mrs. Kusaka](https://anilist.co/character/243784/Kusaka), and cousin, [Yataro](https://anilist.co/character/243785/Yatarou) at the Deer Village and was given a job to work where he wouldn't be around anyone due to his smell. Kabane is quite emotionless due to being raised neglectfully; he is blunt when it comes to responses and could possibly be considered stupid and clueless about things. When in battle he does not consider his own well-being, he only seeks to stop the enemy. Despite his lack of emotions, Kabane is a good kid who cares for his friends and strives to protect them. Through the course of his life, Kabane becomes more expressive and less naive due to his interactions with others. Kabane is in possession of a life calculus, an extremely rare white stone capable of shielding a Kemono's 'thirst', left to him by his unknown parents. Wanting to know who his parents are, he joined the Kemono Office agency in order to look for them.

alternative: 岩木山雪里白那之五十六子晶
Iwakiyama Yukisato Shirona no Gojuuroku Shi Akira
the fifty-sixth child of Shirona of the Snow Village in Mount Iwaki

154750.description:
__Height__: 159 cm
__Species__: Snow Kemono

Akira, is the fifty-sixth child of Shirona of the Snow Village in Mount Iwaki. He's currently an employee of the Kemono office. Akira is a very energetic and approachable person but sometimes clumsy, sometimes even not being able to complete tasks properly. He also likes cute things and is seen constantly talking selfies to commemorate what he feels and currently doing. Akira is very fragile and gets grossed out and gets scared easily to the sight of insect, other dirty things and when in danger. However, despite these weaknesses, Akira can be seen as a reliable friend, willing to overcome his fears just to save his friends. Akira came to Inugami to look for his older brother. Before coming to Tokyo, he lived deep in the mountains of Aomori with his family. However, when they tried to run away, they got separated. Because Akira is a Yuki-onoko he possesses the powers the species are known for. It should be noted that it takes him a lot of concentration to use his powers and because of this isn't very good at controlling them.

154751.description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Species:__ Half-human/Half-Arachne

Up until he came to Inugami's detective agency and before his uncle took care of him, he lived in Kinshi-Go in the Gunma Prefecture with his mother. Shiki initially comes off as a bully, holding his age of one year over Kabane as an authority, and telling the other boy they aren't friends because they're both hybrids. But this is shown to only be a facade, as he shows surprise at Kabane never having had pizza, and laughing when the other first had trouble trying it. But as Akira says, he's only self-conscious due to the fact another hybrid sits under the same roof as him. When on a job, he can see things in a calm and cautious manner. He is also able to judge and react to things in a fast manner, like using his thread to protect him and Akira from Kon's attacks. However, he can also be seen with a short temper. When faced with intimidating enemies, he has the tendency to freeze up but always manages to defeat his enemy.

154755.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm
__Species:__ Kitsune

Kon formerly worked under [Yoko Inari](https://anilist.co/character/154758). Kon idolizes Inari and wants her attention as well as her approval. While seeming emotionless at first Kon does her best to please Inari who she perceives as a mother. She gets extremely mad at those who insult her. Kon was ignored and abandoned by Inari after failing her mission. Kon is not very intelligent or emotionally stable. Because she wants to be a "good girl" more than anything she will do anything to fulfill that role. If anything happens that she believes will prevent her from fulfilling that role, she becomes disoriented and goes into a blind rage.

name.native: アルフレッド・レインフォード

154943.description:
She is Claire Aoki's Older Sister. A 3rd year high school student in a far-off private school. She is bad at talking to people.

She told Claire that she killed their parents for her because they were bad people. They were very strict people and their dad was on the diet but he was doing all sorts of bad things in secret and her mom was cheating on him with all the younger men at her company.

~!It is hinted that Shuichi and her met in the past even though Shuichi doesn't seem to have any memories of her as she seems to know about Shuichi Kagaya and it was also stated that she was the reason Shuichi Kagaya could turn into a monster.

She seems to be obsessed with Shuichi as she seems to think that she should be the one inside of Shuichi Kagaya and no one else should be allowed in there as she freaked out when she heard a voice coming out from inside of him. She also thinks that it would be alright if Shuichi Kagaya would want to kill her since she was the one responsible for dragging him into it because she was weak.!~

155191.description: A high-spec android developed with the latest technology the Kisaragi Corporation has to offer. Her internal reactor will melt down and self-destruct if exposed to excessive levels of violence.

155192.description: A diligent woman who rose up from the slums to become captain of the Royal Guard. She's very ambitious and zealously seeks credit for accomplishments.

155193.description:
The man known as "Combat Agent Six" joined the Kisaragi Corporation in his first year of high school, roughly three to four years before the beginning of the story. He began working there part-time at age nineteen.

Six is a senior in the organization being the oldest member of the organization left except for the generals. That is why, when the company was on the verge of the global conquest, Six was one of the candidates to explore an alternate world similar to Earth in order to conquer it.

Six was eventually chosen, being sent to a alternate world in order to spy on it and prepare him for this world's domination at the hands of Kisaragi.

155194.description: She's an archbishop. She rides in a wheelchair due to a curse accidentally placed on her by herself that does not allow her to wear shoes.

155195.description: A Chimera who can copy the abilities of any monster she eats, just like K*rby. She treats the dying words of her elderly creator as gospel, resulting in....rather tacky lines.

155196.description: One of the Demon Lord's Elite Four, also known as Heine of the Flames. She has huge boobs. If you like dark-skinned demi-humans, this demoness is definitely your type.

155614.description:
is the counsellor of the school Katsuhira is attending. She's a mysterious woman who's almost always seen wearing a white coat.

Initially, Mutsumi comes off as cold, somewhat sarcastic, and even frightening, such as when she pulls out a gun in front of two students in an arcade. In later episodes, she is shown to have caring and motherly qualities

155701.description: Izumi is a friendly, upbeat kid. He’s had terrible luck his entire life. If something can go wrong... he’ll probably wind up in the hospital. But he still thinks he’s the luckiest guy in the world, because Izumi has a girlfriend who is smart, sporty, and always looking out for him. [Shikimori](https://anilist.co/character/155702/Shikimori-Miyako) is his knight in shining armor.

155702.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

Shikimori is not only cute but also smart and athletic, however, she isn't very good at cooking! She is very protective of [Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/155701/Izumi-Yuuki) because he always puts himself in risky situations, when these situations occur, Shikimori reveals her "cool" appearance. She thinks Izumi is very cool and kind. She owns a pet dog named Kara.

Both cute and cool clothing styles suit her, but she seem to have a preference for a cute look. She became very popular at school with the girls after they saw her cool side during the tournament's volleyball game.

155703.description: Shinpei Ajiro is the main protagonist of the Summer Time Rendering series. He returned to his hometown of Hitogashima for the first time in two years to attend the funeral of his childhood friend, Ushio Kofune. Since he lost his parents at an early age and grew up in the Kofune family, he has been close to Ushio and Mio as if they were his family. ~!Ever wonder why Shinpei is drawn with different colored pupils or irises? it is the eye of Haine, the original shadow. It originally belonged to Haine but after leaving it, this eye was granted as a gift from Ushio to Shinpei. Following the information cited by Shide, this right eye has the power to control time, unlike Haine's left eye which can see time. With this eye, Shinpei receives various types of sub-skills, the most common, and most used is that of observation; By observing various parallel worlds with this eye, he can choose which world he will enter, and according to Shide, there is a likelihood that there are several types of world, such as a world where Shinpei and everyone in the village die for Haine and Shide, or a world where Shinpei conquers the shadows and peace blooms again on Hitogashima Island, or a world where the people he loves so much are slowly dying, and so on. This eye in question also gives a certain level of premonition, not least because it can see parts of the future thanks to its time travel. With this eye he can also travel in time, and even take someone with him, or he can use that eye to regenerate himself from injuries or problems that he started to face in each time loop he lived.!~

155704.description:
Haine is the main antagonist of the Summertime Rendering series.

~!Hiruko is known as the God of Hitogashima and the mother of all Shadows. She takes the form of Haine, the first person she copied. Prior to her current apperance and based on the history and legends of Hitogashima, she took on the form of a whale's shadow.!~

155706.description: She is Ushio's younger sister and a first-year high school student. She is good at sports, belongs to the swimming club, and has tanned skin. Despite the death of her older sister, she has a healthy side, such as her cheerful attitude toward Shinpei when he returns home.

155711.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm

Hizuru Minakata is an author who writes using the pseudonym ~!Ryuunosuke Nagumo.!~

~!She has a double personality, the second of which is her dead twin brother, [Ryuunosuke Nagumo](https://anilist.co/character/231699/Nagumo-Ryuunosuke).!~ ~!In actuality, it is [Ryuunosuke](https://anilist.co/character/231699/Nagumo-Ryuunosuke)'s shadow that is within Hizuru. He takes control whenever they must fight, so as not to make Hizuru's hands dirty. They eventually manage to properly meet and talk to each other within their mind, which they were unable to do prior. Afterwards, they take control in tandem, where [Ryuunosuke](https://anilist.co/character/231699/Nagumo-Ryuunosuke) is in control of her body to fight, while Hizuru talks to Haine at the same time!~

155712.description: __Height:__ 162 cm She lives in Hitogashima, she lost her life in a maritime accident while trying to save Shiori from drowning in the sea. Her death acts as the starting point of the story, with Shinpei returning home to attend her funeral.

155751.description: Meets [Sally](https://anilist.co/character/147893) and [Maple](https://anilist.co/character/147892) during the game's second event. Despite rough first impressions, they become friends and she eventually joins Maple Tree.

155752.description: Along with her twin [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/155753), they are recruited to Maple Tree while still on the first layer.

155753.description: Along with her twin [May](https://anilist.co/character/155752), they are recruited to Maple Tree while still on the first layer.

155807.description: He is the Border's General Manager and Commander of the Self-Defense Unit. He is the most powerful person in HQ with a normal trigger.

155808.description:
He is Border's highest person in charge. Due to his actions, he is the main antagonist of the Black Trigger Retrieval Arc.

(Source: World Trigger Wiki)

156049.description: Although she appeared mysterious at first, Toriko is known as upbeat and energetic most of the time, especially when around Sorawo Kamikoshi and Kozakura (to the point Kozakura finds her annoying). She was friendly upon meeting Sorawo, and dropped honorifics immediately after introducing herself to her. She'd been comfortable with Sorawo ever since, certain that they would get along well. She is carefree, not holding herself back when she and Sorawo explores the Otherside or when they celebrate post-expedition. She prefers addressing with no honorific to people she thinks she's friends or close with. She is also reliable and would often be the one to act or think fast during situations to aid Sorawo when needed.

156050.description: Sorawo is a shy, introverted person who usually prefers to be alone, not wanting to be bothered, and often keeps her distance from other people. There had been a time where she tried to make friends during her early years in university, attending a few parties, but in the end, she couldn't keep up, and it was too exhausting for her, so she decided to be on her own instead. When forced into a conversation or meeting people for the first time, she tends to end up flustered or talk excessively.

156316.description:
A 21-year-old man and low-ranked government official who lived in the same town as Appare. He is a master of cooking, cleaning, and laundry, due to having lost his mother early on and having to take care of his father and sister. He is a straightforward man who is often prone to worrying about his friends, and this often leads to him being led around by Appare. Though initiated into the hantsuki ittou-ryu style of swordsmanship, he doesn't get into fights often. According to his father, he has been promised in marriage to a beautiful fiance which he has never seen.

(Source: Anime News Network)

156317.description:
A 19-year-old man who grew up in a rural seaside town. He has been interested in machines since childhood, and has produced his own machines by hand. Though he is a genius mechanic, he has little interest in social interaction, considering machines as closer friends than other people. He often loses all track of time and surroundings once he starts tinkering, but abruptly falls asleep as if running out of batteries when he gets tired, which causes no end of consternation to Kosame. He has an idealistic dreamer side, having treasured a story about travel to the moon since childhood.

(Source: Anime News Network)

156318.description:
An intensely proud 11-year-old Native American boy. He is on a lone journey for revenge, but meets Appare and Kosame in his journeys. He is mature for his years, which leads to him disliking being treated like a child. He will not hesitate to fight anyone, even adults, to protect what he loves. Having inherited his skill of living off the land from his grandfather, he is capable of foraging for food and water, making his own weapons, and reading the terrain and climate. He has great respect for Appare, who seems to not be driven by the whims of society.

(Source: Anime News Network)

156319.description:
The only female racer in the Trans-America Wild Race. She was born to Chinese immigrants who run a laundromat. She began doing odd jobs for various racing teams as a starting point to her strong desire to be a racer herself, but began to become worried when she started losing opportunities due to being a woman. She had halfway decided to give up until she met Appare. She is a master of both her self-honed driving technique, and the martial arts that her father taught her.

(Source: Anime News Network)

156321.description:
A gentle-hearted girl who watches over Al by the order of his father. He has been friends with Al since childhood, and they share a relationship close to siblings, often serving to stop Al before his schemes run out of hand. She has an unexpectedly curious and active side to her. While she wishes for Al to win the race, she also wishes for the safety of Al and his friends.

(Source: Anime News Network)

156322.description:
A 19-year-old European, and the youngest of three siblings. He represents BNW, an automobile company that is one of the many businesses owned by his family's conglomerate, and appropriately drives a car born from his wealth and privilege. He proves a match for the free-spirited Appare, and desires nothing more than a fair match, considering Appare a worthy rival. He is as able a hand at driving as he is with the violin, fencing, golf, and many other skills.

(Source: Anime News Network)

156323.description:
A fifteen year old girl who lives by herself. She became socially withdrawn at age twelve by her own choice because she wanted to play World Fantasy Online as much as possible. After she gave her parents 100 million yen, they left her to her own volition and only return home when they run out of money to spend, causing Yuna to secretly move out into a luxury apartment to hide from them. There, she spends nearly her entire day playing World Fantasy Online and the remainder only eating and sleeping.

Yuna has a lazy personality and is socially withdrawn. She possesses a high level of intelligence, being able to make billions of yen from stocks allowing her to live a comfortable life in her home without ever having to leave.

After getting transported into a world resembling the VRMMO World Fantasy Online, Yuna actively engages in the world, unlike in the real world, as she sees the current world as a game. Here, she interacts with others and holds a sense of justice that is withheld by her lazy and carefree attitude. She also apparently does not have an accurate view of herself as described by others.

156324.description:
A ten-year-old girl and a resident of the town Crimonia. She lives with her [mother](https://anilist.co/character/193052/) and [younger sister](https://anilist.co/character/173792/). Fina's father died when she was still young, while her mother contracted a serious illness and is bedridden. In order to care for her family, Fina is forced to work at an early age to buy medicine for her mother and food for her family. Being only ten years old she is limited in what she can do and earns small wages through occasionally helping the guild with skinning monsters.

Fina is kind, honest, hardworking, and very responsible and mature for her age. As noted by her mother and Yuna, Fina has a mentality that is abnormal for a ten year old.

(Source: Kuma Kuma Kuma Bear Wikia, edited)

156848.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer, Student
__Affiliation:__ Kyoto Metropolitan Curse Technical College
__Grade:__ Grade 3 Sorcerer

A second-year at Kyoto Metropolitan Curse Technical College. Kasumi is a hard-working, restrained, and considerate pacifist. She is also a big fan of [Satoru Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691).

~!She has a very close bond with [Mechamaru](https://anilist.co/character/210154), their friendship is first seen in the Tournament Arc when Miwa offers him a battery telling him not to eat it as [Mai](https://anilist.co/character/134168) and [Momo](https://anilist.co/character/157868) laugh in the background. In the Shibuya Arc, she is seen mourning his death on the train. Over the course of the Tournament Arc and Shibuya Arc it is very apparent their friendship grows as they both strived towards becoming closer to one another. As she mourns his death on the train she holds a mini Mechamaru speaker which tells her to find her happiness. After the recording finishes, she holds the speaker to her heart and cries. The entire Kyoto program seems very distressed by his death on the train. When later entering the battle Miwa is quick to activate her technique out of rage and sadness towards [Mahito](https://anilist.co/character/133702).!~

156860.description:
__Height:__ 140cm

An aspiring spirit medium who believes she's somewhat special because she has the power to see spirits. However, she doesn't know that she can only see lesser spirits, and misinterprets [Miko's](https://anilist.co/character/139631) attempts to protect her from the greater dangers she cannot see as acts of malice.

name.native: アイリーン・アドラー
セバスチャン・モラン
マイクロフト・ホームズ

156991.description:
__Grade:__ Special Grade Cursed Spirit

Jogou is an unregistered special grade cursed spirit aligned with Mahito, Hanami, and Dagon. He was born of humanity's fear and negative association with volcanoes and other fire-related natural disasters. This resulted in a highly intelligent cursed spirit with massive levels of cursed energy even for a special grade. Jogou believes curses are the true humans and desires a world where his kind dominates the earth.

157014.description:
Head of the Witch Covent and sister to the witch that cursed the [Duke](https://anilist.co/character/132920/Bocchan). 

~!She hates to show her face to public due to her sister scarring the face. It was not until [Walter](https://anilist.co/character/224604/Walter), Duke's brother told her that she's pretty that she starts going out with her face shown.

She has fallen in love with Walter!~

157115.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Sorcerer, Student
__Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High
__Grade:__ Grade 2 Sorcerer
__Cursed Technique:__ Cursed Speech

He is a second-year at Tokyo Metropolitan Jujutsu Technical High School. Due to his curse ability, he is only willing to communicate with ingredients used to make rice balls.

157116.description:
Chousou is half human and half cursed spirit and the first of the Death Painting Wombs with a Special Grade rank. He and his two brothers, [Kechizu](https://anilist.co/character/210832/Kechizu) and [Eso](https://anilist.co/character/210831/Esou) are Cursed Womb: Death Paintings who have sided with [Mahito](https://anilist.co/character/133702/Mahito)'s group.

Chousou bears strong attachments to his brothers and is very overprotective of them. ~!However, after receiving a vision during his battle with Itadori, Chousou was eventually convinced that Sukuna's vessel was actually one of his younger brothers. He then became furious at Mahito and the other cursed spirits for manipulating him into harming Itadori.!~

~!Chousou is one of nine death painting wombs that came from a woman capable of giving birth to cursed spirit children. At some point, Chousou and his brothers were stored at the Jujutsu High, along with some of Sukuna's fingers.

As stated by Chousou himself, Noritoshi Kamo, the man who experimented on his mother is in fact his third "parent" due to him having mixed in his own blood into Chousou when his mother was pregnant with him. Although seemingly not remembering much about his own past, it is evident that Chousou himself remembers Noritoshi and holds a grudge against him for toying with his mother and siblings' lives.!~

157117.description: An upperclassman from the art club. Her painting of angels opened Yatora’s eyes to the world of art and inspired him to make art himself.

157118.description:
He has a reserved and shy personality but is shown to be standoffish and easy to anger. He’s blunt, and often says things as they are in his mind without stopping to explain to others what he means. He has complete confidence in his art skills.

He goes to the same cram school as [Yatora](https://anilist.co/character/144674/Yaguchi-Yatora) and provokes Yatora with his genius art skill and antisocial personality.

~!Takahashi gets accepted into Tokyo University of the Arts (Geidai).!~

157214.description: A student at Satozakura High School.

157215.description:
__Height:__  173 cm
__Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer
__Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High
__Grade:__ Grade 1 Sorcerer
__Family:__ [Ui Ui](https://anilist.co/character/217290) (Younger Brother)

__Abilities__:
~!
__Weapon Mastery__: Mei Mei wields a large battle-axe. 
__Cursed Technique__: Black Bird Manipulation - Mei Mei is able to control crows as well as see through their eyes, making her technique great for recon.
__Bird Strike__: by forcing a crow to commit suicide, the trade-off is to erase the Cursed Energy limit of a typical weak bird and hurl it at the enemy.
!~

Mei Mei is a grade 1 jujutsu sorcerer who works independently and only in exchange for money. She is also the older sister of Ui Ui. 

~!She was the senpai of [Satoru Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691) and [Suguru Geto](https://anilist.co/character/133699) during their time at Jujutsu High.!~

157231.description:
He is a Fiend and Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4.

Despite his moniker as the Violence Fiend, he is extremely polite and straightforward. He apologized to [Beam](https://anilist.co/character/157232/Beam) after hitting him in self-defense and told the [Spider Devil](https://anilist.co/character/157277/Prinz) to evacuate the area when he mistook her for a human lady.

~!He is later partnered with [Kobeni Higashiyama](https://anilist.co/character/144594/Higashiyama-Kobeni) following the events of the Katana Man Arc!~

157232.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (With fin: 176 cm)

He is a Shark Fiend and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4.

Beam is very eccentric. He often goes along with [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji)'s plans no matter how crazy they are due to having a lot of respect for the [Chainsaw Devil](https://anilist.co/character/170266/Pochita).

157240.description: The Eien no Akuma is a devil that embodies the fear of eternity. He is the primary antagonist of the titular Eternity Devil arc.

157241.description: Samurai Sword is a human-devil hybrid who merged with the Katana Devil. His [grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/289198/Yakuza) was killed by [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) when they initially fused with [Pochita](https://anilist.co/character/170266/Pochita), and because of that, he affiliated with the [Gun Devil](https://anilist.co/character/208942/Juu-no-Akuma) to get revenge on Denji. He works alongside [Akane Sawatari](https://anilist.co/character/174264/Akane-Sawatari) and other fellow members of the Yakuza.

157244.description: Nagi is Takeshi's little sister who pretended to ask for tutelage from Hiroko in order to scout her brother's rival, Kousei.

157251.description:
Oyecomova is a Neapolitan terrorist who participates in the Steel Ball Run. Having heard of Gyro Zeppeli's participation, he seeks revenge on him and attacks Gyro alongside Mountain Tim and Johnny Joestar in the Rocky Mountains.
He stand Boku no Rhythm wo Kiitekure allows Oyecomova to create and attach special time bombs to anything he touches, be it solid objects or even water and smoke. This make his very deadly to approach.

157277.description:
She is a devil who embodies the fear of spiders, and is a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4.

The Spider Devil usually takes a human shape so she tends to be friendly to humans and works as a devil hunter herself, however she will still kill people for just looking at her the wrong way.

157340.description: Cherry often gets nervous and blushes, therefore making it almost impossible for him to speak to others. He's often seen wearing headphones, so that people won't talk to him; this is also to tune-out the sound around him, as he dislikes loud sounds, finding it difficult to cope with them. He expresses himself through Haiku, as talking to other people is hard for him.

157341.description: Smile is very self-conscious about her teeth, so she wears a mask most of the time. She's a famous JK streamer and one of the most popular on the "Curious Live" platform.

157548.description: A player in Darwin Game who has the sigil to control ice. Sui's twin brother, who died in an accident 1 year ago. D-game brought his soul back in Sui's body.

alternative: Recovery Girl (リカバリーガール)

157655.description:
__Quirk:__ Heal
__Occupation:__ Pro Hero, Nurse

Chiyo has a very kind and compassionate personality, where she treats everyone kindly, though she does have a strict and reproaching attitude towards those that have done something foolish. She's mostly like this with All Might for not teaching Izuku how to use his Quirk properly or with Izuku for using his Quirk recklessly.

name.native: ルーグ・トウアハーデ

157687.description: The oldest son of the clan of assassins, who is often called a boy genius. He was the world's greatest assassin in his previous life, and he combines that knowledge with the magic of his new world.

157688.description: The proxy representative of Lugh's cosmetics brand. She provides logistical support by collecting funds, information, and more.

157689.description: Lugh's personal retainer and his assassination assistant. She cares deeply for Lugh because he saved her life.

name.native: エスリ・トウアハーデ

157690.description: Lugh's adoring mother. She can be a bit of an airhead, but she's clever in her own way.

157691.description:
A noble lady from a foreign country. She is among the strongest mages in the world.

~!She is Lugh's relative.!~

name.native: キアン・トウアハーデ

157692.description: Lugh's father and the strongest man in the history of the clan of assassins. He is both a loving husband and a coldhearted killer.

157864.description: A first grade sorcerer and a teacher at Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School.

157865.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Sorcerer
__Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High
__Grade:__ Grade 2 Sorcerer

Takuma Ino is a grade 2 jujutsu sorcerer and a close associate of Kento Nanami who operates out of Tokyo Jujutsu High.

Takuma Ino is a genuine and cheerful person with a more positive outlook on things than most jujutsu sorcerers. He doesn't believe he's the smartest person around and has a lot of respect for Nanami. Whenever Ino finds himself in a tough situation, he asks himself what would Nanami do.

157866.description:
__Cursed Technique:__ Blood Manipulation
__Grade:__ Semi-Grade 1 Sorcerer

He is a third-year at Kyoto Magic Technical College.

157868.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer
__Affiliation:__  Kyoto Magic Technical College
__Grade:__ Semi-Grade 2 Sorcerer
__Cursed Technique:__ Tool Manipulation

She is a third-year at Kyoto Magic Technical College.

157879.description:
Sui is a slime that Mukoda took as his second familiar. At the time when he got as a familiar, Sui was just a baby slime but evolved on the third day.

~!Thanks to Hephaestos' blessing, Sui gained the ability to do blacksmithing.!~

157880.description: Ninrir is the Goddess of Wind and the Fenrirs are her descendants. She gave Mukouda her blessing in order to extort offerings from him. She's weak to otherworld sweets, especially dorayaki.

157881.description:
A salaryman summoned from modern Japan. He possesses the unique skill, "Online Supermarket", which allows him to buy goods from modern Japan any time, any place. The food he buys with his skill has buffing effects, making anyone who eats it become much stronger than before. He is very good at cooking, but is a coward by nature.

Mukouda was first seen wearing a suit and tie, a huge difference from his co-summoned heroes which were wearing school uniforms. After selling his former clothes, he now wears a dark green shirt with long sleeves that he usually kept folded when he cooks.

157882.description:
__Level:__ 906
__Race:__ Fenrir

Fel is a Fenrir who is considered a legendary magical beast, one of the descendants of the Goddess of the Wind, Ninrir.

Formed a contract with Mukouda and became his first familiar due to his great interest in his cooking. Fel absolutely hates vegetables and prefers to eat meat.

name.native: シルヴィア・シャーウッド

157887.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

She is [Twilight](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Forger-Loid)'s main contact at WISE.

name.native: フランキー・フランクリン

157888.description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5′5")
__Affiliation:__ Ostania
__Occupation:__ Tobacco Store Clerk (False Front), Informant, Soldier (formerly)

Franky is an informant who seemingly works at a tobacco store and presumably works for Loid Forger's agency. He gets information regarding Eden Academy's exam and Anya Forger's past records for Loid Forger.

Franky is a kind person willing to help Loid out when he's in a pinch even though the danger is high. He frequently warns Loid Forger not to get too close to other people in their line of work.

He frequently falls in love with other women but his love life typically fails due to lack of mutual interest or they are already with someone else.

157951.description: The ruler of the Dark Realm, and Jahy's sole superior who was destroyed as a result of the destruction of the Mana Crystals but later reforms back at the house of Kyouko Jingu.

157966.description: Mukasa is Shibazaki's co-worker from the Records Division.  He assists Shibazaki in solving the riddles of the Sphinx at the most unlikely of times. He has a carefree personality and is often depicted eating something.

157968.description: A former manager within the Ministry of Health and Welfare Guidance Division, he holds information about The Athena Plan.

157970.description: Works at the police station. He utilizes Shibazaki's detective skills to analyze and resolve the incidents related to Sphinx.

157971.description: He's an FBI special agent. He is sent to Japan from the United States government to assist in investigations regarding the Sphinx incidents.

157972.description: A bomb specialist working for the Japanese police.

157973.description: He works at the Technology Crime Division. He belongs to the life safety unit, which performs the crackdown of cyber crime.

157974.description: A police officer of the Criminal Division Section 1. He likes solving criminal cases, but he thinks Shibazaki got this job to easily and doesn't get along with him.

157975.description: A police officer of the Criminal Division Section 1. He is responsible for incidents involving kidnapping or hostages.

157982.description: Aya's classmate, and the leader of the group that bullies her at school.

157997.description: The wife of [Fujio Uzaki](https://anilist.co/character/266217), and the mother of [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/130665), [Kiri](https://anilist.co/character/190106), and [Yanagi](https://anilist.co/character/191905). While surprisingly old in age, she appears deceptively young and beautiful. Like her [daughter](https://anilist.co/character/130665/Hana-Uzaki), she is voluptuous.

name.native: ミソラ・ホイットテール

158140.description: She's the leader of fireteam E601 and a 2nd year student of the Sky wizards division preparatory department. Despite having good speed and stamina, she's rather impulsive and not very good with her weapon or giving orders. When [Kanata](https://anilist.co/character/158142/Age-Kanata) finds out her desire of being a Sword Sorcerer as a way of honoring her late mother, he decides to train her in order to make her improve.

158141.description: A member of Platoon E601 with the role of sniper. While intelligent and good at shooting, she's narcissistic to the point of seeing herself as a goddess, not even bothering to practice.

158142.description:
Occupation: Instructor

Kanata Age is a young man who lives on the floating wizard academy city of "Mistgun." He was once celebrated as the "Black Master Swordsman," the elite ace of the S128 special team. However, he is now despised as the "traitor of the special team." One day, he is assigned as the instructor of E601, a team that has suffered 10 consecutive defeats. He's in his second year of regular courses.

Highly analytical and pretty fast in figuring out his students' weaknesses (or opponents') and how to fix those weaknesses.

158154.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Ability:__ Reverse Healing Cursed Technique

Alumnus of Tokyo Jujutsu High, having been classmates with [Satoru Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691) and [Suguru Geto](https://anilist.co/character/133699). After graduating into a full-fledged jujutsu sorcerer, Shoko became the school's primary doctor.

158237.description: Yaeko is an urban life planner and the first, albeit minor, antagonist of Shokugeki no Soma. She is a ruthless business woman who only cares about her job and she is willing to resort to dirty tactics to ensure that she has her way. Because of her job and callous behavior, she disregards many family-owned businesses, such as Restaurant Yukihira.

158250.description: Kumagoro Saiki is the husband of Kumi Saiki, the father of Kurumi, the father-in-law of Kuniharu Saiki and grandfather of Kusuo Saiki and Kusuke Saiki. Kumagoro is a grumpy old man who hates Kusuo's father Kuniharu and loves his daughter Kurumi. He is actually a tsundere who truly wants to dote on his grandchildren.

158251.description: Kumi Saiki is the wife of Kumagoro Saiki, Kurumi Saiki's mother, the mother-in-law of Kuniharu Saiki, and grandmother of Kusuo Saiki and Kusuke Saiki. Despite her old age, Kumi keeps the style of a modern teenage Japanese girl, wearing clothes sexy for her style and a skirt shorter than her knees.

158295.description: The oldest son. A school teacher who struggles with letting others take care of his three younger brothers

158296.description: The second son. Cool and calm. He loves and dotes on his younger brother, [Minato](https://anilist.co/character/158294/).

158385.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Haru is a member of the Modern Crime Prevention Task Force's Metropolitan Police Department. He is a hot-blooded humanistic detective who hates dishonesty and bending. Originally, he belonged to Investigation Division 1 as a promising rookie, but after a siege incident where he misfired and the target was seriously injured, he was dropped from the division and moved to the current headquarters he's in at the start of the series.

158386.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

Daisuke is a scion of the millionaire Kambe family. Utilizing abundant financial resources and the latest technology, he solves various cases in a semi-aggressive manner. He becomes a member of the Metropolitan Police Department's Modern Crime Prevention Task Force, and forms buddies with [Haru Kato](https://anilist.co/character/158385/Katou-Haru). However, he seems to have no ear to hear what Kato says.

158447.description: The self-proclaimed "greatest con artist in Japan" who makes a living swindling innocent seniors and tourists. Used to be an honest, affable guy. Collects capsule toy figures and loves coffee.

name.native: ローラン・ティエリー

158448.description:
An infamous French conman who travels the world. He never loses his cool, and always keeps his eyes on the prize. Likes to dress up and joke around. Becomes the target of one of Edamura's schemes while sightseeing in Asakusa.

~!Laurent originally wanted to become a diplomat in order to help his mother financially. But she passes away after being decieved by an investor named Hugo, which leaves Laurent at a gambling routine in Paris. One night, he tries to kill Hugo, but Dorothy stops him and ends up recruiting him to her Confidence group, alongside Seiji Osaki, Kudo and Shi-On.!~

158449.description:
Cynthia is confident in her abilities and takes pride in her sex appeal. She is a confident and outgoing woman. She’s very smart and good at acting. She can speak multiple languages and can stay calm in stressful situations.

~!Cynthia worked at a café as a young woman. A regular at the café, [Thomas Meyer](https://anilist.co/character/175373/Meyer-Thomas), asked if he could paint her likeness. They hit it off and soon started dating and living together (where they ate many meals of canned beans). Both were trying to hit it big in their careers, Cynthia with acting and Thomas with painting. Their bond grew greater through their time together, and Thomas proposed to Cynthia with a ring he drew. Cynthia accepts his proposal and their relationship is at its peak with the engagement. 

One day while trying to sell his paintings Thomas was noticed by [James Coleman](https://anilist.co/character/175029/Coleman-James). Thomas was hired by Coleman to make counterfeit paintings to sell at his art auctions. During this time, Cynthia and Thomas grew apart due to Thomas's focus on money and his contract with Coleman. Some time after her breakup with Thomas, Cynthia met [Laurent](https://anilist.co/character/158448/Thierry-Laurent) and became a con-artist.!~

~!During the team's Con in London, Laurent makes sure Cynthia can get her revenge against Coleman and patch things up Thomas. After the success of the Con, due to Thomas painting one last forgery, he and Cynthia have a chat and amicably part ways after.!~

name.native: アビゲイル・ジョーンズ

158450.description:
An exceptionally athletic conwoman from Iraq with a flexible and toned body. Blunt and belligerent. Hides a secret in her childhood memories.

~! In episode 7, she recalls her time as a child soldier after war broke out in her home country. She is heavily affected by the trauma it caused and sometimes even considering suicide. !~

158573.description: Hii-sama is the elder and shaman of the Emishi Village.

158664.description:
Year 1, class A at Yubiwa Academy Middle School. Ace of the track and field team. 

He wears a uniform that has been modified to look like shorts. Ever since he entered the school wearing such a uniform, all the girls who saw it stopped shortening their skirts and started wearing black stockings. He has a well-developed face and is ridiculed for being like the archangel who bosses other angels. He insists on exposing his legs even in winter. He is a member of the Detective Club's physical strength and mobility section. Despite his cute appearance, he often acts carelessly and makes dangerous comments.

~!Has been kidnapped three times in the past. His parents are divorced.!~

(Source: Wikipedia)

158665.description:
Year 2, class A at Yubiwa Academy Middle School. 

He is a dangerous person who tops the "ranking of students who should never be involved in the school." He is known as "the bossman" outside of school, but he is also a good cook and has a family-oriented side. He has a habit of using a lot of satirical metaphors.

158666.description:
Year 1, class A at Yubiwa Academy Middle School. 

He is the heir and de facto president of the Yubiwa Foundation, the parent organization of the Yubiwa Academy. As a child prodigy with both financial and artistic talents, he is a member of the Detective Club's art team. He is expressionless and of few words, but only Manabu can read his thoughts. Usually only speaks twice in each book.

name.native: マッシュ・バーンデッド

158734.description:
__Height:__ 171 cm

The main protagonist of the series. Mash is a first-year student at Easton Magic Academy and member of Adler dorm. He has the peculiarity of not possessing any magic but also has inhuman strength which makes him a standout in the academy.

Mash is generally quiet and kind. However, if he sees someone hurting his family or friends, he gets incredibly angry. He is also extremely innocent and obedient, making people abuse those qualities, but thanks to his strength he can twist almost every situation. He also loves cream puffs a lot.

158749.description:
Andy is member no. 9 of the Round Table. He is a Negator with the alias Undead. His original personality is that of Victor.

Andy is a deuteragonist along with Fuuko Izumo.

Andy is insanely reckless, he enjoys attempting to die and is always looking for new methods of death. He also has a soft spot for Fuuko, who he is very protective of and gets very angry when she is hurt, to the point where he will willingly remove the card in his head to release Victor. 

Andy is a tall and muscular man, with white combed back hair. He has a card in his forehead above his left eye which causes his eye to be half-closed which has left a scar. Due to his ability, he has stopped aging around his mid-20's. He has the words DEAD END tattooed on his left shoulder, but the first D in dead is backwards. He has the number 1865 tattooed on his left pectoral as well as a scar that will not go away even when he regenerates.

159234.description: He is student at Fujou High and is also the President of the Science Club.

159235.description: A student at Fujou High who is also the leader of the Band of 14 devils gang, and it is the one that is feared the most at their school.

159237.description: A student at Fujou High. He is a big, muscular boy who is also part of the Real Game Creation Club.

159238.description: She is a teacher at Fujou High and is also the Advisor of the Cooking Club.

159265.description:
Class 1-3, student number 1.

A girl who has a strong yearning for sailor uniforms due to a certain reason. She has a bright and straightforward personality, and is really looking forward to school life. She is very good at sports.

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

159409.description: Itsuhito Sakaki is [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/130664/Shinichi-Sakurai)'s college classmate and friend. He likes to tease [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/130664/Shinichi-Sakurai) about [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/130665/Hana-Uzaki), and he tries to cooperate with [Ami](https://anilist.co/character/159410/Ami-Asai) to come up with plans to get [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/130664/Shinichi-Sakurai) and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/130665/Hana-Uzaki) closer together.

159410.description: Ami Asai is Shinichi's coworker and [Mr. Asai](https://anilist.co/character/169505/Akihiko-Asai)'s daughter. She has medium length hair and wears glasses. Ami enjoys "people watching" and ogling attractive males, and she has a fond interest in watching the interactions between [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/130664/Shinichi-Sakurai) and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/130665/Hana-Uzaki). Ami hopes to see Shinichi and Hana enter a relationship, although Ami herself seems to find Shinichi's athletic build attractive.

159427.description: Kirie is an A-Class agent, member of Tamakoma Branch and [Yuuma](https://anilist.co/character/81239/Kuga-Yuuma)'s mentor. She is a naïve girl who gets tricked easily, who everyone likes to make fun of because she's so gullible, and she tends to make a big ruckus over little things. She also dislikes weaklings, hence why she chose to mentor Yuuma.

159596.description: Takaki is the leader of the younger children of CGS, later Tekkadan. He is strict, wanting them to contribute as much as everyone else unlike before when the adults were in charge. Takaki has a seven-year-old sister named Fuka who lives in an orphanage. He tells Biscuit that she's six-years younger than him, making him thirteen. He was able to put her into an orphanage after he started getting paid by Tekkadan but wants to send her to school one day.

159920.description: Girlfriend of Ibuki Seigo, the top national football player.

159959.description:
Kaato Higashikata is Norisuke Higashikata IV's ex-wife and the mother of Jobin, Hato, Joshu, and Daiya Higashikata. After being condemned to 15 years in jail for the murder of a child, Kaato is released and determined to be duly compensated for her time spent in prison.

~!Her stand, Space Trucking, allows her to store things in her deck of cards.!~

159998.description: Member of the Robot Club in Shibahama High.

159999.description: Member of the Robot Club in Shibahama High.

160089.description: Member No. 2 of the Round Table.

name.native: セス・リッチー・カッター

160092.description:
Seth is an employee of the GM automobile company, and one of the organizers for the race. He is the one that proposed the race to the company's upper management as a way of showing off the company's work by winning. To publicize the race, he has spared no expense to organize parades, plan festivals, and hire Dylan. He has past experience as an engineer designing race cars.

(Source: Anime News Network)

name.native: ディラン・G・オルディン

160093.description:
Dylan, also known as the "Heroic Dylan," is one of the legendary "Thousand Three" outlaws. The major automobile company GM has hired him to participate in the race, at the wheel of their specially made vehicle. He is one of the favorites to win first place. He personally has no great interest in racing, but he thinks the vivacious Appare is interesting enough. He is a man of few words, but his gunslinging skills are beyond question.

(Source: Anime News Network)

160094.description:
TJ is one of the legendary "Thousand Three" outlaws. He is known and feared as "Crazy TJ," both for his outlandish fashion and hairstyle, to his tendency to jump into danger even knowing the risks. He is employed by the Iron Motor automobile company to take part in the race. He feels a kinship with the brash Appare, especially with regard to crazy hairstyles.

(Source: Anime News Network)

160246.description:
**Race:** Beast
**Height:** 152 cm

Karyl can be described as a 'Tsundere' as she is often complaining about her friend, but always follows along regardless. She has a sharp tongue and often gets annoyed and/or flustered. She tries to act tough and harsh on the outside but in fact she is quite soft-hearted. She is a member of the guild 'Gourmet Edifice'. She also likes to play with cats.

160247.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 156 cm

Possessing a voracious appetite and boundless energy, Pecorine lives a seemingly carefree life from meal to meal. She is ever optimistic and is proactive in making friends, regardless of their attitude in return. Pecorine also loves to travel in search of exotic delicacies, and pays respect to all life by not letting any food that is prepared go to waste. She is the Guild Master of the guild 'Gourmet Edifice'.

160248.description:
**Race:** Elf
**Height:** 140 cm

A member of the guild Gourmet Edifice.

160249.description: An amnesiac with good intentions but often clueless.

160562.description: A mechanic who works together as a team with JP and Frisbee, though he claims that is all in the past. In the movie timeline, he helps JP and Frisbee with the new Transam that latter is used by JP in Redline.

160563.description:
He is a mafia boss who sponsors JP behind the scenes.

~!He is the main antagonist who always bets for JP loss and through Frisbee orders him which positions to take in a race with any means necessary, even by almost killing him.!~

160568.description: The princess of planet Supergrass and the last heir of magical powers. She is a part of the Redline Committee. Her team—Super Boins—takes part in the Redline race.

160632.description:
~!Dolomite was originally a handsome man. Wearing an undercut, the hair on his sides was shaved down whilst the hair on his crown was pulled to the right of his forehead. He wore an exotic striped jacket over a dark, long-sleeved shirt.

After his body was destroyed, Dolomite's appearance drastically changed. His entire body and skin took on a more rock-like appearance, with a rougher complexion and cracks in his skin. Dolomite's arms and legs are reduced to stumps while his teeth are broken and cracked. His eyes are duller and a strange marking exists above his nose, in the form of a triangle with a small circle above it. His hair has grown out much longer and is unkempt, hanging over his shoulders. As for clothing, he still retains his exotic jacket but nothing else. 

[Source: JoJo's Bizarre Wiki]!~

160725.description: Reiko Kujirai is a 32-year-old, single woman working at a real estate store in Kowloon Walled City. There she lives alone in an apartment. She has a mole on the left side of her left eye and occasionally wears glasses. She loves the city of Kowloon, people, food, and likes to smoke while eating watermelon.

160726.description: Hajime is a coworker at the same real estate company as [Reiko](https://anilist.co/character/160725/Reiko-Kujirai) who frequently arrives late to work. He knows a lot about Kowloon and enjoys the people, culture, and food.

161088.description: Gina is a Negator who crossed paths with Andy over fifty years ago.

161213.description: The assistant band director of the Kitauji Concert Band.

161222.description: As someone who dislikes conflict, she is often unwilling to take a stand against Erika's unreasonable actions. She is in love with Shuuji, so she decides to learn how to play Tackfam in order to be his practice partner. She ends up asking Fumiya to be her tutor in Tackfam, which eventually leads to a friendship between the two.

161223.description: Hanabi is a blunt and unsociable classmate of Fumiya Tomozaki. She has a close friendship with Mimimi who is her polar opposite. Her blunt nature often leaves her disliked. Once, it got her into trouble as she openly condemned Erika's actions of harassment and bullying, thus making her the target of bullying herself.

161229.description:
A high school student of Kuyo High School who suffers from insomnia. He comes off as grumpy and unfriendly due to his condition. Ganta is determined to protect the observatory and the revived Astronomy Club, of which he becomes the president.

~!After meeting Isaki, he opens up to the people around him and reveals to Isaki that the cause of his insomnia is due to separation anxiety caused by his mother leaving him and his father.!~

~!He becomes Isaki's boyfriend at the end of the club trip during the summer holiday of their first year. He aims to get into a university with a nursing program in Kanazawa, Ishikawa, inspired by his desire to always be at Isaki's side.!~

161230.description:
A cheerful high school girl who also suffers from insomnia like Ganta. She first discovered the abandoned observatory and made it her sleeping haven, until Ganta came along. 

~!As she and Ganta became closer, she shared to him that she has congenital heart disease which requires monthly examinations, frequent hospitalization, and even surgeries. She was the only other member of the Astronomy Club in her first year, and became the vice-president later in the winter of the same year.!~

~!She started dating Ganta after his confession at the end of their club trip. Initially, she aimed for a university within Ishikawa Prefecture, until she managed to convince her mother to allow her to try for a university in Osaka.!~

161231.description: School nurse and advisor of the Astronomy Club.

name.native: イーサン・バークレム
