161251.description: An ordinary human and the younger brother of Stella.

161252.description: The wife of Yuuki Hatori and the mother of Chise and Fumiki Hatori.

161253.description: The husband of Chika Hatori and the father of Chise and Fumiki Hatori.

name.native: ジョエル・ガーランド

161254.description: A widowed old man who took care of a rose garden. A vampire resided with him, and while he didn't have the ability to see her, he was somewhat sensitive to her presence on a subconscious level.

161256.description: An auctioneer working at the Black Market.

161257.description: A Leánnan sídhe that watches over Garland's Household. Her name was given to her by Chise Hatori.

161258.description: A Wu-il from the Land of Dragons.

161259.description: The son of Yuuki and Chika Hatori and the younger brother of Chise Hatori.

name.native: ミハイル・レンフレッド

161260.description: A Sorcerer and mentor to Alice.

161261.description: A friend of Chise and the older sister of Ethan.

161263.description: A Faerie that serves the faerie queen, Titania

name.native: アンジェリカ・バーレイ

161264.description: A Mage and an Artificer with her own magic shop.

161418.description: Luxion was originally a cash in-game shop item in the original Otome Game, but now, he's the deuteragonist of the story, an important supporting player of the major events of the series.

161450.description:
Park Ilpyo is the Meridional Jeolla Province Champion of the G.O.H Tournament. He is considered as one of the top 3 fighters in the country and is famously known as Sakyamuni Park Ilpyo. He is one of the main supporting characters of the series.

__After RagnarÖk__ ~!17 years after RagnarÖk, he becomes one of The Six and devoted himself to teaching Ssam-Su Taekkyeon.!~ 
__CHARYEOK__ ~!Nine-Tails Guardian: This is the Charyeok of Park Il-Pyo. It is currently the only Charyeok that changes the appearance of its user, besides Yu Mi-Ra's Yeo-Po Bong-Seon. It is one of the most powerful Charyeok seen to date it has been seen taking down multiple Charyeok in Greed's arsenal. The Nine-Tails Guardian is seen to give the wielder health generation, physical enhancements including enhanced strength and speed, and pyrokenesis.!~

alternative: The Youngest Member of The Six

161457.description:
__Race__: ~!Supreme God!~
__Style__: Borrowed Power User
__Charyeok__: Longinus

Mu-Jin Park is a member of the National Assembly of Korea, a member of The Six and the organizer of the G.O.H Tournament. ~!He changed his name from Mu-Bong Park to Mu-Jin Park 17 years before the story begins.!~

161463.description: Saturn is a G.O.H. Priest of the Nox organization with a foul mouth. As soon as her mouth is opened, she starts cursing non-stop, though the reason is unknown. She is also short tempered as her cool and quiet image was shattered in the battle with Judge O.

name.native: フェイト・グラファイト

161604.description:
Fate is a young man that has black hair and brown eyes. However, when the glutton skill is activated, the color of his eyes become red.

After his father passed away, the villagers kicked him out from the village. The villagers think of him as a useless guy after his father had passed away. Fate then looked for a job to live.

name.native: ルファス・マファール

161623.description:
__Level:__  1000
__Species:__  Heaven-Winged

The strongest being who once unified Mizgarz and was feared as "The Black-Winged Overlord". Was sealed after a battle with The Seven Heroes, but was summoned back into the world 200 years later.

161637.description: A Japanese gamer who, after falling asleep playing an online game, finds himself trapped in his game avatar, seemingly transported to a different world. In the game, the only paid avatar was a full-body skeleton, which he chose despite wearing full-body armor. When arriving in this world he still is in the body of a skeleton, which he figures out to be a curse. So he thinks up his own background story to be "a knight that is trying to find a cure for his curse".

name.native: ファルマ・ド・メディシス

161669.description: Pharma is the otherworldly reincarnation of Kanji Yakutani, a world-famous medical researcher at T University who created countless medical advances and medicines to counter any sickness.

161676.description: Haruto's childhood friend. They regrettably parted at the age of 7 when Haruto moved to the countryside with his father due to his parents divorce, each promising the other to meet again when they've grown up and to get married at that time.

161677.description: Latifa is a young fox beastkin girl born in the Beltram Kingdom of the Strahl region.  ~!She also has the past memories and personality of an elementary school student Japanese girl named Endo Suzune.!~

161678.description: A teacher who finds Rio in the slums.

161679.description: Rio is a boy living in the slums who wants revenge for his mother who was murdered in front of him when he was five years old. He has inherited the memories of his last life as Haruto Amakawa, a college student who died in an unfortunate bus accident in Japan.

161696.description:
The Lost One.

She is affectionate and easy-going. Menou is unable to kill her because of her ability even though she is not aware of it herself. She begins her journey with Menou, without knowing her true intentions.

161698.description:
The Executioner.

A young executioner girl who has exceptional magical talent. She is strongly dedicated to her mission and tries to finish off [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/161696) before her power gets out of hand. She gets close to her targets with friendly manner to grasp their ability before killing them. Her main weapons are short blade and sacred scripture.

161699.description: Apprentice priestess working under [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou). She is deeply attached to Menou but has near zero religious faith. She is good at fighting with a fretsaw, but has poor skill with scripture magic.

name.native: アーシュナ・グリザリカ

161700.description:
Traveling Princess Knight.
Princess of the Grizarica Kingdom, who is strong and beautiful. People call her the "Princess Knight" and she carries a sword with the royal crest as she always is ready for a fight.

161730.description:
Alpha is a character in DARLING in the FRANXX. He was a Parasite and the official leader of the 9's, a special forces unit that APE directly controls. He was partnered with 9’ζ and piloted a FRANXX called 9 Model. 

Nine Alpha is a rather short young man, his face framed by pale, honey blond hair, his long bangs low above his green eyes. He wears a special Parasite uniform emblazoned with white and gold, instead of the typical gray uniforms that other Parasite squads use. When in his FRANXX, Alpha, along with the others in his squad, sports a red battle suit. Like his fellow stamens, he appears with golden horns that appear to be holographic klaxosaur horns.

161741.description: The main character. Four years ago, he became [Siesta](https://anilist.co/character/161742/Siesta)'s assistant.

161742.description:
She calls herself the Great Detective. "Siesta", is a code name. Her main weapon is a musket gun while she also has "Seven Tools" that contain special powers. Siesta is one of the Twelve Tuners as the famous detective.

She took [Kimihiko Kimizuka](https://anilist.co/character/161741/Kimihiko-Kimizuka) as her assistant four years prior to the main story.

Her real name, age, and nationality are unknown.

161743.description: A girl who asks [Kimizuka](https://anilist.co/character/161741/Kimizuka-Kimihiko) to search for someone.

161745.description: An active female middle school student and idol.

name.native: シャーロット・有坂・アンダーソン

161746.description: A girl who is a pupil of [Siesta](https://anilist.co/character/161742). She looks up to Siesta.

name.native: エリアーナ・ベルンシュタイン
クリストファー・セルカーク・アッシェラルド
アレクセイ・シュトラッサー
テオドール・ウォーレン・アッシェラルド

161842.description: The chief librarian to the Royal Archive and uncle to the royal prince, Christopher Selkirk Ashelard.

162034.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__ Year:__ 2nd Year
__Jersey Number:__ 10
__Position:__ MF

Kuribayashi is considered a football genius, making his professional debut at age 16 for Tokyo City Esperion FC of the J-1 League. He also plays for Japan's Under-20 National Team.

162035.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

Hana Ichijou is the younger step-sister of [Tatsuya Fukuda](https://anilist.co/character/133817), the coach of Tokyo City Esperion FC Youth. She has been a football fan since she was very young. She was especially a fan of Fukuda, even before their parents married. Hana has a deep knowledge of nutrition as she aspires to become a sports surgeon. She uses that knowledge to make meal plans for the players, notably [Ashito](https://anilist.co/character/133818/Ashito--Aoi) and [Kuribayashi](https://anilist.co/character/162034/Haruhisa-Kuribayashi).

162036.description:
__Height:__183cm
__Year:__ 2nd Year
__Jersey Number:__ 4
__Position:__ DF

He is the only player from the class one year above [Ashito](https://anilist.co/character/133818/Aoi-Ashito) to have passed the tryouts. A defender with the skill to earn a starting spot on the first team as early as his freshman year, he is stoic and hot-tempered, often clashing with his teammates. He took a dislike to Ashito after facing him during the tryouts, and even after joining the team, he picks fights with him at every opportunity, trying to take him down.

162061.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")

A first-year student at Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and is the bassist of the band Morfonica.

A somewhat peculiar girl who longs to be normal. She worries about standing out and hides her true self in order to blend in.

(Source: Official Site)

162062.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'5")

A student at Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and the the lead guitarist of the band [Morfonica](https://anilist.co/staff/162066/Morfonica). She handles the band's costumes, and similarly to [Lisa](https://anilist.co/character/128147/Imai-Lisa) she follows gyaru fashion.

A popular girl who gathers people around her both at school and on social media. Cheerful and open-hearted, but those around her are often caught up by her tendency to play things by ear.

162063.description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1")

A first-year student at Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and the vocalist of the band Morfonica.

Mashiro is a quiet and reserved girl. Though she aspired for Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and managed to get in, she was overwhelmed by the talented individuals around her. As a result, she felt depressed daily until she stumbled upon a band. She's also full of imagination and tends to get lost in her fantasies.

(Source: BanG Dream! Wikia)

162064.description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'7")

A first-year student at Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and the violinist and composer of the band Morfonica.

A talented individual who is always at the top of her class. She has a dry personality and always aims to be on top, as well as speaks in a polite manner. She likes sweet red bean soup with mochi, but dislikes strong-tasting food.

(Source: BanG Dream! Wikia)

162065.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

A first-year student at Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and the drummer and leader of the band Morfonica.

A class president who's always full of confidence. Though she tries her best, her clumsiness comes out now and then. She works tirelessly to become a reliable, trustworthy person.

name.native: ヘンリー・クレアモント

162087.description: The eldest son of the Claremont family and [Richard](https://anilist.co/character/146058/Richard-Ranashinha-de-Vulpian)'s cousin.

162213.description:
__Birthplace:__ Chiba
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")

Meguru Bachira is a contender in the Blue Lock Project who currently plays as a center forward for Spain’s FC Barcha during the Neo Egoist League. Bachira is a whimsical forward who plays instinctively.

162214.description:
__Height:__ 188 cm
__Team:__ Team Z

Rensuke Kunigami is very serious about his football career and training; he's always the first in the training room in the morning and the last to leave at night. Kunigami tends to get into arguments with [Raichi](https://anilist.co/character/169402/Raichi-Jingo), but is also the one who restrains him the most when he picks a fight with someone.

~!During the second selection Kunigami is eliminated from Blue Lock project, but afterwards gets a second chance through the Wild Card training!~

~!After Blue Lock vs. Japan U20 match, Kunigami gets back into Blue Lock project. His appearance changed a bit and his attitude too.!~

162228.description: A young girl who lives with her grandmother and calls herself "Josee" after her favorite book

162229.description: A fourth year student at a university in Osaka.

162242.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

Used to be the Class President before being sent to another world. Has been Class President since first grade. Has known Haruka since first grade as well. Usually seen yelling at Haruka for all the messes he gets himself into. 

She is also a part of the main group Haruka has kept close to. 

~!Has the skill "Hijack."!~

162243.description:
Seen as a knight with flowing golden hair and blue eyes. She is saved by Haruka.

~!Angelica is the name of the Level 100 Dungeon Emporer Haruka fought with. Haruka used his skill "Servitude" on to set her free from a curse that had been placed upon her. When she was cursed she had appeared as a skeleton in a black shroud, but her appearance changes upon obtaining level 100 armor named "Living Armor." It is cursed pure silver amor that binds to the wearer as if it become their own flesh. Resulting from this, she is not a skeleton anymore, but is now a 17 year old girl.!~

~!Due to her being saved by Haruka, she is indebted and is also seemingly attracted to him!~

162244.description:
__Height:__ 171 cm

The main protagonist of the story. Haruka, a bonfide loner, as well as his classmates were all surrounded by a magic circle. To avoid the world transfer, he escaped out of the classroom, but failed. This resulted in his transfer getting delayed and because of this, the skills that he could choose on a first-come, first-serve basis were only leftover skills. Failing to notice Haruka was missing, God decides to grant him all of the skills that were unchosen. 

One of the unchosen skills he receives is titled "Loner." The bearer of that title is not permitted to join a party.

162245.description:
__Race:__ Elf

Gamma is a member of Shadow Garden, being third of the original Seven Shadows as well as the director of the Mitsugoshi Company. Despite her lack of coordination, Gamma's knowledge has allowed her to recreate many of the items described by her master [Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou) to sell as Mitsugoshi's exclusive products.

162246.description:
__Race:__ Elf

Alpha is the second-in-command of Shadow Garden. After being cured of Demon Possession by [Cid Kagenou](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou), she would devote her life to his cause, becoming the first member to be recruited into his organization, Shadow Garden. 

~!She is the descendant of the elf [Hero Olivier](https://anilist.co/character/204203/Olivier).!~

162247.description:
__Race:__ Elf

Beta is the second member of Shadow Garden, supporting her master [Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou) against the Order of Diabolos. 

~!Outside of her Shadow Garden activities, she adopts the identity of Natsume Kafka, an up-and-coming author of numerous original pieces of literature.!~

162248.description:
__Race:__ Beastkin

Delta is a member of Shadow Garden, being fourth of the original Shadow Seven to join the organization after her Demonic Possession was healed by her master [Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou). As the most physically gifted of the Seven, Delta is also often the most destructive and brutal of the group due to her lack of sense and self-control.

162249.description:
__Race:__ Elf

Epsilon is the fifth member of Shadow Garden. Due to her insecurities with having a flat-chest, she manipulated her slime bodysuit every year to slowly increase the mass on her chest, eventually developing a fake large breast. As a consequence of this, she developed extreme magic control earning her the title, "The Precision."

162355.description: A 92nd Totsuki Generation student. She is also the heiress to her family restaurant.

162432.description: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") __Peach Ability:__ "Ame-No-Mitori" __Affiliation:__ Anti-Demon Corps (6th Unit Chief) Tenka is the 6th Anti-Demon Corps Chief. She is [Kyouka](https://anilist.co/character/162524)'s friend and rival.

162524.description: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 167 cm (5'6") __Peach Ability:__ Chains of Eternity, "Slave" __Affiliation:__ Anti-Demon Corps (7th Unit Chief) Kyouka is the chief of the 7th Unit of the Anti-demon Corps, an elite group of women who have received power from the Peaches. She is [Yuuki Wakura](https://anilist.co/character/170329)'s savior and becomes his master after she decided to make him her slave. She is a fierce militaristic, calm, and serious woman befitting the 7th Unit Chief. She often fights against the Shuuki more seriously than other chiefs. She cares for the people around her to the point where she will do anything to protect them.

162564.description:
A devil who came to the Earth to find [Jashin-chan](https://anilist.co/character/126884). She is the daughter of the Underworld God, Hades and [Persephone](https://anilist.co/character/288414). She later lives with [Minos](https://anilist.co/character/127128).
Persephone II is very soft-spoken and naïve to human culture. She means well and tries to befriend whoever she meets. Being a kid and all, she tends to state her opinions point blank, usually at Jashin-chan's expense.

162723.description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family, Asano Family
__Occupation:__ Student, Spy
~!__Blooming:__  Hardening!~

Taiyou is the main protagonist of the series. He is a Spy and member of the Yozakura Family. Taiyou married into the Yozakura Family for the sake of wanting to protect Mutsumi Yozakura and also find out the truth of what happened the day of the car accident which took his parents' and younger brother's lives.

Taiyou was a cheerful person before he went through the experience of his entire family's death in a car accident. It was after that day that his personality and made him afraid of forming emotional connections with anyone. The only person who he stayed close with was [Mutsumi Yozakura](https://anilist.co/character/162724/Mutsumi-Yozakura) because of her promise to never leave him.

~!Mutsumi shared her Yozakura blood power with him, granting Taiyou supernatural abilities and the Blooming.!~

162724.description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Student, Spy, Head of Yozakura Family

Mutsumi is one of the main protagonists of the series. She is the wife of [Taiyo Asano](https://anilist.co/character/162723/Taiyou-Asano) and the current head of the Yozakura Family.

Mutsumi is a kind and caring girl who can be willing to do anything to help her friends and family. Additionally, she is responsible as a sister and as the Head of the Yozakura Family, taking after her late mother, the previous head of the family. Since being married to Taiyo Asano, she's seen assisting in Taiyo's missions, leading him the way, treating his wounds, etc. Mutsumi also does not hesitate when it comes to Taiyo and her family despite always being targeted by other spies and assassins.

Since being born as a normal child of the Yozakura Family, making her the Head of the family, she is not known to have any superhuman abilities or skills. Even so, Mutsumi still, does have the talent and knowledge of a spy apart of the Yozakura Family.

name.native: ジュリアーノ・フリップ

162885.description:
**Height:** 155 cm (5'1")

Minase Nagisa is [Mukai Naoya](https://anilist.co/character/162887)'s girlfriend. She is one of the female protagonist of Kanojo mo Kanojo series, along with Naoya's other girlfriend [Saki Saki](https://anilist.co/character/162886)

Nagisa is shown to be a collected, considerate and humble girl. She seems to have no talent, often working hard to stay on her classmates average. Despite her considerate personality, she would resort to underhanded tactics, even to the point of cheating, to preserve her relationship with Mukai Naoya. Nagisa has been shown to have a lack of talent in singing and sports.

162886.description:
**Height:** 161 cm (5'3")

Saki Saki is [Mukai Naoya](https://anilist.co/character/162887/Mukai-Naoya)'s girlfriend. She is one of the female protagonist of Kanojo mo Kanojo series, along with Naoya's other girlfriend [Minase Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/162885/Minase-Nagisa).

Saki is stated to be a cheerful and energetic girl. She is also an emotional, naive and forgetful girl. She excels in sports and can be openly aggressive against anyone, mostly Mukai Naoya, whose actions are a bit too much.

162887.description:
**Height:** 170 cm (5'7")

Naoya is considered to be a very straightforward and outgoing person. His straightforward personality is very explicit and knows no bounds; Naoya is straightforward regardless of his situation, be it in front of the mass crowd or in private with his girlfriends. Additionally, Naoya can be considered slightly selfish for he openly asks his first girlfriend, [Saki Saki](https://anilist.co/character/162886/Saki-Saki), whether he can two-time her and go out with [Minase Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/162885/Minase-Nagisa).

Despite his two-timing behavior, Naoya would do his best to keep himself to only two girlfriends, as seen by constantly rejecting and fending off [Hoshizaki Mirika](https://anilist.co/character/182020/Rika-Hoshizaki) despite her persistent behavior to gain his affection. He would also protect his relationship from all compromise, as seen with Mirika and Shino who tried to expose his two-timing relationships.

The straightforward personality branches off into Naoya's persistence, repeatedly asking Saki out until she finally gives in over many years. It also introduced his restraint, in which he refrains himself from laying hand on the girls (his girlfriends, Rika and Shino) no matter how suggestive the situation may have been.

163009.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Estimated Prison Sentence:__ 745 years

Courier grew up being forced to transport things by adults. He has confidence in his work and is somewhat of a workaholic. He doesn't speak often, but when he does, he has the right words for the situation. He has a habit of clicking his tongue, and his favorite food is takoyaki.

163010.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Estimated Prison Sentence:__ 4 years

Chinpira is greedy and is involved with crimes for money. He tries to act bold, but ultimately, he's a coward who believes that "if you can't beat them, join them." However, thanks to his weakness, he can show consideration to his comrades. He's a pathological liar and likes ramen.

163011.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

She was just a regular girl, born in a regular family, worked like everyone else, and was leading a simple life. One misfortune after another got her involved in the crimes of Akudama. She’s a kind of person who doesn't get depressed, and she deals with problems optimistically.

163012.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm
__Weight:__ 47 kg
__Estimated Prison Sentence:__ 589 years 

The Hacker is more excited the more difficult something is, but is completely apathetic to things he's uninterested in. He likes healthy jelly drinks.

163013.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Estimated Prison Sentence:__ 967 years 

An Akudama.

Cutthroat's hobby is murder. Paradoxically, his usual behavior is innocent and almost childlike. He becomes unable to control his murderous impulses under certain conditions, especially when he sees the color red. Just simply seeing the color red makes him excited to the point of childlike giddiness. His favorite food is marshmallows and he has an extreme infatuation with [Swindler](https://anilist.co/character/163011/Ippanjin).

163727.description:
__Zodiac:__ Capricorn
__Hair Color:__ Light Brown
__Eye Color:__ Yellow
__Height:__ 167 cm

Yukihiro is a member of the Metropolitan Police Department Modern Crime Prevention Task Force. He is a good boss watching his subordinates while tinkering with his hobby plastic model during his duties.

163728.description:
__Height:__ 183 cm

Shinnosuke is a member of the Metropolitan Police Department Modern Crime Prevention Task Force. He works on his own pace, and his enthusiasm for work is not so strong.

163729.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

Chosuke is a member of the Metropolitan Police Department Modern Crime Prevention Task Force. He is a veteran detective that used to be in the Investigation division. He is highly respected by [Haru Katou](https://anilist.co/character/158385/Haru-Katou).

163730.description:
__Height:__ 171 cm
__Base of Operations:__ Metropolitan Police Department (Headquarters, Investigation Division)

Ryo is a member of the Metropolitan Police Department's Investigation Division I.

163731.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Katsuhiro is a member of the Police Agency's "Investigation Division I." He is the chief of the Investigation Department, and takes the lead when it comes to field work. His subordinates carry a strong trust with him. He also cares about his former subordinate, [Haru Katou](https://anilist.co/character/158385/Haru-Katou).

163798.description:
A popular and handsome high school student. He has feelings for [Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/83237/Iroha-Igarashi) and often flirts with her in hopes of making her his girlfriend. He views [Tsutsui](https://anilist.co/character/83235/Tsutsui--Hikari) as his rival and is incredibly jealous of him to the point where he spreads false rumors about him.

Takanashi was initially snobbish, deceptive, and arrogant to the point of ruining Hikari Tsutsui reputation just so he could have a chance with Iroha Igarashi by spreading rumors that Hikari was a lolicon. Later though, after witnessing the gravity of his actions, he begins to feel a bit of remorse and eventually apologizes to Hikari's family along with his younger sister who assisted him with this act. He eventually begins to tag along with Hikari and his group of friends more. He begins to act more like a friend to Hikari as the story progresses and starts to care more about Arisa Ishino, although he continuously denied it that this hints he is having feelings for her and plays into the "tsundere" trope.

~!Post time leap he gets married to Arisa Ishino and they have a child!~

name.native: クラウディア・ブラフォード

164037.description:
__Herocraft:__ Gloster Gladiator Mk. II
__ Height:__  164 cm

Her call sign is Schwertleite. Claudia takes her job as a Valkyrie seriously, however, she's shown to become morose when she's the only one left after a successful mission.

164040.description:
__Herocraft:__ Heinkel He100D-1
__Height: __155 cm

Azuzu is a snippy and argumentative lady. She's also shown to be a rather pragmatic and observant individual.

164041.description:
__Herocraft:__ Macchi M.C.72R
__Height: __147 cm

Sonoka is a soft-spoken and mild-mannered teenager.

164334.description: A punk, Makoto loves to cut loose and pick up chicks. He is very charismatic and is frequently approached by people who need help in desperate situations. Makoto has a vengeful side, which is seen after his girlfriend, Rika, was brutally murdered by an unknown assailant. Makoto also has school ties with the leader of the local gang, G Boys, and can call on him for help if he truly needs it. Raised in a single-parent household, Makoto's mother runs a local fruit shop and frequently asks him to watch the store.

164335.description: The leader of the "Red Angels" gang in Ikebukuro West Gate Park.

164336.description:
An old school-mate of Makoto's, Takashi is the leader of the G Boys, a local gang. He frequently comes off as goofy or playful, but that hides his true personality as a ruthless leader who will do anything to meet his own needs. He frequently comes to Makoto's aid whenever it is needed, but will not hesitate to ask for favors in return.

(Source: Wikipedia)

164519.description: A witch part of an unknown coven.

164547.description: Mage who served as Lindel's magic teacher. She is fond of giving names, having chosen Lindel's and Elias' names.

164752.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

He's really sensitive about his girlish features, and he's a hardcore fudanshi.

164753.description:
__Height:__ 183 cm
__Likes:__ Sweets

Sasaki is [Miyano](https://anilist.co/character/164752/Miyano-Yoshikazu)'s senior in high school. He's a 'bad-boy' who doesn't cause much trouble. He got introduced to BL manga through Miyano.

164986.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm 

Nagisa Kubo is the female protagonist of Kubo-san wa Boku (Mobu) wo Yurusanai. She is one of the few people who can easily find [Shiraishi](https://anilist.co/character/173331/Shiraishi-Junta).

165308.description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy, Vice-Principal of a School, ~!Principal of Teiou Academy!~
~!__Blooming:__  Void!~


Kyoichiro is the oldest son and most powerful spy in the Yozakura Family. After a certain mission, where his younger sister and head of the Yozakura Family, [Mutsumi Yozakura](https://anilist.co/character/162724/) was badly injured, Kyoichiro swore to protect from there on out, no matter the cost.

Kyoichiro is a sister-loving freak. Practically a stalker and would do anything to protect his little sister, Mutsumi. He is very over-protective of her, and won't let any single boy come near her by any means possible; torture, threat, blackmail, murder, etc. Considered annoying by many people, and was once nominated by the Weekly Spies as 'The Spy I Would Want to Kill Most!'. Kyoichro most definitely wants to kill or torture [Taiyo Asano](https://anilist.co/character/162723/) as much as possible. But despite his torturous nature towards Taiyo, Kyoichiro is still reliable, and will protect whoever is close to him even if he dies in the process.

165569.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm
__Instrument:__ Trumpet

Tomoe is a second year during Kumiko's first year.

During the time leading up to auditions, Tomoe began to notice pain in her jaw when she played. Eventually, it started becoming difficult to play high notes. She later announced to the band that she would be stepping down from participation in the auditions, and instead would support them as concert band manager.

165811.description: Hiro Segawa is the love interest of Nagi Umino.

165812.description: Sachi Umino is the sister of [Nagi Umino](https://anilist.co/character/166730/Nagi-Umino).

165814.description: **Height:** 160 cm Erika Amano is a second-year student at Orpheus Jogakuin but transfers to Megurokawa Gakuen. She is a popular social media celebrity and the biological daughter of the family that raised Nagi.

165841.description:
Chihiro Yoshioka is a young girl who is part of Koyanagi's group.

Chihiro is a sweet girl, who is similar to Shuichi in many ways. She wanted to be veterinarian and because of that, in her monster form she grew fox ears and is able to hear and feel the feelings of animals.

165842.description:
Nana Mifune was a girl who became Collector for the Alien.

Nana is a nice smart girl. She had realized she got the recommendation only because Shuichi declined it. She likes Shuichi and when he looked depressed, she tried talking to him to see if there is something she can do to help him.

(Source: Gleipnir Wiki)

165843.description:
Subaru is a young boy who is a strong Collector and part of Elena Aoki's group.

Subaru doesn't like being ordered around or looked down and is ready to kill anyone who does that. He only listens to Elena.

(Source: Gleipnir Wiki)

165844.description:
Sayaka Koyanagi is a young girl who formed a group of Collectors to gather hundred coins.

Sayaka was in love with a female teacher, who had moral doubts about their relationship and Sayaka ended up sharing with a friend, which led to the friend revealing it publicly and the teacher killing herself. After being betrayed, Sayaka started to have trust issues. Because of that, she had a very clear images on what she wanted and received her ability.

(Source: Gleipnir Wiki)

165862.description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'6")

A member of the Demon Slaying Corps, who was taught the Breath of Thunder by former Thunder Pillar, Jigoro, with fellow disciple Zenitsu.

166102.description:
A main character of Talentless Nana. Her talent is mind-reading. ~!Her mind-reading ability is a lie and she's talentless. She uses logical deductions and improvisation to fake her ability.!~

A cute and observant, though somewhat pushy girl. Despite her mind-reading talent, she admits she's not good at reading the room. ~!Nana Hiiragi is actually the protagonist of Talentless Nana. Cruel and calculating, she is an antiheroine who has been sent to the island by the government to stop the Talented from fostering their abilities by assassinating them one by one.!~ ~!Has had a personal vendetta against the Talented ever since they killed her parents in a break-in. She blames her ditzy young self for it.!~ ~!Becomes disillusioned with her goal and vows to never kill again after she learns that each of the Talented's theoretical "body counts" are entirely fabricated.!~

166103.description:
~!Kyouya's immortality allow's him to take attacks that would usually kill someone, and it is shown when he is attacked that he can somewhat regenerate. Although he has immortality he can still feel pain to an extent.!~
~!The price of his immortality is that he can only remember the last 2 years. He writes about his experiences in notebooks, so he can read them and remember past events.!~

166104.description: ~!Can neutralize other people’s powers.!~ ~!After his ability mutates, he is able to neutralize the human body functions too. This can mean neutralizing their bodily functions (breathing, heartbeat, etc.). In addition, the extent of neutralizing human body functions allows him to neutralize people's moral capacity, turning them into temporary killing machines. He is essentially able to mind-control them into the killing.!~

166105.description: __Talent:__ Fire powers. He can engulf his fists in flame and shoot beams of fire from them.

166106.description:
~!She has a Healing ability. Although unlike normal healing, she is giving up her lifespan to heal another. Often times after she heals a major injury, she feels lightheaded and sick. Her healing was shown to be of Type Heavy Injuries as she was able to completely heal Nana having received a fatal injury.
She can do Resurrection, though it is at the cost of her life.!~
~!Her body is revealed to still be cared for. While her heart has stopped, her body is still warm even after events of the island. !~

166107.description: Youhei has the ability to go back in time up to 24 hours, however the further back he goes, the more tired he is when he returns. If someone from the past sees him, he's sent back to the present immediately.

166730.description:
Nagi is a second-year student at Megurogawa Gakuen. He is the biological son of a hotel tycoon, but due to a mix-up after his birth is raised by a different family.

Nagi seems to be obsessed with studying to the point that he studies day and night in order to achieve top marks. He is quite capable in pretty much everything, whether it is housework or schoolwork, proving his culinary skills multiple times by preparing delicious dishes everyday. He is a free-willed and determined person with a stubborn attitude to never give up. He is also naïve when it comes to the girls around him. Yet his kindhearted nature means that he will protect the ones that he cares about by doing everything in his power to help them.

166815.description: A culinary prodigy serving as the charismatic, enigmatic owner of Restaurant K. Kai becomes Gaku's mentor after witnessing his unique potential in cooking.

166816.description: A math genius who was recruited by Kai to work as a chef at Restaurant K. Gaku applies his mathematical talents into molecular gastronomy to learn more about cooking and develop his own recipes.

name.native: リョウマ・タケバヤシ

167274.description:
The main protagonist who lived an uneventful life as an office worker in Japan before dying in his sleep. Due to his diligent and kind behavior, he earns the grace of the gods who send him to another world as an 8-year-old boy where he lives in a forest for three years while polishing his skills and taming hundreds of slimes, making use of their multiple abilities in various tasks from combat and hunting to cleaning and crafting, until meeting the Jamil family who warmly welcomes him among them. Determined to live independently, he refuses to overindulge on their hospitality and looks for ways to make ends meet by himself.

(Source: Wikipedia)

167307.description:
Tooru is a citizen of Morioh. During his high school years, he dated Yasuho and the two seem to have been very close. One year before the events of JoJolion, he broke up with her. He then became a part-time worker at TG University Hospital at an undisclosed date.

~!Tooru is later revealed to be the main antagonist of Part 8. He is a rock human and the mastermind of the Locacaca Organization. 

Tooru's stand, Wonder of U, is able to create illusions that can be sent after a specific target. It can disguise itself and take on the appearance of a human, allowing it to interact with non-stand users. It can also create projections of itself, which can travel quickly between locations by phasing into and appearing on transparent surfaces, such as windows or picture frames. Wonder of U's ability is automatic and can be activated on any person who has looked at its back in either an attempt to pursue it or otherwise moves toward it. While Wonder of U's ability is active, targets will experience various instances of conflict which seemingly play out in the most devastating way imaginable. These calamities often involve an affected person repeatedly colliding with objects in their environment, resulting in far greater injury than is possible under normal circumstances.!~

(Source: JoJoWiki)

167313.description: Member no. 5 of the Round Table. She lived in Russia before becoming a member. The armor she wears acts as a restraint to contain her ability.

167444.description:
__Height:__ 177cm (5'10")

Hyoma Chigiri is a contender for the Blue Lock Project and member of Team Z. 

As a young child, he was thought of as a prodigy due to his incredible speed. However, he is now psychologically scarred by a life-changing injury during his first year of high school.

name.native: グリンハウスミスエリザベス

167555.description: Ellie is another Collector who is secretly Loser's assistant and daughter. She is good at using drones in the form of animals like pigeons and bats.

167670.description:
Himari is a very joyous, cheerful girl and often likened to a puppy by other characters. 

She is able to instantly befriend anyone, even hard to approach characters like [Shiho](https://anilist.co/character/215602/Izumi-Shiho). Himari is always wanting the best for her friends and cheering them on in whatever they pursue.

167671.description: A third year high school student who sings while playing guitar at the school rooftops and loves collecting cat merchandise. She is also a part of the "SS Girls" band in which she is positioned as the guitarist and vocalist.

167819.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm
__Affiliation:__ Easton Magic Academy
__Occupation:__ Student

Lemon Irvine is a first-year student at Easton Magic Academy. She has short, blonde hair with an orange ribbon. Her mark is under her right eye, straight with a half-moon curve. Usually wears the Easton Magic School uniform.

Lemon is a little kooky, but she's honest to goodness person and seems incapable of betraying others. She also gets scared very easily and tends to exaggerate in the conversations she has with other people.

name.native: ポーク・パイ・ハット小僧

167880.description: Pork Pie Hat Kid is one of [Funny Valentine](https://anilist.co/character/20147/Funny-Valentine)'s henchmen. He also happens to be a Stand User wielding the double hooked Wired.

168774.description:
~!__Family:__ [Haru Nanakusa](https://anilist.co/character/364736) (Mother), [Kabura Honda](https://anilist.co/character/175661) (Adoptive Mother)!~

Nazuna is a female vampire who likes the night itself more than the daylight. A certain day she meets with a fourteen-year-old boy called [Kou Yamori](https://anilist.co/character/168866/). Kou is a guy who can't sleep very well every night, so to satisfy Kou's will, Nazuna shows him how to sleep very well at night. On the same night, Kou discovers that Nazuna is a vampire, and that makes Kou feel the will of becoming a vampire too, but the problem began here, because neither Nazuna nor Kou knows what is love, and it is required that Kou falls in love with Nazuna in order for him to become a vampire.

168798.description:
__Race:__ Human

Claire is the older sister of [Cid Kagenou](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou) and heir to the Kagenou Family.

name.native: アレクシア・ミドガル

168799.description:
__Race:__ Human

Alexia Midgar is the second princess of the Kingdom of Midgar and younger sister of [Iris Midgar](https://anilist.co/character/204204/Iris--Midgar). She is also a student of Midgar Royal Spellsword Academy.

168800.description:
__Race:__ Human

Rosa Oriana is a noble Princess from the Oriana kingdom. She is known for being a genius in art in her kingdom. However, she came to Midgar Royal Spellsword Academy in order to learn swordsmanship.

~!Later [Alpha](https://anilist.co/character/162246/Alpha) discovered Rose, who became a fugitive for assassinating her father and was then offered membership into Shadow Garden.!~

name.native: エルヴィン・フォン・アルニム

168825.description: Elvin is the fifth son of a noble family who owns a village with a populace of 500. His family's financial situation is similar to Well's and as the family's 5th son he won't inherit their wealth. So to make his living, he plans on using his sword talent to pass the scholarship exam and become an adventurer.

name.native: ユリウス・ラファ・ホルファート

168842.description: Julius Rafa Holfort is one of the main capture target in first series of the otome game and prince of the Holfort Kingdom.

168866.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'1")

A second-year junior high school boy, who slowly finds himself restless because of his boring life. To reinvigorate himself, he slips out at night to walk the streets. He wants to become a vampire.

168967.description: Crimson is the previous Winged Monarch who betrayed the dragons and tried to kill the Dragon God. Crimson teamed up with [Ragna](https://anilist.co/character/204860/Ragna) to slay all dragons, himself included.

168968.description:
__Race:__ Human

Nu is the thirteenth member of Shadow Garden and an employee of Mitsugoshi Company.

169094.description:
Minako Okukawa is a former ballerina who currently teaches ballet at her studio in Hasetsu and the ballet teacher of Yuuri Katsuki.

Minako is an energetic and outgoing person, often striking ballet poses whenever she gets enthusiastic about something. She insists on manners, discipline, and body management, though she also enjoys alcohol, which contradicts her emphasis on manners and causes her to be quite brash and loud. She tries to keep Yuuri Katsuki motivated as a skater because the number of youth in Hasetsu is declining, putting her job as a ballet teacher in peril.

She is a big fan of figure skating and constantly expresses her attraction towards the male skaters while drunk, especially to Victor. She is also a big fan of Christophe Giacometti's, cheering for him when he performs and becoming flustered when noticed by him.

(Source: Yuri!!! On Ice Wikia)

169095.description: Lutz is one of the triplet daughters of Yuuko and Takeshi Nishigori.

169097.description:
Takeshi Nishigori is a childhood friend and ex-rink mate of Yuuri Katsuki. He is married to Yuuko.

As a child, Takeshi used to tease Yuuri for being overweight, though Yuuko was quick to defend Yuuri from his teasing. He did not share the same interest in Victor Nikiforov that Yuuri and Yuuko did.

As an adult, he has a laid-back and benign personality, and often gives Yuuri blunt but practical advice. Though he still sometimes teases Yuuri like he did when they were children, he does so in a more friendly and joking way. He no longer skates seriously, but is still a fan of the sport along with his wife and daughters.

(Source: Yuri!!! On Ice Wikia)

169101.description: Axel is one of the triplet daughters of Yuuko and Takeshi Nishigori.

169102.description: Loop is one of the triplet daughters of Yuuko and Takeshi Nishigori.

169103.description:
Mari Katsuki is the daughter of Toshiya Katsuki and Hiroko Katsuki and the older sister of Yuuri Katsuki. Mari works at the family hot springs, Yu-topia Katsuki, in Hasetsu. She is the only character seen to smoke.

She is shown to mostly have a laid-back personality, only entering the vicinity when necessary. However, upon seeing Yuri Plisetsky for the first time, she becomes excited, as he supposedly looks just like her favorite band member. Though she usually seems disinterested in what goes on around her, she is supportive of Yuuri and his skating career.

(Source: Yuri!!! On Ice Wikia)

169104.description:
Yuuto Omiki is a 17-year-old figure skater.

(Source: Yuri!!! On Ice Wikia)

169105.description:
Toshiya Katsuki is the husband of Hiroko Katsuki and the father of Mari Katsuki and Yuuri Katsuki. Together with his wife Toshiya runs Yu-topia Katsuki, the last remaining hot springs resort in Hasetsu.

Toshiya is a cheerful individual who likes to make jokes. Later on, it is revealed that he becomes rambunctious when drunk, a trait he passed on to Yuuri.

(Source: Yuri!!! On Ice Wikia)

169190.description:
God of the Plague Affiliation. Gravely injured at the hands of Zi Zhou during the battle at Shang, and seen as a disgrace to the gods for that reason, he was shunned by the gods. 

~!Then an outcast, he met Ji Qiao and he restored his health by consuming the blood of young children. 4 years following the battle at Shang, he went to the Northern Mines to get Li Jing to teach Ji Qiao his Smelting Aura technique and was accused of eating Ne Zha. Following being accused, he briefly battled with Li Jing at the mines.!~

169191.description: Li Jing is the owner of the northern mines, a mine set up by the gods to mine for blood stones, and father of Ne Zha. He is also the master of the Smelting Aura technique.

169192.description:
Scar Face is a bigfoot creature that was brought in to help work the Northern Mines. He was forced to battle Wu Geng. 

~!After Wu Geng defeated Scar Face in a gladiator-style battle, Scar Face became his companion and ended up rescuing him from the hands of Gui Mu. The rescue effort ended up costing Scar Face his life.!~

169256.description: Masamune Okumura is a cosplay photographer and the president of the Manga Research Club.

169257.description: Ririsa is a beautiful first-year student who joins the manga club. Due to her passion for cosplay, she recruits [Okumura](https://anilist.co/character/169256/Okumura-Masamune) to be her photographer. Like Okumura, she is also a fan of Liliel. She was first inspired to become a cosplayer when she visited a cosplay event. Though initially oblivious, she starts to slowly fall in love with Okumura later on.

169409.description: He is a first-year student of Fujiyoki High School who took on a part time job at a convenience store to cope with his parents' divorce and his mother getting a boyfriend. He befriended [Gauma](https://anilist.co/character/169410/Gauma) after offering him food and was dragged into becoming one of the co-pilots of Dynazenon, the others being his classmate [Yume Minami](https://anilist.co/character/169411/Yume-Minami) and [Koyomi Yamanaka](https://anilist.co/character/169412/Koyomi-Yamanaka). Out of the four pilots, Yomogi's schedule prohibited him from spending more time in training for his piloting skills.

169410.description:
~!__Age:__ 5000+!~

Gauma is one of the main protagonists of SSSS.DYNAZENON. He is a mysterious man who befriended [Yomogi](https://anilist.co/character/169409/Yomogi-Asanaka) after the latter offered him food. He fights against the Kaiju Eugenicists using Dynazenon.

~!5000 years ago, Gauma was one of the Kaiju Eugenicists, who brought fortune to a certain country (approximately somewhere in China) through the use of their power to control Kaiju. They were known as "dragon controllers" to the neighboring country. Juuga used to look up to Gauma as well. The princess of their country became interested in the power, but then the Kaiju Eugenicists were betrayed, while also betraying the country themselves. Gauma shifted his loyalty to the princess over his comrades and killed them. He then fell over and seemingly died, gaining the scars on his face in the process. At some point, before or after his death, Gauma received Dynazenon from the princess in the form of a dragon ornament. The princess (also his lover) placed his mummified remains together with other relics before killing herself to join Gauma in the afterlife.!~

169411.description: Yume Minami is a main character in *SSSS.DYNAZENON*. She is is an emotionally troubled classmate of [Yomogi](https://anilist.co/character/169409/Yomogi-Asanaka) in Fujiyoki High School who became one of the four co-pilots of Dynazenon.

169579.description:
A God candidate working as the product planner for an apparel company. He is suffering from terminal cancer, and first uses his red arrows to secure enough money for his family after he dies, then to hire private detectives to find more God candidates.

~!He decides to team up with [Mirai](https://anilist.co/character/89231/Kakehashi-Mirai) and [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/89974/Hanakago-Saki) in order to prevent [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/122073/Uryuu-Kanade) from becoming God, to the point of obtaining firearms from the JSDF in order to have a better chance to kill him. Mirai agrees on the grounds that Nanato continues his treatment.!~

169620.description:
Born poor and ugly, Sokotani was always shunned by others until his mother commits suicide and Balta appears to become his angel. Using Balta's powers, Sokotani manages to obtain money and a new, beautiful face by plastic surgery, but still is unable to attract a girl himself due to his poor communication skills. He develops an obsession with Kanade and offers to become his subordinate, which he accepts, but only in exchange of capturing another God Candidate.

(Source: Wikipedia)

169621.description:
Susumu Yuito was a human who was selected by the angel Penema to be a god candidate. He initially uses a novelty mask resembling Donald Trump to hide his identity.

~!Susumu has claimed to support Mirai Kakehashi and revealed the truth about god candidates to the public.!~

(Source: Platinum End Wiki)

169622.description: Gaku Yoneda is a human who was selected by the angel Muni to be a God candidate. He is the last God candidate to be revealed in the series.

169623.description:
Shuji Nakaumi is a human who was selected by the angel Ogaro to be a god candidate.

(Source: Platinum End Wiki)

169624.description:
Ogaro is a first-rank angel and is the Angel of Darkness. She is one of the thirteen angels and selected Shuji Nakaumi as her god candidate.

(Source: Platinum Wiki)

169625.description: Yuri Temari is a human who was selected by the angel [Yazeli](https://anilist.co/character/172072/Yazeli) to be a god candidate.

169626.description: Meyza is a special-rank angel and is the Angel of Greed. She is one of the thirteen angels and selected [Kanade Uryu](https://anilist.co/character/122073/Uryuu-Kanade), a.k.a. Metropoliman, as her god candidate.

169627.description: Balta is a first-rank angel and is the Angel of Intuition. He is one of the thirteen angels and selected [Hajime Sokotani](https://anilist.co/character/169620/Sokotani-Hajime) as his god candidate.

169628.description: Baret is a first-rank angel and is the Angel of Knowledge. She is one of the thirteen angels and selected [Nanato Mukaido](https://anilist.co/character/169579/Mukaido-Nanato) as her god candidate.

169629.description:
Muni is a special-rank angel and is the Angel of Destruction. He is one of the thirteen angels and selected Yoneda as his god candidate.

(Source: Platinum End Wiki)

169630.description:
Tonma Rodriguez is a human who was selected by the angel Luta to be a god candidate.

Tonma is a very selfish individual, who has no problem using his new found power as a god candidate to force women to fall in love with him. He also has a large ego, brazenly stating in a television interview that he already feels like a god.

169785.description:
Aoi Tanio is a woman convicted of murder and the reason that Guardian Serpent of Tsukana Swamp requested the help of Kotoko Iwanaga in Chapter 15 of the Manga and Episode 2 of the Anime.

She is the main suspect of a murder for disposing a dead body into the Tsukuna Swamp. Furthermore, the serpent claims to have heard her utters: "I really hope they find it," after disposing the body.

169988.description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Student, Spy
~!__Blooming:__  Adaptation!~


Nanao is one of the main supporting characters and younger son in the Yozakura Family.

He is the sweet and gentle (but enormous) youngest brother, adept at creating drugs and medicine of all kinds. Hides his face with a bucket.

~! It is later revealed that he uses medicine to shrink his body so he can look like a normal student and go to school to try and live a normal life. !~

169989.description:
__Afiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy, Hacker
~!__Blooming:__  Analyzation!~

A fiercely competitive Gamer Girl and the fourth child of the family, she's a hypercompetent hacker.

169990.description:
__Age:__ 21
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy
~!__Blooming:__  Magnanimity!~

The responsible second child of the Yozakura family. Her diminutive stature belies her incredible strength and skill in hand-to-hand combat.

Futaba may seem like the non-gentle kind but is actually pretty kind and helpful. At times she can be strict but truly wants the best for her family. Unlike the oldest son [Kyoichiro](https://anilist.co/character/165308/Kyouichirou-Yozakura), Futaba is calmer and protects her family from a distance. She is almost always the one that can easily put Kyoichiro back in his place and does that often when he tries to do something to [Taiyo](https://anilist.co/character/162723/Taiyou-Asano).

169991.description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy
~!__Blooming:__  Assimilate!~
The cheerfully mischievous fifth child of the family, who can craft hyperrealistic disguises.

169992.description: A spy who mainly targets those she falls in love with, setting her sights on Taiyo once he begins to make a name for himself. She eventually settles for working as the Yozakura family's maid after falling in love with Mutsumi as well.

169993.description: The Yozakura family dog. He's a ferocious little thing.

169994.description: A police detective associated with the Yozakura family. He helps cover up the family's actions in exchange for their cooperation in his investigations. He's a middle school classmate of Kyoichiro.

169995.description: The president of Popoppo, a global toy company that is secretly is a criminal consulting firm. One of Mutsumi's stalkers.

169996.description: The Yozakuras' grandmother and Taiyo's grandmother-in-law. She's the eighth head of the Yozakura family prior to Mutsumi's mother.

169997.description: The former patriarch of the Yozakura family and the husband of its eighth head, Keiko Yozakura. His ability to infiltrate any facility and escape any restraint is only rivaled by his inability to keep his intel to himself and his love for flirting with younger women.

169998.description: An elite spy working for the government's Hinagiku division. He looks down on Taiyo's inexperience and strength, becoming a rival in the process.

169999.description: An elite spy working for the Japanese government's elite Hinagiku division and Sui's cheerful partner.

170000.description: The general manager of the Hinagiku and Sui's boss. She's an elite spy and Kyoichiro's long-time equal and rival, and like him she also possesses an intense fondness for Mutsumi.

170001.description: The underworld's most infamous playboy and the ranked third on "Fellow Spy I Want To Kill The Most". He will flirt with anyone, male, female, young or old. For better or worse, Taiyo is his latest crush.

170003.description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy (Gold Rank)
~!__Blooming:__  Destroy!~

The constantly jittery third child of the family, specialized in firearms. He often hides in a trash can.

Shinzo is a scaredy-cat, and he also has a rather low self-esteem despite his strength when serious. Shinzo always has one of his guns on him, even when he was a child. Without his weapons of choice, Shinzo seems useless and cowards in fear and distress. He gives off a different, more serious vibe as if he is focused on something important when armed. However, despite these weaknesses, Shinzo wants to live up to the expectations others set up for him and will try his hardest with every task.

170191.description:
A girl who lost her father and her right arm due to a Gadoll attack when she was a child. She dreams of joining the Kanochikara and fight the Gadoll as a warrior, but reality bites, and ends up working under [Kaburagi](https://anilist.co/character/170192/) as an armor repairer.

Cheerful, energetic, and reckless.

(Source: Official Site)

170192.description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6'2 ft)
__Race:__ Cyborg

__Human Avatar__
Kaburagi is a middle aged man sporting greying black hair, which he slicks back, and facial hair on his chin. He wears a tucked-in wide necked short-sleeved shirt (with the sleeves tucked up and buttoned) with two buttons on the front. He wears olive wide pants and are tucked into brown boots. He has a black belt tied and a leather bracelet on his wrist.

__Cyborg Form__
In his cyborg form, Kaburagi is very short and cylindrical. He has a rectangular faceplate, and a brown and mint-green color scheme. He wears a red jet pack on his back. He also has brown spikes coming off his head, giving the appearance of spikey hair. 

Kaburagi is a  veteran Deca-dence armor repairer with a blunt and surly manner. He was once a great warrior but lost the ardor to fight and spends his days supervising a team on maintenance duties. He follows the cyborg Hugin's orders and spends his nights eliminating "bugs" by removing their chips. His apathetic state of mind changes through his encounter with Natsume who is determined to become a fighter.
Kaburagi is quiet and cold when you first meet him, but is very kind-hearted and caring underneath. He is impulsive and does not often make plans, preferring to jump right into the action. He has a strong moral compass, and often makes the right choice guided by a gut feeling.
Kaburagi is very protective of Natsume, and eventually of all the Tankers, and is determined to fight for them no matter the cost.

name.native: アリスリーゼ・ルゥ・ネビュリス9世

170214.description:
Aliceliese is a calm person and a kind heart to which she uses mostly to protect her family legacy. While she comes off as a cold fighter when she's on the battlefield, Aliceliese isn't much different from a normal girl her age. She enjoys going to the opera (having cried during one play), and is a fan of art and can be very talkative at times.

Being a teenage girl, Alice has some interest in the opposite sex. Not having many males her age around her, she expresses most of this interest in [Iska](https://anilist.co/character/170215/Iska) when they're not on the battlefield. She even treats their rivalry as something similar to a relationship, as [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/180987/Vispose-Rin) compared the way she was planning for their final battle to planning for a wedding.

170215.description:
Iska is the main protagonist of the series. He is the current wielder of the Astral Swords and is determined to end what he considers a pointless war. 

He was the youngest Saint Disciple to ever receive the title; but after releasing a "witch" from captivity, he was stripped of his rank and imprisoned for life. Circumstances around the war against the Nebulis Sovereignty have led to his release, but his goals haven't changed. 

Iska has a moral code that doesn’t discriminate, even if a supposed enemy is at hand. He shows kindness and bravery, despite putting himself at risk, and even willing to risk committing treason for them. On the battlefield, Iska becomes very fierce yet also calm, not being afraid of whatever power his opponent has or taking dangerous gambles to protect himself from their attacks. However, Iska usually avoids cutting down most opponents when he doesn't see any value in doing so, simply knocking them out. This has led Iska to be known as a 'peace-loving war nut'.

(Source: KimiSen Wiki)

alternative: Chainsaw no Akuma (チェンソーの悪魔)

170266.description: Pochita appears to be a small red canine with a chainsaw like appendage protruding from the center of his head. Handles emerge from his body allowing him to be wielded like a chainsaw and his short tail is in the shape of a chainsaw's pull cord. Unlike most devils, Pochita communicated solely through barks and whines like an actual dog.

170329.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")
__Occupation:__ Caretaker
__Affiliation:__ Anti-Demon Corps (7th Unit)
__Family:__ [Aoba Wakura](https://anilist.co/character/170333/Aoba-Wakura) (sister)

Caretaker of the Anti-Demon Corps 7th Unit. He attended Kaminoge High School as a third-year student but after getting caught up in a Mato Disaster, he was rescued by [Kyouka Uzen](https://anilist.co/character/162524) and became her Slave, granting him the power to fight alongside her.

Due to being a male, he could not become an official member of the Demon Corps since men can't receive special powers after consuming Peaches and has instead became the caretaker of the 7th unit, lending his support to his comrades both in and out of combat.

170330.description: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") __Peach Ability:__ Imperial Liberation, "Paradigm Shift" __Affiliation:__ Anti-Demon Corps (7th Unit)

170331.description: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") __Peach Ability:__ "Crazy Sheep" __Affiliation:__ Anti-Demon Corps (6th Unit)

170335.description: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 159 cm (5'3") __Peach Ability:__ Noble Aspirations, "Learning" __Affiliation:__ Anti-Demon Corps (7th Unit Vice-Chief) __Family:__ [Tobera Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/266761/Tobera-Azuma) (grandmother), [Fubuki Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/192784/Fubuki-Azuma) (mother), [Yachiho Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/170337/Yachiho-Azuma) (sister), [Maia Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/266758/Maia-Azuma) (sister), [Homare Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/266760/Homare-Azuma) (sister-in-law), [Yumina Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/266763/Yumina-Azuma) (sister-in-law)

170336.description: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 145 cm (4'9") __Peach Ability:__ Sure To Find, "Promise" __Occupation:__ Scout __Affiliation:__ Anti-Demon Corps (7th Unit)

170483.description:
Kisaki is the principal antagonist of Tokyo Revengers. He's especially known for rising to the top of the Toman at full speed. 

Kisaki is a ruthless, cunning, and ambitious individual who will stop at nothing to achieve his goals. Although average in stature, his power to rule with fear makes even those stronger than he obey him. The entirety of his actions in the entire story revolves around becoming the most powerful and influential criminal in Tokyo.

~! He is also known for organizing the murder of Hinata Tachibana many times. !~ ~!He is later ran over and killed by a truck after a long chase!~

170487.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Unknown
__Occupation:__ Shinobi
__Affiliation:__ Iwagakure

Shija is an elite shinobi assassin from Iwagakure. After the shogun came to Iwagakure for assistance in retrieving the Elixir of Life from Kotaku, having become impatient with the first group, Shija, and a squad of Iwa ninja, was assigned to the second team to complete the mission and supposedly provide support to the first team.

~! In actuality, the Iwa ninjas' true mission is to kill [Gabimaru](https://anilist.co/character/137260/Gabimaru) and take back the alias of __Gabimaru the Hollow__. Shija is also the next chosen Iwagakure shinobi to potentially succeed the current holder of the alias. !~

While working on missions, Shija has the complete mindset of a shinobi and only speaks when it is necessary. As a shinobi, Shija views themselves as a pawn for their master and only prioritizes on the orders they have been given on a mission no matter what the situation was. To this extent, they also hold no sense of concern for their ninja allies since they too follow the same belief.

~! Shija has a long history with Gabimaru and has respect and a deep infatuation towards him, admiring his skills in ruthlessly killing his targets. Whenever they met or even have a mere thought about Gabimaru would cause Shija to break out in an excited love-struck behavior. Despite them respecting Gabimaru a lot, their love for him can be seen as being a twisted, borderline obsession. They think of themselves as Gabimaru's supporter and was driven to commit horrendously violent acts from the shadows for his sake in the past. In terms of loyalty between Iwagakure and Gabimaru, Shija has been pointed out by the latter to be an unpredictable individual that can either chose to give in to their feelings and become his ally or put the village's orders first and serve as his enemy. !~

When they were young, Shija and their brothers underwent intense ninja training, along with many other children. While they managed to endure the gruesome training, Shija was left as the only surviving sibling and one of the few children to survive the screening.

170488.description: A member of Lord Tensen and a partial ruler of Kotaku. Gui Fa maintains a complete deadpan demeanor and is known to be extremely shy around others, as they prefer to cover their face with a book at all times to avoid making eye contact.

171150.description: Murata is a member of the Demon Slayer Corps.

171619.description: A famous hero who saved the world from monsters. He is accidentally killed at the start of the series.

name.native: アンリ・ヘイズワース

171620.description: Anri is one of the companions of the Hero. She is a necromancer. After the Hero's death, Anri transfers Touka's consciousness into the Hero's body so Touka can continue the Hero's work.

171621.description:
Touka is the main character in the Yuusha ga Shinda! manga. He's a farmer from Cheza village, the same as his childhood friend, Yuna Yunis. Touka has a thigh fetish and loves putting kneesocks on vegetables he harvests to engage his fantasies. Touka's simple life changes when a demon attacks his village. Touka digs a pitfall trap and baits it with cooked bacon in order to kill the demon and protect the village. However, the demon dislikes bacon so it continues to destroy the village until the Hero arrives and defeats it. The hungry Hero is lured into the pitfall trap by Touka's bacon and falls to his death.

To avoid blame for the Hero's death, Touka convinces the villagers to bury him in secret and pretend the Hero is missing. Touka believes his plan has worked until he wakes up the next morning in the Hero's body. One of the Hero's companions, a necromancer, has transferred his consciousness into the Hero's dead body and captured his original body so that he'll be forced to take up the role of the Hero. Unfortunately for Touka, this does not stop the decay of the Hero's body and Touka ends up walking around as a skeleton.

171622.description: Yuna Eunice is from Cheza Village and she is Touka's childhood friend. She has a crush on the Hero and she considers Touka a pervert.

name.native: エセル　ボーグナイン

171623.description:
Ethel's first appearance is in front of Hell's Gate in chapter 1. She's an infamous bandit and master trap maker. She's 29 years old.

~!Ethel "trained" Touka in the art of trap making and survival tactics following the end of the war between the Allard Kingdon and Farom when demons terrorized the Northern continent (3 1/2 years prior to the main story line). As a result, Touka refers to her as his teacher or master.!~

~!Ethel aligns herself with the necromancers seemingly aiming for a similar goal, though she still helps Touka's group when possible.!~

~!She seems to be attached to Touka and often wonders how he's doing when they're separated.!~

171624.description: The mayor of Moalan. He begins his mayoral career focused on fortune, but later comes to love the people of his town... and kneesocks,

171625.description: One of the strongest four warriors in the kingdom.

171626.description: Kyle is one of the companions of the hero. After the hero's death he attempts to take his place as hero.

name.native: リーランド・トールマン

171628.description: Director of the orphanage located at the royal capital.

171759.description: She is the devil summoned by [Alto Goldfield](https://anilist.co/character/171760) from a book that she was imprisoned in centuries ago.

name.native: アルト・ゴールドフィルド

171760.description: Alto is the male protagonist of the Kinsou no Vermeil series. He is the one who summoned the most powerful devil of all time, [Vermeil](https://anilist.co/character/171759).

171836.description:
**Height:** 162 cm (5'4")

An ordinary office worker who finds herself in the body of the protagonist of her favorite otome game, Revolution. She aims to become a couple with her favorite character, [Claire François](https://anilist.co/character/149900/Claire-Franois).

Rae deliberately plays herself up as being a foolishly happy-go-lucky girl who is obsessed with gaining Claire's affection. However, in reality, this is more of a coping mechanism brought about by her early experiences with exploring her sexuality. She is actually far less open with her true feelings, often bottling them up and covering it with humor.

172024.description:
Hina is a girl with fair skin, pale blue eyes, and soft long purple hair. She wears a full-sleeved church habit, a white veil with attached navy blue wimple on her head, a blue border lined white vest scarf tied with a yellow ribbon bow on her neck, a large brown belt on her waist, and brown boots.

Once she awakens as a god with precognition to find that the world will be ending, she finds a boy as her companion with whom she wants to spend for the rest of her life with.

~!It is later slowly revealed, that she is in fact, not a god, but a girl who should have died due to a rare hereditary disease called "Logos Syndrome", but due to some almost miraculous circumstance, recovers from it.!~~!Later on, it is then revealed, that her godly powers actually stem from a chip sized supercomputer implanted in her head, which not only compensates for the Logos Syndrome, but allows her to predict the future. This chip is deemed to dangerous to exist in the world and the "Higher ups" authorize the removal of the chip.!~

172074.description:
__Height:__ 182 cm (5'11")

Renji Yomo is a worker at Anteiku and the right hand of [Yoshimura](https://anilist.co/character/136024/Yoshimura). He is an old friend of [Uta](https://anilist.co/character/88414/Uta) and [Itori](https://anilist.co/character/88415/Itori). Because of his scavenging habits and long-beaked, avian mask, he has the nickname of "Raven."

172075.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Affiliation:__ Easton Magic Academy
__Occupation:__ Student

Lance Crown is a student at Easton Magic Academy known for being ranked the first in the entrance exams and having two marks.

When Lance was younger he is shown to be a very caring person who was willing to protect people who were being mistreated by other people even if the repercussions are him getting into fights. Lance is very protective of his sister where he vows to become a Divine Visionary so he can save his sister from being taken by the Bureau of Magic.

~! After a fight with Mash, he later approaches Mash and Finn to reconcile. Now he acts as the brains of their group of misfits. !~

172080.description:
__Circle Tier Level:__ 7 (Sage)

Sage of Wisdom Zod Exarion is the Master of the Tower of Magic and the one and only Seventh-Circle magician in existence. He was known as the greatest mage in the world, the man who had singled-handily revived interest in magic. He also was one of the 100 people who fought against Bhromier Napolitan and one of the six who survived the battle.

name.native: アンドレ・ブンブーン

172166.description:
Andre Boom Boom is a minor antagonist from Part VII: Steel Ball Run and part of the Boom Boom Family.

Andre appears as a boy in his early twenties and his most peculiar physical character are the freckles that cover his face. He has the odd abilities to make his nostrils flat and put his whole ear in his ear hole.

Just like the other members of the family, Andre does not seem completely sane, but he shows a little more intelligence than his younger brother.

172168.description:
Dot Han is a Mongolian competitor in the Steel Ball Run. A descendant of Genghis Khan, Dot Han is renowned for being an Equestrian master and is deemed one of the race's favorites.

(Source: JoJo's Bizzare Encyclopedia Wikia)

name.native: ウルムド・アブドゥル

172169.description:
Urmd Avdol is the alternate universe counterpart of the original universe's Muhammad Avdol.

Coming from Egypt, Urmd was said to have crossed the Sahara desert three times annually. Unlike the other contestants in the race, Urmd's choice of transportation was a camel, which made him a prime candidate for winning the race. Due to the camel's long legs, it had the ability to keep up with a horse's speed, but at the same time crush any other racers with its 800 kg body.

(Source: JoJo Wiki)

name.native: ニコラス・ジョースター

172174.description:
Nicholas Joestar is a minor character featured in Steel Ball Run.

Nicholas is the elder brother of Johnny Joestar by five years and the son of George Joestar.

(Source: JoJo's Bizzare Encyclopedia Wikia)

172175.description: L.A. Boom Boom is a minor antagonist in Steel Ball Run and the youngest member of the Boom Boom Family along with his father [Benjamin](https://anilist.co/character/172184/Boom-Boom-Benjamin) and his older brother [Andre](https://anilist.co/character/172166/Boom-Boom-Andre).

172181.description:
Norisuke Higashikata is a minor character in Part VII: Steel Ball Run.

Norisuke is a mysterious Japanese competitor in the Steel Ball Run race.

(Source: JJBA Wikia)

name.native: ベンジャミン・ブンブーン

172184.description: Benjamin Boom Boom is a minor antagonist from Part VII: Steel Ball Run and the leader of the Boomboom Family and father of [L. A.](https://anilist.co/character/172175/Boom-Boom-L-A) and [Andre](https://anilist.co/character/172166/Boom-Boom-Andre). He is one of the racers of the Steel Ball Run and one of the first Stand Users to be featured in Part VII.

172523.description: Saki Hananoi is a popular highschool student and Hinase Hotaru's boyfriend.

172715.description:
Madoka Takatori is Chihiro's uncle and takes him in after his mother's passing.

He's an extremely skilled costume designer, known for often turning down prospective clients. As such, he designs costumes not only for Chihiro and Miyako but the idol unit Uchouten Boys too. He seems to be quite skilled at baking, but often leaves the kitchen in a disastrous state when he's done. He is scared of dogs but often picks up stray and abandoned cats despite being allergic. 

Madoka has an almost stereotypically elegant appearance, with slightly grown-out blonde hair and blue eyes, which is often contrasted by his slovenliness and stranger fear. All of this makes it difficult for people to figure out that Madoka and Chihiro are relatives.

172721.description:
Damocles is the father of Tohru and is known as the Emperor of Demise and is considered one of the strongest dragons shown.
Damocles is callous and stern, hating humans and viewing them as inferior and evil - a belief he tried to impart on Tohru. However, unlike other Chaos Dragons, he respects the non-interference laws preventing dragons from killing humans of Earth, although when angered, he attacks Kobayashi and threatens to leave her at the brink of death. Despite this, he cares for his daughter and is concerned for her safety and happiness.

172743.description:
__Species:__ Cursed Spirit

Hanami is an antagonist intent on ridding the Earth of Humans and reviving [Sukuna](https://anilist.co/character/133701/Sukuna).

172744.description:
__Height:__ 175cm

Thorfinn, better known by his nickname Bug-Eyes, is a trader working with [Leif Erikson](https://anilist.co/character/19486/). A former slave, Bug-Eyes was bought by Leif under the false assumption that he was [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138/), son of Thors.

172887.description: The Future Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of the future. ~!After seeing [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa)'s future, it made a contract with him, so he can see that future himself.!~

173331.description:
__Height:__ 163 - 166 cm (5'4"- 5'5")

He lacks almost any kind of presence, so people often overlook him. An exception to this is [Nagisa Kubo](https://anilist.co/character/164986/Kubo-Nagisa), who is able to find him easily.

173574.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

He seems lazy but easy-going, complains, is actually meticulous, and has a heart far beyond others. Sometimes he even makes some "shameless" behaviours to achieve his own goals, so he is nicknamed "Don't Shake Bilian", a Chinese Slang for Shameless but he himself doesn't care and accepts it happily. He has a changeable personality and seems to be a contradictory individual. He has tried his best to trace Feng Baobao's life and protect her. He once said in his heart that it doesn't matter whether others like him or not. As long as he likes Sister Baoer, it's enough. He is a person who has more rational elements than emotional elements.

173758.description:
__Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 1

Rentarou is an extremely kind and thoughtful person who loves all of his many girlfriends very dearly, often to a scarily self-sacrificing degree.  

Before he began his days as a high school student, Rentarou had been rejected a total of 100 times. Following a rejection from his friend on the day of his junior high graduation, he goes to a matchmaking shrine and prays to the shrine's god, wishing for a happy high school life by getting a girlfriend. In response, the Love God appears before Rentarou, telling him that he will meet his "soulmate" in high school, and that they will fall in love at first sight.
