He then reveals that Rentarou has 100 of such soulmates, and that should he ever meet one, he must make them his girlfriend and make them happy, or else they will die.

173759.description:
__Type:__ Deredere
__Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 1

**Girlfriend No. 001**

Hakari is described as a "clumsily calculative" lady. She is often planning and plotting to achieve her goals which may or may not go as planned due to her clumsiness. She is prim and proper on the outside while inside she is just as much of a degenerate, if not more so, than the other members of the Hanazono family. She also teases [Inda Karane](https://anilist.co/character/173760) a lot, often leaving her embarrassed or pissed.

173760.description:
__Type:__ Tsundere
__Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 1

**Girlfriend No. 002**

Karane is known for being straightforward and honest about how she feels about a given situation except for two subjects: her feminine figure (or supposed lack of) and her deep love for [Aijou Rentarou](https://anilist.co/character/173758/Aijou-Rentarou). Her desperate attempts to hide how she feels about a given situation despite her honest nature often make people think she is going to strike them.

173761.description:
__Type:__ Dandere
__Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 3

**Girlfriend No. 003**

Shizuka is rather timid especially given her rather quiet or mute voice which makes her rather distant from other people. However, ever since she met [Rentarou](https://anilist.co/character/173758/Aijou-Rentarou) she has become braver, even willing to sacrifice her own safety to help [Hakari](https://anilist.co/character/173759/Hanazono-Hakari) out. She is also the most modest of Rentarou's girlfriends as she refused to peep on him when he was taking a bath and even tried to stop them from doing so.

173762.description:
__Type:__ Kuudere
__Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 6

**Girlfriend No. 004**

Nano is practical to a fault, obsessed with solving a problem in the most efficient way possible no matter what.

Nano is the smartest among the girls. In her school exam, she gets the perfect score (700/700), which is better than the scores of genius-level characters in other manga. Nano has memorized hundreds of digits of Pi, which she sometimes uses to calm herself down. Due to her extreme intelligence and efficiency, in most difficult situations Nano is the first to come up with solutions. However, her solutions are sometimes brutal due to her lack of social experience.

173771.description:
A mysterious man labelled as the "Genius of Killing". With his favourite gun, Night Hawk, in his hands, he's a hitman that can take down any enemy in a single shot. His origins and real name are both unknown.

Seems to very much love watching the comedian, Jackal Tomioka.

173777.description: An inspector at the Los Angeles Police Department.

174133.description:
The Commander in Chief of Deca-dence. Calm, composed, and cerebral, he is irreplaceable in the fight against the Gadoll, as he is in charge of game plan building to emergency decision making. He has known [Kaburagi](https://anilist.co/character/170192/) for a long time, and still worries about him, despite Kaburagi having retired from the battlefield.

(Source: Official Site, edited)

174190.description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'8")
__Occupation:__ Middle School Student (Second Year)

Yamada Anna is the main heroine of the story and is the classmate and love interest of [Ichikawa Kyoutarou](https://anilist.co/character/174191/Kyoutarou-Ichikawa). She is also an airhead who is pretty and very immature besides her looks.

She is a magazine model and actress. She is very popular with both boys and girls but has a clumsy side to her. Anna frequently snacks in the library, much to Kyoutarou's dismay. She is also shown to be very jealous to the point of obsession whenever Kyoutarou interacts with other girls.

174191.description:
__Height:__ 156.5 cm (5'2")
__Occupation:__ Middle School Student (Second Year)
__Twitter:__ https://twitter.com/thanatos_moros

Ichikawa is the protagonist of the story Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu and a classmate of  [Yamada Anna](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada). He at the beginning of the manga is a gloomy, antisocial, sadistic boy and eager to kill his classmates, but in reality he is a kind boy with an incredibly low self-esteem, reaching the point where he believes that the people feel disgusted with the simple fact of being by his side, but the only person who does not think that of him is Yamada.

~!He later becomes the love interest of Anna Yamada.!~

174231.description:
Takashi's friends who acts like a cool biker. He became a magician and gained destruction magic.

Kazumi Ida is one of Takeshi's friends who is a wannabe biker so he pretends to be a bully around others. Soon after Takeshi was accidentally turned into a magician, Kazumi was revealed that he is one also (after he came on contact Hotaru's magic). He has a distinct trait of talking with an Osaka dialect.
Kazumi bullies others to make the impression of a typical "superior delinquent student." It is also shown that he has sister complex.


~!Kazumi Ida and Takashi Nanase appear to be on good terms, and are good friends. Ida was mainly grateful torwards Takeshi, for saving his younger sister from an older man with bad intentions, and always owed him one. This was evident in Episode 04 when Ida urged Takeshi to save Mui Aiba instead of himself who was trapped in a large sum of ice which was going to suffocate and kill him. They work together in fights, and don't seem to quarrel or argue at all.!~

(Source: Wikia)

174232.description:
Mui's older brother whose memories were erased by the Ghost Trailer and who is now chasing Mui.


~! later captured and past memories were restored. Join's in to fight the ghost trailers. !~

174233.description: Kippei Washizu a high ranking member of Ghost Trailer, second only to Kazuma who is also a close friend.

174234.description:
Momoka Shijou is a Magician and a member of the Magician Community, Wizard Brace. She is the Head Mistress and Academy Director of Subaru Magic Academy.

(Source: Wikia)

174235.description:
He is Takeshi's younger brother and also among those people who are insanely obsessed with Isoshima, So obsessed that when he learned about Takeshi's relationship with her, he became very mad and engaged him in a fight where he got caught in an unexpected accident that led him to despise Takeshi to the point of wanting to kill him.

He later on enrolls in the same school Takeshi transferred to.

name.native: ヴァイオレット・ノース

174236.description:
She is Subaru Magic Academy's English teacher, she was later revealed to be part of the Ghost Trailer. Her alias is V which is derived from the first letter of her name.



~! She was also the fortune teller at the school's love fortune telling event that tricked Mui Aiba to go to The Ruined World to look for her brother. However, she was disguised with a robe over her face. !~

174263.description:
__Devil Contract:__ [Fox Devil](https://anilist.co/character/290671/Kitsune-no-Akuma)

A Public Safety Devil Hunter, he is a new recruit working under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. He is partnered with [Kobeni Higashiyama](https://anilist.co/character/144594/Kobeni-Higashiyama).

Hirokazu is shown to have high moral standards and cares a lot about his teammates and their wellbeing, going out of his way to assist and support others whenever possible, especially towards those who are sick. He was trained by [Himeno](https://anilist.co/character/144596) for half a year. Himeno has stated that what he lacks in ability, he makes up for in drive. He likes writing haikus in his free time as a hobby.

alternative: Paakaa no Onna (パーカーの女)

174264.description:
__Devil Contract:__ [Snake Devil](https://anilist.co/character/174269/Hebi-no-Akuma)

An enigmatic former Private Detective Hunter, she pledged her allegiance with the [Gun Devil](https://anilist.co/character/208942/Juu-no-Akuma) after making a contract with him and as a result, she seeks to obtain [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji)'s heart for her master. To that end, she conspires with members of the yakuzas, including the likes of [Katana Man](https://anilist.co/character/157241/Samurai-Sword), while acting as a weapons dealer for them in order to obtain Denji's heart easier.

174368.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Finn Ames is a first-year student at Easton Magic Academy and member of Adler dorm. He is the younger brother of [Rayne Ames](https://anilist.co/character/202422). Finn is Mash's roommate and his first and best friend.

174369.description:
__Affiliation:__ Easton Magic Academy
__Occupation:__ Student

Dot Barrett is a first-year student at Easton Magic Academy and one of the main characters of the Mashle series.

Dot is hot-blooded and obnoxious, however, deep down, he's a nice guy and will apologize if he's wrong about something. He also is shown to fall in love easily.

174594.description: Eve Reese is a demon from the black-winged tribe who is their candidate to become a demon lord. Her objective is to kill the incumbent Demon Lord Hakuou for trying to exterminate her brethren.

174648.description: She is the school's bicycle club manager. Though she doesn't race, she is very knowledgeable about bicycles because her brother, who happens to be a former bicycle club member, owns a bike shop, and she helps out repairing and assembling bicycles.

174746.description:
Shizuka Kitaumekawa is the wife of Daichi Kitaumekawa and the mother of Minori Kitaumekawa. Shizuka is the dutiful housewife of Daichi. She only sees her husband in a positive light ~!and is oblivious to his dark and obsessive side. This is shown evident when Daichi is arrested after being reported for taking advantage of his students and Shizuka looks on in shock with Minori.!~

(Source: Happy Sugar Life Wiki)

174749.description:
The husband of Kaori Komiya and the father of Nonoka Komiya.

(Source: Sora no Method Wiki)

174754.description:
The wife of Shuuichi Komiya and the mother of Nonoka Komiya who died from an illness.

(Source: Sora no Method Wiki)

174777.description: 9'δ is a Parasite who served in the 9's, a special forces unit that APE directly controls. She is partners with [9'ε](https://anilist.co/character/180884/9-Epsilon) and pilots a FRANXX called the 9 Model.

174778.description: 9'β was a Parasite who served in the 9's, a special forces unit that APE directly controls. He was partnered with 9'η and piloted a FRANXX called 9 Model.

174801.description:
__Place of Birth:__ Rim Billiton
__Race:__ Cautus/Chimera
__Height:__ 142 cm

The public face of Rhodes Island and its top executive. Although Amiya appears to be a young and inexperienced girl, she is universally trusted and highly qualified for her position. Amiya now leads Rhodes Island in fighting for the future of the Infected and striving to exorcise the dark shadow of Originium from the land.

~!Amiya is the current holder of Civilight Eterna making her the successor of the previous "King of Sarkaz", [Theresa](https://anilist.co/character/300731/Theresa) who died in an assassination during the previous Sarkaz Civil War. She is also believed to be the "Lord of Fiends" a prophesized legend who will bring the apocalypse and the end of Terra.!~

174872.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm

Raiden Shuga is the vice captain of Spearhead Squadron. As a First Lieutenant, he holds the position of operations commander of the Eighty-Sixth Strike Package and its 1st Armored Division should [Shin](https://anilist.co/character/141060/Nouzen-Shinei) be deemed unfit to command. His Personal Name is Wehrwolf. Having survived four years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, he is considered one of the most elite Processors alive. As he spent three years with Shin prior to joining Spearhead Squadron, Raiden is the closest person to him in the squadron.

174873.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Kurena Kukumila is a platoon leader of Eighty-Sixth Strike Package's Spearhead Squadron. She is the squadron's long-range specialist. Her Personal Name is Gunslinger. Having survived four years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, she is considered one of the most elite Processors alive.

174874.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm 

Theoto Rikka is a platoon leader of the Eighty-Sixth Strike Package's Spearhead Squadron and the artist of the squadron member's Personal Marks. His Personal Name is Laughing Fox. Having survived four years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, he is considered one of the most elite Processors alive.

175114.description: She is a teacher from the middle school that [Nasa](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki) had frequented. She is always super busy with work and doesn't have much time for her life. However, once she sees how happy [Nasa](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki)'s marriage is, she becomes more open to future relationships. She considers herself a boring person.

175149.description:
__Height:__ 175cm-184cm

Yuni Kuroba is a first-year student at Seiin High School and a member of the boys' volleyball team who serves as an outside hitter and their ace

Yuni is a semi-cheerful boy. He becomes passionate about volleyball, wanting to be the ace of the team. According to his cousin, he gets too cocky when he gets complimented

Yuni and Hajima used to be childhood friends before Hajima moved away to Tokyo. During middle school, Hajima moves back and reunites with Yuni.

175150.description:
A first-year student at Seiin High School. He serves as a setter for the boys' volleyball club, and is referred to as the "Genius Setter" due to his remarkable skills. Kimichika often comes off as cold and emotionally distant, but has shown a softer side around people he cares about, such as Yuni Kuroba. He shows a great love for volleyball, and is incredibly driven, focused and determined to bring any team he plays on to victory. However, the brutal honesty he uses when critiquing his teammates and his short temper that flares whenever he is frustrated has caused tension with other players throughout the years. Despite this tension, and the incidents that were caused because of it, Kimichika has stated that he doesn't regret the things he says.

Until kindergarten, Kimichika lived with his parents in Suzumu City, Fukui Prefecture, which was next to the town of Monshiro. Because his mother was in and out of the hospital due to her illness, he was often left at his maternal grandparents' house in Monshiro. His grandfather used to bring him to Yuni Kuroba's grandfather's house to play shogi, and the two boys became friends from there. After his mother's death, his father took him to live in Tokyo. In middle school, he attended the volleyball powerhouse school, Meisei Academy.

175151.description:
__Birthday:__ December 5
__Height:__ 193cm

Misao Aoki is a third-year student at Seiin High School. He serves as the vice-captain of the boys' volleyball team, and he is also the vice president of the school's student council.

175152.description:
__Height:__ 163cm

Oda Shinichiro is a third-year student at Seiin High School. He serves as the captain of the boys' volleyball team and one of their outside hitters.

175153.description: Yusuke Okuma is a second-year student of Seiin High School. He serves as a middle blocker on the boys' volleyball team. A former member of the rugby team, he was invited to the volleyball team by the vice-captain, Misao Aoki.

175154.description:
Akito Kannp is a second-year student at Seiin High School. He serves as an opposite hitter for the boys' volleyball club, and is always seen wearing long sleeves due to his sensitivity to the sun.

He seems to be quiet, shy, kind of gloomy and kind of always looking down.

name.native: クラリオーサ・ダオラ・フォルトーゼ
alternative: Clariossa Daora Schweiger Meltsfen Foa Forthorthe

175509.description: Clariossa Daora Forthorthe, better known as Clan, is the Second Princess of the Forthorthe Galactic Empire. She is a part of the Schweiger family which is rivals with the Mastir family. While [Theiamillis Gre Forthorthe](https://anilist.co/character/88077/Gre-Fortorthe-Theiamillis) is more active, Clan spent her time with intellectual pursuits. This contrast in personalities, as well as their family rivalries has caused her to be Theia's greatest rival.

175510.description:
Maki Aika is a magical girl, much like [Yurika](https://anilist.co/character/88075/Nijino-Yurika). However, she is part of "Darkness Rainbow", an extremist organisation whose motives are as of yet unknown. She is Yurika's rival/arch-nemesis.

~!She later befriends [Koutarou Satomi](https://anilist.co/character/88073/Satomi-Koutarou) after he saves her life and eventually leaves Darkness Rainbow to join his group and eventually his band of knights as treasurer.!~

175599.description:
The President of the Student Council.

~!She has a history between Mari and Meiko and is hell-bent on getting revenge against them.!~

175675.description: He was born with a curse, but gradually gets rid of it. He's extremely good-natured and very positive about himself.

175746.description:
__Height:__ 154 cm

Utena is a shy and introverted girl who longingly admires magical girls, collects their memorabilia, and talks passionately about them. Her obsession with Tres Magia even reached to the point where she wished to fight alongside them, but that ultimately led to her being tricked by [Venalita](https://anilist.co/character/301180). At times, she can be simple-minded.

176265.description:
Leon’s “little sister” who supports him. They are not related by blood but she thinks of him as a real older brother. She does her best to look after Leon, who is useless when it comes to anything except research. She’s cheerful and unafraid of anything or anyone, a really energetic girl. 

(Source: Honey's Anime)

176266.description:
An exiled genius scientist and one of the main people who caused the Shouryuu Crisis. After the incident, he lives in a wasteland outside of Neo Shouryuu with Chloe, who he promised to become family with. He’s generally quiet and useless, but becomes talkative when it comes to his research or food. 

(Source: Honey's Anime)

name.native: ケイン・イブラヒーム・ハサン

176754.description:
Frieren is the protagonist of _Sousou no Frieren_ and [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965)'s master. She was the Mage of the Hero Party and traveled alongside Hero [Himmel](https://anilist.co/character/184311/Himmel), Warrior [Eisen](https://anilist.co/character/184312/Eisen), and Priest [Heiter](https://anilist.co/character/184310/Heiter) in a 10-year journey to defeat the Demon King. 

She was a magic prodigy at a young age, with an impressive quantity of mana, which caught the interest of [Flamme](https://anilist.co/character/219733/Flamme), a human wizard who taught her everything there is to know about magic and mana control until she passed away. Frieren persists in collecting magic knowledge no matter how trivial it may be.

176886.description: Tsuyu is the spirit of a plum tree who lived with Tenjin for 1,000 years. She is not a shinki, but rather stayed with Tenjin out of a lasting love.

177010.description:
__Occupation:__ Witch

Sheila is a character introduced in the [Majo no Tabitabi](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series.

Sheila has long blonde hair tied back in a ponytail and green eyes. She wears a white jacket with a navy blue interior over a brown dress shirt, brown pants, and brown shoes.

177271.description:
The leader of the revolutionary army against the Shield Hero.

~!He was in Itsuki's party. However, when the Spirit Turtle was revived, he and the rest of the party abandoned Itsuki and ran away.!~

177453.description: Mikari is a first-year student who is [Okumura](https://anilist.co/character/169256/Masamune-Okumura)'s childhood friend and [Ririsa](https://anilist.co/character/169257/Ririsa-Amano)'s classmate. A gorgeous and popular model, she has had a crush on Okumura since they were young, though he has never noticed.

177581.description: Man who wants a more adventurous life.

177606.description: A taxi driver who appears in episode 8.

179173.description: Houjou is one of the first employees Usa meets at his summer part time job. Going by the name Yamamoto at work, he appears to have assumed the "apprentice" character rather seriously and uses lyrical, explanatory notations to emphasize his words.

179174.description: Kurokawa is also one of the first employees Usa meets at his summer part time job. Going by the name Saionji, he often speaks of guardian spirits which greatly reminds Usa of Hayashi.

179177.description: Sayaka's classmate back in middle school.

179178.description: Sumiko's friend and Usa's employer at his summer part-time job.

179179.description:
An elementary school student who becomes attached to the Kawai Dormitory residents after Shirosaki found her wallet during a temporary falling out with her friends. She can be quite frank with her observations and can be unsparing when she speaks her mind. She has a fondness for pudding and, in Shirosaki's point of view, has the makings of a sadist.

(Source: Wikipedia)

179362.description: Kinji Ninomiya is a young man overflowing with extreme overconfidence. Right when he thought he was set to live a cushy NEET lifestyle, he was swept off to another world.

179365.description: A witch and childhood friend of [Zain](https://anilist.co/character/179366/Zain).

179366.description: A wizard and childhood friend of [Caph](https://anilist.co/character/179365/Cuff).

179809.description: A deaf college student who seeks to learn about the outside world through [Itsuomi](https://anilist.co/character/179810/Nagi-Itsuomi).

179810.description:
Yuki's university senior and a member of the International Club/Circle. 
He knows 3 languages: German, English and Japanese. He also likes journeys around the world and communicating with children.
In the future he wants to be a teacher that teaches about countries and cultures.

179958.description:
__Height:__ 167cm

Cheapskate, well-informed, and super perverted. He has been friends with Naoya Nifuji since kindergarten.

name.native: アイリスディーナ・ベルンハルト

179966.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5' 8")
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken)
__Rank:__ Captain
__TSF:__ MiG-21PF Balalaika

Commander of the ‘East Germany’s Strongest’, the 666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken, and [Jürgen Bernhard](https://anilist.co/character/261257/Bernhard-Jrgen)'s beloved younger sister. The Captain made her name known and infamous during Operation Palaiologos, became known as a hero during the Poland retreat, and later gained fame across Europe with her Schwarzesmarken squadron. 

Her command and development of the 666th make her one of the few capable of carrying out Laserjagd, typically considered "suicide" missions in strategic doctrine Jürgen created and Irisdina perfected, taking it to new heights.

Growing up, the kind-hearted Iris was virtually unmatched as the top student, until she met [Beatrix Brehme](https://anilist.co/character/179971/Brehme-Beatrix). The two became best friends, national level synchronized divers and later the top 2 graduates at the TSF academy, and remain connected in many ways as East Germany’s best pilots.

name.native: リィズ・ホーエンシュタイン

179967.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5' 3")
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken)
__Rank:__ Leutnant (2nd Lt.)
__TSF:__ MiG-21 Balalaika

Theodor Eberbach's step-sister, Lise Hohenstein was thought to have been killed by the Stasi 3 years ago when their family attempted to defect to West Germany and were all captured or killed. Now assigned to the 666th TSF Squadron as reinforcement to make up for an injured pilot after years as a TSF pilot in Eastern Europe, Lise finally found her cherished brother after three years of searching.

Lise Hohenstein grew up with parents and playwrights Thomas and Marlene in Prenzlauer Berg, Berlin. Like those two, Lise wanted to work in theater to bring smiles and dreams to people in a world she considered dark. A talented actress, her career looked like a sure thing until police pressure forced her circle to be disbanded. Like her parents, she staged plays viewed as anti-nationalist and became ostracized for it.

name.native: カティア・ヴァルトハイム
alternative: Ursula Strachwitz (ウルスラ・シュトラハヴィッツ)

179968.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5' 1")
__Nationality:__ German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (666th Schwarzesmarken), German Bundeswehr (101st Battalion)
__Rank:__ Leutnant (2nd Lt.)
__TSF:__ F-4 Phantom, MiG-21 Balalaika

A surface pilot in the Bundeswehr, Katia was rescued by the 666th TSF Squadron after the rest of her unit was destroyed. When she applies to defect to the East and asks to join the 666th, Irisdina recommends her as a replacement pilot. 

Katia believes that as long as East and West Germany continue hating each other, they'll never be able to win. Viewed as overly idealistic by others, Katia will stand up for what she believes even if others are too afraid to stand beside her, to the point others consider her a danger to be around in a country where the Stasi operate. 

Though she has little experience as a TSF pilot, she possesses natural talent and instinct, which are things that cannot be taught, which is why people view her as a potential ace pilot. 

~!Katia is East German, born as Ursula Strachwitz, named after the saint. She lived in Berlin and was the daughter of Alfred Strachwitz, the legendary war hero turned dissident leader. Before his persecution, he sent her to West Germany under a different name to live with his old friends from Hamburg, where his will would manifest in her as the idealistic girl who tries to befriend everyone and join the hands of all that fight.!~

name.native: ハインツ・アクスマン

179969.description:
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Ministerium für Staatssicherheit
__Rank:__ Oberstleutnant (Lt. Colonel)

The Stasi’s Chief of Operations, Axmann made a name for himself within the organization hunting asylum seekers at East Germany's border, where he captured, imprisoned or executed thousands. 

The Brown Beast's effectiveness, cruelty and sadism in his persecution of dissidents and spies were legendary even by Stasi standards, leading to his prominence within the organization. Axmann's endless pursuit of power and security for himself and the Stasi influenced the significance of the Stasi Armed TSF Force, and the widening of networks of intel and blackmail spanning across Europe, making him hundreds of enemies both outside and inside the Stasi.

180091.description: He is one of the five members and the leader of the new rendition of 'Shounen Hollywood'. Before becoming a member of the group he used to be a delinquent, who dropped out of high school. Despite his former delinquent past he is far from stern and bad-natured. Ikuma likes to laze around and is quite the funny guy. Furthermore he has a hard time learning the dances the group is supposed to learn. He is greatly obsessed with 'Cat' (Hollywood Tokyo Theater's own pet owl) and wants to carry him on his shoulders at least once. His life motto is 'Rome wasn't built in a day'.

180092.description:
Kakeru is a hard-working boy who is a little awkward at times. He's also appears to not care much about girls, also saying that "They don't really look at him", which is in fact false, unbeknownst to him.

He is always thinking, thus spacing out often. He is not very assertive and goes with flow. He seems to have low self-confidence.

180093.description:
One of the members of Shounen Hollywood. He can be really stubborn and likes to make fun of the other members.
He likes to make fun of other people, but he has got a short temper when people start making fun about him. Although he might look a bit lazy he takes being an idol seriously.
He has a big pride and he loves to sing. He becomes stoic and knowledgeable when it comes to music.
(Source: Wikia)

180094.description: Kira is the youngest member of 'Shounen Hollywood' and a former child star. He has been going to auditions and castings starting from a very young age but despite loving the music and acting industry he's having a hard time finding himself. So he decides to take matter into his own hands so his acting won't be 'boring' anymore.

180095.description: Tomii is very passionate about the original 'Shounen Hollywood'. His big inspiration is Minoru Tomii, whom he shares a name with and who is one of the original Shounen Hollywood members. Both of them also grew up at the same orphanage called 'Yamabiko Friends'. Tomii is very easy-going, friendly, cheerful and passionate. Therefore the kids at the orphanage really look up to him. He wants to make the members' dreams come true.

180101.description: The strange, rather random head of Tokyo Hollywood theater.

name.native: ヘンリー・ヘンダーソン

180190.description:
__Affiliation:__ Eden Academy
__Occupation:__ History Teacher, Housemaster of Cecile Hall

Henry is a mature and noble person, who places a high importance on "elegance". To him, elegance seems to be the way a person conducts themselves, and is not afraid to correct inelegant behavior in others.

180245.description: Boss lady of the Tori Clan. Currently employed in a supermarket to maintain income after the loss of her husband, the former Tori Clan leader

180248.description: Urita is a door-to-door salesman who sells fishy products.

name.native: エリアリア・ジャミール

180258.description:
Heir to the Jamil dukedom, Eliaria is an 11-year-old girl who becomes Ryoma's close friend. Like Ryoma, she is a monster tamer and her body is gifted with large magic potential, but has difficulty controlling it, until Ryoma teaches her how to train herself properly.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name.native: ラインハルト・ジャミール

180260.description:
The Duke of Jamil and Eliaria's father, he meets Ryoma in the forest and becomes his friend, later inviting him to live with his family.

(Source: Wikipedia)

180262.description:
The goddess of healing and love.

(Source: Wikipedia)

180263.description:
A female cat beastman and rank B adventurer, she becomes Ryoma's first client after he becomes an adventurer when he is tasked to clean her house, later becoming his friend.

(Source: Wikipedia)

180264.description: Ryoma's co-worker during his previous life.

name.native: エリーゼ・ジャミール
ラインバッハ・ジャミール

180301.description:
Hughes' son, a man in his twenties, he also becomes Tigre's ally along his father. He is very fast making calculations, Gerard takes care of the logistics at the Silver Meteor Army, effectively distributing food, money and weapons in the times of need. Unlike his father, he is a rather sarcastic person and often gets in arguments with Rurick. He constantly tests Tigre to see if he really is worth following, even if his father will punish him severely for it. After the Civil War he becomes Secretary of the Royal Court, being tasked with supervising the progress of the construction of an important road that will connect Brune and Zhcted as part of the peace agreement.
(Source: Wikipedia)

180302.description: Brune's royal Prime Minister. Friend of Mashas. Also poised to be in a three-way standoff with Ganelon and Thenardier over the treatment of Tigre and Alsace.

name.native: ファーロン＝ソレイユ＝ルイ＝ブランヴィル＝ド＝シャルル

180303.description: King of Brune, Faron was a just a benevolent ruler, until the apparent death of his only daughter, Princess Regin, which caused him to breakdown mentally and suffer an illness that began afflicting his body and rendering him unable to keep Ganelon and Thenardier in check. It is later revealed he was poisoned by Ganelon's minions to (if not the initial cause) keep him mindbroken and ill while killing him extremely slowly. After the civil war ends, he is reunited with his daughter and formally recognizes her as a member of the Royal Family and his heir. He also congratulates Tigre and his friends for saving her and ending Thenardier and Ganelon's plans. With his dying breath, Faron gives Tigre the title of Knight of the Moonlight, a title that, in ancient times, was only given to a hero who became the next king of Brune, although only Badowin knows of the true meaning of the title.

180304.description: General of the vanguard of the invading Muozinel army. He was once a slave but because his talent was recognized, he was freed. In order to provoke the Silver Meteor Army, Kashim ordered the beheading of 10 male slaves and threatened to do the same to the women unless they surrendered. His arrogance is what caused his death, as he failed to realize he had fallen into an enemy's trap. He was shot and killed instantly by Tigre with a well aimed arrow to the face.

180305.description: Was chosen by Faron Bastien do Charles to serve him as his knight.

180419.description:
A beautiful fair-skinned woman who is a magazine reporter. She has a close relationship with Souhei, so she knows about his dislike of red beans and calls him "Souhei-kun."

She is the younger sister of [Souhei Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/89076/Souhei-Saikawa)

180420.description:
A student at N University who works in Souhei's lab. He is in charge of planning the seminar trip, and finds himself camping on Himaka island, where the Magata Research Institute is located.
(Source: Wikipedia)

180421.description: A security guard at the Magata Research Institute. His hobby is playing the marimba.

180423.description:
An architecture student at N University. She assists Souhei Saikawa with his accounts. Since she has an androgynous look and also has a very straightforward way of speaking, the other students are afraid of her.
(Source: Wikipedia)

180425.description:
Shiki's younger sister. She lives with a relative in America.

~!She is actually the real Shiki Magata, who doesn't have any sister.!~

180427.description: An employee at the Magata Research Institute who is one of the few who has been at the institute since its establishment.

180428.description: A security guard at the Magata Research Institute.

180429.description: Moe's uncle who works in police. Deeply cares about her.

180430.description: An employee at the Magata Research Institute. She is a programmer.

180431.description:
The head of the Magata Research Institute. He is Shiki's uncle. His hobby is to fly helicopters.
(Source: Wikipedia)

180432.description:
Seiji's wife. She knew Shiki in her early childhood. Her speciality is making sweets.
(Source: Wikipedia)

180433.description: A butler who has served the Nishinosono family for many years. He looks after Moe's everyday needs.

180435.description: The assistant head of the Magata Research Institute.

180436.description: The resident doctor at the Magata Research Institute.

name.native: ジョージ・ジョースター

180500.description:
George is the father of [Johnny Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/19492/Johnny-Joestar) and [Nicholas Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/172174/Nicholas-Joestar), the former with whom he maintains a difficult relationship. He is a horse breeder by trade. 

(Source: JoJo Wiki)

180692.description:
__Height:__ 181 cm

Kafka Hibino, also known as Monster #8, is a Defense Force member and a former worker for the Professional Kaiju Cleaning Company "Monster Sweeper Inc.". Kafka's personality is a bit childish and funny, as well as a very determined and dedicated person who loves his comrades dearly.

After a kaijuu managed to enter his body, he obtained the ability to turn himself into a humanoid kaijuu.

180694.description: He briefly worked at Monster Sweeper Inc, where he met and befriended [Kafka Hibino](https://anilist.co/character/180692/Hibino-Kafka). After witnessing Kafka's transformation, Reno helped him enter the Defense Force and joined with him. ~!He was a member of the Third Division and after destruction of Tachikawa Base he was transferred to the Fourth Division.!~

180881.description:
**Age:** More than 60 million years

He is the chairman of the APE council and by extension all of known humanity. Like a leader, Shuseki speaks in a refined and sophisticated manner, and tends to handle situations in a methodical order.

180885.description:
**Age:** Over 60 million

He is a member of the Seven Sages of APE and is secretly a VIRM.

180985.description:
Mismis is a supporting character in KimiSen. She is the captain of the 907th unit belonging to Iska's squad. She can be seen as a cute yet highly supportive teammate since her fighting skills are subpar to the other characters in her squad. Even though that she isn't highly smart with combat, she is usually the morale booster of their team, and gives everyone the emotional support that they need. She was formerly a human until she was sucked into the vortex where she got exposed. Her power included nullifying every astral mage's to use their abilities whenever she uses hers.

Being  the oldest person in their group, she acts and looks childish as she contains many stuff animals and cute dresses in her room. She also considers herself to be a girl rather than a woman and doesn't like it people call her a child.

180986.description:
Jhin is part of the 907th unit and serves as a sniper. He is shown to be a calm and collected individual, along with being the smartest among them. He usually makes sarcastic remarks, often making a witty remark, but he tends to care a lot for his comrades in his squad.

~!Jhin was selected by Crosswell to find the successor of the sword. Due to the reason that Jhin was good in range, Crosswell awsn't able to teach him other than the gun theory since Crosswell's specialty was being a swordsman. It means that Jhin would have to work hard with perseverance if he wants to learn how to wield the strongest swords that Crosswell wanted to find a successor. Ultimately, it was then that Iska and Jhin knew each other and became best friends.!~

180988.description: Nene is a supporting character of the anime KimiSen. Along with Jhin, Iska and Mismis, they make up the members of the 907th unit with her specialty being able to graph coordinates of her target to a machine and releasing out projectiles to her enemies. She is a cheerful and high spirited girl that will help her teammates even if they go into such troubles, such as when Mismis became an Astral Mage after being exposed to a spirit vortex. She usually sees Iska as her brother and has a close relationship with her squad. Her weapons includes an anti-astral power grenade that disrupts the use of astral powers in a defined range, and has a ring that can indicate the position of her target.

181143.description: He kidnapped [Syalis](https://anilist.co/character/129563/Kaymin-Aurora-Suya-Rhys) in her sleep, so he has hardly ever seen her awake and has never had a proper conversation with her. He is always thinking of ways to make the hero get to him and gets worried if he is going to lose, he even puts weapons and tools to make the hero's quest easier. Apart from that he is a good leader for the demons of the castle, but even he can't go against Princess Syalis, and is shown to care for her to a certain point.

181262.description:
She is a first-year high school student when first introduced—a quiet girl who wears her long hair tied back. 

Her avatar is a blonde woman with shoulder-length hair and sunglasses; she feels somewhat self-conscious about the appearance, as it looks like a cool Hollywood actress. Having accompanied her parents on bouldering trips since childhood, she possesses impressive climbing ability even without relying on skills.

181335.description:
Bug-Eaten is a brown rat approximately 20 cm long. It possesses a strange protuberance on the forehead as well as an abnormally large nose. Its right ear has been chewed out in a fight, earning it its nickname.

(Source JoJo Wiki)

181350.description: An immortal who has lived for over a thousand years, he owns the spirit realm wherein the town resides. During hard times, Laojun travels around and takes refugees with him to live under his shelter, giving them the freedom to stay or leave as they wish. He currently lives in seclusion on top of Laojun Mountain after taking a vow to neither leave his pavilion for a hundred years, nor interfere with any external affairs. He still has about 60-70 years left of this vow.

181440.description:
Kaio Middle School Go club president and former insei who did not become a professional. He played Akira in a game, and had to resign early and admitted he was outclassed and right not to pursue professional play. Later he plays a match against Hikaru to gauge his strength, and defeats him easily. His dismissive attitude to Hikaru's plan to rise to Akira's level while playing in the school club spurs Hikaru on to register as an insei. His liking for black coffee allows Hikaru to realize that he is the failed insei that the other insei are discussing shortly after Hikaru becomes an insei.
(Source: Wikipedia)

181577.description: Miharu Kashiwagi is a nurse working in Little Garden and is in charge of taking care of Karen Kisaragi.

name.native: ジュダル・ハーヴェイ

181780.description: Shōji Satō is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student and a resident of Polar Star Dormitory.

181782.description: Daigo Aoki is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student and a resident of Polar Star Dormitory.

181867.description: Jin Tae-Jin (Kor: 진태진) is Jin Mo-Ri's adoptive grandfather and the sole master of Renewal Taekwondo.

181964.description: Head of the Kudou family. Kiyoka is looked upon as cold or standoffish by others, including his many past prospective fiancés. This is due to his understanding of others' motives.

181965.description:
Eldest daughter of the Saimori family. Her mother died when she was young. She is ungifted
~!Later it was revealed that she is actually gifted, her gift was sealed away by her mother before her death. She has the gift of Dream-Sight!~

182020.description: Hoshizaki Rika, also known as her alternate name Mirika, is a popular virtual content creator on MeTube, and is persistently pursuing over [Naoya's](https://anilist.co/character/162887/Mukai-Naoya) affection for her. She is a first year high school student who attends the same school as [Saki Saki](https://anilist.co/character/162886/Saki-Saki) and Naoya.

name.native: ルサルカ・エヴァレス

182101.description:
__Height: __166 cm

Rusalka acts in a calm and professional manner.

182540.description:
__Occupation:__ High school student

After her prediction of End of the World, [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/172024/) chooses him as her companion to spend and see the end of the world. They met each other nearby a basketball court in a park.

182543.description: Kyouko was once a mischievous, spirited, naughty little girl. However, her mother's death caused her to develop a meek, mild, and introverted personality. Ever since middle school, boys of her age consider her to be beautiful, including [Youta](https://anilist.co/character/182540/).

182565.description:
Sakurako is Shun's childhood friend who has known he was gay since high school. Through an arranged marriage, she was also Shun's fiancée until he came out to his parents during the wedding ceremony. Despite this, Sakurako is still in love with him.

~!In Harukaze no Étranger, A few years after Shun and Mio move into the main house, She ends up cutting her hair, claiming that she feels like a bunch of weight has come off her shoulders.!~ ~!It's also said that The adopted son of the Hashimoto household, [Fumi](https://anilist.co/character/185464/Fumi-Hashimoto), has a crush on her because of the kindness she gave him!~

182729.description:
__Age:__ ~!>13,000!~

Almost nothing is known about the Doctor's background and past, other than that they had a doctorate in neurology and had extensively researched Oripathy prior to the events of the story. Like Kal'tsit, their file number starts with 'B', implying a connection to Babel, the predecessor of Rhodes Island.

Currently suffering from amnesia, the Doctor was rescued by Amiya from Chernobog when Talulah led the Reunion insurgence against the Ursus empire.

~!Doctor belongs to an extinct race called "First Civilization", a space-faring civilization who colonized Terra, bringing with them animals who later evolves into the Ancients and Elders.!~

name.native: ハーリーン・クインゼル
alternative: Harley Quinn (ハーレイ・クイン)

182935.description: Gotham City’s Mistress of Mayhem. A former psychiatrist and The Joker’s love interest who possesses exceptional agility and a sharp intellect. Her wild and unpredictable behavior wreaks havoc wherever she goes.

182983.description:
Sung-Jin Oh is the chairman of the Ohsung group and has affiliations with Nox. He attempted to obtain Bong-Seon from Yu Mi-Ra legally through marriage for Nox.

(Source: The God of High School Wiki)

name.native: エルダリエ・イルマ・ファノメネル

183417.description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

Sayo is a calm and composed person, part of which is attributed to her being a shrine maiden. As shown in the flashback leading to her making the decision to become Magia Azul, she is also a brave person who does not hesitate to help others.

Due to being restrained and tormented by Schiavo multiple times, Sayo began to develop masochistic tendencies. Her masochism and obsession with "fighting" with Enormeeta has gone to the point where she shows envy when [Magenta](https://anilist.co/character/191857/Hanabishi-Haruka) or [Sulfur](https://anilist.co/character/191859/Tenkawa-Kaoruko) get the chance to fight them but she does not, as seen when she glares enviously and drools after seeing Magenta without her panties after the latter fought [Nero Alice](https://anilist.co/character/191858/Morino-Korisu).

183792.description: He has come to the Western Continent to kill any and all Oni that he encounters. He travels with a dog and a Oni named Millia.

183884.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

[Ai Hoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) daughter, and the younger twin sister of [Aquamarine Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183885). 

~!She was previously a patient named Sarina under Goro's care. Due to her illness, she was wheelchair-bound. After discovering B-Komachi, she had always aspired to be an idol although her condition kept her from achieving her dream. Since being reincarnated as Ruby, she is now working towards her dream of being an idol like Ai. To do so she's currently working with Strawberry Productions to revive B-Komachi along with Arima Kana and Memcho.!~

183885.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7")

[Ai Hoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) son. He is the twin big brother of [Ruby Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183884/Ruby-Hoshino).

~!He was previously a doctor named Goro, who became a fan of Ai through his patient named Sarina.!~ 

~!After reincarnating as Aquamarine and witnessing Ai's murder, he is intent on plotting revenge to the person who schemed Ai's death.!~

183889.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

She is the young daughter of Defense Force Director General [Isao Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/257340) and a member of the Third Division. After Tachikawa Base was destroyed, Kikoru was transferred to the First Division.

183929.description: Ready to enforce justice no matter the common sense with her indomitable spirit, Kahabell's actions reflect that of a truly fanatical knight. She is also known to be rather sadistic as she enjoys the sensation of cutting the flesh of living things.

183965.description: Fern is the young mage apprentice of [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) and accompanies her as a member of her party. She is an orphaned war refugee originally from the Southern Lands, later adopted by  [Heiter](https://anilist.co/character/184310/Heiter) and placed under Frieren's care.

name.native: ルマキーナ・ウエスエリア

184003.description: **Lumachina Weselia** is the High priest of the church of the divine beings. She is introduced being hunted down by Paladin Gewalt for assassination because she dared investigate complaints of fraud, corruption, and other unpleasantness from the Church Of Divine Beings.

184067.description:
A figure skater from South Korea, Seung Gil is a stoic and calculating young man. He is generally emotionless, even during his programs, and only thinks about ice skating and improving his skills. Due to his handsome looks, he's very popular, especially with women, but pays no attention to his fans and often treats other people in a cold, detached manner.

(Source: Wikipedia)

184100.description: The CEO of Ogiwara Foods Corporation and the older brother of [Sayu Ogiwara](https://anilist.co/character/127925/).

184211.description: A salary man who writes mystery novels during his free time.

184310.description: A priest who is a part of the Hero's party. He later took care of [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965/Fern) until [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) arrived.

184311.description: Hero and Leader of the party that defeated the Demon King, and a self-proclaimed handsome narcissist. He cares about his friends and can't help but help those in need. He had a great influence on [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren), with whom he had adventures for 10 years.

184313.description: Stark is a warrior who fights alongside [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) and [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965/Fern). After his village was attacked by demons, he fled and became [Eisen](https://anilist.co/character/184312/Eisen)'s apprentice. At Eisen's instruction, he joined Frieren's party as their vanguard.

184367.description:
Seo Han-Ryang (서한량, Seohanlyang) was a member of The Six. He was the 27th leader of the National Homeless Association prior to giving that title to Yu Mi-Ra. He is an advanced weapons expert, capable of using 108 National Treasures.

(Source: God of High School wiki)

184559.description: The librarian at the library that Tsuneo and Josee visit together.

184560.description: Mai Ninomiya is Tsuneo's underclassman at the same diving shop where he works part-time.

184561.description: Tsuneo's friend who shares the same part-time job and age as him.

184770.description: He works at the same store as Yuuki and Sayu, and is someone from Sayu's past.

184812.description:
**Height:** 166 cm

She's one of Shikimori's friends. She is a cheerful and energetic gymnast. She has a friendly personality. She watches over [Shikimori](https://anilist.co/character/155702)'s relationship with [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/155701).

184813.description:
**Height:** 148 cm

She's one of [Shikimori](https://anilist.co/character/155702)'s friends. She has a tendency to melt when overworked. She has an expressionless, slow-paced, and elusive personality, but she pays close attention to her surroundings. She is an indoor girl who is not good at sports.

184814.description: He's part of the group of friends surrounding [Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/155701) and [Shikimori](https://anilist.co/character/155702). He is honest, easy-going, and likes to have fun. He likes to play, but he is also a serious boy who studies hard.

185791.description: Eri is a woman who previously lived with Shun and his grandmother in Okinawa before moving out to live with her girlfriend, Suzu.

185792.description: Shun's grandmother. He stays at her place.

185999.description:
__Race:__ Human, Dragon
__Type:__ Dragonclad
__Affiliation:__ Wing Bind

A human who became a Dragonclad after living with Selvie for 10 years and being bitten by him. He is currently looked after by Noel Niihashi and Ninny Spangcole.

186046.description:
__Race:__ Dragon
__Type:__ Disguiser/Dark Dragon
__Owner:__ [Balgo Parks](https://anilist.co/character/185999/Balgo-Ywain-Parks)

A Dragon masquerading as Balgo Parks's pet dog in London. In his dog form, Osushi is a small Pomeranian with light-colored fur and dark paws. In his Dark Dragon form, Osushi is a large, black dragon with a light underbelly, four thick legs and two enormous wings. He is heavily scaled and possesses many sharp teeth.

name.native: プライド・ロイヤル・アイビー
ブルーノ・バングナイフ

186410.description: The leader of the Inks division of Wing Bind.

name.native: アイヴィス・ネクロン

186471.description: One of the Seven Elder Demon Emperors created by Anos, as well as the head of the Necron family.

186472.description: Right hand of Demon King [Anos Voldigoad](https://anilist.co/character/138595) and the most powerful swordsman among the demons.

name.native: エウゴ・ラ・ラヴィアズ

186474.description: **Eugo La Raviaz** is the Guardian God of Time, and has the appearance of the traditional Grim Reaper, wearing a long black cloak while wielding a scythe.

name.native: レイ・グランズドリィ

186477.description:
Lay Glanzudlii is a member of the Generation of Chaos, commonly known as "The Demon Sword Saint" and a transfer student at Demon King Academy. 

~!He is the reincarnation of the Hero Kanon.!~

187175.description: Bishop is an agent of V Shipping Company who teams up with Yuliy to find the Sirius Arc.

187229.description:
__Age:__ Unknown
__Birthday:__ Unknown
__Affiliation:__ Kawashita Medical Office, TANPOPO
__Occupation:__ Doctor, Spy

Makoto is a doctor and member of the organization TANPOPO.

187524.description:
__Birthplace:__ Osaka
__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")

Tabito Karasu is a contender in the Blue Lock Project. ~!He played as a central midfielder for France’s Paris X Gen during the Neo Egoist League. When first introduced, he was ranked #3 during the Third Selection and later played as a defensive midfielder for the Blue Lock Eleven in their match against Japan’s U-20 team.!~

187526.description: The Joker is a master criminal with a clown-like appearance, and is considered one of the most infamous criminals within Gotham City.

187774.description:
Otoko Hotaruzuka is the daughter of the owner of Copenhagen in Fuyuki.

Otoko went to highschool with [Taiga Fujimura](https://anilist.co/character/505/Fujimura-Taiga), keeping a close friendship since then. During the Fourth Holy Grail War, [Rider](https://anilist.co/character/16021/Iskandar) stole a barrel of wine from their bar meant for the Fujimura family, prompting Taiga to track down the culprit out of friendship. Five years before the Fifth Holy Grail War, [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou) came to start working for them. He took any job given to him, even including working while both she and her father were out sick.

187851.description: **Misa Ilioroagu** is Anos' classmate, and shows herself as skeptical about the current society in which pure-blooded demons are favored. ~!She is the spirit that was formed from the rumors and traditions of the fictional Demon King Avos Dilhevia!~ ~!She is the daughter of Great Spirit Reno and Spirit King Shin Regalia.!~

name.native: エレオノール・ビアンカ

187852.description:
Eleonore is a humanoid magic. She specializes in root magic and is able to create root clones (Zeshia & Diego). She harbours no ill feelings towards the demons and is considered a failure due to her lack of hatred towards the demons.
~!She later becomes Anos' magic.!~

name.native: オリヴィア・サーヴァント

187862.description:
__Race:__ Human+

Olivia is an S class adventurer who was arrested 200 years ago in a trap on the Unending Dungeon after defeating a monster in a room on the 2nd Floor. She was later found by [Noir](https://anilist.co/character/187865/Stardia-Noir) 200 years later, whom she chose to be her successor, and who she starts to instruct and advise. Olivia is energetic and powerful.

187863.description:
__Race:__ Human

A receptionist in the Odin Guild. Lola is the one whom Noir exclusively goes to, by contract, and she is also Luna's best friend.

187864.description:
__Race:__ Human

Daughter of a family of barons, [Noir](https://anilist.co/character/187865/Stardia-Noir)'s childhood friend. She is good at close quarters battles with daggers. She has a kind heart that treats everyone equally and she is very popular with the opposite sex. She likes Noir and enrolled with him into Hero Academy.

187865.description:
__Race:__ Human

He's the main character of the series. He's the son of a baronet, the lowest caste for a noble, and is [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/187864/Brightness-Emma)'s childhood friend. He lost his job but became an adventurer and wants to pass the exam to enter the Hero Academy. He gained a lot of new skills and abilities from [Olivia Servant](https://anilist.co/character/187862/Servant-Olivia), his master trapped in the Unending Dungeon. Noir is a good young man who is usually serious, but occasionally tends to be venomous. Because he looks like a good man and for being a baronet, Noir is often overlooked or disrespected by people who don't know his abilities or personality. He is cautious and timid, as he admits himself. He is also naive, and although he has been favored by several women, he is completely unaware.

187922.description: He is a junior high school student who is [Ramune](https://anilist.co/character/187923)'s disciple and works as an assistant. He has good judgment and motor skills, as well as a rational mind. It's hard to understand his mood due to having a poker face and is always having to play the straight man when Ramune says or does anything. Kuro trusts Ramune's skills as a specialist of mystery diseases completely.

187923.description: He is a doctor who specializes in treating patients with "mystery diseases," which are caused when something "strange" sneaks into the hearts of the weak-minded. He is a foul-mouthed physician who is rude to most and very rarely understands the atmosphere around him. However, he is a very skilled doctor who can quickly identify the root cause of any illness. But because he always puts his patient first, he tries not to treat them too harshly.

188170.description:
He is the commander of the Knights of the Third Order. He is nicknamed the "Ice Knight" for his frigid demeanor. He became an ally of Sei Takanashi after she saved him from a mortal wound.

~!He proposed to Sei and is currently engaged to her.!~

name.native: ヨハン・ヴァルデック

188171.description: He is the director of a medicinal plants institute and the second son of Count Valdec.

188172.description: He is the grand magus of the Royal Magi Assembly. His only interest is in research related to magic and magical powers. He looks cheerful and passionate on the outside, but on the inside, he is a completely different man.

188173.description:
Sei Takanashi is an office lady in her twenties who was summoned by the Saint Summoning Ritual. Her saintly powers enhance her abilities by fifty percent, due to her appearance she was not crowned as Saint. Accidentally making scenes with her research, she is on the verge of being found out as the saint. But after seeing her abilities she was finally been recognized as the Saint. She Likes to cook and make cosmetics in her spare time.

~!On Volume 8, she got engaged to Albert Hawke.!~

188174.description: He is a researcher at the same institute for medicinal plants as Johan Valdec and is responsible for teaching Sei Takanashi.

188211.description:
The master of the Adventurer's Guild's Gimuru branch.

(Source: Wikipedia)

188618.description: Youko Satou is the pseudonym for the getaway driver for the hitman known as Fable. She masquerades as Fable's sister as a part of the operation given to them by their boss.

188751.description: The Section Chief of the Health and Welfare Department. He is first introduced as a talking stuffed rabbit in episode 4 due to his extreme shyness. He sometimes falls prey, though, to the mood of his subordinates--and is either stomped on or has the fur plucked off of him like petals on a flower as a result. He is also an old friend of Hasebe's father.

188752.description: The daughter of Kenzou Momoi. People say that she resembles him. She is also friends with Touko Ichimiya.

188754.description: An old lady living in the ward who frequents the office to visit Miyoshi. She always talks about her daughter-in-law and has a grandson who happens to be Yutaka's childhood friend and rival. Although she tried to get Miyoshi to marry her grandson, she stops talking about him when she realizes that Miyoshi hates him.

188783.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

An actress who was called a prodigy child. She has a rather stubborn personality yet an empathic side to her. She easily succumbs to pressure and while she does put up a front to others, she has very self-deprecating thoughts when it comes to her abilities. She's an honest and earnest person, who is very diligent and persistent even in the roughest of times. Also, she tends to place all responsibility on herself when it comes to others as she is the one who has the most experience in the show business world. She also hates bell peppers.
  
~!After the events of the Sweet Today Drama adaptation, she secretly develops a crush for [Aquamarine](https://anilist.co/character/183885/Hoshino-Aquamarine).!~

~!She longs for someone to look at her for who she is now and praise her efforts, someone to say that its okay for her to be here. And after the new B-Komachi's first concert, that person becomes Aquamarine after he waves her respected colored glow stick. Only reinforcing Kana's resolve to make Aquamarine fall for her.!~

188942.description:
Wang Ling is a cultivation genius who reaches a new realm every two years since he was one year old, Wang Ling has an almost invincible existence with strength far beyond his control.

Wang Ling is a non-talkative individual who‘s obsessed with being average and not standing out. He tries to avoid troublesome matters yet he still manages to get involved and has also secretly saved the world on numerous accounts. He also lives for and loves his crispy noodles. 

He's a genius who has a vast amount of knowledge ranging from simple things to complex concepts such as multiple cultivation systems, techniques, various theories be them resolved or not, space-time and laws. He is calm and collected and most of the time his actions have a plan behind them even if they a lot of time get in weird situations.

189230.description: She met Wang Ling on the meet-and-greet for new students at No. 60 High School.

189232.description: A former demon king who was defeated by a 10-year old Wang Ling six years ago. Not wanting to draw attention, Wang Ling gave the credit to Odd Zhou. It was fused with a dog spirit to become a Green-coloured Akita, and now resides with the Wang Family

189237.description:
He is the current principal of Tokyo Metropolitan Jujutsu Technical High School, the creator of Panda, and the headmaster of Satoru Gojo, Suguru Geto and Shoko Ieiri.

~!After the Shibuya incident Yaga is given a death penalty by the higher ups for inciting Gojo and Geto in the past and "causing the Shibuya incident".!~

189238.description: An assistant manager at Tokyo Prefectural Jujutsu High School.

189404.description:
A nameless character. She instructs the main characters on rock climbing.

Appears in Episode 11 of Season 1.

190106.description: [Hana's](https://anilist.co/character/130665) younger brother, and a high-school junior.

190374.description:
__Height:__ 149 cm

She became a member of Enormeeta to beat up magical girls, because she hated that they got more attention than her on social media. Although Kiwi was initially hostile towards [Utena](https://anilist.co/character/175746), after undergoing shock training, she became docile and developed a crush on Utena. Now she is content with Utena's acknowledgement alone. Kiwi frequently fantasizes about going to a love hotel with Utena. Despite appearances she is decent enough academically to help Utena avoid her grades deteriorating.

She and [Magia Sulfur](https://anilist.co/character/191859) instinctively have it out for each other. They immediately devolve to insults and fighting at every opportunity — even in their civilian forms, despite not recognizing each other due to recognition inhibition.

190386.description:
He is [Nasa Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki)'s father and is married to [Kanoka Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/190388/Kanoka-Yuzaki). He originally taught in a big Tokyo university but then he moved to Nara where he is living with his wife right now.

(Source: Tonikaku Kawaii Wiki)

190388.description: She is [Nasa Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki)'s mother and is married to [Enishi Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/190386/Enishi-Yuzaki).

name.native: ハマモトさんのお父さん

190539.description: A meteorological researcher who has an interest in the sphere after reading his daughter's journal.

190836.description:
Light Novel Volume 14 Chapter 4 & Anime Episode 10 Spoilers: ~!It is revealed that Elaina's Mother is Victorica (ヴィクトリカ) aka Fran no Shishou (フランの師匠), [Fran](https://anilist.co/character/149042) and [Sheila](https://anilist.co/character/177010)'s teacher.
Her appearance is heavily similar to [Elaina](https://anilist.co/character/125736/Elaina). She wears a witch hat with a pink ribbon tied around it, a black jacket with pink collars and interior over a red vest. Furthermore, she wears long black socks and boots.
Sometime before the main story begins, she trained [Fran](https://anilist.co/character/149042/Fran) to become a witch.
(Source: Majo-no-tabitabi Wiki)!~ ~!She also uses the pen name Niké when writing her stories.!~

190905.description:
Sueharu's childhood friend. She also lives next door to Sueharu and is the eldest of the 4 sisters in her family.
~!She likes Sueharu and has a crush on him.!~

190906.description: A famous child actor who worked with Sueharu in the past.

190907.description: Sueharu Maru was originally a very famous child actor, and his mother was also one. However, his mother couldn't express emotions well, so she couldn't become very famous. She supported her son so he could become a fantastic actor for both her and his sake. He likes Shirokusa Kachi and he's a fan of her. Kuroha Shida is Sueharu's childhood friend.

190908.description: A child novelist who has received well-known awards at a very young age for her astounding works. She is Sueharu's first love interest.

191241.description:
__Sports Team:__ Basketball
__School:__ Eimei Junior and Senior High
__Year:__ High School Second-Year / Third-Year

A first-year high school student and the rising star of Elmei Junior and Senior High's girls' basketball team. Her personality and skills have made her incredibly popular both inside and outside of her school, to the point where she's been featured in various magazines. Chinatsu can be quite competitive, as she always arrives to Elmei's gymnasium in the morning for open practice even earlier than [Taiki Inomata](https://anilist.co/character/191242/Taiki-Inomata), whom she frequently shares the floor and sometimes plays one-on-one games with. 

The day after she completed her years as a junior high school student, Chinatsu tearfully practiced playing basketball, having barely failed to qualify for nationals. When Taiki reminds her both of said event and how hard she works, Chinatsu makes it her goal to go to nationals despite her family moving overseas. To get around this, she stays at Taiki's house due to their mothers being friends and former teammates. She gives Taiki a matching foot bracelet when she learns that he also plans to go to nationals.

In the _Ao no Hako_ one-shot, Chinatsu is the captain of her school's girls' basketball team.

191242.description:
__Sports Team:__ Badminton, Volleyball (one-shot)
__School:__ Eimei Junior and Senior High
__Year:__ Junior High Third-Year

A third-year middle school student and a member of Eimei Junior and Senior High's boys' badminton team. While not the most-talented player, Taiki is nonetheless extremely hardworking. He very routinely goes to Eimei's gymnasium for morning open practice, sharing the floor with his crush, [Chinatsu Kano](https://anilist.co/character/191241/Chinatsu-Kano). Taiki's strong work ethic is complemented by his optimistic view of things and his headstrong demeanor. His two friends, [Kyou Kasahara](https://anilist.co/character/218647/Kyo-Kasahara) and [Hina Chono](https://anilist.co/character/218648/Hina-Chono), notice that he likes to push himself beyond his own limits in order to achieve his goals, no matter how far away said goals are from him. Taiki also tends to gets ahead of himself in various situations, as his first few interactions with Chinatsu reveal.

Chinatsu is frequently shown to be an inspiration for Taiki, as seeing her do her best motivates him to work harder. He vows to go to nationals after learning that Chinatsu will stay at his house so that she can focus on doing the same.

In the _Ao no Hako_ oneshot, Taiki is instead a member of his school's boys' volleyball team.

191409.description:
__Team:__ Team C; 3rd Clear Team (formerly); Blue Lock 11 (Left Wing)
__Position:__ Forward; Winger

He is currently ranked #5 out of the original 300 forwards chosen to be apart of the Blue Lock Project ~!and is currently starting as a winger for the Blue Lock Eleven team against the Japan U-20.!~

Yukimiya is highly confident in his own abilities, declaring himself the strongest player in Japan, when it comes to one-on-one battles. He is also a likable and charismatic personality, appearing to make friends easily, like with Nagi. In addition to this, Yukimiya likes to make banter even with his opponents, indicating a playful element to his personality.

Yukimiya claims that he is a pacifist, which forms part of his ego, since he sees the easiest and most peaceful way to score would be to do so himself. He is also inquisitive, often being the first to ask questions of Ego, about his selection criteria.

191607.description:
Saenoyama Norihiro, born Hasegawa Norihiro, is a member of the Shibakiyama Stable.
Saenoyama is an extremely tall man easily towering over Ushio. He has long, black hair which, is kept tied up in a traditional knot. He is light skinned and is quite muscular.
He has a very powerful downward open hand punch and flexible legs. In the second sparring match against Hinomaru, he barely won against him after it was judge that his knee went down after Hinomaru's hand was was down.

191608.description:
Shutou Masaomi is a student from Tottori Hakurou High School and a member of its sumo club.
Shutou is a large, heavy light skinned man with brown hair. He has droopy black eyes, fat lips and a big nose. He wears Tottori Hakurou Sumo Club's typical mawashi which is dark blue with a single light green stripe on the left.
Despite his intimidating look, thanks to his large size, Shutou is incredibly shy. He's also very self-conscious due to him having a speaking disability - he stutters. While he also has a relatively strong temper, he reverts quickly to his real nature outside the ring, as when he apologized to Kei for hurting him, which led to the Oodachi wrestler to ask him for forgiveness as well.

191609.description:
__Height:__ 188 cm

A high school *yokozuna*, he bears the nickname of the National Treasure sword "Doujikiri Yasutsuna" and stands as one of the strongest rivals in the story's first arc.

He is the wrestler whom Hinomaru Ushio, looks up to. He has been a driving force in the world of amateur sumo nationwide—and, to some extent, even within the professional realm. It is no exaggeration to say that while the seeds sown by Yamato-kuni were nurtured by wrestlers like Hakuou and others, it was Tennoji and his peers who provided the essential support to sustain that growth.

However, his strength is not merely a product of natural talent; it is underpinned by his own hard work and sincerity. He is an avid sumo enthusiast—self-described as a "sumo geek"—and a data-driven strategist of extraordinary intensity; he thoroughly analyzes every wrestler who might conceivably face him, considering everything from their growth trajectory and abilities to various match scenarios in order to devise countermeasures. (He seems to believe nothing is impossible for him, and the fact that he actually manages to pull it off is staggering.) This approach underpins his "sumo that refuses to lose"—a style dedicated to defending his titles as both High School Yokozuna and Amateur Yokozuna. Even his younger sister, Saki, remarks that while his opponents may display perfect sumo technique, her brother's obsession with the sport is on another level entirely.

At the same time, he is adept at "sumo that goes for the win"—characterized by a relentless, surging offensive—a style he employed when challenging for those titles; he switches fluidly between these two modes of combat. Furthermore, he tailors his mental simulations to the specific caliber of his opponent, ensuring he is prepared for their level of skill—even if he acknowledges that his worst-case scenarios often turn out to be groundless worries. He also possesses remarkable schedule management skills, balancing his training with social obligations like nightlife and entertaining his *tachimachi* (patrons).

Moreover—as is true for the other characters—his personality is exemplary, defined by sincerity, gentlemanly conduct, and humility. He is a constant learner who instantly reflects on himself whenever something defies his predictions. Even when he is shaken (or briefly succumbs to a dark state of mind), he quickly regains his composure.

191610.description:
Araki Gennosuke is a first year student from Ishigami High School and a member of its sumo club. He is the unknown 5th member, as Tsuji didn't see him at Ishigami High.
Araki is a tall, buff, young man with light skin. He has gray eyes and black hair which is shaved with various lines running across the top and sides. His mawashi belt is beige in color.
He was a national judo champion during middle school. He met Kunisaki Chihiro, thinking Hinomru would be in the dojo, but he when he slept as he waited, Kunisaki Chihiro, who finished his remedial class due to poor grade, slapped him to wake him up. They proceeded to have a match with onlookers. Kunisaki managed to recover from his overhand judo throw, but he was unable to counter attack as the match was interrupted.
Before Araki left, he also expresses desire to become an MMA fighter, which he accused Kunisaki Chihiro of copying his career path.
It was revealed during the preliminary tournament that he was suspended due to delinquency.

191651.description:
The current head of the Kurahashi family and Onmyo Prep School. She is a known figure in the underworld of Onmyouji. The current Kurahashi Clan is considered one of most powerful noble families who's influence over the politics of Onmyoudo and Japan rivals that of once glorious Tsuchimikado family. A skilled Diviner, she helped the Onmyo Agency solve numerous extremely difficult cases. Miyo is also one of the few people who knew Yakou personally. She has a pet cat which uses as a messenger to relay information at long distances.

(Source:Wikipedia)

191657.description: He is a First-Class onmyouji and also a powerful Divine General nicknamed "Ogre Eater". He has a rude personality and does not care about other people. He has a scar on his forehead. He's an Independent Officer/Exorcist. Like Suzuka, Genji Kurahashi has placed a seal on him to lower his spiritual powers but the main source of his powers are from the oni he subdues.

191660.description: A powerful First-Class Onmyouji and a Divine General nicknamed "Fire Demon". He is an Exoticism Officer and Commander of Purification Rite Center. A burly but good natured person. He is considered one of the strongest of 12 Divine Generals due to his mastery of Acala's Fire Realm Mantra, the highest class of fire magic under the Common-Style magic system. He serves as Genji's confidant and has strong faith in him.

191672.description: Akari Watanabe is a Gyaru who was assigned to be [Jirou Yakuin's](https://anilist.co/character/191673) partner during the marriage practical, a special course to train students how to function in a real romantic relationship, despite her wanting to be partnered with [Minami Tenjin](https://anilist.co/character/273110/Minami-Tenjin), her true fool love. She hopes by training by acting as a perfect newlywed with Jirou, she can earn the two of them enough points to swap each other out for who they truly want to pursue. However, after spending more time with Jirou, she begins to second guess herself and how she truly feels.

191673.description:
__Relatives:__ Himari and Leo (Younger Cousins).

Jirou Yakuin is the main protagonist, being an antisocial, pessimistic high school boy. He ends up forced to pair with [Akari Watanabe](https://anilist.co/character/191672) in their school's "Couple Practical" course, despite harboring feelings for his childhood friend [Shiori Sakurazaka](https://anilist.co/character/273105). Because of his crush, he makes it his goal to find a way to pair up with Shiori instead, being willing to do anything to reach his goal even if it means acting as a newlywed with Akari. However, the more time he spends with Akari, the more conflicted he becomes with his true feelings.

191857.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

Haruka is an extremely energetic and compulsive girl, always smiling and acting on her feelings. She cares a lot about Sayo and Kaoruko, admiring their strength and skill as magical girls. However, she is extremely naïve and gullible and seems to lack intelligence and common sense as well. Despite all this, Haruka is an extremely caring girl who cares about her friends and will go through any trial to protect them. When reflecting on being controlled by Baiser, she felt shame and regret over attacking Sulfur and Azul.

191858.description:
__Height:__ 128 cm

Korisu is a quiet and reserved girl, and the youngest member of Enormeeta. She has a large collection of old toys that are precious to her.

Her theme is Alice in Wonderland.

191859.description:
__Height:__ 146 cm

Kaoroku puts on a calm and cool mask for the public, but in reality she is a crude, foulmouthed, and short-tempered girl. She is also the most intelligent and cunning member of Tres Magia. She is not hesitant to start conflict, and will goad and taunt others, whether as herself or as Magia Sulfur.

191914.description:
Amnesia is a character introduced in the [Wandering Witch](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. She is described as a mysterious girl who always lost her memories every time she sleeps.

(Source: Majo-no-tabitabi Wiki)

192024.description:
Judge S, whose real name is Moon Gi-Ju.

~!He was one of the Judges for the G.O.H Tournament. He is also a disciple of Seong Gi-Sa, a member of The Six who was defeated and hospitalized by Kim Du-Sik. He seems to have a closer connection with Park Mu-Bong as compared to other Judges.

Sometime after RagnarÖk he became the legal guardian of Dean Ockham and had him cured of his childhood illness. At some point he had a fight with Yu Mi-Ra who gravely injured him and took possession of Walmung. He is alive, albeit critical, being monitored and treated by doctors working for Park Mu-Bong.!~

(Source: The God of High School wiki)
