192197.description: He is Ayame's great grandchild from her previous life and the current owner of "Mysterious Wares Shop Akatsuki." He is very warm and kind and always smiling, so he's extremely popular with the neighborhood kids who call him the smiley man. He's known ramune ever since he was a child and they think of each other as brothers. Because of a certain condition, he's able to see his surroundings better than anyone else.

192198.description: She is the former owner of "Mysterious Wares Shop Akatsuki" who creates mysterious wares herself. She's currently only 9 years old, but she retained her memories of her past life where she lived to be 103 years old. She's great at taking care of people but she also likes to provoke people when she can. When she knows she can win a fight, she tends to do dangerous things.

192557.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (Debut); 180 cm (Chapter 1268)

Klein Moretti is the main protagonist of Lord of Mysteries. "He" is a Beyonder. "He" is the mysterious leader of the Tarot Club known as The Fool and a Transmigrator who comes from the modern era.

Klein Moretti has exhibited a cautious and good-natured personality. "He" is humorous, polite, mature, and gentlemanly. Fundamentally a lover of justice, "He" will not hesitate to do what is right even at a personal cost. As an ordinary citizen of Earth who transmigrated suddenly into a dangerous world, Klein was naturally a bit fearful and indecisive at first. But during the short span of time following "His" transmigration, Klein experienced a lot of dangerous or tragic situations. "He" even became the leader of a secret organization, killed numerous monsters (even some humans), and finally evolved into a Beyonder. Klein indeed became much more ruthless, confident, and mysterious compared to "His" former mentality. In fact, Klein Moretti became gradually incomparable from the Zhou Mingrui of Earth. "His" experiences notwithstanding, Klein still preserves the core of his personality as one who is cautious, yet will uphold justice where necessary and not involve or target the innocent.

The current transmigrator is like the original Klein, "He" is interested in history and cares about his appearance. Klein immediately became a sophisticated and socialite person known for "His" elegant style as soon as "He" could afford the cost of the different clothes and accessories. Together with his humorous disposition and status as a Beyonder of the Fool Pathway, "He" gave off an amiable and mysterious aura. As for the interest in the history of the transmigrator, it can be explained in a lot of ways (remnant memories of the history graduate; the natural curiosity of a transmigrator; learning more to survive; Pathway related to mysteries, etc.).

Moreover, it is worth noting that Klein Moretti had a talent for acting even before becoming a Beyonder treading the Fool Pathway. It was first seen when "He" had the reflex of assuming the attitude of a mystical and powerful entity called The Fool during "his" first trip in The Gray Fog. Klein then became much better at posing and faking identities as "He" progressed in the sequences of his Pathway with the Acting Method.

name.native: アメリア・ローズクォーツ

192589.description:
She is a young elf of royal lineage and a Silver-rank adventurer. Her class is Shrine Maiden, and she is also quite the glutton.

Although she is often taciturn and expressionless, she begins to show a wide range of emotions after being saved by [Akira Oda](https://anilist.co/character/134269/Akira-Oda).

name.native: レクシア・フォン・アルセリア

192860.description: Yuuya Tenjou is the main protagonist of the series. Located in his grandfather's secret room, Yuuya came across a door leading to another world, Argena, where he gained his powers. Being able to go back and forth between Earth and Argena, Yuuya became extrodinary in both worlds.

192862.description: The daughter of Ousei Academy's chairman, Tsukasa Houjou, Kaori Houjou was saved by [Yuuya Tenjou](https://anilist.co/character/192860/Yuuya-Tenjou) when she was harrased by strangers near a convenience store. With her recommendation, she was the reason behind his acceptence into Ousei Academy.

192962.description:
Shirou Kuramori is a Private Detective who is hired by [Reiko Tamura](https://anilist.co/character/16586/) to spy on [Shinichi Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/12323/).

~!After becoming a liability, he is targeted and his family killed by parasites.!~

(Source: Kiseijuu Fandom)

192973.description: A high school student who gets trapped in the alternate world with Tomochika Dannoura. He has a power that he has kept hidden most of his life, the power to force instant death.

192974.description: Yogiri's classmate and travel companion who he protects. She isn't compatible with the Battle Song program.

194005.description:
One of [Shiriashi](https://anilist.co/character/89790/Shiraishi)'s and [Miyo](https://anilist.co/character/217601/Miyo)'s best friends.

She is shown to be kind and hardworking and vowed to Shiriashi that she will help with her crush on [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/89787/Tanaka).

194056.description:
__Species:__ Human

Nagi Yoshino is the mother of Junpei Yoshino.

Nagi is a friendly, laid-back woman who cared deeply for her son. She's eager for him to make friends and took a liking to Yuji immediately.
As a mother, she has some irresponsible tendencies. She was a smoker and drinker who allowed Junpei to skip school if she wished. Nagi believes that her son could take a different avenue other than education to be successful in life.

After just one meeting, Yuji recognized that Junpei's mother was a great person.

194074.description: Yuji's Grandfather is shown to be a selfless, caring man who taught Yuji to help others. He was also short tempered and stubborn, to the point he would yell at Yuji for visiting him every day and buying him flowers. This temper meant that nobody else wanted to visit him and he tells his grandson to avoid dying alone.

194201.description:
Goes to the same cram school as Yatora.

Under a lot of pressure to do well, as her whole family attended the prestigious Tokyo University of the Arts (Geidai), including her older sister who was the top scorer the year she applied.

Cheerful and friendly, but sometimes makes dark remarks. Is a big eater, and claims that it's common for people into art because drawing burns a lot of energy.

194203.description:
A second year high school student and attends the same school as Yotasuke. Also goes to the same cram school as Yatora.

Hashida applied to Geidai not because he wanted to actually get in but because he enjoys looking at other people's art. He often goes to art exhibitions and displays because he loves seeing people's art a lot (it's like a fetish). Has three sisters, two being older and one being younger.

194263.description:
A new member of the Ao High School Rhythmic Gymnastics Club. He is a first year high school student. Born in Miyagi.

In the summer of the third year of junior high school, he was fascinated by rhythmic gymnastics when he happened to see the performance of the Ao High School Men's Rhythmic Gymnastics Club.

He enrolls in Ao High School and jumps into the world of rhythmic gymnastics, but although he is an amateur, he will grow rapidly with his straightforward personality.

194264.description:
A new member of the Ao High School Rhythmic Gymnastics Club. He is a first year high school student. Born in Miyagi.

He has a cool personality that always keeps his calm attitude, and there is a place where he keeps a distance from others.

He has the ability to runner-up in the men's rhythmic gymnastics junior tournament, and is expected to be a young ace of the Ao High Rhythmic Gymnastics Club.

194267.description: The rhythmic gymnastics team vice captain.

194304.description: Akari Seto is a first year at the same university that Sorawo Kamikoshi attends, she is also a karate practitioner.

194305.description: Kozakura is a reclusive researcher who lives near Shakujii Park and a college friend of Satsuki Uruma. Kozakura She also buys off the items that Sorawo and Toriko acquire from the Otherside and trades them to DS Lab later on. She is also their consultant regarding anything 'Otherside' related.

alternative: ベントゥヴォルピーズ

194351.description: Arc's traveling companion. Ponta is of the species Bentou Volpies, a spirit beast also known as Fluffy Fox. Arc encounters it caged and hurt when defeating some bandits. He frees and heals it. Which makes it decide to follow Arc, so Arc gives it the name Ponta. The species is known for being very rarely tame.

name.native: アリアン・グレニス・メープル
alternative: Ariane Glenys Lalatoya (アリアン・グレニス・ララトイア)

194353.description:
A dark elf female warrior with lilac skin, long white hair, and golden eyes. Excellent in magic and swordsmanship. She encountered [Arc](https://anilist.co/character/161637/Arc) when he assisted her in trying to rescue kidnapped elves. Ever since they have been working together.

Elven names don't follow the same custom as human names do. First, you have an elf their first name, followed by the name of their parent with the same sex's name and as last the name of the place they belong too.

name.native: ローレン・ラーライア・ドゥ・ルビエルテ

194354.description: She is the eldest daughter of Viscount Buckle du Luvierte.

194356.description:
She looks like a ninja, a beast race with animal ears and a tail. A descendant of the Jinshin clan. She has infiltrated various places to release the oppressed beastmen, gathered information to rescue them. She met [Arc](https://anilist.co/character/161637/Arc) and others when she was looking for information in a place elven were hold captive. She's looking for the whereabouts of her brother, Sasuke.

"Chiyome" is not her real name, but one of the names inherited by excellent ninjas from generation to generation. Her real name is Mia.

194358.description: She works as the Chambermaid for the eldest daughter of Luvierte House, Lauren Laraiya du Luvierte.

194901.description:
__Blaze:__ Sword

A girl that Tooru first met at the Entrance ceremony. They fought to determine who would enter the Academy, and Tooru won.

195116.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")
__Talent:__ Snowboarding, Skateboarding

At first glance, Langa appears to be a very stoic young man, barely showing any emotions. But on the inside, he’s more complex and appears to be more confident.

Langa is a teenage boy with blue hair that grows past his ears and blue eyes. He is above average height as he’s taller than [Reki](https://anilist.co/character/195120/Reki-Kyan). Throughout the series, Langa wears the average high school uniform of black pants, a yellow jacket, and a white button-down shirt. But when he associates with [Reki](https://anilist.co/character/195120/Reki-Kyan) he wears baggy clothes consisting of dark pants, a blue coat, and a gray-colored shirt.

Langa was born in Canada to a Japanese mother and Canadian father and grew up snowboarding. As a teenager, he and his mother moved to Okinawa to start anew.

195117.description: In his normal life, as a florist, Shadow looks friendly and kind to his customers. However, entering the middle of the night and S, he changes his attitude to be arrogant, bad, and rude which is thought to be his outlet whenever he experiences unpleasant things during the day.

alternative: Cherry Blossom (チェリーブロッサム)

195118.description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

Kaoru is calm intellectual, well-known even outside of "S" as a famous and successful AI calligrapher. He's been shown to treat clients and strangers with polite respect, but is often prickly towards those closest to him, most prominently his fellow "S" member and childhood friend [Kojiro Nanjo](https://anilist.co/character/195123).
Kaoru is also notably competitive when skateboarding - but does truly trust and care for those who he considers his friends.

195119.description: He is Ainosuke Shindo's secretary and the person who originally taught him to skate.

195120.description:
__Height: __176 cm (5'9")
__Talent: __Skateboarding; Woodworking

Reki is a second year of high school student who loves skateboarding. He gets caught up in the underground skateboarding race "S".

195121.description:
__Height__: 158 cm (5'2")
__Talent__: Skateboarding, Talking to cats

Miya Chinen is a character in the SK8 the Infinity anime series who is an elite middle school student and candidate for Japan's national team. Miya is seen as a carefree boy. He is interested in skating, but not portrayed as obsessed like some of his competitors in "S," an underground and dangerous skateboard race at an abandoned mine.

As a child Miya loved skating and had fun with it. As he grew up, he began improving and received awards for it. However, this lead to his friends assuming that he saw them as "sidekicks" and looked down on them. Furthermore, this resulted in Miya losing his friends, eventually bringing about his negative outlook towards friendship as a whole.

195122.description:
__Zodiac:__ Taurus
__Affiliation:__ Diet Member
__Relatives:__ 3 Unnamed Aunts; Aiichirou Shindou (father)
__Talent:__ Skateboarding

He can use an ability called "Love Hug" which allows him to seem like he is riding uphill.

195123.description:
__Height:__ 189 cm
__Talent:__ Cooking
__Affiliation:__ Sialaluce (restaurant)

He is a skilled skater and a founding member of "S", he uses his unique build and status to skate in an aggressive, movement-oriented manner. 

Despite his aura of hostility towards [Cherry Blossom](https://anilist.co/character/195118/Sakurayashiki-Kaoru), they are good friends, who have the utmost confidence in each other and their abilities. He is shown to be deeply attached to Kaoru, being the person for whom Kaoru sneaks out of the hospital after his injury, and the one who carried Kaoru when he passed out after [Adam](https://anilist.co/character/195122/Shindou-Ainosuke)'s attack. Kojiro and Kaoru were shown to be close, using each other's first name in addition to the childhood friend aspect. Kojiro is extremely loyal to Kaoru and so is Kaoru.

Kojiro has a "papa bear" mentality and appears as a father figure to the young boys, giving them advice and noticing things that are wrong with them. He is very open-minded and kind to the young boys, trying to help them whenever he can.

He helps [Reki](https://anilist.co/character/195120/Kyan-Reki) overcome his doubts and often picks him up when he is afraid he might do something reckless. He talks to Reki when he is depressed, trying to help him regain his self-esteem. He notices the little things in the younger boy's behavior and his playboy personality fades as he shows support. He not only helps Reki, but also Langa to rekindle his friendship with Reki.

He often has a teasing aspect to his entity, but underneath his playboy exterior, he is a very loyal, watchful, and relaxed person who enjoys helping others.

195177.description: Draluc is an immortal higher vampire from the prestigious Dragon Clan who keeps dying and turning to dust from all kinds of small things. As his castle was destroyed, he moved in with Ronaldo, much to the other's dismay. Draluc is a typical-looking adult vampire with pale and boney complexion, pointy ears and nose. He has round lazy eyes, short black hair that is combed backwards.

195178.description: A vampire hunter in his 20s with a base of operations in Shin-Yokohama. Originally not thrilled to have [Draluc](https://anilist.co/character/195177/Draluc) as a roommate, the success of the partnership in his novel series, _The Ronaldo Chronicles_, leads him to reluctantly put up with the vampire. He frequently kills Draluc when annoyed. He also has an extreme phobia of celery.

195567.description:
Shino is a close friend of [Saki Saki](https://anilist.co/character/162886/Saki-Saki). They are in the same class and the same after school club. Shino is serious and considerate, and also academically talented, being the top scoring student at school.

~!After learning [Naoya](https://anilist.co/character/162887/Mukai-Naoya) and Saki Saki were both on a two-time relationship with [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/162885/Minase-Nagisa), she decided to expose their relationship, and attempt to end it, in order to help Saki, believing it was hurting her feelings. However she also has feelings for Naoya, and started to have doubts about hiding her feelings or not.!~

195601.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

A first-year high school student who began living alone at the start of the semester. He is poor at every type of housework and leads a self-indulgent life. He has few friends and tends to put himself down.

195602.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

A classmate who lives next door to [Amane](https://anilist.co/character/195601/Fujimiya-Amane). She is the most beautiful girl in school. She's well-behaved, gets great grades, always wears a smile, and is called an angel by her peers. Because of her beauty, she is very popular for the male student population at school. Due to this, Mahiru tended to avoid her male classmates in the beginning of the story.

195677.description:
Mrs. Tamaki is the mother of Ako Tamaki from the Netoge no Yome wa Onnanoko ja Nai to Omotta? series.

Mrs. Tamaki is a very kind and understanding mother, supporting Ako's desire to play games, but wants her to make friends in school. Mrs. Tamaki can be easily too trusting or understanding as she let Ako continue to believe she has a 'husband' and letting Hideki, a teenage boy, to have the key to her daughter's room and their house. However, her heart is at the right place and believed in what's best for her child. Mrs. Tamaki doesn't seem to understand the sense of privacy as she has a spare key made for her daughter's room and goes in whenever she wants to check up on her as she believed that she has the right since she's a worried mother.

195917.description:
Tsukuyomi is the deity​ who rules over the Moon, and is the one who took on the job of transferring [Makoto Misumi](https://anilist.co/character/138137/Misumi-Makoto) from Earth to the other world. Tsukuyomi also gave his blessing of power to Makoto and later helped him after the [Goddess](https://anilist.co/character/221535/Megami) dropped him to the Wasteland in her world.

Tsukuyomi is a humble individual who helps those he believes he is capable of helping, as long as he thinks it is the right thing to do. Whenever he helps others, he usually does his utmost to achieve the best possible results.

196143.description: High School 2nd Year student from Group K.

alternative: Rizlet of Loggervia (リーズレット・オブ・ロガーヴィア)

196215.description:
A B-rank adventurer from the nearby settlement of Zoltan, Rit is a long-time associate of Gideon. Upon hearing about Red from the adventurer's guild, she wonders whether it's actually Gideon and visits the newly opened pharmacy. She ends up living there and helping out.

(Source: Official Site)

196216.description:
A member of the Hero's party, Ares is blessed with the sign of the 'Leader'. While his intellect and magical aptitude allow him to excel as a magician, he is also proud and incredibly ambitious. He ran Gideon out of the party and told others that he left of his own accord.

(Source: Official Site)

name.native: ルーティ・ラグナソン

196217.description:
Gideon's younger sister, Ruti is blessed with the sign of the 'Hero', she is destined to slay the Demon Lord. This has granted her unimaginable power, yet also inhibits her emotions and very humanity as these are unnecessary for a hero.

(Source: Official Site)

alternative: Gideon Ragnason (ギデオン・ラグナソン)

196218.description:
A D-rank adventurer from the nearby settlement of Zoltan, Red gathers and sells herbs to make a living and hopes to one day open his own herb shop and live a quiet life. He is blessed with the sign of the 'Guide' to protect and guide heroes on their journey, and was once a member of such a party.

(Source: Official Site)

196502.description: One of the four Special Grade Sorcerers.

196521.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm

Shin is a ex-hitman turned employee who works for [Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/196522/Sakamoto-Tarou). He has the ability to hear the thoughts of those around him.

196522.description:
__Height:__ 188 cm

Tarou Sakamoto is a retired hitman. He was the greatest hitman, feared and revered by bad guys and hitmen everywhere. However, he left the hitman world in order to be with his wife. He currently owns a store, and has one child. He is the jack of all trades of his town, and is very popular and well liked by people in his town.

196720.description: He is the little brother of [Junta Shiraishi](https://anilist.co/character/173331/Shiraishi-Junta).

196721.description: She is the older sister of [Nagisa Kubo](https://anilist.co/character/164986/Kubo-Nagisa).

196722.description: She is the little cousin of [Nagisa Kubo](https://anilist.co/character/164986/Kubo-Nagisa), she looks up to her and wants to be like her.

196734.description: A handsome and top-notch doctor who specializes in treating "mystery diseases." He's a master of Ramune. One of his hobbies is to torment people and he's especially strict with Ramune. Because he has no sense of direction, he always has "Pipopo" accompanied by him, a mystery pet that he created to guide him in the right direction.

196865.description: Part of the adult Tomodachi game.

197114.description: A close friend of Kyouya Hashiba. Although displaying a lazy nature, he is a genius in writing scripts.

197115.description: She is a resident of Share House Kitayama, and a very talented singer. Despite her appearance, she's innocent and caring.

197116.description:
Aki has an unfussy and motherly temper while also known to have a caring nature too. She's also a very talented artist. She is a second-year student in [Kyouya Hashiba](https://anilist.co/character/197117/Hashiba-Kyouya)'s Department of Film who is commonly known as "Shinoaki".

~!As of 2016, she was working as a famous illustrator under the name Shino Akishima, whom Kyouya adored.!~

~!In the world of 2018, she married Kyouya (which makes her Aki Hashiba) and become a mother of one child named [Maki Hashiba](https://anilist.co/character/239482/Hashiba-Maki), but had to quit to being a painter as she had lost interest in art. After some time, she quickly found the passion to draw again.!~

197117.description:
Main protagonist of the series. He travels back ten years ago by an unknown event. Kyouya shows a very calm personality. He is inspired by a group of talented people known as "The Platinum Generation".

~!Kyouya had been deeply inspired by paintings of a famous female illustrator which made him feel alive when he was working as a game developer, later Kyouya found out that Aki Shino was indeed that famous illustrator named Shino Akishima.!~

~!In the world of 2018 he married Aki Shino (which makes her Aki Hashiba) and he was the father of a child with a daughter, Maki Hashiba.!~

197151.description: A 5th grade elementary student who loves figure skating so much she used to practice it in secret. Though she greatly lacks academic skill, when she's in the rink she's like a different person.

197152.description: An orphan who was picked up by [Jun Yodaka](https://anilist.co/character/197164/Jun-Yodaka) and currently lives with [Rioh Sonidori](https://anilist.co/character/197158/Riou-Sonidori) and his mother. She is [Inori's](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka) rival who she promised with that they would compete against each other in the All-Japans.

197155.description: [Ryouka Miketa](https://anilist.co/character/197157/Ryouka-Miketa)'s coach. She's lively with lots of piercings, with her bold personality fading into bashfulness around people she doesn't know. She was formerly ranked in Japan's top 12 skaters for her high jumps, but she currently only has one student as a coach.

197156.description: Receptionist at a local skating rink.

197157.description: One of [Inori's](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka) rivals. She is a 3rd grade girl in the Preliminary skating category with Inori. She looks up to "girlish" things and believes cats are the cutest things in the universe.

197158.description: Riou is a 5th grade elementary school student and member of Meikou Wind FSC. Son of Olympic silver medalist [Shinichirou Sonidori.](https://anilist.co/character/197159/Shinichirou-Sonidori)

197159.description: Head coach at Meikou Wind FSC and father of [Riou Sonidori](https://anilist.co/character/197158/Riou-Sonidori).

197160.description: [Inori's](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka) older sister. She used to be a figure skater but quit due to an injury.

197161.description: [Tsukasa's](https://anilist.co/character/197163/Tsukasa-Akeuraji) former Ice dance partner and a current skating coach at Lux Toyama FSC.

197163.description: He is a former ice dancer and now the coach of [Inori Yuitsuka](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka).

197164.description: The coach of [Hikaru Kamisaki](https://anilist.co/character/197152/Kamisaki-Hikaru). He took Hikaru in as his skating disciple from a far away snowy land, but left the task of caring for her other needs to the Sonidori family.

197166.description: You is the daughter of the Kago family who supported [Tsukasa's](https://anilist.co/character/197163/Tsukasa-Akeuraji) skating career.

197172.description: Akane is a college student who had just broken up with her ex-boyfriend. Mainly because of him falling in love with another female gamer he met in the game Forest Of Savior (FOS). She is also a player of the said game and is a part of the guild named [Chocolate Rabbit]. Her character's name is Akane and her character's role is a Paladin. She is not tech savvy but she really likes playing the game and getting along with everyone.

197173.description: Yamada is a high school student who is an intellectual and a good looking guy. He is not interested in romance but in playing games. He is a famous pro-gamer and receives money from sponsors. He mainly plays FPS (First Person Shooter) games. He is a player of the game Forest Of Savior (FOS) and a part of a guild named [Chocolate Rabbit]. His character's name is Yamada and his character's role is a Wizard.

197190.description:
**Occupation:** Spy
**Affiliation:** Lamplight
**Skills:** She has a knack on concocting poisons that can either paralyze or kill her targets.

Lily is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She is the team leader of Lamplight. She wants to become a spy due to her life being saved by one after she survived a poison gas attack during the Great War. Due to her concern for the Lamplight team and her own skills, she is designated by [Klaus](https://anilist.co/character/197206/Klaus) to be the team leader for Lamplight.

197200.description:
**Occupation:** Spy
**Affiliation:** Lamplight
**Skills:** She is good at stealing and is the most athletic member of the team.

Sibylla is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She was born into a gangster family, and she and her younger siblings were forced to help in gang activities. She has a strong sense of justice and wanted to be a spy to protect her younger siblings.

197201.description:
**Occupation:** Spy
**Affiliation:** Lamplight
**Skills:** She is skilled in disguises, and can even disguise herself as a man without being detected.

Grete is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She was the daughter of a politician but for some reason, she was forced out of her birthplace, and she seems to have decided to become a spy. Although she has an excellent brain, she has a deep-rooted distaste for men.

197202.description:
**Occupation:** Spy
**Affiliation:** Lamplight
**Skills:** She is a genius and excels in every skill, making her the most talented spy among the members of Lamplight 

Monika is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She is the daughter of an artist, she ran away from home to become a spy, and within a short period of time, she became the top student at the training school. However, for some reason, she rapidly loses her ambition and is scouted by Lamplight after failing her grades.

197203.description:
**Occupation:** Spy
**Affiliation:** Lamplight
**Skills:** She is both a master negotiator and a professional seductress, able to use her charms to extract information and achieve her goals.

Thea is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She is the oldest and most attractive member of Lamplight, and was the daughter of a newspaper company president and abducted when she was 11 as a hostage. However, she was saved by a spy who she admired and who became her inspiration to become one herself.

197306.description:
Shaun is one of the side protagonists in the Shadows House series. He is a Living Doll working as a servant in the Shadows House and as a "face" of [John Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/197307/John).
He completes his work flawlessly and secretly has poor vision.

197307.description:
John is one of the side protagonists in the Shadows House series and the shadow living under the care of the "Living Face", [Shaun](https://anilist.co/character/197306/Shaun).

John is known to be quite friendly with everyone and very open-minded. Unlike many shadows, he treats Shaun with respect and even offers to wear glasses so that Shaun can be seen while wearing his. Like Kate and Emilico, John and Shaun are polar opposites. John is a muscle-headed extrovert while Shaun is a thoughtful introvert. Despite this, the two are very good friends and John cares for his "face" immensely.

name.native: クリスティーナ・ベルトラム

197376.description: First princess of the Beltrum Kingdom and in line to the throne.

name.native: フローラ・ベルトラム

197377.description: Second princess of Beltrum and the younger sister of Christina.

197585.description:
A mysterious girl discovered by Hitotsuyanagi squad under investigation on the beach.
Yuri is the name Riri gave her temporarily it is also a couple name of Riri and Yuyu that Fumi gave them.

197799.description: Tadano Itsuki is a second year student of Inashiro Industrial and the baseball team's primary catcher after Harada Masatoshi retired.

197877.description:
Lou is one of the side protagonists in the Shadows House series. She is a Living Doll working as a maid in the house and as a "face" of [Louise Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/198188/Louise).

Lou is a quiet and obedient girl who listens to her master's every order. Her top priority is taking care of Louise and her own safety. She often gets worried about her face getting damaged and has been known to invade in people's personal space. When she sets her mind to something, she's very determined to achieve it, especially if it has to do with Louise. Unlike Emilicol, she doesn't think of "unnecessary thoughts" and has the potential to be an outstanding Living Doll.

197880.description: Former assassin. Current employee of Bamboo Forest. Daughter of Fei Ling

197884.description: Employee of Bamboo Forest. Twin of [Carla](https://anilist.co/character/197885)

197885.description: Employee of Bamboo Forest. Twin of [Callum](https://anilist.co/character/197884)

name.native: シェリー・バーネット

197922.description:
__Race:__ Human

Sherry Barnett is a student of Midgar Royal Spellsword Academy. She is also the adopted daughter of [Lutheran Barnett](https://anilist.co/character/291390/Barnett-Lutheran).

198351.description: A badger and the largest of the residents. Vice-chairman of the Carpenters Union.

198353.description: Narai's wife. A good cook who often cooks large meals for the Carpenters' Union.

198354.description:
An old carpenter that Hakumei works for and chairman of the Carpenters' Union. Mistakenly thought Hakumei was a man at first and Mikochi was her wife until she joined the Carpenters' Union.

Has a scar on his eyebrow from an old injury and seemingly learnt carpentry from Hakuyo's father.

198357.description: A fish skeleton that Sen uses as a submarine.

198362.description: Current head of Honey House. One of the oldest residents of Makinata.

198372.description: A young beetle who moves into the tree that Hakumei and Mikochi live in.

198393.description: A hair stylist who lives in an egg. Runs the beauty salon 'Jade Egg' from her house.

198504.description:
**Hometown:** Saitama Prefecture, Japan
**Height:** 159 cm

~!The true identity of her heart donor is [Akari Amasawa](https://anilist.co/character/215440), the older sister of [Rena Hananoi](https://anilist.co/character/198501).!~

198857.description: Aki Koganei is a high school student and a close friend of Mayumi Kurase.

198883.description: Because of her class number, she is in the same room with [Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi) and is partnered with her. She hates war and anyone getting hurt, and has doubts about her mission as a weapon. Her magical power is low, and she can only use magic to move a book by floating it in the air...

198884.description:
__Height:__ 143 cm

A mysterious girl who came to [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena).

She is said to be the school's immortal secret weapon. She possesses unimaginable power despite her young appearance and innocent words and actions, and she has no reservations about killing her enemies. She has the ability to revive herself even after being injured to the point of losing her original human form.

199120.description:
Runa is a middle high school student who usually dresses in Lolita Fashion. She is the younger sister of Eita Sasaki. She is also being mentored by Yamada during the weekends. She is also a player of the game Forest Of Savior (FOS) and a member of the guild [Chocolate Rabbit]. 

~!Her brother (Eita) said that she is the model for his' character Princess Ruri!~

~!In Chapter 44, she showed one of her characters which is named I Love Meat. The character is a male elf, and her character's role is an archer.!~

199121.description:
Sasaki is the older brother of [Runa Sasaki](https://anilist.co/character/199120/Sasaki-Runa). He is also [Yamada-kun](https://anilist.co/character/197173/Yamada-Akito)'s senpai back in their hometown. His hobby is playing video games. He also plays the game Forest of Savior (FOS) and is also a member of the guild [Chocolate Rabbit]. 

~!He is the current guild master of [Chocolate Rabbit] under the name: Princess Ruri. He is a nekama.

(Nekama : a male who dresses as a female, and uses anonymity in his social network with his appearance and identity unknown. It is an abbreviation of the word 'netto okama' where it has been used since the pre-internet online service era)!~

name.native: ララトイア・グレニス

199419.description: A B-class adventurer wielding a lance.

199711.description:
__Instrument:__ Trombone

Kumiko's friend from junior high school. She admitted to Rikka High School, known for its marching band. She is the protagonist of the Rikka-centric spinoff novels.

199764.description: He was the only person taking care of Takatori until Chihiro came.

199866.description: Agni is the Goddess of Fire. She gave Mukouda her blessing so that she could get offerings from him. Agni likes otherworld alcohol, especially beer.

199867.description: A pixie dragon that Mukouda took as his third familiar. Despite his very small stature, he is very strong when it comes to combat. Dora can use all kinds of elemental magic, such as fire, wind, water, earth and thunder.

199890.description: A girl who doesn't hesitate to say what's on her mind, even for people she has just met.

199891.description: A girl who has a very distinct beauty mark and slim figure. She is often mistaken for a man, and is popular among girls.

199892.description:
A girl who has very distinct heterochromia and for that she's bullied at school. Due to a certain event, she is temporarily not attending school. She's a very introverted girl who spends a lot of time alone, she's very protective when it comes to people that she cares about.

She has no special power or abilities but wields a multi-colored pen which can transform into a weapon.

199893.description: A girl who has very distinct green eyes and pigtails. She is very quiet and still at most times, loves herself and makes no initiative to get to know people. On the contrary, she avoids contact with people. She confesses to [Ai](https://anilist.co/character/199892/Ai-Ohto) her goal, to save [her sister](https://anilist.co/character/260352), for whose death she feels responsible.

200291.description:
[Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/200292/Yuuta-Asamura)'s step-sister and a second-year high school student. 

She became Yuuta's step-sister after her parents remarried. Because of her flamboyant outfit, she is considered a delinquent student and is not well-liked in class.

200292.description: [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/200291)'s step-brother and a second-year high school student. He became Saki's step-brother after his parents remarried. He is a normal high school student but is somewhat distant from others. He loves books to the level of a print addict.

200765.description: Sasaki is a second-year student at Sugisawa Third High School and a member of school's Occult Research Club alongside her friends [Yuuji Itadori](https://anilist.co/character/127212/Yuuji-Itadori) and [Takeshi Iguchi](https://anilist.co/character/200767/Takeshi-Iguchi).

200767.description: Iguchi is a second-year student at Sugisawa Third High School and a member of school's Occult Research Club alongside his friends [Yuuji Itadori](https://anilist.co/character/127212/Yuuji-Itadori) and [Setsuko Sasaki](https://anilist.co/character/200765).

201293.description: Mamoru Aikawa is a God Candidate and a major antagonist of Tenkuu Shinpan. As he witnessed his father's suicide as a young child, for which his father wrote a note to "those who betrayed him" on his business and social ventures, Mamoru grew to despise those who were betrayed, believing them to be a cancer to society and worthy of suicide. He explains this belief to Rika and anyone who will listen, with his doctrine explained as: those who earn betrayal earn death.

201323.description:
Ooba is an instructor at the prep school that Yatora attended.

She is a highly eccentric, carefree, and wise teacher who cares deeply for her students and her craft. She tends to be blunt and loud, and often tells her students about random animal trivia, more so during stressful times.

201420.description:
__Race:__ Human

Despite being [Noir](https://anilist.co/character/187865/Stardia-Noir)'s younger sister, she's very possessive and protective of him, and although Alice is very popular with the opposite sex, she is only interested in Noir and has a Brother Complex.

201421.description:
__Race:__ Half Elf

A Cleric of the church, Luna is seen as a saint for using her healing skills on people while listening to their problems, but she fears that using her skills will lead to a premature death like her mother's. Luna is Lola's best friend and a solo adventurer. Luna is convinced that it is her mission to save people and make them smile. She is usually a very dignified person but reveals a strange expression when Luna passes out and murmurs what she really feels.

201538.description: Also known as the "Black Dragon Iris", she is one of the oldest and strongest Dragons still alive. She is the only one who knows Matthias's true identity after reunited thousand years later and decided to keep it a secret upon his request.

name.native: アンベル・イダノカン

202153.description: The Princess of the Earth Ring.

name.native: ネフリティス・ロムカ

202154.description: The shut-in elf princess bearer of the Rings of Wind.

202155.description:
Saphir is one of the twin princesses of the water country of Maasa. She takes on the roll of becoming Ring Princess and gives Satou the Ring of Water to help save her country from Empire influence and so her sister Saphira can be with Marse. She becomes his 4th wife.

She has strong magic powers but has a lazy personality.

name.native: グラナート・ニーダキッタ

202156.description: The current princess and the strongest of the cat people bearer of the Rings of Fire.

name.native: クリストル・ノバティ・ノカナティカ

202665.description:
One of the girls that [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) meets on the island of Jananda. 

~!After she dies she also becomes a form Fushi can take over!~

202667.description:
One of the girls that [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) meets on the island of Jananda. 

~!After she dies she also becomes a form Fushi can take over!~

202863.description: [Gugu's](https://anilist.co/character/136554/Gugu) "brother". They were both servants that were abandoned. They lived for a long time as siblings.

name.native: アニスフィア・ウィン・パレッティア

203119.description:
Anisphia is the first Princess of the Kingdom of Palettia. 

Possessing memories of her past life, she longs to be able to fly in the sky with the power of magic. However, as she's unable to use magic herself, she spends her days conducting questionable research in hopes of fulfilling her dream. Her eccentric behavior earned her the nickname "Princess Peculiar".

name.native: ユフィリア・マゼンタ

203120.description:
The daughter of [Duke Magenta](https://anilist.co/character/261968/Ruomen). A genius beauty who not only excels at magic, but also well-versed in academics, politics and combat.

As the fiancé of [Prince Algard](https://anilist.co/character/287676/Von-Palettia-Algard), she showed promise as the kingdom's next queen. But one fateful night would change the course of her life forever...

name.native: ミレーヌ・ラファ・ホルファート

203167.description: Mylene Rafa Holfort is the mother of [Julius](https://anilist.co/character/168842/Rafa-Holfort-Julius), wife of [Roland](https://anilist.co/character/409980/Holfort-Roland) and the Queen of Holfort Kingdom.

name.native: カイ・レナルド・ロウル

203210.description: He is a soldier from Uralys

203213.description: A former soldier of the Benett founder army

203214.description: A girl from the earthenware people

203268.description: Fudo Aikawa is the main character of the manga Love After World Domination. He is the Red Gelato and leader of the hero squad Gelato 5. He is also the strongest member among them.

203269.description: Desumi Magahara is the deuteragonist of the manga Love After World Domination. She is a beautiful high school student, with blond hair and green eyes, her Gekko Battle Gear is a kind of erotic black demon-style outfit with bunny-like ears. Ever since young, her strength has been remarkable. It is so incomprehensible that she managed to close down a dojo unintentionally after defeating a dojo master there. Her family have some past and connections with Gekko, hence getting her involved with them despite not wanting to.

203384.description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")

Akane Kurokawa is a rising star actress from the Lalalie Theatrical Company. Although a shy and quiet person, she is very serious when it comes to creating a good performance. She does a deep examination of each role she is given, allowing her to perfectly portray the character's personality and motivations. Akane is introduced to [Aqua](https://anilist.co/character/183885) as a fellow cast member on the set of the reality dating show *The Beginning of My Love With An Idol*.

203563.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm

A Tenjiku executive. Ran's younger brother.

~!He's a Bonten executive in the future.!~

name.native: ギオルギー・ポポーヴィッチ

203655.description:
Georgi Popovich is a Russian figure skater. He has a very serious attitude towards competitions, but also has his own comical way of expressing himself. He takes relationships so seriously to the point that he uses his own heartbroken experience as the theme of his skating programs.

(Source: Yuri!!! On Ice Wikia)

name.native: リリア・バラノフスカヤ

203656.description:
Lilia Baranovskaya is Yuri Plisetsky's current ballet coach and the choreographer of his free skate program. Lilia is the former prima ballerina of the Bolshoi Ballet and is implied to be quite famous. She is Yakov Feltsman's ex-wife.

Lilia is first shown to be a stern and strict woman. She is very opinionated on how things should be, especially when it comes to her dance students. Later on, a motherly side of her emerges, especially during Yuri's free skates, where she always cries with pride when Yuri performs well. Lilia also eats pirozhki with the younger skater when he stays at her house and does up his hair for his free skate performances.

(Source: Yuri!!! On Ice Wikia)

203657.description:
Guang Hong Ji is a 17-year-old Chinese figure skater.

He is initially seen as shy and innocent, as shown when he expressed discomfort at Victor's stripping, but his free-skate program revealed a more "intense" aspect of his personality. Guang Hong enjoys using SNS immensely, and he looks up to Victor Nikiforov.

(Source: Yuri!!! On Ice Wikia)

203658.description:
Anya is a Russian figure skater and the ex-girlfriend of Georgi Popovich who is his inspiration for skating as he uses their break-up as stimuli for his Grand Prix programs.

(Source: Yuri!!! On Ice Wikia)

203662.description:
Min-so Park is Seung-gil Lee's coach.

Min-so is single-minded with Seung-gil, insisting that all of Seung-gil's effort should work towards the PyeongChang Winter Olympics. She is pleased when Seung-gil performs well for the Rostelecom Cup short program, and outwardly shows her disappointment when the skater fails to perform up to standard for the free skate. She does not show much emotional support towards Seung-gil. Seung-gil is often seen beside Min-so, but he shows almost no emotional closeness with his coach.

(Source: Yuri!!! On Ice Wikia)

204143.description:
~!Kurumi Saijo emerges from Ai's first Wonder Egg.!~ Kurumi is an empathetic girl. She sometimes speaks to others in an authoritative manner, but is a helpful person. She is very sarcastic in serious situations.
~!Kurumi was a student who had no real friends, only the superficial kind with whom you exchange empty phrases. Her Wonder Killer was an unknown schoolgirl with axes who endlessly laughed at her.!~

(Source: Wonder Egg Priority Fandom Wiki)

204182.description: A person living in the present era. [Yuki Aoki](https://anilist.co/character/204185/Aoki-Yuuki)'s younger sibling.

204185.description: He is a boy from the present era. He offers [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) to stay at his place. He's the vice-president of the occult research club.

204186.description: A boy from the present era. [Aoki's](https://anilist.co/character/204185/Aoki-Yuuki) friend. He's a first-year, occult-club member and self-professed brawn of the club.

204187.description: She's a girl from the present era. [Aoki](https://anilist.co/character/204185/Aoki-Yuuki)'s and [Mizuha](https://anilist.co/character/204189/Mizuha)'s friend.

204189.description: A girl from the present area. ~!She's one of [Hayase](https://anilist.co/character/136545/Hayase)'s descendants and will be the eighteenth leader of the Defense Corps.!~

204190.description: A boy living in the present era. [Aoki's](https://anilist.co/character/204185/Aoki-Yuuki) friend. He's a first-year occult club member and self-professed brains of the club.

204204.description:
__Race:__ Human

Iris Midgar is the first princess of the Kingdom of Midgar and older sister of [Alexia Midgar](https://anilist.co/character/168799/Alexia-Midgar). She is also leader of the Crimson Order.

204416.description:
__Height:__ 172cm

One of Naoya's friends. A loud and perverted muscle-head. He has been friends with Naoya Nifuji since kindergarten.

204418.description: A girl from the present era.

204456.description:
Saki's classmate. 
She's always cheerful and meddlesome, and when she can't stand to see Saki isolated, she gets annoyingly involved with her, and they become friends.

204457.description:
Yuuta's classmate. 
He is almost Yuuta's only friend at school. He is also a member of the baseball team and an otaku.

204458.description: University student. She works part-time as a senior at the bookstore where Yuuta works. As a caring senior, she supports Yuuta's "relationship with his younger sister".

204495.description:
Kukuru is a high school student acting as the director of a small "Gamagama Aquarium" in Okinawa. She has a direct and cheerful personality. Having a stronger attachment to the aquarium than anyone else, Kukuru has a professional side where she is willing to speak harshly when living creatures are involved. She is ignorant of fashion.

Kukuru is struggling to revitalize the "Gamagama Aquarium," which is on the verge of closing.

204496.description: Fuuka is a former idol. She gave up her dream and left for Okinawa on her way back to her hometown. There, she met Kukuru. Fuuka is a serious and hard worker. She is also sensitive to the feelings of others.

204522.description:
__Occupation:__ Taxi Driver

Odokawa is an eccentric and quiet person who does not open up to others. He has a serious and compassionate side. His hobbies include listening to rakugo before going to bed and listening to the radio while working.
 
~!Due to brain damage suffered from a drowning accident in his childhood, Odokawa cannot perceive human beings and instead views them as animals. His condition is solved when he gets in an accident again.!~

204523.description:
__Occupation:__ Nurse

Shirakawa is a nurse at Gouriki's medical clinic. She is a calm and mature woman, but sometimes shows a mischievous side. She is learning capoeira as a hobby.

204807.description:
A feral, violent girl with long fangs and the eyes of a beast. A witch's curse can be seen in the form of a rose tattoo on her collarbones.

Guideau currently works for the Order of Magical Resonance, a group that works by magic, for magic and of magic. Her partner is Ashaf.
~!Guideau's true form is locked inside Ashaf's coffin. She is originally a man who's extremely powerful, considered to be a witch's "one true natural enemy". Her current appearance is the result of a witch's curse.!~

204808.description:
A soft-spoken man with delicate features, a coffin strapped to his back, and an entourage of crows.

Ashaf currently works for the Order of Magical Resonance, a group that works by magic, for magic and of magic. His partner is Guideau.

~!They are currently both looking for the traces of a specific witch in order to remove the curse on Guideau.!~

204860.description: A dragon hunter who teamed up with [Crimson](https://anilist.co/character/168967/Crimson) to kill all dragons.

204987.description:
A high elf, fellow veteran and close friend of Gideon, Yarandrala was born in the Kingdom of Kiramin and is blessed with the sign of the 'Forest Speaker'. She is able to ask plants to lend her their aid.

(Source: Official Site)

205053.description: President of Hebinuma Pharmaceutical based in Hong Kong. They are known for always wearing white suits and it's hard to tell what they are thinking. They have an interest in the secrets of Kowloon and [Reiko](https://anilist.co/character/160725/Reiko-Kujirai)

205054.description:
A girl who lives in Nanto Street, Kowloon. She works part-time in various shops including a shoe shop and cinema, and uses the money she earns to buy more frilly and ribbon covered clothes for her collection. She frequently runs into [Reiko](https://anilist.co/character/160725/Reiko-Kujirai) and [Hajime](https://anilist.co/character/160726/Hajime-Kudou) around the city. 

~!Later revealed to be biologically male, Xiaohei eventually moves to Hong Kong after Kowloon’s demolition, quits cross-dressing, and undertakes covert work under orders from [Miyuki Hebinuma](https://anilist.co/character/205053/Hebinuma-Miyuki)’s father.!~

205055.description: [Kujirai Reiko's](https://anilist.co/character/160725/Reiko-Kujirai) friend. She recently moved to Kowloon and works sewing stuffed animals. She has a bright personality and a mysterious past.

205177.description: Sein is a Priest from a small village in the Alt Woods. After [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) spotted his talent, he joined her group for a period of time with the goal of reuniting with his childhood friend Gorilla.

205374.description:
He has been working as a professional Otokoshi. 

An Otokoshi assists geiko and maiko in putting on their kimono. They make rounds to the maiko houses and lift garments as heavy as twenty kilograms.

alternative: Wolfgunblood (ウルフ・ガンブラッド)

205566.description: A 34-year-old man who woke up from coma after 17 years, but actually went to another world during that time. His unattractive appearance barely changed since the time he transferred to another world, and he was frequently mistaken for an orc and treated extremely poorly by the inhabitants of the other world, to the point where he had to continuously wipe his own memories to maintain his sanity. He retained his magic ability and uses it freely.

205567.description:
__Occupation:__ University Student
__Family:__ [Chiaki Fujimiya](https://anilist.co/character/293824) (Younger Brother)

Fujimiya is [Takafumi](https://anilist.co/character/205568/Takafumi-Takaoka)'s childhood friend, they shared their school Days together and now also meet frequently at [Takafumi](https://anilist.co/character/205568/Takafumi-Takaoka)'s house

~!Fujimiya has romantic feelings for [Takafumi](https://anilist.co/character/205568/Takafumi-Takaoka) and throughout their time together she tries to get closer to him and sets out different scenarios to get closer to him.!~

205568.description:
__Occupation:__ Part-time worker
__Family:__ [Shibazaki Yousuke](https://anilist.co/character/205566/Yousuke-Shibazaki) (Maternal Uncle)

Takafumi resides with his Uncle [Shibazaki Yousuke](https://anilist.co/character/205566/Yousuke-Shibazaki) at the House and have fun playing games on a videogame console, sometimes his Uncle uses an otherworldly technology to play his previous-life moments to Takafumi and his friend [Fujimiya](https://anilist.co/character/205567/Sumika-Fujimiya).

~!Fujimiya has romantic feelings for [Takafumi](https://anilist.co/character/205568/Takafumi-Takaoka) and throughout their time together she tries to get closer to him and sets out different scenarios to get closer to him. In the other hand, [Takafumi](https://anilist.co/character/205568/Takafumi-Takaoka) sees her as a good friend as of now.!~

205569.description: A descendant of the Frost Clan. She is the guardian of the ice sword that has been passed down from generation to generation. She lived in a frozen room inside a large tree trunk. Her demeanor and heart were very cold, as cold as the place she lived in.

name.native: スザイルギラーゼガルネルブゼギルレアグランゼルガ=エルガ

205570.description: An elf who [Yousuke](https://anilist.co/character/205566/Shibazaki-Yousuke) rescued in the other world. She has a crush on him after he saved her from a dragon, but since the term 'tsundere' only became popular four years after Yousuke went into coma, he does not understand her tendencies and thinks she is harassing him instead. Despite this, she is kind, often defending Yousuke when other people attempt to slander him, though he interprets this as blackmail.

name.native: アリシア=イーデルシア

205571.description: A rookie priestess in a party with [Edgar](https://anilist.co/character/278619/Edgar) and [Raiga](https://anilist.co/character/278618/Raiga).

205705.description: Misaki Sakimiya, known professionally as Zaki, is the former heiress to Sakimiya Steel and the assassin hired to kill the original Polka Shinoyama. In the aftermath of her own premature murder and subsequent resurrection as a Zombie—respectfully the accidental and purposeful doing of the Corpse God—she moves in with the Corpse God and assists him with his fortune-telling endeavors. Misaki has since evolved to become a Vampire Larva per the Corpse God's magic, her newfound powers allowing her to better assist him as an offensive agent. At the start of the series, those with the Evil Eye would have been able to see the spirits of Misaki's victims haunting her.

205706.description:
The Corpse God, later known as Polka Shinoyama, is the main protagonist of Dead Mount Death Play. As a human born with the Evil Eye, the Corpse God (not yet known as such) was sold to the necromancer Easlies Swordfrail at the age of ten and studied Necromancy under her tutelage, eventually becoming an Undead himself. Though he wanted nothing more then to live a peaceful life, the Geldwood church spent a century wanting nothing more than to see him dead. To achieve the peaceful life he so desired, the Corpse God pursues the secret art of reincarnation with the intention of reincarnating as one of his fallen kinsmen. His spell works, but not as fully expected: rather than reincarnating as his kinsman, the Corpse God instead wakes in the corpse of the real Polka Shinoyama, freshly murdered in the Shinjuku ward of Tokyo, Japan.

Despite having reincarnated in a wrong body and world, the Corpse God has concluded this is his best chance yet at having a peaceful life. With the real Polka's permission, he has assumed Polka's name and identity along with Polka's body. His real name is unknown, as it is unpronounceable in Japanese.

205707.description: Takumi Kuruya is an informant based in Tokyo's Shinjuku Ward who uses illegal drones to collect data alongside other methods; occasionally, he also helps contract killers conceal their victims' corpses. Per Lisa Kuraki's instructions, he has become companion to the Corpse God and assists his fortunetelling business by collection information on clients during their sessions.

205710.description: Lisa Kuraki, also known as Clarissa, is a mediator and bartender who runs Youtoukorou: a legal bar-illegal freelance agency that operates in Shinjuku.

name.native: シャグルア・エディス・ルグリッド

205711.description: Sir Shagrua Edith Lugrid the Calamity Crusher is a former knight of the Geldwood church's subjugation unit who possesses the Evil Eye.

name.native: ヒュー・ザ・ダーク・アルジャーノンⅢ世

205904.description: Second oldest of the servamps and he is the servamp of pride. His eve is "Tetsu Sendagaya" and he only choosed him because his blood tastes good.

206201.description: Rim is a ferocious dragon that often takes the appearance of a little girl. In the exchange for a promise for tasty food, she helps [Kinji](https://anilist.co/character/179362/Kinji-Ninomiya) out. She has a voracious appetite.

206206.description: Yorimichi has played with Yuni since he was a baby. When he was younger, he wanted to become good at shogi and often went over to his grandfather's house to get lessons. He would also sometimes watch over and play with Kimichika Haijima and Yuni when they were little. As he got older, he became a delinquent and subsequently got abandoned as a lost cause by his relatives, but Yuni knew he had his good points and continued to hang out with him, even when he knew Yorimichi was sponging money off of him.

206208.description: Sotomura is a teacher at Satozakura High School, where [Junpei Yoshino](https://anilist.co/character/157214/Junpei--Yoshino) attends.

206330.description:
Tanjuro Kamadou was the husband of Kie Kamado and the late father of Tanjiro, Nezuko, Takeo, Hanako, Shigeru, and Rokuta.

Tanjuro was a quiet, calculating, forgiving, charismatic and loving person. He had a peaceful relationship with his family and regularly lectured Tanjiro about life.

While he appeared calm on the outside, he showed a decent, noble aura with a quiet perception to his surroundings. According to his son, he did not like standing out or displaying his true abilities to others. However, if his family is in danger, he would not hesitate to protect them and shows no mercy towards the enemy.

~!Despite not being a Demon Slayer and having a tragic disease that makes his body incredibly frail, Tanjuro was shown to be a phenomenally strong individual. He was born with a demon slayer mark on his forehead, had the ability to access the transparent world, and was constantly using the selfless state.!~

206331.description: Kozo Kanamori is a swordsmith affiliated with the Demon Slayer Corps.

name.native: ウェイン・サレマ・アルバレスト

206359.description:
Wein is the crown prince of Natra. He will take over the future of the country on behalf of his sick father. Although the retainers trust him due do his superior position, he is actually lazy. He wants to sell the deadlocked kingdom of Natra and lead a comfortable retired life.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

206364.description: In her first year of high school, and [Ozuma](https://anilist.co/character/206367)'s younger sister. As a sweet and charming honor student, she is well-liked at school. Out of school, she is a high-energy girl without a filter, who likes to get on [Akiteru](https://anilist.co/character/206365)'s nerves constantly. She is a highly talented voice actress. Her LIME profile picture is a tomato.

206365.description: The protagonist. In his second year of high school, and goes through life with the aim of living as efficiently as possible, having only [a single friend](https://anilist.co/character/206367) as a result. Considers himself as average as they come, but is secretly the director of the 05th Floor Alliance. His profile picture on LIME simply says: AKI.

206366.description: [Akiteru](https://anilist.co/character/206365)'s cousin, she's also in his class at school. Usually reserved, she is particularly cruel when it comes to Akiteru. She is a fan of everything under the sea. Her LIME profile picture is a seashell. ~!She secretly writes under the pen name of Makigai Namako. As Namako, her LIME profile picture is a sea cucumber.!~

206367.description: In the same class as [Akiteru](https://anilist.co/character/206365), and his only friend. Kindhearted and handsome, he feels he owes Akiteru a great deal for something that happened in the past. 05th Floor Alliance's genius programmer, his LIME profile picture reads: OZ.

206368.description: [Akiteru](https://anilist.co/character/206365)'s homeroom teacher. Beautiful and intelligent, she's known as the Venomous Queen among the students. She secretly works as an artist under the name Murasaki Shikibu- sensei, though she has trouble keeping deadlines. Her LIME icon is a bottle of sake, since she likes every type of it.

206374.description: Ninym is a beautiful white-haired, red-eyed Flahm girl who is [Wein](https://anilist.co/character/206359/Arbalest-Salema-Wein)'s childhood friend. As his top aide, she assists him in everything from affairs of the state to combat. She is among the few who know what he is really like, as well as the kingdom's current dire straits.

name.native: フラーニャ・エルク・アルバレスト

206489.description:
Yuki's childhood friend who learned sign language for her and is very good at it. 
He has known Yuki since their childhood and he is concerned about her relationship with Itsuomi since he's in love with her.

206490.description:
Rin is a friend of Yuki from the university. She is very supportive of Yuki's relationship with Itsuomi.

She likes Kyoya, Itsuomi's cousin.

206491.description: Itsuomi's cousin. He is a barista in a small bar.

206739.description: General of the Kingdom of Natra. A veteran of the battlefield, he is trusted by Wein with handling military affairs. He holds Wein's talents in high regard, and works to suppress the local lords who are dissatisfied with his leadership.

name.native: ロウェルミナ・アースワルド
alternative: Lowa Felbis (ロワ・フェルビス)

206741.description: The youngest princess of the Earthworld Empire and a former classmate of [Wein](https://anilist.co/character/206359/Arbalest-Salema-Wein) and [Ninym](https://anilist.co/character/206374/Ralei-Ninym).

207168.description: Another of Anna's close friends. The loudest and most energetic of Anna's circle.

207175.description: Yuki is a former elite assassin who abandons her violent past and asks to be employed as a maid by high school student [Hitoyoshi Yokoya](https://anilist.co/character/321802/Hitoyoshi-Yokoya). Having been raised solely to kill, she possesses overwhelming combat ability—particularly with knives—but lacks basic experience in ordinary daily life. As she adjusts to her new role, she gradually learns about trust, warmth, and what it means to live peacefully.

207272.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Lu Shaotang is the daughter of a Triad Family, which is always being hunted down for their wealth and to get revenge for the past actions of the family. She meets Sakamoto when he saves her from assassins sent to steal a key to her family's safe. In return, she would make pork buns for him and has worked at Sakamoto's store since.

~!Lu likes to drink, causing her to go into a "drunken mode" which powers her up in combat.!~

*Note: Lu was introduced with the wrong hanzi (小糖 instead of 少糖) which made her name Romanize as Xiaotang. In the first volume the mistake was noted and corrected, revealing her name should have been Shaotang. However, in the English release, Viz decided to keep using Xiaotang and have not corrected her name.*

207698.description:
A quick witted boy who Rika saves from a close encounter with a number of masked people.


He is nineteen years old and has future plans to work in the video gaming industry after college. His understanding of video games helps him to subsist in the high-rise world by putting himself in the perspective of a video game protagonist when in doubt.

207746.description:
__Species:__ God/Idaten

Ysley is a Idaten who was born about 100 years ago as a result of a natural outbreak. He can be said to be the brains of the Idaten side, and prefers to study rather than fight, but because he was naturally born, he began research to "learn about himself."

He attempted to train under Rin, but quit only two-three months after starting as he found her training to be brutal torture. He likes to study about past human civilizations and ruins. After a magical being appeared, he was pierced in the chest and defeated by it, but Hayato managed to defeat the being. Realizing that more demons will appear, Ysley decided to renew his training under Rin.

207747.description:
__Species:__ God/Idaten

Hayato is one of the Idaten training under [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/207766/), a new generation that was "summoned" by Rin about 80 years ago, but he is extremely brainless and only cares about becoming stronger himself. However, unlike Rin, who became strong out of a sense of responsibility towards the previous generation, and [Prontea](https://anilist.co/character/226660), who only became strong as a result of being beaten up, he has the potential to become the strongest as a Idaten who genuinely seeks power.

He often insults Rin calling her old, but usually gets beaten by her for it. When a magical being appeared after 800 years, he fought it and managed to defeat it.

207748.description:
__Species:__ God/Idaten

Paula was born about 16 years ago, after being "summoned" by [Prontea](https://anilist.co/character/226660), a disciple of [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/207766). She enjoys talking to birds more than fighting, and is good at silent movement.

The birds told Paula about humans gathering at the north and upon checking it, they found out that the humans were resurrecting a demon. Paula was no match for the demon, but [Hayato](https://anilist.co/character/207747) defeated it. [Isli](https://anilist.co/character/207746) suggested they train under Rin, Paula agreed but thought Isli was exaggerating how brutal Rin is, however, the moment Rin started training them, Paula quickly believed all of Isli stories about Rin.

207766.description:
__Species:__ God/Idaten

Rin is the only survivor of the battle against the demon tribe 800 years ago. She is an Idaten and the one who "summoned" Hayato and Prontea. She has been training Hayato and the others while guarding the seal that trapped the demon tribe. Her training is brutal and it involves beating Hayato and the rest to near death. She usually stays around the seal, but sometimes travel fast around the world looking for summoning spots. She is currently the strongest Idaten alive and is capable of generating a sword out of her body which gives her the ability to split apart regions and wreck havoc.

207783.description: She is the younger sister of Fengaril, a Garo tribe member who was one of the Four Heavenly Kings in the Demon King's army. She meets Flio and begins her tentative married life with him. As a Garo tribe member, she can be quick to pick a fight. Above all, she loves [Flio](https://anilist.co/character/207817/Flio).

207817.description: A kind-hearted young man who loves peace. He is suddenly summoned to another world as a "candidate for hero." He is banished because his abilities at level 1 were mediocre, but when he reaches level 2, his status changes to "∞." He obtains powers that ordinary people cannot handle.

207949.description:
Goto is a member of the Kakushi, the clean-up brigade of the Demon Slayers. He is the one who found a near-dead Tanjiro, Inosuke, and Zenitsu in the aftermath of the Entertainment District Arc. He possesses deep respect for the three because of their capability and bravery.

At one point in his life, he was found worthy of being a Demon Slayer, but for unknown reasons, he decided to become one of the Kakushi.

207953.description: Teruko is a young girl, accompanied by her brother Shoichi, who approaches Tanjiro Kamado and Zenitsu Agatsuma to help save her older brother from the Drum House.

207954.description: Kiyoshi is the elder brother of Shoichi and Teruko, who gets kidnapped by the Drum House Demon, Kyogai.

207955.description: Tokie is a resident of the village the Swamp Demon attacked and his final target.

207958.description: Kamanue was a member of the Twelve Kizuki, having held the position of Lower Rank 6.

207959.description: Mukago was a member of the Twelve Kizuki, having held the position of Lower Rank 4.

207961.description: Rokuro was a member of the Twelve Kizuki, having held the position of Lower Rank 2.

207989.description:
__Height:__ 150cm (4'11")

[Tsubasa Shiki's](https://anilist.co/character/142802/Shiki-Tsubasa) senpai or upperclassman one grade above him. 

She is a gal like [Fuyuki](https://anilist.co/character/142801/Fuyuki-Minami), who respects her a lot. She is really timid and insecure, even though she's considered really talented, especially at studying.

208124.description: A character that looks like a mushroom. Kadode Koyama's favorite manga (every volume starts off with a chapter of Isobeyan). Plays a bigger role in later volumes.

208126.description: Kiho's boyfriend who is into various subcultures.

208140.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Job:__ Healer VIII, Holy Dragoon I ~!later on his healer class would evolve into Sage I, Quad Dragoon IV!~

A young japanese salaryman killed by a gunshot and reincarnated by a goddess in an alternate, fantasy-like world as Luciel, a teenager blessed with healing magic. To make sure that he lives a long and happy life this time, Luciel works hard to improve himself.

~!During the events of Volume 8 of the light novel he would lose his holy magic affinity because of a taboo that he broke to save one of his companions and his master Brod and causing himself to die in the process and face a divine trail. During Volume 9 he would pass the trail given to him by the gods and become a sage giving him his affinity for holy magic back along with control over the other elements because of the dragons he has saved during his journey.!~

208338.description: Carrot is one of the characters in the Peach Boy Riverside series. She is a High Oni who was previously known as Meki that joins Sally on her travels after losing her powers. She is an Oni from the east.

208523.description: A second year college student, and the oldest of the main cast. She's a former child actress who was once regarded as a child genius, but her popularity gradually declined as she grew up. Riho is the most calculating and devious of the girls, putting more thought into managing the cafe than the owner, [Hayato](https://anilist.co/character/208525/Kasukabe-Hayato), himself.

208524.description: Part-time worker for the café. Writes music for her band.

208525.description: A Tokyo U student who returned to his Grandmother's café following her passing; now interim manager.

208526.description: A second year who attends the same college as Riho, and is the oldest of the main cast along with her. She is a talented cook who specializes in Japanese cuisine. Has a smell fetish. ~!She is revealed to be a childhood acquaintance of Hayato!~

208527.description: An energetic third-year high school student in the karate club, she works part-time at the Café. Her fighting style consists of moves from the Street Fighter series and other popular works.

208531.description: She is a Ranger and a member of Yellow Battalion, with the rank of Junior First Class.

name.native: ユミエラ・ドルクネス

208534.description:
A girl who reincarnated as the hidden final boss of the RPG otome game _Light Magic and the Hero_. She originally planned to live a peaceful life, but her "gamer soul" became fired up after her first time using her newfound magical powers in a dungeon, and she quickly became obsessed with leveling up.

Yumiella is stoic, logical, and has a phlegmatic expression; she struggles with social interaction, including understanding and building relationships. This, combined with her jet black hair that is feared and discriminated against in the kingdom, often leads others to be scared and distance themselves from her.  However, she never seems bothered by what others think about her, and isn't afraid to be herself. Even though she has problems expressing herself, she is truly a well-meaning and caring person.

name.native: アリシア・エンライト

208535.description:
Alicia is the heroine of the RPG otome game _Light Magic and the Hero_. She is a rare light magic user, which allowed her to attend the Royal Academy despite being a commoner.

Alicia has an optimistic and cheerful personality that's characteristic of a protagonist. She enrolled in the academy so that she could use her magic to help others.

~!After stabbing [Yumiella](https://anilist.co/character/208534/Yumiella-Dolkness), her fate is different depending on the version. In the web novel, she is killed by the demon lord; in the light novel, she is imprisoned for life after Yumiella pleads to spare her from execution. In the anime, it's the game's plot that forces her to attack Yumiella against her will, so she is spared from punishment, and [Edwin](https://anilist.co/character/313858/Edwin-Valschein) confesses his love for her.!~

208599.description: __Kiriko Kamata__ is an inspector working for the Police.

209017.description: [Sasaki](https://anilist.co/character/164753/Sasaki-Shuumei)'s classmate and friend, he's a bad boy. He shares the same music taste as Sasaki, has a girlfriend, wears an ear cuff, and has blue-dyed streaks in his hair.

209027.description: An 18-year-old figure skater from the Czech Republic, Emil has a pure heart and mannerly disposition, which makes it easy for Michele to boss him around. He has a dynamic skating style and likes playing extreme sports during the off-season, which makes his coach anxious.

209210.description: [Ema Yamato](https://anilist.co/character/209214/Ema-Yamato)'s coach. He is a former mens' singles who was strong enough to participate in the free skate in several national events before his retirement. He was born in Osaka and in his junior years, he won several tournaments in the Kansai block. He is a free-wheeling man, when he encounters a problem, he prefers to take it slow and formulate a plan instead of using guts and attitude to tackle it. As a coach, he attempts to dress as close to an elementary school teacher as possible around his students.

209212.description: Suzu is an elementary school student affiliated with Rengecha FSC. She won the silver medal in the All-Japan Novice B competition. She is the youngest of 4 sisters who have doted on her like a doll since a young age, causing her obsession with cuteness. She has an anti-aging plan for remaining cute, and constantly thinks about the philosophy of cuteness. If someone doesn't call her cute she will massage their face into a "Suzu face" and talk about the philosophy of cuteness for hours on end. She's hard on people who are hard on themselves and has cast-iron mental strength.

209214.description: Ema is a 4th grade elementary school student affiliated with Rengecha FSC. She was born in Kyoto and is long time friends with [Suzu.](https://anilist.co/character/209212/Suzu-Kamoto) Her cheeks are always red, and she is well behaved but not afraid to say what's on her mind. She is a hard worker who believes in actions over words. She is an only child and her tall height for her age makes her a motherly figure among her classmates. She doesn't dislike it, but she also likes Suzu treating her like a little sister.

209480.description: Rikya Yoshida is a God Candidate, and currently Rika's ally.

209532.description:
The firstborn prince of the Bosse Kingdom.
Bojji was born abnormally small, weak, and deaf. He is a powerless prince who has lived his life under the shadow of his father, the legendary [King Bosse](https://anilist.co/character/244198/). He wants to be the world's greatest king, following his father

Bojji is extremely hard-working and sincere, and these traits draw people towards him even if they can't always understand him.

~!He learns how to wield a sword thanks to [Despa](https://anilist.co/character/244201/). Despa helps him overcome his physical limitations, by making use of his agility and precision
It was later revealed that the reason why he is so weak is because back when his father was still a wandering adventurer, he made a deal with a demon to take the strength from his yet-unborn first son (Bojji) and give it to him. This made Bosse the strongest man in the world, but took away the physical strength of Bojji in turn.!~

209533.description: Kage is a literal shadow who becomes [Bojji](https://anilist.co/character/209532/Bojji)’s first friend.

209536.description:
Eiko is a competitive, stubborn, and mature young woman whose enthusiasm and talent for film-making have no bounds. She is also somewhat prickly and looks up to her older sister and professor Misaki Kanou. 

At the same time, she is able to empathize with others and holds herself to the same high standards she expects of her colleagues.

~!Later it is revealed that she also had romantic feelings towards Kyouya.!~

209694.description: A curse user working with Mahito. He loves picking on the weak.

209902.description:
Matsumoto is an AI that came to Vivy from 100 years into the future. Its mission as an AI is "to avoid the war between AI and humankind." To that end, its goal is to destroy AI with Vivy.

It is talkative, overconfident, and has a personality that is not like an AI.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

209903.description:
Vivy is the first autonomous humanoid AI in history. Her mission as an AI is to make everyone happy with her songs, thus she aims to sing with all her heart. She attaches great importance to promises and feelings, and is an AI "diva" that serves humankind.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

210062.description: Shouta is a high school student from Satozakura High School.
