210065.description: Yuki met Kamogawa Genji and Nekota Ginpachi at a boxing match in the 1940s. She befriended and lived with Kamogawa Genji and Nekota Ginpachi in their youth.

210154.description: Koukichi Muta is a Semi-Grade 1 sorcerer and a second-year student at Kyoto Jujutsu High. He attends school by controlling the cursed corpse Ultimate Mechamaru, as Muta was born with a sickly and fragile body due to a Heavenly Restriction. In exchange, he has a nearly boundless amount of cursed energy that spreads over a vast range.

210714.description: Takaharu's best friend who is good at sports, academics, and is popular.

210715.description: A waitress at a restaurant Kengo frequents.

210717.description: Koto is a child actress who began crying condiments.

210718.description: A man whose groin became a chikuwa.

210721.description: Takaharu is a high school student whose nails turned into chili peppers. When Takaharu realized that he had better academic and physical abilities as well as better physical appearance than his best friend, Tatsuya, he intentionally behaved to be normal at everything.

210722.description: Rio is the younger brother the family. He wishes for his mother to be able to hear his voice again.

210911.description:
Daiya is the leader of the fifth platoon. As an elite four-year veteran of the Eastern Battlefront, he has earned the personal name Black Dog. He and Anju have been in the same squadron since they were conscripted and are close friends. 

~! When his Juggernaut is surrounded by Self-Propelled Mines, moments before they detonate Daiya whispers Anju's name. He is mortally wounded in the explosion and is later euthanised by Shin, so that he won't be assimilated into the Legion. !~

210912.description: Haruto is the morale booster of the squadron, often times cheerful and joking.

name.native: ジェローム・カールシュタール

210920.description: He was Lena's superior in the Republic Armed Forces. Due to his close relationship with Lena's father, she thought of him as her uncle.

210921.description: The chief mechanic of the Spearhead Squadron. ~!He was an Alba married to a Heliodor wife, whom he had a daughter with. Due to them being taken away to the Eighty-Sixth Sector, he dyed his hair to go after them. By then, it was already too late, both of them had passed. In order to follow his family to the other side, he works as the chief mechanic of the First Ward's First Defensive Squadron of the Eastern Front.!~

name.native: アンリエッタ・ペンローズ

210923.description: A member of the Republic military and later the Eighty-Sixth Strike Package. She serves in the Research Division and specializes on working on the Para-RAID system her father helped develop.

211161.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Occupation:__ Mushroom Keeper

A mushroom protector with the nickname of "Man-Eating Mushroom" who is regarded as a terrorist and has a price on his head. He commands a giant crab named Actagawa that is also used as for transport.

211162.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

A young doctor with outstanding medical skills who runs the Panda Clinic. He has pale blue hair and a panda-like birthmark around his left eye which causes him to be referred to as Panda.

211163.description: Milo Nekoyangi's older sister who is stricken with the Rust disease. She is Captain of the Imihama Watch which defends society from "mushroom terrorists".

211164.description: A young female mercenary with plaited pink hair who is employed by Kurokawa.

name.native: コニー・クリステンセン

211553.description: Connie Christensen is a professional badminton player from Denmark and a former 1st year exchange student at Fredericia Girls. ~!She is also Hanesaki Ayano's adoptive sister.!~

211567.description:
__Height:__ 140 cm

Her comebacks are lightning fast. Showin' 'em what Naniwa girls are made of!

A small girl with an unmistakable Kansai dialect. Despite her size, she's a bundle of energy and is always ready for action, be it in a race or in everyday life. She grew up in a less fortunate environment, but her power comes from her persistent spirit—you won't find much getting her down. She and the effortlessly funny [Oguri Cap](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap) make for a good comedic duo.

211743.description:
A teacher in the Demon King Academy and the homeroom teacher of the 3rd year class 1. 
~!She becomes the temporary homeroom teacher of Anos's class after Emilia's resignation.!~

name.native: リーベスト・エイニー

211744.description: A student from Class 3-1 of the Demon King Academy. He holds a great respect for the founder, and antagonizes Anos for claiming to be him while not matching his image or personality.

alternative: Zeshia Kanon Ijaysica (ゼシア・カノン・イジェイシカ)

211756.description:
Rank 1 of the Hero Academy and member of the Jerga Kanon class.
~!She's in truth a massed produced humanoid magic created by Eleonore.!~

name.native: ディエゴ・カノン・イジェイシカ

211757.description:
The director of the Hero Academy and homeroom of the Selection Class "Jerga Kanon".
~!Like Zeshia, he's in truth humanoid magic created by Eleonore.!~

211764.description:
The general of the demon King Subjugation Army, as well as the mentor of the hero Kanon. Possesses a deep hatred against the demon race after they killed his family.

~!Due disagreeing with the idea of Kanon of making peace with the demon race, he murdered his own student. Later, he created the Hero Academy as a way to assure his hatred and animosity for demons would never be forgotten. Before dying, he divided his root into two; one half was fused with the spell Asc (making anyone who used it develop the same hatred for demons that Jerga did), while the other was used to create the humanoid magic Eleanore.

In the 13th episode, Diego revives him as the spell Demon Judgement Jerga, turning him into a gigant made of Holy Magic unable to be killed by conventional means.!~

212199.description: Mei's father, later Yuzu's new stepfather

name.native: ウィル・セルフォルト

212394.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")
__Race:__ Lyzance

Will Serfort is a sixth year student at the Regarden Magical Academy shunned by most students and faculty due to his lack of magical aptitude. To make up for his lack of magic, Will trains his body and swordsmanship in the dungeon.

212416.description:
Natsumi Ichikawa is Akari Seto's childhood and best friend. After graduating from high school, Natsumi chose not to continue her studies and work at her family's car mechanic factory. 

After Sorawo and Toriko helped her, she undertook the modification of the AP-1.

212447.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm

He is the third division vice-captain of the Tokyo Manji Gang.

212448.description: Langa's mother. She grew up in Japan and moved in Canada with her husband Oliver. When he died, she and Langa moved back to Japan. She cares a lot for her son, as she has shown panicking about Langa's injuries.

212567.description: He is regarded as the man who saved the continent of Hua Xio by defeating the demon king

212586.description:
__Race:__ Resans
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'5")

Only daughter of house Loire, a fallen family of nobles. She specializes in earth magic, but struggles considerably with any spell requiring precision. Colette befriended [Will](https://anilist.co/character/212394/Serfort-Will) following a certain incident during her first year at the academy.

212596.description: First lieutenant of the Sakuragi Family. Infamously known as "The Demon of Sakuragi".

212868.description: Madame Suliman serves as the king's royal sorcerer and is Howl's former mentor in magic.

213148.description: Ann Magnolia is a character in the Violet Evergarden series and the protagonist of the second chapter of the first volume of the light novel. She is a young girl who lives with her terminally ill [mother](https://anilist.co/character/223026/Clara-Magnolia).

213236.description:
Oka is the manager at Dope Sketch, he  appears to genuinely care about the wellbeing of his employees, especially Reki.

He demonstrates that he isn't afraid to be dramatic and tell jokes, such as when he led Reki and Langa to believe that the reason he couldn't deliver a package was due to needing to work to pay off Dope Sketch's debt.

213399.description: Lilia is the real form of Lily's anti-demon weapon. She pretends to be Lily's sister towards Lily's friends.

name.native: ローザ・プレヴィツカヤ

213449.description: Roza Plevitskaya is an Air Force Lieutenant and the only female cosmonaut candidate. She is a former ace pilot who was known as the "White Rose of Sungrad".

213450.description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Height__: 158 cm (5'1) 

She is treated by people as a cursed race and hates humans.

For a certain reason, she has a strong will to go to the moon and aims to become an astronaut.

name.native: アーニャ・シモニャン

213451.description:
She is a researcher at the institute of biomedical research.

She specializes in the ecological study of vampires and is responsible for checking Irina's medical data.

213452.description: Air force first lieutenant. Since he had longed to fly since childhood, he applied as an astronaut cadet. Has a strong sense of justice and tends to go against unreasonable things.

213554.description:
Though he aspired to become an adventurer, at the age of twelve he was deemed to possess "absolutely no talent whatsoever in anything." Yet, refusing to abandon his dream, he secluded himself in the mountains to hone his "Parry" skill—a dedication that eventually allowed him to grow capable of deflecting a thousand blades. 
~!
In truth, he possesses truly extraordinary abilities, though he remains the only one completely oblivious to them.!~

He is currently registered with the guild at the lowest possible rank, he spends his days simply performing menial chores around the town.

213739.description: A member of the gymnastics team at Hakumei University Affiliated High School.

213740.description: A member of the gymnastics team at Hakumei University Affiliated High School.

213741.description: A member of the gymnastics team at Hakumei University Affiliated High School.

213742.description: A member of the gymnastics team at Hakumei University Affiliated High School.

213743.description: A member of the gymnastics team at Hakumei University Affiliated High School.

213744.description: A member of the gymnastics team at Hakumei University Affiliated High School.

213745.description: The coach of the male rhythmic gymnastics club at Ao High.

213746.description: The manager of the male rhythmic gymnastics club at Ao High and a second-year student.

213747.description: Shoutarou's younger sister. She is still treated as the baby of the family despite being already a second-year junior high school student. She and her brother are close, and she loves her mother's homemade dumplings.

213748.description: The coach of Shiro High's men's rhythmic gymnastics team.

213803.description: Red ranger is known to be terrible with directions and has a strong sense of justice to defeat the General. His missions always ends up in ceasefire due to the General's off day.

213899.description: After his dad became a ranger, Blue ended up being chosen as a new ranger by Black.

alternative: Twilight Black (トワイライトブラック)

213900.description: The oldest of the current ranger group and the one who assembled the members. He is shown to look sleepy and uses difficult language. He always seems to be busy, and has the role as a guardian.

213901.description: One of the rangers of the Ranger organization. Despite her role to defeat the evil organization as a ranger, she dreams to be a magical girl.

214056.description: Yume moves in with her ex-boyfriend Mizuto Irido when their parents remarry. Loves reading, especially mystery novels. Used to be quite introverted and shy but put in the effort to socialize and become popular after entering high school.

214057.description: An introverted otaku girl that loves light novels. Despite generally poor grades, she was able to enter the same high-school as the rest of the characters, where she befriends Mizuto Irido due to their shared hobbies.

214058.description: Mizuto is a relatively introverted high-school boy with high intelligence and an interest in books of all kind. Moved in with his ex-girlfriend after their parents remarried.

214060.description: A cheerful, popular high school boy, and the self-proclaimed best friend of [Mizuto Irido](https://anilist.co/character/214058/Mizuto-Irido). He calls himself a "Read-Only Member" when it comes to love, declaring that he has no intention of pursuing it due to personal circumstances. He's also a close childhood friend of [Akatsuki Minami](https://anilist.co/character/214061/Akatsuki-Minami), a girl he appears to share a complicated past with...

214061.description: A short, athletic high school girl, and a good friend of [Yume Irido](https://anilist.co/character/214056/Yume-Irido). She’s chirpy, great at interacting and up-to-date in fashion sense and makeup, but she has a tendency to become obsessive when she begins to care about or like someone, both in friendships and romance. She's also a close childhood friend of [Kogure Kawanami](https://anilist.co/character/214060/Kogure-Kawanami), who she seems to share a complicated past with...

name.native: ベアトリクス・アメルハウザー

214581.description: She came all the way to Japan from Germany because she loves Japanese culture. She saved up money to visit but the apocalypse had already started once she arrived at the airport.

214582.description: Shizuka Mikazuki is a very rational girl who prefers to act alone. Her actions are determined by the benefits and risk of said situation. This is the main reason why she didn't join up with [Akira](https://anilist.co/character/214584) and [Kenichirou](https://anilist.co/character/214583) at first. Her personality is because of her upbringing. Her father was a successful business man. He was very strict and wanted her to be perfect, to succeed.

214583.description: An old friend of Akira Tendou from college and the rugby team. He hasn't seen him in a year before the apocalypse. After he graduated from college he became a salesmen at a major real estate company because of his great communication skills. In reality he seems almost perfect but he too was miserable at his job and wanted to become a comedian.

214584.description: Akira Tendou is a former employee of a company that earned the nickname Black Company (exploitative employment system). This job made Akira so miserable that he was excited that there was a zombie apocalypse because he didn't have to go to work.

214586.description: He is a former NEET and the leader of his group, consisting of people he found during the apocalypse's first days.

215030.description: Miku's classmate at Yuyu who is very friendly and energetic. She grew up in Southeast Asia. Because she does not go to Gatagata, she cannot be an official member of the DIY Club and is instead an external member.

215031.description: A third year student at Gatagata and head of the DIY Club. She has a strong passion for DIY, although this has led to some weird rumors about her around the school. Her family runs the Waku Waku Wan Wan hardware store.

215032.description: A laid-back first year of high school who grew up in a relaxed family. She has a delusional habit and soon becomes empty, hitting a wall or falling on the road and she is constantly injured. Even if the shirt sticks out, or if she has a terrible sleep, she doesn't care about "Oh, well!". Her hobby is graffiti.

215033.description: A shy first year student at Gatagata and Serufu's classmate, who also joins the DIY Club.

name.native: ジュリエット・クイーン・エリザベス8世

215034.description: A 12-year-old child genius from America who ended up enrolling at Gatagata instead of Yuyu due to a kanji mixup and is staying at Miku's house. As she doesn't like her full name, she received the nickname "Jobko" from Serufu after she hears her say "Good job!". She uses her genius skills and state-of-the-art technology to assist with her DIY projects.

215035.description: Serufu's childhood friend and neighbor who attends Yuyu Girls' Vocational High School for technology as a first-year student. She is nicknamed "Purin" by Serufu (and subsequently "Pudding" by Jobko) due to her habit of getting easily worked up and is often not honest about her feelings, particularly when it comes to Serufu.

215082.description:
__Height:__ 5'10"

She is a Kouka actress-aspirant at the Kouka School who stands out of the rest of the Centennial Class and the entire school, and not just because of her bubbly demeanor and being the tallest student in the school.

name.native: ベルザ・シューバッハ

215099.description: Belza Shuba'ha is the Director of Raiza'ha Demonite Mining Corporation, Detmolt branch. She is willing to sacrifice her employees if it will get her results.

215100.description: Ranga is an effeminite male mage. He followed Kinji Ninomiya from a messed up future in order to knock some sense into his ancestor from current times.

215101.description:
Shia Kinou is one of the main protagonists in Meikyuu Black Company.

She is a hero who is known for possessing The Philosopher's Stone by conquering The Fifth Floor of the dungeon.

alternative: Cosette Schneider (コゼット・シュナイダー)

215188.description:
L.V. Beethoven "Symphony No. 5 in C minor Op.67"

She is a Musicart who carries "Destiny" in her body. Despite her ladylike appearance, her facial expressions rarely change and her tone of voice is always calm and polite. At first glance, she looks pretty, but she has an unconventional personality, with a sharp tongue and a sweet tooth. She and her partner, the conductor [Takt](https://anilist.co/character/234535), have a deep and long past together.

~!Cosette used to take care of Takt in his childhood. One day during Symphonica Party, Cosette suggests Takt to play the piano to make his debut as a pianist, which Takt eventually gives into. Cosette joined him in a four hands rendition of popular Uptempo music, impressing everyone. Soon after the performance, the town got attacked by D2, with Takt and Cosette being the targets. Takt managed to survive, however Cosette was fatally injured. Upon her last moments, her white stone pendant (a Harmonia Crystal), awakened Destiny inside her.!~

215389.description:
Shun is Kuro's classmate who is incredibly gifted at making artistic creations. His father wants him to stop making things, telling Shun that his mother is at the hospital because Shun's creations are making her sad. 

~!His mysterious disease is that popcorn keeps popping out from his head.!~

215409.description:
__Race:__ Human

A woman known as the Calamity Witch who once brought chaos and destruction to the world. In the Goddess' Trial in the Sacred Land, she is summoned in reaction to Cid's presence and does battle with him in the form of Shadow. Her body is sealed in the sanctuary, and after helping Cid to escape she disappears together with its destruction. 

~!Aurora's true identity is the great demon Diabolos but it is unknown if she founded the Order of Diabolos or cursed the three heroes with possession. !~

215498.description: She is part of the brass band club who indirectly helps [Himari](https://anilist.co/character/167670/Kino-Himari)'s and [Yori](https://anilist.co/character/167671/Asanagi-Yori)'s relationship by collecting information.

215499.description:
__Skill:__ Elusiveness: combined techniques in running away, evasion, and stealth 
__Emblem:__ Mitsuuroko (Three Scales)

A boy in the Houjou clan who was expected to inherit the rule of the Kamakura shogunate. He excels at fleeing and is now gathering strength at Suwa Grand Shrine so he can use that skill in his efforts to reclaim the throne.

215602.description: She is a third-year high school student and the main vocalist for the band Laureley.

215603.description: She is a second year and President of the Culinary Research Club, she is also Laureley's bassist.

215605.description: She is a third-year student and keyboardist in SS GIRLS.

215606.description:
Aki is a third year high school student and the bassist for the SS Girls. She is best friends with [Yori](https://anilist.co/character/167671/Asanagi-Yori) and was one of the first people to encourage her to pursue [Himari](https://anilist.co/character/167670/Kino-Himari).

~!Yori and Aki are best friends. Aki sometime after they became friends fell in love with her, having wanted several times to take an "extra step" but decided to not confess her feelings and only stay by her side as a friend in fear of losing their current relationship.!~

215868.description:
__Height:__ 192cm

He is the former acting leader of Moebius following Osanai's defeat.

Hanma's single purpose is to find excitement, relieving his boredom by street violence. Hanma slowly sinks in to apathy since he was winning fights easily, without any resistance, that's why he sooner ally with [Kisaki Tetta](https://anilist.co/character/170483).

216142.description: Winnie, also known as Winnie the Witch, is a witch owning a bar nearby the Rimdarl Kingdom.

216426.description: The navigation system used by the employees of NiaLand. It has a foul mouth and speaks harshly to Vivy.

216729.description: Loccobarocco is the chief of Green Dolphin Street Prison. He uses an alligator puppet to communicate in tandem with people.

217043.description:
__Race:__ Vampire

Mary is a Vampire Hunter, dedicated in putting an end to [Elizabeth](https://anilist.co/character/217044/), the Vampire Queen.

217044.description:
__Race:__ Vampire

Elisabeth is one of the three monarchs of the Lawless City and the Queen of Vampires.

217045.description:
__Race:__ Therianthrope (Fox)

She is the ruler of the White Tower, a therianthrope known as a "Spirit Fox". Even Among the Spirit Fox clan she possesses exceptional talents and combat abilities, using an iron fan as her weapon to dance gracefully in battle. While she manages the red-light district in the Lawless City, she is also a savvy entrepreneur who runs a trading company called the Snow Fox Corporation

~!Later on, Yukime chooses to form an alliance between her faction and [Shadow's](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou), both organizations desiring to end the nuisance of the cult.!~

217145.description: An officer from the Vampire Control Division. She's the youngest Vice Captain in the Division's history. She wields dual blades while on duty. While she presents as firm and strict, she's easily flustered. She loves [Draluc](https://anilist.co/character/195177/Draluc)'s cooking, especially his cookies.

217146.description: John is a male armadillo and a familiar of [Draluc](https://anilist.co/character/195177/Draluc). He understands human language, but is unable to speak. As only Draluc can understand him, John uses gestures and signs to communicate with others. He gained immortality after officially becoming Draluc's familiar.

217147.description: [Hinaichi](https://anilist.co/character/217145/Hinaichi)'s subordinate. A dhampir and former high school classmate of [Ronaldo](https://anilist.co/character/195178/Ronaldo)'s. As a mama's boy, he hates that his vampire mother is a fan of Ronaldo's books and seeks to show her a less desirable side of the hunter. His hatred borders on obsession, his room decorated with Ronaldo posters and merchandise.

217265.description: Ritsuka is a skater from Okayama who competed in a Level 1 meet against [Inori.](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka)

name.native: アリサ・ミハイロヴナ・九条

217334.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Alisa Mikhailovna Kujou is a model student who boasts the highest grades in her school year and the student council accountant. Her nickname is Alya and she is the younger biological sister of [Maria Mikhailovna Kujou](https://anilist.co/character/291294/Kujou-Mariya). She is one of the two most beautiful girls in her school year, and is called the "Solitary Princess" because she is perceived as very cold and distant.

Alya is very hardworking to the point she loathes people who don't put in effort. When she was younger, she was disappointed with the lack of motivation from her classmates and this made her realize how ignorant they were, which created an unconscious condescension within her. Once she realized that, she drew a line in order to avoid any conflict with those around her, making her feel distant and reserved to others. For better or worse she doesn't rely on anyone.

217335.description: Masachika Kuze is an unmotivated underachiever who routinely stays up late indulging in his nerdy hobbies. The girl who sits next to him in class, Alisa, constantly gets after him. While his grade may be on the lower end, he actually understands Russian because of his paternal grandfather, who was a big lover of Russian Culture.

217336.description:
Aono Hajime was a prodigy violinist until he grew jaded with playing the violin due to personal reasons. Now in his third year of middle school, he struggles to decide his academic path. One day in school, he meets Akine Ritsuko, a hotheaded novice violinist who wants to enroll in a high school with a distinguished orchestra club. When he finds himself getting closer to Ritsuko and being brought back to the world of violinists, time starts moving again for him.

This is the beginning of a youthful drama where sounds and hearts alike resound in harmony.

217695.description: Sergeant First Class of Japan Self-Defense Forces and one of the female members of Itami's Third Recon Team. She also serves as the team's medic, and usually speaks in a calm and reserved manner, but has shown to be sharp tongued when she thinks the situation warrants it.

218187.description: A  neighborhood boy. He first met Saiki Kusuo after his balloon got blown up high and the latter caught it for him. He got attached to Kusuo and Kokomi in the later chapters. He is one of the few aware that Saiki has powers, but doesn't know he's a psychic.

218265.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Current landlord of Time Photography Studio. Grew up with Cheng Xiaoshi. Acts as the middleman and picks up commissions for Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang.

218266.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Skills:__ Basketball, Photography

Manager of Time Photography Studio. Rough around the edges, but good at heart. Often acts impulsively. In order to save his studio from going out of business, he works together with [Lu Guang](https://anilist.co/character/218267/Lu-Guang), using their powers to enter photos and fulfill client requests.

He can enter the world inside a photo and possess the photographer's body, temporarily controlling their words and actions.

218267.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Skills:__ Intelligence, Strategizing 
__Dislikes:__ Things being messed up after he's tidied them up, Plans being messed up
__Likes:__ Gourmet Food, Basketball, Reading, Sleeping, Sunbathing

Partner at Time Photography Studio. Calm and rational. Works together with [Cheng Xiaoshi](https://anilist.co/character/218266/Cheng-Xiaoshi) to fulfill client requests by acting as his guide and directing his actions.

He can foresee everything that happens inside a photo within 12 hours of it being taken; can share the consciousness of the person going into the photo through a high five and use this to direct their actions.

218333.description: She is the daughter of a second-generation Kouka actress and is in the same class as Sarasa and Ai.

218334.description: Being a huge Kouka fan, she enrolls at the Kouka School, skipping her chance to become a prima ballerina. She is the class representative of the Centennial Class.

218335.description: A former idol expelled from her group because of her trust issues with men, she applied at the Kouka School to escape her past and men in particular. She finds Sarasa, her classmate and dorm-mate, to be annoying at first.

218337.description: She is one half of the Sawada Twins. Inspired by a bunny lady twins they saw on a Kouka performance, she auditioned for the Kouka school with her twin sister, but delayed her admission when her other twin did not make it, which became a flashpoint in their relationship with each other.

218647.description:
__Sports Team:__ Badminton
__School:__ Eimei Junior and Senior High
__Year:__ Junior High Third-Year

A third-year middle school student and a member of Elmei Junior and Senior High's boys' badminton team. He is friends with both [Taiki Inomata](https://anilist.co/character/191242) and [Hina Chono](https://anilist.co/character/218648/Hina-Chono).

In the _Ao no Hako_ oneshot, Kyou is instead a member of his school's shogi club.

218648.description:
__Sports Team:__ Rhythmic Gymnastics
__School:__ Eimei Junior and Senior High
__Year:__ Junior High Third-Year

A third-year middle school student and a member of Eimei Junior and Senior High's girls' rhythmic gymnastics team. The youngest daughter of a former representative of the Japanese gymnastics team, Hina is considered a prodigy in the sport among her peers, having ranked fourth among all junior high school students in the country. While she doesn't consider herself to be a hard worker, Hina is willing to put in considerable amounts of effort if it results in her being able to achieve her goals.

Hina is friends with both [Kyou Kasahara](https://anilist.co/character/218647) and [Taiki Inomata](https://anilist.co/character/191242), frequently teasing the latter whenever the three hang out. She admires Taiki's headstrong stance towards tackling challenges.

218953.description: The titular character in the anime 'Love Hime' that Onoda loves to watch.

alternative: Dantoudai no Aura (断頭台のアウラ)

219110.description:
Aura is one of the Seven Sages of Destruction directly serving the Demon King. 

~!She later was killed by [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) after being commanded to kill herself using her own Auserlese.!~

219135.description: Urara is a 92nd Toutsuki Generation student and a popular idol at Toutsuki Culinary Academy. She is often an emcee for many of the academy's grand events.

219241.description: Wei Pang is a character from the Forest of Piano series. He is a Chinese pianist studying abroad in Poland. He is also one of the participants in the International Chopin Piano Competition and is favored to win. His piano style sounds very eerily similar to Ajino's before his accident.

219632.description: He was one of the 5 guest judges of Block "B" for the 43rd Annual Tōtsuki Autumn Election. A renowned entrepreneur and a founder of his own Gastronomy Club, Osaji's reputation in both his wealth and influence has made him a celebrity in the cooking industry.

219633.description: Natsume Sendawara is one of the heads of the Haubi Food Corporation along with her twin sister, Orie Sendawara, and one of the five judges of Block A in the 43rd Annual Tōtsuki Autumn Election Preliminaries

219634.description: Orie Sendawara is one of the heads of the Haubi Food Cooperation along with her twin sister, Natsume Sendawara, and was one of the five judges of the B Block in the 43rd Annual Tōtsuki Autumn Election.

219665.description: A 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student. Like her fellow schoolmate, Urara Kawashima, she is also an MC for hosting important events occurring around and within Tōtsuki Culinary Academy.

219696.description: Mayumi Kurase is Sōma Yukihira's close friend and one of his former classmates from kindergarten to middle school.

219697.description: Yūya Tomita is the chairman of the Sumiredōri Shopping District and the 2nd generation owner of Tomitaya.

219732.description: He is an elf that Frieren's group meets in a cabin in the mountains. He's a monk and believed to be the last elf alive until meeting Frieren.

219733.description: She lived a millennium before the story and was [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren)'s teacher.

219734.description: An elven mage who is said to possess knowledge about nearly every magic that exists. She was Flamme's master. She founded the Continental Magic Association around 20 years before Himmel's death. First-class mages get the privilege of meeting her and can ask for any magic they desire.

219951.description: Shigeno Kuraki is one of the three judges who appeared in Sōma Yukihira's Shokugeki against Ikumi Mito and she is also the president of the traditional Japanese restaurant called Kuraki.

name.native: トナ・パピク・カジマヒデ

220235.description: He is a shaman from Akranes, Iceland and is a member of The Icemen.

220281.description: Shigenoshin Kouda is a gourmet critique and one of the five judges of Block A in the 43rd Annual Tōtsuki Autumn Election.

220282.description: Madoka Enomoto is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student and a member of the Miyazato Seminar. She adores [Marui](https://anilist.co/character/88721/Zenji-Marui).

220283.description: Tokihiko Sakuma is the Maître d'hôtel of the Tōtsuki Resort and one of the judges during the Egg Breakfast Buffet Challenge at the Tōtsuki Friendship and Rapport Training Camp.

220284.description: Yoshiaki Nikaidō is one of the students who attempted to enter Tōtsuki Culinary Academy alongside Sōma Yukihira. His family owns an unnamed French restaurant.

220285.description: Hiromi Sena is the Vice Chef De Cuisine, Sous Chef to Gin Dōjima at Tōtsuki Resort, and a minor character of the series.

220286.description: Takao Miyazato is one of the lecturers in Tōtsuki Culinary Academy as well as the professor of the Miyazato Seminar. He is among the few who recognizes Zenji Marui's true talent behind his frail endurance.

220287.description: Makito Minatozaka is an exclusive producer of a popular television program called Is That A Kitchen?. He is also one of the five judges in Block A in the 43rd Annual Tōtsuki Autumn Election

220288.description: Takumi Ishiwatari is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student.

220289.description: Yoshiki Bitou is a Japanese black beef critic and one of the three judges involved in Sōma Yukihira's Shokugeki against Ikumi Mito.

220290.description: Katsunori Okamoto is the television producer of First-Class Gluttons, and one of the three judges involved in Sōma Yukihira's Shokugeki against Ikumi Mito.

220599.description:
A civil engineering AI that operates on the unmanned offshore plant, Metal Float. Its mission as an AI is to "contribute to the development of the Metal Float for the benefit of humanity." It shares the same build as several other AI on the island.
(Official Site, translated)

220835.description:
Sayuri's childhood friend and underclassman one grade below her. A member of the swim team, she is athletic and has short hair and a dark complexion. Asuka tries to support Sayuri and her romantic feelings for Tsubasa as much as she can.

(Source: Wikipedia)

220836.description:
Asuka's friend and classmate who calls herself Minami's biggest fan. She has long hair and wears big glasses. Having gone to the same middle school as Minami, she is obsessed with her as she resembles her favorite fictional character. Hina follows Minami on the internet and thoroughly researches everything around her, including Tsubasa.

(Source: Wikipedia)

221395.description:
He is a student at the Royal School of Magic in the Kingdom of Wenias, and the main protagonist of the series. As a result of his grades being at the bottom of the class, he was ordered to participate in special training as remedy to avoid expulsion. 

Before awakening his powers, he was known to be unable to use spells. ~!He is actually born with limitless magic and can be considered to be more powerful than other mages. However, he was unable to control it during his early days at the academy!~

~!Later it is revealed by [Zero](https://anilist.co/character/126102/Zero) that he is her nephew, as well as the son of her brother, [Thirteen](https://anilist.co/character/142956/Juusanban).!~

221477.description: Xiaochun Bai at first has a cowardly personality, so much so that he put off becoming an Immortal for three years just because he was afraid that the lightning that the incense conjured would strike and kill him. Even though he is a cultivator, he is a pacifist and tries to not fight as much as possible. His main pursuit in life is to live forever.

221478.description: Du Lingfei is an Outer Sect Disciple of Fragrant Cloud Peak of South Bank in Spirit Stream Sect.

221479.description: Hou Xiaomei is an Outer Sect Disciple of Fragrant Cloud Peak of South Bank in Spirit Stream Sect, member of Hou Clan and little sister of Hou Yunfei.

221491.description: Kyūsaku is the owner of Natural Cheese's Kyūsaku, a partner of the Tōtsuki Culinary Academy Manufacturer Division, and a food supplier to Tōtsuki Resort.

221492.description: Akari Miyano was a guest at the Tōtsuki Resort and participated as a judge for the breakfast buffet task for the 92nd Tōtsuki Generation's Tōtsuki Friendship and Rapport Training Camp.

221493.description: Kōsuke is the owner of Green Bean's Kōsuke, a partner of the Tōtsuki Culinary Academy Manufacturer Division, and a food supplier to Tōtsuki Resort.

221991.description: [Reijiro Enokizu's](https://anilist.co/character/17495/Reijiro-Enokizu) secretary who lives and works at the "Rose and Cross" detective agency.

222104.description:
An apprentice healer in training at Karasuma Voice Treatment Center.
She is a happy and upbeat person who enjoys singing. She pines for the healer who assisted her as a youngster.

(Source: Official Site, translated, edited)

222105.description:
A first-year high school student who attends the same school as [Kana](https://anilist.co/character/222104).

(Source: Official Site, translated)

222106.description:
A noble and respectable young lady. She works at the Karasuma Voice Clinic with [Kana](https://anilist.co/character/222104/Kana-Fujii) and [Hibiki](https://anilist.co/character/222107/Hibiki-Morishima) with the goal of becoming a healer.

(Source: Official Site, translated, edited)

222107.description: An apprentice healer who loves to sing. She is the eldest sister of 6 brothers and sisters, so she takes good care of everyone and is great at cooking. Her parents' are part-time farmers living in the country. She currently lives in a room at Karasuma Voice Treatment Center.

222258.description:
Shizuka is a baby found on the side of a road in Morioh by Joseph Joestar, who subsequently adopts her. Incidentally, she is a Stand User who can turn invisible thanks to her Achtung Baby. Her face is made visible only when covered by makeup, upon which Joseph and Josuke agree that she is cute.

She wears a range of soft, light baby clothing, including a small, bobbled knit cap, and large, dark glasses (designed to hide her invisible eyes).

222593.description: He is a young male student with a firm belief that UFOs and aliens exist. Upon meeting [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Ayase-Momo) and taking up on her challenge to see if ghosts were real, Okarun became cursed by a yokai known as the [Turbo-Granny](https://anilist.co/character/239956/Turbo-Babaa) and seeks to return to normal.

222594.description: After making friends with [Ken Takakura](https://anilist.co/character/222593), who she calls "Okarun" (due to refusing to call him by the same name as the actor she idolizes), Momo wishes to help restore his body back to normal after being cursed by a yokai and must overcome other paranormal activities that are involved.

name.native: オスカー・ウェブスター

223023.description: A playwright who used to seclude himself due to the deaths of his wife and daughter. However, after deciding to write his very first children's play to dedicate it to his daughter's memory, he entrusts Violet with the task of putting his ideas on paper.

name.native: クラーラ・マグノリア

223026.description: She is the mother of [Ann](https://anilist.co/character/213148/Ann-Magnolia), who had a terminal illness and predicted that her fate was close.

223243.description: She is the Chieftess of the Patch Tribe.

223346.description:
__Height:__ 175cm

Owner of a farm in Southern Denmark, and father of Thorgil and Olmar. ~!Thorfinn, Einar and Arnheid work his farm as slaves!~

223533.description: The half-sibling of Tetsuhiko Kai. She introduces herself as the "Jack of All Trades".

223752.description: Chikami is a good friend of Suzu, who attends the same high school as her. He is a hot-blooded boy who set up a canoe club all by himself and aims for inter-school athletic success. He can be a little airheaded at times and tends to joke about girls having crushes on him. As a skilled canoeist, he eventually manages to quality for the national championship.

223786.description: Kuroha, Midori and Akane's little sister.

name.native: ショーレイ・ノウゼン

224075.description:
Shinei's older brother. Rei was a generally friendly and reliable older brother, but he was not without his faults.

~!One night when he was on patrol, he came across a young Vladilena Milizé, who was taken by her father to see the injustices brought upon the Eighty-Six. Their helicopter had been shot by a Stachelschwein and was forced to land, leaving them vulnerable to an attack from a nearby Ameise. He took the only survivor, Lena, to his base and sent her back to inside the Gran Mur.!~

224083.description: A frequent side character. He is somehow a delinquent with as seen when he fakes being sick to skip the School Year Opening Ceremony and then puts the blame on Nendō and Kusuo, and gets himself into convoluted schemes with his circle of friends; but overall he just is a nuisance to deal with.

225128.description:
__Height:__ 170cm (5'7)
__Ability:__
~!Nagara develops a power that currently has no official name, but has been described as "Warp" or "Escape" by other characters, which allows for the transportation between 'dimensions.'!~

Nagara has long hair and wears the uniform the rest of his classmates do. Nagara is bored with the environment around him and feels like giving up on life. He has trouble communicating with his family and the students at school keep their distance and watch him with a cold attitude.

225129.description:
__Height:__ 165cm (5'5)
__Ability:__
~! Nozomi has developed a "compass" that allows her to see a light that indicates a point anywhere. !~

Nozomi has a strong will and never bends herself, no matter how difficult the situation is.

225130.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")
__Ability:__
~!Nyamazon, which allows cats to bring her whatever she wants.!~

A third-year high school student who always carries her grandmother's three cats, Tora, Gen, and Sakura, in a tote bag. Mizuho's personality is fast-paced and moody, and honest. She does not actively get involved with the people around her and is isolated.

~!Mizuho's power was thought to be "Nyamazon", which allows cats to bring her whatever she wants. It was later revealed that this was just the power of her cats.!~

225131.description:
__Ability:__ A form of gravity control

A rebellious boy caught up in the drifting incident. He opposes the student council's attempts at control.

225314.description:
__Sports Team:__ Badminton
__School:__ Eimei Junior and Senior High
__Year:__ High School Second-Year

A second-year high school student and a member of Elmei Junior and Senior High's boys' badminton team. He placed third in the prefectural qualifiers for badminton, barely missing the mark to qualify for nationals.

225401.description: PK Academy's gym teacher and guidance counselor.

226514.description: Millia, also known as Hatsuki, is a Middle Oni that is capable of controlling her hair.

226661.description:
__Race:__ Demon

Piscalat is a General of the Zoble army. She leads the army with overwhelming power, but is a naive and shy maiden when it comes to sexual matters. She was leading the army into plundering and raping citizens, but [Oobami](https://anilist.co/character/207745/Oobami-Hakase) summoned her back to the capital.

228925.description: Head cardinal who holds substantial authority in the church. He hires an assassin in an effort to kill Lumachina because she is questioning the church's authority.

229290.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

She is a serious person with a strong sense of justice. Whenever one of her classmates behaves in a frivolous manner, she scolds them. But every time she does so, [Ali](https://anilist.co/character/229291/Maud-Ali) calms her down. She shows glimpses of a strong connection with Ali that goes beyond friendship.

229291.description:
__Height:__ 152 cm

She has a calm personality, always smiling, and is more mature than the other students. She has a bold personality and expresses her thoughts directly, which makes [Seiran](https://anilist.co/character/229290/Lizzy-Seiran) worry about her.

229464.description:
She is the adopted daughter of Benkei Kuruma. She holds a secret about her origin due to a mental block that was present when Benkei adopted her. She forms part of the new Getter team alongside Go and Gai, piloting the Shin Getter-2. ~!She is truly the daughter of Professor Saotome, raised as a boy until she became amnesiac and Benkei took her in.!~

Her name and appearance are derived from [Kei Minamikaze](https://anilist.co/character/8661) from the Getter Robo G manga. Otherwise, they are completely different characters.

229652.description:
__Race:__ Human

Akane Nishino is the daughter of the CEO of Nishino Conglomerate and the former classmate of [Minoru Kagenou](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Kagenou-Cid), Cid's pre-reincarnated self.

alternative: Elven Sword Saint Goddess of War

229656.description:
__Race:__ Elf

Beatrix is the champion of the God of War Tournament.

~!She is presumed to be the long lost aunt of [Alpha](https://anilist.co/character/162246/Alpha).!~

229658.description:
__Race:__ Elf

665 is a member of Shadow Garden's Numbers and is in a squad with [664](https://anilist.co/character/229662/No664) and 666. She has a calm personality and is good at providing support.

229662.description: 664 is a member of Shadow Garden's Numbers and is the squad leader of the squad with [665](https://anilist.co/character/229658/No665) and 666. She has a serious personality, but is kind at heart.

230123.description:
The Mother is the Servamp of Wrath and the fourth oldest of the eight Servamps. The Mother is currently under a temporary contract with [Izuna Nobel](https://anilist.co/character/230115/Izuna-Nobel) as her Eve. She is also the only female Servamp.

Being the Servamp of Wrath, she takes that trait herself, always looking grouchy or frowning, giving an impression that she's angry; [Mahiru](https://anilist.co/character/87273/Mahiru-Shirota) assumes she is angry when they first meet, but she claims that she is only acting cool. Despite her alias, she is kind to other Servamps and her Subclasses. Although, this does not stop [Lily](https://anilist.co/character/121997/Snow-Lily) from being afraid of her. It is said that she will not get very angry without a valid reason.

230204.description:
__Height:__ 169 cm

Haruka Sakura is a high school student in his first year. He attends Fuurin, a school known as a delinquent school, with aspirations to reach the top. He admires strong people. Rejected by others for his rough appearance, being alone was natural for him.  Hated by others and sitting at the bottom of the social strata, Sakura believes fighting is his only saving grace and that by winning those fights, he thinks he can feel his worth. He tries to keep an image of a ruthless and tough exterior, but in reality, he is kind-hearted. He easily gets embarrassed by compliments on his good acts. 

(Source: Official Website)

230208.description: She is the girlfriend of Itsuki Akazawa. An active and light-headed person, Chitose is extremely honest with her words. Thanks to her energetic personality, she was able to befriend Mahiru Shiina and allow her to show her true personality more.

230209.description: Handsome, smart and kind boy. He is the most popular boy in his year, often called the Prince. He has good grades, and is a target of many girls.

230210.description:
Itsuki is the best friend of [Amane Fujimiya](https://anilist.co/character/195601/Amane-Fujimiya) and boyfriend of [Chitose Shirakawa](https://anilist.co/character/230208/Chitose-Shirakawa).

He is really honest, although he is sometimes impulsive, acting before thinking, which has caused him trouble.

230438.description: The Master belongs to the de Sade aristocracy - being the grandfather of [Dominique de Sade](https://anilist.co/character/139553/de-Sade-Dominique) - and is widely feared by many.

230536.description: A busty hunter dressed as a nun from [Ronaldo](https://anilist.co/character/195178/Ronaldo)'s  guild whose main job is being a Matagi, hunting bears.

230537.description: A vampire hunter from [Ronaldo](https://anilist.co/character/195178/Ronaldo)'s guild with metal armor on his left arm. A reformed delinquent, he keeps his composure under most situations but his past will surface if he's angered.

230539.description: The captain of the Vampire Control Division and [Ronaldo](https://anilist.co/character/195178/Ronaldo)'s older brother. He used to be a hunter.

230800.description: Sati Saigan is the leader of the Gandhara group, one of the three great powers in the Shaman Fights. She is also the team leader of Team "Nyorai".

230873.description: A first-year student at Tsuwabuki High School and one of the loser heroines. She is a popular girl in [Kazuhiko](https://anilist.co/character/230874)'s class with a bright and charming personality as well as a big appetite, often bickering with Kazuhiko when he says anything to her about gaining weight.

230874.description: Kazuhiko is a student in Class 1-C at Tsuwabuki High School and the president of the Literature Club. He is fairly intelligent and quite experienced in handling girls' issues due to taking care of his little sister. He also has a terrible sense of style, much to the chagrin of his more popular and fashionable friend, [Anna Yanami](https://anilist.co/character/230873/Anna-Yanami).

230875.description: Kaju is the younger sister of [Kazuhiko Nukumizu](https://anilist.co/character/230874/Kazuhiko-Nukumizu).

230876.description: A first-year student at Tsuwabuki High and a member of the Literature Club, she is an avid web/light novel reader and writer. Behind her timid and awkward exterior lies a hardworking girl who deeply cares for her siblings and treasures her closest relationships.

230877.description: A first-year student of Tsuwabuki High School. She's the ace of the Female Track and Field Team and also a member of the Literature Club. She has romantic feelings for her long-time friend [Mitsuki Ayano](https://anilist.co/character/341640/) and is currently friends with Ayano's girlfriend [Chihaya Asagumo](https://anilist.co/character/341637/).

231129.description: [King Bosse](https://anilist.co/character/244198/)'s second wife, current Queen. She is [Daida](https://anilist.co/character/231128/)'s biological mother and [Bojji](https://anilist.co/character/209532/Bojji)'s step mother. Originally a priestess from a neighboring territory/kingdom.

231316.description: He is one of The BoZ Brothers. They are two of Hao's followers and a group of rock monks. He is part of Team "Tsuchi-Gumi".

231317.description: He is one of The BoZ Brothers. They are two of Hao's followers and a group of rock monks. He is part of Team "Tsuchi-Gumi".

231590.description: Stigma is the leader of Amalareiks

231851.description:
**Height:** 152 cm (5'0")

Misha is Rae's best friend and roommate at the Academy. She is a noble from a house that fell from grace and became impoverished. Despite the Jur family's struggles with money, she still holds some reputation. She is accepting of her position and, rather than hold onto the noble status, portrays herself as equal among people with common background. This allowed for Rae and Misha to form their longstanding friendship.

231853.description:
**Height:** 154 cm (5'1")

Lene is the eldest daughter of a wealthy merchant family, Aurosseau. She loyally serves Claire François as her personal maid. Lene seems very patient, and comes off as meek and subservient, but in reality, she just knows how to handle Claire very well after years of serving her.

232038.description:
Milagro Man is the Stand of a weapon merchant from a certain era, featured in JoJolion.
The story of Milagro Man's curse originated from its ability. At its most basic, the Stand can create and duplicate money, with the legal tender changing depending on the country the Stand's money is currently in. The money appears to be generated from the corners of other bills, out of thin air as well. None of the bills are exactly identical, but they all have a serial number ending in "13R". Anyone afflicted by Milagro Man's power through simple touch will constantly earn money until they are literally buried in cash, eventually resulting in death via crushing or asphyxiation. No matter how they try to spend or destroy the money, it will be returned to them and they will somehow receive more money than they originally spent. The only way to escape Milagro Man's power is to return the money to the previous owner or have the money destroyed by another person, after which Milagro Man is transferred to the new victim.

(Source: Jojo's Bizarre Adventure Wiki)

name.native: アオヤマ君のお父さん

232344.description: A well-posed man. He leaves for international work trips.

232362.description: Mark is a German soldier and a friend of Caesar Zeppeli who participated in the effort for stopping the Pillar Men's awakening.

232658.description:
The mysterious mastermind for the Hijacking Bus Incident on December 21st. 
~!He is the main antagonist in Punchline. He is a leader of the Qmay Group and is a "W". Apparently, he is in charge of everything regarding the project to hijack [Meika's](https://anilist.co/character/88905/) hacking of the US satellite. He is the mastermind for the Hijacking Bus Incident, and the real identity of Gliese. He is currently on the run from the police.!~
~! His true identity is Guriko, the third child at the Uber Lab with [Pine](https://anilist.co/character/88902/Yuuta-Iridatsu) and [Chiyoko.](https://anilist.co/character/88903/Mikatan-Narugino) During the accident, Guriko's soul ended up in Pine's body which was taken back to the lab by the Qmay Group.!~

(Source: Punch Line Fandom)

name.native: オブラディ・オブラダ

232910.description:
__Favorite Food__: Blood and body fluids
__Species__: Rock Insect

name.native: ドゥードゥードゥー・デ・ダーダーダー
alternative: Do Do Do De Da Da Da

233052.description: Policeman working at Musashino train station.

233081.description: [Yoriko's](https://anilist.co/character/17482/Yoriko-Kusumoto) mother and Hina doll head maker.

233082.description: Victim number four. The daughter of a photo studio in Kawasaki.

233083.description: A pre-war friend of [Shutaro Kiba](https://anilist.co/character/16912/Shutaro-Kiba) and [Reijiro Enokizu](https://anilist.co/character/17495/Reijiro-Enokizu). Is currently a director.

233805.description: ~!Chonbo is one of the Valhalla captains and expert fighters. !~

233815.description: ~!Chome is one of the Valhalla captains and also one of its expert fighters. !~

234535.description:
A conductor who made a contract with the Musicart "Unmei." He has the idea that "music is prioritized in everything."

(Source: Official Site, translated)

His father was Kenji Asahina, a famous conductor killed in the Boston tragedy incident.

234728.description:
__Stand__: Schott Key No.1
__Species__: Rock Human
__Affiliation__: Locacaca Organization (Damokan Group)

One of the A. Phex Brothers (エイ・フェックス兄弟).

234729.description:
__Stand:__ Schott Key No.2
__Species:__ Rock Human
__Affiliation:__ Locacaca Organization (Damokan Group)

The younger brother of the A. Phex Brothers (エイ・フェックス兄弟).

234803.description: Mitsumi's classmate who approached her after Mitsumi became friends with Sousuke. Mitsumi's pure nature inspired her to face her complexes. She develops a caring relationship with Mitsumi.

234805.description: Fumino is Mitsumi's childhood friend. She remains in Ishikawa while Mitski attends high school in Tokyo. Despite the distance, the two remain best friends, frequently catching up over video calls, and confiding in each other.

234810.description: Second-year student council member. An extreme perfectionist who voluntarily follows a strict daily schedule. She had a stoic personality but became kinder upon meeting Mitsumi.

234824.description: [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Ayase-Momo)'s grandmother. Despite being a grandmother, Seiko possesses a youthful appearance that does not match her age and is recognized as being quite beautiful.

235171.description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Jersey Number:__ 30
__Position:__ MF

A first year student and midfielder playing for Tokyo City Esperion FC's Youth Team. He’s the team’s mood-maker, always looking out for everyone. He gets incredibly nervous before matches, but once the game starts, he’s a midfielder who controls the team with cool, level-headed judgment.

 In everyday life, he’s a bit of a joker who tries desperately to impress girls, but his efforts fall flat (despite his best efforts).

235446.description:
Fascinated by This World around him, Rajdhani investigates how and why the students went adrift in a logical and calculating manner. He can get along with most people and he briefs everyone on his findings openly. Rajdhani is rational, scientific and decisive in nature.

Rajdhani has the power of "Pocket Computer" by which he can design a program which then comes to life. With this ability he creates many useful "gadgets and tools" which aid in uncovering the truth within This World.

238729.description:
Fumi is a young man living in 1941 Morioh who accepts a job offer from Lucy Steel to be her local guide and carry her luggage and camera equipment.

~!In chapter 110, his real name is revealed to be Joseph Joestar, the grandson of Johnny Joestar. He wields a stand similar to that of his counterpart, capable of producing vines that he can control. Unlike the original Hermit Purple, this Stand also has a somewhat humanoid shape with at least a fully formed head.!~

238829.description: Sett looks like a large humanoid walrus. He has two long tusks and one big black Oni horn on top of his head.

238990.description: She is an Automaton and the supervisor of the Ruin Ark. She appears to be around eleven or twelve years of age. She has light green hair and red eyes. She has mechanical rabbit ears on her head, her feature as an Automaton.

239687.description:
__Height:__ 145 cm

A kobold who joined Kabru's party alongside Mickbell. This loyal kobold never wavers in his dedication to his master.

(Source: Dungeon Meshi World Guide: Boukensha Bible)

239921.description: The mother of [Ashito](https://anilist.co/character/133818/Ashito--Aoi) and [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/239920/Shun-Aoi), and the owner of the family's store. She currently resides in Ehime with Shun while Ashito is away in Tokyo.

239956.description:
The yokai took on the form of a very elderly woman with long white shaggy hair and eyes that were stuck looking to the sides. When possessing her targets, she has her victims transform into a mirror image of herself, albeit with a large mouth with teeth that is capable of biting off body parts.

~!After having her consciousness extracted from [Okarun](https://anilist.co/character/222593/Takakura-Ken), the Turbo-Granny is forced to inhabit a maneki-neko doll.!~

242576.description:
An old woman from Bucciarati's neighbourhood who is well acquainted with the latter and respects him as an honorable gangster. However, she brings one of her friends to him and questions him about the drug flowing in Naples, hoping that he isn't among the ones responsible for the drug.
She is named only in the anime adaptation.

242577.description: The woman who performed an autopsy on Diavolo, file number 68, as his second death after he was cut and killed by a drug addict on Tiber river.

name.native: パオロ・ブチャラティ

242578.description: Bruno Bucciarati's father, he wasn't social but he was a kind-hearted fisherman. He did all he could to protect his family from the cruelties of the world. When he and his wife were in their 10th year of marriage and their son was 7 years old, they decided to get divorced. Bruno decides to stay with his father, as the young boy knew his father would be the saddest about the separation. Bruno's father originally thought his son would become a fisherman like him when he grew up, but after the divorce he hoped Bruno would go to a nice school in the city, so he worked diligently to afford Bruno's tuition.

242581.description: Narancia Ghirga's mother is only mentioned in a flashback, where it is stated that she died in 1994 from an eye infection when Narancia was only 10 years old. Despite the fact that Narancia's own eye infection was a mere coincidence after being beaten up by police officers, all of his friends were convinced that it was contagious and that he got it from his mother. Narancia himself began to believe the rumor and was frightened that he would die at any time, all alone. The anime shows her date of birth and date of death to be respectively September 21, 1958 and January 16, 1994.

243034.description: She is Trish Una's mother and was, at some point, Solido Naso's girlfriend. Shortly before her death, she went looking for Solido Naso, making the Boss aware of his daughter's existence and triggering a war between Passione and La Squadra di Esecuzione in order to secure the only lead to the Boss.

243192.description: He is a member of the X-Laws and is a part of and the team leader of Team "X-III". He once served in the military fighting off terrorists in the middle east.

243193.description: A member of the X-Laws and Team "X-II", Porf has, like the rest of the X-Laws, suffered in some way by the hands of Asakura Hao. He was once a member of the U.S. Delta Forces.

243194.description: He is a member of the X-Laws and Team "X-II" and he was once a member of U.S. Delta Forces. His guardian ghost is Archangel Uriel.

243404.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm

Yuki Suou is a proper young lady from a family of former nobility. She is the student council publicist and former middle school student council president. She is one of the two most beautiful girls in her school year, and is called the "Noble Princess". She is childhood friends with [Masachika](https://anilist.co/character/217335/Kuze-Masachika).

243572.description: Hansen is a character affiliated with the Ikebukuro Criminal Black Members.

243575.description: Gariman is the leader of Night Dust, a top gang in tokyo, which governs the Ueno territory.

243882.description: He is a Vampire created by Kars tasked with guarding the hotel Kars is hiding in and briefly battles Lisa Lisa.

244077.description: Yuuto Sakurai is the younger brother of [Touko Sakurai](https://anilist.co/character/131619). He used his enrollment in high school as an opportunity to move to his sister's town.

244078.description:
**Height**: 160 cm (5'3")

Tsukishiro has a unique presence and manner of speaking. Her behavior and activity is quite strange, like bringing a love article into the office or licking Igarashi's fingers to heal her papercut.

She often uses Russian phrases when greeting people.

244317.description: Gaoshun is [Jinshi](https://anilist.co/character/127278/Jinshi)'s attendant. He's shown to be extremely dependable. A stern believer in deference to authority and proper etiquette, his disapproval is often splattered in his transparent facial expressions, even if he says nothing.

alternative: Rube Goldberg Klutz (ピタゴラドジっ娘)

245100.description:
__Height__: 155 cm

Mitsuko is a student at Hachimitsu Academy and the secretary of the aboveground Student Council. She becomes the love interest of [Takehito Morokuzu](https://anilist.co/character/64851)—better known as Gakuto—and is the cousin of [Anzu Yokoyama](https://anilist.co/character/89755/). She is a very clumsy girl who also has an interest in the Three Kingdoms.

245466.description:
__Relatives:__ [Father](https://anilist.co/character/349655/Aira-no-Chichi)

After becoming aware of the existence of the supernatural after collecting a mysterious golden ball, Aira proclaims herself as the "chosen one" that is on a mission to protect the world from evil and directs her attention towards [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Momo-Ayase), believing that she is a demon that has to be stopped after seeing her use her psychic powers. Aira revels in her social status as the popular girl at Kami High and strives to maintain her reputation. Outwardly, she appears sweet, innocent, and somewhat air headed. However, internally, she is far more vain and prideful, a side she only shows to people she becomes close with. Whilst antagonistic towards Momo, she harbors feelings towards her close friend [Okarun](https://anilist.co/character/222593/Ken-Takakura).

~!She later gains the powers of a powerful spirit named [Acrobatic Silky](https://anilist.co/character/245467/Acrobatic-Sarasara) and becomes allies / friends with Momo and Okarun, learning to be more mindful of her actions and being more open with her true self.!~

245521.description: Ichigo Saitou is the director of the agency Ichigo Production. He is the one who scouted [Ai](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) and made her a star.

245613.description: Rusalka is the Goddess of Water. She gave Mukouda's familiar, Sui, her blessing so that she could receive offerings from Mukouda. She absolutely loves eating food from the otherworld.

246054.description: A mage that can use restraint and mental manipulation magic. Good at detecting mana and can use simple recovery magic.

246055.description: First-class mage who was a proctor for the first examination.

246056.description: A third-class mage. Specializes in magic that makes her move at high speed. Treats [Denken](https://anilist.co/character/246058/Denken) as her grandfather.

246057.description: Übel is a third-class mage. Was disqualified in an earlier examination due to killing a first-class wizard. Specializes in magic that allows her to copy the spells of people she can empathize with. Relies mostly on her intuition and is not bound by logical reasoning. ~!Becomes a first-class mage after the examination.!~

246058.description: Denken is an imperial mage of the second-class. In his youth he belonged to an army but became an imperial mage after winning a power struggle. Often calm and calculating, however he still has a fire burning within despite his old age. He saw [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) as his motivation to become a mage. ~!Becomes a first-class mage after the examination.!~

246068.description:
A petite girl with the sign of the 'Assassin', Tisse is a member of the Assassin's guild. She replaced the outcast Gideon in the Hero's party at the request of Ares. She has a small spider familiar named Uge-uge.

(Source: Official Site)

246594.description: A trainee aquarium keeper from "Aquarium Tingaara."

name.native: セラス・アシュレイン

246652.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Rank:__ E-Class Hero
__Inherent Skill:__ Abnormal State Endowment
__Level:__ 1789 (Vol. 1) ~!2500 (Vol. 5)!~

Touka was one of the students summoned by [Goddess Vicius](https://anilist.co/character/246651/Vicius) to become a hero in another world, but he was abandoned and sent to his death.

246680.description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

A second year middle school student at Daikoku Aigo Academy who is a descendant of Santa Claus. He was determined to hide the curse of Santa Claus, but his powers were recently unleashed. When he transforms into Santa, he becomes a muscular old man who works hard to grant the wishes of children.

246681.description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

One of [Sanda's](https://anilist.co/character/246680/Kazushige-Sanda) classmates who is unusually tall for her age. She broke the seal on Santa Claus's powers in order to request his help in solving the mysterious disappearance of her friend [Ono](https://anilist.co/character/363834/Ichie-Ono).

246842.description: The leader of the Taira clan. He has become a monk, but still wields power, and his mercurial nature causes problems for the clan and his eldest son and heir, Shigemori. His other children are; Munemori, Tomomori, Tokuko and Shigehira.

246843.description: Shigemori's half-sister who befriends Biwa. She becomes betrothed to Norihito, son of the Emperor. Her younger sister Moriko was married to Lord Fujiwara no Motazane (the older brother of Lord Motofusa) at the age of nine. When he died two years later, Moriko inherited his lands, angering Motofusa.

246844.description: The daughter of a biwa hōshi who is killed by agents of the Taira after Biwa unintentionally insults them. She dresses like a boy and has one green and one brown eye which enables her to see into the future. Her character does not appear in the original epic story.

246845.description: The eldest son of Kiyomori, the leader of the Taira clan and in contrast to his father, he is level headed and responsible. He holds the posts of Palace Minister and Left Commander. He has four children: Koremori, Sukemori, Kiyotsune and Arimori. He has different colored eyes and can see the spirits of the dead, but is disparagingly referred to as the Lantern Lord because he keeps his household well-lit at night.

246852.description:
Musicart belonging to "New York Symphonica". She looks beautiful, but she doesn't talk much about anything other than necessary.

(Source: Official site, translated)

246853.description:
A Musicart who belongs to "New York Symphonica" and works with Shindler. She has a cruel and atrocious taste.

(Source: Official site, translated)

name.native: アンナ・シュナイダー

246856.description:
A girl who is a childhood friend of Takt and a fateful "sister". She has a cheerful and caring personality.

(Source: Official site, translated)

247022.description: A famous manga author. He lives in a big house next to the Inuyashikis.

247285.description: In her second year of high school, and [Sumire](https://anilist.co/character/206368)'s younger sister. A phenomenal honor student who gets full marks in every subject, every time. Head of the drama club, but her acting skills are dubious. [Akiteru](https://anilist.co/character/206365) suspects she is dirty-minded.

247286.description: In her second year of high school. Her given name is private. Low energy. She's a sound engineer who helps out the 05th Floor Alliance. According to her, fall is obviously the season for music.

247458.description: Eris is an Forest Ogre working in the Kuzunoha Company along with [Aqua](https://anilist.co/character/247460/Aqua).

name.native: ルドセブ・ミュンツァー

247703.description: Asakura Munzer Redseb, previously known as Redseb Munzer, is a member of Team "Kabbalahers", which Asakura Mikihisa formed with Redseb and his younger sister Asakura Munzer Seyram.

name.native: セイラーム・ミュンツァー

247705.description: Asakura Munzer Seyram, previously known as Seyram Munzer, is a member of Team "Kabbalahers", which Asakura Mikihisa formed with Seyram and her older brother Asakura Munzer Redseb.

247735.description:
Shiki is a Lich and presently in servitude to [Makoto Misumi](https://anilist.co/character/138137/Misumi-Makoto). 

His origins and original name are unknown. What is easily ascertained is that he was a brilliant researcher in magic knowledge. Before his death he possibly came back as a lich or possibly, he turned himself into a lich; when and where is unknown. All that is known is that he’s been a lich for a very long time and with quite the reputation.

247953.description: Maou Is a dungeon guardian of The Dungeon of Black Company!

248383.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

A classmate of Akane and Saito. She is gyaru, but despite her flamboyant appearance she has a warm personality. She cares about Akane and Saito, who fight all the time.

248384.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Saito's classmate and natural enemy. When she's not talking, she's a model-class beauty, but when she sees Saito, she's always fighting with him. She has a strong competitive spirit, is hardworking, and has a family-oriented side. She has a dream that she wants to fulfill even if she has to marry Saito.

248385.description:
__Height:__ 142 cm

A cousin and classmate of [Saito](https://anilist.co/character/248386/Houjou-Saito). She has the appearance of a doll and an attractive cool expression. She is a good friend of Saito, who grew up with her like a brother and sister.

248386.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

[Akane Sakuramori](https://anilist.co/character/248384/Sakuramori-Akane)'s classmate and natural enemy. He has trouble getting along with Akane, always quarreling with her. He's smart and always places at the top of the class, but he lacks common sense in his daily life. Married Akane so he could succeed his grandfather to control the Houjou Group.

name.native: 霧・ヴィークトヴィチ・プーチン

249256.description: She is a renowned adventurer and was the strongest adventurer registered to the guild, prior to [Tomoe](https://anilist.co/character/138138/Tomoe) and [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/138139/Mio) joining. She is a dragon slayer that received the rank of SSS in honor of defeating Lancer as a dragon and is given the title "Dragon Slayer" after that.

name.native: モニカ・エヴァレット

249404.description: Monica Everett is famously known as the Silent Witch for being the only human capable of casting spells without chanting. Exceedingly shy, she had trouble conversing with others; and in the worst cases, faints when meeting strangers. Because this crippling anxiety affected her performance at a magic academy, Monica decided to bypass her fears by avoiding chanting entirely. No longer hampered by the time lag inherent in casting spells, she overcame the greatest weakness of all sorcerers and was recognized as one of the Seven Sages for her accomplishment.

250097.description: Kikunojou Tendou is the current head of the Tendou family, as well as Kisara Tendou's grandfather.

250154.description:
Class 1-3, student number 5.

The first classmate that [Komichi](https://anilist.co/character/159265/Akebi-Komichi) met. She has the air of a young lady, but also has an active side that likes fishing and mountain climbing.

250155.description:
Class 1-3, student number 2.

She has good communication skills and a cheerful personality. She knows a lot of rumors about her classmates.

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

250156.description:
Class 1-3, student number 6.

She has a quiet and gentle personality, and loves to read. She started talking to [Komichi](https://anilist.co/character/159265/Akebi-Komichi) when she borrowed her handkerchief.

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

250490.description:
A High school girl living a quiet life in a seaside town, but she feels somewhat detached from her friends during the summer months. She lost her family on a trip when she was six years old. She has a deep, logical, calm and introverted personality. Rarely, she attracts aggressive monsters to her, including sea monsters from the shore.

She seems to have signs of PTSD.

250641.description:
The being that reincarnated Lugh Tuatha Dé into a different world to have him kill the hero.

~!She manipulated fate thus allowing Lugh, Maha, Tarte, and Dia to meet, with the latter three being destined to die if Lugh was never reincarnated.!~

250705.description: *Parody of ghost story talk show host and personality Junji Inagawa (稲川淳二)*

251839.description: Daughter of the local Liege Lord of Omui.

251913.description:
__Bike:__ Colnago

Sugimoto is a member of the Sohoku High Bicycle Club. He is best known for constantly referring to himself as "an experienced cyclist."

(Source: Yowamushi Pedal Wiki)

252175.description: Corrupt city governor who uses his army of rabbit mask bodyguards to hunt down [Milo](https://anilist.co/character/211162/Milo-Nekoyanagi) and [Bisco.](https://anilist.co/character/211161/Bisco-Akaboshi) He seems to have a strange obsession with Bisco.

252578.description:
Class 1-3, student number 16.

She is the tallest girl in her class and has already become a promising member of the volleyball team.

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

252702.description:
**Abilities:**
-Crimson Comet: A High level attack magic
-Twelve Layers Of Barrier (Statis)': A High level magic which can nullify or seal any type of magic regardlessly.
-Voice Changer: A magic that allows to change your voice to anybody's.
-Metamorphisis: A magic for disguise.
-Clearance: A magic which can heals diseases or curses.
-Mirage Eye: A magic technique that can send the information that was seen as it is in its eyes to its caster.

Leo Demonheart is the strongest of all of the Twelve Demonheart Series. He is the main protagonist of the Yuusha, Yamemasu series.

252703.description: Echidna is the demon queen leading the latest invasion on mankind in search of the Philosopher's Stone. After being defeated by Leo Demonheart, she was driven into retreat, but seeks to rebuild her army.

252713.description: A fast assassin, one of the headmasters of the Demon Army.

252714.description: Lily is one of the Heavenly Kings of the Demon Army. She is the beast general.

252715.description: Steina is one of the Heavenly Kings of the Demon Army. She is the magic general.

252716.description: Edvard is one of the Heavenly Kings of the Demon Army. He is the dragon general.

252890.description: Mikoto Shiratori is the newest member of Sunlight Beverage's corporate badminton team as well as its newest and youngest salesman. He is the tactician and front player of the doubles pair consisting of himself and Tatsuru Miyazumi.

252891.description:
Souta Sakei is an employee and badminton player for Sunlight Beverage.

Souta is a singles player and comes across very calm and level-headed most of the time. He is Touya's older brother.

252892.description:
Touya Saeki  is an employee and badminton player for Sunlight Beverage.

Touya works in the planning department at Sunlight Beverage and plays doubles on their corporate badminton team. He is a doubles pair with Kouki Takeda and he is Souta's younger brother. He was a teammate of Mikoto Shiratori in high school and therefore is well-versed in Mikoto's playing style and foresight when Mikoto first joins the team.

252893.description:
Kouki Takeda is an employee and badminton player for Sunlight Beverage.

Kouki works in the sales department at Sunlight Beverage with Tatsuru Miyazumi and Mikoto Shiratori, and plays badminton with them. His doubles partner is Touya Saeki. Kouki is a good communicator and has a silly personality, but often lets his nerves get the better of him during actual matches.

252894.description: Tatsuru Miyazumi is an employee of Sunlight Beverage. He works in the Sales Department and is also the captain of their corporate badminton team. As [Mikoto Shiratori](https://anilist.co/character/252890/Shiratori-Mikoto)'s doubles partner, he usually handles power plays and defence from his position in the back court.

252976.description: The sole daughter of the Sakuragi family boss. A timid girl who struggles at expressing her emotions.

252977.description: The leader of the Sakuragi family. He is strict with himself and others, but has a soft spot for Yaeka.

253008.description: Yaeka's aunt. Runs a restaurant called Kurosaki. Not intimidated by her brother-in-law Kazuhiko or Kirishima, she talks to all on equal footing. Her hobbies include dressing up Yaeka and Kirishima.
