253009.description: A regional boss of the Sakuragi family. For better or worse, he's an honest guy. He gets very emotional, so people tend to tease him. With everything said and done, he respects [Kirishima](https://anilist.co/character/212596/Kirishima-Tooru). His hobby is watching movies. His capacity to empathize with others is astounding. He gets so attached to the main characters that he'll often start shouting or bawling his eyes out.

253010.description: Toichiro's son. He's at the age where he copies everything his father does. He's a precocious little brat who does things without thinking them through. His hobbies are collecting free toys that you get when you order food and hitting on girls.

253011.description: The former right-hand man of the Sakuragi family. He's sociable and good at looking after others like a big brother. He's relatively short-tempered. His hobbies are going on drives and dismantling and remodeling things.

253608.description:
**Height:** 158 cm

Kyouka Tamaki is a member of __TiNgS__ (Idol Group).

Kyouka Tamaki is often known for her Solid Performance by their Manager [__Naoki Hinase__](https://anilist.co/character/282397/)

253609.description:
**Height:** 160 cm

Haru Nabatame is a member of __TiNgS__ (Idol Group).

Haru Nabatame is often known for her Outstanding Observations & Adjustment Skills by their Manager [__Naoki Hinase__](https://anilist.co/character/282397/).

253611.description:
**Height:** 155 cm

Rio Seibu is a member of __TiNgS__ (Idol Group).

Rio Seibu is often known for her Strenuous Efforts by their Manager [__Naoki Hinase__](https://anilist.co/character/282397/).

253764.description: Midou is a hooded demon summoner in Gaia who becomes involved in attacking Kotarou with black demon dogs.

253950.description:
__Height:__ 187 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Jersey Number:__ 31
__Position:__ DF

Togashi is a first year high school student and member of Tokyo City Esperion FC Youth. He is a hot-headed and passionate kid who came to Esperion after leaving his motorcycle gang behind. His dark black hair is regularly styled in a classic biker-yankee pompadour.

253964.description:
__Height:__ 145cm

A first-year high school student. A liar who is "loved by everyone" and keeps up a facade of friendliness with nearly everyone she meets. She rarely lets down her guard, even to those who know her true face. Hopes to marry rich. 

Plays the role of an innocent kohai and Mitsuki's "little sister" at the cafe.

253965.description:
__Height:__ 171cm

A first year high school student. A serious girl who has social anxiety and difficulty understanding people's emotions. Cares about the integrity of the salon.

Plays the role of a kind upperclassman at the cafe, and is Hime's reliable "big sister."

253966.description:
__Height:__ 165cm

A third year high school student. Dresses like a gyaru outside of work. Cares a lot about workplace harmony and dislikes seeing her coworkers get hurt because of romance.

Plays the role of a cool, bespectacled upperclassman in the cafe, and is ~! Kanoko's "elder sister." !~

253967.description:
__Height:__ 156cm

Kitchen staff for the cafe. 

~!Formerly worked out front as Sumika's "little sister", but after a complicated romance bloomed between her and another previous employee she came to work behind the scenes.!~

253968.description:
__Height:__ 145cm

The manager of Liebe who suffered an arm injury. Plays the role of a kohai character who also serves as the cafe's mascot. Watches over the staff as a mature adult, despite her childlike appearance.

253969.description:
__Height:__ 156cm

A first year high school student and Hime's best friend. Is fiercly protective of Hime and has romantic feelings for her, which she doesn't want to see returned. Comes across as soft-spoken, but is actually very blunt. 

Plays the role of a shy kohai and Sumika's "little sister" at the cafe. Usually wears glasses, except while playing her Liebe character.

254180.description: She is the deceased grandmother of Hayato.

name.native: サーラ・クリスピーノ

255627.description:
**Height:** 163 cm 

A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Nirei is weak at fighting, but his frank personality livens up the room — he's the life of the class. He wants to protect the town more than anybody else and thus has always aspired to become a student at Furin High School. Nirei always carries a notepad and pen in his chest pocket. He's a well-informed person whose hobby is collecting and analyzing data on people he thinks are cool. 

(Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

255628.description:
**Height:** 192 cm

A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Sugishita's a mad dog and quite talented — he's the only one who's been allowed to call himself "Bofurin" since middle school. His motivation and driving force come from his excessive loyalty and devotion to Umemiya - whatever Umemiya says, goes. He's usually quiet and has a unique sway as he walks. When he gets mad, though, he's the most unpredictable of them all. 

(Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

255629.description:
**Height:** 174 cm

A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Suo has a refreshing smile and is pleasant to everyone he meets, but his outrageous jokes can cause chaos to the people around him. Despite his pleasantness, he can present an icy personality that leaves no tolerance for people who lack decorum. Suo's an enigma as he usually shows no emotions nor reveals his true feelings. He has a unique fighting style that resembles both kung fu and aikido. 

(Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

255630.description:
**Height:** 188cm

A third-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Umemiya is Bofurin's representative, meaning he stands at the top. With his friendly smile and amicable personality, he's a charismatic man who garners absolute trust from the people around him — not just the students at Furin High School but also from people around town. He's not just physically strong, however — with the tenacity to handle anything thrown his way, his very existence can overwhelm the people around him in a single shout. He likes to grow vegetables as a hobby.

(Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

255890.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm
__Favorite Food:__ Sweet Rolled Omelettes
__Least Favorite Food:__ Coriander
__Recent Ambition:__ To Have A Video Of Her Singing Go Viral On Social Media

Matama is a cheerful girl. However, she is also quite narcissistic and very sensitive to criticism. She fears both [Lord Enorme](https://anilist.co/character/288448) and [Magia Baiser Utena](https://anilist.co/character/175746), finding them both similar in that they use sexual harassment as punishment. She is terrible at singing except when engaging in exhibitionism, a fact discovered when Utena made her perform in the nude on threat of [Nemo](https://anilist.co/character/255889) being harmed.

256378.description:
He is the former Chancellor of Shu Han, well-known strategist of the Three Kingdoms Period (220 -280 AD). 

As his life reached its end at the Battle of the Wuzhong Plains, he wished on his deathbed to be reborn into a world where peace thrives. Thus, he is reborn to modern-day Tokyo, Japan.

256379.description:
**Height:** 164 cm (5'4")
**Occupation:** Singer, Part-Timer (BB Lounge)

She is an amateur singer, who was about to give up her dream of being a singer. But after meeting [Kongming Zhuge](https://anilist.co/character/256378/Kongming-Zhuge), a military strategist, she begins to develop her talents with his help.

257298.description: She never talks to anyone in class, but when she does open her mouth, she’s incredibly sharp-tongued. An aggressive loner with piercing eyes peering out from behind her long bangs.

257562.description: Gotou Hitori is a shy, gloomy high-schooler who started learning guitar after seeing rock bands on TV, in the hope that she too could become as popular as them. However, after 2 years she has yet to make a single friend or join a band. She instead sits in her closet at home, recording guitar covers and posting them to her YouTube channel, "guitarhero", on which she has amassed a reasonable following.

258506.description:
Jin Enjouji is [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Momo-Ayase)'s childhood friend and first crush. After his parents were hospitalized as a result of his house being haunted, Enjouji moved in with Momo and [Seiko](https://anilist.co/character/234824/Seiko-Ayase) and transferred over to Momo's school. 

Jiji comes off as being a very hyper-active young man who likes to express himself with dramatic mannerisms and expressions. He also has a habit of usually ending his sentences with strange verbal tics and is known to be very athletic and enjoy sports, primarily soccer. Past his initial over-the-top presentation, Jiji is a good-natured guy who deeply values his friendships and is committed to protecting those close to him, striving to improve himself and act as a reliable ally in moments of danger. Despite his immaturity, Jiji demonstrates a strong sense of accountability and empathy. 

~!He later gets possessed by a mountain yokai called [the Evil Eye](https://anilist.co/character/309809/Jashi). Thus, whenever he touches cold water, Evil Eye comes out, and when he touches hot water, he is himself.!~

name.native: ラルフ・アンダーソン

258844.description: A former American sergeant and a world-class professional boxer, who was the main antagonist of the Post-War Arc. He largely underestimated Japanese fighters.

259352.description: The new transfer student and [Hinako Yaotose](https://anilist.co/character/250490/Yaotose-Hinako)'s classmate who's secretly a Mermaid. She enrolled to the same academy as Hinako even before summer break with the intent to eat Hinako. She has translucent eyes which resembles the ocean. She has an insightful, mysterious and refined personality.

259510.description:
A kind and polite - yet headstrong - high-school girl who lives with her aunt in Tonami, Miyazaki Prefecture, Kyushu. She has recurring dreams of her younger self wandering through a field, surrounded by ruins of a city, trying to find her mother.

~!After accidentally freeing a disastrous force of nature and peering into the mysterious land of Ever-After (常世), she ends up embarking on a journey across Japan in an attempt to seal it, at the same time gradually learning more about the true nature of her strange visions.!~

She seems to have great admiration for her mother, who was a nurse, studying medicine books and holding onto a small chair she made for Suzume's fourth birthday in 2010. ~!As it turns out, she's constantly repressing memories of her mother's death on March 11th in the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake, having even blacked out pages from her childhood sketchbook that detailed the event, burying it in a metal box near the ruins of her childhood home.!~

259533.description: Momo Yozakura is the husband of the late Rei Yozakura and the father of the current Yozakura Family.

259534.description: Momiji Akikaze is a member of Hinagiku's Smuggling Enforcement unit who assisted Taiyo Asano in acquiring Dark Sweet tea leaves.

259535.description: ~!Tsubomi Yozakura is the first head of the Yozakura Family and a prisoner who was experimented on by Makoto Kawashita during World War II.!~

259543.description: Kaoru Akikaze is a member of Hinagiku's Biology Unit who assisted Taiyo Asano in acquiring Dark Sweet tea leaves. He is also the Master of Cafe Hinagiku.

259547.description: ~!Kurogao is a former spy who was determined to get his revenge for his daughter Yuri who was killed, so he took on the identity of Yoshimasa Kuroyuri (黒百合 義正, Kuroyuri Yoshimasa) as a disguise to lure in politicians and kill them.!~

259552.description: Rei Yozakura was the ninth head of the Yozakura Family, the wife of Momo Yozakura and the mother to their seven children.

name.native: シルフィー・メルヘヴン

259582.description:
**Race:** Human

Sylphy Marheaven was a soldier in the Demon Lord's Army formerly known as Raging Champion.

She spends thousands of years practicing in Phantom Forest in order to defeat the Demon Lord.

260328.description:
Previously an exceptional Lycoris, but for some reason, she now works at Café LycoReco.

A realistic person with a distaste for inefficiency, she can be dissatisfied with [Chisato](https://anilist.co/character/260329/Nishikigi-Chisato), who is not a typical Lycoris.

She wants to see good results in her job at LycoReco.

260329.description:
Chisato is said to be the strongest Lycoris of all time. She enjoys solving private-sector problems that the DA would not address.

At Café LycoReco, she works joyfully and cheerfully as the self-proclaimed poster girl.

~!Chisato has an artificial heart which was developed by Alan Institute, and can be broken by applying high voltages directly to it.!~

name.native: ティアラ・ロイヤル・アイビー
アーサー・ベレスフォード

alternative: Shimokitazawa no Daitenshi (下北沢の大天使)

261674.description: An energetic and cheerful second-year high school student. She is the drummer of Kessoku Band and the organizer who takes care of [Hitori](https://anilist.co/character/257562). She has an older sister, [Seika](https://anilist.co/character/289054), who is the manager of the live house "STARRY" and has a special feeling for the live house.

262323.description: Gaius was a powerful mage roughly 12,000 years ago called the Sage. He was born with the First Crest, and this prevented his ability to progress any further once he learned a certain set of magic. In this life he was considered incredibly powerful, but he wanted to become even stronger in order to challenges the monsters outside in the universe, so he reincarnated to achieve this goal.

262496.description:
She's known [Ria](https://anilist.co/character/262498) since they were in college, and she's a warm person who welcomes everyone. She works at the Karasuma Voice Therapy Clinic.

(Source: Official Site, translated, edited)

262497.description:
She is [Sonia](https://anilist.co/character/222105)'s childhood friend who aspires to be an "acoustic musician" who composes healing music.

(Source: Official Site, translated, edited)

262498.description:
She is a gifted healer who is known as the "witch" of the voice medicine world. She runs the Karasuma Voice Therapy Clinic.

(Source: Official Site, translated, edited)

262535.description:
Dai's old schoolmate. 
Dai's crashing at his place during his time in Tokyo.

262536.description:
A great pianist who appeared in front of Dai when he came to Tokyo. 
He started playing the piano at the age of four and is always thinking about jazz. 
He forms a trio with Dai and Tamada.

262588.description:
Yasuomi Ono is the general manager at Sunlight Beverage, and he is also the badminton coach.

Yasuomi always wears his sunglasses. He is loud and stubborn and a force to be reckoned with. He is smarter than he appears and is a trusted coach.

262763.description: Ruou's cousin. A 14 year old girl and the daughter of Chizuru. Miyako has learned ballet from her mother since an early age. Although skilled, Miyako's personality is deemed unsuitable by her mother to perform in large roles. Miyako discovers Junpei's ability and realizes he has skill for ballet which causes him to reignite his passion for the dance. A kind and polite girl, Miyako has conflicted feelings about Junpei and Luou, both of whom she cares for. She worries for Luou in particular, being aware of his circumstances.

262764.description: A shy 14-year-old boy, he is Miyako's cousin. The son of an American idol, he was abandoned by his mother following a scandal that exposed him as the son of her mother with another man who was not her husband. Raised by her strict, ballet obsessed grandmother, Luou grew under a physically and emotionally abusive environment with little to no contact with the outside world, learning only ballet. As a result, Luou has weak social skills, but his dancing prowess is unparalleled. Despite his tremendous skill, Luou's social reclusion weakens his ability to learn and express himself properly. Luou is in love with Miyako and sees Junpei as a nuisance, but it is through their adventures, that he is able to break out of his shell and grow more as a person.

name.native: グレン・アイゼナッハ

263427.description:
Daiki Oginome is a badminton player for Unisics.

Daiki plays doubles for Unisics and he is paired with his chidlhood friend, Hayato Kirishima.

263428.description:
Hayato Kirishima is a badminton player for Unisics.

Hayato plays badminton for Unisics. He is paired with his childhood friend, Daiki Oginome. Hayato is currently ranked the number two doubles player in the world, second only to his younger brother, Takuma Kirishima. He is very popular and known not only for his skill in badminton but also his good looks.

263429.description:
Ayato Misora is a badminton player for Unisics.

Ayato won the individual championship at the previous year's Inter-High School Tournament and was recruited to join Unisics at only age 17. He is very excitable and loud.

263914.description: One of Azami's many snakes that is now connected to Kokonose's eye ability, Awakening Eyes. ~!The snake controls Haruka Kokonose's remade body, "Konoha", with its empty shell of a personality and fragmented memories. It acts on Kokonose's final wish to make friends, as Konoha. When separated from Konoha in the Kagerou Daze, the snake is more condescending and direct towards Kokonose.!~

264336.description:
__Height:__ 190 cm

Nagumo is an old friend of [Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/196522/Sakamoto-Tarou). He is a member of "The Order", a group of assassins who are the highest ranked in the JAA. He's first seen paying a visit to Sakamoto to inform him of his bounty.

264355.description:
__Race:__ Human
~!__Evolved Race:__ Majin!~
__Level:__ 120
__Class:__ Summoner

__Equipment:__
- Black Staff of Disaster (Rank S)
- Strengthened Mithril Dagger (Rank B)
- Skill Eater (Rank S)
- Astarte's Embrace (Rank S)
- Tailored Black Leather Boots (Rank C)

264356.description: Originally a slave, she is a half-elf bought by Kelvin and trained to be a formidable Archer. She had a curse to set anybody she touches on fire until Kelvin came and broke it.

264529.description: A cool and solitary second year of high school. She is in charge of the bass of Kessoku Band. She's the best friend of [Nijika](https://anilist.co/character/261674). Her hobbies are out of the ordinary, and she rejoices when called a weirdo. She lives with a wealthy family, but she spends much of her money on instruments and always runs out of money. She occasionally eats weeds to get rid of her hunger.

264565.description:
__Race:__ Beastkin

Zeta is the sixth member of Shadow Garden, being one of the original Seven Shadows. She usually travels around the world alone gathering intelligence.

264663.description:
Azuma Tachibana is an employee and badminton player for Tomari Transport.

Azuma plays doubles for Tomari Transport and he is currently paired with Shiryuu Tonozaki. He played badminton as a doubles team with Mikoto Shiratori in both junior high school and high school, but at the time he felt somewhat inferior being paired with someone who was considered a prodigy.

264664.description:
Shiryuu Tonozaki is a badminton player for Tomari Transport.

Shiryuu plays doubles for Tomari Transport with Azuma Tachibana.

264665.description:
Kotetsu Goukura is a badminton player for Tomari Transport.

Kotetsu plays doubles for Tomari Transport with Yuukei Saruhashi. He was previously paired with Shiryuu Tonozaki before Azuma Tachibana joined the team. He is very very quiet and it is rare to hear him speak.

264666.description:
Yuukei Saruhashi is a badminton player for Tomari Transport.

Yuukei plays doubles for Tomari Transport with Kotetsu Goukura.

264851.description: One of the two UMA Kotarou brought home from an alternate dimension.

264852.description: One of the two UMA Kotarou brought home from an alternate dimension.

264853.description: A gentleman who runs an antique shop business in the city of Kazamatsuri. After meeting Kotarou on a certain occasion, he grants him advice that draws from his vast life experience. Although calling himself a "totally humorous, somewhat mischievous businessman", his gags oppositely charm everyone with fear.

name.native: ヘーゼリッタ・オルドリッジ
ブラッド・フォウ・フィールド
ジルク・フィア・マーモリア
グレッグ・フォウ・セバーグ
クリス・フィア・アークライト

265395.description: Kazu is one of the skaters in "S". He was supposed to race against Shadow, but didn't due to Reki bringing the wrong skateboard. He appears to have a grudge against Shadow after the latter beat him in a beef, and later set out to attack him since Shadow's win was the reason for Miki leaving Kazu.

265474.description: She is the eldest sibling of the Shiunji family and is the only one who has already moved onto university. She is a first-year college student and an aspiring nurse.

265475.description: She is one of the youngest Shiunji siblings, along with her twin brother [Shion Shiunji](https://anilist.co/character/265473/Shion-Shiunji). She is a first-year high school student, who is a triple champion of the middle school tennis tournament and is expected to be a future Olympian.

265476.description: She is the second oldest Shiunji sibling, second only to her older sister [Banri Shiunji](https://anilist.co/character/265474/Banri-Shiunji). She is a third-year high school student, who is the valedictorian of her school and the Science Club president.

265477.description: She is the youngest sibling of the Shiunji family and the only one that's still in middle school. She is a third-year middle school student, who is the type of innocent girl that has a peaceful and shy personality.

265478.description: She is one of the third-oldest Shiunji siblings, along with her "twin" brother [Arata Shiunji](https://anilist.co/character/265472/Arata-Shiunji). She is a second-year high school student, who excels in both class and sports, ranking second in the entire high school and the frontrunner for the next student council president election.

265485.description: The owner of Yukichi, she is a 28-year-old office worker. According to Yukichi, she is a "useless person" who works too hard and is barely able to take care of herself outside of work. She always puts off taking care of herself until later and pushes herself to the limit until she collapses. Until she picked up Yukichi, she used to fall sleep in the entrance area of her garbage-filled house(!). As long as she has a bit of good fortune and a beer, she can live happily.

265486.description: An extremely capable tsundere cat. When he was a kitten, he almost froze to death in the street when he was picked up by Saku and became her pet. Initially, he was just an ordinary cat, but because Saku was so lacking in life skills, he had to do something about it and grew into a very capable cat. Although he calls Saku a "useless person," everything he says and does is filled with gratitude and love for his owner.

265500.description: Jerietta is the aide and daughter of the Edvard.

266041.description: A bright and popular first year of high school. She is in charge of the guitar and vocals of Kessoku Band. She is a cheerful character who likes to interact with people and can talk to her with a smile without hesitation, even when she meets her for the first time. She longs for [Ryo](https://anilist.co/character/264529), and her feelings can go too far. She often takes photos and uploads to Isosta.

266336.description:
He is an employee at Sunlight Beverage.

Usuyama is an employee for the Quality Insurance Department at Sunlight Beverage. He is the direct boss of [Souta Saeki](https://anilist.co/character/252891/Saeki-Souta) and regularly has to reprimand [Tatsuru Miyazumi](https://anilist.co/character/252894/Miyazumi-Tatsuru) for reckless sales decisions. He is a very serious and strict person.

He used to play badminton but no longer does.

266369.description: A young girl whom [Takopi](https://anilist.co/character/266372/Takopi) befriends upon its arrival on Earth. She is the subject of bullying in her school due to her mother's work as a hostess and only finds solace at home with her pet dog [Chappy](https://anilist.co/character/269156/Chappy).

266370.description: [Shizuka Kuze's](https://anilist.co/character/266369/Kuze-Shizuka) classmate who is her bully, often mocking her family situation.

266371.description: He is the class representative and has an older brother named [Junya](https://anilist.co/character/269157/Azuma-Junya).

266372.description: A Happian alien from the Happy Planet who resembles an octopus. Takopi's goal is to spread happiness to others through its various gadgets, though its innocent and simplistic worldview is challenged as they confront the complex morality and nature of human beings.

266433.description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Jinki:__ "3R"

Rudo is the foster son of [Regto](https://anilist.co/character/266437/Regto). 

He was originally from the slums of the Sphere, but ended up sentenced to the Abyss after being falsely accused of murder. Due to being physically abused and abandoned by his real parents, Rudo is emotionally closed off and introverted and has permanent painful scars on his hands; having to keep them covered up by bandages and a pair of gloves Regto gifted to him to help sooth the excruciating pain.

266437.description:
The man who raised [Rudo](https://anilist.co/character/266433/Rudo) after he lost his parents. He gave Rudo a pair of gloves.

(Source: Official Site)

266438.description:
__Height:__ 190 cm
__Affiliation:__ Cleaners
__Jinki:__ "Umbreaker"

Engine is from the Abyss and the man that saved [Rudo](https://anilist.co/character/266433/Rudo) when he fell out of the sky. He has a very bright and fun personality, but very little energy and seemingly is chill and laid-back. Despite his incredible abilities, he refers to himself as "your average janitor."

name.native: リリア・クーデルフェイト

266629.description: [Alto](https://anilist.co/character/171760)'s childhood friend, who is in love with him and becomes jealous when [Vermeil](https://anilist.co/character/171759) appears and other girls surrounds Alto. She made a contract with a high-class wind spirit, named [Sylphid](https://anilist.co/character/319902).

266969.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

Osaragi is an assassin and a new member of the Order, a group of powerful assassins that work under the JAA.

267616.description: Skilled priest and executioner, who has killed the most Lost Ones from other worlds. She is [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou)'s mentor and Menou is considered her successor.

268522.description:
**Height:** 179 cm

The protagonist who runs a small private military company. He is usually broke as he cannot handle finances well. He is an orphan, as the rest of his family is presumed to be dead after an incident prior to the events of the series.

268523.description:
**Height:** 158 cm

A young girl who goes to a high school in Bayron City. She is actually a demon girl who is hundreds of years old. She has the ability to eat the memories of people, including [Shuu](https://anilist.co/character/268522/Ogata-Shuu).

268524.description:
**Height:** 165 cm

[Shuu Ogata's](https://anilist.co/character/268522/Ogata-Shuu) first ex-girlfriend. Although she and Shuu have broken up, she still has feelings for him. She is also [Akino's](https://anilist.co/character/278138/Yuugiri-Akino) daughter.

268676.description:
__Height:__ 148 cm

An ace student at Kikyo Private Academy. Kaoruko is incredibly intelligent and kind, but often acts airheaded as well. She greatly enjoys eating sweets, meeting [Rintaro](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi) in his family's cake shop and quickly befriending him. Despite later learning that he attends Chidori High—a school at bitter odds with her own—she continues to be close with him.

268677.description:
__Height:__ 190 cm

A student at Chidori High. Rintarou is a very kind and calm person, but his blonde hair and piercings—adopted due to struggles with self-expression in his childhood—have led to many writing him off as a delinquent. The exceptions to this are his close friends at Chidori High, as well as [Kaoruko](https://anilist.co/character/268676), a girl from an opposing school known as Kikyo Private Academy. After first meeting Kaoruko in his family's cake shop, Rintarou gradually begins to spend more time with her.

~!Later, Rintarou falls for Kaoruko and confesses his feelings to her. While this causes some awkwardness between the two at first, she eventually returns his feelings and they begin dating.!~

268742.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm 
__Jinki:__ "Lovely Assistaff"

He’s a former Hell Guard trainee and is currently a member of the Akuta faction of the Cleaners.

269064.description:
__Team:__ Paris X Gen, France National Team, Team World Five (Former)
__Position:__ Forward

Julian Loki is a young French football prodigy renowned for his exceptional speed and skill. He plays as a forward for the French club Paris X Gen (PXG) and is also a member of the France National Team.

First introduced during Third Selection, as a member of the Team World 5, he is initially at Blue Lock to analyze and rate the last string of Blue Lock players. He later returns to help train the Blue Lock players and participate in the Neo Egoist League as the master striker and coach of the France Stratum, all in order to train his protégé, [Charles Chevalier](https://anilist.co/character/334890/Charles-Chevalier), into becoming his personal passer so they may become the best in the world together. ~!He is a member of the New Generation World XI.!~

269077.description: Seventh Seat of the Winged Bloodline. Fourth Seat in the future timeline.

269129.description:
Mahiru Seki is a former middle school student and a childhood friend of [Kou Yamori](https://anilist.co/character/168866/Kou-Yamori) and [Akira Asai](https://anilist.co/character/175663/Akira-Asai).

~!Died with [Kiku Hoshimi](https://anilist.co/character/269128/Kiku-Hoshimi) at the sunrise after she turned him into a vampire!~

269156.description: Shizuka Kuze's dog. It was originally her dad's dog.

269157.description: He is Naoki's older brother. He usually get perfect grades at school and decided to get a part-time job against his mom wishes. He has a girlfriend and a cheerful attitude.

name.native: エレオノール・ボヌフォワ

269675.description: Pharma's personal tutor and a talented pharmacist who passed her first-grade exam at the age of fifteen. Has so many glasses to replace those she lost. She joins her student in building his dreams.

name.native: シャルロット・ソレル

269676.description: Charlotte is a maid at the de Médicis house and Pharma's childhood friend. Later on, she joins her master as a pharmacy clerk.

269797.description: Ferrarin is a mayor of the Regia Aeronautica. He oparates the red plane MC72.

269961.description:
**Occupation:** Rapper

A freestyle rapper of overwhelming talent, he boasts three consecutive victories in the DRB MC battle championship.

He is a true genius, possessing an exceptional gift for crafting rhymes on the spot—drawing inspiration from casual conversations overheard on the street—and a lightning-fast vocabulary that operates with the speed of a reflex.

He is also the very person [Kongming](https://anilist.co/character/256378/Kongming-Zhuge) had long been seeking, having identified him as a powerful potential ally for [Eiko Tsukimi](https://anilist.co/character/256379/Eiko-Tsukimi).

However, by nature, he is timid, pessimistic, and easily rattled by pressure. Traumatized by a past incident where he suffered an acute gastric ulcer during an MC battle, he struggled with his mental health, eventually retiring from the scene and spending his days trying to escape reality.

270095.description:
[Kaoruko](https://anilist.co/character/268676/Kaoruko-Waguri)'s closest friend since middle school. Subaru is noted to be exceptionally pretty by her peers but has a somewhat withdrawn personality, particularly having trouble whilst talking to boys. She's also very protective of Kaoruko, initially disapproving of her relationship with [Rintaro](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi) and the others before discovering how kindhearted the boys are.

~!Despite becoming friendly with the Chidori High boys, Subaru feels as though she doesn't fit in with the group despite wanting to be close with them. However, with Kaoruko and the boys' help she reaffirms her friendship with them, even becoming comfortable enough to casually tease [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/272241/Saku-Natsusawa) and bring him presents for his birthday.!~

270184.description:
Shuuhei Nakamura is a badminton player for Mitsuhoshi Banking.

Shuuhei plays doubles for Mitsuhoshi Banking with Chiaki Takimoto.

270185.description:
Chiaki Takimoto is a badminton player for Mitsuhoshi Banking.

Chiaki is a doubles player for Mitsuhoshi Banking with Shuuhei Nakamura.

270186.description:
Takuma Kirishima is a badminton player for Mitsuhoshi Banking.

Takuma plays doubles for Mitsuhoshi Banking with Naohiro Izumo. He is currently the number one doubles player in the world. His brother, Hayato Kirishima, is ranked second.

270187.description:
Sentarou Ibuki is a badminton player for Mitsuhoshi Banking.

Sentarou is a singles badminton player for Mitsuhoshi Banking and currently ranked the number one singles player in the world.

270188.description:
Naohiro Izumo is a badminton player for Mitsuhoshi Banking.

Naohiro plays doubles for Mitsuhoshi Banking with Takuma Kirishima. He used to play for Sunlight Beverage and was paired with Tatsuru Miyazumi before getting recruited by Mitsuhoshi.

270928.description: Jusetsu Ryuu is the current Raven Consort, a special consort that does not perform nighttime duties, despite living in the inner palace. She lives in the Yamei Palace without anyone in her palace, except herself. She is mysterious and aloof, and she is able to use special magical techniques passed on to her as a Raven Consort.

270933.description: The cheerful lady-in-waiting to the current Raven Consort. Shouxue met her while snooping around in disguise outside of the Ye Ming Palace while working on a case, and later took her in as her lady-in-waiting.

name.native: ニックス・フォウ・バルトファルト

271024.description: The eldest son & child of the Bartfort Household & Leon's older brother.

name.native: レターナ＝アンドレアノワ

271113.description: Pepesha's deceased mother who died 15 years ago and left Pepesha to an orphanage.

271367.description:
__Height:__ 5'9"

Rakurou, better known by his nickname "Sunraku," is an enthusiast of Kusoge (shit games); games that are well-known for buggy states, unfair mechanics and awful AI. He is well known by his friends as a Kusoge fanatic and lunatic. Thanks to the skills Sunraku has built up playing such awful games, he becomes a more motivated and better player the crappier the hand a game deals him.

name.native: シャロン・ホーリーグレイル

271925.description:
**Height:** 162 cm

[Shuu Ogata's](https://anilist.co/character/268522/Ogata-Shuu) second ex-girlfriend, who dresses as a nun. She is actually an assassin and a part of an international organization tasked with fight against D-Hazards.

272240.description: A student at Chidori High and a close friend of [Rintaro](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi)'s, alongside [Ayato](https://anilist.co/character/272243/Ayato-Yorita) and [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/272241/Saku-Natsusawa). Shohei is extremely outgoing, being the most talkative member of Rintaro's friend group. He also holds no hostility towards Kikyo's students despite the opposing school's vitriol towards each other.

272241.description:
A student at Chidori High and a close friend of [Rintarou's](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi), alongside [Shouhei](https://anilist.co/character/272240/Shohei-Usami) and [Ayato](https://anilist.co/character/272243/Ayato-Yorita).

Despite his attractive features he always appears gloomy, making him appear hard to talk to. But while he is more withdrawn than his friends he cares deeply about them and is naturally kind despite his cynical exterior. He is also incredibly intelligent, being the smartest student at Chidori High and even outdoing Kikyo's students, as noted by [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/270095/Subaru-Hoshina) who begins to study with him.

~!Due to his standing as a genius he became isolated from his peers in middle school, resulting in his current introverted personality.!~

272295.description: A high school sophomore in a secluded side of town and [Karen](https://anilist.co/character/278440/Touno-Karen)'s older brother.

272339.description:
A mysterious girl who just transferred in from Tokyo. 

~!By law she is 30 years old, but her body is still 22 years old because she entered the Urashima Tunnel in order to find [Kaoru](https://anilist.co/character/272295/Touno-Kaoru).!~

272394.description:
__Occupation__: Mangaka

Ichirou is a Shoujo Mangaka and also the Owner of a Social Apartment. He's a Wise person who provides for his two younger siblings, Machi and Fumio by himself.

~!Ichirou supports his siblings from his job as a shoujo mangaka. At the verge of a certain deadline, a very capable assistant known as [Shiori Goshiki](https://anilist.co/character/272395/Shiori-Goshiki) turns up at his house. They clear up the deadline with no incident, but all of a sudden she declares that she is the Princess of a Kingdom and that now they're bound together by a vow of marriage.!~

272395.description:
__Occupation__: Mangaka Assistant

She's a "god-tier assistant" as described by the Mangaka she works for who is known as [Ichirou Kuga](https://anilist.co/character/272394/Ichirou-Kuga), she's a mysterious person who claims to be the Princess of a Kingdom.

~!At the verge of a certain deadline for his (Ichirou's) Manuscript, Shiori turns up at [Ichirou Kuga](https://anilist.co/character/272394/Ichirou-Kuga)'s house. They clear up the deadline with no incident, but all of a sudden she declares that she is the Princess of a Kingdom and that now they're bound together by a vow of marriage.!~

272621.description: She's the daughter of one of Tokyo City Esperion's sponsors' CEO, Denji Kaido and an aspiring football coach.

273090.description: Leo is a Mexican-American figure skater and choreographer. He won gold at Skate America during the current season, but did not place at the Cup of China, due to him messing up a number of key jumps in his free program

273105.description:
Shiori is [Jirou Yakuin's](https://anilist.co/character/191673/Jirou-Yakuin) classmate and childhood friend (and crush). She was paired with [Minami Tenjin](https://anilist.co/character/273110/Minami-Tenjin) in their school's couples training.

She is a kind and gentle girl, but she isn't very confident in herself and has a shy demeanor. Shiori is academically intelligent and regularly scores high marks on her exams, although she is known to struggle athletically. She is especially bad at talking to boys she doesn't know due to past experiences she had in middle school, but is known to be very caring towards those close to her regardless of gender, including Jirou and [Mei](https://anilist.co/character/286619/Mei-Hamano). Despite the fact she is paired with Minami in the couples training, she seems to still harbor some feelings for Jirou.

273109.description:
__Relatives:__ Keiichiro Kamo (Older Brother).

Sadaharu is a close friend of [Jirou Yakuin](https://anilist.co/character/191673/Jirou-Yakuin), being one of the few people Jirou is comfortable being open around. He is paired with Satsuki Kaneyama in their school's Marriage Practical.

Sadaharu is portrayed as being a mild mannered and eccentric otaku who enjoys reading manga, watching anime, and playing video games. Like Jirou, Sadaharu also has lousy luck with women, preferring the women to be "2D" instead of real so they can't end up hurting his feelings. However, it appears that he and his practice partner get along well which indicates that the practical has somewhat improved his social skills with women. Sadaharu is considered to be the series primary comic relief character, having a knack for making light of serious situations by comparing them to similar events found in many Japanese media and pointing out common tropes. He often showcases incredible creativity by imagining himself or others in fictional circumstances that almost appear to break the laws of reality, with his rampant imagination even causing him to the break the 4th wall on a few occasions. Despite his absurd antics, Sadaharu is ultimately a good, kindhearted person and will go out of his way to help and support those he cares for when he sees fit.

273110.description:
Considered to be the most popular student at Seishun Academy, Minami Tenjin is [Shiori Sakurazaka's](https://anilist.co/character/273105) partner in the Marriage Practical and [Akari Watanabe's](https://anilist.co/character/191672) crush. He works at a café together with [Shuu Terafune](https://anilist.co/character/286620) and Keiichiro Kamo.

What makes Minami so admirable are the numerous amounts of traits and skills that he has that would make other boys jealous. He is a star athlete who is proficient in multiple sports including basketball, volleyball, and track-and-field, on top of him being academically intelligent. Above all else, he possesses a calm and cool demeanor in the presence of others which is what has earned him the respect and admiration of his peers. Despite his popularity amongst the school, Minami does not have an ego where he sees himself as superior to the other students, and is generally portrayed as a very friendly, humble person who treats everyone with respect. He is also known to be incredibly observant.

273796.description:
Before the beginning of the series, he was an assassin for Qin in his early years. At the request of his friend, he left the Empire to take care of his friend's son, Jing Tianming. A prodigy of swordsmen, Ge Nie studied in the school Gui Gu alongside Wei Zhuang, his rival.

Ge Nie is able to single-handedly defeat 300 of the Elite Troops of Qin, and returning with only a few injuries. His swordsmanship is impressive, thus earning him the title of 'Sword Saint'. He rarely smiles, or shows emotion, but is very protective of Tian Ming, who in turn adores Ge Nie very much and regards him as a role model. He is famed among swordsmen for his "Hundred Steps Flying Sword" technique.

He is very clear about what the meaning of being strong is and often reminds Tianming that chivalrous heroes do not fight others to prove themselves, but they help those who are small and frail.

274195.description: Lihaku is a military officer, residing in the outer court of the palace. He's strong and honest, but not exactly brilliant.

name.native: エレナ・キンバーライト
クリス・ウェストランド

274773.description:
Representative of the Libelle Family Head. 
Sole daughter of Count Libelle, who acts as the representative of the family after the Count fell ill. She is always dressed in a kimono and carries herself gracefully.

274775.description: ~!One of the four Human Errors, demon of the fog Pandemonium which was sealed away. She takes the form of a young girl, but her true body is still inside the fog. She has lost the memories and personality from before she became a Human Error.!~

274796.description:
**Height:** 176 cm
__Year:__ 2nd Year
__Jersey Number:__ 22
__Position:__  MF

He is one year older than Ashito and was promoted from the junior youth team. He is a midfielder who belongs to the second team. He has a caring personality and often gives advice to Ashito, who is less skilled, as a senior from the youth team. He is also well-liked by his teammates.

274797.description:
**Height:** 182 cm
__Year:__ 2nd Year
__Jersey Number:__ 13
__Position:__ FW/MF

He's one year older than Ashito and was promoted from the junior youth team. His position is forward/midfielder. He's a talented player who has been selected for the Japanese national team at various age levels, and he also has leadership qualities that allow him to be considerate of his teammates and inspire them.

274798.description:
**Height:** 168 cm
__Year:__ 2nd Year
__Jersey Number:__ 18
__Position:__ MF

He is one year older than Ashito and was promoted from the junior youth team. He is a midfielder with outstanding technique. He is a talented player who has been selected for the Japanese national team at various age levels, but he is not happy that he has always been seen as Kuribayashi's second-best player at Esperion since his junior youth days.

274985.description:
Kuon Nanami is a vocalist and bassist that Eiko found singing on the streets. Nanami and Eiko immediately befriend each other, finding themselves singing in the street in their first meeting, after Eiko prevented Kuon from being taken away by the police because of her lack of a permit to perform in public. 

~!Nanami is the vocalist and bass player of the band 'Azalea', a band she formed in the first year of high school with two of her friends, a band that a few years later would have been taken over by a large music production company. Nanami, although she was the one who reluctantly decided to collaborate with this music production company, was the first to regret it, after her band was forced to totally change music genre, wear provocative costumes for concerts, and eventually even playback concerts.!~

275108.description: High School 3rd Year student from Group K. He is the childhood friend and neighbor of [Kei Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/127625/Shinomiya-Kei).

275749.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm
__Jinki:__ "The Ripper"

She’s a former hitman and currently a member of the Akuta faction of the Cleaners. She has an unusual fighting style where she wields her large scissors with her feet. Normally cheerful and playful, she becomes strikingly pragmatic in battle.

276195.description: Ittoki's uncle and one of Iga's strongest fighters with a reputation of being called "Tokisada the Demi-God". Despite his laidback attitude, Tokisada is powerful in combat and will not hesitate to go into extremes to complete a mission.

276196.description:
Ninja of Iga Village. She always has her guard up and makes sure [Ittoki](https://anilist.co/character/276197/Ittoki-Sakuraba) keeps up with his responsibilities and doesn't slack off.

~!It is later revealed that she is the daughter of [Kidou Minobe](https://anilist.co/character/283067).!~ ~!There is a chip in her brain that gives Koga the ability to control her mind, which they use to make her kill [Yumika](https://anilist.co/character/276198/Yumika-Sakuraba).!~

276197.description:
Ittoki is an upstanding student in school, taking a multitude of advanced classes and even attending a cram school six times a week. He is also very physically capable, taking a gymnastics class three times per week on top of his other extracurricular activities. He is friends with [Kousetsu](https://anilist.co/character/276196/Kousetsu) although he finds her overbearing at times as she never lets him stray away from his schedule to have fun.

~!He becomes the Chief of Iga Village as the legitimate successor following [Yumika](https://anilist.co/character/276198/Yumika-Sakuraba)'s death.!~

276198.description: Ittoki's mother and the current chief of the Iga village who took over the leadership after the death of her husband. Though she wasn't born into a ninja family, her prudence and courage in the face of death that has earned her the respect of the entire Iga Village.

276961.description: Mamoru Shirono is a Shield Hero of Raphtalia's World in the ancient past. He was one of two Legendary Heroes summoned to defend against the waves.

277990.description:
Dunn Smith looks to be a man in his thirties, with light brown hair, a straight nose, and sharp gray eyes. [Klein Moretti](https://anilist.co/character/192557/Moretti-Klein) described his eyes as "like a lake in an ancient forest that no one visited, giving him an indescribable sense of depth". He also has an receding Hairline despite his young Age.

Dunn Smith is the captain of the Nighthawks, a division under the Church of the Evernight Goddess, in Tingen City diocese.

He is a Sequence 7 Beyonder of the Darkness Pathway but has the power not too different from a Sequence 6.

277991.description: Leonard is a relaxed person who doesn't like rules by nature. He often put his feet on the table and didn't like going to church.

277993.description:
Audrey is an extremely beautiful young lady with emerald green eyes and smooth blonde hair. She is known as the most dazzling gem in Backlund.

One of the first members of the Tarot Club.

278139.description: The second-oldest daughter of Baylong City's mayor

278140.description: The oldest daughter of Baylong City's mayor

The son of Baylong City's mayor

Height: 184cm

ディアドリー・フォウ・ローズブレイド

A third-year student of Holfort Academy and one of the heiresses of the Roseblade Household.

name.native: ギルバート・ラファ・レッドグレイブ

278296.description: Eldest child of the Redgrave Household and [Angelica](https://anilist.co/character/152676/Angelica-Rafua-Redgrave)'s older brother.

name.native: ヴィンス・ラファ・レッドグレイブ

278298.description: Current head of the Redgrave Household and father of [Gilbert Rapha Redgrave](https://anilist.co/character/278296/Rapha-Redgrave-Gilbert) and [Angelica Rapha Redgrave](https://anilist.co/character/152676/Rafua-Redgrave-Angelica).

278300.description: A Half-Elf servant of [Marie](https://anilist.co/character/152675/Marie--Fou-Lafuan). He was supposed to be a servant of [Olivia](https://anilist.co/character/152673/Olivia) according to original game.

278301.description: One of the princesses of the Principality of Fanoss

278302.description:
Height:168cm
Clarice was engaged to [Jilk](https://anilist.co/character/265075/Jilk-Fia-Marmoria), however, after Jilk was disinherited, he ended their engagement via letter. She tried to contact him multiple times, but Jilk refused to speak to her in person. She eventually grew to hate Jilk. She tried to sabotage Jilk during an air bike race, but [Leon](https://anilist.co/character/152674/Leon-Fou-Baltfault) was able to win the race and convinces Jilk to meet up with her so she could get proper closure from him.

278388.description: An ancient dragon who nearly destroyed the world after Demon Lord disappeared. She disguises herself as Jessica and acts as an instructor in the Laville National Academy Of Magic.

278391.description: Elrado is said to be a child prodigy from the House of Duke Burks. He used to bully [Ginny Fin de Salvan](https://anilist.co/character/152258/Ginny-Fin-de-Salvan), but stopped after being defeated by [Ard Meteor](https://anilist.co/character/152259/Ard-Meteor) in a duel.

278397.description: Father of [Shiho Sawaragi](https://anilist.co/character/127638/Shiho-Sawaragi). He works as a policeman, and is close friends with [Yutaka Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/278398/Mikasa-Yutaka).

278439.description: A girl in Kaoru's class who loves bossing him around.

278440.description: Kaoru's younger sister who passed away five years ago.

278661.description: He is a Beast Tamer who originally had no other combat skills except weak fire and healing spells, which leads him to be expelled from the hero's party. However, upon meeting Kanade and making a contract with her, Rein learns that he can also obtain other skills from members of strongest races, which makes him stronger with each new contract.

278662.description: Kanade is a talented and powerful fighter from the Cat Tribe, the rarest of the strongest races. She left her hometown in search for adventure. After she meets Rein Shroud, she asks him to tame her, and Rein does so, making her his first companion.

278663.description: Tania is a red dragon, a member of Dragon Tribe, and is traveling the world challenging worthy fighters until Rein and Kanade defeat her. After befriending them, she joins the party, making her his second contractual.

name.native: バンデル・ヒム・ゼンデン

279430.description: The strongest warrior in The Principality, earning himself the title of The Black Knight.

279505.description:
The top pilot backed by Peil Technologies, one of the group's three branches. A third-year student in the piloting department. Elan is a taciturn and solitary person, who doesn't open his heart to anyone in school. He has an interest to Suletta.

(Source: Official Website)

279506.description:
An heir to Jeturk Heavy Machinery, one of the group's three branches, and a third-year student in the piloting department. Guel has a rough temperament and is quick to anger. As the ace pilot of Jeturk House, he has absolute confidence in his own skills.

(Source: Official Website)

name.native: スレッタ・マーキュリー

279507.description:
A second-year student in the piloting department, who transferred to the school from Mercury. Suletta is timid and somewhat lacks communication skills. She is the pilot of the Gundam Aerial developed on Mercury.

~!Suletta was one of the repli-children created from Ericht Samaya. However, according to official records, she had a deceased father. As Aliya Mahvash mentioned when she told her fortune, she learned that her father had passed away when she was a young child.!~

name.native: ミオリネ・レンブラン

279508.description:
An attractive and academically distinguished second-year student in the management strategy department. Miorine is the only daughter of Delling Rembran, the president of the Beneritt Group and chairman of the school's board. She has a strong rebellious feeling towards her father.

Miorine has shown an interest in gardening in her spare time, with an apparent focus on tomatoes.

(Source:  Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury Official Site)

name.native: アルミリア・ボードウィン

279603.description: Engaged to McGillis at a young age, Almiria is enthusiastic of the arrangement and works to make sure she'll be a proper wife. She is the sister of Gaelio Bauduin.

279926.description: A famous and wealthy Japanese painter. Komari's father and Kakushi's father-in-law.

279935.description: She's Ittoki and Kosetsu's classmate who appears to be friendly and weak, however unbeknownst to the two and to Suzaku Ban, she's deceptive and manipulative. She belongs to the Fuma Village, whose ways were conservative and radical, they frown about the changing times and prefers the old ways of the ninja.

279936.description:
She belongs to the Saiga village that is already endangered by disappearing, her village was once known as the technological hub of ninjutsu, where during its heydays was to go to place for ninjutsu tech. She and her father were the last of the said village, but despite her father's reluctance to let her continue the family tradition of her being a ninja, she is still hopeful to revive the village and still invents stuff that she and her friends can use. 

Despite having moderate fighting skills she excels in studies and would often ace any test, she also excels in the use of technology in conjunction with her ninjutsu.

279937.description: Ittoki's classmate and a ninja from the Koga village. Hiding her ninja status, she "became" Ittoki's temporarily girlfriend in an attempt to kill him.

279996.description: Novak is a former mercenary and current inquisitor. He doesn't particularly believe in the church's dogma, but wants to maintain a peaceful society for the sake of his daughter.

279999.description: Badeni is a monk in search of the "moment that makes life special." As a result of that, his eyes were burned out and he was moved to a rural village. He has an extraordinary amount of knowledge and the ability to calculate.

280002.description: Pessimistic and afraid of looking up at the sky, this private police duelist by trade goes on an unlikely astronomical quest. “Oczy” is the plural word of “oko”, the Polish word for “eye”.

280138.description:
**Height:** 154 cm

A fresh-faced 17-year-old girl who moves to Akiba to become a maid cafe waitress after seeing a flier from the Oinky Doink Cafe. Despite her initial enthusiasm, Nagomi quickly becomes disillusioned when she gets dragged into the schemes of the Cafe and her Manager as she begins to learn the hard reality of being a maid.

280139.description:
**Height:** 166 cm

A 35-year-old woman with a stern, professional demeanor at all times, whether serving patrons at the cafe or gunning down rival maids. Despite being introduced as a rookie at the Oinky Doink Cafe, Ranko has a history in the world of the Akiba Maids stretching back over a decade. She previously spent some time in prison.

280422.description: [Souichirou Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/253948/Souichirou-Tachibana)'s fraternal twin sister. She also plays soccer, currently as a member of Tokyo Musashino Women's Youth.

280423.description:
__Jersey Number:__ 10
__Position:__ MF

Captain of Tokyo Musashino Youth. He was teammates with [Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/253948/Souichirou-Tachibana) in middle school. Plays midfield.

280424.description:
__Height__: 163cm
__Position:__ Defender

A first year high school student. 

After failing the Tokyo Esperion Youth tryouts he, just like [Kaneda](https://anilist.co/character/278135/Akinori-Kaneda), joined Tokyo Musashino Youth.

280454.description: GGG Super-AI Multi-Robo GMX-GH101: GoldyMarg was constructed specifically to carry the Goldion Hammer and transform into the Marg Hand that allows GaoGaiGar to use it properly and without damage. He also has the ability to System Change into the Goldy Tank, which has a powerful Fusion Beam Cannon. His AI is patterned on Geki Hyuuma, giving him a hotheaded personality

281109.description:
The best friend of [Hikaru](https://anilist.co/character/281110/Hikaru-Indou), he is a quiet teenage boy. He has a fondness for animals and insects. 

~!The first to realize that "Hikaru" isn't Hikaru. He struggles with accepting the fact that his childhood friend has been replaced by something else, yet continues to go about his daily life with it.!~

281110.description:
An easy going teenage boy who went missing in the forbidden mountains for a week about half a year ago.

~!A shapeshifter who took the form of Hikaru after his death. This new "Hikaru" has become greatly attached to Hikaru's best friend, [Yoshiki](https://anilist.co/character/281109/Tsujinaka-Yoshiki). It seems innocent and full of curiosity.!~

281250.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

An energetic but self-conscious girl. She admires [Tani](https://anilist.co/character/281251/Yusuke-Tani) for being the complete opposite of herself, but she can't interact with him normally and always ends up bothering him with pointless conversation.

281251.description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7")

A quiet boy who clearly states his opinions. [Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/281250/Miyu-Suzuki) always approaches him with a lighthearted vibe, but he always seems to reply curtly.

281763.description:
__Occupation:__ Office Worker

A tired middle-aged corporate slave. His daily relaxation comes from cigarettes and Yamada's cheerful hospitality.

~!He doesn't recognize that his favorite employee, Yamada, is the same person as his new smoking friend, Tayama.!~

281764.description:
Yamada is an employee of the supermarket known as Super S. She initially started in a part-time position 8 years ago as a teenager.

~!As Yamada, she is a cheerful, flawless customer handler. Her real self, which she introduces to [Sasaki](https://anilist.co/character/281763/Sasaki) as "Tayama", is much more frank and less outwardly polite. She invites Sasaki to come to the smoking area behind the store, which he then does regularly.!~

282618.description: She was a researcher who represented the Vanadis Institute. As a leading proponent of the "GUND FORMAT" theory, she had earned the respect of her fellow researchers

282621.description: The father of the Samaya family.

282967.description: Forward for Tokyo City Esperion FC Youth B Team. He was promoted from the junior youth team.

282968.description: Goalkeeper for the Tokyo City Esperion FC Youth B Team. He was promoted from the junior youth team.

282969.description: Defender/Midfielder for Tokyo City Esperion FC Youth B Team. He was promoted from the junior youth team.

283066.description: Ittoki's rival and classmate from the Ninja Academy. He has a strong prejudiced hate against Ittoki for the Iga clan's murder of Koga's head, a man whom Suzaku had highly admired.

283100.description:
A minor character in the Confession Executive Committee: Love Series, and Haruki Serizawa's deceased older brother. Chiaki and Haruki look one and the same, but his hair is slightly messier than Haruki's. He has blond hair like his brother, but his roots are brown. In the anime, however, the brown roots are done away with and his hair is completely blond. He once saved a girl from drowning. After that, he died from an unknown sickness.

~!He is later revealed to be Miou's savior.!~

(Source: Love Committee Wiki)

283404.description:
A terrorist who attacked a subway station.
~!He was the one who blew up the radio tower prior to the events of the series, and had met young chisato during that time!~
~!He, alongside Chisato is also a child of Alan!~
~!In the last episode he is shown falling to his death, however shortly after it is revealed he survived!~

283406.description: Cafeteria worker at the Tokyo City Esperion FC facility. She connects [Kuribayashi](https://anilist.co/character/162034/Haruhisa-Kuribayashi) with [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/162035/Hana-Ichijou) so he can ask Hana to make him a meal plan.

name.native: セイカ・ランプローグ

283420.description: He is the reincarnation of Haruyoshi Kuga. He is very kind and will do anything to protect people dearest to him.

283421.description:
A young girl who served as a slave in Seika's birthplace, the House of Count Lambrogue. Although she hides it from her surroundings, she has the power to see "spirits" that even Seika cannot see, and the talent to follow them. Ever since she was young, she has taken a liking to Seika, who has treated her well.
~!She is a half elf.!~

283422.description:
A commoner girl who, like Seika, came to take the entrance exam for Rodnaire Academy of Magic. She has magical aptitude for all attributes, and she has an amazing talent for swords and magic, topping the entrance exam. Because of her ability, it is rumored that she is a "hero" who can defeat the Demon King.
~!She is also the hero who is destined to be protected by the Demon king!~
~!She also looks like Haruyosh's disciple who killed him!~

284157.description:
Lucy is a mysterious netrunner from Night City. She is quite introverted and doesn't like to talk much about her past. Although she looks innocent, she won't hesitate to kill a person in a heartbeat if they tick her off. Lucy also considers Night City a prison and dreams of one day leaving it for the moon.

Lucy is a part of [Maine](https://anilist.co/character/284159)'s crew of edgerunners. One of its members, a netrunner named [Kiwi](https://anilist.co/character/284161), is her mentor. She also becomes acquainted with [David](https://anilist.co/character/284158) and takes him on a tour through Night City's criminal underworld, leading the two of them to become partners in Maine's crew.

~!She is Half Polish and Half Japanese!~

name.native: デイビッド・マルティネズ

284158.description:
David is a street kid from Arroyo, Santo Domingo in Night City, who is enrolled into Arasaka's educational system at Arasaka Academy. He lives with his mother Gloria in an apartment of Megabuilding H4.

After experiencing a personal tragedy, David has the powerful Sandevistan speedware installed in his body and becomes one of Night City's edgerunners. He also becomes acquainted with [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/284157/Lucy), who leads him into the city's criminal underworld, and chooses to join the gang of edgerunners she is a part of, led by [Maine](https://anilist.co/character/284159/Maine).

284159.description: Maine used to be a military soldier before he became a mercenary. Now a veteran edgerunner in Night City, Maine dreams of "making it big", although he values his friendships with his crew more than his own glory.

284162.description: Pilar is an edgerunner of Night City, known to be a comical and crude techie who loves to show off. He and his sister, [Rebecca](https://anilist.co/character/284163/Rebecca), often team up with [Maine](https://anilist.co/character/284159/Maine) and his crew to conduct mercenary jobs.

284163.description: Rebecca is an edgerunner of Night City, and is described as a short, spunky, trigger-happy solo who is always fighting with her brother [Pilar](https://anilist.co/character/284162/Pilar). The two siblings often team up with [Maine](https://anilist.co/character/284159/Maine) and his crew to conduct mercenary jobs.

284165.description: Faraday is a ruthless fixer with ties to Militech and a distinctive optic cyberware that gives him four eyes. He is based in Santo Domingo and often employs Maine to conduct jobs.

name.native: グロリア・マルティネズ

284166.description: Both Gloria and her son David live in an apartment of Megabuilding H4 in Santo Domingo, Night City. She is an emergency medical technician (EMT).

284260.description:
He is a young man who travels around Japan looking for doors that appear all over the country as a "closers" to close doors that bring "disasters".

He meets Suzume on his way to the ruins where the door is located.

~!He is turned into Suzume's three-legged chair by Daijin.!~

284261.description:
A mysterious white cat that speaks human language who suddenly appears in front of Suzume.

~!It appears at places where doors open and plays tricks on Suzume and her friends. In the form of a cat statue, it was the western gatestone responsible for holding back the worms from escaping open doors in abandoned places before it was unknowingly released by Suzume.!~ ~!Daijin transforms Souta into a chair and designates him as its replacement as the western gatestone.!~ ~!Daijin becomes thinner and more ragged in body structure when rejected by Suzume and gains its normal appearance back when treated with kindness.!~

284533.description: Sora, a dryad from the Spirit Tribe, was given the job of protecting the forest and safeguarding the Shield of Truths. She gave the shield to Rein and others after they told her it was needed to defeat the demon lord. Noticing that she is sad, Rein asks her to tell the reason. Sora told Rein and others that her younger twin sister was captured by Shadow Knight as an offering to protect their village. Rein helped her and her sister by defeating Shadow Knight. Then, Sora and Luna decided to join his party, making them his third and fourth contractual.

284534.description: Luna, a Dryad from the Spirit Tribe, was sacrificed to Shadow Knight in order to protect their village. At Sora's request, Rein helped her and her older twin sister by defeating Shadow Knight. Along with Sora, decided to join his party, making them his third and fourth contractual.

284573.description: Assuming the identity of a boy named Hitori, he and his brother Dali are adopted by the middle-aged couple, Mr. and Mrs. Sonoyama. He's shown to be more sensitive of the two when it comes to emotions and has a hard time controlling his feelings.

284574.description: Assuming the identity of a boy named Hitori, he and his brother Migi are adopted by the middle-aged couple, Mr. and Mrs. Sonoyama. He can be described as logical and precise. Dali is the twin most focused on his vengeance and instructs Migi to act stealthily like a good boy, but at times, he can lose his composure. Dali is highly protective of Migi; if anyone messes with Migi, Dali may resort to violent methods.

284780.description: Amanda is a half-elf who is an extremely famous and powerful A-ranked Adventurer of Altessa, who's main weapon of a choice is a mixture of a whip and wind magic.

284781.description: Donadrond is an instructor working at Alessa's Adventurer's Guild. He is also tasked with dissuading weaker looking wannabe adventurers wanting to sign up to the guild by beating them up in a duel.

284841.description: Tsumugi's mother. ~!She died due to unknown illness 6 months before the events of the series.!~

284843.description: Mother of Iida Kotori. Often out of the house due to her work with TV food shows. Owns the diner Kotori and Inuzuka-sensei use for cooking practice.

alternative: The Twin Pillars of Rakoste Vocational High School

284964.description:
__Birthplace:__ Kagoshima Prefecture
__Height:__ 182 cm (6'0")

Junichi Wanima is a contender in the Blue Lock Project and the older twin brother of [Keisuke Wanima](https://anilist.co/character/284965).

285223.description: The school nurse and DIY club advisor.

285278.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

Katori is the childhood friend of [Himuro](https://anilist.co/character/151351/Himurokun). He is the descendant of a Phoenix.

285315.description: A scheming witch who is mistakenly considered a hero and city protector by the townspeople.

285339.description: Onkei is a eunuch who was asked by [Eisei](https://anilist.co/character/270934/Eisei) to serve as [Jusetsu Ryuu](https://anilist.co/character/270928/Jusetsu-Ryuu)'s bodyguard.

285560.description: Anzu Hoshino is the protagonist who bears the "anti-heroine" attribute. She is a high school first year who claims her 3 great desires are video games, cat, and chocolate. She has no interest in real life romance and has been counter-measuring all the shojo manga-like situations conspired by [Riri](https://anilist.co/character/285561/Riri). She is logical and a very caring person who can't leave her troubled friends. Her biggest fear are cockroaches.

285561.description: Riri is a wizard who can do romantic magic with their star shaped magic wand.

285827.description:
**Height:** 149 cm

One of the veteran maids at the Oinky Doink Cafe, with a small but dedicated following, able to read other people and turn on her charm as needed.

285831.description:
**Height:** 158 cm

A tanned gyaru and another veteran maid at the Oinky Doink Cafe.

285834.description:
**Height:** 175 cm

The mascot of the Oinky Doink Cafe, despite being a panda instead of a pig. Their true identity is currently unknown, but Okachimachi does support the other cafe members as needed.

286677.description: Fujino is a fourth grader who draws 4-panel manga strips for the elementary school's newspaper. Her talent as well as her funny stories are praised by her classmates. But one day, she is challenged by the skilled drawings of a truant student from next-door class, and becomes determined to improve her art.

name.native: チュアチュリー・パンランチ

286806.description:
Chuchu is a troubled young girl, who is an Earthian facing discrimination from a significant portion of the Spacians who look down on Earthians as underlings. Being in the same school as many Spacians, she along with her Earthian friends has been the subject of regular abuse and harassment. This along with her home people being the subject of Spacian oppression and exploitation has given Chuchu a profoundly negative impression of all Spacians often deriding them as "Shitty Spacians" and lashing at them at the first opportunity. 

Because of the harsh circumstances of her growth and her present situation, Chuchu is rather hot-headed and prone to pick fights, especially with Spacians who harass or torment others for fun or classism. Chuchu sees herself as someone who carries the burdens and hopes of her home people and is sympathetic to those who carry similar struggles.

286932.description: Kyomoto is a truant student in fourth grade. Because she doesn't show up to school, she practices drawing at home relentlessly. One day, her art gets published alongside [Fujino](https://anilist.co/character/286677)'s in the elementary school's newspaper, which began a one-sided rivalry.

287140.description: Nina, a member of Demigod Race, was worshipped as a deity in her homeland until she is captured and sold into slavery, where she is put magic collar to restrain her and enslaved by Edgar Fromware. After being saved by Rein Shroud, she became his fifth contractual.

name.native: ステラ・エンプレイス

287141.description:
She is the vice-captain of the Order of Knights. She created a rebellion group of female knights and formed an alliance with Rein Shroud to stop the misdoings of Edgar Fromware and his father.

After Edgar's downfall, Stella has been promoted to captain of The Knights when replacing her former mentor and captain, Jill Stregger.

287144.description: A talented writer, on the brink of ending his life alongside his cherished "Sachiko", was unexpectedly struck by a "that truck" and transported to another world. Carrying his favorite sleeping pills, he is always searching for a place to die.

287420.description: Falco is a Nomad wheelman, and part of Maine's edgerunner crew.

287479.description: Joined the Tokyo City Esperion FC Junior Youth team on a trial basis, along with [Togashi](https://anilist.co/character/253950/Keiji-Togashi), as a kid. Walked away from the team after a few days of the trail due to the treatment from the existing academy players.

287481.description: Joined the Tokyo City Esperion FC Junior Youth team on a trial basis, along with [Togashi](https://anilist.co/character/253950/Keiji-Togashi), as a kid. Walked away from the team after a few days of the trail due to the treatment from the existing academy players.

287673.description:
[Anisphia](https://anilist.co/character/203119/Wynn-Palettia-Anisphia)'s personal maid. Although a servant, she watches over Anisphia like an older sister. She was saved by Anisphia in the past and is deeply loyal to her.

~!Ilia was born into a low-ranking noble family. To improve their status, her parents intended to marry her off to an influential husband, basically treating their daughter as a political tool. All of this caused Ilia to grow up to become a fairly weak-willed person who did whatever she was told. However, before marrying her off, her family had her work at the royal palace as a maid.

This led to her meeting Princess Anisphia, the Anisphia made Ilia her personal maid and permitted her to talk openly in her presence. All of this caused Ilia's personality to undergo a great change as she became much more blunt and willing to stand up for herself. Eventually, she cut all ties with her parents and continued serving as Anisphia's maid after the princess moved into the new Separate Palace.!~

name.native: アルガルド・ボナ・パレッティア

287676.description: Crown Prince of the Kingdom of Palettia. Engaged to [Euphilia Magenta](https://anilist.co/character/203120/Magenta-Euphyllia).

287678.description:
The daughter of a commoner elevated to the rank of Baron. Despite her humble origins, she has succeeded in attracting the attention of the sons of several influential nobles at the aristocratic academy.

~!It is eventually revealed that Lainie is actually a vampire who constantly gives off a charm that makes people infatuated with her, which she herself was unaware of. Following this, she is taken in by Anisphia so she may learn to control her abilities, which she repays by working for her as a maid.!~

name.native: ティルティ・クラーレット

287679.description:
The eldest daughter of the powerful Marquis Claret. She has withdrawn to a private residence, where she studies curses. Occasionally she conducts joint research with [Anisphia](https://anilist.co/character/203119/Wynn-Palettia-Anisphia), but they have a complicated relationship because of their different beliefs.

~!Tilty suffers from an incurable affliction that left her unable to properly release her magical energy, causing her physical and mental pain whenever she tries to use magic. Nonetheless, her family, being traditionalists blindly faithful to the spirits, forced her to learn to use her magic anyway. This continued until the pain finally caused Tilty to snap and lash out against her family.!~

287816.description:
A cold and reserved boy who is Anzu's first romance candidate. He is popular among women due to his good looks but tends to avoid them, rejecting any romantic proposals outright. He meets Anzu in a meet cute where she accidentally bumps into him and breaks his phone. Due to Riri's meddling, his house is flooded and he has to live with Anzu early in the story. 

It is later revealed that before transferring schools he was a warm and caring person who could "befriend anyone", indicating that his cold appearance is a façade.  In an effort to distance himself from women's attention, he often wears hats in public and experiences panic attacks if left alone with them due to traumatic memories. 
His personality changed drastically after being repeatedly stalked by an older woman he had helped once, to the point where he was forced to transfer from his house and school to be away from her and his strict father who blamed him for the situation. 

~!He finally realizes his hidden feelings for Anzu after she helps him many times, considering her to be his savior.!~

287817.description: A wealthy boy who is not in touch with the lives of "peasants", also set up by Riri for Anzu. He meets Anzu in a twist on a classic anime meet cute, where she is running late to school and is hit by his car. He takes her on a date for compensation, assuming she got hit on purpose, and is shocked when she rejects him. He is not used to having girls reject him so he tries to woo Anzu by buying her off. After being called out and further by Anzu, he tries to navigate common life by getting a job at the convenience store that Anzu works at and getting his own money. Knowing how much Hijiri was used to getting what he wanted, his father had transferred him from his former private school so that he could learn to fend for himself. It is shown that he too gradually developed a romantic interest in Anzu, as well as a hot and cold "tsundere" personality.

287821.description:
The "childhood friend" that Riri set up for Anzu. Anzu originally believed him to be a random hot guy brainwashed by Riri, but it is later revealed that he is in fact a childhood friend of Anzu.

He had picked up baseball and changed himself after overhearing Anzu say that she would like to date an "athletic guy who can beat the boss."

Anzu is aware of his feelings for her, and acts oblivious to hide it from him.

alternative: Lily White (リリィー ホワイト)

288123.description:
__Height:__ 145 cm

[Shuu Ogata](https://anilist.co/character/268522/Ogata-Shuu)'s sister. Half human and half demon. Disappeared due to the incident 12 years prior.

288473.description: A girl with a dark and cold atmosphere. She is a junior at the school that Seika attends, but she is not Amu, who is the top student in the school year, but at the request of the principal of the school, she will participate in the general martial arts tournament in the Imperial City with Seika.

288474.description: Ayakashi, a Kangitsune that Seika has been using since before she was reincarnated. She is a useless mascot character with possessiveness and supernatural powers, but she loves Seika from the bottom of his heart. In the past, the human body was like an adult woman, but in this world, for some reason, it has become smaller overall. She usually hides in Seika's hair in the form of Kangitsune.

288810.description:
