She is a first-year student of Fujino Misaki High School who was unable to make friends due to extreme fright, and she was escaping from reality, thinking that she could express her feelings to aliens living on planets other than Earth.

She is extremely frightened and unable to communicate well with others. After meeting [Yu](https://anilist.co/character/300088/Yuu-Akeuchi), they set a goal to build a rocket to reach the stars in space.

Her special skill is swimming.

name.native: デリング・レンブラン

288842.description: The president of the Benerit Group, and supervising representative of the auditing organization Cathedra.

288851.description: She is a second-year student in the Business Strategy Department at Burion House. She is a member of the Dueling Committee. Secelia is a sarcastic person with a foul mouth. No one is better than her when it comes to sarcasm.

288953.description: Serufu's mother, who is just as laid back as her daughter.

289014.description:
__Level:__ 800
__Species:__ Magical Beast

A one-of-a-kind monster called the "Rainbow Sheep", who was taken in by [Lufas](https://anilist.co/character/161623/Maphaahl-Lufas) and made the first member of her Twelve Heavenly Stars, representing the **Ram** constellation. In spite of his feminine human form, he is male.

289015.description:
__Level:__  800
__Species:__  Demon Lord

A demon who faithfully serves in Lufas's Twelve Heavenly Stars, representing the **Goat** constellation. He is feared by all as the "Demon Lord Aigokeros". His anthropomorphic form is that of an elderly butler, and although he is loyal to Lufas, he can also tend to run amok.

289017.description: A blue-haired girl who the resurrected [Lufas](https://anilist.co/character/161623/Maphaahl-Lufas) met at her former base, the Tower of Mafahl. She claims to be Lufas's loyal retainer and has been waiting for her return for 200 years.

289020.description:
__Level:__  910
__Species:__  Golem

An artificial golem in the form of a maid, who is a member of Lufas's Twelve Heavenly Stars representing the **Scales** constellation. Out of the Twelve Heavenly Stars, she is the most brutal combat-wise, as her ultimate skill **Brachium** can provide unavoidable near-fatal damage to anyone who stands in its way.

289022.description:
__Level:__  320
__Species:__  Heaven-Winged

A heaven-winged girl raised in Vanaheimr by her mentor, [Parthenos](https://anilist.co/character/358430/Parthenos).

289027.description:
__Level:__  15
__Species:__  Human

An ordinary high school boy who, after Lufas' resurrection, was brought to Mizgarz via a hero summoning ceremony. With an extremely average body and no special skills at all, he sets out to defeat the Demon Lord and Lufas, both of whom threaten humanity.

289028.description:
__Species:__  Vampire

One of Lufas' former comrades and one of the Seven Heroes. Has outstanding combat and magic power even among vampires, and after Lufas' sealing founded the Kingdom of Mjolnir, where she dominates all immortal monsters.

289032.description: The ruler of the demons. After Lufas' sealing, he won the battle against the Seven Heroes and cursed their bodies, taking away their powers. Since then, he has intensified his armies' offensive against humanity and continues to threaten their existence.

name.native: プロスペラ・マーキュリー

289107.description: The CEO of the Shin Sei Development Corporation, which is headquartered at Mercury. She was in charge of the Gundam Aerial's development, and is Suletta's mother. She always wears special headgear for physical support.

289297.description:
__Race:__ Elf

Eta is the seventh member of Shadow Garden, being one of the original Seven Shadows. She specializes and is in charge of the research faction of Shadow Garden and as a result has her own laboratory. She is known as Eta Lloyd Wright, the genius architect, whose work won unanimous first place in an Architecture of the Year.

289467.description: A middle-ranking reporter for Bernardelli News Agency. Travels with Meryl as her educator. He is a drunkard who loves sake and is aloof, but he is a veteran who has overcome many battles.

289531.description:
__Height:__ 163 cm

~!A former Liebe employee who disrupted the work environment due to her relationship with [Nene](https://anilist.co/character/253967/Nishidera-Nene). She played the role of a seductive, wicked older sister character.!~

289802.description: Magna is one of the Ten Patch Priest and the Patch Officiant responsible for overseeing Teams "Hana-Gumi", "Hoshi-Gumi", and "Magical Princesses".

289803.description: Ohachiyo is a small rabbit-like demon that once took care of the orphaned Asaha Doji who would later be known as Asakura Hao.

289805.description: Bron is one of the Ten Patch Priests and the Officiant responsible for overlooking Lyserg Diethel and overseeing the X-Laws Teams.

289807.description: Khafre is part of Team "Niles". Anatel considers him to be the best embalmer ever.

289808.description: Rutherfor is one of the Ten Patch Officiants, responsible for overlooking the Shaman Fight.

289809.description: Thalim is one of the Ten Patch Officiants who oversees the Shaman Fight 2000 in Tokyo and runs the series of Patch's Cafés. He is also responsible for overseeing Team "Kabbalahers" and Team "Cowboys".

289810.description: Namari is one of the Ten Patch Priests overseeing the Shaman Fight and the Patch Officiant responsible for overseeing the Gandhara teams and Team "Tsuchi-Gumi".

289824.description:
Maru is a boy searching for a place called "Heaven".

~!He is the alleged son of [Tokio](https://anilist.co/character/289825/Tokio) and [Kona](https://anilist.co/character/289848/Kona).!~

289828.description: Kiruko is [Maru](https://anilist.co/character/289824/Maru)'s bodyguard, and he is searching for a place known as "Heaven".

289968.description:
[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/fantastic_sweeper0516/)

Kazuki lives with his colleague and buddy [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/289969/Suwa-Rei), who also looks after his personal needs. Contracting, gathering information in advance, and making execution plans are the main areas of work with Rei. He likes women and gambling and he has good communication skills. He is skilled at cooking and cleaning, and he occasionally chastises Rei for his indulgent lifestyle. 

He was previously married and had a wife who was pregnant with his child, but he lost her due to his shady work.

289969.description:
Rei is a man of few words who doesn't mind that [Kazuki](https://anilist.co/character/289968/Kurusu-Kazuki) has already moved into his house. He is physically strong, and his fighting abilities and marksmanship are among the best in the industry. He has a clear separation between his professional and personal lives and spends most of his time at home playing video games. His family is a large underworld family, and his parents have been training him as a gifted assassin since he was a child. 

He has not been able to escape the family feud and has no comprehension of normal parent-child relationships.

289970.description: Miri is an innocent girl who is just as energetic and fearless. Her father is a mafia boss and a major broker for a human trafficking organization. Her mother is the mistress of the boss. When she arrives at the hotel in search of her father, she becomes involved in a gunfight and is rescued by Kazuki. She is friendly and refers to Kazuki as "Papa Kazuki" and Rei as "Papa Rei".

290163.description: One of the girls who came to cheer for Aoba Johsai, especially Oikawa, during the Interhigh Preliminary match against Karasuno. Throughout the match, she shows that she isn't too familiar with the rules and plays of volleyball and relies on [Takinoue](https://anilist.co/character/80511/Yuusuke-Takinoue) and [Shimada](https://anilist.co/character/80513/Makoto-Shimada) to explain things to her. She would later appear during Seijoh's rematch against Karasuno.

290164.description: One of the girls who came to cheer for Aoba Johsai, especially [Oikawa](https://anilist.co/character/71611/Tooru-Oikawa), during the InterHigh Preliminary. Throughout the match, she shows that she isn't too familiar with the rules and plays of volleyball and relies on [Takinoue](https://anilist.co/character/80511/Yuusuke-Takinoue) and [Shimada](https://anilist.co/character/80513/Makoto-Shimada) to explain things to her. She would later appear during Seijoh's rematch against Karasuno.

290165.description:
__Uniform Number:__ 11

Third-year student at Karasuno High and wing spiker for the girls' volleyball team. She is close friends with [Michimiya](https://anilist.co/character/77165/Yui-Michimiya) and Aihara.

290202.description:
__Height:__ 186.8cm (6' 1.5")
__Uniform Number:__ 1
__Position:__ Middle Blocker
__Ability Parameters (out of 5):__ Power = 5; Jump = 2; Stamina = 4; Game Sense 2; Technique = 2; Speed = 4

Third-year student at Datekougyou High School. Prior to retiring, he played on the boys' volleyball team as a middle blocker and the vice-captain. He is loud, strict, and often argues with and threatens his problematic kouhai [Futakuchi](https://anilist.co/character/77415/Kenji-Futakuchi). However, he is incredibly supportive of his team and often attends their official and practices matches with [Moniwa](https://anilist.co/character/77413/Kaname-Moniwa) and [Sasaya](https://anilist.co/character/137486/Takehito-Sasaya) after retiring.

290205.description:
__Uniform Number:__ 2

Third-year student at Karasuno High School. She played on the girls' volleyball team as the team's ace and vice-captain. She is good friends with and very supportive of [Michimiya](https://anilist.co/character/77165/Yui-Michimiya).

290272.description: Hinako is a young lady from one of Japan's largest conglomerates. On the surface, Hinako appears to be a brilliant and beautiful young woman, but in reality, she is a lazy girl with no life skills.

name.native: フィオナ・ウルド・エールグライフ

290375.description: Akashi has dark hair and eyes, but fair skin. Not much is understood about his family, but it is shown that his father had died during a former investigation of the Lightless Realm.

290376.description: She was a test pilot for IX but she now has to go through training again as she was selected as part of the elite team investigating the Lightless Realm.

290377.description: He has short, white hair and brown eyes. He killed his family when he was younger due to being stuck in the Lightless Realm.

290379.description: A very eccentric scientist from IX in charge of the creation of the MA-Vess and the LIM system. He is very interested in finding out the truth about the Lightless Realm.

290380.description: Emiru Hazaki, a tall girl with long blonde hair in the style of two long ponytails that reach to her thighs, brown eyes and fair pale skin. Emiru had lost her parents in the Lightless Realm when she was little, and so she was adopted by her relatives.

290381.description: A young girl with short, silver hair and large brown eyes with pale looking skin.

290382.description: The most cheerful and easy going member of Team Gargouille. He has brown hair and dark brown eyes.

290383.description: Akashi's friend who is also a 2nd-year from Kukonochi Academy. He is tall, has brown hair and eyes and wears a red headband.

290384.description: Sasame's older sister with the same appearance as Sasame except with longer hair.

290385.description: A scientist at the academy who used to be Aoshi's lover.

290386.description: A government military officer assigned to supervise the Team Gargouille. She used to be schoolmates with Kasane and dislikes being called by her first name.

290387.description: A 1st-year high-schooler from Kukonochi Academy. Has black hair tied into two low tails and big black eyes. Although soft spoken and shy, she tends to express her dark emotions in a notebook.

290389.description: The older brother of Akashi. He is one of the first people to use a MA-Vess before the LIM system was created.

290511.description: One of the mages from [Rein](https://anilist.co/character/278661/Rein)'s former party.

290517.description: Kanon Hisui is a Ranger and a member of Green Battalion, with the rank of Junior First Class.

290518.description: Footsoldier XX or more commonly known as XX is a foot soldier of the Villainous Army who similar to Foot Soldier D, left the Sky Fortress in order to defeat the Dragon Keepers.

290519.description: Aizome Komachi is a Ranger and a member of Blue Battalion who is acting as the Junior First Class.

290520.description:
Angel Usukubo is a Rankless Green Battalion Ranger. 

~!It is later revealed her father is the leader of the Invader Rights Association, Yakushi Usukubo.!~

290638.description: Kai Shion is an Independent Ranger currently taking the Bailong Exam.

290639.description: The man who serves as the chairman of the Japan Football Association. He sees soccer as a business and doesn't really think about helping the Japanese national team win The World Cup. He is also skeptical of the "Blue Lock" project.

290700.description: Machi Kuga is the younger sister of [Ichirou Kuga](https://anilist.co/character/272394/Ichirou-Kuga) and older sister of [Fumio Kuga](https://anilist.co/character/290701/Fumio-Kuga). She is an energetic child with a kind personality, often seen taking care of Fumio to allow Ichirou to focus on his work.

290701.description: Fumio is the younger brother of [Ichirou Kuga](https://anilist.co/character/272394/Ichirou-Kuga) and [Machi Kuga](https://anilist.co/character/290700/Machi-Kuga). He is a timid child, rarely talking and often seen clinging to his older sister.

290877.description:
The seventh prince of the royal family that rules the Kingdom of Saloum. He was reincarnated and grows up with the memories of his previous life as a sorcerer. Although he's only ten years old, he has an enormous amount of sorcery knowledge and possesses mana that even terrifies demons. He's not interested in things such as succession to the throne, girls, or romance. Instead, his activities and desires are all focused on the research of his beloved sorcery and its practice. 

(Source: Official Site)

290878.description:
A demon who uses the old magic and once drove the Kingdom of Saloum into the verge of collapse. After being sealed inside of a forbidden tome that was locked away in the kingdom's sealed archive for several centuries, he's released by Lloyd and they have their first encounter. But he becomes overwhelmed by Lloyd's immeasurable mana and sorcery and surrenders to him. After that, he turns into a cute familiar and serves Lloyd. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

name.native: ベリル・ガーデナント

291242.description:
__Race:__ Human/Ghost
__Occupation:__ Maid

Tina Hollee is a ghost who had been haunting a mansion where she was killed by her previous master until Rein Shroud came and bought the mansion. She later becomes his sixth contractual after Rein helped her in arresting her murderer and now stays at Rein's residence as a maid.

name.native: マリヤ・ミハイロヴナ・九条

291294.description:
Mariya Mikhailovna Kujou is a second-year student and the student council secretary. Her nickname is Masha and she is the older biological sister of [Alisa Mikhailovna Kujou](https://anilist.co/character/217334/Kujou-Mikhailovna-Alisa). She is one of the two beauties from her school year. She is popular for her looks and motherly gentle aura. She is called the "Madonna" of the school because of this.

Masha purposefully acts like an airhead around Alya because she doesn't want to compete with her. She acts like this because she loves her sister very much. In reality she is very mature and serious deep down inside. [Masachika](https://anilist.co/character/217335/Kuze-Masachika) finds it very hard to read her because of this.

~!Masha turns out to be Maa-chan, Masachika's first love. They were childhood friends and often played together until Masha had to leave for Russia. Masachika never recognised Maa-chan in high school because she had blonde hair and sapphire eyes when she was younger. She continues to love Masachika even now but takes a step back because of her younger sister's feelings for him.!~

name.native: ブライアン・ナイトレイダー
ボルツ・ デクスター
ロビン・ティンバート
ライラ・キャンディハート
セオドア・トンプソン

291639.description:
Bassist and vocalist of the band "SICK HACK".

Always drunk to forget about life's downsides.

291689.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Jinki:__ "Tokushin"

He is a member of the Cleaners' Team Eager. His vital instrument is a distaff and he has a calm demeanor and sharp observing eye.

291877.description: She is the guild receptionist of the city Horizon.

name.native: レベッカ＝ブラッドリィ
アリアーヌ＝オルグレン

292027.description: Ariane is a first-year student at the Diom Academy of Magical Arts. She is a childhood friend of [Amelia](https://anilist.co/character/288008/).

292106.description: Ebihara's subordinate. Looks up to Akira Satou.

292351.description:
__Year:__ 3rd Year
__Jersey Number:__ 6
__Position:__ FB/MF

Third-year Fullback/Midfielder for Tokyo City Esperion Youth FC A Team.

name.native: ミケーレ・クリスピーノ

292677.description:
__Height:__ 179 cm

An Italian figure skater and twin brother of [Sara Crispino](https://anilist.co/character/254925/)

name.native: リアム・セラ・バンフィールド

292833.description: Having lived a miserable life being virtuous, Liam decides to be evil in this next life. However, a combination of his long-term plans to strengthen and develop his fiefdom, comparison against the often corrupt and indolent nobility of the Empire, and comedic happenstance, he ends up looking like a benevolent and just ruler. Even his desire for gold looks odd as it has relatively low monetary value in the new world compared to metals like mithril and adamantium.

292955.description: Fumitan Admoss is Kudelia Aina Bernstein's personal maid. She was assigned to her at a young age and was given the mission to bring Kudelia to her own demise. Despite this, she has changed slowly and began to care for Kudelia. Kudelia treats her like an older sister and often goes to her to ask for advice.

292981.description:
Kudou's friend and owner of the Goldfish Tea House. 
~!Miyuki's ex-boyfriend!~

293041.description:
__Uniform Number:__ 23

Forward for Tokyo City Esperion FC Youth A Team and second year high schooler. He joined the club as a scouted player.

293201.description: **Race:** Human Hiraku Machio is the main protagonist of Isekai Nonbiri Nouka series. He was resurrected with a healthy body, the ability to speak the common tongue, and the All-Purpose Farming Tool (AFT) by God. Despite being unable to use magic, he cultivates the forest to create farmland and a village, with the help of the wolves Kuro and Yuki, the demon spider Zabuton, and even humanoid species.

alternative: Loo Lulucy (ルールーシー＝ルー)

293202.description: __Race:__ Vampire __Affiliation:__ Taiju Village, Kingdom of Galbart (Formerly) Loo is a Female Vampire, who stumbles into Hiraku's farm during his early days of living in the formidable forest of death. On the run, with no where to turn, she falls in love with Hiraku who by this time has not seen another person since coming to the world. She can change her body/age to suit her needs to survive. She is a skilled magician as well as a farmer who works at Hiraku's farm. At first she viewed Hiraku's farm (now a village) as a place she can hide from the nobles and now she views it as home. ~!She and Hiraku had a kid named Alfred.!~

293203.description: **Race:** Angel Tier is one of the main characters of Isekai Nonbiri Nouka series. She is an angel with celestial magical powers and bird-like wings that allow her to fly. She is part of the Angel of Annihilation tribe, specializing in golem magic. Tier visits the forest in search of Loo, her frenemy, and ends up living there with Hiraku and Loo.

293204.description: **Race:** High Elf Ria is the leader of a group of high-elf girls who wandered in the forest after their village was destroyed by humans in a war. They were homeless for 200 years until Tier brought them to Hiraku's farm. Ria is a reliable construction enthusiast and contributes to the farm by establishing a smithy and bringing other technologies such as building construction and baking. After meeting Hiraku and his friends, Ria decides to live with them.

293727.description: Lawine is a third-class mage in the Second Party of the First Class Mage Examinations. She specializes in manipulating ice.

293728.description: Kanne is a third-class mage who graduated from the Academy of Magic. She is childhood friends and classmates with [Lawine](https://anilist.co/character/293727), and the two entered the first-class mage exam together. In the first stage of the exam, she was paired with Lawine and [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754).

name.native: エールドメード・ディティジョン

294130.description:
A rare slime that is almost never seen. It has no official name and is variously referred to as the "Weakest Slime" or the "Fragile Slime." 

According to monster guidebooks, it is said to be "so frail that it vanishes from existence if merely poked or exposed to a strong gust of wind." It becomes [Ivy's](https://anilist.co/character/294131/Ivy) friend, and the two set out on a journey together. It consumes blue potions—bottle and all.

294131.description: In a world where all people receive skills from God, she is a young girl who received a tamer skill. However, her rank is the weakest: "starless." As the starless are considered ominous, she was abandoned by her family and chased away from her village. In reality, Ivy was reincarnated from another world. At times, her memories from her previous world give her advice, but they are of little use.

294909.description: **Race:** Beastman Senna is the leader and representative of the Beastmen immigrants who migrated from Howling Village to Hiraku's village. She is also the daughter of the former chief of Howling Village.

294910.description: **Race:** Dragon Rasutisumoon is the daughter of Doraim and Graffaloon, who requested her to serve as a diplomat in Hiraku's village. She later takes charge of the village's diplomatic relations.

295090.description: A cafe owner who supplies Rei and Kazuki with both jobs and information.

295452.description:
An energetic girl who happens to be [Hinako](https://anilist.co/character/250490/Yaotose-Hinako)'s classmate and childhood friend. However, she is often sick and therefore, absent from school. After "the incident", Miko was the only one to treat Hinako normally. She dislikes [Shiori](https://anilist.co/character/259352/Oumi-Shiori), but is not necessarily enemies with her.

~!She appears to be human, but she is in fact a fox spirit with an appetite for human flesh. She calls in sick to fight her instinct to eat other humans. After failing to protect the rest of Hinako's family, she tasked herself with protecting Hinako from other monsters.!~

name.native: テラコマリ・ガンデスブラッド

295878.description: One of the seven Crimson Lords, she is the commander of the 7th unit.

295879.description: [Komari](https://anilist.co/character/295878/Gandesblood-Terakomari)'s personal maid, assigned as part of her position as a Crimson Lord.

name.native: カレン・エルヴェシアス

295881.description:
Empress of the Mulnite Empire.

Hard to read and wanton in nature, she appoints the reclusive [Komari](https://anilist.co/character/295878/Gandesblood-Terakomari) as a Crimson Lord.

295899.description: A slime life form accidentally created by Kotarou Kawaii in his childhood. She considers herself the cutest slime, and her dream is to become a synonym for “kawaii". Recently, Kotarou has stopped calling her cute, so she is pursuing various “kawaii” forms on a daily basis in order to be recognized as such...!

alternative: Heavenly Father God NousGalia (天父神ノウスガリア)

296121.description: The Heavenly Father, the god that creates order, and the father of the gods.

296122.description: Student from the Demon King Academy and a member of the Chaos Generation. ~!He is a reincarnated demon from 2,000 years ago and the subordinate of the Curse King Kaihilam Jiste.!~

name.native: リンカ・セオウルネス

296125.description: Student at Demon King Academy and one of the Chaos Generation. She is a subordinate of the Netherworld King Eges Code. ~!She is a reincarnation of the demon Ledane Aeon (レドアネ・イオン)!~

296193.description: [Takemichi](https://anilist.co/character/145342/)'s cousin and a third year student in Shibuya Middle School. He claimed to be the leader of the delinquents at his school, only to be exposed as the servant of [Kiyomasa](https://anilist.co/character/171921) and his friends.

296365.description: The consort of Yuanyang palace. She is also the childhood friend of Koushun.

296535.description: An aspiring novelist with an interest in the occult. She wrote an award winning novel at age 15, but struggled to write after that point and now works at a bookstore.

296650.description: A nursery teacher at Aozora Nursery School.

296842.description: Member of [Snake](https://anilist.co/character/79913/)'s mercenaries employed as guards of [Ketil](https://anilist.co/character/223346)'s farm.

296851.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

A former slave working for [Ketil](https://anilist.co/character/223346) as a farm hand.

296952.description:
The leader of the Dragon Keepers and commander of the Red Battalion. 

~!He seems to be friendly and inspiring, but he is actually cruel and does not hold back against others when something needs to be done.!~

296953.description:
The Blue Keeper and commander of the Blue Battalion. Originally in a gang to raise money for an orphanage, he joined the rangers after Akabane blackmails him between jail.
~!He was killed by Peltrola's sneak attack in a battle with D.!~

296954.description:
The Pink Keeper and commander of the Pink Battalion who's also Hibiki's older sister, whom she obsesses over.
~!When un-transfomed, it is revealed she is disabled, having lost her legs 13 years ago when she was caught up in Peltrola's battle, and has since had to rely on the use of a wheelchair.!~

296955.description:
One of the five Dragon Keepers and the leader of the Green Battalion.

~!An information broker going by the name "Chidori."!~

297070.description: A second-year student at Lime Junior High School. He has been living with Puniru, whom he created by accident when he was a child. He is a twisted boy who really likes cute things but hides it from everyone around him. He is sometimes pushed around by Puniru's freewheeling behavior, and sometimes gets nervous when he sees how much she has grown up...

297071.description: A third-year student at Lime Middle School. She is kind to everyone and is the school's Madonna, like a holy mother. She is the object of Kotarou's unrequited love. When she is in front of a child, her maternal instincts are uncontrollable.

297072.description: Kotarou's classmate. In contrast to his playboy appearance and behavior, he loves children's hobbies and card games.

297073.description: Kotarou's classmate. She is a rich girl who is next in line to inherit the Kyuthi Land company. She views Puniru as a rival.

297074.description: Frustrated with his life as a teacher after being expelled from an academy, obsesses over Puniru as a great discovery.

297094.description:
Ayano is an expressionless maid of the Suou household. She's the sort of devoted servant who has boundless love for her master, and she's dedicated herself to serving [Yuki](https://anilist.co/character/243404). She often has no presence and vanishes into thin air.

~!Ayano used to originally serve Masachika. She still has boundless love for him and treats him as her master too.!~

297198.description:
__Species:__ Demon

One of the Four Evil Kings, known as the Netherworld King. He is a great demon who competed with [Anos Voldigoad](https://anilist.co/character/138595) during the Mythical Age.

297199.description:
__Species:__ Demon

One of the Four Evil Kings, known as the Curse King. Kyhilam is great demon from the Dorfmond clan who competed against [Anos Voldigoad](https://anilist.co/character/138595) during the Mythical Age.

297229.description: Miri's mother. After having an affair with a mafia boss [Atsushi Hayami](https://anilist.co/character/295980), she gave birth as a single mother.

297787.description:
__Specialist Type:__ Poison User

Hikaru Gero is part of the Gero Family, one of the top five families of specialists. He is the current heir to the Poison clan. A poison-using hitman from the clan of assassins. In order to keep his sister from being forced into having a child to continue the lineage of the clan, Gero decides to try and get married and have a child of his own.

297788.description:
~!__Gender:__ Male!~__Occupation:__ Swindler

Mei Kinosaki is a marriage swindler who charms both men and women in order to get money from them to help keep their sick brother alive. Mei was saved by [Gero](https://anilist.co/character/297787/Gero-Hikaru) after being captured by a crime syndicate that they had wronged. Mei agreed to help Gero find a wife in exchange for Gero's protection, and help with keeping their sick brother alive.

297902.description: She is Tokio's classmate and good at dancing.

297979.description: A demon from 2,000 years ago. He is regarded as the second most skilled swordsman among Anos' subordinates, behind Shin Reglia.

298261.description:
~!Gender: Female!~

The third heir within the Bauer Kingdom's royal family. A charismatic and attractive prince type who uses charm to mask a cunning mind. Yu is the second most popular capture target within the game.

~!Later in the story it is revealed that Yuu was born as female, but she was raised as a boy. She wishes to live as a girl again.!~

298263.description:
Manaria Sousse is the first crown princess of the kingdom of Sousse. She is a distant relative of Claire. She is the world's first confirmed quad-caster who possesses the highest aptitude in every element.

~!Manaria was Claire's first love, although she was first mistaken for a boy, and helped Claire overcome the trauma of losing her mother. They grew close after this incident and would continue writing to each other for years to come.!~

name.native: ジョディオ・ジョースタ

298895.description:
__Stand:__ November Rain

Jodio is a small-time gangster living in Hawaii with his big brother [Dragona](https://anilist.co/character/298896) and his mother [Barbara Ann Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/298906). He is a Stand user that wields November Rain, allowing him to create localized drops of rain that can crush his opponents.

name.native: ドラゴナ・ジョースター

298896.description:
__Stand:__ Smooth Operators

Dragona is [Jodio Joestar's](https://anilist.co/character/298895) older sibling and works alongside him as a gangster in Hawaii. They are a Stand User that wields Smooth Operators, a colony Stand that can displace anything.

298904.description:
__Stand:__ The Hustle

Paco is a gangster working in the same gang as Jodio and Dragona Joestar. They are assigned to the same team in order to steal a diamond. Paco is a Stand User possessing The Hustle, an integrated Stand that allows him to grab objects with his muscles anywhere on his body.

298905.description:
Principal of the school Jodio and his group attend, as well as the proprietress of a fashion boutique called Iko Iko. Both of those occupations, however, are a cover-up for her real nature as a crime boss that Jodio and his group work for.

According to Jodio, she has a handsome husband and child at home.

name.native: バーバラ・アン・ジョースター

298906.description: A daughter of [Fumi](https://anilist.co/character/238729/Fumi) and Suzie Q and the mother of [Jodio](https://anilist.co/character/298895) and [Dragona Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/298896).

299364.description:
[Koito's](https://anilist.co/character/183155) younger sister, elementary school student

She is a professional-level cook

name.native: スタッカート＝レイロング
alternative: バーニング・アルファ

name.native: バッファ＝プランターズ
ハルリード＝コパカバーナ
シキブ＝チェリーブロッサム
オリヒメ＝チェリーブロッサム
プライズウェル＝シティ＝スリッカー

299681.description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7'')
__Specialist Type:__ Hamster User

She is from Beast Clan. After her brother disappeared, Kimie would try to take a job in his place, this would cause Kimie to be kidnapped by a group of terrorists who wanted her organs.

At that moment a small [Hikaru Gero](https://anilist.co/character/297787/Gero-Hikaru) would come to save her. From that moment on, Kimie would become a big fan of Gero.

299682.description: She is a famous art thief known in the underworld. Himekawa is an animal lover as she is friend with a shark named Jawshua. She is also able to see the feelings of painting.

300088.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Yuu is [Umika](https://anilist.co/character/288810/Umika-Konohoshi)'s classmate and a self-proclaimed alien. She has a telepathic ability called "Odekopathy", which allows her to read the thoughts of others by matching her forehead with theirs.

She has an abysmal optimism and a bright personality, and she instantly melts away the anxiety and tension of others.  She also tends to hate steady effort and studying. With her natural cheerfulness and energy, she can easily open up to her new classmates. Due to a spaceship malfunction, she crash-landed on Earth and possesses a diary written in cosmic language.

300482.description:
__Height:__ 175cm

 Canute's head thegn and his battle instructor.

300483.description: Daughter of King Sweyn and sister to Harald and Canute.

300484.description: Eldest son of King Sweyn and brother to Canute and Estrid.

300737.description: One of the seven Crimson Lords, she is the commander of the 6th unit.

300790.description:
__Jersey Number:__ 5
__Position:__ Forward

A member of Team World 5. Silva currently plays for Brazi's National Football Team.

300811.description: Professional player from Spain known as 'The Scion of Real Madrid' who plays on Spain's Real Madrid and the Spain National Team. He arrives at Blue Lock as member of the Team World 5 to analyze and rate the last string of Blue Lock players.

300812.description: Member of the Team World 5. Pablo currently plays for Argentina's National Football Team.

300898.description:
__Skill:__ Future Sight

Worshiped as the God of Suwa by having the spirit of Suwa Myojin within him. He's the person who offers safety to Tokiyuki after the fall of his clan in 1333. He is one of the 3 most outstanding arahitogami in Japan.

301052.description: A young Heian era woman and a yōkai, who is beheaded by an unknown half-demon assailant from Britain and has her headless body taken away. Since she is a demon, she cannot die (though being decapitated by a half-demon means she cannot heal herself) and thus her head continues to live on, ultimately seeking support from [Tsugaru](https://anilist.co/character/301053/Shinuchi-Tsugaru) to search the assailant and take revenge.

301053.description: A former member of a special oni extermination squad charged with slaughtering monsters across Japan during the Meiji Restoration. At some point, he was injected with oni blood by the same man who beheaded [Aya](https://anilist.co/character/301052/Rindou-Aya) and turned into a half-oni himself. Though the power allows him to kill oni and other supernatural beings with his bare hands, he knows that at some point in the future the oni blood will overcome his human personality and he will be put down by a similar hunter. In the meantime, he supports himself by fighting other demons in cage matches as a circus act called the Oni Slayer.

301054.description: A stern maid who serves under Aya. She wields a rifle with an attached bayonet that fires silver rounds.

301078.description: Went to the same elementary school as Hotaru.

301089.description: A high school student. Hotaru Hinase's friend since middle school.

301090.description: A high school student in the kendo club. Friend of Hotaru Hinase and Hibiki Asami.

301732.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

A former Viking warrior turned slave. ~!Before being a slave, he had a happy life with his wife [Arnheid](https://anilist.co/character/75590) and son [Hjatli](https://anilist.co/character/302134).!~

alternative: Bizen no Daidarabotchi  (備前の大巨人)

302052.description:
__Height:__ 321 cm

One of the criminals sent to acquire the Elixir of Life for the [shogun](https://anilist.co/character/301606/Nariyoshi-Tokugawa). ~!Despite his size, he is an 8-year old child suffering from an abnormal case of gigantism.!~

302091.description:
**Height:** 156 cm

Taki Shiina is a first-year student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the drummer and composer of **[MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO)**.

Taki is a loner who enjoys being all alone. She works part-time at RiNG, but due to her blunt personality, short temper and the fact she has a tendency to glare at people, she isn't good at customer service. She is a bit of a perfectionist, but at the same time has an inferiority complex towards her older sister.

302092.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm

Raana Kaname is a third-year student at Hanasakigawa Girls' Junior High School and the lead guitarist of [MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO)

Raana is an eccentric girl. She is a very talented guitarist who also has a very frank personality, as she always states what she likes and doesn't like. She is somewhat of a glutton and loves sweets, especially matcha parfaits, but also dislikes hot foods as she has a sensitive tongue.

302093.description:
**Height:** 162 cm

Soyo Nagasaki is a first-year student at Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and the bassist of **[MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO)**

Soyo is a very kind and mature girl and she is often compared to an older sister. Due to this, she is often relied on by her peers. She has a habit of fiddling with her fingertips when she's thinking or planning something. Although not outwardly hostile, Soyo can be quite cunning at times.

302094.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Anon Chihaya is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and the rhythm guitarist of [MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/).

Anon is an honor student who is very social and also assertive at the same time. Despite this, it is shown that she has had a hard time making friends. Anon also loves following and trying out the newest trends. She approaches [Tomori](https://anilist.co/character/302095/Takamatsu-Tomori) after learning about her in hopes of creating a band together with her. Although she initially created the band in order to gain attention, to the point where she wanted to name the band after herself, she ends up becoming dedicated to her band activities and taking practicing seriously.

302095.description:
**Height:** 155 cm

Tomori Takamatsu is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and the vocalist and lyricist of **[MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO)**.

Tomori is a kind but sensitive girl who has an awkward personality. She has a tendency to stutter while talking and not make eye contact. She also tends to blame herself for the conflicts that happen around her, even if they weren't caused by her.

She is infamously known as "Haneoka's Weirdo Girl" due to her peculiar personality. She likes collecting all sorts of things, such as band-aids (especially ones with animals such as pandas or penguins on them), slippery things, just-the-right-size things, and even rocks and fallen leaves that she picks up from the ground. She also likes pill bugs and has been shown often drawing them in her notebooks.

302624.description:
__Height:__ 147 cm (4'10")

A quiet and reserved girl from the class next to [Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/281250/Miyu-Suzuki) and [Tani](https://anilist.co/character/281251/Yusuke-Tani) who actually laughs at just about everything. She's extremely shy and bad at talking to classmates other than [Honda](https://anilist.co/character/378435/Rikako-Honda). One of her main worries is always being a beat behind in conversations.

302625.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

A cheerful, easygoing boy and classmate of [Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/281250/Miyu-Suzuki) and [Tani](https://anilist.co/character/281251/Yusuke-Tani). He's the life of the party, open, honest, and quick to befriend anyone. He expresses his thoughts without holding back.

302626.description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")

A mature-minded girl in [Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/281250/Miyu-Suzuki) and [Tani's](https://anilist.co/character/281251/Yusuke-Tani) class. Though she comes off as jaded, she's never experienced a proper romantic relationship.

302627.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

A boy in [Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/281250/Miyu-Suzuki) and [Tani's](https://anilist.co/character/281251/Yusuke-Tani) class with a cynical attitude. Lacking confidence, he often compares himself to others and ends up feeling insecure or down.

303628.description:
An ordinary human, but a genetic anomaly with abilities far beyond a regular assassin. He possesses exceptional information-processing skills along with superhuman physical abilities. Needs to sleep more than 10 hours a day to function properly, but after sleeping his body can heal almost any injury or ailment. In terms of pure talent, he is among the very best in the modern era. 

His dream is to open up a cafe with his girlfriend, [Marin](https://anilist.co/character/336020).

name.native: シャルロッテ・ゼンフィス

303773.description:
____Age____ 7 (Debut) 11 (Time Skip)
____Affiliation____ Camelot
____Aliases____ Weiss Owl

____Personality____
Charlotte is a curious individual, which led her to investigate [Haruto ](https://anilist.co/character/303772/Hart-Zenfis) and she noticed his odd behavior. While initially hesitant around Haruto, she grew to have immense faith in him and his abilities. Haruto introducing her to anime at a young age led to her becoming a chuunibiyo, a big fan of the magical girl genre, and imagining the capita was home to a massive conspiracy (which coincidentally turned out to be true).

304462.description:
A four-year-old girl who lives with her family at Fólkvangr. She is the daughter of Elnora and Nadim. Ericht is an innocent child, and so curious that her parents sometimes don't know what to do with her.

~!After the Vanadis Incident, she was turned into the Gundam Aerial.!~

name.native: ティルファー・リルミット

304624.description: She's a second-year student in Lux's classroom and one of the elite members of the “Triad”.Tillfur has a very energetic and cheerful personality, and often jokes with and teases others.

305606.description:
Taizen Shiba is Yuuichi Katagiri's adoptive father and mentor figure who taught him the value of money.

~!He was one of the three people killed by Yuuichi!~

305642.description: Yuka is Yuuichi Katagiri's adoptive mother who is presumably deceased and is mainly shown sporadically in flashbacks throughout the series. Unlike Yuuichi's mentor and father figure Shiba, Yuka teaches Yuuichi that friends are "more important than money".

305653.description:
__Height:__ 181 cm

He is the chief of the Planning and Sales department at Minette whose concentration at work is high and his performance is good. In matters outside of work, he gets easily distracted and often makes mistakes.

305654.description:
__Height:__ 191 cm

He is an employee working at Minette in the Planning and Sales department where he reports directly to [Yuusei Shirosaki](https://anilist.co/character/305653/).

305655.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

He is the manager of the Planning and Sales department at Minette. Mitsuo's wife ran away from him shortly after he bought a house and a new employee he was in charge of ran away after a week; as a result, he has low self-esteem and he is lonely. He tends to spend lot of time working and he often makes little time for his wife. Although, this is due to the fact that he had to work a lot to pay off the debt and mortgage for his new home he bought with his wife. His wife said that since he didn't spend time, she felt lonely and found companionship with another man. Because of this, he has become very needy and seeks for attention, mostly fishing for compliments or praise. He is usually self-deprecating and says it loud enough for others to hear. However, despite all these things, Aoyama is a good boss and has a positive reputation among his peers and employees. He is diligent with his work and always does his best to mentor his employees.

Because of his loneliness, Mitsuo has become obsessed with a bear called [Kumattechan](https://anilist.co/character/318267/).

(Source: Atarashii Joushi wa Do Tennen Wiki)

305656.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm

He works at Minette in the Planning and Sales department.

305657.description: He was an abandoned cat who was found and picked up by [Kentarou Momose](https://anilist.co/character/305654/) and [Yuusei Shirosaki](https://anilist.co/character/305653/). Shirosaki later adopted him. He was named by taking a kanji each from Shirosaki's (白) and Momose's (桃) names.

305774.description: An ordinary high school student who just dreams of something special. While he was on his way home from school with Suzune and Kazuki, he was involved in the summoning to the Ringle Kingdom. When it was discovered that he has an aptitude for healing magic, he is forced to join Rose's lifesaving group. There he acquires his strong body through hellish training.

306223.description: Ozaki was a Demon Slayer and part of the Demon Slayer Corps.

306276.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

Taichi Kanada is an alumni of Saitama Urami East Junior High ~!and was one of four victims who were cursed as a result of bungee jumping from Yasohachi Bridge. Like the other cursed humans, Taichi died after a cursed spirit appeared between his auto-lock doors, which were stuck wide open.!~

306282.description: Tadashi Okazaki was a minor character serving time at the Eishu Juvenile Detention Center.

306614.description:
__Height:__ 152 cm

An ordinary girl who is a little shy. She attended school, but kept a low profile and had average grades. She didn't have any big dreams and lived her life going with the flow.

306616.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

A young street musician. She is easy-going and firm. She does not like to dress typically feminine and chooses to keep her hair down, and keep her clothes plain. She is bright and caring and has the feeling of an reliable senior at an athletic club.

306618.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

A girl who attends an entertainment school. She's appeared in commercials and has a promising future ahead of her. She is a beautiful girl who could become a model, and is good at socialising and is very graceful.  But, inside she is actually strong-willed and competitive.

306619.description:
__Height:__ 148 cm

Originally, she was a young lady from a wealthy family that was famous in their local area. However, she currently lives in a shared apartment. Her view on the world is cold and oblique. Like a hedgehog, she is very cautious and does not open up much.

306620.description:
__Height:__ 169 cm

A slightly tanned girl who has a South Asian father and a Japanese mother. She has an artistic sense, and a clear-headed mind. She is a so-called genius that everyone respects for her gentle and modest demeanor. Her only flaws is that she is a heavy drinker, and gets tunnel vision when she has a goal in mind.

alternative: Yamada Asaemon Tesshin (山田浅ェ門鉄心)

306847.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

Tesshin was a former Asaemon of the Yamada clan and the first apprentice of [Shion](https://anilist.co/character/137267/Shion).

307151.description: A commander in the Dominicus special forces. 21 years earlier, Kenanji served as a Begir-Beu pilot during the Vanadis Incident.

307811.description:
__Occupation:__ The manager of Super S.

A hyper competent employee respected by all of her coworkers. She is aware of [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/281764/Yamada) and [Sasaki's](https://anilist.co/character/281763/Sasaki) secret meetings and takes pleasure in watching their relationship.

308017.description:
__Occupation:__ Butler

Sebas is the butler of the Shinomiya Family and serves [Kikoru Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/183889/Kikoru-Shinomiya).

Sebas appears as a calm man in a subservient relationship with Kikoru. ~!He is also very protective towards her since he hit [Kafka Hibino](https://anilist.co/character/180692/Kafka-Hibino) just for touching Kikoru.!~

309183.description: A beautiful and deadly vampire with incredibly swordsmanship who works for The Professor.

309267.description:
[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/chang.chin_lan/)

An international exchange student from Taiwan who moves into the dormitory. She has short black hair, a calm atmosphere, and a self-paced personality. Japanese isn't her native language, and she occasionally uses Taiwanese Hokkien when speaking.

~!She very quickly catches onto Ibuki's feelings for Botan and tells Botan to only keep getting closer to Ibuki if she plans on answering her feelings.

She also became friends with Gujou rather quickly, after finding out about her unrequited feelings for Ibuki.!~

309268.description:
[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/eve.o0o0.keeey/)

Born in Toyama prefecture. She is a third-year at the same university as [Botan](https://anilist.co/character/309275/Kamiina-Botan). She is the dorm leader of the university dormitory where her and Botan live. She has a neat bob cut and usually wears lax, boyish, and oversized clothes. She is a pretty heavy drinker and has a lot of knowledge about alcohol. This shows especially in her dorm room, which is filled with half-empty liquor bottles.

Due to things that happened in her past, she is scared of drinking with other people, so she usually drinks alone. However, this changes when she meets Botan.

309270.description:
[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ka_na_de.206/)

Born in Gifu prefecture. She is a student at the same university as Botan and the others and lives in the same dormitory.

She has been interested in Ibuki for a long time and is jealous of Botan's relationship with her. She has seen Ibuki drinking alone once before and has asked her to drink together a number of times, however, Ibuki has always refused.

309274.description:
[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/y0usir_jp/)

A second-year student at the same university as [Botan](https://anilist.co/character/309275/Kamiina-Botan), she also lives in the dormitory.

She has a deep knowledge of music and her dorm room is filled with instruments and vinyl records from her dad. She plays guitar as part of the band "YOUs!R".

She seemingly has an intimate relationship with [Yaeka](https://anilist.co/character/309271/Kitamori-Yaeka).

309275.description:
[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/kamiina.botan/)

Born in Nagano prefecture. The main character of the manga as well as a first-year college student. She is enrolled in the management engineering department of the Faculty of Science and Engineering. She entered college as a ronin, and thus is 20 years old, meaning she is allowed to drink. 

She has a hard time drinking carbonated drinks and bonds over this with [Ibuki](https://anilist.co/character/309268/Tonami-Ibuki).

309417.description: Receptionist at the Merratoni branch of the Healers' Guild. She is distrustful of the healers who demand high treatment fees, but she supports Luciel's earnest efforts as a healer.

309418.description: Commander of the Holy Valkyrie Knights. A benefactor associated with St. Shurule's Church who helped Luciel to make a living as a healer.

309419.description: Receptionist at the Merratoni branch of the Healers' Guild. She always looks like she has free time, but according to her, she is "quite busy." She cares about Luciel for some reason or another. She is like a big sister to him.

309420.description: She is the receptionist at the Merratoni branch of the Adventurers' Guild, a rabbit beastman with a cute smile who is popular among adventurers. She helps Luciel with his personal needs, such as laundry.

309518.description: Emihara-sensei is the homeroom teacher of Umika and her friends.

309804.description: [Yuna](https://anilist.co/character/171622/Yunis-Yuna) and [Milly](https://anilist.co/character/271646/Yunis-Milly)'s father. He has as an obsession for women's breasts and hates [Touka](https://anilist.co/character/171621/Scott-Touka).

309908.description: Shizuru suddenly leaves Agano in order to find her friend [Youka](https://anilist.co/character/330322/) and acts as a leader of the group. She is skilled in Agano Jiu-Jitsu

309910.description: A mysterious boy who works at the same bookstore as [Sumireko.](https://anilist.co/character/296535/Sumireko-Ogawa) He calls himself her fan and anticipates her new work. However, he also has a strange knowledge of mysterious phenomena happening around them.

311040.description: Usato's classmate and student council vice president. Like Suzune, he was summoned to the Ringle Kingdom as a hero and has an aptitude for light-attribute magic. He is extremely popular with the female students, but on the other hand, he is troubled by the fact that he has no male friends.

311041.description: She has excellent grades, is good at sports, and is the student council president that everyone admires. She was summoned to the Kingdom of Ringle as a hero and has an aptitude for lightning-based magic. To Usato, she was like a flower of Takamine, but after she was summoned to another world, she began to reveal her "true self''.

311042.description: Amako is a beast girl who lives in the castle town of Ringle Kingdom and helps out at a fruit shop. She is paying attention to Usato...

311335.description: A kind and gentle girl who hates arguments and often acts as a mediator. She is skilled at archery.

311336.description: A trend follower who longs for the city and loves cute things. She is blunt and relies on intuition more than thinking. She loves the anime "Alice in Nerima-land."

311337.description: She enjoys reading difficult books, which gives her with lots of miscellaneous and detailed knowledge. She tries to act like an adult but can be childish and cowardly.

311489.description:
Member of the high-level Akabane Family. Although insanely strong, he's very petty and short-tempered, especially if people don't take his flashy technique names seriously or make fun of him. He also doesn't seem to mind killing other players at any given time - something which the Planet community strongly frowns upon.

~!In the real world, he's a shut-in, living on terrible terms with his family - especially his father, whom he considers loathsome and irredeemable, and his brother, whom he assumes must be looking down on him all the time. However, he's a very skilled programmer, for example being able to create a program to bypass a ban with minimal effort.!~

~!He hates when Aya is brought up in conversation, prompting him to have PTSD flashbacks and snap at whoever brings her up.!~

311492.description:
One of the members of the high-ranking Akabane Family. Due to being dependable, wise and strong, Ichi looks up to him as a sort of father figure, and the rest of the guild sees him as their backbone.

~!He's actually Ichi's real-life father, as well as the creator of Planet. Although he's an extremely skilled programmer and tech genius, he's also a hopeless perfectionist who dislikes anything illogical, which often had terrible consequences for his children - most notably Aya, who was often the target of his scrutiny due to her timid nature.!~

~!He blames himself for his daughter's death, having even gone as far as creating an AI replica of her in an attempt to bring her back and apologize for his mistakes.!~

311493.description:
One of the Akabane Family's members. He's very friendly and cheerful, although not as skilled as the rest of the guild's members. He also remarks that he's not a very creative person, which is why he named himself the way he did.

~!In real life, he's actually Ichi's younger brother and seems to have a successful professional career. However, he struggles to express emotions, which makes him often come off as cold and uncaring.!~

311494.description:
Leon's best friend, a childish sidekick who often engages in wacky theatrics and carries his head around whenever it gets cut off.

~!Their real identity is an AI, being one of many living within Planet's code as a result of Shiro/Kojirou attempting to bring back his dead daughter. However, Sasumata is the only one aware of their true nature as such, which makes them question the nature of their existence and purpose in life constantly.!~

311495.description:
One of the Akabane Family's members. Although she's not very good in combat, she's an excellent healer, as well as the emotional backbone of the group due to her kindness. She enjoys peaceful side content in the game a fair bit, such as taking care of the flower garden or cooking for the other three guild members, even though she knows it's only a game.

~!She's actually the wife of Shiro/Kojirou in real life, as well as the mother of Ichi and his siblings. Following the death of Aya, she would move out into a net cafe, where she's lived ever since. Her mental health seems to be in a very poor state - although she still cares for her sons and husband when she decides to visit their house, she seems to be largely just going through the motions without thinking much of her actions, repeating the same phrases repeatedly and often smiling in moments that don't require her to.!~

311496.description:
One of Pico's subordinates, her serious and intimidating right-hand man.

~!He actually never truly cared about Planet and deeply loathes every player around him, seeing everybody, including Pico, as mere means to an end, his only true desire being to get his hands on the prize money offered for capturing the Black Bird.!~

~!In real life, he seems to be a failed musician, living in a rented apartment, which he struggles to pay rent for in time.!~

~!Following his encounter with the Black Bird, he becomes stuck in an endless simulation, dying over and over again.!~

311497.description:
Captain of the pirate guild in Planet. A very arrogant girl who enjoys acting on her whims and prioritizes having fun above all else, often griefing and generally being a nuisance in-game, with her crew consisting of likeminded people who play the game to mess with others. At times, she tends to casually make wordplays that integrate her name into random words.

Her only weakness seems to be a hopeless infatuation with Ichi, as the two had bonded over their loneliness in the past and, impressed with his chuunibyou antics, she considered him the coolest player on Planet. She tends to daydream about what could happen if they met in real life, thinking she would be able to help Ichi recover from his life as a shut-in and even fix him in general.

~!She was one of the AIs made by [Kojirou](https://anilist.co/character/311492/Akabane-Shiro) in an attempt to bring back his daughter, and arguably one of the more elaborate ones, being able to swap out at will between Planet and a simulation of the real world, as if she were truly an ordinary human playing a videogame. Her mind is a perfect replica of a deceased girl by the name of Hanako.!~

311498.description:
Head of a trading guild in Planet. Although he tries to stay neutral and maintains that he is, he considers himself to be part of a very small group of Planet players that genuinely love the game, strongly believing that they are morally obliged to backseat moderate, sabotage and eliminate those who, in their view, spoil others' fun, such as Pico's pirates.

~!In real life, he's a young schoolkid who never had friends before meeting Sasumata, which made him want to create a world where AIs get what they want, believing that they are alike.!~

311499.description: Kojirou's right-hand woman, a calm and collected subordinate that sees him as an unquestionable genius. She possesses a very one-sided yet unwavering attraction to her boss, often offering her body to him, much to his ire.

311500.description:
Kojirou's daughter and the youngest of the three siblings. Although she was a very sweet child who cared a lot about others, she was often the target of her father's wrath, as he considered her to be the most clumsy and irrational.

~!After her father forced her to go back to school late at night to pick up a notebook that she forgot to take home, she would fall victim to a serial killer, prompting the family to break apart and traumatize her oldest brother.!~

name.native: エリス・セイファート
リーシェ・イルムガルド・ヴェルツナー

312403.description: Rishe is a noble who dies at the age of 20 and returns to the moment of her broken engagement five years earlier. As a result of her various lives, she has acquired numerous skills and resilience; in this life, her seventh loop, she is engaged to Crown Prince [Arnold](https://anilist.co/character/312404/Arnold-Hein).

name.native: ミリセント・ ブルーナイト

312410.description: A member of the terrorist organization "Inverted Moon".

312746.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

The leader of SF-Zoo, a clan whose purpose is to observe and photograph monsters. A sorcerer who mastered abnormal status (debuffs) just to photograph monsters. She shows an abnormal obsession with monsters.

312796.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

Sakiko is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School. She is a refined person who comes from a rich family, and used to attend Tsukinomori Girls' Academy. She often plays the piano in the school's music room.

Sakiko is currently the producer, composer, and keyboardist of the band Ave Mujica. She used to be a member of CRYCHIC.

312797.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

In addition to being the guitarist, Uika is also in charge of composing and writing lyrics for sumimi's songs. She is quite popular due to her cool appearance. She loves stargazing.

~!Born as Hatsune Misumi, she is the illegitimate child of [Sadaharu Togawa](https://anilist.co/character/352933/Togawa-Sadaharu) and one of the Togawa family housekeepers. She was raised on an island by her biological mother and foster father, alongside her half-sister Uika. Upon arriving in Tokyo, she was scouted and debuted as an idol using her sister's name.!~

312798.description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5'0")

A first-year high school student. Mutsumi used to be a member of the band CRYCHIC, where she was in charge of the guitar. She is very stoic and a taciturn. Her father is a famous comedian called Wakaba, and her mother is Mori Minami, an actress. One of her hobbies is ballet.

312799.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

Umiri is one of Taki's classmates. She is somewhat playful as she enjoys teasing Taki. Umiri is an exceptionally proficient bassist who has played as a support artist for over 30 different bands.

312800.description: Mana became popular thanks to her cute smile and pure personality. She loves eating donuts.

name.native: ライアス・オルテアス
ギーゼロッテ・オルテアス
マリアンヌ・オルテアス

313120.description: Leader of the Lingle Kingdom Lifesaving Team. She is a healing magician, but her combat abilities are very high, and she once served as a battalion commander of the Knights. She forces Usato, her healing magician, to join the lifesaving group and trains him as her right-hand man.

313463.description: Sakamichi's mother is the mother of the protagonist, [Sakamichi](https://anilist.co/character/82871/Sakamichi-Onoda). She supports her son's cycling without really knowing what it's all about.

313789.description:
A member of the Indian Ocean Special Response Team.

One of the more hostile and reckless member of the team.

name.native: グレース・ワイズマン

313790.description:
One of the members of the Indian Ocean Special Response Team.

Unlike the others, she was kind to Sousuke and urged them to listen to him.

313793.description: Mira Kudan is a whispered girl that Sousuke rescues right in the very beginning. When Mithril is destroyed, she goes into hiding along with Wraith and Hunter in Alaska. With the help of AL, the original AI system in the Arbalest, she builds the ARX-8 Laevatein. In the novel translation, she is called Sarah Miller.

name.native: パトリック・アッシュバトン

313857.description:
Patrick is a student at the Royal Academy and [Yumiella](https://anilist.co/character/208534/Yumiella-Dolkness)'s closest friend. He is the second son of a margrave and is skilled at battle tactics and wind magic. In the original game, _Light Magic and the Hero_, he was just a background character.

Patrick is a sincere, kindhearted, and level-headed person who often acts as the straight-man for Yumiella's antics. After he hears her reject another man by saying she "only likes people stronger than her", he begins to work hard at leveling up every day (even though he knows that Yumiella was only saying that as an excuse).

~!He later gets engaged to Yumiella after becoming the second-ever level 99.!~

name.native: エドウィン・バルシャイン

313858.description: Edwin is the second prince of the kingdom and the main hero of the game _Light Magic and the Hero_.

313859.description: William is a short-tempered swordsman with a strong sense of justice. He is one of the three love interests in the game _Light Magic and the Hero_.

name.native: オズワルド・グリムザード

313860.description: Oswald is one of the three love interests in the game _Light Magic and the Hero_. He is skilled at magic and can use all four basic elements.

314493.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'5")

Nyamu is a popular beauty influencer and the drummer of Ave Mujica.

314675.description: Second Son of the Hino family and Chihiro's classmate and friend

314677.description: Chiyo and Madoka's mother and Chihiro's grandmother

name.native: リック・グラディアートル

315381.description: At the age of 30, he left his job as a guild clerk to pursue his dream of becoming an adventurer. After undergoing two years of "terrifying beyond hellish training" from his seniors from the Orichalcum Fist party, the strongest on the continent, he showed remarkable growth. The days of continuous death and resurrection during training have left him deeply traumatized.

name.native: リーネット・エルフェルト

315382.description: Reanette is a dark elf and Rick's assistant and companion who once achieved the legendary 9999 consecutive victories in an underground arena. She now wears a maid outfit and takes care of all the housework for "Orichalcum Fist". She meets Rick through a certain incident and invites him to join her party.

name.native: ブロストン・アッシュオーク

315383.description: Broughston is a warrior-monk orc who became an adventurer, and is known as "The Sage Beast" because of his monstrous physique and intelligence. He currently leads "Orichalcum Fist," and Rick looks up to him as his mentor. Despite his gigantic size, he is skilled in support magic, including healing magic, and can even resurrect the dead if they have died shortly after.

name.native: ミゼット・エルドワーフ

315384.description: The young-looking half-elf, half-dwarf, (but over 50 years of age). He continues to develop weapons that cannot be made with the scientific technology of this world, and people say that he has access to technology from 1000 years into the future, earning him the nickname "The Thousand-year Workshopper". He is an invincible womanizer.

name.native: アリスレート・ドラクル

315385.description: A pure-blooded vampire girl. Nicknamed the "The Demon Child of Devastation", she is the continent's strongest super-genius offensive magician. Rick has been killed numerous times during training while she innocently toys around, unleashing tremendous offensive magic that carves into mountains and the earth. She is a glutton, which is difficult to believe given her appearance.

315430.description: The first friend Akutsu made after transferring. At first glance, he is a herbivorous man who seems harmless to humans and animals, but he is actually quite a strategist, and his dark side occasionally peeks through.

315432.description: Kensaku's childhood friend (self-proclaimed girlfriend). She has a burning rivalry with Lily, who she views as her romantic rival.

315433.description: Akutsu's boss in the demon world. She sends Akutsu to the human world with high expectations. She seems like a good boss who is passionate about her work, but she is a bit out of touch and tends to make misguided plans. She is an unconscious cosplay enthusiast.

315451.description: Head of the produce department at Super S. He greatly respects [Goutou](https://anilist.co/character/307811/Gotou) and works hard every day to become someone she can rely on among the staff.

315452.description: A veteran cashier at Super S. She has a gentle aura and kind personality, but is actually a heavy drinker.

315453.description: Head cashier at Super S. She has an energetic personality and loves fun things. She nicknames [Sasaki](https://anilist.co/character/281763/Sasaki) as [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/281764/Yamada) Fan #28.

name.native: エドワード・サックス
ペギー・ゴールドベリ

316482.description: She is smart, friendly, and is considered "the second cutest girl in the class" by the boys.

316483.description: A boy who doesn't know how to make friends because he kept changing schools.

316484.description: She is the undisputed No. 1 beautiful girl in her class. She and [Umi](https://anilist.co/character/316482) have been best friends since elementary school.

316854.description:
Wolffy's hot-tempered wife, who insistently tries to get him to capture the goats and hits him with a frying pan every time he fails to catch them.

While very violent and aggressive, she genuinely does love and care for her husband and shows this every once in a while whenever she's actually nice and romantic towards him for a change.

316946.description: A sage who summoned Yogiri's class along with the bus to the alternate world. She herself was formerly summoned into the new world and became a sage at the end of her adventure, but due to her immense magical power her common sense has lapsed somewhat since.

name.native: テオドール・オーギュスト・ハイン

317216.description: Arnold's younger brother and the second prince of Galkhein.

name.native: オリヴァー・ラウレンツ・フリートハイム

317217.description: He was cut off from being a knight due to an injury and was picked up by Arnold. He has served as Arnold's squire ever since.

name.native: フギル・アーカディア

318094.description: Employee of the Major Corporate Alliance hired by Garter and the superior who commanded the most prolific mercenary Clovers. ~!In reality, he controls the Alliance from the shadow collaborating with the Cult of Diablos to destroy Mitsugoshi Company.!~

name.native: アレクサンダー大統領

318148.description: A young demon girl that ate the daughter of two villagers in a town the Hero Party visited. She called for "mother" when Himmel attempted to kill her, and the village chief takes her in as his own family and tries to give her a chance to atone.

318198.description: Commoner who [Hinako](https://anilist.co/character/290272/Konohana-Hinako) took a liking to after a kidnapping incident. He entered the school under a fake identity to be Hinako's caretaker.

318357.description:
Part of the Assassins Guild, whose members all have bounties on their heads. Members of this guild are all born with a condition affecting their mana, known as “The Blighted”, and in Ren's case she is able to secrete poison through her skin, earning her the name "Ren the Poison Moth." Normally wears heavy clothing, and when her skin is exposed she is capable of spreading poison around an area. A bit of a tomboy, who has a shy personality thanks to her power. 

(Source: Official Site)

318358.description:
A martial artist that uses a foreign breathing method that gives access to superhuman abilities, known as “Qi”. After a life dedicated wholly to training, she fled her dojo to become an adventurer in pursuit of a fateful meeting with a handsome man. However, she had little luck with finding adventuring comrades, and encounters Lloyd while traveling on her own. Has a weakness for pretty faces, with a cheerful and excited disposition. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

318360.description: An impoverished man who runs a modest detective agency in Gifu.

318361.description:
A princess from another world that is proficient in magic.
After her homeland gets destroyed, she flees to modern Japan through a magic portal. 
Influenced by manga, she aspires to become a great detective.

name.native: イエロー キーパー

319296.description: One of the five Dragon Keepers and the leader of the Yellow Battalion.

name.native: アイザック・スターン
エレノーラ・ヒルローズ

319862.description:
Eleanora is the daughter of Duke Hillrose, the leader of the radical nobles part of the anti-king faction. She has a crush on [Prince Edwin](https://anilist.co/character/313858/Edwin-Valschein) and tries to keep the women around him in check. She initially comes across as a stuck-up villainess type, but is actually just a naive lovestruck girl. Her "friends" use her as a scapegoat to pick on [Alicia](https://anilist.co/character/208535/Alicia-Ehnleit), though she is unaware that their actions make her look bad in Edwin's eyes.

Eleanora is the only other person that isn't afraid of [Ryuu](https://anilist.co/character/372403/Ryuu); she finds him cute and spoils him with treats. She befriends [Yumiella](https://anilist.co/character/208534/Yumiella-Dolkness) over their shared love of dragons and the fact that Yumiella isn't taking advantage of her, being able to be honest and open with her alone.

319878.description: Head chef of Red Cat Ramen. He's in charge of arranging the food and the side menu.

319879.description: Customer service manager of Red Cat Ramen. Her coy act makes her quite popular.

319880.description: Employee of Red Cat Ramen who's in charge of making the noodles. A scaredy-cat.

319881.description: Manager of Red Cat Ramen. He is responsible for service and the register, as well as handling the finances.

319886.description: The only human employee of Red Cat Ramen. She dedicated to taking care of the cats in the shop.

319958.description: An expert marksman who never misses his target. Rough and foul-mouthed by nature, he sports a gauntlet on both arms.

name.native: クリストファー・スミス

319959.description: A hulking macho man and violent vigilante determined to achieve peace at all costs. He possesses a twisted sense of justice and considers himself a superhero.

319960.description: A struggling movie actor and loquacious, chatty narcissist. A shape-changer made of living clay, he freely changes his appearance in battle.

alternative: King Shark (キング・シャーク)

319961.description: A shark-like humanoid who has the IQ of a kindergartener. A pure and innocent soul, he is solely preoccupied with satisfying his appetite.

320605.description: A priest at the Airsten Cathedral where Sensei was transferred. A pure-hearted person who devotes herself to others.

320607.description: Annette's familiar with the ability to transform. Named "Melos" by Sensei

320610.description: A martial artist girl who Sensei helped. Although she has a competitive personality, she also has an honest and cute side.

320614.description: A girl with a dragon named "Luka". She has a strong hatred for those who have been transferred.

name.native: 絵梨依・エバーグリーン

321629.description: A first-year high school student who suffers from extreme communication disorder. Cosplays under the name "Nonoa" and is attracting attention as one of the rising stars of cosplay alongside [Ririsa Amano](https://anilist.co/character/169257/Amano-Ririsa). Famous for having a stoic expression while cosplaying, due to her communication disorder, with people calling her an "ice queen" as a result

321716.description: Second-class mage and the leader of the eighth party during the first stage of the First Class Mage Exam. He is the captain of the Northern Magic Corps and is thus a very experienced mage. Specializes in magic that restrains the opponent when their body is in full-view.

name.native: リヴィア・ド・ウーディス

321906.description: A knight from another world who serves as an aide to [Sara](https://anilist.co/character/318361/Odin-Sara). After being transported to modern-day Japan in pursuit of Sara, she becomes homeless. Through her overwhelming mental and physical strength, she manages to make the best of her situation.

322047.description:
2nd year at Kawagoe Academy.

He is a top tenor and formerly a member of the choir.
Although he loves to sing, he is unable to sing in public due to a traumatic experience in the past.
A commercial song that he sang when he was a child plays in his parents' pastry shop.

322048.description:
A 29 year old who is not very popular.

He is the new advisor for the Kawagoe Academy Boys Choir club.
He was an up-and-coming conductor, but due to his trouble-making tendencies, he was expelled from the orchestra, and was reluctantly transferred to Kawagoe Academy, where his grandmother is the principal.
He confuses those around him with his words and actions that can't seem to read the atmosphere.

322049.description:
1st year at Kawagoe Academy. He is a top tenor.

He is an identical twin. They are both twisted and foul-mouthed.
However, their unison is exquisite.
When they open their mouths, they are always quarreling, which confuses everyone around them, but they also harmonize beautifully when they are quarreling.

322050.description:
1st year at Kawagoe Academy. He is a baritone.

He is a shy otaku who hides his face with his long bangs as he goes about his school life.
He is good at singing and his singing ability is outstanding. He has been uploading "singing" videos on SNS while hiding his true identity.
He is scouted by Haruo, who discovers his true identity.

322051.description:
2nd year at Kawagoe Academy. In charge of baritone.

He is a delinquent who wears face paint to and from school.
He's super handsome without the makeup. He is a tsundere son who follows his mother who is not good at cooking.
One day, he becomes friends with Danbocchi and joins the choir club with trepidation.

322052.description:
1st year at Kawagoe Academy. He is a baritone.

His father is Nigerian and his mother is half-Japanese.
He is an intellectual, logical, and straightforward person, but he has a modest personality.
He cooperates with the SNS activities of his karaoke buddy, the Doctor, but he keeps his distance from everyone else.

322053.description:
2nd year at Kawagoe Academy.

In charge of the bass.
He is Danbocchi's best friend. He is an excellent student, good at sports, humble and positive.
He is a perfect guy who is popular with girls, and his only flaw is that he has no flaws.
His only weakness is that his casual clothes are uncool. He basically moves around on a skateboard.

322054.description:
2nd year at Kawagoe Academy. In charge of the bus.

His parents, who believe in masculinity, forced him to do bodybuilding from an early age.
Despite his muscular body, he loves cute things and has a girlish heart.
He is a beginner in choir, but he likes to sing.

322055.description:
1st year at Kawagoe Academy. He is a top tenor.

He is an identical twin. They are both twisted and foul-mouthed.
However, their unison is exquisite.
When they open their mouths, they are always quarreling, which confuses everyone around them, but they also harmonize beautifully when they are quarreling.

322056.description:
2nd year at Kawagoe Academy.
In charge of second tenor.
