Danbocchi's best friend. An energetic and cheerful musclehead.
He is a crass man who lacks frankness and delicacy, but he is carefree.
In the choir club, which he reluctantly joined on good terms, he is often told by Haruo that he is "not good enough".

322057.description:
2nd year at Kawagoe Academy.
He is the second tenor.

The son of a “self-proclaimed” IT company manager. Her partner is Poppa, a famous and mysterious robot.
He is bubbly and likes to show off a lot.
He has a strong desire to be popular and views Ei-chan, a popular guy, as his rival.

322062.description: She is a music teacher and another advisor to the boys choir club. She is a hard worker who is at the mercy of the Boys Choir Club and the Hibiki family.

322065.description: Haruo's grandmother and the principal of Kawagoe Academy. She takes offense at her grandson's troublesome behavior and orders him to become an advisor to the boys' choir.

322066.description: IT-kun's robot that can analyze one's subconscious.

322663.description: The teacher of Akutsu's class. He is concerned about his thinning hair. Although he has a scary and blunt personality, he is a nice guy who guides the students with his strange masculinity and middle-aged sadness.

322841.description: She is one of the sages who rules over the alternate world. She is also the highest ranking vampire and has an immortal body. Her trademark is a bright red dress. She becomes interested in Yogiri due to a certain incident and is looking for him.

322842.description: She is the surrogate mother and guardian of Yogiri Takatou. She is a young Japanese woman who was tasked with raising Yogiri by the Institute. She was also the one who named Yogiri, who then proceeded to take hers.

323312.description: The chief of Aria Trading Company.

323666.description:
A member of the adventurer group Verdant Wind. He is [Meela's](https://anilist.co/character/323663/Meela) older brother and [Tolto's](https://anilist.co/character/323665/Tolto) twin—sharing a resemblance in face, voice, and personality. He possesses a 2-star skill in Two-Handed Swords and a 1-star skill in Water Attacks. 

He has a fondness for sweets.

323821.description:
Mahiru is a typical high school girl who follows the philosophy of "nothing matters." Despite being sensitive, she often gets upset over small things, although she truly cares about others.

When she was young, Mahiru used to draw illustrations under the pseudonym "Kurage Yoru." However, something happened that made her stop for a while. Now, she struggles with feeling different and tries to blend in with everyone else.

But then, she meets Kano, and everything changes. Kano helps her see that it's okay to be unique, and Mahiru's life starts to feel special again.

323822.description:
Meet Kano, a former idol who is determined to achieve her dreams! She's a strong-willed individual who knows what she wants and isn't easily swayed by others. 

Kano used to be part of the "Sunflower Dolls" idol group, where she performed as "Nonoka Tachibana." However, she decided to leave the group after a controversy and embarked on a journey to discover her true calling.

During her journey, Kano meets Yoru Umitsuki, an artist who creates a beautiful jellyfish mural that inspires her to look at life in a new way. This encounter becomes a turning point for Kano as she redefines her values and explores new possibilities in her own unique way.

323823.description:
Kiui and Mahiru have been friends since childhood. Operating under the persona of the Vtuber "Nox Ryugasaki," Kiui consistently promotes their belief in being the strongest individual. Kiui is adept at swiftly mastering any task, and all the skills they display as a Vtuber are their own.

However, these differences have led to them feeling somewhat out of place among peers. Mahiru is the only person with whom Kiui feels comfortable discussing the past without reservation, and is always willing to help dear friends.

name.native: 高梨・キム・アヌーク・めい

323824.description:
Mei attends a high school affiliated with the conservatory.

She started her musical education at a young age and has earned numerous awards in competitions, demonstrating her exceptional talent. Despite her mixed German heritage, Mei's reserved demeanor and appearance often lead her to spend time alone, keeping her distance from others.

However, by chance, she became a dedicated fan of Nonoka Tachibana and followed her activities passionately until the end. Feeling adrift after her favorite idol retired, Mei starts to feel a mix of emotions when she encounters Kano, who is being true to herself.

323828.description: [Ren's](https://anilist.co/character/309910/Ren-Adashino) younger sister who attends an all girls' school. She is initially distrustful of [Sumireko](https://anilist.co/character/296535/Sumireko-Ogawa) and is weak to sweets.

323829.description: Manami is a teacher at an all girls' school who is sensitive to potential bullying. However, she does her best to encourage her students' dreams.

324201.description: They are an Executive of the Villainous Army and was shown hiding in the Blue Garrison. They're assigned the codename "Rooster".

324330.description:
Alabaster, the Great Sage. Called Gramps by Satou and Hime.
Was able to create a portal to Earth, taking Hime with him to protect her and the Ring of Light.

Is very knowledgeable about the Ring King, the Abyss, magic, and the world.



Was involved with Sumaragdi at some point in his youth and the two were in love. He left to spare her the pain of seeing him grow old, since she will live much longer, being an elf.

324709.description: A member of the Alpha Class and Blue Moon Party. Despises and looks down on commoners.

324711.description:
Shougo Rikudo is a retired archaeologist living in Nirai-Kanai. He is the uncle of Haruka and Megumi, and welcomes Ayato into his household. Soft-spoken and wise, he helps to ground the other characters. He is an expert at shogi and at Japanese calligraphy.

~!It is revealed that it was Professor Rikudo and his assistant Shirow Watari who found Maya and Quon at the shrine, and that Maya was raised as Rikudo's adoptive daughter, making him Ayato's grandfather.

Rikudo has an equally prominent position in the movie as in the series, and he takes on a greater importance in telling the story. In the movie, he is the one to encourage Haruka to join Ayato.
!~

(Source: Wikipedia)

325224.description: Kasamatsu is a member of the Taiyō Sphinx. He is the second-largest lineman on the Pyramid Line, though he is more rotund than muscular.

325684.description: A ranger who is a member of the Red Battalion with the rank of Third Class.

325685.description: A ranger who is a member of the Pink Battalion with the rank of Junior First Class.

325994.description:
After assembling a group of other Blighted, he created the Assassin's Guild, acting as its leader. Known as the Phantom Blighted, his power will teleport him to random locations regardless of his own will. He was originally the third son of the noble family who ruled the territory of Lordost. He formed his team of Blighted in order to oppose his relatives, who dominate Lordost with political power. Kind-hearted and caring, the Assassin’s Guild looks to him for their direction, until... 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

326377.description:
An idol who claims to be forever 17 and the strongest in the galaxy. She has been active for a long time and is always full of motivation and perseverance.

~!In actuality, she is 31-years-old and mother to [Ariel](https://anilist.co/character/332268/).!~

name.native: エルファリア・アルヴィス・セルフォルト

326398.description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")
__Race:__ Lyzance

A true prodigy and the youngest Magia Vander in history, she watches over a certain young man from her windowsill in the Tower. Those close to her say she is an easygoing Magia Vander who likes to play the saint. [Will's](https://anilist.co/character/212394/Will-Serfort) childhood friend who specializes in ice magic.

326408.description: A boy whose job is introducing travelling bodyguards in the village of Viridis. The sword passed down from his father holds great value to him.

326488.description: Powerful and merciless leader figure whose name will strike fear into the hearts of the villains. Original founder of the Suicide Squad and head of A.R.G.U.S. She is willing to sacrifice the lives of the villains to achieve her purpose.

326489.description: Elite solider who commands the villains. Ultra stoic. Although he is supposed to oversee the villains, often thrown away by their chaotic natures.

326490.description: Ruthless cursed sword wielder. Mysterious figure that stands in Harley’s way. She accomplishes her mission with a cursed sword known as the “Soul Taker”.

326491.description: Princess of the kingdom in another world. She loves her people but is too shy to speak out against her mother, Aldora’s orders. She is fascinated by the free-spirited Harley.

326492.description: Queen of the kingdom in another world. She rules the kingdom and commands the war with the empire with her unwavering majesty. She tends to be harsh with Fione.

326493.description: The knight commander of the kingdom in another world. Once known as the savior of the kingdom, he was rewarded with legendary armor. He is a serious and worldly man. He is deeply devoted to Fione and cares for her.

326719.description: Emma is an FBI agent investigating the deaths of [Joe](https://anilist.co/character/326717/Higan)'s family and partners with [Moriss](https://anilist.co/character/326720/Moriss-Mike).

326863.description: [Asuma Mutsumi's](https://anilist.co/character/89546/Mutsumi-Asuma) older brother. He is a student teacher who teaches at the same school Asuma is attending.

327168.description: FBI Branch Director. Formerly Mike Moriss's partner.

327305.description: Scharf is a third-class mage and member of the eighth party along with Wirbel and Ehre for the First Class Mage Examination.

name.native: クラーク・ダーウィン

327838.description:
Ronald is the new school principal who replaced the previous headmaster on the King's orders. Unlike his predecessor, Ronald is supportive of [Yumiella](https://anilist.co/character/208534/Yumiella-Dolkness) and acts as the messenger between her and the King.

~!He is actually part of the Hillrose family and is [Eleanora](https://anilist.co/character/319862/Eleanora-Hillrose)'s older brother.!~

327839.description: The kingdom's queen and [Edwin](https://anilist.co/character/313858/Edwin-Valschein)'s mother. Like her husband, she is more respectful to [Yumiella](https://anilist.co/character/208534/Yumiella-Dolkness).

327840.description: Adolf is a general and the captain of the knights. He is level 60, one of the strongest in the kingdom before Yumiella.

327841.description: The kingdom's ruler and [Edwin](https://anilist.co/character/313858/Edwin-Valschein)'s father. Unlike his son, he is more supportive of [Yumiella](https://anilist.co/character/208534/Yumiella-Dolkness) and intends to use her to help in their fight against the Demon Lord.

327988.description: Will's familiar and pet. Kiki is a carbuncle, capable of casting reflective magic to protect Will in emergencies.

alternative: Jikuu no Ossan (時空のおっさん)

328513.description: Collaborator of the Adashino siblings. He lives in another dimension, helping people who are lost.

328514.description: Moved to the city from the countryside due to family issues and works in a maid cafe. She is looking for her friend Tomoko, who went missing a year ago.

328515.description: [Oto's](https://anilist.co/character/323828/Oto-Adashino) friend. Her family runs a hospital but she dreams of being an idol.

328631.description:
A runaway girl that aspires to become a professional musician.
She works various part time jobs to fund her band activities.

328633.description: After being helped to get back at her bullies, she becomes best friends with [Sara](https://anilist.co/character/318361/Odin-Sara).

328634.description:
She works at the largest detective agency in Gifu Prefecture and was Souske's junior while he still worked there.
She specializes in breaking up couples.

328636.description: A punk that offers [Livia](https://anilist.co/character/321906/Woodis-Livia) shady jobs.

329053.description: The "idiot second son" of the head of Tarui Village in the northern region. He was selected as an attendant to the young prince by chance and began working at the imperial court. When he was young, he got lost in the forest and was saved by an unknown crow.

329054.description: The third daughter of the Northern House, with pale complexion and jet black hair. She is a quiet girl who appears frail. In the Cherry Blossom Palace, she resides in the Winter Hall.

329056.description: The wife of the Emperor. As Empress, she exerts her political power. Originally from the Southern House, she schemes to have her son [Natsuka](https://anilist.co/character/329059/) succeed her husband. In the previous Rite of Ascension, she went by the name Yuuzemi.

329057.description: An Imperial princess who is the younger sister of the Crown Prince. Because her tutor was Asebi’s mother, she affectionately refers to Asebi as “big sister.” She acts a bit childish for her age.

329058.description: The Crown Prince of Yamauchi, said to be the true golden raven. His real name is Nazukihiko but goes by Sumimaru when incognito. He is the half-brother of Natsuka and although he has an exceptionally beautiful appearance, his personality is quite the opposite.

name.native: ディアン=ディ=サルーム

329066.description:
The fourth prince of the Saloum Kingdom, and one of Lloyd's older brothers. While he had a fondness for magic from an early age, due to a lack of talent, at age 10 he chose to pursue blacksmithing instead, traveling to the neighboring kingdom of Bartram for his education in the subject. His dream is to create swords enchanted with magical power, with an eye towards establishing a Magic Swordsman Corps in Saloum. A dedicated craftsman with a rough edge, but a kind heart. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

name.native: アルベルト=ディ=サルーム

329067.description:
The second prince of the Saloum Kingdom, and one of Lloyd's older brothers. The current heir to the throne with both martial and academic ability. Often at the center of attention in the palace, but lacking in arrogance, he treats his subordinates with care and has earned the backing of many parties. Albert has recognized Lloyd's talent with magic where others have overlooked it, and considers him a potential valuable ally for the future. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

name.native: アリーゼ=ディ=サルーム

329068.description:
The sixth princess of the Saloum Kingdom, Lloyd's older sister. With her personal maid, Eris, she keeps a menagerie of her favorite animals in the castle's "Boxed Garden Tower", and spends her days leisurely looking after them. A laid-back and absent-minded girl who, much like her brothers, dotes on Lloyd. She possesses a magical power that lets her subconsciously connect with animals and monsters, resulting in even high-level creatures like a lesser fenrir being among her pets. She believes this is purely the result of the affection she shows them 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

329069.description:
One of the four wild bearwolf monsters that live in the forest. After being doused in Lloyd's magic power he transforms into a white, fluffy form, earning him the name "Shiro." With a keen sense of smell and a massive body, he can transport Lloyd and Sylpha around with ease. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

name.native: ミスマル・コウイチロウ

329693.description: One of Shirokusa's only friends at Hozomino High School.

name.native: アンジェリカ・ディルムット

330276.description: She is the eldest daughter of the Duke of Diarmuid, a distinguished family that unites the noble people of the north, and a second-class knight in the Royal Knights. She is known as "Flash Angelica" for her high-speed combat skills using the strengthening magic "Shunkyaku". Although she can be a little harsh in her words, she is a hard worker and shows a caring side towards her siblings.

name.native: ラスター・ディルムット

330277.description: The eldest son of the Duke of Diarmuid and Angelica's older brother. A genius adventurer who was promoted to A rank at the age of 17, he boasts the strongest A-rank magical abilities. He is also infamous for being an "F-rank crusher" who participates in mock battles for the E-rank exam as an examiner and crushes test-takers.

name.native: フリード・ディルムット

330278.description: He is the second son of the Duke of Diarmuid and Angelica's younger brother. At just 11 years old, he is said to have the ability to control magic that is comparable to C rank, far surpassing all other candidates taking the E rank promotion exam. Perhaps because he was raised as a child prodigy and expected great things from those around him, he acts high and mighty and pompous.

330742.description: He is the First Prince of the Kingdom of Clays; his full name is Rein Clays. Possessing a calm and composed demeanor, he also serves as an aide to the King of Clays.

330743.description: One of the Six Sovereigns who safeguard the Kingdom of Clays. He has been bestowed the title of "Magic Saint"—the highest rank attainable by a Mage—and also serves as an instructor at the School of the Mage in the Royal Capital.

330744.description: One of the Six Sovereigns who serve as guardians of the Kingdom of Clays. He has been bestowed the title of "Sword Saint"—the highest rank attainable by a swordsman—and also serves as an instructor at the School of the Swordsmen in the Royal Capital.

330745.description:
A knight of the Kingdom of Clays and deputy commander of the Warrior Corps. She possesses a special defensive ability known as the “Divine Shield,” which she uses to serve as [Lynne's](https://anilist.co/character/330746/Lynne) bodyguard. 

A former orphan, she was taken in by the “Shield Saint” [Dandalg](https://anilist.co/character/330747/Dandalg), who taught her how to wield her power.

alternative: Linneburg Clays (リンネブルグ・クレイス)

330746.description:
The First Princess of the Kingdom of Clays, her full name is Linneburg Clays. She excels in every conceivable ability, having graduated from the Royal Capital Training Academy with the highest scores in its history across all disciplines. She has comprehensively mastered skills spanning all six elemental systems. 

She was once attacked by a monster and saved from a perilous situation by [Noor](https://anilist.co/character/213554/Noor); ever since, she has looked up to him and affectionately addresses him as Sensei.

330747.description:
One of the Six Sovereigns who serve as guardians of the Kingdom of Clays. He holds the title of "Shield Saint"—the highest distinction attainable by a Warrior—and also serves as an instructor at the School of the Warrior in the Royal Capital. 

He is [Ines's](https://anilist.co/character/330745/Ines-Harness) adoptive father; having taken her in from an orphanage, he taught her how to harness her powers.

330748.description: One of the Six Sovereigns who safeguard the Kingdom of Clays. He has been bestowed the title of "Healing Saint"—the highest rank attainable by a Cleric—and also serves as an instructor at the School of the Cleric in the Royal Capital.

330749.description: One of the Six Sovereigns who safeguard the Kingdom of Clays. He holds the title of "Hidden Saint"—the highest rank among Thieves—and also serves as an instructor at the School of the Thief in the Royal Capital.

330750.description: One of the Six Sovereigns who safeguard the Kingdom of Clays. She has been bestowed the title of "Bow Saint"—the highest rank among Rangers—and also serves as an instructor at the School of the Ranger in the Royal Capital.

330751.description:
He is the King of the Kingdom of Clays—the nation that houses the world's oldest labyrinth, the "Labyrinth of No Return"—and the father of [Lynne](https://anilist.co/character/330746/Lynne) and [Rein](https://anilist.co/character/330742/Rein). In his days as an adventurer, he explored the "Labyrinth of the Lost" alongside the Six Sovereigns, ultimately discovering the Black Blade deep within its innermost depths. 

Although he has since retired from adventuring, he remains one of the kingdom's most formidable assets; having sensed the ominous atmosphere now shrouding the nation, he remains on high alert.

name.native: モーリオン・ノバティ・ノカナティカ

331075.description:
__Stand:__ Bigmouth Strikes Again

He is introduced as an antagonist who stalks Jodio Joestar and his allies to try retrieving the Lava Rock. His Stand lets him disguise with his surroundings and confuse his enemies' perceptions.
~!It is revealed that he was searching for the Lava Rock believing it was connected to the disappearance of his brother Mauka.!~

331128.description: A mermaid VTuber with 800,000 followers. She calls her fans Small Fries (Zako) and tries to cheer them up by giving them advice on stream.

name.native: リアーナ・オーウェンザウス

331143.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

Born to the knight family of Owenzaus. Her abilities have made her the best in her year and earned her the nickname of "Miss Perfect." She specializes in thunder magic.

331549.description: Captain of the Special Search Unit of The Red Coats.

334149.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

The leader of the gal group, a classmate. She is a former reader model and a fashion enthusiast.

335883.description: A kind-hearted boy with the special ability to communicate freely with monsters. He is a descendant of the demon race, considered an abhorrent existence that has long since gone extinct, and spent a very unhappy childhood working for a slave trader.

335884.description: He serves as the Vice-Commander of the Spearman Corps—the guardians of the Kingdom of Clays—and bears the title of "Spear Saint." Possessing an unrivaled passion for battle, he once traveled far and wide in search of worthy opponents. He is a disciple of [Sig](https://anilist.co/character/330744/Sig), the "Sword Saint," and wields a spear.

336995.description: She is the lead guitarist of Diamond Dust who uses a Deep Candy Apple Red ESP Horizon-I electric guitar.

337003.description: The vocalist and rhythm guitarist of Diamond Dust after Momoka's departure, and a former friend of Nina. She uses a See-Through Purple Fernandes NTG-LTD electric guitar.

339201.description: He was expected to be a rising star in the world of high school boxing, but was injured during a match. He was then found to be compatible with Beethoven's gift and transferred to the private Gloria Academy. He is typically innocent and generous, but he is also a bit quick to put up a fight. He is the type of person who operates based on his senses.

339202.description: He has loved classical music since he was a child and is now a talented composer. While attending Gloria Private School, he has been recognized for his prodigious musical talent and exceptional appearances. He is also active as a new artist. He is a serious and hardworking person, but is also stubborn.

339203.description: He showed talent on the piano from an early age and entered Gloria Academy, a private school with great prospects for the future. He has also been performing in the hip-hop music scene and has a high level of physical ability. He also excels at acrobatic dancing. Despite his cute looks, he has a sharp tongue.

339204.description: Born in a family of traditional performing arts, his expressive skills as an onnagata are of a level on par with a high school student. He is also active as a model. He appears to be a friendly, easy-going person with a sense of distance from both men and women, but in fact is actually an attentive person. Contrary to his appearance, he has a strong masculine side and is very particular about keeping his promises and responsibilities.

339294.description:
__Instrument:__Tenor Saxophone
Chikao is a first year during Kumiko's first year.

name.native: ニャンタン・キキーパット
オーティス・フラネガン
alternative: Rat Catcher (ラットキャッチャー)

339585.description: Former rat exterminator who can communicate with rats.

339588.description: Brilliant but mad scientist with huge ego. He enhances his abilities and manipulates minds with a “Thinking Cap” worn on his head.

339592.description: An ancient witch, who inhabits the body of a kind woman named June Moon.

340135.description:
__Instrument:__Flute
Kotoko is a third year during Kumiko's first year.

340139.description:
__Instrument:__Bassoon
Mikino is a third year during Kumiko's first year.

340141.description:
__Instrument:__Clarinet
Hirone is a third year during Kumiko's first year.

340145.description:
__Instrument:__Clarinet
Sakiko is in her third year during Kumiko's third year.

340146.description:
__Instrument:__Alto Saxophone
Shinobu is a second year during Kumiko's first year.

340147.description:
__Instrument:__Alto Saxophone
Hiroe is a third year during Kumiko's first year

340148.description:
__Instrument:__Alto Saxophone and Soprano Saxophone
Kiriko is a third year during Kumiko's first year.

340151.description:
__Instrument:__Bass Clarinet
Hitoshi is a third year during Kumiko's first year.

340153.description:
__Instrument:__Trumpet
Sana is a third year during Kumiko's first year.

340189.description:
__Instrument:__Flute
Tsune is a third year during Kumiko's first year.

340193.description:
__Instrument:__Trombone
Hideri is a third year during Kumiko's first year.

340195.description:
__Instrument:__Bass Trombone
Keina is a second year during Kumiko's first year.

340197.description:
__Instrument:__Horn in F
Juri is a third year during Kumiko's first year.

341269.description: He sits at the top of the Demon King's army, and is the one who recognized Uchimura's abilities and summoned him to another world. He is calm, collected, and has foresight, and is perfectly considerate of his subordinates, making him an ideal boss for Uchimura.

name.native: ウチムラ デンノスケ

341270.description:
A dull office worker who was demoted to a factory overseas.
The Demon King of another world recognizes his work skills and scouts him to be one of the four heavenly kings of the Demon King's army.
With the desire to work hard under a boss who recognizes his abilities, he makes a fresh start at his new workplace in the Demon King's army.

341271.description: One of the four heavenly kings of the Demon King's army.

342332.description: She is an assassin like [Yuki](https://anilist.co/character/207175/Yuki) and from the same organization as her.

name.native: イドラ・アーヴォルン
テルティナ・リズ・ワーグレイ ・アヴァルロスト

343078.description:
__Stand:__ Glory Days

An agent and investigator affiliated with HOWLER. He works together with Lulu.

343080.description:
__Stand:__ Bags Groove

A young girl who works for HOWLER and uses her Stand to inflict illness upon anyone that touches the company's original land deeds. She's paired up with Agent Bobby Jean, whom she often begs to buy her various items and even demands he adopts her.

343917.description: Kotarou's classmate. A gal-type girl who admires celebrities.

343918.description: Kotarou's classmate. A modern girl who wants to be pampered on social media.

343925.description: Mami and Maika's father. A househusband often mistaken for a schoolboy.

344106.description: [Monica's](https://anilist.co/character/249404) familiar. Although it has the appearance of a black cat, it can understand and speak human language. When Monica looks distressed, it will let her touch its paws to soothe her. It has trouble remembering the names of humans other than Monica. However, it likes reading novels written by humans, and is a big fan of the novelist Dustin Gunther.

344110.description: A first-year student in the high school division at Serendia Academy, she is the daughter of Count Kerbeck. She is one of the few people who knows [Monica](https://anilist.co/character/249404)'s true identity, the Silent Witch, and is indebted to her for helping her exterminate the pterodragons that were causing a dragon plague in the lands of Count Kerbeck. She helps Monica out behind the scenes at Serendia Academy, and sometimes even plays the role of a villainess, pretending to bully Monica, who is set up to be Isabelle's caretaker.

345368.description: Nagi is a graduate student majoring in mineralogy. She is intelligent, patient, and passionate about her field of study.

345369.description: Ruri is a high schooler with a love for pretty gemstones, which leads her to become interested in mineralogy.

347588.description: He is the owner of Taihei Koshinsho. On the surface, he is a good-natured middle-aged man who works to correct dangerous areas in the park for the sake of children. But he is a villain in reality who commits fraud, blackmail, kidnapping, and murder for money.

347650.description: Parkour specialist originally from Brazil. He has outstanding physical abilities and is a quick thinker, who can fly through the city like a bird. He is famous for his numerous jailbreaks.

347652.description: Originally from Nigeria. He's an intelligent man who creates strategies as the brains of the team, and hides his warm heart behind a calm and collected demeanor. As a student, he studied physics and had a great respect for [Dr. Skinner.](https://anilist.co/character/347658/Skinner) He has a high-strung and prideful personality.

347653.description:
Originally from Russia. She has a lively and frank personality, allowing her to get along with anyone. She acts as a gun specialist, who can use any type of gun. She is also a heavy drinker and optimist.

~!Christine is not her real name, she changed her face and identity after defecting from Russian intelligence.!~

347654.description: Originally from Canada. His special skill is piloting drones. He seems like a normal dumb middle school student, but has a complicated family situation which is kept secret. He is skilled at reading the room but never says his real intentions. His hobby is ego surfing.

alternative: Mad Screamer (マッド・スクリーマー)

347655.description: Originally from Hong Kong. Although she seems unsociable and is bad at listening to what others say, she is actually a famous hacker under the name "Mad Screamer."

347656.description:
Leader of Lazarus. She has a lot of influence on both nations and large corporations, and does her job without being carried away by emotions. She is an angry and terrifying woman.

~!She used to work with Skinner as a fellow researcher at the Hague.!~

347657.description: Director of the National Security Agency (NSA). He is always unfazed, calm, and rational, to the point his colleagues questioned if he is secretly an AI.

347658.description: Skinner is a three-time Nobel Prize winning scientist. He suddenly disappeared three years ago. He is the inventor of the cure-all drug Hapna, and was seen as a saint for donating his patent and prize money to solving world issues.

name.native: アーサー・レイウィン

347710.description:
In his former world, he lived as someone who stood on the top of his country in terms of combat and authority, until he was assassinated one day. However after dying as King Grey, he reawoke as Arthur Leywin as if he wasn’t assassinated.

After being reincarnated into the Leywin Family, Grey decided that, unlike his previous life, he would live this life to the fullest. To be loved, and surrounded by the friends and family he was void of in his past life.

347837.description: An AI maid robot gifted to [Liam](https://anilist.co/character/292833/Banfield-Sera-Liam) on his fifth birthday by his mother, before she and her husband abandoned the Banfield domain for the Imperial Capital Planet.

347838.description: A malevolent emotion eater, who feeds on misery, despair, and other negative emotions. He made Liam's life hell by helping his cheating wife frame him for tons of things. Because Liam keeps on succeeding in the new world despite the Guide's best efforts to bring misery, Liam continues to hold the misapprehesion that the Guide is his benevolent guardian, with his feelings of gratitude hurting and starving the Guide.

348163.description: An original character Alice created when she was younger.

349521.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

An unruly lone wolf known for his superhuman resilience, he eagerly awaits his opportunity to take the title of X with his indomitable fighting spirit.

(Source: Official Site)

349522.description:
__Height:__ 180cm

Former employee at an advertising agency in charge of producing commercials for [Nice](https://anilist.co/character/362412) and [Moon](https://anilist.co/character/361972). After being fired from his job, he witnesses Nice's apparent suicide and is found at the scene by [Juan](https://anilist.co/character/361976). She and her men take Ling Lin and begin the process of turning him into the hero Nice.

349528.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

A cool-headed hero who completes his mission without uttering a single word. He is loved by his many fans for the silence with which he completes his work and for the chiseled, handsome face behind the mask.

(Source: Official Site)

349529.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Half of a hero duo that's become famous for their mascot-like charm. Once Big Johnny goes berserk, only Little Johnny can stop him.

(Source: Official Site)

349530.description:
A university student who works part-time as an actor playing E-Soul in a Children's Theater. He dreams of being reunited with E-Soul, who saved his life as a young child.

(Source: Official Site)

351117.description: Allen lives in a small, nameless pioneer village. His status is serf. Although he is ostensibly without talent, he actually has the world's only "Summoner" class. In fact, he was an enthusiastic gamer in his previous life, and with his experience and enthusiasm of clearing unreasonably high-difficulty games, he challenges the "hell mode" of another world.

353223.description: A first-year student at Sumomogaoka High School and Kana's classmate. She has a friendly personality. She is a member of the track and field club.

name.native: フィッセル・ハーベラー
アリューシア・シトラス
クルニ・クルーシエル
ロスト・ベートーヴェン
ロスト・ヴィヴァルディ

354101.description: Minami is Mutsumi's mother. She's a famous actress.

name.native: ヴァイパー・ ロードペント
ルーシー・ダイアモンド
ヘンブリッツ・ドラウト

355112.description: An engineer from the Seventh Imperial Weapons Factory.

name.native: クリスティアナ・レタ・ローズブレイア

355113.description: Former "Princess Knight" of the Holy Kingdom of Rosebreyer, captured by Goaz's pirate gang and subjected to inhumane torture after the destruction of her home. She and other victims are rescued by Liam after defeating Goaz's fleet.

355133.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

A junior who transferred to [Saito Houjou](https://anilist.co/character/248386/Houjou-Saito)'s high school.

A girl who possesses both childlike innocence and a captivating aura. She's free-spirited and clingy, and she loves [Akane](https://anilist.co/character/248384/Sakuramori-Akane) very much.

355259.description:
Tessia is an elf girl who was taken captive by slave traders in the forest and later crossed paths with Arthur. Her upbringing made her wary and reserved, but after meeting Arthur, she gradually became more cheerful and started smiling more often.

(Source: Official Site)

name.native: ジャスミン・フレームスワース

355260.description:
Jasmine is a member of the adventurer party "Twin Horns" and a former comrade of Arthur’s parents. Although she is quiet and struggles to socialize, she is a skilled Augmenter who wields dual blades and is known for her sharp observational skills and high learning ability.

(Source: Official Site)

355415.description: A master swordsman hired to teach Liam while claiming expertise in the Way of the Flash style. He is later revealed to be a fraud who taught nonsensical techniques, intending only to collect a payment. After Liam miraculously develops incredible swordsmanship skills from the erroneous instruction, the master flees, fearing execution for his deception.

355416.description: Goaz is the leader of the pirate fleet.

name.native: ブライアン・ボーモント

355417.description: A butler in service to House Banfield since the days of Liam's great-grandfather.

name.native: シャウハ・シェムハザール

355488.description: Shau’ha Shemyazal is the current Royal Scepter and Yihdra's rival.

355494.description: Meiko was the wife of [Kouichi Kago](https://anilist.co/character/197162/Kouichi-Kago) and sponsored [Tsukasa's](https://anilist.co/character/197163/Tsukasa-Akeuraji) skating career

name.native: ザイロ・フォルバーツ

355722.description: The former captain of the Federated Kingdom's Fifth Order of the Holy Knights and the now de facto leader of Penal Hero Unit 9004. He was sentenced to be a hero for the crime of killing the goddess [Senerva](https://anilist.co/character/387992/Senerva). He would later meet and reluctantly make a contract with [Teoritta](https://anilist.co/character/355726), the "Goddess of Swords".

name.native: ベネティム・レオプール

355723.description: The commander of the Punisher Heroes Squad 9004. He is a rare conman who attempted to sell off the royal palace to a circus. His eloquence and deception skills make him appear competent at first glance, but in reality he's a weakling with no guts. He always delivers "bad news" in a hurry.

name.native: パトーシェ・キヴィア

355724.description: Captain of the 13th Holy Knights. She was originally supposed to make a pact with the Goddess [Teoritta](https://anilist.co/character/355726/Teoritta). She is a serious and righteous holy knight, but can also be strict and harsh in her words. She is willing to sacrifice her own life and the life of the hero for the Goddess.

355725.description: An unparalleled petty thief, responsible for over a thousand thefts. He impulsively attempts to steal anything, from the Goddess's coffin to completely meaningless objects, and possesses the skill to actually steal anything. He has excellent low-light vision and is sensitive to presences, but is extremely timid.

355726.description: The Sword Goddess who made a contract with [Xylo](https://anilist.co/character/355722/Xylo-Forbartz). She summons numerous swords, including holy swords and demon swords. While possessing a high sense of self-worth and a fondness for being praised, she also exhibits a characteristic goddess-like trait of engaging in self-sacrificing actions.

356922.description: A mysterious person involved with [Miyuki Hebinuma.](https://anilist.co/character/205053/Miyuki-Hebinuma) He is trying to track down people involved in the secrets of Kowloon and discover the truth of the city.

357387.description: A former office worker who loves eating and bathing. After being reincarnated in another world (Madeus), he makes use of his various supernatural powers (gifts) to collect and sell rare materials, working as a "material gatherer."

358221.description: The main character. Yuri suffers from memory loss. They are embroiled in a debate over the search for the Gnosia that have infiltrated the Interstellar Cruiser D.Q.O.

358222.description: As a Federal Galactic Army Special Forces solider, they are in charge of the elimination of the Gnosia. They often support [Yuri](https://anilist.co/character/358221/Yuuri), who has lost their memory.

358223.description: A somewhat stubborn and strange girl, she tends to lighten the atmosphere with her carefree attitude. Her behavior makes it extremely difficult to figure out just what is genuine and what is false.

358224.description: Her indifferent-seeming demeanor gives an impression of coldness, but she’s actually a very warm-hearted woman. Constantly searching internally for answers as to what exactly she needs to do, and the meaning of her very existence.

358225.description: A non-binary-identifying crew member with a sharp tongue and a penchant for flair. They place high importance on logic and are quick to cast doubt even on their closest allies.

358430.description:
__Level:__  800
__Species:__  Human

A human woman who represents the **Maiden** of Lufas's Twelve Heavenly Stars. A direct descendant of the "Aeneas Family", a race of primordial humans created by the goddess to act as her agents. Since Lufas was sealed by the heroes, she retired to the city of Vanaheimr, which she used a barrier to make an uninhabited sanctuary.

358730.description: Shouko is [Ruri](https://anilist.co/character/345369)'s classmate. She's been interested in mineralogy for her whole life.

358731.description: Youko is a university student majoring in mineralogy. She works closely with [Nagi](https://anilist.co/character/345368)

358732.description: Aoi is Ruri's friend and classmate.

358989.description:
Baiku Manabe is a motorcycle instructor at the JET driving school. 

He often uses the phrase "B. K. B." This is a reference to Fumitaka Kawasaki, who is his Japanese voice actor, as well as a comedian known for using this phrase in his routine. 

His name comes from the words "学ぶ (まなべ)" which means learn/study, and the Katakana spelling of bike/motorcycle, "バイク" respectively.

name.native: フェリクス・アーク・リディル

359150.description:
__Height:__ 161.8 cm

The second prince of the Kingdom of Ridill. He is a third-year student in the high school division of Serendia Academy, one of the most prestigious schools in the Kingdom of Ridill, and serves as student council president. His maternal grandfather is Duke Crockford, one of the most powerful men in the country. He is embroiled in a battle for the throne to become the next king of the Kingdom of Ridill, and is frequently targeted by assassins. His handsome looks and refined intelligence have made him an object of admiration at the school. His face and body adhere to the golden ratio (according to [Monica](https://anilist.co/character/249404)).

359202.description:
A classmate of [Yoshiki.](https://anilist.co/character/281109/Yoshiki-Tsujinaka) Since childhood, she has been able to "hear" things that ordinary people cannot. She is tall, lively, and intelligent. 

(Source: Official Site)

359203.description:
A housewife who can "see" things that ordinary people cannot. She worries about [Yoshiki,](https://anilist.co/character/281109/Yoshiki-Tsujinaka) who is with a dangerous and terrifying presence, and warns him to stay away. 

(Source: Official Site)

359204.description:
A man who seems to be investigating something for a certain company. He is always carefree and elusive. He has a hamster as his partner. 

(Source: Official Site)

359899.description: A second-year student in the high school division at Serendia Academy, she is [Monica](https://anilist.co/character/249404)'s classmate. Her father is a wealthy merchant, and her family rose to the ranks of baron, so some of her classmates and nobles mock her and call her a "nouveau riche". She is strong-willed, so she doesn't care about such insults. As she comes from a family of merchants, she is well-informed about fashion. She speaks to Monica when she transfers to the school, and she become her first friend.

360741.description: A berserker who has been a member of the Hero Squad longer than anyone else. Because he has been resurrected as a hero so many times, he has lost his sense of self and the ability to think, and is unable to speak. His true identity and everything else about him are shrouded in mystery. His close combat abilities are monstrous, and he wields a giant battle axe as easily as a kitchen knife.

name.native: ノルガユ・センリッジ

360742.description: A terrorist who believed himself to be the true king of the United Kingdom and carried out a large-scale terrorist act against the royal family. Nicknamed "His Majesty." Although he displays an arrogant attitude, his concern for his people is genuine. He possesses exceptional talent in the art of Sacred Seal Tuning, which engraves sacred symbols.

363818.description:
Principal of Daikoku Aigo Academy.

~!Underwent a total of 72 reconstruction surgeries to maintain his youthful appearance.!~

363834.description: [Fuyumura](https://anilist.co/character/246681/Shiori-Fuyumura)'s best friend who mysteriously went missing.

name.native: ロゼ・マーブルハート

365040.description: Became famous at a young age as a genius pastry chef, and although he has the ability to go independent, he currently works as Kai Asakura's right-hand man at restaurant "K". As the sous chef at restaurant "K", he is the central figure who brings together the unique members of the team. He has a wealth of knowledge about wine and buys it himself. He is in charge of desserts.

365042.description: Employee of "K" who boasts cooking skills on a par with Katsuya Hotei and is highly regarded by Kai Asakura. In contrast to Hotei, who always has a stern expression, he never loses his smile even in the midst of chaos in the kitchen. He has a weakness for delicious food and highly praises the food made by Takeru, who has just arrived at "K". He is in charge of fish dishes.

365043.description: The only female chef at restaurant "K". Due to past events, she has complicated feelings towards the owner and chef, Kai Asakura. She is harsh towards Gaku Kitada, saying that he lacks spirit, but after she sets Gaku a challenge at Umi's command, she begins to change her opinion of him. She is in charge of side dishes.

365044.description: The head waiter (maitre d') in charge of restaurant "K". Age unknown. She calls Kai Asakura "Kai-sama" and has a distinctive laid-back way of speaking, but she is perfect at everything except cooking. In order to remember the faces of her customers at first glance, she quickly forgets about other people.

365045.description: Employee at restaurant "K." His family runs a traditional Kyoto restaurant, but he moved to Tokyo with a dream. He was inspired by the food he tasted at Kai Asakura before moving to Tokyo, and so he starts working at "K." He has a crush on Ranna Akamatsu.

365046.description: A genius mathematician studying abroad at a prestigious university. He has been friends with Kitada Gaku and Musashi Kagura since they competed in the Junior Mathematical Olympiad, but his talent blossomed in his junior high school days, causing Gaku to give up. He plans to one day hire the two as his assistants and challenge the truth of the universe.

365047.description: Talented girl who represented Japan in the Mathematical Olympiad and won a silver medal. She has been friends with Kitada Gaku and Hirose Ichitaro since they competed in the Junior Mathematical Olympiad, and has aspired to be a mathematician since she was a child. She is usually cool and collected, but when it comes to Gaku, she gets passionate.

365048.description: A classmate of Kitada Gaku at the prestigious private high school, Verus Academy. A bright and dedicated sports student, she became acquainted with Gaku through her part-time job at the student cafeteria. After graduating from the academy, she moved to Tokyo to train as a swimmer. Despite facing major obstacles, she cares about and supports Gaku, who is in a similar situation.

365938.description:
Classmate of [Yoshiki](https://anilist.co/character/281109/Yoshiki-Tsujinaka). A class clown with a shaved head.

(Source: Official Site)

365939.description:
Classmate of [Yoshiki.](https://anilist.co/character/281109/Yoshiki-Tsujinaka) Childhood friend of [Asako Yamagishi.](https://anilist.co/character/359202/Asako-Yamagishi)

(Source: Official Site)

366174.description: Former Associate Professor in the Departyment of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science at MIT, focusing on the development of AI systems capable of quantum-level processing. He developed the AI Naga and formed a commune that worships Naga as a God.

368782.description: Satoko is Yoshiki and Kaoru's mother. She works as a hairdresser.

368783.description: Hajime is a man living in Kubitachi. He's concerned about the state of the village and the Indou family ritual.

368784.description: Hara is a teacher at Kibogayama High.

368786.description: Tooru is a man living in Kubitachi. He's concerned about the state of the village and the Indou family ritual.

368791.description: Toshinori is Yoshiki and Kaoru's father. He has a rocky relationship with his family.

369272.description: Nanashima's younger sister. She is a fan of the anime Puri Puri Moon.

name.native: セシル・グランヴェル

369796.description: The willful young heiress of the Granvelle family, who own and lord over Allen's hometown. Her class is "Wizardess". She usually plays the role of a graceful daughter to her family, but shows her selfish side to her closest friends.

369797.description:
A serf girl with an innocent personality. Her natural class is "Sword Lord" - while her skills with swordplay already outpaced an adult's when she was five years old, she'd not good with using her head.

Loves to fight and plays knights with her childhood friend [Allen](https://anilist.co/character/351117/Allen).

369798.description:
The son of an arms dealer in Granvelle Village, Dogora is considered the bratty general of the kids there. He has a competitive personality and wears his heart on his sleeve. His natural talent is wielding axes.

He loves to tease [Allen](https://anilist.co/character/351117/Allen), who he considers lower than himself.

370389.description: An ancient dragon child who travels with Takeru. It is a reliable companion who excels in spirit arts and exploration abilities. It has a strong appetite and is very cute, but a smells little fishy.

370390.description: An elf who is skilled in combat using her twin daggers. She has a beautiful face, but unfortunately her behavior is too mischievous and she quickly becomes covered in dirt. She has a strong appetite.

372477.description: The Demon Lord is the final boss of the game _Light Magic and the Hero_. He uses dark magic and was once a human.

374199.description:
__Species:__  Human

One of the Seven Heroes, and one of Lufas' closest friends. Widely known as the "Sword King" Alioth, who sealed Lufas away 200 years ago.

374200.description:
__Level:__  500
__Species:__  Elf

One of the Seven Heroes and Lufas' close friend. In present day, he is called the "Wisdom King" as he rules the kingdom of Svel. After losing to the Demon King 200 years ago, he was cursed by him, leaving to the paralysis of his lower body and his strength only being half of what it used to be.

374201.description:
__Level:__  500
__Species:__  Heaven-Winged

One of Lufas' old friends and a member of the Seven Heroes, now known as the "Sky King" and ruler of Gjallarhorn. As a result of his loss against the demon king, he was cursed and lost his right wing, as well as half of his strength.

374855.description:
__Species:__  Demon

One of the Seven Luminaries, the Demon King's elite force. Despite his appearance, he likes to dispatch his opponents through cunning.

374856.description:
__Species:__  Demon

One of the Seven Luminaries, the Demon King's elite force. Has Fire affinity, and aims to kill the Seven Heroes to win the Demon King's favor.

name.native: エリック・イムガルト・メンディリバル

376523.description: Former leader of the Hero Party, Eric was born a chosen one from the royal family. His swordsmanship is S-rank, and his holy sword is SS-rank. After Luck's sacrifice, he was elected king for his achievements in defeating the demon army. He used his wealth and prestige to erect a statue of Luck and to spread word of his heroics around the country.

376524.description: Former S-ranked member of the Hero Party, Goran is an exceptionally strong fighter who can use fire magic with his greatsword. He is the current grandmaster of the Adventurer's Guild and the strongest warrior still active. Surprisingly, he's also very dexterous and does all of the housework.

name.native: ラック・ロック・フランゼン

376525.description:
An S-rank adventurer who told his teammates to leave him behind after monsters attack in a dungeon. He comes back ten years later, now younger, having beat all the monsters in the cave. Upon his return, he discovers he was made a hero and has had a statue erected of himself in the middle of the royal capital.

He meets up with his old friends, deciding to start over again, as an F-rank Adventurer, named Lock. He joins up with two other F-rank adventures, one a fireball caster, Ario, and an archer, Genie. Along the way he also meets a B-rank Adventurer, Sia.

376812.description: A lizardman warrior who belongs to the adventurer's guild "Europa." Although he can be a bit preachy, he is a veteran adventurer with a strong sense of justice and connections. He has a voracious appetite.

376813.description: A divine beast known as the Ancient Horse (Altatum Ecruus), its real name is Hofvalpnir. It guards a certain lake, but by chance accompanies [Takeru](https://anilist.co/character/357387/Takeru-Kamishiro) on his journey. A silent, expressionless beauty, but with a voracious appetite.

377492.description: A 6-year-old who has been reincarnated as the emperor’s thirteenth child, now holding the title of the Thirteenth Prince. On top of being born with a “status cheat,” he possesses an innate skill with no level cap and the ability to add the powers of those he commands to his own.

377493.description: A young maid who serves exclusively at Noah’s side. Attentive and meticulous in her work, she handles nearly all of Noah’s personal affairs, making her his closest support. Her loyalty runs deep, and she is always striving to be of help to him.

377494.description: Another maid serving Noah. Brilliant and quick-witted, she’s even been praised by Noah as “the smartest.” Thanks to her intelligence and precise execution, she enjoys his deep trust.

name.native: シャーリー・グランズ

377495.description: A talented young knight aiming to pass the knight selection exam. Serious and hardworking by nature, she hails from a poor village and is a little unfamiliar with courtly etiquette, but her sincerity and passion more than make up for it.

377496.description: The newest member among the maids. Innocent and openhearted, she tends to speak her mind without hesitation. Although still inexperienced, she’s doing her best to serve Noah wholeheartedly.

377497.description: A budding singer performing at a venue called Keith’s. She works diligently to pay off the debts left by her father. Her earnest attitude and steadily improving singing voice have begun to draw growing attention.

379905.description: [Mimori's](https://anilist.co/character/204418/) mother and [Hirotoshi's](https://anilist.co/character/375548/) step-mother. She is only 2 years older than Hirotoshi.

name.native: ギルバート・アララート

380216.description: The First Prince. He has a ruthless nature, showing no mercy in discarding those who are useless.

name.native: アルバート・アララート

380217.description: The Second Prince and Crown Prince. He has a cruel nature, constantly eyeing the emperor’s throne.

name.native: オスカー・アララート

380218.description: The Eighth Prince. He is known as the most benevolent among the princes.

name.native: ヘンリー・アララート

380219.description: The Fourth Prince. Among the princes, he is cautious by nature and excels in calm judgment.

380242.description: The rector of Daikoku Aigo Academy. In contrast to Principal Ooshibu, who constantly pursues youth, she has gracefully accepted her old age. She's still spry for her age, however...

name.native: アンハルト・ハルフレズ

380871.description:
__Height:__ 148 cm

[Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi) and [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena)'s classmate.

When younger, they disliked wearing the hand-me-down skirts from their older sisters, and asked for their brother's shorts instead, leading them to be criticized for not acting "like a girl" and causing problems for their family. At present, they are still figuring out their identity, and about relationships. They are intrigued by Mimi and Sheena's bond. Their favorite food is anything easy they can carry to their room.

380872.description:
__Height:__ 158cm

An upperclassman from class 16.

Esta puts on a cheery demeanor and is kind to both her juniors and classmates. She would often ignore her own health and lets others have priority when it comes to getting treatment, regardless of how bad her own condition might be.

She is roommates with a classmate named [Heather](https://anilist.co/character/402132/Heather).

name.native: キリカ・ローズクォーツ

381983.description: Allen's younger brother. His name has the meaning of "so that you will grow up to be a child who runs around freely". He became interested in spears after watching Allen and his friends play knights.

381984.description: The mother of [Allen](https://anilist.co/character/351117/Allen). She raises her children with a lot of love. She does not disown Allen, who is judged to have no talent, but accepts him gently.

381985.description: The father of [Allen](https://anilist.co/character/351117/Allen). Contrary to his wild appearance, he has a kind heart. He cares about his family very much. Besides, that, he's a hard worker. He is a serf in the pioneering village and plays an active role when hunting the demonic beast Boa.

381988.description: The eldest son of the Granvelle family. He is skilled in swordsmanship but is also a humble and gentle person who never shows off his skills to those around him.

382734.description:
[Goran’s](https://anilist.co/character/376524/Goran-Morton) only daughter. Although an F-rank warrior, her skills and combat abilities inherited from her father make her the equivalent to a B-rank. 

Also inherited her father’s personality, as she mistook Luck for his illegitimate son when she first met him. After learning the truth, she became Lock’s (self-proclaimed) first disciple.

382735.description: A B-ranked warrior. As the daughter of the wolf beastmen’s chieftain, she is skilled with hunting vampires, as their allure doesn’t work on beastmen.

382952.description: A renowned ruler who led the empire into its golden age. He is carefully observing which prince should become his successor.

name.native: ノクト・リーフレット

383729.description: She is Airi Arcadia’s roommate. She is a first year and one of the “Triad” who are the famous trio of the Royal Officer Academy.

383945.description: Duodecuple is the mysterious referee whose job is to host and manage the Zodiac Tournament and grant the winner's wish. The tournament is a proxy battle for control of the countries possessed and to control the betting on the outcome. He monitors the tournament in the presence of faceless VIP avatars.

388952.description: Hinako’s father and president of the Konohana Group.

388953.description: A young lady who sees Hinako as her rival. She's strict with herself but kind to others.

388955.description: Normally, she'a cool beauty with sharp eyes. However, in reality, she's shy and not very good at communicating.

388956.description: Cheerful and approachable, she's the mood maker of the group.

389131.description: The eponymous Chainsmoking Cat. Yaniko is so addicted to cigarettes that she will do anything for another smoke, no matter how degrading or gross it may seem, and attempts by others to help her quit smoking never last long.

389132.description: [Yaniko](https://anilist.co/character/389131/)'s younger sister who is a respected and responsible high school student. She often takes care of Yaniko's wellbeing.

389134.description: A girl who looks up to [Yaniko](https://anilist.co/character/389131/) as her senior. She secretly uses harder drugs in her apartment.

name.native: ゆるふわアナル天使ハメ子

389135.description:
[Yaniko](https://anilist.co/character/389131/)'s high school classmate and neighbor who loves playing fighting games, livestreaming, and uploading videos on her "Hame Channel". Easily angered and flustered when things do not go her way.

Born without a legal last name, she decided to register Easygoing\*Angel (ゆるふわ＊天使, Yurufuwa\*Tenshi) as her last name. However a city hall worker mistook the asterisk symbol for anus, hence giving her a rather awkward last name.

389136.description: A college student and amateur comedian from the Kansai region.

389137.description: A college student despite looking like a small girl with a massive hairdo. An alcoholic with a habit of wandering off to distant places when drinking outside her home.

389139.description: The only human neighbor of [Yaniko](https://anilist.co/character/389131/)'s apartment and a fellow smoker who works as a manga artist under a pseudonym, though her manga does not sell well. She sometimes asks Yaniko or other Beastfolk to assist with her manga, with mixed results.

395258.description: The landlord of the apartment building where most of the main cast live. Often the victim of [Yaniko](https://anilist.co/character/389131/)'s laziness, but very levelheaded despite his intimidating appearance.

397772.description:
A receptionist at the Adventurer's Guild headquarters.

She is usually kind, but stern with adventurers who attempt to take on reckless quests.

397773.description:
A mage and F-rank adventurer from the countryside. He meets Rock at the Adventurer's Guild headquarters and takes on quests alongside his younger sister, Ginny.

He can cast Fireball.

397774.description:
An F-rank adventurer and bow-wielding scout; she is Ario's younger sister. She met Rock at the Adventurer's Guild headquarters and, alongside Ario, accepted a quest to exterminate goblins.

She is sharp and observant, and excels as a scout.

400732.description: The school nurse at the school [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena) and her friends attend. She is skilled in healing magic and is indispensable to the school. She’s always looking out for [Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi).

404623.description:
A rooster possessed of divine power. It was worshipped as a sacred fowl by Lucilla's clan.

Its crow holds the power to "redraw boundaries," and it is said to have been the one to divide the world into day and night. Because of this power, it is the natural enemy of vampires and is constantly hunted by them.

406198.description:
A wolf spirit beast. It shares a common ancestry with the wolf-beastkin, and the two groups hold each other in mutual respect. 

It is very fond of Luck and Sia; it is intelligent and understands human speech.

406199.description:
A girl left all alone after losing her parents at a young age. She lost both the home and the grandfather who had raised her in their place, and ended up living in the sewers.

Despite her harsh circumstances, she remains cheerful and positive, always acting with the desire to be of help to others.

406200.description:
The sole survivor of a village of demon-kind that worshipped the divine rooster, Gerberga. As a member of the demon race, they possess immense magical power and extensive knowledge of magic.

After narrowly escaping a vampire attack, he used his mastery of illusion magic to single-handedly protect Gerberga from the vampires—and it was during this time that he met Luck.

408009.description: Healer of the group and a former priestess. Eventually became head of their religion's clergy, wife of King Erik and had daughters. She prefers fighting in close range than what her order prefers doing.

name.native: ローランド・ホルファート
